name: W rytmie biegu, w rytmie jeziora
Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 1. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event held in the Buseck/Alten-Buseck region. It comprises several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon (21.1 km). The races each start at 2:00 p.m. at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck and offer a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. The series promotes a sense of community with a series classification for participants who take part in all three races. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the fastest runners follow the finish.
course_highlights: Course profiles for 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km are available on Komoot
Start and finish at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck
Timing with a passive transponder from Raceresult
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. There is a series classification for participants who take part in all three races in the series. After finishing, runners receive a complimentary soft drink. Coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at the Harbig Hall. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, recognising the three fastest participants (men/women) in each race on the day, as well as the age-group winners at the end of the series. Winter running series, cross-country character, several race distances, community event in November 2026

name: Alzauenlauf TSV Trostberg

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 10 km: Männer und Frauen, Senioren und Seniorinnen: 22 €

description: The Alzauenlauf in Trostberg is a long-running event taking place on 14 November 2026. The 10 km main course runs through the picturesque Trostberg Alzauen, an idyllic wooded area along the Alz, the outflow of Lake Chiemsee. The course combines pleasant natural forest trails with a lap in the stadium, offering a varied running experience. Shorter distances are also available for children and young people. Refreshments are provided for all participants in the finish area, and changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Alois-Böck sports hall.
course_highlights: 10 km course through the picturesque Trostberg Alzauen on natural terrain
Start and finish in the stadium, with one and a half laps before the forest section
The course runs along the Alz, the outflow of Lake Chiemsee
additional: Bib collection from 10:30 to 13:00 at the Alois-Böck sports hall. Electronic chip timing, with the chip integrated into the bib. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Alois-Böck sports hall. Participants who register for the 10 km course at least 14 days before the race will receive a technical shirt; after that, shirts are available while stocks last. Late registration is possible for an additional fee of €5. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Refreshments are provided for everyone at the finish. Participants must accept the DLV terms and conditions. The event includes refreshments, changing rooms, showers and chip timing; online registration is available. Family-friendly and suitable for all age groups.

name: Bezirksmeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The District Cross-Country Championships in Velpke are a long-standing cross-country running competition organized by the NLV Braunschweig District. The event gives runners of various age groups, from children to Masters, the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The course crosses varied terrain and offers a challenging test for all participants. Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, and the event takes place on February 8, 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through varied terrain
Competition for children, youth, adults, and Masters
Organized by the NLV Braunschweig District in Velpke
additional: Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, at 23:59. The organizer is the NLV Braunschweig District. The event category is 6.4.2 District Championships. Cross-country terrain; registration deadline is February 1, 2026; various course distances, including children’s and youth categories.

name: Bokeler 6 Stundenlauf
description: The Bokeler 6-Hour Run is an established ultramarathon challenge in northern Germany, held in Bokel, Schleswig-Holstein. Participants run a loop course approximately 3.67 kilometres long, completing as many laps as possible in six hours. The event attracts endurance athletes looking to test their limits and offers a family-friendly atmosphere in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 3.67 km loop course
Flat terrain in Schleswig-Holstein
Six-hour run with individually determined distance
additional: The course is a loop that runners complete multiple times. The event is a longstanding tradition and takes place annually. Results from previous years are available on the website. The race is held on a 2,040 m loop course, with a growing number of participants and a legendary refreshment buffet. A participant record was set in 2023, and the event was already fully booked well in advance for 2024. November weather is usually cool and rainy, adding to the challenge.

name: Deutsche Polizeimeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The German Police Cross-Country Championships are the police’s official cross-country running championships and focus on competition within the police force. The event takes place in Ravensbergerwald in Potsdam and features distances of 3.6 km and 9 km. The races are part of a wider German running series regulated by the German Athletics Association (DLV), with officially measured courses and professional timing. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The race offers a challenging cross-country experience in typical November weather, with cool temperatures and frequent rain.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in Ravensbergerwald
Officially measured courses of 3.6 km and 9 km
Part of the DLV-regulated police championships
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, a low of 2 °C, an average of 45 mm of precipitation, and rainy days. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The event is not an open road race but is exclusively for police runners. It is not open to the general public and is organized within the police force. The challenging course includes uphill and downhill sections and sandy terrain.

name: Graal-Müritzer Schneckenlauf
description: The Graal-Müritz Schneckenlauf is a long-standing running event held annually at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium. Runners and walkers of all ages can choose from several distances, including a Bambini race, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and awards for the strongest classes and best teams. The Streuselschnecken pastries served after the finish are especially popular.
course_highlights: Red course: 2 km run
Blue course: 5 km and 10 km (2 x 5 km laps)
Start and finish at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium
additional: Start times: 10:00 a.m. Bambini race, 10:30 a.m. 2 km run, 11:00 a.m. 5 km and 10 km runs. Walkers start 5 minutes after the runners. Training for children takes place on Wednesdays from 4:30–6:00 p.m. in the sports hall at Ostseegrundschule. Traditional awards are given to the strongest class and best team. Streuselschnecken pastries are a popular post-race treat. The race takes place at the Forest Stadium. Advance registration is available, with categories for children and adults as well as team and class competitions.

name: Gudensberger Crosslauf 2026 Hermann Kilian Gedächtnislauf
description: The Gudensberg Crosslauf Hermann Kilian Memorial Run is a long-standing cross-country race in Gudensberg, offering short off-road distances. The start and finish are on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool on Schwimmbadweg. The course runs mostly on unpaved paths, and spikes are allowed, emphasizing its classic cross-country character. The event commemorates Hermann Kilian, a dedicated runner and coach with TSV Obervorschütz.
course_highlights: Start and finish on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool
Course mostly on unpaved paths; spikes allowed
Three distances: 1000m (two small laps), 2000m (two large laps), 4000m (one longer lap)
additional: Depending on the event announcement, district championships may be included. Typical November weather is expected, with temperatures around 7 °C and rainy days. November is usually rainy; the terrain has a cross-country style. The event honors Hermann Kilian for his dedication to running.

name: Herzowerke-Trail 2026
location: TSH sports grounds, Herzogenaurach, Bavaria, Germany
description: The 3rd Herzowerke Trail takes place on 14 November 2026 in Herzogenaurach. The trail starts and finishes at the TSH sports grounds and runs through the Dohnwald around the town. There are several distances from 0.5 km to 16 km; the longest distance can be run as one or two laps. This is a true forest trail, and poles are permitted. There are no refreshment stations along the course; refreshments are available only in the start and finish area. The event is organised by the running section of Turnerschaft Herzogenaurach.
course_highlights: Trail through the Dohnwald around Herzogenaurach
A true trail where poles are permitted
Refreshments only in the start and finish area; no support along the course
additional: There are several distances: 0.5 km Bambini Trail, 2 km Kids Trail, 4 km Youth Trail, 8 km Speed Trail and 16 km (one or two laps). Participants must be self-sufficient on the course; there are no drink or refreshment stations in the forest. Times, results and placings will be published online. The top three will be honoured. A trail with various distances, self-sufficiency required on forest sections, start and finish at the TSH sports grounds, results and placings online. Cold and wet November weather is possible.

name: Landesoffener Crosslauf des KLV Segeberg
description: The KLV Segeberg open cross-country race takes place every November in Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park. It offers races for children, youth, adults and Masters, with distances ranging from approximately 625 m to 7.9 km. The event is open to runners from across Schleswig-Holstein. The course runs across meadows, parks and wooded areas, offering a varied alternative to traditional road or track races. The event is organised by KLV Segeberg and Kaltenkirchener TS, which also hosts it on site.
course_highlights: Distances of approximately 625 m to 7.9 km
The course runs through Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park, across meadows, parks and wooded areas
Open event with categories for children, youth, adults and Masters
additional: Typical November weather, around 7 °C, with rainy days. The event is part of the KLV Segeberg cross-country championship series, which also includes other local club venues in the Segeberg district. Cross-country running in November in typical rainy weather, with temperatures around 2–7 °C, on an outdoor course, suitable for trail running and cross-country fans.

name: Potsdamer Cross im Rahmen der 22. DPM
description: The 2nd Potsdam Cross, held as part of the 22nd German Police Championships (DPM), takes place on November 14, 2026, in Potsdam. The event is organized and hosted by OSC Potsdam Luftschiffhafen e.V., Athletics Department. It offers runners the opportunity to compete in a challenging cross-country race and take part in a long-standing competition series. Registration is open until November 9, 2026.
course_highlights: Participation in the German Cross Championships (DPM)
Off-stadium course in Potsdam
Event held as part of a national championship
additional: The entry deadline is November 9, 2026; the scenic venue offers a varied cross-country course.

name: Waldlauf
location: Remsecker Waldlauf, Hochdorfer Wald, Büchenbach, Bayern, Germany
description: The Remseck Forest Run is a family-friendly race through the picturesque Hochdorf Forest, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers a range of distances, from a Bambini run and children’s and youth races to short, middle- and long-distance races. The varied forest trails, with muddy, uneven ground and small obstacles, make the race a memorable and adventurous experience. The run is organized by Sport- und Gesangverein Hochdorf e.V. and places great importance on community and experiencing nature.
course_highlights: All routes lead through the beautiful Hochdorf Forest
Muddy, uneven ground and narrow trails with small obstacles
A variety of distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Race number collection: Friday, 16:30–18:00, and Saturday from 9:30. Each participant receives a race number with an integrated chip. Recycled technical shirts can be ordered online as an option until 05.09.2026 (children €15, adults €20). Late registration is possible on the event day until 60 minutes before the start; the late registration fee is €3.

name: Zeiler Waldmarathon
location: Zeil am Main, Haßberge, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Zeil Forest Marathon takes place on 14 November 2026 in Zeil am Main and offers challenging running routes through the Haßberge Nature Park. The course runs mainly along paved forest paths, following a varied route over Schlossberg and Bischofsheimer Höhe and past several lakes. Events include the marathon, half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking over 21.1 km and 7.5 km. The event is organised by TV 1884 Zeil and features professional timekeeping with an integrated chip.
course_highlights: Challenging course through the Haßberge Nature Park, almost entirely on paved forest paths
Route over Schlossberg and Bischofsheimer Höhe and past the Seven Lakes
Aid stations every 5 km with mineral water, tea, isotonic drinks, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the Setzbachbrunnen in the Zeil am Main running park. Timekeeping with an integrated chip. Marathon runners can switch to the half-marathon course after one lap. Parking is available at the indoor swimming pool and school car parks, as well as the Tuchanger car park, with a city bus transfer. Race number collection is at the school on Friday evening and Saturday morning. Showers and changing facilities are available in the school gym. There is no baggage storage in the start/finish area. Free buses run every 5 minutes from the school building to the start line. The course runs almost entirely along paved forest paths in the Haßberge Nature Park. Aid stations are available every 5 km. Race numbers include a chip. Parking is available at the indoor swimming pool and school car park, and showers and changing facilities are available in the school gym. Medals are awarded to all participants after the race, and a free bus transfer is available.

name: Augsburger AOK-Winterlaufserie Südring
description: The Augsburg AOK Winter Running Series organized by TG Viktoria Augsburg consists of four races through the beautiful Western Forests Nature Park. The courses run through hilly terrain in the western forests of Augsburg and require good fitness and health. The event offers age-group rankings and an overall ranking with attractive prizes and trophies. The races take place on Saturdays and one Sunday in November and December and are a popular series for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Western Forests Nature Park
Hilly terrain with challenging sections
Course distances of approximately 2.8 to 3.2 km per race
additional: Race numbers are distributed in the start/finish area each time. Portable toilets are available at the Kathreinerstraße car park (races 1–3), and there is space to leave a change of clothes or luggage in a tent or pavilion (at your own risk). Finish refreshments include tea, water and a cake buffet at races 1–3; the fourth race also offers mulled wine and children’s punch. The overall awards ceremony takes place at the forest hut after the fourth race. Parking is available in Bergheim, on Kathreinerstraße and on surrounding streets, but not at the Bergheim sports clubhouse. Races take place in November, with distances ranging from approximately 2.8 km to 9.9 km. The meeting point is usually by the forest car park near Kathreinerstrasse and Brennhölzerweg in Augsburg-Bergheim. November weather can be cool and rainy.

name: ILM – Ich lauf mit gegen Gewalt
Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec is a traditional autumn trail race in the Plzeň area, offering scenic routes through nature with minimal asphalt. The race is intended both for fans of healthy outdoor exercise and for competitive athletes and elite trail runners. Choose from routes of 42 km with 700 m of elevation gain, 22.5 km, 7 km, and shorter children’s and youth routes, including a multigenerational relay. The race hub, start and finish are in the suburban district of Plzeň - Bílá hora. The organizers follow the motto “I don’t run on asphalt” and prepare a race focused on running in nature and enjoying beautiful views.
course_highlights: Scenic trails along both banks of the Berounka River valley
Forests around the Bolevec ponds
A climb to Krkavec with 700 m of elevation gain on the marathon route
additional: Three main routes are available (42 km, 22.5 km, 7 km), along with shorter children’s and youth routes, including a multigenerational relay. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup. The race hub is in the suburban district of Plzeň - Bílá hora. Terrain: trail, cross-country; the race takes place in November 2026; exact registration details are not provided.

name: BoBoBěh
description: BoBoběh is the final mountain race in the BoBoloppet trilogy, taking runners through the beautiful Jizera Mountains. The race offers a challenging 30 km course with climbs up Olivetská hora, a section across the Černá Nisa dam, and a tough ascent up Bílý Štolpich. A shorter 10 km course is available for less experienced runners, as well as a 1 km children’s MINI run. The race is open to all running and nature lovers, whether they are registered for the full trilogy or wish to take part in this race only.
course_highlights: 30 km mountain race over Vysoký hřeben and Kanál
Two climbs up Olivetská hora and a section across the Černá Nisa dam
The toughest climb in the Jizera Mountains — Bílý Štolpich
additional: The race does not have a mass start. The start area is open for two hours, during which runners choose their start time. The course is not marked, so the race involves some orienteering. There are three options: 30 km, 10 km (fit), and the 1 km children’s MINI run. The event is open to everyone and offers registration for different course options, with an emphasis on natural beauty and sporting experiences in a mountain setting.

name: Běh přes Černovírský les
description: The Run through Černovír Forest is a flat 10 km race held in Hlušovice near Olomouc. It is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners and attracts local runners who enjoy a course along cycle paths and paved roads. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers not only a sporting experience but also a chance to meet the local running community. The race is a welcome opportunity to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: Flat course along cycle paths and paved roads
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners
Open to participants in various age categories
additional: 10 km race, part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners, flat terrain, participation by local distance runners

name: Běh Dlouhými záhony
description: Běh Dlouhými záhony is a challenging 6.8 km cross-country race with significant elevation changes, held in Úpice. The race is part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running and the Winter Running League for the King of the Jestřebí Mountains. The course challenges runners with hilly terrain and beautiful natural scenery in the Jestřebí Mountains. This race is suitable for experienced runners looking for a technically demanding mountain run.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country race with significant elevation changes
Course length: 6.8 km
Part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running and the Winter Running League
additional: The race is part of the Winter Running League and the Czech Cup in Hill Running, with the best Czech hill runners ranked after the race.

name: Svatomartinský běh
location: Petřkovice u Starého Jičína, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The St. Martin’s Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers a sporting experience in beautiful countryside, with a course approximately 5.5 km long that is suitable for the general public. The event is organized at the Hotel Zámek Berchtold grounds, which provide facilities and comfort for participants and spectators alike. The race is ideal for runners who want to combine sport with a pleasant atmosphere and beautiful views of the surrounding area.
course_highlights: A 5.5 km course in a natural setting
Picturesque surroundings of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín
Start and finish at the Hotel Zámek Berchtold grounds
additional: Results from previous editions are available online. The route passes through natural surroundings and is mostly on forest and field surfaces. The Zámek Berchtold grounds offer facilities for participants, including parking and refreshments. The race takes place in November 2026; exact details about registration and the courses are not provided. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: Ludgeřovický kros

price_tiers.distance: běh 10 km, 4 km, Nordic walking 9 km, děti

description: Ludgeřovice Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event held in the natural surroundings of the village of Ludgeřovice, attracting runners of all ages every year. The main course is 10 km long and follows varied terrain, including forest roads, field paths and routes past local landmarks. In addition to the main race, there are shorter 4 km runs, a 9 km Nordic walking event and children’s races by age category. The event is part of the Prajzsko-Opavská Running League and is subtitled the Veterans’ Run, paying tribute to heroes from both past and present.
course_highlights: Main 10 km course with 140 m of elevation gain
Terrain includes forest roads, field paths and routes around local landmarks
Additional events: 4 km run, 9 km Nordic walking and children’s races of 100 m and 500 m
additional: A custom-designed metal finisher’s medal; a commemorative magnet for the first 200 participants to register in person; a copy of the book Ještě jeden maraton for the first 300 entrants; cash prizes for the main race winners; chip timing for children’s races too; awards presented down to fourth place in all races; the accompanying Ludgeřovice Veterans’ Day programme; personal race videos and photos; changing rooms, showers and convenient parking; children’s races with an awards ceremony and a raffle. Courses: 10 km, 9 km, 4 km and children’s races. Weather uncertain. Held in conjunction with Veterans’ Day.

name: Půlmaraton pátera Václava Kosmáka
description: The Páter Václav Kosmák Half Marathon is a road race running from Moravské Budějovice to Lukov and back. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves over the half-marathon distance in the picturesque Vysočina region. The race is suitable for anyone looking for a quality road race with a traditional atmosphere. The organizers welcome both experienced and beginner runners and look forward to your participation.
course_highlights: Road race from Moravské Budějovice to Lukov and back
Picturesque setting in the Vysočina region
Traditional half-marathon course
additional: The race is open to all age groups and is part of a running league. It offers a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to take part as a recreational runner.

name: Hubertův lesní trail
location: Lesní „Finská“ běžecká stezka near Lesní hřbitov, Malšovice, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50,- kč dětské kategorie (předem na účet i v den registrace na místě)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 250,- kč dospělý při registraci přes internet do 10.11.2026

description: Hubert’s Forest Trail is a running race for children and adults, held in the beautiful surroundings of the Hradec forests on the Forest “Finnish” Running Trail in Malšovice. The start and finish are located near the Forest Cemetery. The event offers children’s categories with shorter, untimed courses, as well as a main race for adults. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the first three finishers in each category. Results are published on the organiser’s website within 24 hours of the race.
course_highlights: Forest “Finnish” Running Trail in Malšovice
Start and finish 200 m from the Forest Cemetery
Beautiful woodland setting in the Hradec forests
additional: Registration is available online until 10.11.2026 or in person on race day. Children’s categories start from 10:20, with check-in for children from 09:30 to 10:15. The main adult race starts between 11:00 and 11:45. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the first three finishers in each category. Results are published on the organiser’s website within 24 hours. The children’s races start at 10:20 and the main race at 12:00. The entry fee includes timing, refreshments and a medal; the first three finishers in each category also receive a small gift. Public transport: bus line 9, Forest Cemetery stop; parking is available at the Forest Cemetery.

name: Dvouetapový kros Zaječov
location: Louka, Malá Víska, Zaječov, Czech Republic
description: Dvouetapový kros Zaječov is a two-day running race held at Louka, Malá Víska near Zaječov. The race offers two stages: a long 13.5 km route with 330 m of elevation gain and a short 6.7 km route with 190 m of elevation gain. Both follow courses originally designed for sled-dog races. The main challenge is the combined competition across both stages, covering a total of 20.2 km with 520 m of elevation gain. The race is open to everyone regardless of gender or age, with finishing times adjusted by age and gender coefficients. The long stage starts on Saturday at 9:00, and the short stage starts on Sunday at 8:30.
course_highlights: Long stage: 13.5 km with 330 m of elevation gain
Short stage: 6.7 km with 190 m of elevation gain
Routes run through meadows and along forest paths prepared for sled-dog races
additional: Registration is online only, and you must register separately for each stage. Race numbers can be collected from 7:00 on Saturday and on Sunday. The competition is open regardless of gender or age, with finishing times adjusted by age and gender coefficients. The first 5 runners are announced after each stage. For runners taking part in both stages, times are added together and the 10 runners with the fastest combined times are announced. Online registration is open until 11. 11. 2026. To enter the combined competition, you must register separately for each stage; the entry fee must be paid by 11. 11. 2026.

name: Kuchařovická výzva
location: Víceúčelové zařízení (kulturní dům), Kuchařovice, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč hlavní závod; 50 Kč dětské závody

price_tiers.distance: Muži 8,4 km / Ženy 5,9 km / Děti 150 m

description: Kuchařovická Výzva is a running race held in Kuchařovice, offering courses for men, women, and children. The men’s course is 8.4 km with 114 m of elevation gain, the women’s course is 5.9 km with 71 m of elevation gain, and the children’s course is 150 m long. The race takes place in pleasant surroundings, mainly on forest paths and sections of asphalt, giving the course a rolling profile. The start and registration are in front of the multi-purpose facility in Kuchařovice, creating a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Rolling course profile with 114 m of elevation gain for men and 71 m for women
70% forest paths and 30% asphalt
Start and finish in front of the multi-purpose facility in Kuchařovice
additional: Registration for the main race takes place from 8:30 to 9:30 in front of the multi-purpose facility in Kuchařovice. Parking is available by Emrammus restaurant, by the kindergarten, and on Větrná Street. The start and facilities are at the multi-purpose facility (cultural center) in Kuchařovice. The listed children’s race distances are 100, 300, and 600 m. Parking is available by Emrammus restaurant, by the kindergarten, or on Větrná Street.

name: Hrouzovka 2026
description: Hrouzovka 2026 is a running race taking place on November 14, 2026, in Krnov. The race offers a route approximately 15 km long, crossing hilly terrain with varied surfaces, including asphalt, grass, and rocky paths. The event is for runners seeking a challenge in a natural setting and looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in beautiful surroundings. Details about the organizer and registration have not yet been announced, but the race is part of the local running calendar.

name: Za jedovnickým kaprem
location: Jedovnice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

name: Podzimní Řakom
location: Dolany village square, inn hall, Dolany, Plzeň Region, Czech Republic

name: Zemplínsky extrém – Beh v múzeu
price_range: 20€ online, 25€ na mieste pre hlavné kategórie; 3€ online, 5€ na mieste pre deti
description: Zemplínsky extrém – Run in the Museum is an autumn running race held on the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce on 14 November 2026. The race offers a unique experience in the museum’s cultural setting and the surrounding countryside. It is part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, which includes several events in the region. Runners can look forward to an interesting course with an autumn atmosphere and a sense of local history.
course_highlights: The course runs through the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce
An autumn setting with a cultural touch
Part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, which includes several events
additional: The event takes place on 14 November 2026. It includes several categories, including children’s races, and is held on the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce.

name: Zelenyáková trinástka
location: Cultural House, Hronovce, Levice District, Slovakia

name: Šutrovský bežecký maratón
location: Ivanka pri Dunaji, Senec District, Slovakia

name: Beh na Minčol
description: The Minčol Run is a challenging uphill mountain race in the beautiful surroundings of the Višňovská Valley. The route follows a marked hiking trail with steep climbs all the way to the summit of Minčol at an elevation of 1,363 m, where runners can enjoy beautiful views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of the Malá Fatra. The race is for bold runners who want to test their abilities on a demanding course with little room to rest. Refreshments are provided after the finish, followed by an awards ceremony with prizes for the best runners in each category.
course_highlights: Marked hiking trail with blue blazes
Steep climbs from the start to the finish
Finish at the summit of Minčol, with views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of the Malá Fatra
additional: Race check-in is from 8:30 to 9:30. Results will be announced shortly after the last runner finishes, at approximately 12:30. There are refreshments on the course at approximately 2 km and at the finish; after the race, lunch is served (homemade kapustnica and a drink). Runners can use a drop bag, which will be transported to the facilities below the ski slope, where the prizes will be presented. The organizers arrange transport of runners’ belongings to the results ceremony venue. Refreshments are provided after the finish, followed by an awards ceremony with prizes for the best runners in each category.

name: Ferčekovská desiatka
location: Ferčekovce, Spišská Nová Ves, Ferčekovce, Spišská Nová Ves, Malé pole
description: Ferčekovská desiatka is a running race held in the village of Ferčekovce, near Spišská Nová Ves, with courses for children, juniors, and adults. The race takes place on forest roads and rolling, grassy terrain, creating a pleasant natural setting for runners of all ages. It is organized by Športový klub Ferčekovce in cooperation with the city of Spišská Nová Ves. The race is suitable for the general public, including families and running enthusiasts, who can choose from several categories and distances.

name: Grand Prix Powiatu Kościerskiego
description: The Kościan County Grand Prix is a series of five 5 km races, organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County under the patronage of the Kościan County Governor. Its aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition, and community integration. Residents of the county who turn 16 in 2025 may participate. Each race requires a separate entry fee, and the overall standings are based on the total points earned across the races.
course_highlights: A series of five 5 km races
Organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County
Separate standings for women and men, with no age categories
additional: Participation in the Grand Prix is free; only the entry fee for each individual race, set locally, is payable. The races are scheduled from June to December 2025 in various locations across the county. Points from the individual races are added together, with prizes for the top 6 women and top 6 men, as well as additional special prizes from the organizers of the individual races. The series comprises five 5 km races held from June to December, with overall standings and prizes for the top finishers. The main 10 km race is scheduled for 15 November 2026 in Kościerzyna, with typical autumn weather and possible rain.

name: XXIV Maraton Odrzański
description: The 24th Odra Marathon is a race held in Kędzierzyn-Koźle and organized by the Odra Consortium Foundation. The event offers two categories: a full marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.097 km. It is a sporting and recreational event, with the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle as its partner. The race office operates on the days before the race and on race day, providing support for participants.
course_highlights: Marathon and half-marathon courses in Kędzierzyn-Koźle
Organized by the Odra Consortium Foundation
In partnership with the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre
additional: The race office is open on 14.11.2025 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 15.11.2025 from 7:00 to 8:30. Organizers' telephone contacts: Piotr (+48) 500 028 811, Piotr (+48) 604 589 483, Ania (+48) 602 534 780. The event's partner is the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle. Electronic timekeeping; a 6-hour time limit; the event includes both a marathon and a half marathon and takes place in November in Kędzierzyn-Koźle.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The races take place in beautiful woodland surroundings by Lake Szmaragdowe, with a course suitable for both beginners and advanced runners. Each race is an opportunity to test yourself on the same course, and results from individual races count toward the series standings. The organizers promote outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland beside Lake Szmaragdowe
A varied course profile with climbs and descents, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
The start and finish are located behind Zajazd Szmaragd, at ul. Kopalniana
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The main race starts at 11:00. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. Participants can collect their race number and timing chip at the race office on race day. A pass for the entire series entitles the holder to one free start in another city in the series, after notifying the organizers by email in advance. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Registration is available online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. The main race is open to participants aged 16 or older, or those who turn 16 in 2026; CITY TRAIL Junior is also held alongside the event.

name: XII Puchar Bielan w biegu na orientację
1. Volkslauf Seelze
description: The ADAC Marathon Hannover offers a varied running experience with distances from 4 to 42 km, including the marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 10 km run and handbike marathon. The course is one of the flattest in Germany, with just 19 m of elevation difference, making it ideal for fast times. The event combines an urban atmosphere, modern music and green stretches, taking runners through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied programme of events featuring an expo, Power Party and finisher celebration.
course_highlights: Flat course with just 19 m of elevation difference
Route through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks
A range of distances from 4 to 42 km, including relay and handbike events
additional: Race packs are distributed at the Marathon Expo over marathon weekend. The course is very flat and therefore ideal for fast times. Live tracking is available via the ADAC Marathon app. Massage facilities and showers are available. The programme includes the ROSSMANN Power Party, the expo and a finisher party at the brewery. Free public transport on the event day is included. Information about the course, registration, results and photos is available on the event website. The race is part of a broad Laufpass programme featuring a variety of events in the Hannover region.

name: Bremer Kuhcross QX
description: The Kuhcross is a challenging and varied cross-country race organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on demanding terrain and enjoy the ultimate cross-country experience. The event traditionally takes place in Bremen in November and attracts cross-country enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: Challenging and varied cross-country terrain
A traditional event in Bremen
Organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen
additional: The race is open to children, young people and active runners, with various categories and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Geislinger Volkslauf
description: The Geislingen Volkslauf is a long-established running event held annually in Geislingen. It offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages, including student races and an integration run. The course starts at the Schlossparkhalle and is known for its varied, well-organized route. The event is popular in the region and is hosted by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V.
course_highlights: Start at the Schlossparkhalle Geislingen
Student race for all school grades
Inclusion run for inclusive participation
additional: The Volkslauf takes place on Sunday, 15 November 2026. There are student races and an integration run. The event is organized by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V. The start is at 10:30 a.m. at the Schlossparkhalle. Runners can register online until 12 November 2025; the event includes children’s, youth, open and masters competitions.

name: Jetzendorfer Hobby Crosslauf
description: The Jetzendorf Hobby Cross-Country Run is a local cross-country event held at LOWA Stadium in Jetzendorf, Bavaria. Organized by TSV Jetzendorf, the event takes place in November and offers various distances for different age groups. It is aimed at recreational runners, families, and club athletes, and is now in its 17th edition. In addition to the running races, there is also a Nordic walking course suitable for beginners and recreational walkers.
course_highlights: Cross-country running at LOWA Stadium Jetzendorf
Distances from 650 m to 5.8 km
Nordic walking course, approx. 2.9 km
additional: The program includes an 800 m stadium cross-country race for younger children, approx. 1,600 m for older children and teenagers, and the main race of approx. 5.8 km for older teenagers and adults. The event takes place in the morning in November. Typical November weather, with temperatures of approx. 7 °C and frequent rain, is to be expected. Several running distances and a Nordic walking option make the event ideal for families and recreational runners. The event takes place in November at LOWA Stadium.

name: Lila-Eule-Cross
distance_verbose: 10 km, 8.1 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2.4 km, 1.4 km
description: The 37th Lila-Eule-Cross in Kappeln is a long-running cross-country race on the Schlei that is very popular with runners. At the most recent edition, 308 runners reached the finish, setting a participation record. The course is known for its autumn atmosphere and for being less muddy than in previous years, making the race especially appealing. The event is organised by the Schleswig-Holstein Athletics Association and offers a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country race on the Schlei
Autumn atmosphere and strong performances
Less muddy course than in previous years
additional: Cross-country race on a varied course along the Schlei, including children’s and youth races, with a focus on autumn weather and state championships.

name: Offenbacher Behörden- und Volkswaldlauf
price_range: Erwachsene 6,00 EUR, Jugendliche U18/U20 3,00 EUR, U10-U16 1,00 EUR, Nachmeldung 2,00 EUR
description: The Offenbach Authorities and Volkswald Run is a traditional running event that has taken place annually since 1972. The race is open to municipal employees, company sports participants and guest runners, who compete on forest paths in Offenbach am Main. The course is 100% forest paths, with the start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings. In addition to individual events, there are team classifications, with trophies for the winners. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers shower and changing facilities as well as free refreshments after the finish.
course_highlights: Course consists entirely of forest paths
Start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings
Various distances for youth, adults and walkers
additional: The Authorities Forest Run takes place in all weather conditions. Shower and changing facilities are available at the Arbeiterwohlfahrt recreation grounds. Free tea is offered after the finish. The award ceremonies include trophies for team winners and individual events. For travel, participants are advised to use the car park at Nasses Dreieck, opposite the Stadthalle. The course consists entirely of forest paths, with the start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings. Registration is open until November 6, 2025; late entries are accepted until 9:30 a.m. on race day. Free tea, changing rooms and showers are available.

name: Winter Crosslaufserie 2026/27 / 1.Termin
description: The 2026/27 Winter Cross-Country Series in Goldbach, Lower Franconia, offers runners a challenging winter race series with several dates. The races take place on varied cross-country courses through the winter landscape and are suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The established series promotes the enjoyment of winter running in the region and offers a great opportunity for competition and community.
course_highlights: Varied cross-country courses through the winter landscape
Challenging course layout with natural obstacles
Running enjoyment for competitive and recreational runners
additional: Dates and details of the series are available on the website; terrain details are not specified.

name: Beh jastrabskými vŕškami – 3. ročnik memoriálu Jána Dobáka
location: Šarišské Jastrabie, Obec Šarišské Jastrabie, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Šarišské Jastrabie, ZŠ s MŠ Šarišské Jastrabie
price_range: € (rôzne kategórie, niektoré zadarmo pre špecifické skupiny)
description: The Run through the Jastrabie Hills is the 3rd edition of the Ján Dobák Memorial, held in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie. The race offers categories for children and adults across various age groups and disciplines, including 10 km and 5 km runs for men and women, as well as Nordic walking. The children’s race starts at 12:30 and the adults’ race at 14:00. The organizers, the Municipality of Šarišské Jastrabie and the Šarišské Jastrabie Primary School and Kindergarten, welcome runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Jastrabie Hills in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie
Categories for various age groups and disciplines, including Nordic walking
Start at the Šarišské Jastrabie Municipal Office grounds
additional: On-site registration is possible only in exceptional cases, by arrangement with the organizer. Children’s categories, residents of Šarišské Jastrabie, men over 70, and women over 60 can enter for free. A discounted race bundle is available for Z Ľubotína na Hrad Plaveč + Run through the Jastrabie Hills. The event includes 5 km and 10 km courses; registration is available online and on-site, and prices vary by category and registration method. Categories are also offered for children, seniors, and Nordic walking.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 11. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race held at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. It is organised by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is part of a race series with points awarded by men’s and women’s categories. Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the race starting at 10:00. The categories are children, juniors, women, men and veterans. Runners can also earn points for improving their times during the year.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.218 km) course
Registration and start by the volleyball court at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex
Categories for children, juniors, women, men and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30. Competitors vie for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with points calculated using coefficients based on year of birth. In the event of a tie, the best time decides, followed by shoe size. At the end of the year, the two months with the fewest points are removed (amnesty). Registration is available on site; the event is held in several rounds throughout the year, with each race covering approximately 2 miles (3.218 km).

name: Beh na Husárik
location: Horské hoteli Husárik, Čadca, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The Beh na Husárik is a traditional running race organized by the Kysucký Marathon Club Čadca, the City of Čadca, and the Husárik Mountain Hotel. Held in honor of Students’ Day, the race gives runners the chance to test themselves in beautiful mountain surroundings. The start is always at 11:00, and the race is known for its friendly atmosphere and the Mayor of Čadca’s Cup awarded to the winners. The Beh na Husárik is suitable for the general public interested in sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain surroundings around the Husárik Mountain Hotel
Race held in honor of Students’ Day
Mayor of Čadca’s Cup for the winners
additional: Online registration is closed. You can also register on race day for the increased entry fee of 8 EUR. The race takes place on 15 November 2026, with a start at 11:00. Online registration is available; the course is hilly and trail-based. The race is held in Čadca near the Husárik Mountain Hotel.

description: Hermanovská desiatka is a running race organized by the Municipality of Hermanovce nad Topľou and the Hermanovce Running Club. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office in Hermanovce nad Topľou and offers categories for children, youth, and adults. The children’s and youth races start at 12:00, and the adults’ race at 14:00. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Competition for different age groups, including children, youth, and adults
Organized in the picturesque surroundings of Hermanovce nad Topľou
Registration available via QR code; low entry fee of €10
additional: The children’s and youth races start at 12:00, and the adults’ race at 14:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including local categories. Registration is required by 10.11.2025 via QR code. The race is open to runners of all levels, with categories for children, youth, and adults. The event takes place on 15 November 2026, with the children’s race starting at 12:00 and the adults’ race at 14:00.

name: Bėgimas Lietuvos karių dienai
description: The Run for Lithuanian Soldiers’ Day will take place in Tauragė on Saturday, November 17. The event will begin at 11:00 with a 600 m run for children and parents. At 11:20, runners choosing the 1.8 km distance will start, completing three laps of the 600 m course. Participants in the 6 km and 12 km distances will start at 12:00. Registration is open online at www.begimotaure.lt until November 16. Winners in each age group will receive medals and prizes.

name: Krosová 12°
description: Krosová 12° is a 12 km or 6 km running race on a hilly 6 km loop around Velešín in the South Bohemian Region. This cross-country race challenges runners with demanding, hilly terrain, making it ideal for those who enjoy trail running and hills. The race is suitable for the general public who want to try running off-road amid beautiful views and a natural atmosphere. Recommended running gear and accessories are presented on the official website.
course_highlights: Hilly 6 km loop with elevation gain
Choice of 12 km or 6 km course
Natural terrain with views around Velešín
additional: The race offers two course distances: 12 km and 6 km, both on a hilly loop. The website recommends running gear and accessories such as Ultra Trail socks, Altra and Puma running shoes, and lightweight jackets suitable for changeable weather. The race is suitable for runners of all levels, offering an attractive hilly course and a choice of two distances.

name: Běh 17. listopadu
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 17 November Run is a traditional running race in Ostrava-Hrabová commemorating an important day in Czech history. It offers two main distances: the certified 10 km Freedom Ten and the 5 km Revolution Five. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and support the idea of freedom. Check-in and registration take place at ZŠ Paskovská, with the races starting in the morning. The routes pass through the scenic surroundings of Ostrava-Hrabová, which is easy to reach by public transport and shared Nextbike bicycles.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km Freedom Ten course
5 km Revolution Five
Routes through Ostrava-Hrabová, with good public transport connections
additional: On-site check-in and registration take place at ZŠ Paskovská 110/46 from 8:30 to 9:40. The individual races start in the morning. Public transport is available on lines 27, 39, 41 and 77, with a stop at Šídlovec. Shared Nextbike bicycles are also available. The race includes several course distances, online registration is available, and the event has a long tradition, with results from previous editions.

description: The Velvet Run is a traditional running event held in Odolena Voda, offering races for all age groups, including a family run for parents and children. The event takes place at the football field and includes distances of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, a handmade gingerbread medal and light refreshments after the race, including tea and mulled wine. The organizers ensure the course is safe and also prepare a raffle with a variety of prizes. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:17.
course_highlights: Distances of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km and 10 km
Start and finish at the football field in Odolena Voda
Handmade gingerbread medals for participants
additional: Race-day registration opens at 08:45 at the event venue. Light refreshments are available after the race, including tea, mulled wine and homemade buns. Runners receive a race bib with a timing chip and safety pins. Parking is available by Penny Market. The organizers provide course and event safety. Categories are divided by age and gender, including the Fighters, Champions and Legends categories. The course surface includes the football field; the event features a raffle, refreshments and fun activities for families. Registration is available on site.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Přerov
description: The November 17 Run in Přerov is a traditional athletics event organized by Atletika SK Přerov. The race offers runners of all ages and abilities the opportunity to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test themselves on an interesting course. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the city of Přerov and is part of the local athletics calendar. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: A 9 km cross-country race, with children’s categories also available
Part of the Grand Prix of Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Online registration and results available
additional: The race is part of the local running calendar, offers various courses including cross-country, and attracts a wide range of participants from the region.

name: Běh kolem koupaliště
description: The Run Around the Swimming Pool is a traditional running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place on a 5,000-meter course that runs around the local swimming pool. The start is at 11:00, and participants can compete in several age categories. Race facilities include registration at the sports hall, changing rooms and showers. After the race, the results are announced and prizes are awarded. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 5,000-meter course (4 laps)
The route runs around the swimming pool in Kopřivnice
Start and registration at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall
additional: Registration from 9:45 at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. Categories are divided by age and gender. Changing rooms and showers are available. The results will be announced at 12:30 in the sports hall buffet, with prizes awarded. Registration takes place at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. The race is open to men and women; participants run 4 laps. Roots and stones are marked for safety. Refreshments are available at the finish, and there is a raffle. The ceremonial start is signaled by a pistol shot fired by the mayor.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Kadaň
location: Rooseveltovy sady, Kadaň, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The November 17 Run in Kadaň is a traditional running race organized by the SK Městská policie Kadaň sports club. The race takes place in Rooseveltovy sady and offers an opportunity for runners of all ages. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and support for the local running community. The race information and further details are available to download in PDF format on the official website.
course_highlights: The race runs through Rooseveltovy sady in Kadaň
A course suitable for different age groups
A friendly atmosphere and support for the local running community
additional: The race information is available to download in PDF format. Results and photo galleries from previous editions are published on the website. The organizer is SK Městská policie Kadaň, a sports club with Bc. Jiří Vlasák as its contact. The event includes starts at various distances (e.g. 100 m, 280 m, 550 m, 1300 m, 1800 m, 2500 m, 5000 m). Registration is available on the website, and the event is suitable for all age groups. The venue is in Rooseveltovy sady in Kadaň, behind the sports hall.

name: Běh městem Hradec Králové
location: V Lipkách, Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Běh městem Hradec Králové is a traditional road race held in the city centre on a flat course. The race offers a 9.7 km route consisting of five laps. A shorter 200-metre lap is prepared for children and young athletes. The event is suitable for the general public and is organised by TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové with the support of the Czech Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: 5 laps on a flat course in the city centre
200-metre children’s lap
9.7 km road race
additional: The first category starts at 10:00, and the main category starts at 12:00. The race takes place in the V Lipkách residential area, near ZŠ Josefa Gočára in Hradec Králové. The organiser is TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové z.s.; the contact person is Jiří Brych. Starts are scheduled for 10:00 and 12:00. Registration is available through the sport-reg.cz sports portal.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Polička
location: Lesopark Liboháj, Polička, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč hlavní závod, dobrovolné startovné lidový běh
description: The November 17 Run in Polička is a traditional cross-country race held in Liboháj Forest Park. The main race is 6 km, split into two 3-kilometre loops, and is complemented by a 3 km fun run. The race is part of the ISCAREX running cup and also offers an additional uphill race on the Polička ski slope for the brave. The start is at the ski slope at 11:00, with registration from 10:00 to 10:45. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Liboháj Forest Park, with paths and trails
Main race: 6 km (2 × 3 km loops); fun run: 3 km (1 loop)
Additional uphill race on the Polička ski slope
additional: Runner registration is from 10:00 to 10:45. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The additional uphill race on the ski slope is for brave runners. The weather is usually autumnal, and the course may be slippery or icy after overnight rain. The course follows paths and trails in the forest park; a special challenge is the uphill race on the ski slope. Part of the ISCAREX Cup 2025

name: Běh o pohár Jehnic
location: Základní škola Jehnice, Brno, Czech Republic
organizer: VSK Univerzita Brno – oddíl atletiky, Atletika UNI CZ s.r.o., ZŠ v Jehnicích, Fakulta sportovních studií MU a ÚMČ Brno-Jehnice
description: The Jehnice Cup Run is part of the 27th edition of the Brno Running Cup, which comprises eleven races in the Brno area. The race takes place at the Jehnice Primary School and offers courses for various age groups, from the youngest runners to adults. The event is open to the general public and is supported by the Statutory City of Brno. Runners can expect a friendly atmosphere, good organization, and the opportunity to score points in the series.
course_highlights: Courses for the youngest runners, children, youth, and adults, with distances of 1, 1.5, 5, and 10 km
Start and registration at Jehnice Primary School
Drinking water is provided; BBP reusable cups are available to borrow
additional: Registration closes 15 minutes before the start of each category. The race is open to the public without restrictions. Youth and junior runners may enter the 10 km race and score points in the older category. Drinking water is provided only for runners using their own cups, or they can borrow a BBP reusable cup for a 20 Kč deposit. The race takes place at Jehnice Primary School and is part of the Brno Running Cup. A championship for students and teachers of Brno’s universities is also listed.

name: Podzimní cross – Běh 17. listopadu
location: Fotbalové hřiště, Bořice, Pardubice District, Czech Republic
organizer: Běžecký oddíl Vejvanovice – TJ Sokol Bořice
description: The Autumn Cross-Country – 17 November Run is a traditional trail race through the Dvakačovice-Podborský Forest near Bořice. The race offers two options: a short 5 km race (1 lap) and a long 10 km race (2 laps), with 110 metres of elevation gain per lap. The course follows forest roads and trails, making for an enjoyable cross-country experience. The event also includes children’s races, and traditional refreshments and prizes for the winners are provided at the finish. It is organized by Běžecký oddíl Vejvanovice - TJ Sokol Bořice.
course_highlights: The course follows forest roads and trails
110 m of elevation gain per lap
Each lap is 5 km; the short race is 1 lap and the long race is 2 laps
additional: The event includes children’s races. Traditional refreshments and prizes for the winners are provided at the finish. The start and finish are at the football pitch in Podboři - Bořice. According to the organizers, registration opens at 9:00 and the race program starts at 10:00.

name: Mestský študentský beh - Liptovský Hrádok
location: Liptovský Hrádok, Okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia

name: Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: The Eurovaistinė Christmas Run stands out not only for its festive atmosphere, but also for its distinctive participants, who dress up especially for the running celebration in Christmas (and other!) costumes. This year, the event schedule has been shifted so participants can run after dark, when the capital’s streets will reveal their magical Christmas spirit! We invite you to prepare not only Christmas costumes, but also glowing accessories that will turn the runners into a truly radiant Christmas spectacle!

name: Finnensturm
location: Sport- und Solepark Große Wiese, Arnsberg-Hüsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Finnensturm is an evening race in November on a joint-friendly Finnish track at the Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park in Arnsberg-Hüsten. The 1,000-metre-long and 2.50-metre-wide track has a soft, springy surface that provides a pleasant running surface, different from asphalt or synthetic tracks. The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event attracts several hundred participants each year and is ideal for a November race with a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run on a 1,000 m-long, joint-friendly Finnish track
Soft, springy surface instead of asphalt or synthetic track
The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere
additional: The Finnish track is 2.50 m wide and runs independently of the rest of the path network. It is lit from 5:00 a.m. and in the evening until 11:00 p.m. The Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park is signposted from the Hüsten exit on the A46. The event takes place on a woodchip track at the Hüsten Sports and Saline Park; in November, weather conditions can make it wet and slippery. Refreshments and showers are available on site.

name: Loučení s turistickým rokem
location: Důlce, Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem District, Czech Republic

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, ZŠ Pavla Horova Michalovce
description: The Michalovce Liberation Run is a traditional evening race held in the city center of Michalovce. Runners follow city streets over a course of approximately 5.8 km made up of several laps. After finishing, they receive refreshments and a participant medal. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with the option to register in person on race day.
course_highlights: Evening run through the center of Michalovce
5.8 km course made up of 1,450 m laps
Refreshments and a participant medal after the finish
additional: In-person registration takes place in the lobby of the Town Hall from 16:30 to 17:45. Headlamps are recommended for safety. After finishing, runners return their race number and receive a medal. The results ceremony is at 19:30 in the gymnasium of P. Horov Elementary School No. 8. The course has been shortened to 5.8 km and runs on asphalt and stone surfaces. Registration is available online or in person. The entry fee is €20; a reduced fee applies to online registration by 19.11.2025.

name: Katarínsky večerný beh
location: Námestie Jána Vojtaššáka, Dolný Kubín, Slovakia

name: II Mazowiecki Bieg Jesieni
description: The 2nd Mazovian Autumn Run is an annual race held in Staroźreby, taking place on November 21, 2026. Participants can compete in the 10 km race, and a 400-meter race is prepared for the youngest runners. The event is open to everyone, offering attractive prizes, medals, and the opportunity to take part in both the main race and children’s races. The race takes place in urban and park areas, providing a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km route on asphalt and through park areas
400-meter race for children
Medals and prizes for participants
additional: Online and on-site registration; the event also includes a program for children and adults, with the schedule and details available on the organizer’s website.

name: X Koszęcińska Dycha
description: The anniversary 10th Koszęcińska Dycha is a special race held in Koszęcin that attracts runners from various places. Its anniversary edition highlights the event’s special significance and atmosphere. The race follows a 10 km course, giving participants the chance to test their fitness in scenic surroundings. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain, providing an attractive and varied course
Anniversary edition, highlighting the event’s long-standing tradition
Local sporting event that brings together the Koszęcin municipality community
additional: The event is held as a race over a distance of approximately 10 km, with strong involvement from the local community and broad participation.

name: XLVII MnO Pierwszy Śnieg
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Rozwoju Orienteeringu, GKT Cyrkino Gliwice, Czartak Katowice, AKInO Kraków, RO PTTK Częstochowa, PlesInO Pszczyna, be-lość Piekary Śląskie, Krokus Miliardowice
description: The Silesian Voivodeship Orienteering Walks Cup is a series of events organized by tourism clubs and groups across Silesia. Competitions take place in different rounds throughout the year, with participants competing in six age categories and a team classification. The “First Snow” round is the tenth edition of the cup in the 2026 season and will take place on November 21 in Katowice. The event combines sporting competition with spending active time outdoors and navigating the terrain.
course_highlights: Orienteering walks across the Silesian Voivodeship
Competition in six age categories
Team classification and cups for the top participants
additional: The event includes different age categories, is part of an orienteering event series, and takes place in forested and urban areas in Katowice.

name: Botaniczna Piątka – Gdynia, edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczny Ogród w Gdyni, Gdynia, Poland

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide cross-country running series over a distance of 5 km, held in seven locations, including Warsaw’s Młociński Park. The races take place in forests and urban parks, promoting physical activity outdoors. The series consists of four races in each location, and participants can compete in both the local and overall standings. The races are open to people aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with permission from their guardians. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests and urban parks
Located in Młociński Park in Warsaw
A series of four races per season
additional: A season pass for the entire series in a given city is available for purchase. The entry fee on race day at the race office is 60 PLN. The race office opens at 8:30; race bibs and timing chips can be collected on race day. In Warsaw, the warm-up is at 10:30 and the main race starts at 11:00. There is no participant limit. Participants under 16 may take part with permission from their guardians. The main race is scheduled for November 21, 2026. Online registration is available through the CITY TRAIL website; the rules also allow registration at the race office on race day. CITY TRAIL Junior races are also held as part of the series.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
XIII Poranny Bieg po Plantach Krakowskich
13. Schloss Marienburg Marathon
description: The 13th Schloss Marienburg Marathon takes place on November 21, 2026, in Nordstemmen-Adensen. This varied scenic marathon is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The course follows village streets, paved and unpaved country lanes, woodland paths, and trails, with about 560 metres of elevation gain. A special highlight is the refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg, where runners can take a break. The 21.1 km course is shaped like a figure eight, with three refreshment stations in Adensen, and offers beautiful views of the Calenberger Land and the Leinebergland in good weather.
course_highlights: Varied course featuring village streets, country lanes, woodland paths, and trails
Refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg
Figure-eight course with about 560 metres of elevation gain and views of the Calenberger Land and Leinebergland
additional: Early marathon start at 9:00 a.m. for runners who need more than 6 hours. Official electronic timekeeping. Refreshments approximately every 5 km, including water, tea, isotonic drinks, cola, fruit, and gingerbread. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and baggage storage in the start/finish area. German Red Cross medical service in the start/finish area and along the course. Participant limit: 550 runners, including a maximum of 300 half-marathon runners. Hilly course with trails, 560 metres of elevation gain, scenic views, aid stations every 5 km.

name: 4. Heartbeat Ultra
description: Heartbeat Ultra is a participatory charity ultrarun in Fulda, taking place on November 21, 2026. Participants run laps of approximately 6 km, covering up to 112 km, and decide for themselves when to start, take breaks and finish their run. Each lap raises donations for children with half a heart, supporting research and quality of life. The event is open to everyone, from beginners to ultrarunners, and wheelchair users are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 6 km in Sportpark Johannisau, Fulda
Charity laps covering up to 112 km
Flexible start and running time between 06:00 and 21:00
additional: This is a charity run where every lap counts and the entry fee is donated in full. Participants receive a personal fundraising page where supporters can donate for each lap completed. There is a 400-metre children's run in the stadium, with each lap counted. The event is also available virtually, so people can take part from anywhere in the world. Flexible running time, virtual participation, donations for children with heart defects, registration with a personal fundraising page, medal for the first 1,500 participants.

name: 50. See-Park-Lauf
description: The 50th Bad Gandersheim See-Park Run is a traditional road race held in late November in Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark. Organized by SVG GW Bad Gandersheim, it offers categories for various age and performance groups, including boys, girls, men, women, juniors, open runners, and masters up to 95+. The event is closely connected with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, whose students and teachers take part and support the organizing team. After the race, results, personalized certificates, and a photo gallery are published online.
course_highlights: Road race around the grounds of Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark
Separate categories for a range of age and performance groups
Strong connection with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, with active participation
additional: There are two distances: 400 m and 10 km. Typical November weather is expected, with daytime highs of about 7 °C and rainy days. The organizing team comprises about 50 people, supported by around 80 students and teachers. Results, certificates, and a photo gallery are published online after the race. Road race in the Seepark, distances of 400 m and 10 km, organized by the school, with rainy November weather expected.

name: Ainringer Crosslauf
description: The Ainring Cross-Country Run is a long-standing event organized by Ski-Club Ainring e.V. in the municipality of Ainring. The start and finish are on Schwimmbadstraße. The event gives runners the opportunity to test their endurance and running technique on varied cross-country courses. It is part of the club’s diverse sports program and welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Schwimmbadstraße in Ainring
Varied cross-country courses in the municipality
Long-standing running event organized by Ski-Club Ainring
additional: The race takes place in the Ainringer Moos and around the Eschlberg area; the start and finish are on Schwimmbadstraße; children’s and school races are included.

name: Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser
description: The Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser is a traditional race held at the end of the running season, taking participants through the Braunsteich nature reserve. A particular highlight is crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, which offers a picturesque view across the water. The event is for all ages, from children to seniors, who enjoy running and walking. The race is part of the Dresden District Rankings and the Niederlausitz Cup, and is officially recognized by the German Athletics Association in the walking category.
course_highlights: Crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, with views across the water
The route mainly follows public forest paths, with three short sections on quiet residential cul-de-sacs
Autumnal November atmosphere in the Braunsteich nature reserve
additional: The 5 km and 10 km routes have three short sections on public roads, which have little traffic as they are residential cul-de-sacs. The rest of the route follows moderate forest paths, some of which are cross-country style. The race is open to all age groups, and walking is also officially recognized. Participant limit of 300–500; medals for finishers; registration on site or online; free showers and changing rooms available; integrated into regional athletics.

name: Crossmeisterschaft SC Magdeburg
description: The SC Magdeburg Cross Country Championships is a traditional cross-country running competition organized by SC Magdeburg and the City of Magdeburg in Saxony-Anhalt. As a championship cross-country race in the German athletics calendar, it offers a challenging off-road course that differs from classic track races. The event is part of the DLV system, with official entries, rules, and timing, and is supported by the volunteer club and federation culture. The races take place in November, typically in cool and rainy weather, offering an authentic cross-country experience for club and federation runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country course, not on a track
Distances: 700 m and 1.4 km
Event held as part of the German athletics calendar
additional: The event is officially listed in the DLV system, with entries, rules, and timing. Typical November weather is cool (7 °C, low of 2 °C) and rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The start location is in Magdeburg; detailed directions are available. Cross-country course, distances of 700 m and 1.4 km, held in November in rainy weather

name: Kunstweglauf Rednitzhembach
description: The Kunstweglauf in Rednitzhembach is organised by the endurance sports club PowerBärs Rednitzhembach e.V. and will take place for the 18th time in 2026. The event brings art and sport together in a unique symbiosis and is centred around the school building in Rednitzhembach, which offers excellent facilities including changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The start and finish are right in front of the school, creating a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators. The race is an established event in the region south of Nuremberg and offers a friendly, sporty experience in November.
course_highlights: Start and finish directly in front of the school building in Rednitzhembach
Excellent facilities including changing rooms, showers and the school café
A running event that brings art and sport together
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day up to 60 minutes before the respective start. The event takes place in and around the school building, which serves as its hub, with an assembly hall for the awards ceremony and refreshments. The event also includes results, race information and photos, and is a creative blend of art and running fun in Rednitzhembach.

name: Lipperland Marathon
description: The Lipperland Marathon in Dörentrup offers a friendly, family atmosphere without crowds along the roads. The event is known for its straightforward organization and takes place in the beautiful Lipperland region in autumn. Runners can look forward to great views and a pleasant atmosphere in Humfeld. The event is organized by TuS Humfeld 1911 e.V. and is aimed at all participants looking for a personal running experience.
course_highlights: Marathon in a family-friendly setting
Beautiful Lipperland region in autumn with great views
No crowds along the roads
additional: The course runs through hilly terrain; start at the Humfeld sports hall; family-friendly; includes half-marathon and loop-course options; registration by bank transfer

name: Rhädenlauf
description: The Rhädenlauf takes place on November 21, 2026, in the Rhäden Nature Reserve in Wildeck-Obersuhl. The race is organized by TV 1888 Obersuhl and is part of the 2026 competition year. The event is for runners who want to experience a nature-rich route through a protected landscape. Timing has been provided by a modern ALGE system since 2022, ensuring precise results.
course_highlights: Run through the Rhäden Nature Reserve
Nature-rich and scenic route
Modern ALGE timing system in use since 2022
additional: Timing is provided by an ALGE system, including a start trigger with an integrated flash (E-Start). The department head is Luisa Wunn, who can be reached at 0177 4691132. Club training takes place on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays from 17:30 to 19:00 at the stadium or the Obersuhl indoor sports hall. Route through the nature reserve, training plans for participants

name: Werler Straßenlauf
description: The Werl Road Race is a long-standing running event taking place for the 36th time on November 21, 2026. With distances for Bambini, recreational runners, and ambitious athletes, it offers a wide range of running options. The event marks the final stretch of the DJK competition year and welcomes runners of all abilities to run together with heart. It takes place amid the autumn atmosphere of Werl and combines sporting ambition with a sense of community.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from short routes to 10 kilometers
Suitable for Bambini, recreational runners, and ambitious athletes
Long-standing event with a 36-year history
additional: Distances for Bambini, recreational runners, and athletes; takes place on November 21, 2026; ideal for fast times and personal bests

FLVW Crossmeisterschaften
