name: Kružská Kundratická - Memoriál Honzy Šíra
description: Kružská Kundratická - Honza Šír Memorial is a hilly road race in Kruh, Liberec Region. Men run a 12 km course with a turnaround in Kundratice, while women run 5 km, turning around earlier. The race is named in memory of Honza Šír and is suited to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain. Contact details for the organizers are available for more information. The race is part of the running community and offers an opportunity to test yourself on a demanding course.
course_highlights: Hilly road course
12 km course for men with a turnaround in Kundratice
5 km course for women with an earlier turnaround
additional: For information about the race, contact Jiří Sedláček (606280856) or Jan Šír (732851697). Race information is also available by calling Jiří Sedláček (606280856) or Jan Šír (732851697).

name: Přáslavická desítka
location: Přáslavice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Přáslavice Ten is a traditional running race organised by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the village of Přáslavice near Olomouc. The race offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to enjoy a course in the picturesque surroundings of Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the regional running community. The Přáslavice Ten is part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje race series and attracts runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque countryside around Přáslavice near Olomouc
Mostly asphalt and forest terrain
Part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje
additional: The race takes place on 21 April 2026 and is part of a series of local runs. The course is mostly on asphalt roads.

name: Běh na Čáp
location: Teplice nad Metují, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Běh na Čáp is a public hill running race with a mass start, held in Teplice nad Metují. This traditional race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and offers a sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings. It is suitable for the general public and gives participants the chance to test themselves on challenging terrain. It is organized by Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, which ensures high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Hill race with a mass start
Challenging terrain around Teplice nad Metují
Part of the Běžecké vršky series, with a long tradition and history
additional: A hill running race with categories. Registration is available for an entry fee of 50 Kč. The race takes place on terrain with a challenging elevation gain. Results are published regularly, and the race has a long tradition.

name: Forestovo Nočník
location: Záluží u Plzně, Plzeň-sever, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Forestovo Nočník is a nighttime trail race in Záluží near Plzeň, offering a 5 km course full of fun and challenges. The race takes place in the dark, so a headlamp is mandatory, and the course is marked with reflective elements to ensure safety and create a unique atmosphere. Tea and refreshments are provided for participants after the finish. This race is ideal for fans of night running and trail challenges who want to experience running in an unusual setting with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 5 km nighttime trail course
Course marked with reflective elements
Headlamp mandatory for safe running
additional: Tea and refreshments are provided for runners at the finish. The race is characterized by 100% darkness and 100% fun. The organizers are Jiří Cipra and team. The course is 5 km long, a headlamp is mandatory, the course is marked with reflective elements, refreshments are available at the finish, and the race is intended for various age groups.

name: Slánské běhy
description: Slánské běhy is a traditional orienteering race organized by the Slaný Orienteering Sports Club. The race takes place around the town of Slaný and offers various categories, including a 12 km main category and children’s categories. The race is suitable for the general public and attracts runners of all ages. The organizers provide facilities and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: 12 km main category around Slaný
Children’s and youth categories with shorter courses
Facilities provided at Gymnázium V.B.T. Slaný
additional: The race is traditionally held in November; the most recent edition took place on 29 November 2025. The organizers thank all participants and look forward to the next edition. In the past, around 70 runners took part in the main category, along with several dozen children and young people. The main race is 12 km. Registration takes place at Gymnázium V.B.T. Slaný, and the races are held on Saturday, 21 November 2026, at 10:00.

name: Čertovskej wintertrail
location: Hamr na Jezeře, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

description: Čertovskej wintertrail is a trail race through the hills, forests and rocky terrain around Hamr na Jezeře. The race offers two distances, 33.3 km and 16.6 km, and runners can switch between them free of charge. Participants can expect challenging winter conditions, several aid stations and an unforgettable experience on the “hellish” course. Both distances start together at 10:00, and the time limit is 7 hours. The entry fee includes timing, gifts and refreshments on the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: Trail running through hills, forests and rocky terrain
Two distances: 33.3 km and 16.6 km, with the option to switch free of charge
3 aid stations on the long course and 1 on the short course, plus refreshments at the finish
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. The time limit is 7 hours, with cut-off times at the aid stations at km 15 (3 hours) and km 25 (5 hours). Runners must bring their own drinking cup; a Čertovskej running cup is available to buy at race registration. The entry fee includes pre-race refreshments (coffee, homemade cake), gifts in the race pack (sports socks), chip timing and split times, and food and drinks at the finish (soup, main course, beer, soft drink, mulled wine, tea). Marked course, aid stations, bring your own drinking cup, accommodation nearby, registration on Friday and Saturday before the race.

name: Vranov Trail
location: Vranov, Brno-Country District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Trail is a series of running races organized by friends who run ultratrails and create high-quality events with carefully planned courses, good food, and a relaxed atmosphere. The races take place around Brno and Vranov, often in forests and on trails with carefully marked routes. Each race has its own special feature, such as a winter night run or a spring half marathon symbolizing the balance between day and night. After each race, there is an afterparty with hot food and drinks, adding to the friendly atmosphere of the event.
course_highlights: Courses follow forest paths and trails around Brno and Vranov
Routes are clearly marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter night trail with a heated tent and hot drinks
additional: Race facilities are often set up outdoors at the Stará Prádelna or Samovýčep venues. There are plenty of refreshments on the course, including water and sports drinks, and hot food after the finish. After the race, there is an afterparty with hot food and drinks, including mulled wine. Bus travel is recommended, with stops nearby. Parking is limited, and participants should follow the organizers’ instructions. Race bibs are collected at designated times before the start.

name: GP vytrvalců Kamenného Újezda
location: Kamenný Újezd, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

name: Lysacup – Visalaje, parkoviště
location: Parkoviště ve Visalajích, Visalaje, Staré Hamry, Czech Republic
description: Lysacup is a winter stage running series in the Beskydy Mountains, held mostly on Lysá hora. Each weekend, a stage starts from a different location, and both individuals and teams compete. The start is usually at 10:00, and participants use chips activated for the entire season with a voluntary contribution. The race offers the atmosphere of a traditional mountain run, with the option to take part as a walker too. The overall winner receives a perpetual trophy, and the race is supported by a number of partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: Winter stage race on mountainous terrain in the Beskydy Mountains
Each stage starts from a different location, usually on Lysá hora (1323 m above sea level)
Mountain-running atmosphere with scoring for individuals and teams
additional: The start is usually at 10:00. Participants must have a chip activated for the entire season, which is obtained by sending a voluntary contribution. Chips can also be bought from other competitors or the organizers. If there are many competitors, the organizers reserve the right to adjust the scoring. The two worst stages are discarded from the overall standings, one from each half of the series. It is also possible to take part as a walker, with an assigned number of points. The overall winner and the best teams receive perpetual trophies. The organizers provide refreshments and prizes from sponsors.

name: Lesný beh priateľov Šemše
price_range: 12-18 € v závislosti od dĺžky trate a spôsobu registrácie
description: The Lesný beh priateľov Šemše is a running event in the municipality of Šemša, in the Košice-okolie District, offering three distances: 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km. The course runs along paved forest roads and trails, country roads and asphalt, creating a pleasant and varied running environment. The race is open to all ages, with no age-group divisions, and is organised by the Šemša v pohybe civic association. The start is split into two waves: the longer distance starts at 10:00, and the shorter distances at 11:00. The event is suitable for runners looking for a forest run with a choice of distances and difficulty levels.
course_highlights: The course follows paved forest roads and trails
Includes country roads and asphalt sections
Three distances: 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km
additional: The start is split into two waves: the 22 km race starts at 10:00, and the 5.5 km and 11 km races start at 11:00. Categories have no age restrictions and are intended for children, men and women. The event is organised by the Šemša v pohybe civic association. The course surface is varied, including forest roads, country roads and asphalt. The race takes place on terrain featuring forest roads, country roads and asphalt. Registration is available online or on site. Categories are available for children, men and women, with a choice of short and long distances.

name: Beh na Kysacký hrad
organizer: Klub orientačného behu Kysak, Obec Kysak

tiers.label: tier_1

The course runs mainly on forest roads (85%), with a smaller proportion on asphalt (15%). The race is open to various age groups, from youth to veterans, divided by age and gender. Entry fees vary by category and are paid during registration, with payment by bank transfer available until a specified deadline. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to compete in beautiful natural surroundings.

Start at the Cultural House in Kysak
Several age categories, from youth to veterans

The event includes categories for various age groups and genders.

description: Vilnius Challenge is a unique multisport event held since 2009, giving participants the opportunity to test their physical and psychological limits on a variety of courses. The event includes running, cycling, orienteering, and special physical challenges, offering an adventure in Vilnius’s urban and natural surroundings. Participants can choose a course level to suit their ability, from amateur to extreme courses with a range of obstacles. Vilnius Challenge promotes a healthy lifestyle, teamwork, and community spirit, bringing together sports enthusiasts and people who enjoy an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course includes running, cycling, orienteering, and physical challenges
Participants can choose a course level: amateur, challenge, or extreme
The extreme course features climbing, crawling, swimming, and rappelling
additional: The event centre is the main event venue, where registration, the start, and the finish take place. Participants receive information about the programme and other important details by email in stages. Start times and participant flow may be managed in waves for safety. The event programme and courses may be adjusted for objective reasons. Trail running event with courses at several levels; registration is required. Event date: November 21, 2026.

The event features two distances: 15 km and 5 km, with the start and finish located at the municipal stadium. It is organized by the Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Club together with local authorities. The race attracts both experienced runners and younger participants, offering sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the municipal stadium in Maków Mazowiecki
Two distances to choose from: 15 km and 5 km
An urban course suited to adult and youth runners
additional: Timekeeping uses a modern UHF RFID system with passive chips. Results are displayed instantly on a television at the finish and sent to runners by SMS. The race is filmed in Full HD, and an electronic clock at the finish tracks the time. The organizer provides original race bibs made of synthetic or laminated paper. Runners can choose between the 5 km and 15 km races; the event includes training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks and expert support; the race is part of a series of sporting events in the region.

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewnickie forests in Katowice. The race takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about appropriate conduct in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and members of sports clubs.
course_highlights: A route through the Panewnickie forests, approximately 4,882 m long
The loop is marked every 1 km
The route can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for running and Nordic walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Children and young people under 18 may participate only when accompanied by a parent or guardian. A package covering all starts during the year is available for purchase. Entry fees are non-refundable, but they may be transferred to the next start if the request is submitted by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the start. Running and Nordic walking events; 3-hour time limit; annual packages available.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of urban parks and forests. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located on Św. Wawrzyńca Street. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compare their results on the same course over many years. Races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and nationwide rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start and finish by the city beach at Rusałka, Św. Wawrzyńca Street
Suitable for both run-walking and fast running, and accessible to runners of all abilities
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the main race at 11:00, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course remains unchanged, allowing participants to compare results over the years. In the 2026/2027 season, the Poznań edition also includes races on 11 October 2026, 17 January 2027, and 21 March 2027. The series also features races for children and young people.

description: The Nuremberg Winter Running Series is a traditional running event held in several stages around Dutzendteich and Silbersee in Nuremberg. The races follow gravel and partially paved paths, where snow and ice may be present, underscoring the winter character of the event. The series offers various distances from 5 km to 20 km and is open to recreational runners of all age groups. All runners are welcome; club membership is not required. Times are recorded electronically, and there is a cup classification for participants who take part in all three races.
course_highlights: Route around Dutzendteich and Silbersee
Gravel and partially paved paths
Possible icy and snowy conditions on the course
additional: The Winter Running Series consists of three races, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 20 km spread across three dates. To qualify for the cup classification, you must register for all three races. Bib numbers are non-transferable and must be worn visibly. Refreshments are available in the start/finish area. The course may change due to official orders. Routes around Dutzendteich and Silbersee; snow and ice possible; accompanying others on sports equipment is not permitted; aids such as inline skates are not permitted; start times between November 2025 and February 2026.

name: Memmelsdorfer Schlosslauf
description: The Memmelsdorf Castle Run is a longstanding running event held annually in Memmelsdorf since 1985. The event offers various race distances around Seehof Palace, with community and the beautiful setting at its heart. Participants of all ages are warmly invited to explore the varied routes in and around the palace and enjoy sport together.
course_highlights: Runs around Seehof Palace
Various distances for all age groups
Scenic routes through the palace park and surrounding forests
additional: Multiple race distances, including Bambini, junior races and a fun run; registration and detailed information on the website; the event takes place in late November.

name: Wilscher Geburtstags-Etappen-Marathon
description: The VfR Wilsche-Neubokel Birthday Stage Marathon is a special group run that annually honors all runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. Participants run together at a moderate pace of 6:00 to 6:15 minutes per kilometer and can join at various refreshment stops. At these stage points, the birthday celebrants treat the runners to culinary delights, making the run a unique and enjoyable experience. The event combines sporting camaraderie with a festive atmosphere and is a cherished club tradition.
course_highlights: Group run at a pace of 6:00–6:15 min/km
Refreshment stops approximately every 5–10 km, with a 10-minute break
You can join at any refreshment stop
additional: The run honors all fellow runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. The birthday celebrants lovingly prepare the refreshments at the stage points. Recent photos from the run are available via an external Flickr link. Group run, approx. 6:00–6:15 min/km; registration via an external link

name: WMF BKK AST Süßen Herbstlauf
description: The WMF BKK AST Süßen Autumn Run is a long-established running event held annually in Süßen. It offers main races over 5 km and 11 km, a 1.8 km youth race, and a 5 km walking route. The event takes place at the Kultur- und Sporthalle Süßen, which is open from 11:00 a.m. into the evening. The Autumn Run welcomes runners of all ability levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main races over 5 km and 11 km
1.8 km youth race
5 km walking route
additional: The venue is the Kultur- und Sporthalle Süßen, open from 11:00 a.m. until the evening. Races are available for different age and ability groups, along with a walking route. The event is part of AST Süßen’s club life. Courses are not officially measured; on-site registration is available; bibs use transponder timing; various running and walking options are offered for all age groups.

name: Winterlaufserie TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen – 1. Lauf
description: The TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event held at the Weidelsburg Stadium in Wolfhagen-Ippinghausen. It includes several races ranging from 310 m to 15 km on forest paths with firm, paved surfaces. The series is open to all age groups and offers individual and team rankings, with certificates and awards. The event is sanctioned by the Hessian Athletics Association and emphasizes fair conditions; for example, spikes are not allowed.

name: Winterlauf-/Wanderserie TuS Jaderberg 1.Teil
description: The TuS Jaderberg Winter Running and Walking Series is a popular event held annually in Jaderberg. The first part of the series takes place in November and gives runners and walkers the opportunity to enjoy some friendly sporting competition. The event is known for its winter atmosphere and the support of TuS Jaderberg, which organizes the series. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Winter running and walking routes
A shared community experience
Part of a popular series in Jaderberg
additional: The first part of the series takes place on November 22, 2026. The event promotes sporting activities in the community.

name: 405. Malá cena Monaka
description: The 405th Malá cena Monaka is a traditional running event taking place on November 22, 2026, in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The event is part of the Monaka race series and offers runners of all levels the opportunity to take part and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. Exact details about the course and registration are not yet available, but the race is popular with both local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: A traditional local race in the heart of the Pardubice Region
A welcoming atmosphere and friendly setting
The opportunity to take part in various categories and at different performance levels
additional: The race is part of the Monaka series, which has a long tradition in the region. Exact information about registration and course distance has not yet been published.

description: Running Back to the Past is a unique event where history becomes the present. All the award medals, trophies, and prizes from previous years’ races are given a second life and new meaning, symbolizing the bond within the running community. The essence of the event is not the novelty of the trophies, but the joy of running and the opportunity to rediscover the meaning of sport. Every participant who completes the full marathon distance will receive a Saulėtekis Marathon neck gaiter.

name: Temple x Nike Winterized Challenge
description: The “Nike Winterized Challenge” with Temple Social is your motivation boost for the cold season. Keep running when the days get shorter and the weather gets colder. Join the Nike and Temple Social running community—we’ll run for 4 weeks, twice a week. Every step counts—earn points, and Nike will reward you with discounts and gifts. Four of you will have the chance to win the new VOMERO GORE-TEX!

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Run Provocation is an annual running event held in Gliwice, combining sport, a friendly atmosphere and time among the city’s green spaces. The run is open to both experienced runners and people who want to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The start traditionally takes place in the clearing behind the Piast Stadium, and participants can look forward to a welcoming atmosphere and an active way to wrap up February. The event is a great opportunity to start a new month with energy and in a good mood.
course_highlights: Start in the clearing behind Piast Stadium (entrance from Leśna Street)
The route passes through the city’s green spaces
The event combines sport, a friendly atmosphere and recreation
additional: The event office is open from 9:00. To be included in the results, advance registration and an entry fee are required. The event takes place on the last day of February, making it a great way to end the month actively. trail run, online registration, start and finish in the clearing behind Piast Stadium

name: Jesienny Ultra Świr
description: Jesienny Ultra Świr is a mountain ultramarathon held in Grybów, offering a challenge for fans of long-distance running in natural terrain. The course runs mainly along forest and gravel paths, with minimal asphalt, providing an authentic trail-running experience. The event offers different competition formats, including timed races and Nordic Walking, catering to various levels of experience. It is organised by experienced enthusiasts who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and participants’ safety.
course_highlights: 98% of the course runs along forest and gravel paths
Minimal asphalt: just 2%
Start and finish at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa
additional: The start, finish and race office are at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa. On race day, the race office is open from 06:45 to 07:30 for the 6/12/24-hour distances and until 09:30 for Nordic Walking and the one-lap race. In the 6-hour and 12-hour races, the winner is the participant who completes the greatest number of full 17 km laps. Running is prohibited during the Nordic Walking event, and judges on the course monitor proper technique. Participants must check in at the race office with an identity document and have the mandatory equipment. The event is part of the Jesienny Ultra Świr series, which includes various distances and activity formats, with online registration. The course may be changed due to weather conditions.

name: XXIII Maraton Komandosa
description: The XXIII Commandos Marathon is a demanding 42.195 km marathon held in Lubliniec. The race takes place on 28 November 2026 and is organised by the Wojskowy Klub Biegacza „Meta” Lubliniec. The course has recently been changed and is available online. Participants can expect professional timekeeping and full technical support for the event.
course_highlights: The new course is available online
Marathon distance: 42.195 km
Organiser: Wojskowy Klub Biegacza „Meta” Lubliniec
additional: The race office is open on 28 November from 15:00 to 20:30 and on 29 November from 07:00 to 08:40. The entry fee can only be paid via an individual link to quick online payments through tpay.com, sent by email. After 31 October 2026, entry is possible only with the organiser’s consent and without the full race package. The participant limit has been reached and registration is suspended. New course; participant limit reached; urban and forest terrain; electronic timekeeping.

name: Freiberger Adventslauf
description: The Freiberger Advent Run takes place on November 28, 2026, in the festively decorated city center of Freiberg, combining sporting activity with the special atmosphere of the run-up to Christmas. The event is a regional highlight, with several races for different age groups and distances. It attracts many runners every year and offers a festive setting with musical accompaniment, including the barrel drummers “Blechlawine” at Schlossplatz. Registration opens in June 2026 and is in high demand due to the limit of 1,000 pre-registrations.
course_highlights: Festively decorated city center of Freiberg
Musical accompaniment from the barrel drummers “Blechlawine” at Schlossplatz
Various race distances from 1 km to 12 km, including a relay
additional: Race number pickup from 12:00 at Rüleinsporthalle; late entries and changes are possible until 1 hour before the start. All races start at Café Hartmann. Start times: Bambini Run 15:00, 1 km Children's Run 15:15, 3 km Teen Run 15:30, 6 km Fun Run 15:45, 12 km Main Run and relay 16:30. Limit of 1,000 pre-registrations. Registration opens in June 2026; late entries are possible on race day. Start times: Bambini Run at 15:00, Children's Run at 15:15, Teen Run at 15:30, Fun Run at 15:45, Main Run at 16:30.

name: Mesumer Adventslauf
description: The Mesum Advent Run is a long-established running event in Rheine, offering various distances from 1 to 10 kilometres. More than 660 runners took part in the 37th edition in pleasant temperatures and sunshine. The event attracts a broad range of participants, including many athletes from Laufgemeinschaft Emsdetten, who achieved excellent results in various age groups. The race offers an appealing competition during Advent for both ambitious and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Races over 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
More than 660 finishers
Top placings in various age groups
additional: The race takes place in cool temperatures and usually sunny weather. The event includes several distances suitable for young people and children. Laufgemeinschaft Emsdetten is strongly represented and supports the event. Races in Rheine-Mesum, family-friendly, flat courses, races for children and young people

description: 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – November is a regular running race in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The race is part of the 16th edition of the Vaší Liga running series, where runners can compare their performances with others and track their progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments, and the chance to share your experiences at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex.
course_highlights: A pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified measurer; suitable for achieving the Czech Championships qualifying standard over 10 km
Relaxed running atmosphere with refreshments after the race
additional: The 10 km race starts at 14:00 and the 5 km race at 14:05. Check-in is open from 13:00 in the blue tent by the cycle path near U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, an isotonic drink is available, as well as refreshments at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. The race is timed using chip timing, and each runner also receives a chip time. The race takes place in November 2026; registration is probably through the official website. The series includes multiple races throughout the year.

name: Mikulášský běh Zlín
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Zlín-Louky is a traditional running race held in the beautiful setting along the Dřevnice River. The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes on flat loops with crossings over small bridges and cycle paths. It also includes a 1.5 km family run in costume, a children’s programme, and St. Nicholas and devil-themed festivities. Runners receive a race pack with gifts and a commemorative medal at the finish. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant Advent atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route follows a wide grassy path along the Dřevnice River
Crossings over a concrete bridge and an iron footbridge
Flat loops around the football pitch in Zlín-Louky
additional: A 1.5 km family run in costume, with gingerbread as a finish-line reward. A children’s programme and St. Nicholas and devil-themed festivities in costume. The race pack contains gifts from partners and a commemorative medal. A charity raffle for Krtek, with prizes sold and awarded during the event. 5 km and 10 km races, family and children’s runs, a charity event, start and finish by the football pitch in Zlín-Louky, a varied accompanying programme, and a race pack.

name: Výběh na Lovoš
location: Lovoš, Lovosice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run up Lovoš is a traditional uphill race held in Lovosice, in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a challenging trail run climbing to the summit of Lovoš, a popular destination for runners seeking a challenge and beautiful views. The start is on Lovošská Street, and the race is suitable for runners who want to try uphill running in a natural setting. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with registration available in advance or on site.
course_highlights: Off-road uphill run
Start on Lovošská Street in Lovosice
Challenging climb to the summit of Lovoš
additional: Luggage transport is available from 12:30 to 13:30. The vehicle carrying the bags departs at 13:30, so be sure to watch the departure time. The race is part of the Král středohoří sports event series. Registration is available in advance or on site. The start is at 14:00, and luggage departs at 13:30.

The atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, with extensive facilities and refreshments after the finish. The entry fee includes a finisher’s medal, timing, race photos, prizes, and a raffle. The race is open to all athletes, taking their health and abilities into account.

name: 45 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kamiennik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a walking orienteering event in which teams of 2–5 plan their own route to visit as many checkpoints as possible within a set time. The checkpoints are spread across the terrain and marked on a map. The event is open to participants of different ages and experience levels, from enthusiasts and recreational participants to families. Rogaining combines tourism and sport, and participants can modify their route at any time during the competition, making it an appealing way to enjoy the outdoors. The event is organised by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin District Branch, which has been holding orienteering competitions in the region for many years.
course_highlights: Teams travel on foot only, using a map and compass to navigate the terrain
Checkpoints have different point values depending on how difficult they are to find
Participants can choose and change their own route, at any length from 5 to 70 km
additional: The competition is open to all age groups and genders. Teams consist of 2–5 people. Rogaining combines tourism and sport and is suitable for both experienced competitors and families. Routes can be changed during the competition. In 2026, four rogaining events are planned around Strzelin, including the 45th edition in November. The events offer distances from 5 km to 70 km and use maps and compasses. They cater to different experience levels and offer both recreational and competitive participation.

name: Szybka Piątka
description: Szybka Piątka is a 5 km race held in Lublin on 29 November 2026. The event is part of a series of races organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which promotes physical activity and the integration of the local community. The race is an excellent opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness and enjoy the city’s sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the city
Training support for 8 to 20 weeks
Organized by a local sports foundation
additional: The race is part of local sporting events and includes various distances and age categories, as well as the Lublin Grand Prix classifications.

name: VI Biegowe Grand Prix Krainy Dobrej Energii
Christmas Run To Tree
description: The Christmas Run To Tree is an atmospheric forest run in Klövensteen Forest near Hamburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km or 12 km. The run combines sporting activity with the special experience of buying a Christmas tree. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Forest run through scenic Klövensteen Forest
Choice of 6 km or 12 km distance
Race bib in the shape of a Christmas tree
additional: Race packet pickup on event day from 09:00 to 11:15. The race bib is in the shape of a Christmas tree and must be worn visibly on the chest. Bag drop-off is available with the coupon on the race bib. Late entries are not possible. Participant transfers are possible for a fee until November 25. Awards ceremony for the 6 km at 11:15 and for the 12 km at 13:00. The event includes race bib pickup, certificates, Christmas activities, and a festive atmosphere.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Schiffenberger Wald, Giessen, is a flat running event held annually in November. It offers 5 km and 10 km races for adults, as well as races for children and young people. The event is ideal for runners looking for a fast, flat course in a natural setting. The start and finish are at the same location; exact details are available through RUNME Premium. The run takes place on Sunday, November 29, 2026, and starts at 10:15 a.m.
course_highlights: Flat course in Schiffenberger Wald
5 km and 10 km distances for adults
Races for children and young people
additional: The start and finish are the same for all races. The exact start and finish locations are visible only with RUNME Premium. There are also 5 km walking and Nordic walking events. Results are usually published on the RUNME results page shortly after runners finish. The event is for adults, children, and young people, with start times in the morning. The exact start and finish locations are visible only with RUNME Premium.

name: Friedeholz Cross
description: The Friedeholz Cross is a traditional forest cross-country race in Syke, Lower Saxony, and part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series. On November 29, 2026, races will be held over various distances, from a 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race to the 10.3 km main race, for children, young people, and adults. The course runs mostly on forest trails, with a short asphalt section before the finish at Waldstadion Syke. The event offers a varied cross-country running experience in an autumn setting and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Mostly forest trails with only approx. 100 m of asphalt
Start and finish at Waldstadion Syke
Part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series, with several distances
additional: Four distances on race day: 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 3.6 km middle distance for U16 and older, and 10.3 km main race for U20 and older. The event is part of a series of three races, with series scoring for those who register before the first race. Switching between the middle and long distances is possible, but does not count as a series switch. Forest trails, cross-country running, series scoring, registration required for series scoring, limited shower and changing facilities at Waldstadion Syke

name: Ratzeburger Adventslauf
description: The Ratzeburg Advent Run is a traditional race around Lake Ratzeburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. The main course covers 26 kilometres, mostly on hiking trails with scenic sections and historical landmarks. There is also a 7.5 km run around Küchensee and a 1.5 km children’s run, offering an accessible introduction to running. The event combines a sporting challenge with nature and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 26 km around Lake Ratzeburg, with approx. 80% hiking trails and 20% asphalt
5 refreshment stations along the course at km 5, 10, 15, 20 and 22.5
A scenic, undulating 7.5 km route around Küchensee, plus a 1.5 km children’s run with spectator support
additional: New since 2022: split-time tracking on the 26 km course, allowing spectators and athletes to follow intermediate times. The races start at the same time, with runners lining up on the right-hand side at the start on Königsdamm. The children’s run is supported by Dein-Holzpferd.de. Routes around Lake Ratzeburg and Küchensee; online registration opens on 01.09.2026; participant limits apply to each distance; timing by Race Result.

name: Schlößlelauf - 4. Lauf der Jedermannlaufserie
description: The Schlößlelauf in Donauwörth is the fourth race in the Jedermannlauf series and offers runners of all ages and ability levels an attractive opportunity to compete. The event is organised by LG Donau-Ries and traditionally takes place in late autumn. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Donauwörth and is part of a popular running series in the region. The event promotes recreational sport and is aimed at children, young people and active runners.
course_highlights: Part of the Jedermannlauf series
Various categories for all age groups
Race in the historic town of Donauwörth
additional: Registration is by email. The event includes running and cycling events, as well as filters for terrain and sport type.

name: Uplengener Adventslauf
description: The Uplengen Advent Run is a traditional cross-country race taking place for the 54th time. The races run through the Hollsand Nature Reserve and offer challenging courses depending on the weather. The event is one of the oldest running events in the region and is often used to prepare for cross-country championships. Various course distances give young people and adults the opportunity to achieve personal bests or improve their endurance. The Remels Primary School Friends’ Association will provide coffee and cake.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Hollsand Nature Reserve
Challenging courses depending on the weather
Various course distances for different age groups
additional: U14 runners can choose between 1450 m and 3100 m; U16 runners can take part in the 4450 m middle-distance race. The red loop is approximately 3000 m plus a 100 m start chute. The course uses a checkpoint system for route guidance. Cross-country race in the Hollsand Nature Reserve; course distances vary; registration and results online; coffee and cake from the Remels Primary School Friends’ Association.

name: Poľančanska päťka
location: Sečovská Polianka, Vranov nad Topľou District, Prešov Region, Slovakia

name: Trail Start: Nemokama Bėgimo Treniruotė
location: Vingio parko lauko treniruoklių sporto aikštelė
description: Trail START. A free running workout with Monika Mile will take place on December 2 (Tuesday) at 18:30 at the outdoor fitness equipment area in Vingis Park. The workout will last about 1 hour and cover approximately 5 km at an easy pace. It is aimed at beginners who want to learn to run confidently in the forest. The focus will be on technique, feel, and safety in the forest. You must bring running shoes with good tread, weather-appropriate clothing, a headlamp, and a good mood.

name: Advento bėgimo iššūkis 2026
description: The Advent Running Challenge 2026 is a virtual event taking place from December 1 to 24. Participants receive a new task each day, involving running, physical, accuracy, and creative challenges. The challenge encourages not only speed, but also perseverance, creativity, and engagement throughout all 24 days. Participants compete for the title of Advent Champion and receive a participant kit, with the chance to win prizes from the prize fund.
course_highlights: 24 days with 24 different tasks
Physical, accuracy, and creative challenges
A virtual running challenge with the opportunity to earn points and compete
additional: A participant kit for every participant. Prize fund: €175 (may increase depending on the number of participants). A 24-day challenge with tasks, prizes, and registration via a Google Form.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is an exceptional trail race taking place on 5 December 2026 in the picturesque Tricity Landscape Park. The course combines a seaside atmosphere with varied, mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging climbs, valleys, ravines and gorges. It is a great opportunity to end the season amid sporting competition and close contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Tricity Landscape Park, close to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, ravines and gorges
Challenging elevation gains and natural climbs characteristic of trail running
additional: Race packs can be collected on 4–5 December 2026 at the race office. Starts are held in waves: the 6 km night race starts at 19:00 on 4 December; on 5 December, the 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30) and 12 km (13:30) races start, along with Garmin Junior races for children. Time limits for completing the distances range from 2 to 15 hours, depending on course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The participant card is available 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Distances from 12 km to 86 km, time limits, qualifying points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and young people.

name: Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf
description: The Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf is a popular race around the Christmas market in Wiedenbrück’s old town, illuminated for the festive season. The course is a five-lap circuit of approximately 10.2 km and has not been officially measured. The race traditionally takes place in December and offers a festive atmosphere in the town centre. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück and attracts numerous runners from the region.
course_highlights: Five-lap circuit around the Christmas market
Wiedenbrück’s old town illuminated for the festive season
Approximately 10.2 km; run clockwise
additional: Start and finish on Lange Straße in Wiedenbrück. Race-pack collection on 5.12.2025 from 15:00 at the Luise-Hensel-Saal in the Stadthaus. Online registration only, opening on 8.10.2025 at 21:00. No race-day registration. Time limit: 75 minutes. Wearing headphones or earbuds is prohibited and will result in disqualification. Participants are asked to keep as far to the right as possible and not to run in groups, to allow others to lap them. Participant limit: 1,100. Online registration only. Medals can be reordered. Start on 04.12.2026.

name: Pražská stovka
location: Milín, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

name: Vánoční večerní běh Líbeznice
location: Areál ZŠ a ZUŠ Líbeznice, Líbeznice, Czech Republic
description: The Christmas Evening Run in Líbeznice is a traditional sporting event held on the grounds of the Líbeznice Primary School and School of Arts. The run is paired with a competition for the best Christmas strudel, adding a festive atmosphere and a community feel. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an enjoyable experience in the run-up to Christmas. It is organised by Monika Šponerová and takes place on Friday, 4 December 2026.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km long
Gently undulating terrain with both firm and off-road surfaces
Part of the route is unlit; a headlamp was mandatory in previous years
additional: The event takes place on the grounds of the Líbeznice Primary School and School of Arts. It is organised by Monika Šponerová and includes a competition for the best Christmas strudel.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners of all abilities. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running levels. Participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete throughout the Grand Prix series. Registration is available only at the Race Office on race day, and participation is free.
course_highlights: 10 km race in the scenic surroundings of Mysłowice
A series of seasonal events promoting a healthy lifestyle
A running community and opportunities to connect with the local community
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation in the Grand Prix races is free. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. It focuses on promoting physical activity, health, and the running community, with varied courses and seasonal editions.

name: Trail!ON Stawiguda 2026/2027 #1
location: Ruś, Gmina Stawiguda, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Berliner Nikolauslauf 2026
price_range: 5,00 Euro bis 30,00 Euro (je nach Kategorie und Anmeldungstermin)
description: The 2026 Berlin St. Nicholas Run is a traditional race around the picturesque Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke lakes in Berlin’s Grunewald forest. The course follows a measured 5.3-kilometre lakeside path that is popular with both recreational visitors and competitive athletes. The event offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the Bambini Marathon to the Big 5 Marathon, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings. It takes place on December 6, 2026, and is organised by DIE LAUFPARTNER e.V.
course_highlights: A loop around Schlachtensee, 5.3 km per lap
A nature-rich route through Berlin’s Grunewald forest
A popular training route with top athletes and recreational visitors
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:00 a.m. at Fischerhüttenstraße 137, 14163 Berlin, near the turning circle between Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke. Race-day late entries are available online, subject to an additional fee. The event offers a range of distances for runners and Nordic walkers, as well as relay races. Distances range from 330 m to 26.8 km. Registration is available online or in writing; race-day late entries are online only and subject to a fee. Race bibs can be collected in Berlin.

name: Forchheimer Nikolauslauf
description: The Forchheim Nikolauslauf is a long-standing running event hosted by LG Forchheim on the Sportinsel in Forchheim. The 46th edition takes place on December 5, 2026, and features races for children and young people, a 5.3 km fun run, and a 10 km main race. The course follows a new route heading south, with the 10 km race making four circuits around the Sportinsel. The event regularly attracts more than 600 participants and offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Children’s and youth races in the morning, starting at 11:20 a.m.
5.3 km fun run on a new route heading south (4 laps)
10 km main race with four laps around the Sportinsel
additional: Start times: children’s and youth races from 11:20 a.m., 5.3 km fun run at 1:00 p.m., 10 km main race at 2:00 p.m. The 5.3 km course is run four times heading south; the 10 km course is run four times around the Sportinsel. Various race categories, festive atmosphere, traditional December event, children’s and youth races, 5.3 km fun run, 10 km main race.

name: Glücksburger Nikolaus-Crosslauf
location: Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2, 24960 Glücksburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Glücksburg St Nicholas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country event held in December in Glücksburg on the Baltic Sea, organised by TSV Glücksburg 09. The races start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2. Adults and older teenagers can choose between a medium 4.1 km cross-country run and a long 8.2 km run, while younger children take part in shorter, fun runs. The event has a St Nicholas theme, with a piggyback run for parents carrying babies and various races for toddlers and young people. Every participant receives a chocolate Santa Claus as a gift.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on varied terrain by the Baltic Sea
Start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2
A range of distances from 100 m to 8.2 km for all age groups
additional: The youngest participants’ races are not timed, to preserve their fun, playful character. The event takes place in typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. It also includes volunteer duties at the start, finish and along the course, as well as refreshments including coffee, tea and cake. Registration is online, and the event takes place at Schwennau Arena in Glücksburg.

name: Nikolauslauf
description: The Nikolauslauf in Schnaitheim is a traditional running event held annually at Moldenberg. The event offers various distances for students, fitness runners, and trail runners, including 5 km, 10 km, and a 12 km trail run. Runners can look forward to a varied course in a sporty, family-friendly atmosphere. TSG Schnaitheim Athletics looks forward to welcoming all participants on December 5.
course_highlights: Children’s races with age-appropriate courses
5 km fitness run and walking on varied terrain
12 km trail run with sections close to nature
additional: The Nikolauslauf takes place at Moldenberg. The event is organized by TSG Schnaitheim 1874 e.V. Various race distances are available for different age and ability groups. Results and rankings from previous races are available to download. The event takes place on December 5, 2026, with course analyses, elevation details, and downloadable results. It is a popular event for runners and walkers in the region.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim (2)
description: The Rodgau Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event that has taken place in Rodgau-Jügesheim since 1980, attracting both recreational runners and top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series comprises four events, each offering 5 km and 10 km distances, starting at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion. Alongside the sporting competition, community spirit is also a key focus, supported by team scoring for men’s, women’s and mixed teams. The event is easy to reach by public transport and offers professional timing with a chip attached to each race number.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion in Rodgau-Jügesheim
5 km and 10 km distances
Easy to reach by S-Bahn (S1), with only a 1 km walk from the station
additional: Team scoring is available for teams of three (men, women, mixed). Chip timing with gun-time recording by MA:XX-. The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. Series dates: 1.11.2025, 6.12.2025, 3.1.2026, 7.2.2026. The series comprises several races, with team scoring also available. The routes are on paved and asphalted forest paths, which often have snow or frost in winter conditions. Training plans for various target times are offered to help runners prepare for the races.

name: MOUNTAINMAN Nikolaus-Trail Pommelsbrunn
description: The MOUNTAINMAN Nikolaus Trail in Pommelsbrunn offers trail running and hiking in the picturesque Hersbrucker Schweiz in the Nürnberger Land. On December 5, 2026, runners can choose from four challenging routes ranging from 10 km to a marathon, and families can take part in the Wichtel Trail. The trails are well marked and cross varied terrain with some challenging climbs, making them ideal for both ambitious runners and beginners. A free shuttle service makes getting there easier, and there are special options for trail runners with dogs.
course_highlights: Four routes from 10 km to a marathon, with challenging climbs
Well-marked trails in the Hersbrucker Schweiz
Wichtel Trail for families and special trails for runners with dogs
additional: On Saturday, December 5, 2026, the XL and L trails and the Wichtel Trail take place; on Sunday, December 6, 2026, the S and M trails take place, including options for runners with dogs. A free shuttle service runs from parking areas in Happurg to the start and finish area. The routes are fully marked, and participants receive a voucher code 14 days before the event for a free Komoot route download. Parking in Pommelsbrunn is limited, so travel by public transport is recommended. Trails with up to 1,582 meters of elevation gain, aid stations, well-marked routes, GPS downloads available.

name: Maraton Praha – Dobříš
location: A Park, Braník, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Prague–Dobříš Marathon is a traditional trail race held on 5 December 2026. The event offers three distances: 42 km with an individual start, and 21 km and 10 km with mass starts. The route runs from Prague 4, Braník, through Dobříš to Kytín, with elevation ranging from 125 to 593 metres. Runners can use baggage transport from the start to the finish. Overall winners and age- and gender-based category winners are announced. The event is suited to trail-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with a choice of distances.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 593 m of elevation gain
Start in Prague 4, Braník; finish in Kytín
Baggage transport for runners from the start to the finish
additional: The 42 km race has an individual start; the 21 km and 10 km races have mass starts. The 42 km course has aid stations at kilometres 10, 16, 27 and 33, and at the finish. Parking is available near the start and finish area. Runners take part at their own risk and must take extra care when crossing roads. The course is suitable for runners of all levels. Online registration is available, along with course maps and information about race categories.

name: Mikulášský běh Čimelice
description: The Mikulášský běh Čimelice is a traditional annual race held in Čimelice, a popular event with a long history that usually takes place in early December. It attracts local runners and visitors, who can look forward to a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. Exact details about the course and race distance are not currently available, but the race is part of the local sporting calendar and has a long tradition.
course_highlights: A traditional race with a long history in Čimelice
Held annually in December
Friendly atmosphere and local community
additional: The race is part of the local sporting calendar. Results from 2025 are available online.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - prosinec
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children aged 12 and under (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course is a precisely measured asphalt loop; the children's course is 800 m long. The race is open to all age groups, with categories for men, women, boys, and girls. You can start by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race has a friendly atmosphere and encourages everyone to enjoy running, whether you want to improve your personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. After the finish, everyone gets a warm cinnamon pancake. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children one.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children up to 12 years old run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Beautiful setting in the Royal Game Reserve – Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate (below the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Pre-registration online is available for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age, with an age-adjustment coefficient used for the year-round Lívancový Cup. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage facility, and toilet cabins are available. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. 3.2 km course, road surface, registration is voluntary, and running without a bib is permitted.

name: LEKI WINTER SkyRace®
description: LEKI WINTER SkyRace® is a winter skyrunning race held at Ještěd, in the ski jump area. The race offers a challenging 22 km royal course with 1,180 metres of elevation gain, bringing the 2025 skyrunning season to a close. Shorter courses and children’s races are also available, welcoming a wide range of runners. The event atmosphere is rounded out by the winners’ ceremony and an accompanying programme.
course_highlights: Winter SkyRace® royal course: 22 km with 1,180 m of elevation gain
Other courses: Winter Trail 12 km / 520 m+, Winter Easy 6 km / 220 m+
Children’s races: 200 m, 500 m and 1,200 m
additional: The winners’ ceremony starts at 15:30. The race takes place in the ski jump area at Ještěd. Canicross races are also available over the same distances as the main courses. The race is part of the LEKI JEŠTĚD SERIES. winter mountain race, multiple courses, children’s races, canicross, registration, race equipment and refreshments

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace®
description: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace® is a trail-running race held on the Ještěd Ridge in the Liberec Region. It offers challenging courses with beautiful views and natural scenery, appealing to both experienced runners and fans of mountain running. The race is part of the JEŠTĚD SKYRACE series and is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and extensive accompanying program, including healthy refreshments and a partner zone. Participants can also purchase original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary.
course_highlights: Trails on the Ještěd Ridge with beautiful views
Challenging mountain terrain with courses of varying distances (22 km, 13 km, 6 km)
Extensive accompanying program, including healthy and varied refreshments
additional: Participants receive a specially stocked race bag. Healthy and varied refreshments are available, including meat, vegetarian, and vegan options, as well as quality coffee. The event also features a TV studio with interviews and competitions, and an expanded partner zone with equipment and accessories for runners. Original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary is available. Races on different courses, a series of summer and winter races, registration, results, and rules are available on the official website.

name: Čertovská 5
description: Čertovská 5 is a traditional winter run in Unhošť over a distance of 5.7 km. It offers not only a sporting experience, but also a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Runners are welcome to wear devil costumes, adding a unique atmosphere to the race. The race is divided into categories by age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place at the Sokol hall and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Traditional 5.7 km winter run
Runners in devil costumes are welcome
Sokol Cup results announced after the race
additional: The race takes place on 6 December 2025 from 08:00 to 11:00 in Unhošť, at the Sokol hall, Melicharova Street. Categories are divided by age and gender (men and women in different age groups). After the race, there is a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Terrain: winter course. Registration via naZávody.cz. The event is suitable for all age groups and fans of dressing up.

name: Běh do vrchu Ráztoka-Pustevny
description: The Ráztoka–Pustevny Uphill Run is a traditional mountain race held in Ráztoky and around Pustevny. It offers a challenging course with elevation gain that tests runners’ endurance and strength in the beautiful setting of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The event is popular with athletes of all levels and has a rich history dating back to 1969. It welcomes everyone who enjoys mountain running and wants to experience the race’s unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Climb to Pustevny with 400 m of elevation gain
Course length of approximately 5.7 km
Mountain setting in the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race is also suitable for children. Weather may affect conditions. Registration details are not provided. The event has a long tradition and is very popular.

name: Jested Series
description: Ještěd Skyrace is a technical trail-running race on the Ještěd Ridge, featuring challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and professionals and includes several route options, including races for children. The event is part of a race series with a friendly atmosphere and a generous participant race pack.
course_highlights: Technical trail sections on the Ještěd Ridge
Challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 m of elevation gain
Route options from 6 km to 22 km, including children’s races
additional: Mandatory equipment is required. Race bibs and timing chips are provided. On-site registration is available, along with bag storage, changing rooms and toilets. Refreshments and an awards ceremony are provided after the finish. The race is livestreamed, and results are available online. The race also offers canicross options and children’s races on shorter routes. The series also includes children’s races. The listed Winter SkyRace distances are 22, 12 and 6 km; the date 5 December 2026 is not confirmed in the available information.

name: Last Man Standing Run VYSOČINA
description: Last Man Standing Run Vysočina is a unique endurance race held on December 5, 2026, at Želiv Monastery. Competitors repeatedly complete a 6.7 km loop, starting every hour, with the aim of lasting as long as possible and lining up for another start on the hour. The inaugural edition is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops, with the winner being the person who completes all 24 loops. The race is not about speed, but about endurance and the ability to overcome physical and mental challenges in the winter conditions of Vysočina.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop through the hilly terrain of Vysočina
A new start every hour, up to a maximum of 24 loops / 24 hours
The official time is set by the tolling of the church bell at Želiv Monastery
additional: The race is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops. Every competitor must wear their race bib throughout the event and keep a timing chip on their ankle. Headphones are prohibited on the course for safety reasons. Registration is processed manually; payment details are sent by email after the application has been processed. A T-shirt can be ordered as an add-on for 490 Kč. The official race time is set by the tolling of the church bell, which also symbolically closes the finish gate on the hour. The entry fee includes participation, light refreshments and facilities. Mandatory equipment includes a red rear light, a reflective item, neck protection and a personal drinking container. Part of the route may run along roads open to regular traffic.

name: Veleslavín běží
location: Přerost a Švorc, Veleslavín, Prague 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Veleslavín běží is a 7.2 km run through the Veleslavínka Valley, past Libocký Pond in Prague 6. It takes place on December 5, 2026, at the Přerost a Švorc grounds. The race is part of the Běhej s námi 2026 series and offers events for children and adults. Children’s races of 100 m to 1,500 m, depending on age, take place in the morning, followed by the main adults’ race in the afternoon. The field is limited to 200 runners, and the race bib is also valid for other races in the series. The route runs mainly along park and field paths, with one more pronounced climb beyond the pond.
course_highlights: The 7.2 km route runs through the Veleslavínka Valley, past Libocký Pond
Mostly park and field paths with gravel and dirt, plus short sections of asphalt
One more pronounced climb of about 25 m of elevation gain beyond the pond
additional: The race bib with timing chip is also valid for other races in the Běhej s námi 2026 series. The field is limited to 200 runners. Check-in and bib pickup close 30 minutes before the start. Parking is included in the entry fee. Running with a dog is not permitted. There is no time limit. The adults’ race starts at 13:00, and the children’s races begin at 11:00. Online entry costs 200 Kč for adults; children can enter free of charge. Entry on the day costs 300 Kč for adults and 100 Kč for children. Check-in closes no later than 30 minutes before the start. Adults must be at least 15 years old to compete; running with a dog is not permitted.

name: Běh na 2 míle, Zlín – Příluky
location: Madal Bal, Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and covers just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake. Categories are divided by age and gender, with times recorded and prizes awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are Men (ages 13–127), Women (ages 13–127), Boys (up to 12 years) and Girls (up to 12 years); age categories remain the same throughout the calendar year. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The top three finishers in the men’s, women’s and children’s categories receive small prizes. The men’s course record is 9:31.8. Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building from 8:15 to 8:55, and the main race starts at 9:00. Times are recorded for all participants, and the top three in the women’s, men’s and children’s categories receive small prizes. Runners can look forward to a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish.

name: Adventní běh Žatec
location: Náměstí Svobody, Žatec, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Advent Run in Žatec is a traditional pre-Christmas running race held through the city’s historic centre, starting at Svobody Square. The race offers various categories for men, women, youth and children, with distances ranging from 330 metres to 6.6 km. Every participant receives a medal and mulled wine at the finish, adding to the pleasant Advent atmosphere. Registration opens at 14:00, and the main races start from 15:55. The event is organised by the Hopman Triathlon team, which puts on events for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: A 2,200 m loop through the historic centre of Žatec
Men run 3 loops (6,600 m); women and youth runners run 2 loops (4,400 m)
Children’s and school-age races: 330 m and 1,000 m
additional: Registration opens at 14:00, the first children’s races start from 15:15, and the main adult categories start from 15:55. Every participant receives a medal and mulled wine at the finish. Registration opens at 14:00, the children’s races start from 15:15, and the main categories start from 15:55. Every participant receives a medal and mulled wine at the finish.

name: Adventní běh pro zdraví
location: Městský úřad Hodonín, Hodonín, Czech Republic
description: The Advent Run for Health is a traditional running event organized by Běžecký klub Hodonín, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the community. The race takes place in the center of Hodonín, by the Municipal Office, and offers an opportunity for runners of all ages and ability levels. The club has a long history of organizing running competitions and supports the development of distance running in the region. The event is part of a wider running calendar and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the Municipal Office in Hodonín
The route runs through an urban setting on a pleasant surface
Friendly atmosphere and support for a healthy lifestyle
additional: The organizer is Běžecký klub Hodonín, which has a long-standing tradition. The club also organizes other running events in the region. Contact details for the club's chairman, Pavel Bíl, are listed on the website. Results from previous editions and information about other races in the Grand Prix of Distance Runners of Hodonín District are available on the website. In the 2025 edition, the first category started at 10:30; results are published on the Běžecký klub Hodonín website.

WE RUN on December 7, 2024, in Vilnius. The event stands out for its festive atmosphere and participants dressed in Christmas costumes with glowing accents. This year, participants can run after dark, when the capital’s streets reveal a truly sparkling and magical Christmas spirit.

name: Edgaro atminimui Bėgimas
description: On October 18, we invite everyone to the 11th annual “In Memoriam” run, held to honor the memory of soldiers who died this year. All funds donated during the run will support the families of deceased Lithuanian soldiers. Two championship distances are dedicated to the memory of Lithuanian sports legends: the Felicija Karoblienė Cup (2,000 m for girls) and the Jonas Pipynė Cup (5,000 m for boys).

name: 22. Bieg Barbórkowy - Rybnik
description: The 22nd Barbórka Run in Rybnik is an annual running event organized by MOSiR Rybnik and held on December 6. The race is a long-standing tradition and an important sporting event in the region, attracting runners of different age groups. It is part of the Rybnik Running Grand Prix, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: Organized by MOSiR Rybnik, providing professional conditions and timing
A variety of city routes suited to different distances
Part of the Rybnik Running Grand Prix series, promoting activity and health in the region
additional: The race will take place on December 6, 2026, with the start at 12:00. Registration is open until November 29, 2026. Various distances and city routes are available.

Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful forest settings. In Katowice, the course runs through the State Forests of the Katowice Forest District, with the start about 700 metres from the finish near the “Rybaczówka” centre by Janina Pond. The event is open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced runners, who can regularly compare their results on the same course. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and nationwide rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the forests of the Katowice Forest District
The start is about 700 m from the finish, near the “Rybaczówka” centre by Janina Pond
A course suited to runners of varying abilities
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The 5 km main race starts at 11:00. It is not possible to drive directly to the start; parking is available on Karolinki Street, about 1 km from the race office. CITY TRAIL Junior races over shorter distances are also held as part of the event. In Katowice, the finish is located near the “Rybaczówka” centre. The race is part of the Grand Prix CITY TRAIL 2026/2027 season.
