name: 27 Szczeciński Bieg Noworoczny
location: Teatr Letni im. Heleny Majdaniec, Park im. Jana Kasprowicza, Szczecin, Poland
description: Szczecin New Year's Run 2027 is an annual running event held on January 1 in Szczecin, by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre. The program includes a 5 km Main Run, Nordic Walking, and children's races for different age groups. The Main Run route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, past Psia Polana and around Jasne Błonia. The start and finish are by the Summer Theatre. The event is a great opportunity to start the new year actively in a family-friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The 5 km route consists of two 2.5 km loops
The route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, past Psia Polana and around Jasne Błonia
The start and finish are by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre
additional: The race office is open on December 29 and 30, 2026, from 17:00 to 19:30, where race numbers can be collected. A bag drop is available by the race office. Changing rooms are located in the start area by the Summer Theatre. Capacity: 470 participants for the Main Run and Nordic Walking combined, and 115 for the Children's Races. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. Nordic Walking and the Main Run each consist of two 2.5 km loops. Children's races are divided into three age-group heats, with distances of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m. The program also includes Nordic Walking events over two 2.5 km loops and children's races of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m, depending on age group. Places are limited.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz Orienteering is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz Orienteering Foundation. They take place in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. The activity is for everyone, regardless of age or experience, combining sport with adventure and exploring nature using a map and compass. The foundation promotes accessibility by also creating courses for blind and partially sighted participants. The series includes a variety of courses with different difficulty levels, and participants can earn badges for completing individual rounds.
course_highlights: A variety of forest terrain around Bydgoszcz, changing with each round
Courses for beginners and advanced participants, including courses for blind and partially sighted participants
The opportunity to earn digital badges and collectible stickers for completing rounds
additional: The series consists of six rounds held from November to January in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. For each completed round, participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collectible card. A special final badge is available upon completing the entire series. Courses are tailored to different ability levels, and the final round features a mass start on the semi-open grounds of a former manor farm. Information about a specific edition on December 31, 2026, is not provided in the available materials.

name: Kresowe Trail #1
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are for both beginner and experienced runners, aiming to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. Each race offers carefully marked courses, electronic timekeeping, and a generous race package.
course_highlights: Trail courses ranging from approximately 5 km to over 18 km
Carefully marked trails with colored arrows (green, red, purple)
Aid stations along the course and at the finish; time limit of approximately 2 hours
additional: Registration is available on race day until 08:40 and on-site from 8:00. New race numbers are in use starting with the 2026 season; the first race number is free of charge. The race package includes a hot recovery meal (vegetarian option also available), electronic timekeeping, medical support, aid stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography service, and points toward the series’ overall standings. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited. Online registration and race-day on-site registration are available.

name: Lekkoatletyczne Halowe Mistrzostwa Europ... Bieg Uliczny 5 km
description: The 15th European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships will take place in Toruń from 27 March to 2 April 2026. As part of the event, a 5 km road race will be held, giving masters runners an excellent opportunity to compete on the city's scenic routes. The competition combines sporting rivalry with a chance for the athletics community to come together. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this prestigious event.
course_highlights: A 5 km road race in the centre of Toruń
Scenic city routes suited to fast times
An event accompanying the 15th European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships
additional: Details of the date and event may change.

name: XVII Noworoczny Bieg z Ochotą
description: The New Year's Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw, giving participants the chance to run into the New Year full of energy. The course passes through the capital's scenic spots, offering both amateur and more experienced runners a unique sporting experience. The organizers provide professional support and a friendly atmosphere, encouraging everyone to celebrate together and start the new year actively.

name: XX Jubileuszowy Śląski Maraton Noworoczn...
distance_verbose: Maraton, 35 km, 28 km, Półmaraton, 14 km, 7 km
description: The 20th Anniversary Silesian New Year’s Cyborg Marathon takes place in Silesian Park in Chorzów and invites participants to start the year actively. Participants can choose a distance from 7 km to the marathon, covering one to six 7 km loops. The program also includes a Nordic Walking half marathon. The start is scheduled by the Silesian Park administration building.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop in Silesian Park
Choose from one to six loops, up to the marathon distance
Nordic Walking half marathon over three loops
additional: The start is at 12:00 by the Silesian Park administration building. Participants could change the number of loops during the race; the time limit for the marathon was 360 minutes.

name: Wbiegnij z Nami w Nowy Rok
Silvesterlauf Bremen
description: The Silvesterlauf Bremen is a popular running event on December 31 that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers various distances, from 400 m for Bambinis to 10 km for experienced runners, through the beautiful surroundings of Werdersee. Alongside a sporting end to the year, festive music and a New Year’s Eve atmosphere make for a special experience. Participants in costumes are warmly invited to add their own creative touch to the event and run together into the New Year.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Werdersee
More accessible 2.5 km route for beginners and people with special needs
Festive New Year’s Eve atmosphere with music and medals for all finishers
additional: Start times vary by distance: 5 km run at 12:00, 2.5 km walk at 12:30, 5 km and 10 km walks at 12:50, 400 m Bambini run at 12:55, 1,000 m kids’ run at 13:00, 10 km run at 13:15. Race materials can be shipped for a fee. More accessible 2.5 km route suitable for everyone. Costumes are expressly encouraged for a special New Year’s Eve feeling. Various distances, including children’s and walking options, festive atmosphere, medals for everyone, creative costumes welcome.

name: Silvesterlauf Hannover
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a traditional year-end race held on December 31. The event features a 7.7 km loop, mostly on paved paths through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and along the Stichkanal to the Ihme. The race starts at 13:00 at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer. After the race, participants can refuel with mulled wine and bratwurst and receive a finisher wheat beer glass as a keepsake. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and mass start.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course goes through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the Stichkanal
Start and finish at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer
additional: Mass start; mulled wine and bratwurst at low prices after the race; every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass in the event design. On-the-day registration is possible on site from 12:00 (cash or PayPal). The race takes place on December 31, with online registration open until 31.12.25 at 10:00. There is a mass start and festivities that make the race a sociable way to end the year.

name: Silvesterlauf Wernigerode
description: The 49th Wernigerode New Year's Eve Run is the perfect end to the year in the Harz district for running enthusiasts. The race takes place on December 31, 2026, at Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode and offers a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V., this popular event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode
Run through Wernigerode's picturesque old town
Festive end-of-year atmosphere in the Harz district
additional: The course goes around Wernigerode Castle; start and finish at Marstall; no shower facilities; several events, including youth races and training sessions.

name: Silvesterlauf Burgwedel
description: The Burgwedel New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Burgwedel. The races cover several distances, including 10.6 km, 5.3 km and 2 km for children, and follow a scenic course with the start and finish at the modernised stadium on Ramhorst. The event attracts numerous runners and spectators and is organised by Schwimmverein Burgwedel. It is a popular sporting way to round off the year, with a family-friendly atmosphere and a diverse range of participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the recently modernised stadium on Ramhorst
Distances: 10.6 km, 5.3 km and a 2 km children’s race
Beautiful blue running track in the stadium
additional: The starting signal is given promptly at 12:00 by the local mayor. The event traditionally takes place on Ramhorst, where the series began in 1984. There is an award for the largest group, and the event is supported by numerous volunteers, sponsors and spectators. Distances: 2 km, 5.3 km, 10 km; December weather is usually cold and snowy; the event involves local clubs, fire brigades and families; course records have been set.

name: Silvesterlauf Salzgitter
organizer: Move SZ - Wir fördern Sport e.V.
description: The Silvesterlauf at Salzgittersee is a traditional running event held on the last day of the year. The event offers various running and walking distances for different age groups and ability levels. The race is a sporting highlight and a meeting place for runners and spectators who want to end the year on an active note together. Alongside the sporting competition, there is a team classification and an awards ceremony that gives special recognition to the children’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes at Salzgittersee of 5.7 km and 11.4 km
Children’s race over 1.2 km for age groups 2013 to 2019
Team classification based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners
additional: Race number collection and late registration (plus €3) from 16.12. to 28.12.2025 at the Stadtbad Salzgitter pool cashier. Changes of registration and late registration are possible on 30.12. (15:00–17:00) and 31.12. (11:00–13:00) in the Stadtbad foyer. Online registration is available until 31.12.25 at 10:00 without an extra fee, unless the event is full. Team classification based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners. Race packs do not need to be collected in person. Online registration until 31.12.25, race number collection at Stadtbad Salzgitter, refreshments in the finish area, parking available at Salzgittersee, dogs and jogging strollers allowed

name: Silvesterlauf Magdeburg
description: The Magdeburg New Year's Eve Run is a traditional popular sporting event that has been held on the last day of the year for over 50 years. It brings together runners of all ages and ability levels in the city of Magdeburg. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and its sporting end to the year, with over 900 participants crossing the finish line. The run is part of the Magdeburg City Rankings and is very popular in the region.
course_highlights: 5 km loop, run twice
10 km main race
1.5 km children's run for the youngest participants
additional: The New Year's Eve Run is the eighth and final event in the Magdeburg City Rankings. More than 950 runners of all ages take part. The event is organized by the Magdeburger LaufKultur 08 e.V. club. Courses, registration, results, photos, press reports; the weather in December is usually cold and snowy.

name: Silvesterlauf Berlin
description: The Berlin New Year’s Eve Run on December 31 gives runners the chance to end the year on an active note. The event offers three different distances (4 km, 6 km and 10 km) through the scenic Grunewald, with challenging sections such as Drachenberg and Teufelsberg rewarded with great views over Berlin. Alongside the sporting experience, fun takes centre stage, particularly with the option to run in costume and prizes for the best costumes. At the finish, all finishers receive a delicious Pfannkuchen as a sweet keepsake to hang around their neck.
course_highlights: Route through the Grunewald, including Drachenberg and Teufelsberg
Fantastic views across Berlin before the turn of the year
A choice of distances: 4 km, 6 km and 10 km
additional: The start and finish are near Mommsenstadion (Waldschulallee 34, 14055 Berlin). The race pass and race number will be sent by email in advance. Race materials can be collected on site from 10:00 a.m. on the event day. Timing is provided by a disposable transponder attached to the race number. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes. Water, tea and Pfannkuchen are available at the finish. Only reusable cups are used. Changing facilities are available at Mommsenstadion, but there is no bag drop. Results and certificates are available online that evening. Distances vary between 2, 4, 6 and 10 km; a run for all age groups; start and finish at Mommsenstadion; refreshments include Pfannkuchen, with awards for the top finishers and the most original costumes.

name: Silvesterlauf München
description: The MRRC Munich New Year’s Eve Run is a long-established running event in Munich’s Olympic Park, held annually on December 31. With more than 4,300 participants from 54 nations, it is one of Germany’s largest New Year’s Eve runs. The races follow loop courses through the Olympic Park, starting and finishing by the lakeshore near the Olympic Tower. The event offers distances for all age groups and ability levels, making for an active and festive end to the year.
course_highlights: Loop courses through Munich’s Olympic Park
Start and finish by the lakeshore near the Olympic Tower
The 10 km race is officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for rankings
additional: Race bib collection is available on December 30 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 9:30. The race bib with its QR code must be clearly visible on the chest. Safety pins are provided. Pacemakers will be available for the 5 km and 10 km races. The start and finish are by the lakeshore near the Olympic Tower. Late entries are not possible. Race entries can be transferred to another participant for a fee until December 23, 2025. Public transport and cycling are recommended for getting to the event. Annual participant numbers range from 1,600 to more than 2,900. Results, photos and videos are available, and online registration is possible.

name: Silvesterlauf Nürnberg
description: The Silvesterlauf Nürnberg is a traditional running event held annually on December 31 around Lake Wöhrder See. Various races are offered for all age groups, from the Bambini run through the children’s and fun runs to the 10 km main race. The course is mostly flat and entirely paved, making fast times possible. The event is open to runners of all abilities and offers a festive atmosphere to round off the year.
course_highlights: Loop around Lake Wöhrder See, entirely paved
Flat course, ideal for fast times
Out-and-back courses for the Bambini and children’s races along the northern shore
additional: The start and finish are in front of Café Tante Noris im Wastl on Johann-Soergel-Weg. Race packs are distributed at Sebastianspital. Nordic walking poles and jogging strollers are allowed in the fun run, but not in the main race for safety reasons. Participant limits apply: 150 for the Bambini and children’s races, and 1,300 for the fun and main races. A Silvesterlauf long-sleeved shirt can be ordered for an additional charge; children’s sizes can only be ordered until 16.11.2025. Races take place on 31.12.; registration is open until 18.12.2025. Participant numbers are limited, and race-day entries may be possible for certain races. Race number distribution is at Sebastianspital. Participation is open from certain birth years.

name: Silvesterlauf Zossen-Ludwigsfelde
description: The 46th Zossen-Ludwigsfelde New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional race covering approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde. The event begins at Zossen Town Hall Square with a ceremonial start at 9:00 a.m. and the official start at 9:15 a.m. on the outskirts of Zossen. The route follows firmly frozen paths that are easy to run on in good weather. At the finish in Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, participants receive a commemorative medal and a prosecco as a reward.
course_highlights: Approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde
Start on the outskirts of Zossen, beyond the railway crossing on the old B246
Finish at Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, with a medal and prosecco
additional: Ceremonial start at 9:00 a.m. at Zossen Town Hall Square. In frosty conditions, the route is firmly frozen and easy to run on. At the finish, runners receive a commemorative medal and prosecco. Registration deadline: December 28, 2025; route may be frozen depending on the weather; commemorative medal and prosecco for finishers; event away from the stadium.

name: Silvesterlauf Gießen
description: The traditional Sparkasse Gießen New Year’s Eve Run takes place on 31 December 2026 in Gießen-Ost and offers runners a varied event with four distances: a schoolchildren’s race, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The event is sold out, with 1,800 starting places, and is known for its family atmosphere and high-quality organisation. The start and finish are at Karl-Reuter-Weg, and all finishers receive a medal sponsored by Autohaus Erben. In addition to the races, there are awards and ceremonies for walkers and Nordic walkers, as well as a team competition with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Karl-Reuter-Weg in Gießen-Ost
Four distances: schoolchildren’s race, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon
Separate results and awards ceremony for walkers and Nordic walkers
additional: Race-number pickup is available before Christmas at Sparkasse Gießen premises and on the day before the race at Sporthalle Ost. Changing and shower facilities are available at Sporthalle Ost. Every finisher receives a medal; for the first time, fruit will be provided in the finish area. Start times are staggered to ease congestion on the course. The field is limited to 2,200 participants, and medals go to the first 2,000 finishers. Finisher shirts can be ordered at an additional cost. Parking is available at Philosophikum I and the Studierendenwerk on Otto-Behaghel-Straße. GPX files of the courses are available and can be used with navigation apps. Participant limit: 2,200. Online registration is open until 27 December 2025. Race-number pickup is on 27.12.2025. Medals for the first 2,000 finishers. Entry fee includes a deposit. Shower and changing facilities are available at Sporthalle Ost.

name: Silvesterlauf Bad Staffelstein
description: The Silvesterlauf Bad Staffelstein is a traditional running competition held annually on December 31. The event attracts both recreational and competitive runners and offers an appealing course in the Bad Staffelstein region. The race is known for its team rankings and the personal bests achieved by participants. The event is organized by Böhnlein Sports Bamberg e.V., which also provides professional training programs.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer race course
Team rankings with strong participation
Appealing course in Bad Staffelstein
additional: Böhnlein Sports Bamberg e.V. offers professional training with experienced coaches. The event is part of the club calendar and is organized by a dedicated team. It features strong team rankings, and participants often achieve personal bests. The event takes place at the Adam-Riese-Halle in Bad Staffelstein and offers both individual and team competitions. It is a popular opportunity to end the year on an athletic note.

name: Silvesterlauf Schwalmstadt
description: The New Year's Eve Run in Schwalmstadt-Ziegenhain is a traditional race that has taken place every year on December 31 since 1970. The event offers a short 2.7 km race for children and young people, as well as a long 8.1 km race for adults. The race marks the end of the Schwalm-Eder Cup series and is known for its musical program, with samba rhythms by Sola Quente accompanying runners along the course. The event is organized by a dedicated team from TuSpo Ziegenhain and is a popular way for many track and field athletes to end the year.
course_highlights: Short race: 1 lap = 2,740 m; long race: 3 laps = 8,100 m
Samba rhythms by Sola Quente provide musical accompaniment
The course runs through Schützenwald, with parking nearby
additional: Parking is available in the woods between the hospital and the start. Access to the parking lot at the start is possible until 12:45 p.m. After 12:45 p.m., free parking is available at the Asklepios Hospital parking lot. The awards ceremony takes place at the venue in Schützenwald after the races. The race takes place in Schützenwald; online registration is available. The start and finish area is by the pond at Ziegelhütte. Parking is available nearby. There are no shower facilities. Food and drinks are available, along with a program of music and community activities.

name: Silvesterlauf Winsen (Aller)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt für Erwachsene und Jugendliche 5,00 € und ist im Vorfeld per Überweisung zu entrichten.

description: The MTV "Fichte" Winsen (Aller) New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional year-end running event that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 1,600 m for children to 10,300 m for adults, as well as a 6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure. The run starts and finishes at the Allertalsporthalle, where changing rooms and showers are also available. The event is officially sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and features a celebratory awards ceremony for the fastest participants in each distance.
course_highlights: Distances from 1,600 m to 10,300 m for all age groups
6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure
Start and finish at the Allertalsporthalle, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Race bib distribution from 2 December 2024 at the business office (Mon–Fri, 8:00–12:30). Late registration is possible on the event day from 12:00 to 13:45 for an additional fee. Plenty of parking is available at the Allertalsporthalle. Awards ceremony at approximately 15:30. Distances: 3 km, 5 km, 10.3 km, children’s race 1.6 km; walkers welcome. Start at 14:30. Register online or on site.

name: 12. Silvesterlauf an der Leine
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a popular end-of-year race that traditionally starts at 1:00 p.m. on December 31. The event offers a 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths along the Leine, through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and back along the Ihme. The race is organized by Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC), Bladerunner and Trimindous UG, and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with mulled wine and bratwurst after the race. Every finisher receives a wheat beer glass featuring the event design as a keepsake. There is also a walking category, making the event appealing to a range of participants.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course runs through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the Stichkanal
Return route along the Ihme
additional: Mass start at 1:00 p.m. Late entries are available on site on the day of the event from 12:00 p.m., payable in cash or via PayPal. Every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass featuring the event design. There is a walking category. The event venue is the clubhouse of Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC) at Weddigenufer 23, near Unisport. The race has a relaxed atmosphere, with mulled wine, bratwurst and a wheat beer glass for finishers. There is also a walking category, and the course is ideal for anyone who wants to round off the running year in good company.

name: 25. VR-Bank Mitte Silvesterlauf
location: Seeburger See, Bernshausen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The VR-Bank Mitte New Year’s Eve Run is an active way to round off the year, taking place around Lake Seeburger See in Bernshausen. The flat loop course on paved paths offers runners an attractive route of one or two laps around the lake, depending on the distance. The event traditionally takes place on 31 December and welcomes runners of all abilities for a festive end to the year. The start and finish areas are on Kreisstraße 106, near the Bernshausen multipurpose hall.
course_highlights: Flat loop course around Lake Seeburger See
Paved paths
5 km lap (1 lap around the lake) and 10 km lap (2 laps around the lake)
additional: Bib pickup on event day from 10:30 a.m. at the Bernshausen multipurpose hall, until 30 minutes before each start. Online late registration is not possible after 26.12.2025. The start and finish are on Kreisstraße 106, near the Bernshausen multipurpose hall. No bib pickup at Laufline Göttingen. No refund of the entry fee is available if a participant does not start or if the event is cancelled. Run on paved paths, online registration until 26.12.2025, bib pickup in Bernshausen, no late registration, no showers, winter conditions possible, recommended parking in Seeburg.

name: 38. Silvesterlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The SC Altenrheine New Year’s Eve Run is the region’s sporting finale to the year and, with up to 800 participants of all ages, is one of the largest running events in the area. The event offers various distances that run through Altenrheine and each finish with a lap of the stadium. The varied courses include out-and-back sections and loops through the town. The run is a popular opportunity to end the year on a sporting note and enjoy a sense of community.
course_highlights: 600 m out-and-back section along Schürweg towards the car park, plus 1 lap of the stadium
2,000 m out-and-back section along Schürweg towards Außenhook, plus 1 lap of the stadium
10,000 m with 3 loops through Altenrheine, plus 1 lap of the stadium
additional: The event is designed for up to 800 athletes of all ages. Each course finishes with a lap of the stadium. Distances range from 600 m to 10,000 m. Registration is online; registration details and prices are not explicitly listed on the website. The run offers a festive atmosphere at the end of the year, with courses in the region and a broad participant base.

name: 44. Bad Harzburger Silvesterlauf
location: Sportpark an der Rennbahn, Bad Harzburg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Bad Harzburg New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event organized by MTK Bad Harzburg since 1981. The race takes place every year on December 31 in the Sportpark an der Rennbahn and is the oldest New Year’s Eve run in the region. The event offers several distances, including 2,500, 5,000 and 10,000 meters, run on a 2,500-meter loop. Participants can record and follow their lap times electronically, making the race especially appealing.
course_highlights: 2,500-meter loop in the Sportpark an der Rennbahn
Electronic chip timing with split times after each lap
Traditional New Year’s Eve run since 1981, with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: The race office opens at 11 a.m. on race day. Live results are available online for the first time at https://oresults.eu/events/2639. Timing is provided by a SportIdent chip, which is scanned after each lap on the 5,000- and 10,000-meter courses. Certificates and trophies are presented at 3:30 p.m. Distances: 2,500 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m; registration by post or on race day; electronic timing; awards ceremonies for top finishers; start at 1:30 p.m.

name: 47. Silvesterlauf rund um die Thülsfelder Talsperre
description: The 47th International New Year’s Eve Run around the Thülsfelder Talsperre is a traditional race held on New Year’s Eve in Molbergen, Lower Saxony. The course runs around the Thülsfelder Talsperre and offers two distances: 0.8 km and 16.1 km. Organized by SV Molbergen since 1975, the race is the final competition of the year for many runners and officially counts toward rankings. After the finish, traditional pea soup provides a sociable end to the event.
course_highlights: Loop course around the Thülsfelder Talsperre
Scenic route in Lower Saxony
Traditional start with a cannon shot
additional: The race starts with a cannon shot fired by a local fireworks club; traditional pea soup is served after the race; the event attracts many local runners and club runners; December weather is typically cold, with possible snowfall. Distances: 0.8 km and 16.1 km; held on December 31, 2026; traditional communal meal after the race; large fields of participants can cause bottlenecks at the start.

name: Active Laufshop Silvesterlauf
description: The ACTIVE LAUFSHOP New Year’s Eve Run in Münster is a popular running event traditionally held on December 31. Organized by Laufsportfreunde Münster e.V., one of Germany’s largest running clubs, the event offers several race distances for runners of all abilities. The routes pass through the city of Münster, creating a varied and lively atmosphere to round off the year. The event is open to recreational runners and competitive athletes and supports community and running in the region.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 5 km and 10 km
Routes pass through the city of Münster
A varied and lively running atmosphere at the end of the year
additional: Course maps for the 3 km, 5 km and 10 km races are available as PDFs on the website. The run takes place annually on December 31 and is a popular way to end the year on an active note. Registration is already open.

name: Dübener Silvesterlauf
description: The 47th Dübener New Year's Eve Run takes place on December 31, 2025, in Bad Düben and is organized by SV Bad Düben, Athletics Department. The event gives runners of all ages the opportunity to end the year on an active note. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Bad Düben and promises a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Registration is online via SV Bad Düben.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic surroundings of Bad Düben
Traditional New Year's Eve run to close out the year
Event for children, young people, and adults
additional: The registration deadline is December 27, 2025. Registration is online via SV Bad Düben. The event is for children, young people, and active runners. The venue is the Obermühle sports facility, Parkstraße 1, Bad Düben. Cross-country run through heathland and woodland, children's and walking races, compact club event

name: Emmerthaler Silvesterlauf
description: The Emmerthal New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing race held on New Year’s Eve in Emmerthal, celebrating its 51st edition in 2026. Organized by TSG Emmerthal, the event gives runners the opportunity to track their performance with detailed lap times. It is supported by local sponsors and volunteer helpers from the fire brigade, police, the German Red Cross (DRK), and the club. The race is known for its friendly, community spirit and warmly welcomes all participants.
course_highlights: Distances: 300 m and 7 km
Results published with lap times
Race held on New Year’s Eve in Emmerthal
additional: Supported by local sponsors and helpers from the fire brigade, police, the German Red Cross (DRK), and TSG Emmerthal. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with frequent snowfall. The venue is in Emmerthal, with directions provided. December weather is typically cold and snowy; results are published with lap times; the event is very popular with runners and families.

name: Finale Furioso 2.0 - Silvesterlauf der DJK Göggelsbuch
location: Sportgelände des Vereins, Allersberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: Finale Furioso 2.0 is a New Year’s Eve run organized by DJK Göggelsbuch at the club’s sports grounds in Allersberg. The race is open to everyone, from ambitious runners to families with children, and offers several distances, including a Bambini run, a children’s race, a 5.5 km run and the 10 km main race. The flat routes follow paved farm and forest paths with short asphalt sections and are easy to run. After the race, the sports hall provides a cozy atmosphere with refreshments, music and an awards ceremony, under the motto “Welcome among friends.”
course_highlights: Flat routes over paved farm and forest paths
Short asphalt sections
Start and finish directly at the DJK clubhouse
additional: Refreshments in the sports hall include Weißwurst, Vienna sausages and pretzels; music and awards ceremony; a compact race day centered around the club. Distances: 700 m, 5.5 km, 10 km; family-friendly, flat routes, refreshments, music, awards ceremony, and food such as Weißwurst and pretzels.

name: Geraer Silvesterlauf
description: The Gera New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held annually on December 31 in Gera. The event offers various distances from 3 km to 20 km, with varied routes featuring elevation changes. The run is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners and ends in a festive atmosphere to mark the close of the year.
course_highlights: A range of distances: 3 km, 4 km, 11 km, and 20 km
Varied routes featuring elevation changes
Start and finish in front of the Panndorfhalle in Gera
additional: Online registration includes direct payment by credit card, Klarna, or PayPal. Participant certificates can be printed after the race until March 31 of the following year. The event offers extensive online media galleries and result records. The run takes place on December 31; details about the terrain and registration are available on the website.

name: Haseder Silvesterlauf
location: Dorfgemeinschaftshaus Giesen, Giesen, Hildesheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Hasede New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Giesen. With courses for children and adults, the run offers a sporting and sociable way to see out the year with friends and family. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, professional timing and dedicated team of volunteers. The courses run through the residential area around the sports hall and offer both short and longer distances for different ability levels.
course_highlights: The 600 m course loops once around the sports hall, through the residential area and back
5 km and 10 km courses for ambitious runners
Family-friendly atmosphere with children’s races over 0.6 km and 1.2 km
additional: Professional timing is provided by Eichels-Event from Hanover. The event is supported by a large team of volunteers. Bambini races are offered for children over 0.6 km and 1.2 km. The awards ceremony takes place in the sports hall, which also serves as a meeting point. Courses for children and adults, results, photo gallery, timing by Eichels-Event, refreshments on site

name: Hohenloher Silvesterlauf 1. Lauf zum 4 Jahreszeiten Laufcup 2027
description: The Hohenloher Silvesterlauf is a traditional race in Germany’s Hohenlohe region, starting and finishing in Hengstfeld on December 31, 2026. The event offers two distance options: a 5 km fun run and a 10 km main race. As the first race in the 4-Seasons Running Cup, it combines a year-end run with a larger series spanning all four seasons. The race is aimed at club runners, recreational joggers, and beginners who want to end the year on an active note.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the clubhouse of SpVgg Hengstfeld-Wallhausen e.V.
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Run through the scenic Hohenlohe region
additional: Typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. The race is the first of four events in the 2027 Seasons Running Cup. Start at 13:00; weather-dependent winter conditions with snow cover. Suitable for different ability levels and part of the Four Seasons Running Cup.

name: Hueber-Silvesterlauf in Pleinfeld
description: The Hueber New Year’s Eve Run in Pleinfeld is a long-standing race held at the Brombachhalle Sports Park. With over 600 participants, it marks the finale of the Raiffeisen Läufer-Cup Roth/Weißenburg series. The event offers races for Bambini, schoolchildren, walkers, and adult runners. After the competitions, the Brombachhalle provides refreshments and an awards ceremony for a pleasant end to the day.
course_highlights: Race at the Brombachhalle Sports Park in Pleinfeld
Distances: 0.5 km and 9 km
Finale of the Raiffeisen Läufer-Cup Roth/Weißenburg series
additional: After the races, the awards ceremony and refreshments take place in the Brombachhalle. The event is open to all age groups, from Bambini to adults. Distances: 0.5 km and 9 km; December weather: approx. 3°C, with snow cover on some days; includes an awards ceremony and refreshments after the race.

name: Int. LEW Silvesterlauf Gersthofen
description: The International LEW Gersthofen New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional end-of-year race in Gersthofen, Bavaria. It offers various events, including the main race of approx. 9.7 km, a schoolchildren’s race, the Flitzi Run for the youngest participants, and walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, professional organisation and varied programme throughout the day, with musical accompaniment. The start and finish areas are on the grounds of the TSV sports hall in Gersthofen.
course_highlights: Main race of approx. 9.7 km through Gersthofen
Schoolchildren’s race of approx. 2.2 km
Walking and Nordic walking routes of approx. 9 km
additional: Start and finish on the grounds of the TSV sports hall in Gersthofen. Late entries are possible until 31.12.2026 for a fee. Race packs will be distributed on 30 and 31 December in the TSV Gersthofen sports hall. Group warm-up before Nordic walking and walks. Musical accompaniment by the Gersthofer Blasharmoniker on event day. Race routes, online registration, start in the sports hall, limited to 1,500 participants

name: Kieler Silvesterlauf
description: The Kiel New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held on December 31 in Kiel-Ellerbek at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz. The event is organized by LTV Kiel-Ost e.V. and is limited to 250 runners. In addition to the sporting competition, there is a costume contest for individuals and teams, as well as a draw for prizes. The awards ceremony takes place in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School, and every participant receives a memento and has the option to order a certificate.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz
Limited to 250 runners
Costume contest for individuals and teams, with prizes
additional: Race materials can be collected at the sports hall on 30.12.2026 from 15:00 to 16:30 and on 31.12.2026 from 11:00 to 12:30. Late entrants must pay a fee and may receive a place if any are still available. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 14:30 in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School. There are no age-group rankings, but men and women are ranked separately. Participants who hand in their race number after the run are entered into a draw for prizes; attendance is required. Participant limit: 250; start times on 30.12.2026 and 31.12.2026; late registration possible; awards ceremony at approximately 14:30; certificates and prizes

name: Mergelstetter Silvesterlauf
location: Mergelstetten, Heidenheim an der Brenz, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Mergelstetten New Year's Eve Run is a popular running event in Heidenheim, held annually on December 31. Participants can choose between distances of 5.4 km and 10 km, and the event is open to runners aged 12 and over. The run offers a great opportunity to end the year on an active note and enjoy the winter atmosphere in Heidenheim. The event is organized by Sportverein Mergelstetten 1879 e.V. and attracts runners from across the region.
course_highlights: Run in a winter atmosphere
Two distances: 5.4 km and 10 km
Open to participants aged 12 and over
additional: Runners can choose between 5.4 km and 10 km; start location in Heidenheim; open to participants aged 12 and over.

name: Nellschützer Silvesterlauf
description: The Nellschütz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional 10 km road race in Lützen, Saxony-Anhalt, held on the morning of December 31. Since 2000, it has been a regular fixture in the local running calendar and offers runners in the Burgenlandkreis a chance to end the year together. The race starts near the church in Nellschütz and is officially organized within the German athletics framework, including insurance and coordination of the event date. Its characteristic relaxed style means runners usually run and chat in small groups rather than aiming for a personal best. After the race, participants are traditionally treated to hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family.
course_highlights: 10 km road race through Lützen and the surrounding area
Dedicated aid station on the course
Finish area with hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family
additional: Typical December weather: around 3 °C, a low of -2 °C, usually snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The race is designed as a communal year-end event, with runners taking part in small groups. The start is near the church in Nellschütz. The race starts in Nellschütz near the church, with a dedicated aid station on the course. The event is known as a year-end race with a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Oberlichtenauer Silvesterlauf
description: The Oberlichtenau New Year's Eve Run is a traditional end-of-year race in Pulsnitz, Saxony. With a 1.2 km children’s race, a 4.8 km fun run and a 9.2 km long-distance race, it offers a sporting option for all ages and ability levels. The race is popular with runners and spectators and always takes place on New Year’s Eve, giving participants a chance to end the year on an athletic note. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and dedicated organizers.
course_highlights: 1.2 km children’s race
4.8 km fun run
9.2 km long-distance race
additional: The race traditionally takes place on December 31 and includes three distances for different age groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and provides a sporting end to the year. The website has no information on start times or pricing tiers. The organizers provide a welcoming race environment, with mulled wine and a gymnasium as a meeting point. Start times on December 31, 2025: 13:10, 13:50 and 14:00; on-site registration available; race distances: 1.2 km children’s race, 4.8 km fun run, 9.2 km long-distance race; refreshments provided by club members.

name: OTB Silvesterlauf
description: The OTB New Year’s Eve Run in Osnabrück is a traditional year-end race that welcomes recreational runners, walkers and competitive athletes alike. On the last day of the year, participants can choose from several distances, including a 10 km main race, walking routes, a 5.6 km short race, an accessible fun run and a Bambini run. The event offers a lively atmosphere and modern timing with a disposable chip. The route passes through scenic areas such as Rubbenbruchsee and Natruper Holz, and the race has been a fixture on Osnabrück’s running calendar since 1980.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race goes to Rubbenbruchsee, through Natruper Holz and over Finkenhügel before returning to Illoshöhe
Walking route along Rubbenbruchsee (approx. 8 km), not timed
Accessible fun run on the Illoshöhe track, with up to 5 laps of 400 m each
additional: Timing uses a disposable chip attached to the race number (walking is not timed). From 2025, the Bambini route goes through the “big finish.” The accessible fun run is new from 2025. Start times vary by distance: walkers at 11:20, Bambini at 11:30, fun run at 11:50, 5.6 km short race at 12:10, and 10 km main race at 12:20. Spikes are not allowed on the 10 km and 5.6 km routes. Several race options are available, including an accessible run, a children’s race and walking; spikes are not allowed; online registration is available; field limited to 3,000 runners.

name: Ottenbacher Silvesterlauf
description: The Ottenbach New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional running event in Ottenbach, held annually at the end of the year. It gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to enjoy being active together and round off the year with a sporting highlight. The courses pass through the scenic surroundings of Ottenbach and offer varied running conditions. The event is organized by TSV Ottenbach and is a popular meeting point for the regional running community.
course_highlights: Running routes through the beautiful surroundings of Ottenbach
A range of distances for different age and ability groups
Traditional New Year’s Eve running atmosphere to round off the year
additional: The event is organized by TSV 1904 Ottenbach e.V. Information about travel and parking is available on the website. Registration is online via the official registration page. The event includes various age groups and race distances; details about the routes are available on the website. The race takes place on December 31, with online registration available. The course is approximately 10.4 km; details are available on the official website.

name: Pönitzer Silvesterlauf
description: The Pönitz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional road race held in Pönitz, a district of Scharbeutz in Schleswig-Holstein. On December 31, 2026, runners set off at 9:00 a.m. to choose between 7.5 km and 15 km on a flat course that finishes at Lindenstraße 34. The event is organized by SVG Pönitz and features electronic timing. After the race, participants receive a hot drink, a Berliner doughnut and a commemorative medal, as well as a personalized certificate on request.
course_highlights: Flat course in Pönitz, finishing at Lindenstraße 34
Electronic timing
Traditional New Year’s Eve event with refreshments and a medal
additional: Registration is easy and available on race day. The event has a long tradition, with more than 40 editions, and attracts numerous runners and walkers even in adverse weather conditions. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with occasional snowfall. A traditional New Year’s Eve run with a sense of community, electronic timing and small celebrations to round off the year.

name: Silvestrovský běh Jistebnice
location: Jistebnice, Jistebnice, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: SPOLEK PRO SPORT VŠEHO DRUHU a Město Jistebnice
description: The Jistebnice New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional race organized by the Association for Sports of All Kinds and the town of Jistebnice, held every year on New Year’s Eve. In 2025, the event will celebrate its 43rd edition. This popular event also includes a scooter race and children’s races. The race takes place in full road traffic, with organizers assisting at key intersections, and offers a sporting experience for the general public. The organizers warmly invite all sports enthusiasts to take part and wish them an enjoyable experience and a great start to the new year.
course_highlights: The race takes place in full road traffic, with organizers assisting at key points and intersections
The event also includes scooter races and children’s races
A traditional New Year’s Eve run with a long history (43rd edition)
additional: By registering, participants confirm that they are fit to complete the race and acknowledge the health risks. The organizer accepts no liability for health-related injuries. The race is part of the wider SPSVD Jistebnice sporting calendar and is accompanied by other sporting and cultural events. races, routes, schedule, facilities, start, health warning, road traffic

name: Silvestrovský běh Hrabovou
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Hrabová is a traditional race held at the end of the year in Ostrava-Hrabová. It gives participants the chance to end the year with some exercise in a friendly atmosphere. The routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Hrabová and are suitable for a range of ability levels. The race is part of the Hrabová Runs series and is known for its long-standing tradition and community spirit.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Ostrava-Hrabová
A range of course distances suitable for runners of varying abilities
The race is part of the traditional Hrabová Runs series
additional: The race is part of the Hrabová Cup and the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup. Refreshments, changing rooms and toilets are available after the race. Photos and videos are taken to promote the event. Participants can find relay partners and take part in the New Year’s Eve relay. The event takes place every year on 31 December. Participants can choose from various categories and courses, and registration is available on the website.

name: Silvestrovský běh okolo 3 přehrad
location: Jablonec nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The New Year’s Eve Run Around 3 Reservoirs is a relaxed race held on the last day of the year in Jablonec nad Nisou. The route runs around three Jablonec reservoirs and is approximately 5 km long. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere at the end of the year. Gifts are prepared for those who register in advance, and the winners receive interesting prizes from the partners.
course_highlights: The route runs around three reservoirs in Jablonec nad Nisou
The route is 5 km long
Start and finish at the Volt Brewery grounds
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the start location from 9:30 to 10:30. In the event of adverse weather conditions, the organizer reserves the right to change the route. Gifts from the partners are prepared for those who register in advance. The start list and results are published at www.stopnito.cz. The course is approximately 5 km long, with possible changes in adverse weather. Registration is open until 29.12.2025; entry fees are non-refundable. The event is open to the general public and is ideal for ending the year actively.

name: Silvestrovský běh Karviná
price_range: 200 Kč předem, na místě zdarma pro děti
description: The Silvestrovský běh in Karviná is a traditional 10 km road race held every year on December 31. The route runs along the city’s outer streets and features more than 100 metres of elevation gain, making it a challenge for every runner. The event also includes free children’s races in the local forest park, over distances from 200 m to 1.8 km. The start and registration take place at the city stadium, which also serves as the event’s base. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments and the medal ceremony for various categories.
course_highlights: The 10 km route runs along the outer streets of Karviná
More than 100 metres of elevation gain
Children’s races in the forest park over distances of 200 m, 350 m, 900 m and 1.8 km
additional: Registration is open from 8:30 to 9:45. The children’s races start at 10:05. The main route is on paved roads; the children’s races take place in the forest park. Refreshments after the race include goulash soup and tea, with rum available. Registered athletes are entered by their clubs; parents enter unregistered children. The race starts at 10:00, and the children’s races start at 10:05. Registration is open until December 28 or 29. The event takes place at the City Stadium and in the forest park.

name: Silvestrovský běh Havlovicemi
description: The Havlovice New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional running race organized by Maratonstav Physical Education Association Úpice and held annually on New Year’s Eve in Havlovice. The event offers a 6.6 km main race on a new four-lap course, as well as children’s categories with shorter distances. It is suitable for adults, juniors, and youth runners, and concludes with New Year’s Eve refreshments at the finish. The race starts at the HAPO grounds in Havlovice, where runner registration also takes place. The event is part of a long-standing tradition of running races in the region.
course_highlights: Main race: 6.6 km — 4 laps on a new course
Start and finish at the HAPO grounds in Havlovice
New Year’s Eve refreshments at the finish
additional: Children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00. Registration is open until 9:30 for the children’s categories and until 10:30 for the main race. The event includes the main course and children’s categories; race day concludes with festive refreshments; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Silvestrovský běh Zlín
description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Zlín is a traditional race held on New Year’s Eve, offering 10-kilometer and 5-kilometer courses. The main 10 km race consists of two laps on an out-and-back route along the cycle path from Vršava to Kostelec and back. The race is suitable for the general public, including young people and juniors, and is part of the Běhy Zlín series. Winners are announced shortly after the race, with prizes awarded to the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: The route follows the cycle path from Vršava to Kostelec and back
The main race is 10 kilometers long, split into two laps
A shorter 5-kilometer course is also available for young people and juniors
additional: Online registration is open until December 30 at 12:00; on-site registration on race day is open until 10:40. Winners are announced at 12:45 at the race registration venue. Age categories are according to the rules of the Běhy Zlín series. Category winners receive prizes, subject to the organizer’s options. 5 km and 10 km races, online registration, category winner announcements, photos and results available

name: Silvestrovský běh Stříbro
organizer: Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro, z.s. a TJ Baník Stříbro
description: The Silvestr Stříbro Run is a traditional year-end running race held in the picturesque town of Stříbro in the Plzeň Region. The race offers a 10.5 km course, mostly off-road, starting and finishing at the KERMI complex. It is suitable for all runners who want to end the year on an active and enjoyable note, with the option to start in different waves according to pace. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a get-together and refreshments for participants. The organizer, KERMI Stříbro, provides a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: 10.5 km course, mostly off-road
Start and finish at the KERMI Stříbro complex
Option to start at 10:00 or 10:30, depending on the runner’s pace
additional: After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a get-together and refreshments. The entry fee can be paid in advance by email or on site at the KERMI complex, training center. The race includes a trail at KERMI and a historic city run. Registration is available on site or by email. The start is at 10:00. The race is suitable for the general public.

name: Silvestrovský běh - memoriál Richarda Plcha
location: Park Pod Plachtami, Brno-Nový Lískovec, Brno, Jihomoravský, Czech Republic
price_range: 120 Kč – při přihlášení předem do 29. 12. 2025, 18:00 hodin; 200 Kč – na místě

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 120 Kč – při přihlášení předem do 29. 12. 2025, 18:00 hodin.

description: The Silvester Run – Richard Plch Memorial is a traditional running race organized by the AC Moravská Slavia Brno athletics club. It takes place on 31 December in Brno-Nový Lískovec, in Pod Plachtami Park, and offers races for all age groups, from children to veterans. Runners can choose between the main races of 9.84 km and 4.92 km, a 1.64 km fun run, and children’s races starting at 100 m. The course is asphalt with a mix of paved paths, and runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere as they end the year on the move.
course_highlights: Asphalt surface combined with paved paths
Routes for all age groups, from 100 m to 9.84 km
Held in Pod Plachtami Park in Brno-Nový Lískovec
additional: Check-in is required no later than 30 minutes before the start of each category at ZŠ Svážná 438/9; it opens at 8:00. Changing rooms are available at ZŠ Svážná and are for changing only; the organizers are not responsible for belongings left there. Results will be posted throughout the event in the start/finish area and later published on mslavia.cz and atletika.cz. The first three finishers in each category will receive prizes, and children will receive a small prize at the finish. In the fun run, prizes will be drawn among three runners. Entering two races is permitted only for categories up to and including older pupils. The course consists of asphalt and paved paths; online registration runs from 20. 11. 2025 to 29. 12. 2025; the event includes various age categories and a fun run open to all birth years.

name: Silvestrovský běh Kolín
location: Lesopark Borky, Kolín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kolín New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional three-kilometre race held in Borky Forest Park. In 2026, the race will take place in an unusual format: the course will be marked from December 30 to January 1, and each participant can complete it individually. Results can be sent to the organisers by email or SMS, after which the results list will be published. The start is by the FK Kolín football pitch, and the course follows a road, a cycle path and a chestnut avenue, finishing at the athletics stadium.
course_highlights: Traditional three-kilometre course in Borky Forest Park
Start by the FK Kolín artificial-turf football pitch
The route follows a road, a cycle path and a chestnut avenue past STAP
additional: The race can be completed individually between December 30 and January 1, with results submitted by email or SMS. The start is by the FK Kolín football pitch, and the finish is on the cycle path by the athletics stadium. The results list will be published on January 2. The race will not be held as a conventional mass start due to pandemic-related restrictions. Modified format due to the pandemic; individual participation; the course is marked from December 30 to January 1; results submitted by email or SMS; results published on January 2.

name: Půlnoční silvestrovsko - novoroční běh metropolí
description: The Midnight New Year’s Eve–New Year’s Day Metropolis Run is a unique sporting event held in Prague at night, just before midnight on New Year’s Eve. The race starts at Galerie Butovice and offers the last run in Europe in 2025. It is for recreational runners as well as more experienced competitors who want to celebrate the arrival of the new year together in an active, sporting way. The start is scheduled for December 31, 2025, at 23:50. Registration is available in advance and on race day.
course_highlights: A night run in Prague’s unique atmosphere
Start at Galerie Butovice
The last race in Europe in 2025
additional: Registration is also available at the race-day check-in desk. Detailed information about the course, rules, safety measures, and videos from previous editions are available at www.behmetropole.cz. Start at Galerie Butovice, registration at www.behmetropole.cz, course and safety information on the website

name: Silvestrovský běh Přerov
description: We invite you to the traditional Přerov New Year’s Eve Run, held on December 31, starting at 10:00 from the boathouse. Men run 7.5 km, while women, junior women and junior men run 5 km, consisting of two 2.5 km laps. The race offers a pleasant end-of-year atmosphere and the chance to compete in the beautiful surroundings of Přerov. You can register online in advance or at the race office on the day of the event. We look forward to seeing you!
course_highlights: The course runs around the boathouse and skatepark in Přerov
Men run 7.5 km; women and juniors run 5 km (two 2.5 km laps)
Start at 10:00 from the boathouse
additional: Registration is available in advance via an online form or at the race office on the day of the event. The course is a 2.5 km loop: boathouse – skatepark – boathouse. Men run three laps (7.5 km), while women and juniors run two laps (5 km). The race takes place on December 31, 2026. Registration is available online or on-site on race day. Start at 10:00.

name: Běh od Hasy k Hase
location: Roudnice nad Labem, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The Run from Hasa to Hasa is a traditional New Year's Eve run in Roudnice nad Labem, now being held for the 42nd time. The race offers a simple, easy-to-follow format, with times recorded using chip timing. The atmosphere is friendly, and participants enjoy a beautiful race at the end of the year. Check-in takes place from 8:30 in the Elbe River Board building in Roudnice nad Labem.
course_highlights: A traditional New Year's Eve run with high participation
Chip timing
Start and check-in at the Elbe River Board building, Pod Katovnou 228
additional: Check-in from 8:30 at the Elbe River Board building, Pod Katovnou 228, Roudnice n.L. The start is between 10:00 and 11:00. The race is simple and easy to follow, and suitable for the general public. It is part of a regional celebration attended by runners and organizers from Sokol and local partners. The course is approximately 5.2 km long, and registration is available online at naZávody.cz. The event is traditionally associated with celebrating the arrival of the new year.

name: Horovská desiatka
description: Horovská desiatka is a traditional New Year’s Eve race, now being held for the 40th time. It starts by the Cultural Centre in Horovce. Runners compete on a 10 km course from Horovce to Tušice and back. The event is suitable for the general public and offers categories for different age groups, including children. The atmosphere is friendly, making it an ideal way to end the year with a sporting achievement.
course_highlights: 10 km course from Horovce to Tušice and back
Start and finish by the Cultural Centre in Horovce
Traditional New Year’s Eve race with a long history
additional: There are categories for adults and children based on age. The course is one 10 km lap. The event takes place on 31 December as a New Year’s Eve race. Date: 31.12.2026; terrain: probably road; registration is available via websites; adults start at 11:00 and children at 9:30; several categories for different age groups.

description: The Silvester Run in Humenné is a traditional running race held at the Municipal Athletics Stadium. This 43rd edition features a main 5.7 km event, with categories for juniors, men, and women across different age groups. The race starts on December 31 at 11:00. Online registration is open until 11:00 on race day, or you can register in person at the venue from 8:30. Runners can download a GPX course map and view a route animation to help them prepare for the race.
course_highlights: A 5.7 km route at the Humenné Municipal Athletics Stadium
Categories for juniors, men, and women across different age groups
Option to download a GPX course map and view a route animation
additional: On-site registration is available from 8:30 on race day. Categories are divided by age and gender. name: Pažadų Bėgimas
description: PROMISE RUN. We continue the tradition started in 2018. On the morning of 2026-01-01, while the sound of fireworks still echoes in your ears, confirm to yourself during the run that your New Year’s resolutions will really come true. No competition, registration, medals or prizes—just you and your New Year’s “PROMISES.” Run 10 km and write down your goals so you can check on 2027-01-01 whether they came true. The start will take place on 2026-01-01 at 14:00 at Kaunas Santaka Stadium.

Kauno santakos stadionas.

name: Naujametinis ruonių maratonas
description: 2026-01-01 Pasvaliečiai invites all club members and friends to the 1st New Year’s SEALS MARATHON, which will take place in Pasvalys. This marathon is part of the traditional 18th ice-swimming event organized in Pasvalys District. After the marathon, a club members’ meeting will be held, during which the club’s most active members will be awarded.

name: ACSPORT.CZ Novoroční půlmaraton | desítka
location: Pavilon Anthropos, Pisárky, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

name: Trnavský novoročný beh – Memoriál Ladislava Kmeča
XIV Jonavos Naujametinis bėgimas
location: Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryža, Jonava, Lithuania
description: The 14th traditional Jonava New Year’s Run will take place on January 1, 2027. The start is at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets. The traditional 20 km course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala, and the finish is on Kauno Street near the treatment facilities. The event features a hilly course and winter conditions. After the run, participants are invited to enjoy tea and snacks and collect commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Traditional 20 km running course
Start at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets
The course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala, with the finish on Kauno Street
additional: After the run, participants receive trophies and prizes, commemorative medals, and can enjoy tea and snacks. The course is hilly, and in winter it may be slippery and windy. The course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala; the weather is often wintry, and the event is popular with local runners as a way to start the new year.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Leśny parking Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic Walking events, offering both amateur and professional athletes the opportunity to compete over half-marathon and marathon distances. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests near Biedrusko, with the event hub at the Łysy Młyn forest car park. The courses are challenging, running through natural woodland with varied surfaces, and each race has its own theme. Races start on Saturdays, and race packs can be collected on race morning. Additional races and walks are also held over 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop, while the marathon is two loops totalling 42.6 km.
The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with sections of asphalt and natural surfaces that are often slippery.
The marathon has 220 m of total ascent, with the biggest climb gaining 35 m over a 1 km stretch.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and accessories are encouraged for the individual races. The course is marked with red-and-white tape and “Łysy Młyn” running trail signs. The 21.3 km Nordic Walking event starts together with the half-marathon runners. The New Year’s Run is event no. 2 in the series. The event hub and race office are at the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. Race-pack collection is scheduled for 7:45–9:30 on race day, with the start at 10:00. Free parking is available by the event hub.

description: Ełcka Zmarzlina 2027 is a walking orienteering marathon held in Ełk, offering two routes of 50 km and 25 km. The event takes place on January 9, 2027, and is funded from the budget of the City of Ełk. Participants can expect professional organization, registration at the marathon office, and a celebratory closing with a feast. It is a unique opportunity to spend an active winter day on routes of varying difficulty.
course_highlights: 50 km walking orienteering route
Alternative 25 km route
Time limits: 12 hours for 50 km and 9 hours for 25 km
additional: Participant registration takes place on January 8, 2027, from 16:00 to 20:00, and on January 9 from 6:00 to 9:30 at the race office. The time limit is 12 hours for the 50 km route and 9 hours for the 25 km route. A celebratory closing and a feast for participants are planned for 21:00 after the event. Registration is conducted through Timekeeper. According to the 2027 event page, TP 50 km starts at 08:00, and TP 25 km at 10:00. The event is funded from the budget of the City of Ełk, and KOMA EŁK is a partner.

name: Resolution Run
description: Resolution Run 2026 is a fast, flat 5K taking place on New Year’s Day, January 1, 2026, at 10:15 a.m. in Galway city centre. The route passes through the city centre, starting at the Claddagh, crossing Wolfe Tone Bridge, and continuing along Merchants Road and through the Docks before returning via Grattan Road and the Prom, with a fast finish in South Park, beside Nimmo’s Pier. The route passes many of the city’s most iconic attractions. The race is AAI-certified.

name: Resolution Run 2026
description: Resolution Run 2027 invites you to start the new year with energy and activity. It’s a great opportunity to keep your New Year’s resolutions by running alongside a crowd of enthusiastic runners. The event promises good spirits, smiles, and a fun start to the year in Kaunas.
course_highlights: Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Warm-up for participants in all distances
Run on routes through Kaunas
additional: Distribution of participants’ race packs and awards are scheduled in the event programme. The event will include an official opening and a warm-up for participants in all distances. The event takes place in Kaunas and is organised by VšĮ Kauno maratono klubas. Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km; the event takes place in Kaunas; the organiser offers a festive start and a sense of community.

name: 5 Wieluński Bieg Noworoczny
description: The 5th Wieluń New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Atelier Sport Association in Wieluń. The race takes place in early January and attracts runners from various regions. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and timing is provided using modern electronic systems. The organizers ensure a high standard of event management and sport, providing professional support and an atmosphere conducive to competition.
additional: Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and mats at the start and finish lines. The organizer provides phone support from 8:00 to 16:00, as well as assistance on race day. The event is organized by the Atelier Sport Association. Available information concerns the fifth edition, held on January 4, 2026; there are no confirmed details about the 2027 edition.

name: Bieg Noworoczny
description: The New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Wroniecki Running Club. It takes place on scenic routes near Rzecińska Street in Wronki. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle among residents of the Wronki municipality and brings the local community together. The route passes through the beautiful forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest, offering participants a distinctive sporting challenge and the chance to start the new year together. The event is open to runners and Nordic walkers, with chip timing and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5.5 km for runners and Nordic walkers
Scenic forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest
Start and finish near Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: Chip timing (a reusable chip attached to the shoelace). The race office is open from 11:30 to 12:45 on Rzecińska Street. Participant limit: 200. The awards ceremony will be held at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. A refreshment area at the finish will serve hot tea and coffee. Participants under 18 must have written parental consent. The organizer does not allow anyone under 15 to take part. The 2026 edition regulations provided for electronic chip timing and participation from age 15; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

name: Zamczyska Winter Trail
location: Drewniane altany nad Czarnym Potokiem, Rymanów-Zdrój, Poland
description: Zamczyska Winter Trail is a mountain race held in the scenic area of Rymanów-Zdrój. The course runs along both marked and unmarked hiking trails. The 12.5 km course has a total elevation gain of +650 m and is additionally marked by the organizer to make navigation easier during the race. The start and finish are by the wooden shelters above the Czarny Potok. The race requires good physical fitness and experience in mountain running. The participant limit is 200.
course_highlights: 12.5 km course with +650 m elevation gain
Two checkpoints and water stations along the course
The course follows marked and unmarked hiking trails
additional: The participant limit is 200. The start and finish are by the wooden shelters above the Czarny Potok. The race office is open from 8:00 to 9:45. The time limit is 2 hours 30 minutes. After registering, participants have 48 hours to pay the entry fee. If withdrawing, the entry fee is refundable until 30.11.2026. The participant limit is 200, and the time limit is 2 hr 30 min. Entry is open to adults with experience running on difficult terrain. Registration is available through raatiming.pl.

Start and finish at Manufaktura Market Square
The route includes Piotrkowska Street

description: Ultra CK Marathon is a demanding ultra race of approximately 51 km with around 1,520 m of elevation gain, held in Kielce. The event also offers shorter races: Czarci Oddech, 15 km with 422 m of elevation gain, and the MTB cycling route Upiorna Trzydziestka, 30 km with 828 m of elevation gain. The event is aimed at enthusiasts of challenges and varied forms of sporting suffering, and is organized by the Świętokrzyskie Mountain Biking Association MTBCross Kielce. The start and race office are located at Hala Legionów in Kielce. Participants in the longest-distance race must carry mandatory safety equipment.

Czarci Oddech: 15 km race with around 422 m of elevation gain
Upiorna Trzydziestka: 30 km MTB route with around 828 m of elevation gain
additional: The race office is open on 5.01.2026 at Hala Legionów Kielce from 17:00 to 20:00, and on race day from 6:00. The cutoff for all distances is 18:00/18:30. Mandatory equipment for ultra-race participants: a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, a charged mobile phone, identification, and clothing suitable for the weather. The race office is located at Hala Legionów, ul. Leszka Drogosza, Kielce. Participants in Piekielna Pętla are required to carry safety equipment, including a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, and a charged phone. Details of the 2027 edition are not confirmed in the available information.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic course in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The route follows a 5.15 km loop through forest, climbing the highest hill, Dziewicza Góra, twice. The races bring together runners of different ages and abilities across various distances, and also offer Nordic walking and races for children and young people. The organizers provide professional timing and a welcoming atmosphere, creating a unique “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest

The course passes through the event centre, where spectators can cheer on participants
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted chip band. Race office open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The races are held as a series of six stages. Children’s and youth races over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,500 m. The course is marked with orange ribbons and directional arrows. Participants in the 10 km race complete two loops; after the first loop, they cross the finish line and continue onto the second loop. The 2026–2027 season consists of six stages; passes for the whole series were also available.

name: Viva Las Natalin

It is organized by the “Z Biegiem Dwóch Rzek” Association in cooperation with Wyszków Municipality, WOSiR, and the Wyszków Forest District. The event offers several distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km Nordic walking, with separate classifications for women and men.
course_highlights: The route runs through the forests of Natalin
Picturesque winter scenery
Carnival atmosphere with participants in colorful costumes
additional: The event is organized by the “Z Biegiem Dwóch Rzek” Association in cooperation with Wyszków Municipality, WOSiR, and the Wyszków Forest District. The event has a carnival theme, with participants wearing colorful costumes.
