The organizers ensure professional race management and a rich program of additional events, including team classifications and relays. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and take on a sporting challenge.

A social, recreational run
An atmosphere that encourages socializing and having fun
additional: The run takes place in Bródno Park in Warsaw. The event is social and recreational, with no details provided about distances, start waves, or entry fees.

name: Bieszczadzki Bieg Lotników
location: Trasy biegowe im. Stanisława Nahajowskiego, Ustjanowa Górna, Poland
description: The Bieszczady Aviators’ Run is an annual race held on the Stanisław Nahajowski cross-country trails in Ustjanowa Górna. The event attracts runners seeking mountain challenges and beautiful views. The Górskie Loty half-marathon course is demanding, with significant elevation gain, making the race an unforgettable experience for participants. The race has a long tradition and is an important sporting event in the Bieszczady region.
course_highlights: The 21 km Górskie Loty half-marathon course
Mountain elevation gain and steep sections
Beautiful views of the Bieszczady Mountains
additional: The race takes place on the Stanisław Nahajowski cross-country trails in Ustjanowa. The half-marathon course is new for 2025 and features significant elevation gain. The event is held under the patronage and with the support of the Regional Directorate of State Forests in Krosno. In the past, summer and winter editions have been held, as well as Nordic walking events. The available information relates to previous editions; details of the edition scheduled for 10 January 2027 are not provided.

name: Górski Bieg Nawoja
location: Nawojowa Góra, Krzeszowice, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Górski Bieg Nawoja is a mountain race held in Nawojowa Góra, showcasing the natural attractions and surroundings of Górzanka. The race takes place on 3 km and 7 km courses marked with arrows and tape, with distance-to-finish markers. The event is held regularly and is supported by local institutions and sponsors. Participants can use the on-site refreshment point, changing rooms, and toilets.
course_highlights: Mountain courses of 3 km and 7 km
Marked with arrows and white-and-red tape on more difficult sections
Distance-to-finish markers every kilometre
additional: Race office located at the LKS Górzanka sports field in Nawojowa Góra, with parking for participants. Changing rooms, toilets, and a refreshment point are available at the office. Race materials will be distributed from 10:00 to 10:50. The 7 km race starts at 11:00 and the 3 km race at 11:01. The race ends at 12:30.

name: VII Żniński Bieg Powstańczy
description: The 7th Żnin Insurrectionist Run is a 5 km race taking place on January 11, 2026, in Żnin. The course is flat and paved, with one small incline and a turnaround halfway through the distance. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street, near the tennis court. The race is organized by the Jedynka Association and has a participant limit of 200.
course_highlights: 5 km course with GPS tracking
Flat paved course with one small incline
Turnaround 2.5 km from the start
additional: The participant limit is 200. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street in Żnin, near the tennis court (property no. 14). The payment reference must include the runner’s first name, last name, and year of birth.

name: X Zimowe Grand Prix Zadyszki
location: ul. Kamieniec, near the animal shelter, Oświęcim, Poland
description: The X Zadyszka Winter Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Oświęcim Running Club “Zadyszka,” which promotes running as part of a healthy, active lifestyle. The club brings together recreational runners who value community and the joy of movement, regardless of their experience level. The events take place in the scenic surroundings of Oświęcim, where participants can expect a welcoming atmosphere and support from the local running community. The club also organizes social gatherings and events that help build a strong running community.
course_highlights: Routes in the area of Kamieniec Street, near the animal shelter in Oświęcim
Scenic surroundings ideal for recreation and active leisure
A sense of community and support among local runners
additional: The club holds meetings on the first Wednesday of each month at 17:00 at MOSiR, ul. Legionów 15, Oświęcim. An up-to-date events calendar is available on the website. The club promotes recreational running and brings the local running community together. For the 2025/2026 edition, race-day registration was open from 10:00 to 10:45, and races began at 11:00. These details have not been confirmed for the date of 10 January 2027.

name: XIII Bieg Zimowego Dziadka
description: The 13th Winter Grandpa Run is a friendly 10 km race held on the Kuchary Forest District running route. The route is fully marked and has restricted vehicle traffic, helping ensure participants’ safety. The time limit is 90 minutes. The event begins with a warm-up, followed by an awards ceremony and refreshments for participants after the race.
course_highlights: Kuchary Forest District running route
Fully marked 10 km course
Restricted vehicle traffic on the route
additional: Registration takes place from 10:00 to 10:30 on race day. There is a warm-up before the 10:30 start. The participant limit is 120. The awards ceremony and refreshments take place after the race, at around 12:30. Information available for the 13th edition relates to the race held on 11 January 2026; the entry fee was PLN 40 during registration and PLN 50 on the day of the event, and the participant limit was 120. It has not been confirmed whether these conditions will apply in 2027.

name: Zimowa Piątka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Zimowa Piątka is an annual race organized by the Suwałki Sports and Recreation Centre, held by Arkadia Reservoir. It is a unique opportunity to kick off the winter season with an active outing in the picturesque surroundings of Suwałki, known for its harsh climate and beautiful landscapes. The event attracts both recreational and experienced runners, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting competition among residents and visitors. For years, OSiR Suwałki has ensured the professional organization of sporting events, providing participants with comfort and safety.
course_highlights: The race route follows a picturesque course around Arkadia Reservoir
The winter scenery of Suwałki, with its characteristic cold climate
A well-prepared and marked route suited to runners of different abilities
additional: In previous editions, the race was part of Stacja Pogodne Suwałki, whose program also included a Nordic walking event and a children's race. Participants in Zimowa Piątka could take part in carnival costumes.

name: Zimowy Bieg Niedzwiedzia
location: Nowy Dębiec, Kościan County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Kościanie
description: The Winter Bear Run in Nowy Dębiec is an annual running event organized by the Kościan Municipality Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place at the holiday resort in Nowy Dębiec, offering participants the opportunity to compete in a scenic setting. The event is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix, promoting active recreation and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: The route runs through the holiday resort in Nowy Dębiec
Scenic areas by the lake
Organized as part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix
additional: The event is organized by the Kościan Municipality Sports and Recreation Centre. The race is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix series. The resort has a swimming area, a beach and sports courts in Nowy Dębiec. Information about distances and routes is from the 2026 edition; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Winterlaufserie
description: The Stadthagen Winter Running Series is a relaxed running and Nordic walking event consisting of 10 individual events. Participants can choose from four signposted loop courses of varying difficulty in the scenic Bückeberge hills. There is no mass start or timing, making it a stress-free way to assess your own performance. All participants receive a warm tea at the finish in the sports center.

name: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti
description: The XXV Run Commemorating Freedom Defenders’ Day in Klaipėda is a traditional running event held to honour those who died and fought for Lithuania’s freedom. The event brings together the city’s community and visitors and takes place in Klaipėda on January 18. Participants can choose between two distances: the main 8 km course and a shorter 3 km course for schoolchildren, seniors and anyone who finds the longer course too challenging. The event starts in the evening, and the routes pass through scenic parts of the city, including a cycle path and the Summer Amphitheatre.
course_highlights: The 8 km course follows a cycle path past Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre, Liepojos Street and H. Manto Street
Finish near Klaipėda City Municipality (Liepų St. 11)
The 3 km course starts near Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre and is intended for schoolchildren and seniors
additional: Race bibs have an external timing chip. Picking up race bibs in advance is recommended to avoid queues on event day. Bib pickup for 8 km runners is on a bus near the Rotušė, and for 3 km runners it is near the Summer Amphitheatre. Buses depart for the start locations at 19:00. Individual warm-up: 19:45–19:55. The course closes at 21:20. Medals are awarded to the first 900 finishers. The event is organised with buses and community participation; the start is at the Klaipėda Giruliai Radio and TV Tower.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski
description: The Świętokrzyski Winter Marathon is a mountain challenge held in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, in the town of Chęciny. The event brings together runs, hikes and run-walks, giving participants the opportunity to discover the region’s beautiful, scenic landscapes. For years, the organizers have promoted outdoor activity and mountain tourism by creating and restoring hiking trails. This event is for those who enjoy long-distance challenges and being close to nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Scenic landscapes and natural hiking trails
Routes suitable for running, hiking and run-walks
additional: The organizers also restore and promote hiking trails in the region. The event is part of a broader range of outdoor activities in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Aid and checkpoint stations are available to participants, as is the option to download a GPX file with the routes. The event is aimed at runners and hikers taking on challenging winter conditions.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful, wooded settings in city parks, including Młociński Park in Warsaw. The races are open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with the required permission. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish in Warsaw are in Młociny Forest, and the course stays the same, allowing results to be compared over the years.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the wooded setting of Młociński Park
The start is about 1.5 km from the finish, which is on a clearing in Młociny Forest
The course is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. In Warsaw, the warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:30. The course stays the same throughout the season. Parking nearby is limited, so using public transport is recommended. Register online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. A pass for four races at one location is also available.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
XI Eko Cross po Ziemi Pietrowickiej
Gdynia ULTRA WAY - Winter Race Stary Wilk
description: Gdynia ULTRA WAY - Winter Race is a winter running festival held in Gdynia, offering six distances from 5 km to over 76 km. The courses pass through scenic areas with significant elevation gains, combining sporting competition with natural beauty and a unique atmosphere. The event is organized by the ULTRA WAY Foundation and features courses with checkpoints and aid stations, as well as professional timing and participant safety measures. It is an event for runners of varying experience levels who want to take on challenging courses and winter conditions.
course_highlights: Nocny Jeleń course – 76.6 km with +2309 m / -2313 m elevation change
Tropem Rysia course – 50 km with +1501 m / -1575 m elevation change
Courses with checkpoints and aid stations, and professional chip timing
additional: The start and finish of all races are located at the Gdynia Sports Centre – National Rugby Stadium, ul. Kazimierza Górskiego 10. Buses take participants to the start of the longest distances from outside the Gdynia Sports Centre (paid transport; advance registration required). The time limit for completing the longest distance is 15 hours, and for the 50 km distance it is 11 hours. The DZIKI DUET race is run in pairs. Aid and hydration stations are available on the course (except on the shortest distances). The race has an ITRA 4 classification, UTMB 100K status, and 3 Mountain points.

name: 17 Chrustowski Bieg Zimowy
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. Bronisława Malinowskiego, Chrustowo, Gmina Oborniki, Poland
description: The Chrustowo Winter Run is the oldest running event in the Oborniki municipality, organized since 2007. The 12 km main race passes through the picturesque villages of Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo, while accompanying races for primary school pupils take place on routes adapted to their age. The event promotes physical activity and community spirit, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. The organizers also provide prizes for the top finishers in the OPEN and age categories.
course_highlights: The 12 km main race route passes through Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo
Accompanying races for children and young people on routes adapted to their age categories
Picturesque surroundings and a winter atmosphere make for an active start to the year
additional: The main race is limited to 200 participants. The race pack includes a commemorative medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut, and water. The top finishers receive statuettes or trophies. The accompanying children’s races start at 11:05, immediately after the main race begins. In the 2026 edition, the main race was scheduled to start at the Bronisław Malinowski Primary School in Chrustowo; the limit was 200 participants. The race pack included a medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut, and water. This information refers to the previous edition.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by a group of running enthusiasts. The events take place in scenic locations, with a particular focus on the visual appeal of the courses, often in botanical gardens and green spaces. The Łódź race is held in the Botanical Garden, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The organizers promote running and create a welcoming atmosphere for runners of different ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden in Łódź
Scenic, attractive green surroundings
Courses suited to runners of different ability levels
additional: The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las from Poznań. The events are cross-country races held in various locations in Wielkopolska and other cities. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrates its 10th anniversary. The organizers encourage people to sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date with events. The Łódź editions also include children's races. The cited sources concern previous editions and do not confirm details of the event on January 16, 2027.

name: Dziki w Ogniu & Sztafety Ogniomistrza
location: OSP fire station, Spręcowo, Dywity, Poland
organizer: Gmina Dywity, OSP z terenu gminy Dywity i Gminne Dywickie Zrzeszenie LZS
price_range: 30-40 zł za bieg indywidualny; sztafeta bezpłatnie

description: Dziki w Ogniu & Firemaster’s Relay is a winter cross-country race held in Spręcowo, in the Dywity municipality. The approximately 6 km course runs entirely along forest roads and tracks. It is highly challenging, with numerous climbs and natural terrain obstacles. The event includes an individual race and relays for members of volunteer and state fire services (OSP/PSP). The start and finish are by the OSP fire station in Spręcowo. The races take place in January and are recreational and sporting in nature, with manual timekeeping and a commemorative medal for participants.
course_highlights: An approximately 6 km course running entirely along forest roads and tracks
A challenging cross-country course with numerous climbs and natural obstacles
Start and finish by the OSP fire station in Spręcowo
additional: Race office open from 9:00 to 10:30 by the OSP fire station in Spręcowo. The individual race is limited to 100 participants, with additional on-site registration available for 20 runners. Timekeeping is manual; start chips must be returned at the finish. Proceeds from additional registrations support the 34th WOŚP Grand Finale. Information about the distance, course and fees comes from the 2026 edition and may differ from the conditions for the 2027 edition. In previous editions, the relay was for teams of six firefighters.

name: Run in Sopot - 1 etap
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata Startowa : 49 PLN lub 40 PLN z Kartą Sopocką

description: Run in Sopot - Stage 1 is the first race in the #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series, taking place on January 17, 2026, on Sopot beach. It’s a unique opportunity to tackle a course on the seaside sand and experience the atmosphere of a sporting celebration in one of the most beautiful resorts on the Baltic Sea. The race series also includes further editions on the beach and a race near the Forest Opera, with participants competing for cash prizes in the overall standings. The organizers invite both recreational and experienced runners to take part in this modern, dynamic running event.
course_highlights: Course on Sopot beach
A race in a seaside resort with a unique microclimate
Overall standings competition with cash prizes
additional: The #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series includes four races: three on the beach and one near the Forest Opera. Participants compete in the overall standings for cash prizes. Sopot residents can receive a discount on the entry fee by using the Sopot Card.

name: WOŚPowa 5
description: WOŚPowa 5 is a 5 km race held in the picturesque town of Dąbki during the Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The start and finish are at the Water Sports Centre. The event combines sporting competition with a good cause, encouraging participants to support WOŚP through voluntary donations. Shorter races of 200, 400 and 800 metres are planned for children, making the event appealing to the whole family. Everyone is welcome to take part and celebrate sport and helping others together.
course_highlights: Main 5 km race starting and finishing at the Water Sports Centre
Children’s races over 200 m, 400 m and 800 m
Picturesque route in the spa town of Dąbki
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary donation to the WOŚP collection box. The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale, combining sport with charitable support. Shorter races over 200, 400 and 800 metres are planned for children. The start and finish are at the Water Sports Centre in Dąbki. In the previous edition, the donations collected were given to the 33rd WOŚP Grand Finale. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: XIII Bieg Podhalański
location: Nowy Targ Airport, Nowy Targ, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Zgłoszenie internetowe do dnia 14 stycznia 2026 r. -40 zł – osoby dorosłe

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The 13th Bieg Podhalański is a prestigious classic-style cross-country skiing race held at the airport in Nowy Targ. Competitors race over 6 km, 15 km, and 30 km courses (two laps of the 15 km loop). The event attracts cross-country skiing enthusiasts of all ages and also offers activities for children and families, such as dog-sled rides and a play zone. After the races, there is an awards ceremony and a quiz with prizes from sponsors. This sporting event has a unique atmosphere, combining competition with community spirit.
course_highlights: Classic-style cross-country skiing courses over 6 km, 15 km, and 30 km
A 15 km loop completed twice by competitors in the 30 km race
Start and finish at the airport in Nowy Targ, with views of the winter scenery of Podhale
additional: Total entry limit: 950 participants, with distance-specific limits of 300 for 30 km, 599 for 15 km, and 499 for 6 km. The race is held in classic style. Underage competitors may enter only the 5 km and 15 km distances with written parental consent. On race day, registration is available at the race office at the airport in Nowy Targ. Results are sent by SMS to the phone number provided. Dog-sled rides and a play zone are available for children and families. A quiz with prizes from sponsors takes place after the awards ceremony. The 13th edition was held on 17 January 2026; available sources do not confirm 16 January 2027 as the date. The program for the edition described included, among other things, a play zone for children and dog-sled rides.

name: IV Zimowy Bieg Chrząszcza
description: The 4th Winter Beetle Run is a winter running event scheduled in Szczebrzeszyn, with the venue in Kawęczynek. It’s an opportunity to spend an active day running around the town. The race calendar lists a distance of 10 km, but this is not confirmed in the available registration details. The event date needs confirmation, as sources indicate January 17, 2027, rather than January 16.
course_highlights: Event location: Szczebrzeszyn – Kawęczynek
A winter run in the area around Szczebrzeszyn
The race calendar lists a 10 km distance, not confirmed in the registration details
additional: The race calendar gives an approximate date of January 17, 2027, which differs from the stated date of January 16.

name: Zimní běh na Blaník
description: Zimní běh na Blaník is a legendary January race in the picturesque town of Načeradec, taking place on 16 January 2027. The event offers two main races: a challenging 19.9 km main race over Velký and Malý Blaník, and an accompanying 11.2 km race. The routes pass through the beautiful Podblanicko countryside, with significant climbs, forest sections, and views from the lookout tower on Velký Blaník. The start and finish are right in the centre of Načeradec, with cosy facilities. The race is limited to 700 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: The 19.9 km main race with 542 m of elevation gain over Velký and Malý Blaník
The 11.2 km accompanying race with 238 m of elevation gain and views from Malý Blaník
Refreshment stations along the route in Býkovice and by the lookout tower on Velký Blaník
additional: The start and finish are behind the Načeradec Municipal Office building, approximately 270 m from the race facilities. Parking is available in several designated areas, marked with traffic signs and assisted by volunteer firefighters. The race is limited to 700 runners. The organisers offer free secure storage for valuables in the changing rooms at the primary school. The accompanying race starts at 10:45. The entry fee includes the option to order functional accessories from the J&O 2025/2026 collection. In adverse circumstances, the race may be modified to individual starts or postponed. Online registration is available, with entry-fee refunds possible until 31.12.2026. The race takes place in January and has a capacity of approximately 700 runners. The route runs mostly along forest and field tracks. The main race starts at 10:10.

name: Aplink Želvos ežerą
description: The “Around Lake Želva” run will take place on January 11, 2025, in Suginčiai (Molėtai District), in remembrance of Lithuania’s Freedom Defenders Day. The event aims to promote running in Lithuania, improve athletic performance, and encourage a healthy, active lifestyle. We recommend arriving at around 10:00; the race starts at 11:00.

name: XVII Bieg o Puchar Burmistrza Miasta Pszów
description: The 17th Pszów Mayor’s Cup Run is an annual running event organized by the Pszów City Office. The run attracts participants of different ages and ability levels, promoting physical activity and community integration. The race takes place on a course in Pszów and is a recreational sporting event featuring competition for the mayor’s cup. It’s a great opportunity to test your abilities and celebrate sport together in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main race over a distance of 12 km
Course in Pszów
additional: This edition took place on January 18, 2026, not January 10, 2027. A total of 156 runners started the 12 km race.

name: IV Pogórzański Bieg Górski
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Burzynie, Burzyn, Poland
description: The 4th Pogórzański Mountain Run is a mountain race of approximately 21 km with around 800 m of elevation gain, held in the picturesque village of Burzyn. The route is approximately 70% forest trails and 30% asphalt, with three aid stations along the way. The time limit is 240 minutes, and timing is electronic. The race office, start and finish are at the Primary School in Burzyn, where changing rooms, bag storage and showers are available. There are overall classifications for women and men, as well as age-group categories.
course_highlights: Approximately 21 km with around 800 m of elevation gain
Route is 70% forest trails and 30% asphalt
3 aid stations along the route (5 km, 12 km, 19 km)
additional: The race office is open from 7:30 to 10:00 at the sports hall of the Primary School in Burzyn. Changing rooms, bag storage and showers are available on site. A race pack may be collected on another participant’s behalf only with a written authorization and proof of identity. The route is marked every 1 km. The time limit is 240 minutes. The winners’ ceremony is scheduled for approximately 14:30–15:00. Route and event information is based on previous editions. In the 4th edition, the start, finish and race office were at the Primary School in Burzyn; the time limit was 240 minutes.

name: 9 Miński Bieg Biegiem dla WOŚP
description: The 9th Mińsk Biegiem dla WOŚP Run is an annual 10 km road race held in Mińsk Mazowiecki. The event is charitable and offers an excellent opportunity to support the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity through sport. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the streets of Mińsk Mazowiecki
Asphalt course of moderate difficulty
Charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to participants’ VDOT levels. Expert support is available during preparation. The organizer encourages the use of its platform for managing the race listing and marketing collaboration.

name: Trail Kamieńsk
location: OSiR Góra Kamieńsk, Góra Kamieńsk, Poland
description: Trail Kamieńsk is a mountain race held on Mount Kamieńsk in central Poland, offering three distances: 6 km, 14 km, and 30 km. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle and attracts runners of varying abilities. The route passes through scenic, varied terrain, offering challenges and beautiful views. The organizers provide professional event management and support for participants along the course.
course_highlights: Mountain routes on Mount Kamieńsk, measuring 6 km, 14 km, and 30 km
Scenic views and varied terrain
Well-marked and secured routes with refreshment points
additional: The race office is located at the OSiR Kamieńsk grounds, by the lower ski-lift station. The routes are well marked and secured, with refreshment points along the course. The event takes place in winter conditions, so appropriate equipment and clothing are required. The rules require a signed statement confirming there are no medical contraindications to participation. In 2027, the minimum age is 16 for the 6 km race and 18 for the 14 km and 30 km distances. The official website lists the date as February 7, 2027, not January 17.

name: Zimní šestka Kravaře – Kouty
location: Sportovní areál Olšinky, Kravaře-Kouty, Czech Republic

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė is a Backyard Ultra-style race designed to make it easier for runners to cover 100 miles. If you’ve never experienced a DNF in your life, here you’ll have the chance to earn one with honor. There will be only one winner.

name: 11 Górski Zimowy Maraton Ślężański
description: The Górski Zimowy Maraton Ślężański is a challenging mountain race held in Sobótka, covering 42.6 km with approximately 1,130 m of elevation gain. A half marathon is also held as part of the event, covering 23.9 km with approximately 575 m of elevation gain. The course runs through scenic mountain terrain, offering participants unique challenges and beautiful views. The event has a long-standing tradition and is popular among mountain runners.
course_highlights: Marathon distance: 42.6 km with ±1,130 m of elevation gain
Half marathon distance: 23.9 km with ±575 m of elevation gain
Mountain course with scenic views and a challenging profile
additional: The event includes two races: a marathon and a half marathon. The attendance record is 714 people (2020). The marathon and half-marathon course records are listed with the athletes’ names and times. GPX routes are available for both distances. The event’s Facebook page provides a GPX track of the course.

name: Zimowy Półmaraton Gór Stołowych
location: Centrum Szkoleniowo-Edukacyjne Parku Narodowego Gór Stołowych, Karłów, Poland
description: The Stołowe Mountains Winter Half Marathon is a challenging 21 km mountain race held in winter conditions in the scenic Stołowe Mountains. The route follows hiking trails with numerous rocks, turns and significant elevation gains. It is often covered in snow and ice, requiring participants to be in good shape and have sound technique. The start and finish are located at the Stołowe Mountains National Park Training and Education Centre and the Shelter on Szczeliniec, which can be reached only under your own power. The race is part of a series of mountain running events and takes place whatever the weather, with mandatory equipment and environmental rules.
course_highlights: The route follows hiking trails in Poland’s Stołowe Mountains
Significant elevation gains, many rocks and turns, and potentially heavy snow and ice
The finish is at the Shelter on Szczeliniec, accessible only on foot
additional: The time limit for completing the route is 5 hours. There are 2 checkpoints with refreshment stations and time cutoffs: Parking under Szczeliniec (6.7 km, cutoff 2:30 hours) and Błędne Skały (13.6 km, cutoff 4:00 hours). Participants may use snowshoes. Race packs can be collected at the Stołowe Mountains National Park Training and Education Centre in Karłów on Friday and Saturday morning. After the race, a recovery meal, an awards ceremony and a prize draw for prizes from partners are planned. Deposits weighing up to 3 kg can be left at the finish, but valuables and documents must not be left. The start is at 09:00; the finish time limit is 5 hours. Snow and ice may occur on the route in winter; snowshoes are permitted. There are two checkpoints on the route with refreshment stations and time cutoffs.

name: X Ultra River Ultra Świder - zima
6 Nocny Maraton / Półmaraton
organizer: Klub Sportowy Ultra Team Łódź i Fundacja Wybiegaj Marzenia
description: The 6th Night Marathon and Half Marathon with the Ultra Team in Łagiewnicki Forest is a unique running event organized by runners for runners. The race takes place in the scenic Łagiewnicki Forest in Łódź, offering participants a nighttime atmosphere and a memorable running experience. It is a great opportunity to test yourself on a marathon or half-marathon course surrounded by nature. The event has become a tradition and is attracting growing interest among runners from the region.
course_highlights: The course runs through scenic Łagiewnicki Forest
The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
Organized by the experienced Ultra Team—runners for runners
additional: According to the available information, the participant limit is 250: 170 for the half marathon and 80 for the marathon. The program includes a race pack, a hot meal, prizes for the women's and men's overall categories, and a medal for every participant.

name: 20 Bieg WOŚP Policz się z cukrzycą
description: The 20th WOŚP “Measure Up to Diabetes” Run is a charity race in Warsaw, held as part of the 35th Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. It combines sporting activity with support for the Grand Finale’s cause and invites everyone to run together for a good cause. The event is scheduled for January 23, 2027, in Warsaw.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Winter Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of its routes, offering picturesque and attractive terrain for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during the winter edition of the race. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy some sporting fun together.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque routes
Scenic locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The organizers particularly promote cross-country running and the scenic appeal of their routes. In summer 2026, they celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale marathon in Chwałowice, held in a friendly atmosphere. The course passes through forest and countryside, offering a chance to run away from the bustle of the city. One local landmark along the route is Napoleon’s Stone. It’s an event for people who enjoy relaxed running meetups and a cross-country feel.
course_highlights: A forest and countryside route around Chwałowice
Passes by Napoleon’s Stone
A small-scale race with a cross-country feel
additional: Available sources describe previous editions and a historical series of four marathons in 2024; they do not confirm details of the edition scheduled for January 23, 2027.

name: X Zabrzański Bieg dla WOŚP
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 15 im. ks. Jana Dzierżona, ul. Czołgistów 1, Zabrze, Poland
organizer: Sztab WOŚP Zabrze oraz Bieg Pluszaka działający przy Stowarzyszeniu Wielka Flota Zjednoczonych Sił
description: The 11th Zabrze Run for WOŚP is an annual sporting event organized by the WOŚP Zabrze Headquarters and Bieg Pluszaka, part of the Wielka Flota Zjednoczonych Sił Association. The run takes place on January 30, 2027, in Zabrze, at Primary School No. 15 named after Rev. Jan Dzierżon. Participants can choose between two routes: 3 km and 6 km (two 3 km loops). The event is charitable and community-focused, welcoming runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: 3 km and 6 km routes (two 3 km loops)
Start and finish on the grounds of Primary School No. 15 in Zabrze
Charitable event supporting WOŚP
additional: The run takes place from 10:00 to 15:00. It is organized by the WOŚP Zabrze Headquarters and Bieg Pluszaka, part of the Wielka Flota Zjednoczonych Sił Association. The event is community-focused and charitable, and takes place on the grounds of a primary school. It will be held on January 30, 2027, at Primary School No. 15 named after Rev. Jan Dzierżon, ul. Czołgistów 1. There is no age limit for participation.

name: XII Zimowy Maraton Bieszczadzki
description: The 13th Bieszczady Winter Marathon is a winter mountain race taking place in Cisna on 23 January 2027. Participants can choose from three distances: 10 km, 26/28 km, and 42/44 km, with routes adapted to weather conditions and snow cover. The races start from designated points, and the course runs through the scenic Bieszczady Mountains, featuring challenging climbs and descents. Participants can expect refreshment points with drinks and snacks, as well as shared transport to the start for the 10 km distance. The finish closes at 15:30, and the organizer provides professional support and attractive race packages.
course_highlights: Mountain routes of 10 km, 26/28 km, and 42/44 km, with a total elevation gain and loss of up to 860 m
A route adapted to winter conditions, with alternative versions in the event of heavy snow cover
Refreshment points along the course with water, tea, and snacks
additional: The 42/44 km and 26/28 km races start at 7:00 at the school in Cisna. The 10 km race starts at 8:40 in Przysłup, with coach transport from Cisna at 8:00 (participants cannot make their own way to the start). Participants must bring their own cups or bottles for the refreshment points. The time limit for completing the course is when the finish closes at 15:30. Safety and hygiene rules in force at the time apply during the race. The start is scheduled for 7:00. The race office is located at the school in Cisna, Cisna 58; it will be open on 22 January 2027 from 17:00 to 22:00 and on 23 January from 6:00 to 9:30.

name: XIII Karnawałowy Bieg Górski Pielgrzym
description: The 13th Carnival Mountain Run Pielgrzym is a challenging 10 km mountain race taking place in Leśnica. The event is an excellent opportunity to test yourself on a demanding trail course, ideal for fans of mountain challenges. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The race takes place in a winter setting, which adds to its unique character and appeal.
course_highlights: A challenging 10 km mountain trail course
Winter scenery in Leśnica
A challenge for runners who prefer demanding terrain
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including training instructions and expert support. The date shown in calendars is approximate; the date listed there, January 24, 2027, differs from the event date provided.

description: The Run around Bremst is part of the Winter Running League organised by TJ Maratonstav Úpice in the Jestřebí Mountains region. The race offers courses for adults of approximately 5 to 7 km and shorter courses for young runners from 0.5 to 3 km, which may be adjusted depending on the weather. The race starts in Malé Svatoňovice, where race check-in and the race office are also located. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and is part of a series in which the five best races count towards the score. The organiser prioritises safety, including mandatory reflective gear for all participants.
course_highlights: A 5 to 7 km course for adults in the Jestřebí Mountains region
Short 0.5 to 3 km courses for young runners, which may be adjusted depending on the weather
Start and check-in in Malé Svatoňovice (SŠBPA)
additional: Check-in until 9:30, children’s categories start at 10:00, and the main race starts immediately after the children finish. The race number is valid for the entire Winter Running League series. The race takes place in all weather conditions and at participants’ own risk. All runners must wear reflective gear. The race office opens one hour before the first category starts. The races are open to the general public; registration is available 15 minutes before the start. Reflective gear is required, and weather may affect course conditions.

name: 5. Pietrasze Cross Country 3/5
description: Pietrasze Cross Country is a series of cross-country races held in the picturesque Pietrasze Forest in Białystok. The course is entirely natural and highly varied, featuring forest trails, uphill and downhill sections, and different surfaces such as forest floor, grass, sand, and mud. The race requires versatility and good fitness from participants, with volunteers and lead cyclists present along the course. After the race, participants can socialize over music, doughnuts, and tea, adding to the event’s friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A course entirely on varied, natural forest terrain
Numerous climbs and descents, with a total elevation gain of 140 m+
The course is marked with blue-and-white tape, with lead cyclists and volunteers present
additional: Race packs are distributed from 8:30 to 9:30 at Primary School No. 32 named after Major Henryk Dobrzański, nom de guerre Hubal, at ul. Pietrasze 29. Before the start, a warm-up with a trainer and music takes place from 9:40 to 9:50. After the race, a music event and social gathering with doughnuts and tea continue until 12:00. Participants start from the start zones, where race numbers are checked by officials at 9:55. The series includes multiple races on different dates, with online registration available. Participants can look forward to a sporting atmosphere and beautiful surroundings.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: The Olęder Double Marathon is a series of running races organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Runners’ Club and held in a friendly, social-sporting atmosphere. The event is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to stay active outdoors through the challenging autumn and winter months. Participants run a marathon or a multiple of the 10.5 km loop. The races take place in different towns between October and March. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and encourage all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of a 10.5 km loop
Off-road running in autumn and winter conditions
Option to run a marathon or a multiple of the loop
additional: The Olęder Double Marathon takes place on a series of weekends from October to March, each in a different town. Races start at 10:00, and the race office opens an hour earlier. The time limit for the first race is 16:00 and for the second race, 15:00. The minimum distance is 10.5 km. The races are co-financed by Nowy Tomyśl County and are held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. The date of January 17, 2027, comes from a running calendar; the organizer’s available pages do not yet confirm details of this edition in Grudna.

name: XVIII Jelczańsko-Oławski Zimowy Maraton ...
description: The 19th Jelczańsko-Oławski Toyota Winter Marathon in Stages is a series of seven races, each 7.033 km long, held at different locations around Jelcz-Laskowice and Oława. The event combines running and Nordic walking, with a shared start and electronic timing. Participants can collect their race packets the day before the first stage or on race day. The event is organized by KB Harcownik Jelcz-Laskowice and supported by local authorities and partners, including Toyota Motor Manufacturing Poland.
course_highlights: Seven stages, each 7.033 km long
Courses in different localities: Chwałowice, Oława, Jelcz-Laskowice, Janików, Miłoszyce
Nordic walking and running starts with electronic timing
additional: A race packet may be collected by an authorized person presenting a printed and signed form. Collection the day before the start is recommended, at Termy Jakuba in Oława or at Jelcz-Laskowice City Hall. Nordic walking and running starts take place at 11:00, with Nordic walking starting 30 minutes earlier from the second stage onward. On race day, the race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30 before the first stage and from 10:00 before subsequent stages. For the date January 31, 2027, the source lists Stage III of the 19th edition, not the 18th edition. Nordic walking is scheduled for 10:30 and the run for 11:00.

name: VII Zimowy Bieg po Zdrój
description: The Winter Run po Zdrój is an annual running event held in Jaworze that attracts runners and their families. The races take place in a winter setting, offering participants a unique running experience on urban and mountain routes. The event includes a road race and a mountain half marathon, and GPX files of the routes are available for navigation. The organizers welcome both younger and older runners, dividing participants into age categories.
course_highlights: Routes available in GPX format for navigation devices
A road race and mountain half marathon in the winter setting of Jaworze
Age categories from 16 and up, including M20, M30 and M60
additional: Race packs can be collected at the Race Office in tents at the sports complex on ul. Koralowa. Race routes can be downloaded in GPX format. The races take place in winter conditions, so runners need to be appropriately prepared. Sources refer to the 7th edition, scheduled for 25 January 2026; they do not confirm an edition on 24 January 2027.

name: 10 Bieg Pobiegnij z WOŚP
description: The 10th Run with WOŚP in Ostrów Wielkopolski is an annual running event organised under the patronage of the WOŚP Ostrów Wielkopolski Committee. The race covers a distance of 10 km and is a charity event, combining sporting competition with a social cause. It takes place in January, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to train and compete together. On race day, the organiser provides an information point at Plażowa Restaurant.
course_highlights: 10-kilometre road race
Charitable event supporting WOŚP
Race in Ostrów Wielkopolski
additional: On race day, 25 January 2026, the information point will be open from 10:00 to 11:30 at Plażowa Restaurant, ul. Plażo. Training sessions count from the time of registration until the race. No information is available about start waves, participant limits or additional equipment. Information about the 10th edition gives the date as 25 January 2026; the running calendar tentatively indicates 25 January 2027. Information about the course and entry fee has not been confirmed.

name: 13 Bieg Wielkich Serc
location: Bulwar Kurlandzki near Galeria Kazimierz, Kraków, Poland
organizer: Sztab Wielkiej Orkiestry Świątecznej Pomocy #7702 przy Hufcu ZHP Kraków-Podgórze
description: The 13th Bieg Wielkich Serc is an annual running event held in Kraków on the Kurlandzki Boulevard near Galeria Kazimierz. The race is a charity event associated with the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. Participants can expect a special atmosphere and the opportunity to support a worthy cause through a sporting event. The organizers provide a baggage drop at Galeria Kazimierz, but there are no changing rooms for participants.
course_highlights: The route follows Kurlandzki Boulevard in Kraków
Start and finish near Galeria Kazimierz
The race takes place in the morning on 25 January
additional: The organizer does not provide changing rooms. The baggage drop for participants will be located at Galeria Kazimierz and will be open on race day from 11:00 to 13:30. Previous editions have also included races for children and young people, as well as Nordic walking. Information for the 2026 edition listed a baggage drop at Galeria Kazimierz; the organizer did not provide changing rooms.

description: The 14th Opole “Count Yourself in with Diabetes” Run is an annual event held during the Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity in Opole. The run is a charity event, and all entry fees go to the account of the 34th WOŚP Grand Finale. Participants can expect a certificate, a medal, and gifts from sponsors. Registration is online, and places are limited.
course_highlights: Approximately 5-kilometre route
Start at Plac Wolności
The route passes, among other places, along the Nadodrzański Boulevard and through Bolko Island, with the finish at the National Centre of Polish Song
additional: Every participant will receive a certificate, a medal sponsored by ARTAL, and gifts from SFD and Smooth The Fruit at the finish. Start numbers are sponsored by INFODRUK printing house (www.startowe.eu). Registration opens on 11 November at 11:11 via zmierzymyczas.pl; places are limited. At the finish, participants will receive a certificate, a medal, and a gift.

name: 16 Postomiński Bieg Policz się z cukrzycą
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Postominie
description: The Postomino Run “Count Yourself in the Fight Against Diabetes” is an annual running event organized by the Culture and Sports Center in Postomino. The race is charitable and is part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity, promoting awareness and support for people with diabetes. The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino, bringing together the local community and runners from various regions. The event combines sporting competition with an important health and social message.
course_highlights: The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino
A charity event supporting people with diabetes
Organized as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity
additional: The race is organized by the Culture and Sports Center in Postomino and takes place as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event involves local running clubs and the community. The available websites provide no details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. The race takes place as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity.

description: The 18th Run for Diabetes Awareness is an annual running event organized by Maratończyk Team in Szczecin. The race takes place on Łasztownia, near Stara Rzeźnia, and is a charity event that brings people together and promotes diabetes awareness. The race is scheduled to start at 13:00, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and support from the local community.
course_highlights: The course runs through scenic Łasztownia in Szczecin
The start and finish are located by Stara Rzeźnia
The race takes place in the afternoon, which helps ensure participants’ comfort
additional: The race is organized by Maratończyk Team - Klub Biegacza Szczecin. The event is charitable and brings people together. Participants can sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date with race information. Information about the distance, fees, and course comes from the regulations for the 18th edition in 2026, not from a confirmed edition scheduled for 2027. In 2026, the participant limit was 400; children’s races were also held over distances of 100 m and 500 m.

description: The 34th Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity in Świerklaniec is a special charity event organised jointly with the Świerklaniec Municipality. As part of the finale, the 3rd Run in Funny Costumes takes place, with participants covering a route of approximately 2 kilometres in amusing and unusual outfits. The event combines sporting fun with a rich arts programme and numerous attractions for the whole family. The fundraising goal is the diagnosis and treatment of digestive tract diseases in children. In the evening, the symbolic “Light to the Sky” illuminates the park in Świerklaniec.
course_highlights: Approximately 2 km route through the park in Świerklaniec
Run in amusing and unusual costumes
Symbolic “Light to the Sky” at 20:00
additional: Participants receive a commemorative medal, and the creators of the most original and funniest costumes are rewarded. Adults and minors may take part, with parental or guardian consent required for minors. After the run, numerous attractions are available, including a bonfire with free sausages in exchange for a donation to a WOŚP collection box, dance performances, a food area, first-aid lessons, a children’s play area, and free admission to the Pałac Kawalera. Participation is at the participant’s own risk and requires acceptance of the event rules. Costumes are not compulsory. Registration is via a Google form, and payment is made through the WOŚP Tarnogórskie Stowarzyszenie Obywatelskie e-collection box. Minors may participate with the consent of and under the supervision of a parent or guardian; participation is at the participant’s own risk.

name: Bieruński Bieg Utopca
description: The Bieruń “Utopiec” Run is a cross-country race promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity, held in Bieruń. The event brings the running community together and supports the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. Competitors can choose between two distances: 17 km (the main race) and 5 km (running and Nordic walking). The course features varied surfaces, along with numerous uphill and downhill sections. The start and finish are in Bieruń’s Market Square, alongside a Family Sports Picnic with activities for children and local exhibitors.
course_highlights: Cross-country course with varied surfaces
Numerous uphill and downhill sections
Start and finish in Bieruń’s Market Square
additional: The race package includes a personalised race bib, a commemorative T-shirt and a medal featuring a depiction of the “Utopiec” that changes each year. The race office is located at the Sports Hall at 15 Szarych Szeregów Street, about 400 metres from the Market Square. The event also features a Family Sports Picnic with local artists, sports clubs, handicrafts, food products, activities for children and an awards ceremony. Previous editions offered 17 km and 5 km distances, with Nordic walking also available on the shorter distance. The race package included a bib, commemorative T-shirt and medal; the race office was located at the Sports Hall at 15 Szarych Szeregów Street. Details of the 24 January 2027 edition are not provided in the available materials.

description: Gramy dla WOŚP is a running event and walking rally held in the wooded areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest, partly along the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail. Participants can choose from several walking distances and an 11 km run, which was shortened in 2026 due to weather conditions. The finish is in Nowa Wieś Wielka, where the awards ceremony, refreshments and a campfire get-together take place. The organizer provides return transport from the finish to the start locations, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and access to aid stations along the route.
course_highlights: The running and walking rally routes pass through the wooded areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest
Part of the route follows the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail
Aid stations are located in Łażyn and before the finish
additional: Race packs are handed out one hour before the start in the start area. The combined participant limit for the run and walking rally is 250. Time is recorded before the railway crossing in Nowa Wieś Wielka. The organizer provides return bus transport from the finish to the start locations (Plaża Piecki and Solec Kujawski). Hot drinks, firefighters’ pea soup and a campfire are available at the finish. A mobile bag drop is available for participants’ personal belongings. Separate classifications are held for women and men, with awards for the top 5 runners and the top 3 participants in the walking rally. Information in the sources describes earlier editions, including an 11 km run from Plaża Piecki to Nowa Wieś Wielka and bus transport from the finish to the car parks by the beach.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Szczecin by Emerald Lake. The races take place from October to April, promoting physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. Each location has its own final standings, giving participants the chance to test themselves in a sporting competition. The race is open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event follows a regular schedule and has a friendly atmosphere, encouraging both adults and children to take part.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and city parks
Szczecin: the race takes place by Emerald Lake
The races take place in natural surroundings, bringing the city and nature together
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. The main race starts at 11:00. The programme also includes CITY TRAIL Junior races for children, with distances from 200 m to 1 km. In Szczecin, there is a group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The races follow a regular schedule, and the race office remains at the same location throughout the season. In Szczecin, the 2026/2027 season races are scheduled for 18 October 2026, 15 November 2026, 10 January 2027 and 4 April 2027. The stated date of 24 January 2027 does not appear in Szczecin’s official calendar. The regulations specify an 11:00 start and allow registration online or at the race office on race day.

Policz się z cukrzycą
description: The 11th “Get to Know Diabetes!” Run is an annual sporting event held in the City Park in Stalowa Wola, combining physical activity with charitable support. The run is part of the 34th Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity, and aims to support the treatment of digestive diseases in children. The event attracts whole families and sports enthusiasts, offering activities for both children and adults. Participants can expect professional organization, race packs, and a varied programme of accompanying events.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque City Park in Stalowa Wola
A family event with races for children and young people (Kids/Junior)
A sports warm-up led by activity leaders before the main race
additional: The race office opens at 9:00 at the City Park. Races for children and young people start at 11:00, preceded by a warm-up with an activity leader. After the main race at 12:00, the winners’ award ceremony and WOŚP charity auctions are scheduled to take place in the auditorium of the State Music School. The event officially ends at 16:30. The event combines sport, music, and charitable activities. Source information concerns the 11th edition in 2026; the date and programme for the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed.

name: X Bieg Wokół Stołu
description: The X Around the Table Run is a commemorative recreational running event organized by the “Pszczelnik” Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Siemianowice Śląskie. The event involves covering a distance of 1 km, or 117 laps around a table, without touching it. The run takes place in the sports hall of the “Michał” Sports Complex and is divided into two age categories, with separate classifications for women and men. Participants start in heats of 6, and at the end all those who complete the run in accordance with the regulations receive commemorative medals.
course_highlights: 1 km distance — 117 laps around a table
The run takes place in the sports hall of the “Michał” Sports Complex
Competition in two age categories, with separate classifications for women and men

The 51 km route with 2,600 metres of elevation gain starts and finishes in the village of Uhrovec, birthplace of Ľudovít Štúr, after whom the race is named. The race is demanding, and experience with similar long-distance routes is recommended. There are three aid stations along the course, which follows marked hiking trails throughout, offering beautiful views and historical sites.

Checkpoints at Uhrovec Castle, Chata pod Čiernym vrchom and Kajtárov

The organiser monitors the weather and may adjust the route or programme in case of danger. The start and finish are at Ľudovít Štúr Square in Uhrovec. name: Bieg Wedla
description: Bieg Wedla is a non-profit running event organized by enthusiasts from the PTTK Warsaw-Praga Branch. It takes place in the picturesque Skaryszewski Park in Warsaw. The routes follow a paved loop, with connecting sections on mineral-surfaced paths, and participants can enjoy the special atmosphere and historic park. The event is held in winter, which gives it a unique character, while the organizers take care to minimize its impact on the environment and local residents. After the race, participants receive medals and gifts, and can also enjoy free pea soup and hot tea.

Winter course in Turawa
Electronic timing
additional: The race office is open from 8:30 to 10:30. The organizer provides electronic timing. Turawa Municipal Office is a co-organizer. Turawa Municipal Office is a co-organizer. The race office for the 5 km distance is open from 8:30 to 10:30.

name: Bieg Pamięci Sybiru
description: The Sybir Memorial Run is an annual sporting event commemorating the first mass deportation of Polish citizens to Siberia on February 10, 1940. The race takes place in two cities: Białystok and Wrocław, offering 5 km and 10 km distances in Białystok and a 5 km distance in Wrocław. The route in Białystok runs through the picturesque Turczyński Forest, with evening starts using a wave-start system. The event combines sporting competition with historical remembrance and the emotional significance of commemoration.
course_highlights: The route through Turczyński Forest in Białystok
Evening starts with a wave-start system
Winter scenery and an unobstructed running route
additional: The 10 km race uses wave starts, with starting groups based on declared finish times. Start lines close 10 minutes after the last wave starts. Participants should report 30 minutes before the start. A 50% discount is available to people born in 1961 or earlier. The 2026 edition also offered virtual participation, requiring participants to cover at least 5 km in a single run. Participants received a race package and a commemorative medal.

name: Janosik Winter Race
description: Janosik Winter Race is a unique winter mountain race held in the heart of Spiš, at the foot of the majestic Tatra Mountains, in Niedzica. The course runs through scenic areas, including trails such as Spacer Murgrabiego, Bedzies, Kwicoł, Zawiany, Pyzdra, Kierpce and Maryny. The event is part of the Janosik Race Series, organized by a foundation with a passion for sport and development. It also offers races for children and young people, creating a family-friendly atmosphere and promoting physical activity in winter conditions.
course_highlights: Routes through the scenic areas of Spiš and the foothills of the Tatras
The Spacer Murgrabiego, Bedzies, Kwicoł, Zawiany, Pyzdra, Kierpce and Maryny trails
A winter mountain race featuring varied, challenging terrain
additional: Races for children and young people. Routes of varying distances and difficulty. The event takes place in winter mountain conditions. Photo and video galleries from previous editions are available. Parking and a race office are provided. The program also includes Janosik Kids races. The routes available in the edition described by the sources are 10, 21, 30 and 55 km.

name: Silesia Race
location: Hala Sportowa MOSiR w Knurowie, al. Lipowa 12A, Knurów, Poland
organizer: Stowarzyszenie „Planeta Przygody” oraz Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Knurowie
description: Silesia Race is an annual event held in the Silesia region, combining sporting competition with orienteering. Equipped with maps and, on selected courses, GPS devices, participants must find checkpoints placed along the route. The event base is the Sports Hall of the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Knurów. The event is organised by the Planeta Przygody Association and MOSiR Knurów. It is a great opportunity for lovers of outdoor activities and navigational challenges.
course_highlights: Sporting competition combined with orienteering
Participants use maps; GPS is available on selected courses
Checkpoints placed along the route for participants to find
additional: The event base is the MOSiR Sports Hall in Knurów at 12A Lipowa Avenue. The organisers are the Planeta Przygody Association and MOSiR Knurów. Participants can use GPS on selected courses. Registration is available on the external website silesiarace.pl. The event base is the MOSiR Sports Hall in Knurów at 12A Lipowa Avenue.

name: XXIII Zimowy Bieg Trzech Jezior
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Trzemesznie
description: The 24th Winter Three Lakes Run will take place on February 6, 2027, in Trzemeszno. This winter running event is held in the picturesque area of three lakes. The competition combines sporting rivalry with local classifications, and is open to runners from the Trzemeszno municipality as well as other participants.
additional: The previous edition included, among others, classifications for the Trzemeszno Municipality Championships, State Forests employees, and PAROC employees.

name: Zimowy Bieg Górski
location: Stok narciarski Na Complu, Rajcza, Poland
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Rajczy
description: The Wilcze Gronie Winter Mountain Run is an annual running event held on the ski slopes of Na Complu in Rajcza. The race features a winter mountain course that challenges participants and offers an active way to spend time in the picturesque surroundings of the Żywiec Beskids. The organizers invite runners to take part in this sporting competition, which combines a passion for running with the beauty of winter nature.
course_highlights: The course runs along the Na Complu ski slopes
Winter mountain scenery of the Żywiec Beskids
Picturesque views and demanding terrain
additional: A course map and GPX file were made available for the 2025 edition. These details refer to a previous edition and are not confirmed information about the 2027 event.

name: Běh po cyklostezce
description: Běh po cyklostezce is a traditional running race organized by the Maratonstav Úpice sports club. The race takes place in Úpice, near the tennis courts by the Elbe River, and is part of the Winter Running League. The main race starts immediately after the children’s categories finish, creating a friendly atmosphere for all age groups. Participants can enjoy a run in a scenic setting, with high-quality organization and a long-standing tradition.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the tennis courts in Úpice
The course follows the cycle path along the Elbe River
Part of the Winter Running League, with children’s categories
additional: Check-in until 9:30. The main race starts immediately after the children’s categories finish. The race number is valid for the entire Winter Running League series. The race takes place in February 2027. Registration is available on-site or via the website. The course is approximately 4.6 km long, and the start is by the tennis courts in Úpice.

description: The Mountain Half Marathon in Jedlina-Zdrój is a challenging mountain race set in the picturesque Wałbrzych Mountains. The course follows natural trails, technical sections and varied terrain, offering runners a sporting challenge and contact with nature. The event has an intimate atmosphere and is supported by the local community, creating a unique experience for participants. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace in Jedlina-Zdrój. The event offers several distances, including a mountain half marathon, a 10 km race and an ultra, as well as the accompanying Mountain Festival.
course_highlights: The course follows natural trails and technical sections in the Wałbrzych Mountains
Several refreshment and nutrition points along the course
Start and finish at Jedlinka Palace, ul. Zamkowa 4, Jedlina-Zdrój
additional: The field is limited to 300 participants for the Winter Half Marathon and Winter 10K. The course is marked with orange ribbons and arrows. Refreshment and nutrition points are provided along the course. Race numbers and race packs (socks, isotonic drink) can be collected at Hotel Jedlinka. All participants must wear their race number visibly on their torso. Winners are awarded during the event. Carrying a charged phone and a GPS track or course map is recommended. The race starts on 7 February 2027 at 10:00 from Jedlinka Palace, ul. Zamkowa 4. The total participant limit is 300 for the half marathon and Winter 10K combined. The organizer provides baggage storage, changing rooms, a post-race meal, hot drinks, and refreshment and nutrition points.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Polana Różopole, Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in scenic woodland and parkland. In Bydgoszcz, the route passes through the Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, with the start and finish at Różopole Clearing. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compete on the same course year after year. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete for overall standings and prizes.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the woodland scenery of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Różopole Clearing
The route is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the main race at 11:00, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. Parking is not available at Różopole Clearing; participants are advised to use car parks approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The race schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The main race starts at 11:00. Registration is available online through the Competitor Panel or at the race office on race day.

name: XIV Grand Prix Krakowa
description: The Krakow Mountain Running Grand Prix is a series of mountain races held in Krakow, offering a range of distances from 3.7 km to 23.2 km, as well as a Vertical race. The races take place on scenic routes with varying levels of difficulty, inviting both beginners and experienced runners to take on the challenge. The event is a recurring series with an anniversary edition, attracting hundreds of participants and offering individual and team classifications. The organizers provide a varied program, including races for children and relays, creating a welcoming sporting atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: Distances: 3.7 km, 5.7 km, 11.6 km, 23.2 km, and Vertical 1.5 km
Scenic mountain routes around Krakow with varied terrain
Special races for children and an anniversary relay
additional: Starts take place at various times on Sunday, including the 23.2 km race at 9:00. The Vertical GPK competition takes place on Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00. The series also includes races for children and an anniversary relay. The courses can already be tested during the summer. The series also includes the 5.7 km distance, the Vertical race (1.5 km), and races for children. The prices listed apply to a single race in the 14th edition and depend on the distance, registration date, and discounts.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz na Orientację is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz na Orientację Foundation, aimed at people of all ages and skill levels. Participants use a map and compass to explore a variety of forest and urban areas around Bydgoszcz. The event promotes outdoor activity, family participation, and the development of navigation skills, offering courses suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The foundation also works to create courses for blind and visually impaired participants, making the event accessible to everyone.
course_highlights: A variety of forest and urban areas around Bydgoszcz
Courses for beginners, experienced runners, and blind and visually impaired participants
A series of several events during the season, with an overall series classification
additional: The Autumn-Winter Series comprises six orienteering rounds in different forests around Bydgoszcz and nearby areas, with courses of varying difficulty. Participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collectible card for each completed round. Completing the entire series is rewarded with a special final badge and discounts on the Bydgoszcz and Surrounding Areas Championships. The project is supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism and the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Government. Available sources do not confirm details of the edition on 7 February 2027.
