name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in picturesque forests and urban parks. In Bydgoszcz, the course runs through Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, giving participants the chance to compete on a regular, well-established route. The races are open to anyone aged 16 and over and aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity. The start and finish are at Polana Różopole, and the organizers provide professional event support and a recurring race series.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the woodland setting of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
The course is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start at 10:45. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; parking lots approximately 1–1.5 km from the start are recommended. Races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season across 7 locations. Four races are scheduled in Bydgoszcz: November 7, 2026; December 12, 2026; January 23, 2027; and March 6, 2027. During the 2026/2027 season, the Bydgoszcz races take place in Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District. Registration is available online through the Participant Panel or at the race office on race day.

name: Tropem Wilczym
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run in Zalesie is an annual running event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, Polish heroes of the anti-communist underground from 1944 to 1963. Organized by the Ryki Municipality, the World Association of Home Army Soldiers, and the biegusiem.pl group, the event offers two distances: 1,963 meters and 5 kilometers. The run starts at 11:00, giving participants the opportunity to honor the soldiers’ memory while running along a scenic route near Zalesie. The event is open to runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Two distances to choose from: 1,963 m and 5 km
Route near Zalesie, close to Ryki
A run commemorating the Cursed Soldiers and their historical legacy
additional: The run is organized by the Ryki Municipality, the Ryki branch of the World Association of Home Army Soldiers named after Marian Bernaciak “Orlik,” and the biegusiem.pl group. The event is commemorative and patriotic in nature. A sample consent form for minors is available. Information about the run is published on its Facebook event page. The start and finish are in Zalesie, near Ryki. Information about the 2027 edition in Zalesie, including local distances and registration, has not been confirmed in available sources.

name: Bieg Niezłomnych
description: The Bieg Niezłomnych in memory of Major Zenon Wechmann is an annual running event held in the Babki Forest District in Luboń, in the so-called Lasek Majoński. The event is open to different age groups, from young children to adults, with distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest participants to 5 km for older runners, as well as a Nordic walking event. It has a family-friendly, inclusive atmosphere and promotes physical activity and remembrance of heroes. Participant numbers are limited to ensure comfort and safety during the event.
course_highlights: Routes run through the scenic Babki Forest District (Lasek Majoński)
Distances for different age groups range from 250 m to 5 km
Separate children’s races, as well as races and a Nordic walking event for adults
additional: Participant limits: 100 children in the children’s races and 200 participants in total across the 1963 m race, 5 km race and Nordic walking event. Starts are scheduled from 10:30 to 12:30, divided by age category and distance. The minimum age for the 1963 m race is 14; for the 5 km race and Nordic walking event, it is 16. Fees depend on the distance and registration date.

name: Bieg Pamięci Żołnierzy Wyklętych
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Sportowa 3, Kamieńsk, Poland
organizer: Gmina Kamieńsk i Stowarzyszenie Aktywni Kamieńsk
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run is an annual sports and patriotic event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, held in Kamieńsk. The route starts at the Municipal Stadium at 3 Sportowa Street. The event brings families together and offers an opportunity to pay tribute to KWP soldiers who fought for Poland’s independence. Before the 14:30 start of the ceremony, flowers are laid and candles are lit at the monument to Stanisław Sojczyński, nom de guerre Warszyc. The race is scheduled to start at 15:00.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Kamieńsk
Patriotic run commemorating the Cursed Soldiers
Pre-race ceremony at the monument to Stanisław Sojczyński, nom de guerre Warszyc
additional: The race is limited to 100 participants. The event is organized jointly with the Aktywni Kamieńsk Association. At 14:30, flowers are laid and candles are lit at the monument before the race. The organizer’s information concerns the 2026 edition, so the program, registration, and route details for February 28, 2027, have not been confirmed. In 2026, the race was scheduled to start at 15:00, preceded by a ceremony in which flowers were laid and candles were lit at the monument to Stanisław Sojczyński, nom de guerre Warszyc.

name: Biegi Hrabiego
location: Kosina, Łańcut County, Podkarpackie Voivodeship, Poland
description: Biegi Hrabiego is a series of mountain races held in the scenic surroundings of Kosina and Łańcut. Participants can choose from distances ranging from 10 km to over 70 km, running along well-marked hiking trails with numerous aid stations. The courses feature varied elevation and beautiful views, and the organizers provide transport to the start and professional timing. The event is for runners seeking adventure and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The courses follow well-marked hiking trails
Beautiful views and varied elevation, from approximately 290 m to 664 m
Several aid stations along the route with food in sealed packaging
additional: Participants are transported by bus from the MOSiR parking lot to the start of each race. Mandatory equipment includes a race number, timing chip, charged phone with the coordinator’s number, a cup or bottle for drinks (no disposable cups are provided at aid stations), a bottle or soft flask with a minimum capacity of 0.5 l, and an NRC emergency blanket. The participant limit for most distances is 140. Time limits depend on the distance—for example, 4 hours for 20 km, 6 hours for 35 km, and 8 hours for 50 km. Bus transport to the start is organized for the Mały Panicz race; participants should bring their own cup or bottle. This information applies to the 10 km distance.

name: I Uliczny Bieg i Marsz Pamięci Żołnierzy...
Kołobrzeska Odysea
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Nadmorscy Biegacze oraz Seaside Park Hotel Kołobrzeg
description: Kołobrzeska Odysea is a new race series in Kołobrzeg, bringing together three races held by the Baltic Sea over the course of a year. Participants can take part in a half marathon, a marathon or a 10 km race, earning three unique medals that form a single design. The event offers not only sporting excitement, but also beautiful coastal views and a unique atmosphere. The organizers provide full sanitary facilities, professional timing, attractive prizes and refreshments for finishers. Kołobrzeska Odysea is an event for runners who appreciate sport and the atmosphere of a seaside town.
course_highlights: Half marathon along the Baltic coast — 21.0975 km
Marathon or 10 km race — 42.195 km or 10 km
Beautiful views of coastal Kołobrzeg
additional: Participants receive three unique medals that form a single design. After the races, a finisher zone is available with a hot meal, snacks, isotonic drinks and water. An awards gala is held at Seaside Park Hotel* and includes a quiz and prizes. Full sanitary facilities are provided: bag drop, changing rooms, showers and toilets. Special accommodation discounts at Seaside Park Hotel* are available during the event. The organizers promise professional timing, food and drinks in the finisher zone, prizes and a gala at Seaside Park Hotel. Available sources describe the 2026 edition and do not confirm a race on the stated date of February 28, 2027.

name: Prusice biegają
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Prusicach
description: Prusice Biegają is a series of races organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Centre in Prusice, bringing together residents of all ages—from the youngest to adults. In the 14th edition, runners compete across four stages of the overall standings and receive a medal at the end for completing the entire series. Children can take part in the special “Prusice Biegają od Małego” category, combining sporting fun with their first race-day excitement and a medal at the finish. The event is about more than running: it also offers shared cheering and a great atmosphere in Prusice.
course_highlights: Four stages in the overall standings
Special category for the youngest participants: “Prusice Biegają od Małego”
Medal for completing the entire series
additional: The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and encourages participation with family and friends. It is about more than competition, with shared cheering and a friendly atmosphere. Participants who complete the entire series and children in the younger category receive medals. In the previous edition, medals were planned for completing the entire series, including for children.

name: Sielska Piątka
description: Sielska Piątka is a 5 km race held in Lublin. The event is part of the wide range of running events organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which promotes physical activity and social integration through sport. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of the Lublin Village Museum, allowing participants to enjoy both sporting competition and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all abilities to test themselves and experience the spirit of the running community.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
The course runs through the grounds of the Lublin Village Museum
Picturesque, peaceful surroundings ideal for recreation
additional: The race is organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which has promoted physical culture and the development of sport in the Lublin region since 2011. Lublin is one of Poland’s most running-friendly cities, and Sielska Piątka is one of many races held there. The race starts at 09:00.

name: Sopocki Bieg Inki
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie (MOSiR)
description: The Sopot “Inka” Run commemorates Danuta Siedzikówna “Inka” and is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Sopot under the patronage of the Mayor of Sopot. The event takes place as part of the National Day of Remembrance of the “Cursed Soldiers” and is symbolic, with no timing. Participants complete a running distance of their choice, and each receives a commemorative medal. After the run, attendees sing soldiers’ songs together and share food from a field kitchen, creating a unique atmosphere of remembrance and fellowship.
course_highlights: A run commemorating Danuta Siedzikówna “Inka”
No timing—the tribute is more important than the result
Group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen
additional: The run is not timed. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. After the run, there is group singing of soldiers’ songs and food served from a field kitchen. In previous editions, participants received a commemorative medal; after the run, there was group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen. Details of the edition on 28 February 2027 are not confirmed by available sources.

name: VIII Tropem Wilczym
location: Leśna Altana, Osiedle Bór, Skarżysko-Kamienna, Poland
description: The 8th Skarżysko edition of the nationwide Tropem Wilczym Run is an annual event held on the first Sunday of March in Skarżysko-Kamienna. The run pays tribute to the Cursed Soldiers and combines athletic competition with historical remembrance. Organized by the Aktywisko and Kultura Sportu associations, the event takes place at the City Gazebo in the Bór district. It is a special opportunity to honor the heroes and spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the City Gazebo in the Bór district of Skarżysko-Kamienna
The event combines athletic competition with a tribute to the Cursed Soldiers
An annual edition held on the first Sunday of March
additional: The Tropem Wilczym Run is organized by the Aktywisko and Kultura Sportu associations. The event runs from 08:30 to 13:15. The start and finish are at the City Gazebo in the Bór district of Skarżysko-Kamienna. The source describes the 8th edition as a 2026 event; details about the edition on February 28, 2027, have not been confirmed.

name: XIV Bieg Pamięci Żołnierzy Wyklętych
description: The “Tropem Wilczym” Run in Memory of the Cursed Soldiers in Kluczbork combines running with commemorating the Cursed Soldiers. The 14th edition was announced at the Provincial Training Centre. The running calendar lists a distance of 10 km, but the date of this edition and event details require confirmation from the organizer.

10 km distance according to the running calendar
A run commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, organized as part of the Tropem Wilczym initiative
additional: Available information about the 14th edition concerns the run announced for March 1, 2026; the calendar gives March 1, 2027 as an approximate date, not February 28.

name: XIV Bieg Tropem Wilczym
location: MOSiR przy Parku Miejskim, ul. Parkowa, Lubartów, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Lubartowie we współpracy ze Stowarzyszeniem „Aktywny Lubartów” (poprzednia edycja)
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run is an annual sports and educational event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, held since 2013. Its 15th edition will take place in 2027, bringing together sport, history, and local communities across Poland and beyond. A distinctive feature of the run is the symbolic distance of 1,963 metres, referring to the year of the death of Józef Franczak, known by the alias “Lalek.” The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or running experience. Many locations also host additional runs, Nordic Walking marches, and family activities.
course_highlights: A symbolic 1,963-metre distance commemorating the year of Józef Franczak, known as “Lalek,” died
An event combining sport with historical education and local community involvement
Additional runs, Nordic Walking marches, and family activities in many locations
additional: The event takes place on 28 February 2027. Local organisers decide the scale of the event, additional distances, and accompanying activities. Schools hold a separate edition of the “Tropem Wilczym at School” project on 1 March 2027; it is free and intended for students. Previous editions have featured history meetings, historical reenactment groups, exhibitions, and family activities. In the previous edition, the start and finish were on Parkowa Street, by MOSiR. The local programme and registration for 2027 have not been confirmed in the available sources.

The event takes place in the evening and is part of a series of gatherings organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. It’s a great opportunity to spend time together outdoors and connect with others.

An evening edition of the Active Czerwonak at Night series

Participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels, allowing them to prepare optimally for the start. The event is part of Poland’s night-race calendar, attracting runners from across the country.

10 km night race
Held in Częstochowa, Silesian Voivodeship

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route near the forests and the Łyna River, close to Ruś. Winter weather is no obstacle to staying active—the crisp air and forest paths create a unique atmosphere for running. It’s a great opportunity to regularly test your fitness, enjoy the excitement of competition, and spend time outdoors. The organizers make things comfortable for participants by offering passes for the whole series as well as the option to enter a single race.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish on the beach at a bend in the Łyna River in Stawiguda municipality
Varied forest terrain and natural winter conditions
additional: Children’s Mini Trail!ON races over distances from 300 m to 1,000 m, depending on age. Participants can buy a pass for all four races or enter a single race. Single-race entry can also be purchased at the race office on race day. At the final race, winners will be presented with awards, followed by a communal bonfire with the Mayor. Pass holders use the same race number throughout the series and must bring it to every race. The programme also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m, and 1,000 m. Online registration is open until 3 March 2027; cold-water immersion is also planned.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn Forest Parking, Łyse Lake, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter running tournament consisting of a series of four running events and Nordic Walking walks, held on forest tracks and trails in the forests along the Warta River. The events offer half-marathon (21.3 km) and marathon (42.6 km) distances, as well as Nordic Walking walks over the half-marathon distance. This is a small-scale event for both recreational and professional athletes, featuring themed races and seasonal touches. The start and race office are located by Lake Łyse, next to the Łysy Młyn forest car park in Biedrusko. The gun start for each race is at 10:00.
course_highlights: The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with some paved sections and slippery surfaces depending on the weather.
The half-marathon is one 21.3 km loop with 110 m of total elevation gain; the marathon is two loops, covering 42.6 km in total.
The course is marked with red-and-white tape and signs for the “Łysy Młyn” running trail, and passes, among other places, a landmark oak and stream cascades.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. During the 2026/2027 winter season, races and walks over 5 km and 10 km distances are also held. Each race has a theme, with suggested outfits and touches. The course is not officially certified; it is measured using bicycle computers and a Garmin. The start and event centre are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, beside Lake Łyse, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00; race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. Free parking is available, and the venue can also be reached by bus.

name: IX Chwaszczyńska 10
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. A. Mickiewicza, Chwaszczyno, Poland
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej, Fundacja Aktywne Kaszuby oraz Sołectwo Chwaszczyno
description: The 9th Chwaszczyno 10 is a 10 km race and the prologue to the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event takes place in Chwaszczyno. In 2026, due to snowy conditions, the course was changed to a temporary 5 km loop with a hard surface of asphalt and jombo slabs. The event also includes shorter races for children and young people, which are free and do not require advance registration. After the main races, the winners are presented with their awards and prizes are drawn. The organizers prioritize participants’ safety and comfort by adapting the course to current conditions.
course_highlights: The 10 km race consists of two laps of a 5 km loop
Hard surface: asphalt and jombo slabs
Additional races for children and young people over 100 m, 300 m and 600 m
additional: The race office and bag drop open at 08:30 in the sports hall. The children’s races start by the blue inflatable arch. A post-race recovery snack is provided after the 10 km race. The winners’ presentation takes place at 12:40 in the sports hall. Prizes are drawn at 13:10; participants must be present with their race number. The entry package limit for the main races has been reached, and registration is closed. The available details concern the 2026 edition, not a confirmed 9th edition scheduled for 2027. Previous editions also included 5 km races and children’s races.

name: Letecká stovka
description: Letecká Stovka is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike covering 106 km with +3,590 m of elevation gain. It takes place in the Považský Inovec and Strážovské vrchy mountains. The start and finish are in Trenčín, and the route runs mainly along marked hiking trails. It is ITRA-certified. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League and is also a qualifying race for the 2028 Western States Endurance Run. It is organized by o.z. SLOVAK ULTRA TRAIL, an ITRA member since 2015. The race is open to individuals aged 18 and over; participants aged 17 may also take part if accompanied by a legal guardian.

name: XIV Grand Prix Krakowa
organizer: Grand Prix Krakowa w Biegach Górskich
description: The Kraków Mountain Running Grand Prix is a series of mountain races held in Kraków, offering a range of distances from 3.7 km to 23.2 km, as well as a Vertical race. The event attracts runners of varying abilities, including children and seniors, and also features team and additional classifications. The courses have varied profiles and are suitable for training outside the racing season. This is the 15th anniversary edition, combining sporting competition with the beauty of Kraków’s natural areas.
course_highlights: Distances: 3.7 km, 5.7 km, 11.6 km, 23.2 km, and a 1.5 km Vertical race
Varied mountain-running terrain in Kraków
Special races for children, plus team and additional classifications
additional: The entry limit for each individual race is 100 people per distance. Discounts are available for children, young people up to 18 years old, and seniors aged 65+. The series includes team classifications, a uniformed services competition, relays, and special passes for 5 races. Races start at different times on Sundays, with the first start at 09:00. The materials provided do not confirm that the date 7 March 2027 is for the 14th edition; information about the 2026–2027 series refers to the 15th edition.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity, on Spokojna Street in Gdynia. The races take place in forests and urban parks, combining a city atmosphere with contact with nature. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in the overall and local standings. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and also offers races for children and young people.

Location in the Gdańsk Forest District and around the Mały Kack estate in Gdynia
Races take place in the natural setting of the Tricity Landscape Park
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race bibs and chips can be collected on race day. The schedule includes the main race starting at 11:00 and CITY TRAIL Junior races for children in different age categories. A pass for the entire series also includes one free race in a city other than the main location, provided participants notify the organizers by email in advance. Register online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. The race starts at 11:00.

A fast course suited to achieving good times
An evening race amid the city’s illuminations

Participants can choose between two distances, 5 km and 10 km, on scenic routes around Plac Wielkiej Armii Napoleona and Wawel. The run promotes women’s solidarity and physical activity, offering participants race shirts and commemorative medals. The event attracts an increasing number of women runners, creating a unique atmosphere of sporting competition and support.
course_highlights: The route runs through central Kraków, around Plac Wielkiej Armii Napoleona and Wawel
Two distances to choose from: 5 km and 10 km
Scenic urban surroundings with historic views

In addition to the overall standings, age categories and a “Team Matka - Córka” (Mother-Daughter Team) classification are planned for pairs running the 5 km. Every participant receives a race shirt and a commemorative medal after finishing within the time limit. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and women’s strength, while bringing participants together in an atmosphere of joy and support. It includes a 5 km main race, a Nordic walking event and mini-races for younger participants. The organizers provide a varied program of accompanying activities, partner zones and attractions for the whole family.

The event is open to all, with overall classifications for women and men in the 21 km and 10 km races, and for the 10 km Nordic Walking event. The half marathon is scheduled to start at 10:00, and the event supports a charitable cause. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and help those in need.
course_highlights: Main half marathon: 21 km
Accompanying run: 10 km
Nordic Walking: 10 km, plus family runs: 2.3 km

Overall OPEN classifications for women and men apply to the 21 km and 10 km runs and the 10 km Nordic Walking event. In the 2026 edition, the half marathon started at 10:00, the 10 km run and Nordic Walking at 10:30, and the family events at 11:00. The information provided concerns the 2026 edition and does not confirm details for the 2027 edition.

name: Legendarna Piątka Legendarna Dycha
description: The Legendary Five and Legendary Ten are exciting races held as part of the Toruń Legends Trilogy, taking place in the picturesque Old Town Market Square in Toruń. The events combine professional organization with a friendly, family atmosphere, offering participants fast courses with nationwide appeal. They are a great opportunity to take on the 5 km and 10 km distances while enjoying the beauty of Toruń’s Old Town and its local attractions.
course_highlights: The course runs through Toruń’s Old Town Market Square
Fast and exciting 5 km and 10 km distances
The race takes place in the historic city center, with views of UNESCO-listed landmarks
additional: Children’s races are held at every edition; in March, they take place alongside the main race. Online registration for the first edition of the Trilogy is open until March 1, 2026. After that date, registration is possible only at the race office. The organizer provides professional support and a friendly atmosphere. Available sources describe the edition on March 8, 2026, and do not confirm details of the event planned for March 7, 2027.

name: Piątka dla Kobiet
organizer: Miejskie Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Jaworznie
description: Piątka dla Kobiet is a special sporting event held to celebrate International Women’s Day at OWR Sosina in Jaworzno. Participants can choose between a competitive 5 km run with age-group classifications and a 5 km Nordic walking event for those who prefer a recreational pace. The event is free and offers a great opportunity to celebrate Women’s Day actively. The run is limited to 200 participants and the walk to 150. The run starts at 11:00 and the walk at 11:15.

Age-group classifications in the run: K16 (ages 16–35), K36 (ages 36–49), K50 (ages 50 and over)
Course at OWR Sosina in Jaworzno

In previous editions, the run was open to women over the age of 16. The rules, fees, and participant limits for 2027 have not been confirmed.

description: Run 4 Her Klimkówka is a charity race organized to celebrate Women’s Day. It takes place beside the picturesque Lake Klimkówka, at Czarna Chata LUXURY RESORT. Participants can choose between two distances, 5 km and 10 km, on a gently graded asphalt course suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. After the race, participants can enjoy a concert by the band Krucabanda and compete for attractive prizes, including the grand prize: a weekend stay for two at Czarna Chata. The event combines sporting competition with a charitable mission and the promotion of the Low Beskids region.
course_highlights: Gently graded asphalt course with minimal elevation gain (15 m over 5 km; 30 m over 10 km)
Scenic paths beside Lake Klimkówka
5 km (1 loop) and 10 km (2 loops)
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:45 at Czarna Chata LUXURY RESORT. There is no parking at Czarna Chata; parking is available beside the Water Sports Centre (about a 600 m walk). The race pack includes a clothing bag, vouchers for a hot meal and tea, a commemorative T-shirt, and gifts from local municipalities. Electronic timing and medical support are provided. A concert by the band Krucabanda follows the race. Cash and in-kind prizes are awarded to the top women and men in both distances, and prizes are raffled among all participants. In the 2026 edition, the start, finish, and race office were at Czarna Chata LUXURY RESORT in Klimkówka; a concert by the band Krucabanda was announced after the race. This information refers to the previous edition and may not apply in 2027.

name: XRUN Tajemnicze Kopce
description: XRUN Tajemnicze Kopce is a mountain trail race held in the picturesque Glichowiec Range near Dobczyce. Runners can choose from several distances, from short children’s races to the demanding 32 km Long Trail with 1,100 m of elevation gain. The route passes through dense forests, technical climbs, ravines and winding forest trails, with the finish at Hotel Dobczyce. It’s a unique opportunity to experience the spirit of XRUN and take on natural mountain terrain.
course_highlights: A mountain crossing of the Glichowiec Range, with technical climbs and descents
The Long Trail covers the loop via Kacza Góra, Trupielec and Glichowiec twice
The final kilometres pass through Stare Miasto and the Dobczyce Dam before finishing at Hotel Dobczyce
additional: The start and finish for all distances are at Hotel Dobczyce. The time limit is 6 hours for the Long Trail (32 km), 4 hours for the Classic Trail (21 km) and 14 km, and 2 hours for the 6 km race. Age categories for the children’s races cover ages 3 to 15. Routes include natural forest trails, technical sections and fast descents. The time limits for the 32, 21 and 14 km distances are 6, 4 and 4 hours respectively; the limit for 6 km is 2 hours. The children’s races cover distances of 150, 300, 500, 800 and 1,000 m.

name: XVIII Bieg Kazików
description: The 18th Kaziki Run is an annual street-running celebration in Radom, attracting both recreational and experienced runners. The 10 km route runs through the city centre, offering a demanding race with a fast pace from the start. The event combines sport, community engagement and charitable activities, making it an important fixture in the region’s sporting calendar.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through the centre of Radom
A fast-paced, demanding race from the first metres
A road race with a history and sporting tradition
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Radom City Hall, 53 Żeromskiego Street. The organisers provide race shirts and medals for participants. The event also includes races for children and young people, as well as charitable activities. It brings residents together and promotes outdoor physical activity. The previous edition, the 18th Kaziki Run, took place on 8 March 2026; available sources do not confirm details of the edition planned for 2027.

name: Radebeuler Wintercross
distance_verbose: 10 km, 8.7 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.1 km, 3000 Meter, 0.8 km

name: Frauenseelauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 15 km, 12 km, 11.5 km, 10 km, 8 km, 7.2 km, 5 km

name: Úpická desítka
description: The Úpice Ten is a traditional 10 km road race held in Úpice. The course is accurately measured, flat, and follows an asphalt road from the town centre towards Havlovice and into the Ratibořické Valley before returning. The race is suitable for the general public, including juniors, who may take part with the race director’s approval. After the race, results are announced at the Municipal Hall in Úpice, with cash prizes for the top finishers in the adult categories.
course_highlights: Accurately measured 10 km course
Flat asphalt road
Start and finish in front of the Municipal Hall in Úpice
additional: Children’s categories have no entry fee and can register only on site. Juniors (born in 2009–2010) may take part in the main race with the race director’s approval. Registration takes place until 12:00 for children and until 12:30 for juniors and adults. Results are announced at 15:00 at the Municipal Hall in Úpice. The race follows athletics and road traffic regulations, and participants take part at their own risk. Registration is available online and on site. The race takes place on an asphalt road, weather permitting. Categories are available for children and adults, and category winners receive prizes.

name: Majcichovská desiatka
location: Majcichov Municipal Office, Majcichov, Trnava District, Slovakia

name: Pomerania Winter Trail
description: Pomerania Winter Trail is a winter trail race held in the scenic area of Szemud. The course follows varied forest paths and natural terrain, offering runners a challenge and a chance to connect with nature. The event is part of the Pomerania Sports series, known for its professional organization and friendly atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity for trail-running enthusiasts who want to test their endurance in winter conditions.
course_highlights: Forest paths and natural terrain
Winter running conditions
Scenic area of Szemud
additional: The available information gives the 2027 edition date as February 21, not February 27.

name: Cytadela by Night # 112
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed runs held in Cytadela Park in Poznań. The runs cover a distance of approximately 5 km and attract both recreational and more experienced runners. The event combines recreation and sport, offering a great opportunity to spend an active evening in the park’s scenic surroundings. It is very popular and held regularly, creating a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: The run takes place in Cytadela Park in Poznań
Approximately 5 km with timekeeping
An evening route through scenic, green surroundings
additional: The runs are free and held regularly, with timekeeping. The event is recreational and open to everyone. Timed run.

name: XXXVII tradicinis bėgimas „Obeliskas A. Kulviečiui – Jonava“
location: Jonava, Jonava District Municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The traditional “Obeliskas A. Kulviečiui - Jonava” race is a Lithuanian Running Cup event held in Jonava. It invites recreational and professional runners to take part in various distances, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting spirit. The race is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup, which includes several stages across the country. The event is organised by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė to promote running and encourage people to take part in competitions regularly.
course_highlights: More than 1,100 participants from Lithuania and abroad
Traditional distances: 2 km and 15 km
Events and concerts commemorating March 11
additional: Registrations are administered and entry fees collected by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another participant no later than the closing of advance registration; a fee of 10 euros applies. The first race stage starts at 08:00. The event is a Lithuanian Running Cup stage and offers awards and a photo gallery. Runners of all age groups are invited to participate.

name: Bėgimas „Pamario taurė“
location: Šilutė, Šilutės rajonas, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lietuva

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registracija NEMOKAMA, atidaroma 2026 m. vasario 10 d., sustabdoma 2026 m. kovo 8 d., 22.00 val.

description: The “Pamario Cup” run is a traditional event in Šilutė, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and popularizing running. The event is organized by Šilutė District Municipality together with local sports organizations. Participants are invited to run various distances, including a 400 m children’s course in the city center by the municipality. The event has a friendly atmosphere and aims to bring together both local residents and visitors.
course_highlights: Start by Šilutė District Municipality
Children’s course – 400 m in the city center
Participants run with electronic timing
additional: Race bibs are distributed on race day by Šilutė Cultural Center and on March 10 at the reception desk of Šilutė Leisure and Sports Center. Children participating in the run may be accompanied by one parent or guardian. Each participant must attach their bib, which contains an electronic timing chip, to the front of their shirt. The event takes place in Šilutė and is often associated with Lithuania’s Independence Day; it has about 500 participants, offers various distances, and awards prizes.

name: 2026 metų Kovo 11-osios bėgimas, skirtas Lietuvos Nepriklausomybės atkūrimo dienai paminėti
location: Gargždų kultūros centras, Gargždai, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lithuania
price_range: nemokamai iki IV grupės, 4-5 eurai vėlesnėms grupėms

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: I-III grupės dalyviai ir pensininkai - nemokamai

description: The 2026 March 11 Run is dedicated to commemorating Lithuania’s Restoration of Independence Day and aims to encourage the public to take part in sports and identify the strongest runners in various age groups. The event takes place near Gargždai Cultural Centre, and participants can choose from different distances according to their age and fitness level. The run is open to everyone, with participants starting in groups between 10:00 and 10:30. This traditional event promotes physical activity and brings the community together to mark an important date.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Gargždai Cultural Centre
Different distances from 1.3 km to 14.3 km, according to age group
The course consists of laps, with the number run determined by age group
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:45 to 9:30. Participants start in two groups: Groups I–III at 10:00, and Groups IV–V at 10:30. Registration is online only and closes on March 10 at 20:00. Participants may not be accompanied by bicycles or other vehicles during the run; directional markers will be placed along the course. Various race courses, online registration, awards, traffic management during the event.

name: IV Ultra Kocioł
description: IV Ultra Kocioł is an ultramarathon in Świdwin, previously held as the Ultramarathon Along the Świdwin Kocioł Trail. In the previous edition, participants covered 60 km through the area around the Świdwin Kocioł in the central part of Western Pomerania. The race combines a long distance with a historical theme.
course_highlights: A 60 km ultramarathon course, according to information about the previous edition
A race in the area around the Świdwin Kocioł
Świdwin and the central part of Western Pomerania

name: XIV Zimowy Bieg Dębowy
location: Zespół Szkół, ul. Sportowa, Dąbrowa, Gmina Dąbrowa, Poland
description: The Winter Oak Run is an annual sporting event held since 2012. It attracts an ever-growing number of participants and is an important sporting event in Mogilno County. The race promotes physical activity among people of all ages and is part of the Mogilno County Crown series. The main race route passes through the villages of Dąbrowa, Parlin and Parlinek, and runs on asphalt certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The organizers warmly invite everyone to take part and celebrate their passion for sport together.
course_highlights: Route certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Asphalt surface with markers every kilometer
Water stations along the route in Parlin and Parlinek
additional: The start and finish are by the school sports field of the School Complex in Dąbrowa, ul. Sportowa. The event includes children's races over distances from 60 m to 1,000 m and a 7.5 km Nordic walking event. Electronic timing. Awards ceremonies and prize drawings take place in the sports hall in Dąbrowa. The race office is open from 07:00; registration closes at 10:45. The start and finish are by the School Complex sports field on ul. Sportowa; the race office is in the sports hall. The race pack includes, among other things, a medal, a hot meal and an SMS with the result. Registration is open until 3 March 2027; there is no race-day registration or fee.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Boisko w Lesie Osobowickim, Wrocław, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful woodland settings in city parks. The Wrocław event takes place in Osobowicki Forest, with the start and finish located by the sports field. The races are open to runners of different ages and ability levels, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The series is held regularly, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings. The course remains unchanged, allowing runners to compare their results over the years.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the woodland setting of Osobowicki Forest
Start and finish by the sports field in Osobowicki Forest
A course suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The main race is open to participants aged 16 and over. It is not possible to drive directly to the start or race office; parking is available along Osobowicka Street, with traffic management in place. CITY TRAIL Junior races over shorter distances also take place on race day. A group warm-up before the main race starts at 10:45. The event follows a fixed schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. The start is scheduled for 11:00. Registration is available online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. Driving near the start and race office is not possible; parking is available along Osobowicka Street.

name: 1 Gibko Piątka
description: Gibko Piątka is a fast 5 km race on a PZLA-certified course, held in Frydek, Miedźna Municipality. The course is flat with minimal elevation gain, making it ideal for both beginner runners and those looking to improve their personal best. The event also includes the Wartki Bajtel run for children and young people up to 16 years old, divided into three age groups, offering an appropriate level of competition and plenty of fun. The event attracts hundreds of runners and is a great opportunity for sporting competition and a good time.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 5 km course
Flat and fast course with minimal elevation gain
Course ideal for a personal best
additional: The event includes the Wartki Bajtel run for children and young people up to 16 years old, divided into three age groups (3–6, 7–10, and 11–16 years). The awards ceremony is planned after the race, and the race office is on site. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. Registration is open until race day. The cited sources refer to the first edition on 14 March 2026; they do not confirm details of the edition scheduled for 13 March 2027.

name: 42 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kuropatnik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej (PTTK Strzelin)
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is an orienteering event on foot in which teams of 2–5 plan their own route to visit as many checkpoints as possible within a set time. The checkpoints are spread across the terrain and marked on a map. The event is open to participants of different ages and experience levels, from enthusiasts to those taking part for recreation. Rogaining combines tourism and sport and is an excellent way to enjoy the outdoors. Organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin Land Branch, it has a long tradition and is popular among orienteering enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Teams travel on foot only, using a map and compass to navigate the terrain
Checkpoints have different point values depending on how difficult they are to find
Participants can choose and change their own route, of any length from around 5 km to 70 km
additional: The event takes place in teams of 2–5. Each team independently decides the order in which to visit checkpoints and which checkpoints to visit. Rogaining is open to all age groups and genders. The event combines tourism and sport and is also attractive to families. Night rogaining events have also been held in the past. Strzeliński Rogaining is contested in teams of 2–5; checkpoints have different point values, and the route is covered on foot.

name: Baran Trail Races
organizer: Michał Loska, Piotr Winter, MWC sp. z o.o. i Gmina Węgierska Górka
description: Baran Trail Race is a mountain running event taking place on March 13, 2027, in Węgierska Górka. Runners can choose from several distances, including 10 km, 25 km, and 60 km, with substantial elevation gain and challenging mountain terrain in the Silesian Beskids. The 10 km course is a loop with numerous climbs and descents, following scenic trails, including a section of the Main Beskid Trail. The race is officially scored in the ITRA and UTMB systems, highlighting its competitive nature and endurance challenge.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is an 11-kilometer loop with approximately 550 m of elevation gain
A section of the course follows the Main Beskid Trail (red trail)
Varied terrain: narrow, muddy paths, asphalt descents, and scenic sections
additional: There are no aid stations on the 10 km course. The intermediate time limit for the 25 km race is 5 hours, at the sports hall in Węgierska Górka. Mandatory equipment includes, among other items, a switched-on and charged phone with emergency numbers and the organizer’s number saved, a visible race bib, and a chip attached to the shoe. There are no disposable cups at the aid stations. Navigation using the latest GPX file is recommended; supplementary course markings are permitted in accordance with the regulations. Registration is scheduled to open on October 13, 2026. BTR 25 is a UTMB Index 20K category race and awards 1 ITRA point; BTR 60 is a UTMB Index 50K category race and awards 3 ITRA points. BTR 60 has an intermediate time limit of 5 hours at the 25th kilometer. The organizer recommends using the latest GPX file for navigation.

name: III Beskidzkie Grónie Zima
description: Beskidzkie Grónie Zima is a winter mountain race held in the picturesque town of Istebna. Participants can choose from three routes of different lengths: Rodzinna 15 km, Beskidzkie Grónie 30 km, and Beskidzkie Grónie 50 km. The routes wind through the varied mountain terrain of the Beskids, offering both challenging trails and beautiful views. The event is part of the Beskidzkie Grónie series and is growing in popularity among mountain running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The routes cross the varied mountain terrain of the Beskids
Three distances available: 15 km, 30 km, and 50 km
Picturesque views and natural winter trail conditions
additional: The routes are available to download in GPX format. The event is available in the UTRA app, which provides easy access to event information. It includes three distances of varying difficulty to suit runners of different experience levels. This is a mountain hiking event, not a race. The family route has an elevation gain of approximately 410 m and a time limit of 7 hours.

name: IX Cross Maraton Jana Kulbaczyńskiego
description: The 9th Jan Kulbaczyński Cross Marathon is a marathon held in picturesque Kodeń, in the Masovian Voivodeship. The event takes place on Sunday, March 14, 2027, and offers an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately difficult course. The organizers provide training plans tailored to different experience levels, helping participants prepare optimally for the start. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running and athletic development.
course_highlights: A marathon course measuring 42.195 km
A moderately difficult cross-country run
Picturesque landscapes of Kodeń and the surrounding area
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels, with instructions and expert support. You can manage the race listing and arrange marketing cooperation through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: Ladies & Gentlemen

price_tiers.distance: Bieg 5 km i 10 km oraz Nordic Walking 5 km

description: The Ladies & Gentlemen Run 2026 will take place on March 14 in Kabaty Forest in Warsaw as part of the Warsaw Grand Prix. This running event gives participants the opportunity to compete over different distances, with age and gender categories. The race office is located in Kabaty, and the different distances will start at different times. The organizer provides a race pack, a commemorative medal, and prizes for the top finishers and oldest participants.
course_highlights: Routes in Kabaty Forest—natural forest paths
5 km and 10 km races, plus 5 km Nordic walking
Time limits: 60 minutes for the 5 km run and 80 minutes for the 10 km run
additional: The race office opens at 09:00 in the clearing next to the Kabaty Metro Technical Depot. Race bibs will be distributed only on race day. A special trophy will be awarded to the oldest male and female participants, along with recognition for the funniest outfit. Prizes will be awarded in the overall standings and age categories, separately for women and men. 120 participants took part in the race.

name: Mistrzostwa Polski Masters w Biegach Prz...
description: The Polish Masters Cross Country Championships is a national competition for masters runners, scheduled for March 14, 2026, in Toruń. The races will take place in Rudelka Park, next to the Kujawsko-Pomorska Arena. It is an opportunity to compete in cross-country running and meet masters athletes from across Poland.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Rudelka Park
Rudelka Park is next to the Kujawsko-Pomorska Arena
The competition takes place in Toruń
additional: The competition is scheduled for Saturday, March 14, 2026.

name: Odlotowa 5 - Olsztyn Mazury
description: Odlotowa 5 - Olsztyn Mazury is a 5 km race held in the scenic area around Olsztyn-Mazury Airport in Szymany. The event takes place annually and attracts runners of various age groups, offering a friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The course is fast and accessible to runners of varying experience levels. Participants can expect efficient service and the option to collect their race packs on race day or the day before.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Start and finish at Olsztyn-Mazury Airport in Szymany
Fast, flat course conducive to good results
additional: Race packs can be collected at the race office in Szczytno on 22.03.2025 or in Szymany on 23.03.2025. Authorization is required to collect a race pack, as is parental consent for minors. Olsztyn-Mazury Airport co-organized the 2026 edition. Sources for that edition stated a limit of 600 participants and a 60-minute time limit for the 5 km distance; it has not been confirmed whether these rules will apply in 2027.

name: Run in Sopot - III
location: Beach by Sopot Pier, entrance no. 23, Sopot, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie

description: Run in Sopot III is a 5 km beach race held by the Sopot pier. The start and finish are on the beach by the pier, and the course follows a scenic stretch along the coast. The race takes place in an intimate atmosphere, with the number of participants limited to 250 to ensure comfort and safety. The race is scheduled to start at 10:00, and participants line up in the designated starting area. The race is also open to Sopot residents with a Sopot Card and to people over 65, who have special participation terms.
course_highlights: A 5 km course on the beach by the Sopot pier
Start and finish on the beach by the pier
The race takes place in an intimate atmosphere, with a limited number of participants
additional: The participant limit is 250. People without a race number may not be on the course, except for people organizing the race. Participants line up in the designated starting area. Special pricing terms apply to Sopot residents with a Sopot Card and people over 65. The on-site entry fee is 99 PLN (or 0 PLN for people aged 65 and over). The limit is 250 participants. Information about Run in Sopot III confirms the edition scheduled for 14 March 2026; the date 13 March 2027 has not been confirmed.

name: Test Coopera - wiosna
description: The Cooper Test is a recurring run organized by the Mafia Team Sports Club in Lubliniec. This sporting event takes place in spring and autumn and is popular with local runners. The run is an endurance test, and its results are regularly published and archived by the organizers. The event is part of a wider series of runs organized by the club.
course_highlights: An endurance test with results measured in meters
Spring edition of the recurring Mafia Team event
Location: Lubliniec
additional: Results from previous editions are available in the organizer’s archive.

Deset jarních kilometrů
description: A spring running race in Kunčina near Moravská Třebová, now in its 11th year. The main race is 10 km on a rolling course (95% asphalt, with 400 m on a compacted dirt road), alongside a 3.8 km hobby race and children’s races from 40 to 919 m. The race is part of the Iscarex Cup.
additional:
Start times: children’s races at 13:00, hobby race at 15:00, main race at 15:05.
Race-day registration: children 11:30–12:30; 10 km and hobby races 12:00–14:00.
Entry fees in advance / on the day: 10 km 250 / 350 Kč, hobby 150 / 250 Kč, children 50 / 100 Kč.
Prizes of 1,000 Kč for the fastest man (under 35 min) and woman (under 40 min), and 2,000 Kč for a course record. Competitions for the best climber and sprinter via Strava.
Travel by train to Kunčina station. Online registration at desetjarnichkm.cz (registration opens in early November).
