name: 5. Pietrasze Cross Country 5/5
description: Pietrasze Cross Country is a series of cross-country races held in Pietrasze Forest in Białystok. The course follows natural, varied forest terrain, with numerous ascents and descents that require versatility and good fitness. The event attracts runners who value sporting competition in scenic surroundings and the chance to socialize in a sporting atmosphere. Organizers offer the option to purchase a pass for the entire series, making it easier to take part and encouraging regular starts.
course_highlights: A course approximately 7.83 km long with 109 m of elevation gain
A run on natural forest surfaces: leaf litter, grass, sand, mud, and puddles, depending on the weather
The course is marked with blue-and-white tape, with volunteers and cyclists acting as guides
additional: Race packets are distributed from 8:30 to 9:30 at Primary School No. 32 named after Maj. Henryk Dobrzański, alias Hubal, at 29 Pietrasze Street. After the start, there is a music event with refreshments (doughnuts and tea) and an opportunity to socialize. Starts take place in designated start zones, with officials verifying participants and checking race numbers. The course is available as a downloadable GPX file for GPS watch users.

name: BeMore5K
description: BeMore5K is a special 5 km race held in Bemowo, Warsaw. Its fast, officially certified course is ideal for setting a personal best, combining high-level competition with the joy of running. The event attracts both experienced runners and people just starting out, offering attractive prizes, cheering zones, and professional photo and video coverage. The race takes place in a spirit of community and motivation, encouraging participants to push their limits and draw inspiration from others’ achievements.
course_highlights: Fast, PZLA-certified 5 km course
Start and finish on the western carriageway of Powstańców Śląskich, beyond Górczewska
The route runs along Powstańców Śląskich and Radiowa, with a turnaround near the Stare Bemowo stop
additional: Participant limit: 3,000 race packages. T-shirt size can be changed after logging in to b4sportonline.pl. The start and finish area is close to a metro line. Open 5 km Championships in age categories in five-year increments. Race time limit until 12:00; winners’ awards ceremony at 12:15. Race office and race-package pickup at the Bemowo District Office on March 14 (14:00–20:00) and March 15 (09:00–10:30). Side event: sports EXPO and cheering zone. The official website lists the date as March 7, 2027, which conflicts with the March 14, 2027 date in the metadata. The 2026 edition had a 45-minute time limit and a participant limit of 3,000; these details may not apply to the 2027 edition.

name: Bieg Dnia Kobiet
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Orzyszu
price_range: Bezpłatny udział w edycji 2026; pamiątkowa koszulka za 30 zł
description: The Women’s Day Run in Orzysz is a recreational, community-oriented running event. A previous edition covered a symbolic distance of 2.5 km. The route followed sidewalks and unpaved roads, with the start and finish in Ogródek Jordanowski. The run was open to everyone, with no final rankings; participants received commemorative medals. Details of the edition scheduled for March 14, 2027, have not yet been confirmed in available sources.
course_highlights: A symbolic distance of 2.5 km in the previous edition
The route followed sidewalks and unpaved roads
Start and finish in Ogródek Jordanowski
additional: In the 2026 edition, participants received commemorative medals, and small prizes were raffled among them. No final rankings were kept.

name: Cross Śrem Grand Prix

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – przy zapisie online na jeden bieg

description: Cross Śrem Grand Prix is a cross-country running series held in the forested areas near the Orlik sports field in Psarskie, Śrem. The approximately 5.4 km course follows forest paths and paved sections, giving runners a chance to enjoy nature and a unique atmosphere of sporting competition. The start and finish are in the same location, making it easier to organize the event and cheer on the runners. Participants receive a medal, a post-race meal, and prizes in the age-group classifications. The event is organized by Śremski Sport together with the Municipality of Śrem and the Konstantynowo Forest District.
course_highlights: An approximately 5.4 km course on forest paths and paved sections
Start and finish at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie, in one convenient location for runners and spectators
A run surrounded by forest near the center of Śrem
additional: The race office, warm-up, and official opening take place at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie. The warm-up and opening are scheduled for around 11:45. Participants have access to water, hot tea, and coffee in the new building with changing rooms. A medal, a post-race meal, and prizes in the age-group classifications are provided. The start and finish are at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie. Information about the price and details of the edition scheduled for 14 March 2027 has not been confirmed by available sources.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful woodland surroundings. The Szczecin course is varied and located behind Zajazd Szmaragd, by Emerald Lake, with challenging uphill and downhill sections. The event is open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly check their results on the same course. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in woodland surroundings by Emerald Lake
Start and finish behind Zajazd Szmaragd, at the edge of Kopalniana Street
Varied sections with uphills and downhills, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the 11:00 start, there is a group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The event also includes races for children in different age categories. Races are held regularly during the season, from October to April. The start and finish are behind Zajazd Szmaragd on Kopalniana Street; the race office is next door. According to the official calendar, Szczecin has no race on 14 March 2027—the Szczecin race dates for the 2026/2027 season are 18 October, 15 November, 10 January and 4 April.

name: II Bieg Trzech Wież
description: The 2nd Three Towers Run in Biała is a unique sporting event held among the oldest historic landmarks in the Opole region. Following the success of the first edition, the organizers invite participants to the next edition, with new features including children’s categories that bring generations together. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km runs, or a 5 km Nordic walking event. The race package includes a hot meal, a race pack, a recovery bar, drinks, sports merchandise and a commemorative medal. Trophies and attractive prizes, including cash prizes, are planned for the top finishers.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km running routes in the historic surroundings of Biała
5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s categories bringing different generations together
additional: The race package includes a hot meal, a recovery bar, drinks, sports merchandise and a commemorative medal. Trophies and cash prizes are planned for the top finishers. The event takes place among the oldest historic landmarks in the Opole region. The children’s categories encourage whole families to take part. The 2026 edition program included races for children and young people; the race package included, among other things, a commemorative medal, a hot meal and drinks.

name: Krakoski Kros
description: Krakoskikros is a cross-country running event held on unpaved paths and clearings in Kraków’s parks. The competition is open to people of various ages, from children to adults, and does not require a PZLA licence or club membership. The event features a range of athletics competitions, including sprints, middle-distance races, long jump, softball throw, and relays. The competitions take place in green spaces and at the AKF stadium in Kraków, with age- and gender-based categories.
course_highlights: A course on unpaved paths and clearings
Competitions in green spaces and at the AKF stadium in Kraków
A range of athletics competitions for children and adults
additional: Categories are organised by age and gender for children, young people, and adults. The project is carried out with financial support from the Małopolska Voivodeship.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
location: Wapnica, Międzyzdroje, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented sporting event that invites running and Nordic walking enthusiasts to compete on courses of approximately 5 and 10 km for runners, and 5 and 7 km for Nordic walkers. The league takes place during the 2026/2027 season, starting on October 18, 2026, and ending on April 11, 2027. Participation is free, and participants can enjoy healthy competition in a fun atmosphere on the beautiful routes of the Municipality of Międzyzdroje. To be included in the overall standings, participants must complete the required distances in at least four events. Both regular participants and newcomers are welcome to run and walk together.
course_highlights: Running courses of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking courses of approximately 5 and 7 km
Beautiful routes in the Municipality of Międzyzdroje
additional: Participation is free. Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors may take part with written consent from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be ranked in the league, participants must compete in at least four events and complete the required distances: two 5 km and two 10 km races, or two 5 km and two 7 km Nordic walking events. The league is known for healthy competition in a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere full of smiles and fun. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete at least four events. The minimum age is 14; minors participate with a parent’s or guardian’s consent and under their supervision. The official website schedule lists the Wapnica event in this edition on March 21, 2027, not March 14.

name: Murowana Goślina Półmaraton
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Murowanej Goślinie
description: The Murowana Goślina Half Marathon is a historic race dating back to 1978. Initially organized for masters athletes, it is now open to everyone who wants to take on the half-marathon distance of 21.097 km. The race has a rich tradition and runs through the scenic surroundings of Murowana Goślina. After a break caused by the coronavirus pandemic, the race was revived in 2025 by the Centre for Culture and Sport in Murowana Goślina.
course_highlights: A classic half-marathon distance of 21.097 km
Scenic surroundings of Murowana Goślina
A tradition dating back to 1978, with a history of races for masters athletes
additional: The race is open to everyone, not just masters athletes. Entry fees increase across three registration periods, and registration is also available at the race office for a higher fee. The half-marathon has a long tradition and has been organized intermittently since 1978. The event is part of the Grand Prix series. The entry fees listed on the website are 99 zł, 119 zł, or 139 zł for the successive registration periods, and 200 zł at the race office.

name: Półmaraton i Piątka Raduni
location: Centrum Kultury i Sportu, ul. Chopina 34, Pruszcz Gdański, Poland
description: The Pruszcz Gdański Half Marathon and Piątka nad Radunią are annual running events held in Pruszcz Gdański. Both courses are certified by PZLA, and the start and finish are located by the Centre for Culture and Sport. Runners start in time zones according to their declared finish time, allowing for a comfortable run. After the races, there are award ceremonies and a prize draw, creating a friendly atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified half-marathon and 5 km courses
Start and finish by the Centre for Culture and Sport in Pruszcz Gdański
Start divided into time zones according to declared finish time
additional: The start takes place in front of the Centre for Culture and Sport building and is divided into time zones according to declared finish time (red, blue, yellow). The race office is located on the glazed terrace of CKiS; baggage storage and changing rooms are inside the CKiS building. Parking is available at the stadium, with access from Bora-Komorowskiego Street. The award ceremonies and prize draw take place after the races. In previous editions, the start, finish and race office were located at the Centre for Culture and Sport, ul. Chopina 34. The courses were certified by PZLA; details for the 2027 edition may differ.

name: Wrocławska Trzydziestka
description: Wrocławska Trzydziestka is a training run designed to prepare participants for a marathon, organized by the Pro-Run Wrocław Association. Runners can choose distances from 5 to 30 km, run on a 5 km loop. The course runs over gravel and cobblestones, with the start and finish at the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław. The event promotes running and physical activity among Wrocław residents, and showcases the city’s running routes.
course_highlights: 5 km loop over gravel and cobblestones
Start and finish at the Olympic Stadium, al. Paderewskiego 35
One hydration and refreshment point on the course, approximately every 5 km
additional: The time limit for completing the course is 4 hours. Timing is recorded using chips attached to race bibs; these are required to be classified. The race office opens at 8:00 on race day. The course is a 5 km loop, with a choice of 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, or 30 km. In previous editions, the race started at 9:00, the time limit was 4 hours, and a hydration and refreshment point was located approximately every 5 km. The details and price provided apply to a previous edition and do not confirm the conditions for 2027.

name: X Zimowe Grand Prix Zadyszki
location: ul. Kamieniec, near the animal shelter, Oświęcim, Poland
description: The 10th Zadyszka Winter Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Oświęcim Running Club “Zadyszka,” promoting running as a form of recreation and a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place in the scenic area around Kamieniec Street, near the animal shelter in Oświęcim. The club welcomes runners of all abilities to take part together and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the sense of community among local runners. The events are friendly and offer a chance to spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: The course runs around Kamieniec Street, near the animal shelter in Oświęcim
The races take place in a winter setting, adding a distinctive character
The event brings together the local running community and promotes a healthy lifestyle
additional: The club holds meetings on the first Wednesday of every month at 5:00 p.m. at MOSiR, 15 Legionów Street, Oświęcim. The events are open to runners of all abilities. The club maintains an events calendar and actively communicates through social media. No details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees are provided on the website. In the previous edition, registration was available only on race day, and the start was scheduled for 11:00 a.m. This information relates to the 2025/2026 season and does not confirm the rules for the 2027 edition.

name: XI Myślenicki Bieg Uliczny
location: Stadion KS Dalin Myślenice im. Gustawa Grochala, Myślenice, Poland
organizer: KS Dalin Myślenice – Sekcja Biegowa i Miasto i Gmina Myślenice
description: The Myślenice Street Run is a 10 km race held on the streets of Myślenice. In its 11th edition, held on March 15, 2026, 389 runners took part. The event is organized by the running community of KS Dalin Myślenice in cooperation with the City and Municipality of Myślenice.
course_highlights: A 10 km street course in Myślenice
The start and finish are associated with the KS Dalin Myślenice Gustaw Grochal Stadium
The race is organized as part of a local running event
additional: Available information about the 11th edition concerns the race held on March 15, 2026; it does not confirm an edition scheduled for March 14, 2027.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (3)
location: Entrance to Panewnicki Forest opposite M&M Gastro, ul. Owsiana 58A, Katowice, Poland
price_range: 20–60 zł za start; pakiety całoroczne 220–800 zł

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 220.00 PLN

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 – w wysokości 20 zł przelewem na konto, w dniu biegu 30 zł

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Pozostałe osoby – w wysokości 45 zł przelewem na konto, w dniu biegu 60 zł

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Małżeństwa – w wysokości 80 zł przelewem na konto, w dniu biegu 110 zł

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: Pracownicy KS AZS AWF Katowice i AWF Katowice oraz studenci AWF Katowice – opłata w wysokości 30 zł

tiers.label: tier_5
tiers.description: Osoby urodzone w roku 1950 i wcześniej zwolnione są z opłaty startowej

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic Walking event held in the Panewniki forests in Katowice. The course is approximately 4,882 meters per loop and can be completed up to four times, with a time limit of 3 hours. The event promotes an active lifestyle and educates participants about proper conduct in forest areas. Participants may be amateurs or members of sports clubs. The event is organized by the Jerzy Kukuczka Academy of Physical Education and the Katowice State Fire Service.
course_highlights: Loop course approximately 4,882 m long
The course is marked at least every 1 km
Participants may complete up to 4 loops, with a time limit of 3 hours
additional: The participant limit is 700. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during check-in. Fees are non-refundable but may be transferred to a subsequent race, provided the request is submitted by 15:00 on the Thursday before the race. Running and Nordic Walking events are available. The time limit is 3 hours. The start is at the forest entrance opposite M&M Gastro, 58A Owsiana Street; race-day registration is available at the race office from 9:30 to 10:30.

name: Łódzkie Biegi Górskie
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 61, ul. Okólna 183, Łódź, Poland
price_range: 30–65 zł przy płatności do niedzieli poprzedzającej bieg; 40 zł dla juniorów lub 80 zł w kategorii OPEN przy dogłoszeniu
description: Łódź Mountain Runs is a series of cross-country mountain races held in Łagiewnicki Forest, with distances of 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km and elevation gains of 140, 220 and 300 metres respectively. The races are organised by the “Orientuś” Student Sports Club and take place at Primary School No. 61 in Łódź. Each participant receives a cast medal and a meal at every event, with competition in junior and OPEN categories. The series promotes physical activity and sporting competition in scenic woodland.
course_highlights: Routes in Modrzew Forest, measuring 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km
Elevation gains of 140 to 300 metres on running loops
Scenic woodland routes with multiple loops (two or three laps)
additional: At every event, each participant receives a cast medal and a meal. A free event is available when registering for the whole series. Four of the five events count towards the overall standings. Event wrap-ups begin at 12:35, and prize giveaways at 12:40. The race office is open from 9:30 on race day. Parking is limited near the event base; parking around the Shrine of St Anthony of Padua and other designated locations is recommended. Electronic timing from a mass start. The fifth race in the series will take place on 14 March 2027 at 11:00. Event base: Primary School No. 61, 183 Okólna Street, Łódź. Entry fees for the OPEN category depend on the distance: PLN 55 for 6.6 km, PLN 60 for 10.5 km and PLN 65 for 14.4 km.

name: Kobeřická dvacítka
location: TJ Sokol Kobeřice sports ground, Kobeřice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: Nuotykių lenktynės „Aplink Rėkyvos ežerą“
description: The “Around Lake Rėkyva” adventure race is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup, held in Šiauliai by Lake Rėkyva. It is a run approximately 14.5 km long, intended for recreational and professional runners, with the aim of promoting running and encouraging a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place in spring and is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup series, which includes various races throughout Lithuania. Participants are invited to test their abilities and enjoy the natural scenery around the lake.
course_highlights: An approximately 14.5 km route around Lake Rėkyva
The race takes place in Šiauliai, surrounded by nature
A Lithuanian Running Cup stage for both recreational and professional runners
additional: The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another participant until advance registration closes, subject to a €10 change fee. Registration and entry fee administration is handled by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The event took place on 2026-03-15, but the planned date is 2027-03-21; the course is not marked, participants choose their own route, and navigation and tactics are important.

name: X Setka Komandosa
location: Ośrodek Harcerski, ul. Pusta, Lubliniec, Poland
description: The X Setka Komandosa is a 100 km ultramarathon held in challenging woodland conditions around Lubliniec. Runners complete the course in full field or training uniform, carrying a mandatory backpack weighing at least 10 kg. The race is part of the Komandos Grand Slam and promotes competition among uniformed services and awareness of service in special forces units. The start and finish are at the Scout Centre on Pusta Street in Lubliniec, and the time limit is 20 hours.
course_highlights: The 100 km course consists of five laps on forest roads
Full field or training uniform and tactical boots covering the ankles are required
A backpack measuring at least 45 × 30 cm and weighing at least 10 kg is mandatory
additional: The participant limit is 999. The race course consists of five laps on forest roads. Clothing and equipment requirements are strict, including a mandatory uniform, tactical boots, and a backpack weighing at least 10 kg. The race counts toward the Komandos Grand Slam. The “Setki Komandosa” badge can be ordered for an additional fee. The X edition took place in March 2026, with more than 1,000 participants.

name: 106 Vejvanovických
location: Hostinec na Křižovatce, Vejvanovice, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland setting by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly test themselves on the same course. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish are near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, and the course runs through picturesque woodland and the city beach. The races are part of the Grand Prix CITY TRAIL 2026/2027 series, which includes four races in Poznań, with an overall classification and a separate classification for each city.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the woodland setting by Lake Rusałka
Start near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, with the finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event follows a consistent schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. Participants can choose charity packages supporting the Siepomaga Foundation. The event receives funding from the budget of the City of Poznań. The series also includes races for children.

name: Zimowe Biegi Górskie Falenica
location: Falenica Dune, Mazowiecki Landscape Park, Warsaw, Poland
description: The Falenica Winter Mountain Runs are an annual running event held on the Falenica dune in the Masovian Landscape Park in Warsaw. Runners can choose from three distances: 3.33 km, 6.66 km, or 10 km, corresponding to one, two, or three loops with elevation gains of 85 m, 170 m, and 255 m, respectively. The race office is located at Primary School No. 124 and is open on race day from 9:00 to 10:30. The course is marked on the ground, and the races traditionally take place on Saturdays, attracting runners who enjoy winter challenges in natural, hilly terrain.
course_highlights: The course runs along the Falenica dune in the Masovian Landscape Park
Three distances available: 3.33 km (1 loop), 6.66 km (2 loops), and 10 km (3 loops)
Elevation gains range from 85 m to 255 m, depending on the distance
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30 at Primary School No. 124, ul. Bartoszycka 45/47. In the event of epidemic-related restrictions, the office may operate outdoors near the start, without changing facilities. Race office: Primary School No. 124, ul. Bartoszycka 45/47; open from 9:00 to 10:30. If the school cannot be used, the race office may operate outdoors near the start.

name: 10 KonstantyNOVA Dycha by Night
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 11th KonstantyNOVA DYCHA by NIGHT is a unique 10-kilometer race through the scenic areas of the Konstantynowo Forest District. In 2027, its night edition will be held for the second time, with runners taking on the 10 km distance after dark and required to wear headlamps or carry flashlights. Children’s and youth races take place during the day over shorter distances tailored to different age groups. The event is inclusive and charitable, with an opportunity to support a local association when collecting race packs.
course_highlights: The route passes through the scenic areas of the Konstantynowo Forest District
Night edition of the main 10 km race
Children’s and youth races over distances from 150 m to 1,000 m
additional: Children’s and youth races start at 16:30. Participants in the main race are required to have a headlamp or flashlight. When collecting race packs, participants can voluntarily support a local association by putting a donation in the collection box. The main race will take place on March 20, 2027; children’s and youth races are scheduled from 16:30. When collecting race packs, participants will be able to make a voluntary donation to support an association from the Municipality of Mosina.

name: 14 Luboń Track
location: Stadion Miejski w Luboniu, Luboń, Poland
description: The 15th Luboń Track is an athletics competition held at the municipal stadium in Luboń. The event is scheduled for Saturday, August 29, 2026, and includes races over 3,000 m and 1,609 m, as well as children’s races over shorter distances suited to participants’ ages. Runners are divided into heats based on their submitted times, with results classified by gender and age category. Timing is provided by PZLA judges, and each heat is limited to 15–20 participants. The detailed timetable will be published on the event’s official Facebook fan page.
course_highlights: Races at the municipal stadium in Luboń
Heats divided according to submitted times
Results classified by gender and age category
additional: Each heat is limited to 15–20 participants. Heats are assigned based on submitted times. Timing is provided by PZLA judges, without photo-finish equipment. Children’s races are held in different age categories, with separate classifications by gender. The detailed timetable is published on the Facebook fan page two days before the competition. Heats are determined based on submitted times. The 1,609 m and 3,000 m races are for participants aged 13 and over.

name: 40 Kołobrzeska 15-stka Zaślubin
description: Kołobrzeska 15-stka Zaślubin is an annual 15 km race held in Kołobrzeg, commemorating Poland’s Wedding to the Sea and the end of the fighting for the city. Certified by the Polish Athletics Association, the course runs along scenic seaside promenades and city streets, offering participants beautiful views and sporting competition. The race has a rich tradition dating back to 1987 and attracts both experienced runners and those just starting out. The organizers provide a great atmosphere, support from partners and sponsors, and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Three laps: two longer laps of approximately 6.4 km each and one shorter lap of approximately 2.18 km
Scenic seaside promenades and Kołobrzeg streets with sea views
additional: The course consists of three laps: two longer laps and one shorter lap. The start and finish are by the IKAR and Perła Bałtyku sanatoriums. The race commemorates the 82nd anniversary of the end of the fighting for Kołobrzeg and Poland’s Wedding to the Sea. The organizers provide medical and recovery support for runners. The race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The 41st edition is scheduled to start on 20 March 2027 at 11:30. Registration is open; the rules and course information are also available. Holders of the Kołobrzeska Resident Card can receive discounts.

name: 8 Dycha z Górką
description: The VIII Dycha z Górką Run is a cross-country race organized by the Oborygeni Running Group in Oborniki Śląskie. The course consists of two five-kilometer loops over the hilly terrain known as “Grzybek.” The event takes place in early spring, offering runners a challenge on scenic, hilly terrain. The start and finish are located on Kasztanowa Street.
course_highlights: Cross-country route over the hilly terrain of “Grzybek”
Two five-kilometer loops
Start and finish on Kasztanowa Street
additional: Admission is ticketed. The race takes place from 10:00 to 13:00. The route is a cross-country course through Oborniki’s Grzybek. Confirmed information concerns the VIII edition, scheduled for 21 March 2026, with the start at 10:00. The date of 20 March 2027 has not been confirmed.

name: Bieg Stolarza
description: The 7th Stolarz Run is an annual running event organized in Radomsko by the Radomsko Cycling and Running Sports Club. The race takes place on a route suited to runners, and timing is provided using a modern electronic system based on RFID chips. The race is scheduled to start at 16:00, and participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Running route in Radomsko
Electronic timing with RFID chips
High-quality organization by a local sports club
additional: Online registration closes the day before the race at 23:59. Timing is provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu, which uses systems used at the world’s largest marathons. Telephone contact is available from 8:00 to 16:00 and on race day via the emergency number. In 2026, the event was accompanied by a picnic and a charity drive. The previous edition was scheduled to start at 16:00.

name: Bieg Wiosenny
description: The XIII Spring Run in TAURON Park Śląski is an annual running event held in one of Europe’s largest urban parks, in Chorzów. The route winds through the scenic grounds of Park Śląski, giving participants a chance to connect with nature and enjoy the unique atmosphere of a sporting celebration. The finish is at Superauto.pl Stadion Śląski, and to mark the 13th edition, all participants whose race number contains the digit “13” will receive a gift. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, encouraging them to spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: The route passes through more than 600 hectares of meadows, forests and gardens in Park Śląski
Finish at Superauto.pl Stadion Śląski
Scenic running paths in a unique urban green oasis
additional: To mark the 13th edition, all participants whose race number contains the digit “13” will receive a gift. The route passes through Park Śląski, one of Europe’s largest urban parks, with varied vegetation and landscapes. The start and finish are at Superauto.pl Stadion Śląski. In previous editions, places were limited. Details of the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Bie...
Na przijmo bez Gaszowice
location: OKiS recreational area, Rydułtowska 7, Gaszowice, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Gaszowicach
description: Na Przijmo bez Gaszowice i Okolice is a spring orienteering race held near Gaszowice, offering four routes of varying difficulty and distance. Participants can choose a walking route of approximately 50 km (TP50), a cycling route of approximately 50 km (TR50), a shorter 15 km walking route (TP15), or a family route of approximately 10 km with additional attractions. The race takes place at the OKiS recreational grounds in Gaszowice and combines sporting competition with the chance to enjoy time outdoors. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and a hot meal, while the top finishers on the TP50, TR50, and TP15 routes also receive prizes. This event is for everyone who values exercise, fun, and being close to nature.
course_highlights: Walking and cycling routes of approximately 50 km
Family route with attractions and activities for children and adults
Start and finish at the OKiS recreational grounds in Gaszowice
additional: Every participant receives a medal bearing the event logo and a hot recovery meal. The top finishers on the TP50, TR50, and TP15 routes receive additional prizes. The family route includes extra attractions and activities along the course. In the previous edition, the event base was at the recreational grounds by OKiS, ul. Rydułtowska 7, Gaszowice. In 2025, participants received a medal and a hot recovery meal.

name: Ultramaraton Zielonogórski
description: The Zielona Góra New Borders Ultramarathon is a unique running event held in the picturesque Piast Hills in Zielona Góra. As part of the anniversary edition, participants can choose between two distances: 13 km and a new, demanding 23 km course featuring technical sections, numerous elevation gains, and beautiful views. It is an excellent option for trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience a mountain atmosphere without leaving the city. The event has a welcoming atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners, promising sporting excitement and unforgettable experiences.
course_highlights: The 13 km course features dynamic changes of pace, forest singletrack, and demanding climbs
The new 23 km course features technical sections, numerous climbs, and fast descents
Picturesque trails in the Piast Hills, with beautiful views and a natural trail-running character
additional: The Ultramarathon offers several running distances: 23 km, 48 km, and 103 km, as well as a solo 103 km duathlon and a 103 km cycling race. The 48 km and 23 km courses start at checkpoints in Nowy Kisielin and Jarogniewice. The organizer provides professional catering during the event. GPX course files are available to download. Information on the official website refers to the 12th edition on 21 March 2026; a GPX track for the 103 km course is available.

name: VI Koleżeński Bieg Henryka Brauna
description: The 6th Henryk Braun Friends’ Run is a 10 km race taking place in Radzyny, Masovian Voivodeship, on Sunday, March 21, 2027. The race is an excellent opportunity to test your running fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to each runner’s level. The event is part of the running calendar and is aimed at runners looking for a spring challenge.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
Moderately challenging asphalt course
Held in Radzyny, Masovian Voivodeship
additional: Training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including training instructions and expert support.

name: Wiosenny Ultra Świr
location: Centrum Sportów Zimowych w Ptaszkowej, Ptaszkowa, Grybów, Poland
description: Ultra Świr is a mountain race run on a 15.5 km loop with +650 m of elevation gain, starting at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa. The route features a fast, steep climb to the summit of Mount Jaworze (882 m above sea level), followed by a sharp descent to the aid station in the valley. Competitors can choose how many loops to complete within the time limit, allowing them to adapt the distance to their abilities. The race combines mountain challenges with a comfortable event base offering changing rooms, showers, a hot meal and a support area, among other facilities.
course_highlights: A 15.5 km loop with +650 m of elevation gain
A fast, steep climb to the summit of Mount Jaworze (882 m above sea level)
90% trails and gravel surfaces; aid stations at 6 km and at the event base
additional: Timing is provided using B4Sport chips. The event base at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa offers changing rooms, showers, hot water, lockable lockers, a hot recovery meal (including vegetarian options), a support area, and space for a sun lounger or tent for 12-hour and 24-hour teams. Free, ample parking is available directly next to race registration. Safety on the course is a priority, and competitors are required to check off the mandatory gear before packing it in their backpacks. The programme includes 6- and 12-hour races, a single loop, and a 17 km Nordic walking event. For the timed races, only completed full loops count.

name: Wiosna z kompasem
description: Wiosna z kompasem is a 10 km race held in Bobrowniki, Mazowieckie. It is an excellent opportunity to prepare for a spring race using training plans tailored to your individual level and VDOT. The organizers offer detailed training instructions and support from experts, helping you prepare optimally for the race. Alongside the main race, the event also includes children’s races, relays, Nordic walking and a special trail run with a dog. The event is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with high-quality organisation and a certified course.

This is authentic mountain country, untamed nature, and a true challenge for the determined—marking the start of the Triple Crown series. The event counts toward the large and small gold badges, and the race base is at the Gorce Municipal Sports Hall in Nowy Targ.

Registration and race-pack collection at the race office from 15:30 to 20:00 on the previous day. The event base will be at the Gorce Municipal Sports Hall in Nowy Targ. The event also includes Children’s Races starting at 10:00. The maximum time to complete the route is 120 minutes, allowing people with lower fitness levels to take part too. Information about the route, schedule and time limit comes from the 2026 edition; it does not confirm the details of the 2027 event.

description: Niebieska Fala is a charity run held in Poznań, combining a passion for running with helping people in need, particularly by raising awareness of autism and purchasing therapeutic equipment. The main race route follows the scenic paths of Marceliński Forest and Węgorka Street, with distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event. The youngest participants can take part in the Niebieska miniFala family run, a 1 km route around ENEA Stadium. The event is family-oriented and inclusive, promoting a healthy lifestyle and counteracting the social exclusion of people with disabilities.
course_highlights: The main route is a 5 km loop in Marceliński Forest, with 30% paved and 70% forest surface
New on the route: a section along Węgorka Street, adding variety and improving running comfort
The Niebieska miniFala family run is a 1 km route around ENEA Stadium, with a paved surface that is safe for children
additional: The time limit for completing the main race (5, 10 or 15 km) is 120 minutes. The route is marked with blue-and-white tape, and volunteers assist participants along the way. There is a refreshment station on the route. The MiniFala family run starts at 11:30, the main race at 13:00, and Nordic walking at 12:30. Participation can be transferred to another runner until 10 March 2026. The start and finish are by ENEA Stadium’s Stand No. 2. Information about the route, distances and fees comes from materials for the 2026 edition; details of the 2027 edition may differ. The 2026 edition started by ENEA Stadium’s Stand No. 2, at ul. Bułgarska 17.

name: V Bieg Strażaka
description: The 5th Firefighter Run is an annual race organized by the Dąbrowa Volunteer Fire Department (OSP Dąbrowa) and held in the picturesque village of Dąbrowa. The event attracts runners looking to test themselves on a running course. Timing is professionally provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu, ensuring accurate results and a high standard of organization. The race is scheduled to start at 3:00 p.m., and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and sporting competition.
course_highlights: Main race: 5 km in the 2026 edition
5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s races and a firefighter competition in full protective gear
additional: The 2026 edition’s program also included a 998 m race for Youth Fire Brigades. Children’s race distances ranged from 300 m to nearly 1,000 m. The information about the program and distances applies to the 2026 edition.

name: V Bieg W samo południe
location: Kompleks sportowy Zespołu Szkół im. Mikołaja Kopernika, Samborowo, Poland
description: The 5th “At High Noon” Run is an annual running event held at the sports complex of the Nicolaus Copernicus School Complex in Samborowo. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, offering an opportunity to compete and spend time actively outdoors. This local event brings the community together and promotes a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: An approximately 10-kilometre loop around Samborowo
A cross-country route running mainly along field tracks
Start and finish at the sports complex of the Nicolaus Copernicus School Complex
additional: Participant limit: 250 people. The time limit is 2 hours. The route is not certified by the PZLA.

name: VIII Półmaraton Świebody i Sulecha
organizer: OSiR „Sulechowianka” w Sulechowie, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Świebodzinie, Sulechowski Klub Sportowy oraz Wierzbicki Running Project
description: The 8th Świebodzin and Sulechów Half Marathon is a race connecting Sulechów and Świebodzin, organized to promote running and outdoor physical activity. The course runs through the scenic streets of both towns and the localities of Kalsk and Rosin, giving participants the chance to test themselves in a sporting competition. The participant limit is 300. The organizers provide transport from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów. The race starts at 11:00 at Town Hall Square in Sulechów.
course_highlights: The course runs from Sulechów to Świebodzin through town streets and along Road No. 276
Passes through the localities of Kalsk and Rosin
Start and finish at town squares: Town Hall Square in Sulechów and John Paul II Square in Świebodzin
additional: The participant limit is 300. The organizers provide transport by bus from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów. The bus departs at 9:40 from the car park by Primary School No. 2. The time limit for completing the course is 2 hours 30 minutes; participants must finish by 13:30. The race office is open on race day from 7:30 to 9:30 at the Town Hall in Świebodzin. The participant limit was 300, and the time limit for finishing the race was 2 hours 30 minutes. The organizers provided bus transport for participants from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów.

name: Wrocławska Dycha Cztery Pory Roku
description: Wrocławska Dycha Four Seasons is a series of four park runs held in Wrocław at different times of the year. Each race covers a distance of 10 km and follows scenic paths through Wrocław’s parks, giving both amateur and experienced runners the chance to compete and get to know the city. Participants can earn points toward the overall series standings, and generous refreshment stations and commemorative medals await them at the finish. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively amid the unique atmosphere of sporting competition and beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: The routes pass through four different parks in Wrocław
Scenic park paths and forest trails
Each race covers a distance of 10 km
additional: The series consists of four races: the Valentine’s Day Run (February), Wrocławska Dycha Spring (April), Wrocławska Dycha Summer – St. John’s Eve (June), and Wrocławska Dycha Autumn (September). Each race also includes a Great KIDS children’s run, with medals and safe race conditions. Participants can compete in the overall series standings. Generous refreshment stations are available on the course and after the race. The 2027 spring edition is listed for April 4, not March 28. The website schedule also includes the summer race on June 20 and the autumn race on September 26.

name: Trailo kalvės S4E5. Bražuolė. Finalas
description: Trailo Kalvė S4E5 Bražuolė Finalas is the final event of the traditional Lithuanian Trail Running Cup season, held in the Bražuolė area. The event offers a range of distances for participants of different ages and experience levels, from youth to adults. The courses wind through woodland and vary in length and difficulty, offering both natural beauty and challenges. Participants start at the Bražuolė campsite, and the event is friendly and open to all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Woodland courses in the Bražuolė area
Distances of varying lengths, from 4.8 km to 24.8 km
Courses with varied elevation gain and scenic natural views
additional: Start at the Bražuolė campsite. Courses feature elevation gains ranging from up to 150 m to over 500 m, depending on the distance. The event has youth and adult categories. Event merchandise is inspired by forest animals, and part of the proceeds goes to support care organizations. The event offers different distances, registration is online, and the location is Bražuolė campsite, Pugainiai.

name: Cytadela by Night # 113
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed 5 km runs held in Poznań. The event takes place in the Citadel, offering participants a unique opportunity to run at night. The run is open to everyone who wants to spend time actively and take on the course in the scenic surroundings of the park.
course_highlights: 5 km course
The run takes place in the Citadel in Poznań
Night-time atmosphere
additional: The run is free and timed.

name: Halowe Mistrzostwa Europy Masters - 5 km
location: Ulica Generała Józefa Bema, Toruń, Poland
description: The European Masters Indoor Championships are a prestigious athletics competition for masters athletes, taking place in Toruń on Bema Street. The event is held indoors, and the 5 km is one of the running events. It brings together experienced athletes from across Europe, offering high-level competition and a unique sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: An indoor 5 km race
Events for masters age categories
Location in central Toruń, on Bema Street
additional: The competition takes place from 27 March to 2 April 2026. The event programme is available as a PDF on the organiser’s website. No information about entry fees or online registration is available on the pages reviewed. The available information concerns the 15th edition of the championships, scheduled to take place in Toruń from 27 March to 2 April 2026, not the stated date of 31 March 2027.

name: Běh Terezským údolím
location: KVS Olomouc, Zákostelí, Náměšť na Hané, Czech Republic
description: Běh Terezským údolím is a race organized by SK RELAX Olomouc, held at the KVS Olomouc complex in Náměšť na Hané. The 7.1 km course is an out-and-back route and almost flat, with climbs after the start and before the finish. The surface consists of field paths, asphalt, and gravel, offering a varied running experience. The race starts at 11:00 and is suitable for runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Out-and-back course with climbs after the start and before the finish
Surface: field paths, asphalt, and gravel
7.1 km course at the KVS Olomouc complex in Náměšť na Hané
additional: The race is organized by SK RELAX Olomouc. The contact person is Karel Pikal. The race is part of Český běh, a service of the Czech Athletics Federation for runners. The course is certified, and the race is listed in the official Český běh race calendar. In 2026, the race was part of the Hanácký běžecký pohár and the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje. The race information also lists a fitness run open to all ages.

name: 18. PANAS Półmaraton Ślężański Piątka Ślężysława
organizer: Miasto i Gmina Sobótka, Ślężański Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sobótce, Klub Biegacza Sobótka, Zespół Szkolno-Przedszkolny im. Janusza Korczaka w Sobótce oraz Centrum Szkolenia Wojsk Inżynieryjnych i Chemicznych
description: Piątka Ślężysława is a 5 km race held as part of the 19th Ślęża Half Marathon, which starts on 20 March 2027 in Sobótka. The course was designed by local runners and has a unique route with no equivalent in Poland. The start and finish are in the centre of Sobótka, and the finish is inside a sports hall, providing comfort for participants. The event promotes physical activity and the tourist attractions of the Ślęża region.
course_highlights: Course designed by runners from Sobótka, unique in Poland
Start and finish in the centre of Sobótka; finish inside a sports hall
Scenic surroundings at the foot of Mount Ślęża
additional: The race finish is inside a sports hall, providing comfort for participants. The course is available to download in .gpx format. The event is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Lower Silesian Half Marathon classification for the Sudeten Mouflon statuette. The race will take place on 20 March 2027. Detailed information about the start time of Piątka Ślężysława was not provided in the available materials.

description: Širokodolský Cross-Country Run is a traditional off-road race held in the village of Široký Důl near Polička in the Pardubice Region. The event offers races for children and young people ranging from 60 metres to 4 km, as well as a 7 km main race with a mass start for men and women. The course runs along paved roads, forest trails and dirt tracks, with a climbing bonus on the first hill. Children can win prizes, while adults can receive cash prizes in their categories. The start and finish are by the municipal hall, creating a welcoming race atmosphere.

Climbing bonus on the first hill
Start and finish by the municipal hall in Široký Důl
additional: Children and young people start in successive age categories, with distances ranging from 60 m to 4 km. The 7 km main race has a mass start for men and women. Children receive prizes for the first three finishers in each category, while adults receive cash prizes for the first three in each category. The race starts by the municipal hall. The programme includes races for children and young people; the results for the 2026 edition list distances from 80 m to 7.8 km.

description: The traditional “Senvagė-2026” running competition is part of a Lithuanian Running Cup stage and takes place in Panevėžys, in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park. The event brings together running enthusiasts from various cities to promote sports, a healthy lifestyle, and the discovery of the natural and cultural beauty of Lithuania’s regions. The competition is part of the long-standing Lithuanian Running Cup tradition, which has brought together professional and amateur runners across the country since 2009. The event takes place in spring, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: The competition takes place in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park in Panevėžys
A traditional Lithuanian Running Cup stage featuring runners from various cities
Encourages participants to discover the nature and architecture of Lithuania’s regions
additional: Registration is managed by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another person no later than the close of advance registration. If changing from a more expensive to a less expensive distance, the price difference is non-refundable. The participant change fee is 10 euros. The event will take place at Kranto g. 24, Panevėžys, with online registration available.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The course runs through beautiful woodland around Lake Szmaragdowe, with varied uphill and downhill sections, making the event appealing to both beginner and experienced runners. The races aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity, while providing an opportunity for friendly sporting competition. The start and finish are located at Zajazd Szmaragd, and races take place regularly during the season from October to April.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Szmaragdowe
Varied uphill and downhill sections, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
Start and finish behind Zajazd Szmaragd on Kopalniana Street
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start, at 10:45. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course is permanent, making it possible to compare results over the months and years. The race is scheduled for 4 April 2027, with the start at 11:00. CITY TRAIL Junior races are also held as part of the series.

name: Čendův běh v Petrově
location: Obecní hřiště, Petrov, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Obec Petrov, Libřický osadní klub, osada Hřebena a SDH Petrov
description: Čendův Run is the oldest tramp-style running race in Bohemia and one of the oldest cross-country races of all. It is traditionally held on Easter Sunday in Petrov near Prague and offers technically challenging courses along soft forest roads and trails in the valley of the Záhořanský Stream and around Ďábel Hill. The race is known for its family atmosphere and demanding terrain, with professional chip timing provided by irontime. Courses range from 100 metres for children’s categories to 12 km for experienced cross-country runners.
course_highlights: Technically challenging courses along soft forest roads and trails
The valley of the Záhořanský Stream and the area around Ďábel Hill
A traditional Easter-time date and a family atmosphere
additional: Professional chip timing is provided by irontime. The race offers a wide range of categories, from 100 metres for children to 12 km for experienced runners. The event takes place at the municipal sports ground in Petrov near Prague. It is traditionally held on Easter Sunday; the listed courses in the previous edition included 6 km and 12 km. The date 11 April 2027 has not been confirmed by sources.

name: Velikonoční běh Tovačov
description: The Tovačov Easter Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque grounds of Tovačov Castle. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for endurance runners and gives athletes the chance to test themselves in recreational and competitive races. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for a wide audience who enjoy running in a pleasant setting steeped in history.
course_highlights: Picturesque grounds of Tovačov Castle
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for endurance runners
Traditional endurance race with a long history
additional: The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for endurance runners. Details for the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed by the listed sources.

name: 6 BMWielkanocny
description: The 6th BMWielkanocny is a 10 km race held in Kraków. Participants can prepare with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers offer detailed training instructions and expert support to help runners prepare optimally for race day. The race is part of the running calendar and is aimed at people looking to improve their fitness and achieve good results over 10 km.
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to each runner’s VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. The race listing can be managed and marketing collaboration arranged through the TreningBiegacza platform.

name: XII Bieg do Pustego Grobu
organizer: Parafia Rzymsko-Katolicka pw. Świętego Antoniego w Nowej Soli
description: The 12th Bieg do Pustego Grobu is a 10 km race held in Nowa Sól on Easter Monday at 14:00. The course passes important churches in the city, including St. Anthony’s, St. Barbara’s, St. Joseph’s, the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, and St. Michael’s, as well as the cemetery on Wandy Street. The race has a spiritual and symbolic character, recalling the footsteps of St. Peter and St. John as they ran to the Tomb of the Lord to confirm the Resurrection of Jesus.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through churches in Nowa Sól: St. Anthony’s, St. Barbara’s, St. Joseph’s, the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, and St. Michael’s
Passes through the cemetery on Wandy Street
Held on Easter Monday at 14:00
additional: The organizer is the Roman Catholic Parish of St. Anthony in Nowa Sól. The race has a spiritual and symbolic meaning, referring to the Easter tradition. No information was found about entry fees or participant limits. The start is scheduled for Easter Monday at 14:00. The 12th edition took place in 2026; available sources do not confirm details of the 2027 edition.

name: Běh kolem Harrachovky v Táboře
description: The Easter Harrachovka Run in Tábor is a traditional 7.5 km running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the town of Tábor. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and offers a sporting experience for runners of all levels. The course surface is suitable for fast running, and the race has a friendly, motivating atmosphere. The event is organised by the South Bohemian Marathon Club, which provides high-quality organisation and support for participants.
course_highlights: Course distance: 7.5 km
Surface suitable for fast running
The route runs around the town of Tábor
additional: Registration is available online and requires payment of a membership fee of CZK 250. The registration fee must be paid within 14 days, otherwise the registration will be cancelled. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup, with a points system and the option of a team competition. In 2026, the start was scheduled for 14:00; the information provided does not confirm details for the 2027 edition.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Prague is a charity run held in the evening in the beautiful setting of Stromovka and Výstaviště. Participants can choose between two routes—a short 2.8 km loop and a long 4.5 km loop—which can also be walked. The start is at 21:00, and registration opens at 18:30. The event offers an accompanying programme, including a concert, and is open to all age groups. Proceeds support people with severe visual impairments. Capacity is limited to ensure runners’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: 2.8 km route – short loop in Stromovka
4.5 km route – long loop in Stromovka
Night run with a choice of entry option including a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration is through the GoOut.cz portal, where participants can choose an entry option with a headlamp or sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards are admitted free of charge, without a headlamp or headband. Children under 15 accompanied by an adult are admitted free of charge, but do not receive a headlamp. A cloakroom and baggage storage, medical services and an accompanying programme including a concert are available on site. Dogs on a leash and wearing a muzzle are welcome, except in Jihlava. Information about the venue, route and price is based on the 2026 edition; the date 15. 4. 2027 has not been confirmed. In the 2026 edition, participants with a TP, ZTP or ZTP/P card and their companions were admitted free of charge.

Participants can run a 3 km route at their own pace and support their health. The start is at Lodičky, and proceeds from the entry fee are donated to help those in need. Everyone is warmly invited to take part in this community sporting event.

Start at Lodičky in Karviná
Run at any pace in pleasant natural surroundings
additional: Registration begins at 17:00, and the start is at 17:45 at Lodičky. Proceeds from the entry fee go to help those in need. Registration begins at 17:00, and the start is at 17:45 at Lodičky. Proceeds from the entry fee are intended to help those in need.

name: Jarní běh v Pávově
description: The Spring Run in Pávov is an 8.8 km race that follows both roads and trails around Jihlava, specifically in Pávov. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and gives runners the opportunity to enjoy a combination of paved and off-road sections in the picturesque Vysočina countryside. It is suitable for the general public and offers a sporting experience in spring.
course_highlights: 8.8 km course
Combination of road and off-road sections
Around Jihlava, in Pávov
additional: The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup.

name: 23 Bieg Europejski Mistrzostwa Polski Ciepłowników
organizer: Klub Sportowy Altom Gniezno oraz Przedsiębiorstwo Energetyki Cieplnej w Gnieźnie Sp. z o.o.
description: The 23rd European Run is an annual running event held in Gniezno to commemorate Poland’s accession to the European Union. The 10 km main race follows city streets, with the start and finish at Gniezno’s Market Square. The course is certified by PZLA and consists of a single loop on asphalt and cobblestones. The event attracts runners from many countries, creating an international sporting celebration. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal at the Market Square and attend the winners’ award ceremony.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through Gniezno, on asphalt and cobblestones (5%)
Start and finish at Gniezno’s Market Square
PZLA-certified, single-loop course
additional: The race office is open on Friday, 10.04.2027, from 17:00 to 20:30, and on race day, 11.04.2027, from 11:00 to 15:00 (the location has changed to the sports hall at Primary School No. 2 in Gniezno). The time limit for completing the race is 1 hour 30 minutes. Timing is recorded using chips in the race bibs. After the race, a recovery meal is available at the Market Square (for runners only). The winners’ award ceremony takes place at 18:00 on the stage at the Market Square. The event also includes a Preschoolers’ Run, divided into age groups, with wristbands and T-shirts required. The Polish Heating Engineers’ Championships are intended for employees of the heating industry. Available sources describe the 23rd edition, scheduled for 11 April 2026; details of the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed.
