The race office is open from 17:00 to 20:00 on 7–9 April and from 8:00 to 10:30 on race day. The time limit is 2 hours. Nordic Walking over 5 km is also organized for residents of Raszyn Municipality, with a separate classification and a 10:45 start. Children can take part in the accompanying races free of charge. For the 2026 edition, the participant limit is listed as 600 and the time limit as 2 hours. The program also includes children’s races and Nordic Walking.

name: Běh lipovou alejí – Nymburská desítka
location: Tyršův ostrov and athletics stadium, Nymburk, Czech Republic
description: Běh lipovou alejí is a traditional road race in Nymburk, held since 1996. The race features a 10 km loop course, running mainly on paved paths on Tyršův ostrov and on the athletics stadium’s synthetic track. It is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, who have their own categories and courses. The race is organised by Sportovní klub POLICIE Nymburk, z.s., and takes place at the athletics stadium in Nymburk.
course_highlights: A 10 km loop course running mainly on the paved paths of Tyršův ostrov
The opening and closing sections, approximately 1,800 m in total, are on the athletics stadium’s synthetic track
The course complies with IAAF/AIMS rules for measuring courses outside a track
additional: Children’s and youth categories have separate starts from 8:30 to 10:55, with course distances ranging from 100 m to 2,700 m. The main 10 km race for men and women starts at 11:15. Registration for the children’s and youth categories is available only on race day, no later than 30 minutes before the start of the relevant category. The course is measured and can be run individually using GARMIN and STRAVA segments.

name: Horské běhy v Novohradských horách
location: Hojná Voda, Horní Stropnice, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Martin Brožka a tým Sportcentra Novohradské hory
description: The Mountain Runs in the Novohradské Mountains are traditional spring races held amid the beautiful scenery of the Novohradské Mountains, with their hub in Hojná Voda. They offer a variety of courses, from children’s categories and shorter runs to a challenging 63 km ultra trail with 2,050 m of elevation gain. The races are suitable for a wide range of runners, from amateurs to experienced athletes, and also include a canicross category. The start and finish are both in Hojná Voda, where you can also register on race day. The event is organised by Martin Brožka and the Sportcentrum Novohradské hory team.
course_highlights: Ultra trail: 63 km with 2,050 m of elevation gain
Canicross Classic: 19 km with 660 m of elevation gain
Zážitek: 12.4 km with 430 m of elevation gain
additional: You can register online at maraton.cz or in person on race day in Hojná Voda. Race numbers are distributed from 9:30 to 10:30 for adults and from 12:00 to 13:45 for children. Detailed course maps are available in the Mountain Runs Course section, along with course videos for each category. A prize raffle with valuable prizes, including accommodation and a subscription to the Svět běhu magazine, is planned for participants.

name: Kyfův Jarní běh
location: Louka pod bývalým lyžařským můstkem, Hrušov, Senohraby, Czech Republic
description: Kyfův Spring Run is a traditional running race organised by TJ Sokol Senohraby. It takes place in a meadow below the former ski jump in Hrušov, Senohraby. The race is part of the Ladův kraj Cup and offers a springtime sporting experience with various courses, including a special stream crossing for younger pupils. Participants can also look forward to a mobile café serving hot drinks and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and encourages sporting activity among children and adults.
course_highlights: The courses run through a meadow below the former ski jump in Hrušov
A special stream crossing on the 1.8 km course for younger pupils (born in 2011–2012)
Natural terrain with gentle uneven sections and a springtime atmosphere
additional: A mobile café serving coffee and hot chocolate will be on site. Bringing a change of shoes is recommended because of the stream crossing on the younger pupils’ course. The courses follow traditional routes, and marking is done the evening before the race. The terrain may be uneven in places due to animal activity. A mobile café serving hot drinks is usually on site.

name: Kros Sázava
location: Fotbalové hřiště, Pikovice, Hradištko, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kros Sázava is a running race held in Pikovice, by the football field, in the Central Bohemian Region. It offers three routes of varying distances and elevation gains, all entirely on natural terrain. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain with beautiful views. The routes are 15.5 km, 10 km and 5 km long, with elevation gains ranging from 120 to 500 metres, offering a varied experience for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Long route: 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain
Medium route: 10 km with approximately 230 m of elevation gain
Hobby route: 5 km with approximately 120 m of elevation gain
additional: All routes run entirely on natural terrain. A photo gallery of the course is available at krosovypohar.cz/kros-sazava/fotky-z-trasy/.

name: Žďárská 10
location: Žďár nad Sázavou, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic
description: Žďárská 10 is a fast 10 km road race that opens the spring season in the heart of the Žďárské vrchy. The route starts in the center of Žďár nad Sázavou, follows cycle paths to the end of the Pilská Reservoir, and then returns, offering beautiful scenery and minimal elevation gain. The race has a mass start and is precisely measured, making it ideal for runners looking for a fast, enjoyable race in the picturesque Vysočina region. It is organized by Sportovní klub Žďárák z.s., with Vojtěch Bořil as the race representative.
course_highlights: Road route along a paved cycle path with minimal elevation gain
The route runs from the center of Žďár nad Sázavou to the Pilská Reservoir and back
A short 200-meter section on Dvorská Street with controlled road traffic
additional: Registration is also available on race day from 9:45 to 10:45 at the start area behind the House of Culture. Parking is available at the Municipal Office and in nearby areas. The awards ceremony will take place at 12:30. The route follows a cycle path with minimal elevation gain; the race has a mass start and is precisely measured.

name: Korunou za korunu
location: Cihelský rybník, Nové Město na Moravě, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s.
description: Koruna za korunu is a short cross-country race around the dam of Cihelský Pond in Nové Město na Moravě. The race is suitable for all runners who want to enjoy a pleasant running experience in the natural surroundings of the Vysočina region. The course is 3.2 km long, and spikes may be worn. The race is organised by TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s., which provides a friendly atmosphere and high-quality race organisation.
course_highlights: A short cross-country race around Cihelský Pond
A 3.2 km course in the natural surroundings of the Vysočina region
Spikes may be worn
additional: The first category starts at 9:30, and the main category starts at 11:20. The race is organised by TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s., and the contact person is Petr Hubáček. The race is also suitable for runners wearing spikes. The main category starts at 11:20. The race is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s running activities.

name: Běh u Chlumce
location: Chlumec, Ústí nad Labem District, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Plné vstupné: 50 Kč Startovné 50 Kč platí pouze dospělí.

description: We invite you to the traditional NaPOLEon run in Chlumec, an event for the whole family. The race takes place in the beautiful Chlumecko countryside and offers courses of varying lengths and difficulty, so everyone can find a suitable route. The event is friendly and suitable for all ages, with registration available in advance or on the day of the race.
course_highlights: Courses of 500 m, 1 km, 5 km and 10 km (2 x 5 km loop)
Beautiful Chlumecko countryside
Start and finish in the meadow by the pear orchard in Chlumec, under a shelter
additional: You can register in advance by emailing chvatalova@mesto-chlumec.cz or in person on the day of the race from 9:00 to 10:00. The start and finish are under a shelter in the meadow by the pear orchard in Chlumec.

name: Kysucká desiatka
organizer: Mestské kulturno-športové stredisko Kysucké Nové Mesto
description: Kysucká desiatka is a running race in Kysucké Nové Mesto, offering courses for different age groups, including children and adults. The start is in the western part of Murgašova Street. Participants can compete in the 1 km race for children or the 10 km race for adults and juniors. The race is organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Centre of Kysucké Nové Mesto and offers categories by age and gender. The children’s race starts at 10:05, and all other categories start at 10:30. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners and supports sporting life in the region.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v maratóne mužov a žien, veteránov a veteránok (ČSOB Bratislava maratón 2026) (4.kolo BP SAZ)
description: The Slovak Republic Marathon Championships for men, women, and masters are a major athletics event taking place in Bratislava. Runners can look forward to a well-prepared course and professional organization under the auspices of the Slovak Athletic Association. The event is part of a race series and offers the opportunity to compete in various categories, including masters. Registration is online and open to the wider running community.
sources: http://statistika.atletika.sk/admin/media/propozice/MAJSTROVSTVA SR v maratone - propozicie_12.4.2026, Bratislava akt..pdf

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 2. kolo
location: Trenčianske Stankovce, Trenčianske Stankovce, futbalové ihrisko
description: The Trenčín Running League is a series of nine running events organized in the area around Trenčín since 2015, open to the general public, including competitive runners and enthusiasts. One race takes place each month from March to November on a variety of interesting courses. The events offer a friendly atmosphere, motivation, and a chance to meet people who support a healthy lifestyle. The results and standings after each race provide motivation for further training and improving performance.

name: Šrégom nočným Zvolenom
organizer: Technická univerzita vo Zvolene, WoodenWorld, Cyklo Zvolen o.z., Mesto Zvolen
description: Šrégom nočným Zvolenom is a night run organized by the student organization Woodenworld at the Technical University in Zvolen and the City of Zvolen. Runners complete a 7 km course with 40 metres of elevation gain through the city of Zvolen, passing landmarks such as Zvolen Castle, SNP Square and the Hron River. The event offers electronic timekeeping, refreshments, prizes for the top finishers and a commemorative item. The start is at 20:30 in front of the Technical University, and the race is suitable for the general public, including university students and staff.

name: Bieg Kreta
location: Kletno, Stronie Śląskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg Kreta is an elite mountain ultramarathon held in the Sudetes, offering two routes: the classic 148 km and the extreme 377 km Hardcore. The route follows the famous Sudetes Triangle, covering the three highest peaks of the Sudetes, across varied terrain, mud, snow, and ice. The race runs day and night without long breaks. It is a challenge for experienced runners who want to take on a legendary route and the history of this ultramarathon. The race traditionally starts in Sobótka, and participants are provided with aid stations and mobile support.
course_highlights: The route covers the Sudetes Triangle: Ślęża, Śnieżka, and Śnieżnik
Varied terrain: asphalt, cobblestones, forest trails, rocky sections, and muddy sections
Extreme elevation gain of up to 12,000 m over the 377 km distance
additional: The race traditionally starts on Wednesday at 17:00 from Winiarnia Celtica in Sobótka (ul. Czysta 1). Participants can leave their cars in the parking lot and book accommodation. Mandatory gear for the route: a charged phone, a flashlight with spare batteries, a water container with a capacity of at least 1 l, a hooded rain/windproof jacket, a route map, and a GPS tracker. The organizer plans gear checks and aid stations where participants can access their own drop bags, as well as mobile support. The Classic route is open to people aged 18 and over who have no medical contraindications to long-distance running; the limit includes 80 places for participants who register and pay the entry fee by the required deadline, plus 25 places allocated by the organizer. Candidates for the Hardcore option are vetted by the organizer.

name: Bratrušovské vrchy
description: Bratrušovské vrchy is a traditional cross-country race organized by the volunteer firefighters in Bratrušov. The race starts at the football field and offers a course approximately 10.7 km long with 418 meters of elevation gain, making for a challenging and interesting run through natural terrain. Children can take part in a shorter 2 km race with 80 meters of elevation gain. The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series and attracts runners of various age groups.
course_highlights: A 10.7 km course with 418 meters of elevation gain
Start at the football field in Bratrušov
A 2 km children’s course with 80 meters of elevation gain
additional: The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series. The number of starters is usually around 65 in the adult categories and around 24 in the children’s categories. The organizer is the Bratrušov Volunteer Firefighters Association, which organizes the race regularly.

name: Zbraslavská pila VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Praha-Zbraslav railway station, Zbraslav, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Zbraslavská pila VAŠÍ LIGY is a challenging mountain race in Prague, offering a 7 km course with 500 metres of elevation gain. It takes place on trails with three demanding climbs and descents, giving the race its distinctive difficulty and challenge. The race starts at Praha-Zbraslav train station and is suitable for runners looking for an intense trail experience in an urban setting. It is organised by VAŠE LIGA under the direction of Petr Lundák, who ensures the event is professionally run.
course_highlights: 7 km course with 500 m of elevation gain
3 demanding climbs and descents
Mountain cross-country race in Prague
additional: The race starts at Praha-Zbraslav train station. It is a mountain cross-country/trail race with significant elevation gain and demanding sections. The organiser is VAŠE LIGA; Petr Lundák can be contacted. The race is part of the VAŠÍ LIGA series. The start is at 18:00 at Praha-Zbraslav train station.

name: Jarní běh Olympu
location: Sportovní areál OLYMP CSMV, Stromovka, Praha 7, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Run of Olympus is a cross-country and trail race held at the OLYMP CSMV grounds in Prague’s Stromovka Park. It offers courses of 5.5 km, 4.4 km and 3.3 km through natural surroundings with varied terrain. The race is suitable for the general public and is organised by PSK Olymp Praha. Registration is online only, and the event is traditionally popular with runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail courses
Course distances of 5.5 km, 4.4 km and 3.3 km
Set in Prague’s Stromovka Park at the OLYMP CSMV grounds
additional: Registration is online only and closes at midnight on 8 October 2026. The organiser does not accept entries on race day. The first category starts at 16:00, and the main category starts at 18:55. According to the available context, the main category is scheduled to start at 18:55.

name: Olomoucká desítka
description: Olomouc Ten is the third edition of a 10 km running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc. The race is part of the 2026 Haná Running Cup and offers runners an asphalt course 3.343 km long, which they must complete three times. The first lap is slightly shorter, giving the race its distinctive character. Winners in each category will receive sweet gifts, and the awards ceremony takes place at the Music Pavilion in Smetana Gardens.
course_highlights: A 3.343 km loop on asphalt paths through Smetana Gardens
The course is run three times; the first lap is 28 m shorter
Start and finish by the Music Pavilion in Smetana Gardens
additional: Bags can be left in the start and finish area. Registration takes place at the race venue; runners must present a chip card with sufficient credit. The race is run according to road-running rules, and everyone takes part at their own risk. The winners’ announcement and prize-giving will take place next to the Music Pavilion. The race offers age categories and a fitness run with no age distinction.

name: Krčská 10
location: Krčský les, Prague 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Krčská 10 is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4. The race offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy running in nature in a friendly atmosphere. The route follows forest paths and offers beautiful views and pleasant terrain. The event is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: The route runs through Krč Forest in Prague 4
Forest paths with natural surfaces
Picturesque views and peaceful surroundings

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Olomouc
location: Výstaviště Flora Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Olomouc is a charity running event held in Flora Park. Participants can choose between a 2.5 km course (1 lap) and a 5 km course (2 laps). The run starts at 21:00, and registration opens at 19:00. The event is both a sporting challenge and a way to support the Světluška project, which helps people with severe visual impairments. Participants can choose an entry option with a headlamp or a sports headband, adding to the safety and atmosphere of the night run.
course_highlights: The course runs through Flora Park in Olomouc
A choice of 2.5 km or 5 km course
A night run with an entry option that includes a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration is available through the GoOut.cz portal. Capacity is limited for participants’ safety and comfort. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards are admitted free of charge, but are not entitled to a headlamp or sports headband. Children under 15 accompanied by an adult are admitted free of charge, but do not receive a headlamp or headband. A cloakroom and baggage storage are available on site. Refreshments and medical services are provided throughout the event. The accompanying programme includes a concert and other activities.

name: Kateřinský běh Hrabovou
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Kateřinský běh Hrabovou is a traditional running race in Ostrava-Hrabová, held in spring. The main course passes the historic Church of St. Catherine, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The event offers 5 km and 2.5 km races, including children’s races and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Participants can enjoy not only a sporting challenge but also an accompanying program and refreshments after the race.
course_highlights: The course passes the historic Church of St. Catherine
Main race: 5 km; shorter course: 2.5 km
A 5 km Nordic Walking event is available
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. Registration and the start take place on Bažanova Street in front of the Hrabová Municipal District Office. The entry fee includes a medal for participants who register by 13 April 2026, participation in the Hrabová and Moravian-Silesian Running Cups (for the 5 km race), a reusable race number with a chip, SMS results service, refreshments after the race, changing rooms and toilets, and an accompanying program. Participants are advised not to wear headphones during the race, and their race number must be attached to their chest. Photos and videos will be taken for promotional purposes.

name: Szczyt Wytrzymałości
description: Szczyt Wytrzymałości is an extreme mountain race held on a loop of approximately 4.5 km around Mount Równica in Ustroń. The course features significant elevation gain of around 420 metres per loop, making it physically and mentally demanding. Competitors can choose one of two categories: the 12-hour category, where the number of completed loops counts, or the 24-hour 8848 Everest category, symbolising a climb of Mount Everest. The race is for warriors who want to test their endurance, character and determination on a challenging, technical course.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 4.5 km with +/- 420 m of elevation gain per lap
Narrow trails, steep climbs and technical descents
A course described as one of the most demanding loops in Polish mountain running
additional: Two race categories: 12H (12 hours to complete as many loops as possible) and 8848 Everest (21 laps, approximately 95 km, a 24-hour limit, symbolising a climb of Mount Everest). The race takes place on a loop around Mount Równica, known for its difficult conditions and significant elevation gain. The course demands great endurance and determination, and the race is a rite of passage and a test of character. Source information describes the 2026 editions, so details about the date of 16 April 2027 are unconfirmed. At the December edition, the start, finish and race office were located at Gościniec Równica.

name: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov
location: Vranov nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Základnej škole Sídlisko II.
description: The Friendly Night Run through the City of Vranov is a traditional running event in Vranov nad Topľou, offering a nighttime running experience through the city. The race takes place at the Sídlisko II Primary School grounds and is open to men, women, and children. The main category starts at 19:30, and the children’s run begins at 17:00. The organizers—OZ S rukou v ruke, Sídlisko II Primary School, the City of Vranov nad Topľou, and OZ Vranovské Vydry—warmly invite all runners to enjoy a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience.

name: 19 Mini Cracovia Maraton im. Piotra Gład...
description: The Cracovia Marathon is the most important running event in Kraków and Poland’s largest spring marathon. It has been held since 2002. The 42 km and 195 m course passes through historic and modern parts of the city, including the Main Market Square, Wawel Royal Castle and Nowa Huta. The event attracts runners from around the world and is held under the slogan “with history in the background.” The marathon weekend also features accompanying races, including the Piotr Gładki Mini Cracovia Marathon, the 10 km Night Run, roller-skating events and Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Kraków’s Main Market Square
The course passes Wawel Royal Castle and the Cloth Hall
The route passes modern venues such as TAURON Arena Kraków and the ICE Kraków Congress Centre
additional: The marathon weekend also includes the Piotr Gładki Mini Cracovia Marathon (4.2 km), the 10 km Night Run, the Cracovia Marathon on Roller Skates (the full marathon distance, to be completed in a maximum of 3 hours) and a 4.2 km Nordic walking event. Athletes with disabilities compete in wheelchairs in the handbike, rim-push and active-wheelchair categories. In the edition described in the source, registration was open until 10 April or until the entry limit was reached; a “School in the Run” classification for students was also planned. Information about fees and registration applies to the edition described, and not necessarily to the 2027 edition.

name: II Leśny Lament
location: Ośrodek Sportowo-Rekreacyjny „Grzybówka”, ul. Podgórna 50, Rybnik, Poland
description: II Leśny Lament is a trail run in Rybnik, based at the “Grzybówka” Sports and Recreation Centre. The route follows forest trails, making the event a chance for runners to enjoy off-road running and test themselves on natural terrain. Previous editions featured 4-, 6- and 8-hour formats.
course_highlights: Forest trails and natural terrain
Start and base at the “Grzybówka” Sports and Recreation Centre in Rybnik
Previous editions offered 4-, 6- and 8-hour formats
additional: Previous editions of the event took place at 50 Podgórna Street in Rybnik.

name: 7 Nocna Dycha
description: Nocna Dycha Brzeg is a 10 km road race held in Brzeg, Opole Voivodeship. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), guaranteeing official measurement and high quality. The race attracts night-running enthusiasts, offering a unique atmosphere and the chance to compete on a certified course in the city centre.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
PZLA certification guaranteeing official distance measurement
The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
additional: 1,196 runners took part in the 2026 edition.

name: 7. 6 godzin pełnej MOCY
location: Stadion OSiR Targówek, ul. Łabiszyńska 20, Warsaw, Poland
price_range: Bieg indywidualny: 260 zł; sztafeta: 640 zł (ceny z edycji 2026)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa w biegu indywidualnym wynosi 260 zł (dla członków Stowarzyszenia 230 zł)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa w biegu sztafetowym wynosi dla całej sztafety 640 zł (dla sztafet w 100% z członków Stowarzyszenia 540 zł)

description: The 7th edition of the “6 Hours of Full POWER” race will take place on 17 April 2027 at the OSiR Targówek stadium in Warsaw. The event features individual and relay races lasting 6 hours, run on loops approximately 400 m and 422 m long. Participants compete in two groups simultaneously, with results combined. An official split time is recorded at 50 km. The event also includes the Mazovia Relay Running Championships.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a stadium course with loops measuring 400 m and 422.382 m
Official split time at 50 km
Two groups compete simultaneously, with combined results
additional: Participant limit: 70 individual runners and 16 relay teams. A relay team may consist of 4 women, 4 men, or be mixed (at least one woman). The organizer assigns participants to start groups. The entry fee must be paid to the account of the POLSKIE ULTRA Sports Association after completing the registration form. The 7th edition took place on 18 April 2026 at the OSiR Targówek stadium, ul. Łabiszyńska 20. Information about the edition scheduled for 17 April 2027 has not been confirmed.

name: 9 Dziesiątka Babicka
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Stare Babice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Zapisy na biegi dziecięce do 31 marca 2026

description: Skynet Dziesiątka Babicka is the largest running event organized in the Municipality of Stare Babice near Warsaw, aimed at running and healthy-lifestyle enthusiasts. The centerpiece is the main 10 km race on a certified course, following flat asphalt roads with an uphill section in the final 100 meters. The event also includes children’s races over shorter distances, without timing and divided into age categories. Participants receive race packs containing a bib with a chip, a commemorative T-shirt, and a sponsor pack. The start and finish are located at 32 Rynek Street in Stare Babice. The time limit for completing the main race is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 10 km course
Entirely asphalt and flat, with an uphill section in the final 100 meters
Start and finish at Stare Babice Municipal Office, 32 Rynek Street
additional: Race packs can be collected at Stare Babice Primary School, 40 Polna Street, on April 17 (17:00–20:00) and April 18 (7:00–11:30). Each pack contains a race bib with a chip, safety pins, a commemorative T-shirt, and a sponsor pack. The start line will close 10 minutes after the starter’s gun. The time limit for completing the main race is 1.5 hours, with an additional 10-minute allowance for runners who pass the 9 km mark after the cutoff. The children’s races start at 9:45, are untimed, and every participant receives a medal. Awards ceremonies take place on the main stage immediately after each children’s race.

name: Bieg Daniela
description: Daniel’s Run is an annual running event held in Smolarnia, in the Strzeleczki municipality. This is the fifth edition of the event, which combines sporting competition with the joy of movement and good fun. Participants can take on a course full of sporting energy, regardless of their experience level. The run is open to everyone who wants to spend time actively and enjoy the atmosphere of running together.
course_highlights: Previous editions included 5 km and 10 km races.
Juniors and people who practice Nordic walking also took part in the event.
The run takes place in Smolarnia, in the Strzeleczki municipality.
additional: Daniel’s Run takes place in Smolarnia and is a sports and recreation event that promotes the joy of movement and good fun. It is a local event organized by the Strzeleczki Municipal Office. In previous editions, runners competed for personal bests or simply for the satisfaction of finishing the race with a smile. Information about the 2027 edition has not been confirmed on the official website; the running calendar lists an indicative date of 18 April 2027 and a distance of 10 km.

name: Bieg po Zdrowie
organizer: Zespół Szkół nr 1 im. Powstańców Śląskich w Kędzierzynie-Koźlu
description: The 11th Run for Health is an annual running event organized in Kędzierzyn-Koźle by the Powstańcy Śląscy No. 1 School Complex. The race takes place on an urban course with professional RFID timing, ensuring precise results. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and participants can expect smooth organization and a sporting atmosphere. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among local residents.
course_highlights: Urban course in Kędzierzyn-Koźle
Professional RFID timing
Organized by a local school – the Powstańcy Śląscy No. 1 School Complex
additional: The event uses electronic RFID timing provided by Time-Sport.pl. The organizer provides comprehensive technical support and timing. The event is open to all and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: II Półmaraton Karolewo - Pruszcz
description: The 2nd Karolewo–Pruszcz Half Marathon is a certified 21.0975 km race taking place on 17 April 2027. The course is entirely paved, flat and marked every kilometre, making it conducive to good results. The race office is open on race day, and participants receive race packs containing, among other things, a bib, a timing chip, a T-shirt and a voucher for a recovery meal. The event is organised by the Agro-Economic School Complex in Karolewo, and timing is provided by STS-Timing.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course
Entirely paved and flat
Course marked every 1 kilometre
additional: The race office is open on race day from 8:30 to 16:00. Race packs contain a bib, a timing chip, safety pins, a voucher for a recovery meal, running memorabilia and a T-shirt. Participants should indicate their T-shirt size in the registration form. Unclaimed race packs will not be mailed or made available at a later date.

name: II Żelechowska Nocna Piątka
organizer: Żelechów Aktywni Sportowo oraz Miasto i Gmina Żelechów
description: The 2nd Żelechów Night Five is an annual race held in Żelechów that kicks off the running season in the town. The event attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, offering a sporting atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time actively. The race takes place in the evening, giving it a distinctive character and an added attraction for participants. It is organised by the local authorities of the town and municipality of Żelechów together with the Żelechów Aktywni Sportowo group.
course_highlights: Evening road race in Żelechów
5 km distance
First stage of the 2nd Żelechów Running Triad
additional: The race takes place in the evening and is organised by the Żelechów Aktywni Sportowo group. The event is part of the local sporting calendar and aims to promote physical activity among residents. Registration for the race is open. The stated date, 17 April 2027, does not match the organiser’s account of the edition held on 18 April 2026.

name: III Mistrzostwa Polski Masters
organizer: Koszalińskie Towarzystwo Krzewienia Kultury Fizycznej i Polski Związek Lekkiej Atletyki Masters
description: The 3rd Polish Masters Championships is a race organized by the Koszalin Society for the Promotion of Physical Culture, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The competition takes place on Chełmska Mountain in Koszalin and is aimed at masters-category runners. The event combines recreational and competitive sport, with chip timing and overall classifications for women and men. The organizer provides third-party liability insurance, and participants can expect official award ceremonies.
course_highlights: A race on the natural terrain of Chełmska Mountain
Timing with reusable chips attached to shoes
Overall classifications for women and men, with trophies for places 1–3
additional: Information in the sources describes the event held on April 18, 2026; the date April 17, 2027, has not been confirmed. A license was not required for the 2026 edition.

name: Kresowe Trail #2
description: Kresowe Trail in Mielnik is a small-scale trail race held in the scenic Topolina woodland. The event offers two distances: the shorter Szpurt (7.8 km) and the longer Wertep (15.6 km), along carefully marked routes with natural surfaces and green markings. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature, and the local natural and cultural attractions of eastern Poland. Participants can expect professional organization, electronic timing, aid stations along the course and at the finish, and commemorative medals for those who register in advance.
course_highlights: Routes marked with green arrows on a yellow background
Two laps on the Wertep 15.6 km distance
An aid station along the Wertep course
additional: Online registration is available until 08:40 on race day. The first race bib is free; if it is lost or you change distances, you can purchase a replacement for 30 zł. The course time limit is 2 hours 15 minutes. The race package includes a hot recovery meal with a vegetarian option, electronic timing, medical support, aid stations at the finish and along the course, and a photography service. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited. The 2026 edition started at 11:00 and had a time limit of 2 hours 15 minutes. The organizer announced electronic timing, medical support, and a hot recovery meal.

name: Nocna Piątka po Głogowskiej Starówce
description: Nocna Piątka po Głogowskiej Starówce is an annual road race held in Głogów. Its scenic course runs along the Nadodrzański Boulevard and through the city’s Old Town. The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere for participants. It is organized by the ZG RUN Sports Club with the support of the local community and the School of Economics in Głogów. It is a great opportunity to compete and spend time actively in the heart of the city.
course_highlights: The course passes through scenic Głogów Old Town
The race takes place in the evening, giving it a distinctive nighttime character
The start and finish are located on Nadodrzański Boulevard
additional: You can officially and safely purchase a race package from another participant. Races for children are also organized. Event locations listed include Nadodrzański Boulevard and the School of Economics in Głogów.

name: OSHEE Bieg Nocny
description: OSHEE Night Run is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque heart of Kraków, at the Main Market Square. This unique sporting event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering a nighttime atmosphere and professional organization. The course runs through the city’s historic streets, making the race not only a sporting challenge but also an unforgettable adventure. The organizers ensure participants’ comfort and safety along the course.
course_highlights: 10 km course in the center of Kraków
The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
The course runs through the historic streets around the Main Market Square
additional: Telephone support is available Monday to Friday, 8:00–15:00, at +48 12 616 63 02. Organizer: Sports Infrastructure Management Board in Kraków.

name: Pobiegnij z Siódemką
location: Park Kultury i Wypoczynku and Lasek Południowy, Słupsk, Poland
organizer: Niepubliczna Szkoła Podstawowa nr 7 im. Marii Skłodowskiej-Curie w Słupsku
description: Pobiegnij z Siódemką is a charity cross-country race organized by the Maria Skłodowska-Curie Non-Public Primary School No. 7 in Słupsk. The event takes place in the Park of Culture and Recreation and the Southern Forest, and aims to support the treatment and rehabilitation of a child with a cleft palate. The race combines sporting competition with helping those in need, engaging the local community and sponsors. This is the event’s fourth edition, and it has developed a charitable and community-building character.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Park of Culture and Recreation and the Southern Forest
Charity race supporting the treatment of a child with a cleft palate
High-quality organization thanks to support from local sponsors
additional: The race is a charity event, and the funds raised support Mateusz Gulbitowicz’s treatment. It is organized by a local school and supported by many regional sponsors. Previous editions raised more than 7,000 złoty for charitable causes. In previous editions, the race supported Mateusz’s treatment and rehabilitation; the funds were transferred to the Siepomaga Foundation’s account.

name: Sportowa Gra Miejska
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 4, Osiedle Paderewskiego, Katowice, Poland
description: The Sports City Game in Katowice is an extreme urban adventure taking place on April 18, 2026, in the Paderewski Estate and around the Three Ponds Valley. Participants can choose from three routes, including a family route with special tasks for parents and children. The game combines physical and logic-based challenges, offering a unique way to explore the city by completing a variety of tasks. The event attracts both fans of physical activity and those who want to discover the city in an unusual way.
course_highlights: Three routes to choose from, including a family route with special tasks
Explore the Paderewski Estate and the Three Ponds Valley
Physical and logic-based challenges at checkpoints
additional: Registration will be available on the day of the event. A two-person trip to Prague, Vienna or Budapest will be drawn after the awards ceremony. The event base is at Primary School No. 4 in the Paderewski Estate. Three routes have been announced, including a family route for parents and children. Event base: Primary School No. 4. Registration is set to open on March 9.

name: Wiosenna Hała
description: Wiosenna Hała is a walking orienteering marathon organized by KS Hała in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, in the village of Ruda. The event offers courses of varying difficulty, with the event base at Widok 1. Participants tackle challenging routes with numerous checkpoints, making it an event for fans of navigation and endurance. The start takes place in the afternoon, and the time limit for completing the course is 14 hours. Wiosenna Hała is a great opportunity to test your skills in the outdoors and compete with other orienteering enthusiasts.
course_highlights: TP50 course with 40 checkpoints
14-hour time limit to complete the course
Event base in Ruda, Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship
additional: The late-arrival time limit on the course is 14 hours. The TP50 course has 40 checkpoints. The event is organized by Klub Sportowy Hała. The event base is at the primary school in Ruda, Widok 1, 27-230 Ruda. A cycling course is also listed.

name: Mistrovství Moravy a Slezska v půlmaratonu + 24. Hanácký půlmaraton
description: The Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships, held alongside the 24th Haná Half Marathon, is a traditional athletics event organized by Atletický klub Olomouc. The race takes place on the athletics track in Olomouc and attracts runners from across Moravia and Silesia, who compete for championship titles. The event is known for its excellent organization and an atmosphere that supports both elite athletes and amateurs. The race starts at 9:00 in the morning and is part of the club’s wider athletics program.
course_highlights: The course follows the athletics track in Olomouc
Part of the Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships
An atmosphere that supports both elite runners and amateurs
additional: The race is part of the club’s wider athletics program, which includes youth categories and para athletics. The organizer is Atletický klub Olomouc, which has a rich tradition and experience organizing athletics events at the home stadium of TJ Lokomotiva Olomouc. The Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships are also held as part of the event.

name: Běh Javorkou
location: Park Javorka, Česká Třebová, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh Javorkou is a traditional spring running race with a long history, held every April in the beautiful setting of Javorka Park in Česká Třebová. The fast main race covers 6 km on firm park paths and is mildly undulating, making it suitable for strong performances. The race is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and offers categories for children, a main race, and team relays. Race facilities are located by the outdoor stage next to the Javorka restaurant.
course_highlights: 6 km loop course (with shorter options) on firm park paths (gravel, paving)
Mildly undulating course profile, suitable for fast running
Course markings in different colours by category
additional: Registration is available online in advance or on race day, no later than 20 minutes before the start of the relevant category. The race takes place on Saturday: the first children’s categories start at 9:30, the main race at 11:30, and the team relays at 12:10. Race facilities are located by the Music Pavilion in Javorka Park, next to the Javorka restaurant. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup series.

name: Žehrovický Kalspotkros
location: Kamenné Žehrovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Žehrovický Kalspotkros is a 6.2 km cross-country race with a rolling profile, held in Kamenné Žehrovice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves on challenging natural terrain. The course is suited to cross-country enthusiasts who appreciate a mix of hilly sections and natural scenery. A long-standing regional event, it welcomes runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 6.2 km cross-country course
Rolling profile with hilly sections
Natural scenery in Kamenné Žehrovice

name: Listonošův krpál
description: Listonošův krpál is an uphill race in Prague-Jarov near Zbraslav, measuring 2.88 km with 150 metres of elevation gain. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and challenges runners with a demanding climb. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and uphill running who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. The course is short but intense, making for a dynamic and exciting racing experience.
course_highlights: Course length: 2.88 km
Elevation gain: 150 m
Uphill race on terrain in Prague

name: Cena Tolštejnského panství Jiřetín pod Jedlovou – Jedlová
location: Jedlová Mountain summit, Lužické hory, Czech Republic
description: The Price of the Tolštejn Estate Jiřetín pod Jedlovou–Jedlová is a 6 km uphill race with 340 metres of elevation gain, finishing at the summit of Jedlová in the Lusatian Mountains. Part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup, the race offers runners challenging and beautiful terrain. The route passes through picturesque countryside and is ideal for mountain-running enthusiasts and anyone looking for a challenge. This traditional event attracts runners from across the country.
course_highlights: 6 km route with 340 m of elevation gain
Finish at the summit of Jedlová in the Lusatian Mountains
Part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup
additional: The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup.

name: SAFARIBĚH
location: Main Entrance, Safari Park Dvůr Králové, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: The ČSOB Safari Run is a running race held at Safari Park Dvůr Králové, offering a unique running experience in the surroundings of the African and Walking Safaris. The race is open to the general public and offers three distance options: a 2 km family run, and 5 km and 10 km races. The start and finish are located by the safari park’s main entrance, and the routes run mostly along paved asphalt roads. The entry fee includes free admission to the safari park on race day and supports the protection of maneless zebras.
course_highlights: The 10 km route follows the same 5 km route twice through the African and Walking Safaris
The 5 km route runs through the African and Walking Safaris
The 2 km family race runs through the Lion Safari
additional: A race bib with a built-in chip, which runners keep. The entry fee includes a contribution to the protection of maneless zebras and free admission to the safari park, valid only on race day. After finishing, runners receive a voucher for refreshments (one drink and one meal), a commemorative medal, and a small snack (water and fruit). The family run includes activities for children at the stand of main partner ČSOB. The entry fee includes admission to the safari park on race day. The race supports the conservation of maneless zebras.

name: Jarní běh Dražovkou
location: Dražovka Forest Park, Hořovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Run through Dražovka is a traditional running race in Hořovice, offering runners of all ages the chance to enjoy a run in the picturesque Dražovka forest park. The course follows forest paths through varied terrain, providing interesting challenges and beautiful natural scenery. After the race, refreshments are available at the finish, including hot drinks and homemade pastries. The event is suitable for runners with a reasonable level of training, who take part at their own risk. Registration is online, preferably through the Brdský pohár.
course_highlights: Forest paths through the varied terrain of Dražovka forest park
Start by the children’s playground on Lesní Street in Hořovice
Refreshments at the finish, including tea, coffee, homemade pastries, and fruit
additional: Registration is online, preferably through the Brdský pohár. Runners take part at their own risk. Hot refreshments and homemade pastries are available at the finish after the race.

name: Husínský kros
location: Tajanov, Klatovy District, Plzeň Region, Czech Republic
description: Husínský Cross is a traditional and prestigious cross-country race held every spring since 2012 in Tajanov near Klatovy. The race was established to replace the cancelled Klatovská patnáctka and takes place in the birthplace of Czech running legend Vlastík Zwiefelhofer, who serves as chief referee. Men run three laps, while women and girls run two. Each lap is approximately 3.6 km long, with two-thirds on forest trails and one-third on smooth asphalt. Since 2022, the original, longer route around the perimeter of Husín Forest has been used again.
course_highlights: Approx. 3.6 km lap, mostly on forest trails with some smooth asphalt
The course runs around the perimeter of Husín Forest
Men run 3 laps; women and girls run 2 laps
additional: The race is part of the Ešus liga series in the Klatovy district. The course records are 38:22 for men (2012) and 29:56 for women (2018). The race starts by the tennis courts in Tajanov. The organiser is Jiří Přibík (tel. 608279305). The race is part of the Ešus liga series.

name: Bakovský půlmaraton
location: Náměstí, Bakov nad Jizerou, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 300 Kč pro předem přihlášené s platbou předem do 16.4.2026

description: The Bakov Half Marathon is a traditional road race with a long history, held in Bakov nad Jizerou. The certified course is exactly 21.097 km long and follows a hilly asphalt road with varying surface quality. It offers several refreshment stations. The race starts in the town square at 10:00 and is open to a wide range of runners across different age categories. It is organized by TJ Bakovský půlmaraton with the support of the municipal office and other local organizations.
course_highlights: Certified course measuring 21.097 km
Hilly asphalt road with varying surface quality
Refreshments at 9.7 km, 14.5 km, and at the finish
additional: Registration is also available on race day at the venue for 400 Kč. Check-in takes place from 8:00 to 9:45, approximately 150 m from the start. Categories are divided by age for men and women. Cash and in-kind prizes are offered, including bonuses for breaking records. The course records are 1:05:01 for men and 1:17:46 for women. According to the available description, advance registration has a lower entry fee than registration on race day.

name: Run for ProCit

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Na místě 600 Kč registrace 8:30–10:00 · hotovost i karta

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Na místě 600 Kč registrace 8:30–10:00 · hotovost i karta

description: Run for ProCit is a charity family run held in Borský Park in Plzeň, supporting families of children with autism. The event offers three distances: a children’s run of up to 600 metres, a 2 km run suitable for Nordic walking, and a 5 km run. Dogs are welcome (canicross), and the course follows flat loops with an optional colour zone. Entry fees go directly towards educational and sport-and-relaxation stays for families with children on the autism spectrum. The atmosphere is relaxed and free of competitive pressure, making the event suitable for all ages and for runners with strollers or trekking poles.
course_highlights: Flat loops in Borský Park
Optional colour zone along the course
Dog-friendly run (canicross) and Nordic walking with an instructor
additional: On-site registration is available from 8:30 to 10:00, with payment by cash or card. The entry fee includes a commemorative medal and prizes for the three fastest runners. The programme includes children’s runs at 10:00 and 10:10, the 2 km start at 10:15 and the 5 km start at 10:45, followed by the results ceremony and a raffle at 11:30. The run is also suitable for runners with strollers and walkers with trekking poles. This charity event supports families with children on the autism spectrum; runners with dogs are welcome.

name: ŘepoRun
description: Řepo Run is a running race held in Prague, offering courses for children and adults. The race route goes through the area around Řeporyje and is suitable for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the enthusiastic group of runners Run Labe Run, who want to offer a high-quality sporting experience. All participants receive a race pack and a medal after finishing; the winners receive prizes from sponsors.
course_highlights: The route goes through the area around Řeporyje
Children’s races: 200 m, 600 m and 1,300 m
Chip timing using a chip on the race bib
additional: Race packs can be collected from 9:00 to 11:45, depending on the category. Time is measured by a chip on the back of the race bib, which does not need to be returned. A bag drop and changing room are available. Using public transport is recommended due to limited parking. On-site registration is possible until capacity is reached.

name: Děčín RunFest
description: Děčín RUNFEST 2027 is a spring running festival in the heart of Bohemian Switzerland, offering a fast, certified course along the Elbe River and a family-friendly atmosphere at the event base on Mariánská Meadow. The race is for a broad running community, from elite distance runners to beginners and children. The festival combines athletic performances with a community spirit and an accompanying program that appeals not only to competitors but also to their families and friends. Mariánská Meadow provides an ideal setting with beautiful views of Děčín Castle and the Elbe River.
course_highlights: Certified, extremely fast course along the Elbe River
Event base at Mariánská Meadow with views of Děčín Castle
Family-friendly atmosphere and accompanying program for all age groups
additional: Registration and results are managed through the RaceTeam system. The race is inclusive and also offers activities for supporters and families. Places in the main races often sell out in advance, so early registration is recommended. The program also includes Nordic Walking.

name: Kotva race
description: Kotva Race is an OCR race held in Děčín, offering a challenging obstacle course for competitors born in 2011 or earlier. The race is known for its demanding course, and competitors under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. Registration is available online and on-site for an increased entry fee. Competitors must sign a liability waiver and follow the race rules.
course_highlights: A challenging OCR course with obstacles in Děčín’s natural surroundings
Open only to competitors born in 2011 or earlier
Competitors under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian
additional: On-site registration is available on race day from 8:00 to 9:15 for the main race and from 11:30 to 12:15 for the children’s race, for an increased entry fee. Competitors under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian and sign a liability waiver (REVERZ). Information about the courses, prices, and registration published on the website applies to the 2026 edition; details for the date 17 April 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Žákovský běh Bakovem
location: Atletická dráha u základní školy, Bakov nad Jizerou, Czech Republic
organizer: Školní sportovní klub při ZŠ Bakov nad Jizerou
description: The Bakov Schoolchildren’s Run is a traditional children’s running race held in Bakov nad Jizerou since 2002. Races take place on the athletics track by the primary school, with courses run in laps of approximately 300 metres. There are several age categories, from preschoolers to juniors, including relays. The event is held alongside the Bakov Half Marathon and is known for its friendly atmosphere and appearances by prominent athletes as guests. There is no entry fee, and registration takes place at the venue on race day.
course_highlights: Laps around the primary school’s athletics track, approximately 300 m per lap
Run on a paved path; running spikes may be used
Categories from preschoolers to juniors, including 4 × 300 m relays
additional: Registration takes place on race day in the theatre hall on the square and closes 30 minutes before the start of the relevant category. There is no entry fee. Relays have four members, including at least two girls; relay categories are determined by the age of the oldest member. The race is part of the Bakov Half Marathon programme, which starts at 10:00. The top finishers receive diplomas, medals and gifts from sponsors.

name: VALAŠSKÝ TRHÁK
location: Městský park střed, Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: Valašský trhák is a half marathon held in the heart of Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, which comes alive with a sporting atmosphere every spring. The race runs through the town park and offers runners an enjoyable experience in the beautiful surroundings of the Zlín Region. The event is suitable for the general public and brings a traditional sporting occasion with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A half marathon in the town park of Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Beautiful natural and urban surroundings in the Zlín Region
A sporting atmosphere in the heart of the town

name: Běh do vrchu Jiřetín - Jedlová
description: The Jiřetín–Jedlová Uphill Race is a traditional sporting event organized by the Varnsdorf Running Club, held in the beautiful surroundings of Jiřetín pod Jedlovou. It is part of the Czech Cup in Mountain Running and features a challenging 5.7 km course with 340 m of elevation gain. The race starts at the Jiřetín pod Jedlovou sports complex and finishes at the summit of Jedlová Mountain. It is suitable for a wide range of age categories and offers cash prizes for the top competitors as well as special prizes for records.
course_highlights: Course length: 5.7 km with 340 m of elevation gain
Surface: 10% asphalt, 60% gravel, 30% forest paths
Start at the Jiřetín pod Jedlovou sports complex (434 m above sea level); finish at the summit of Jedlová (774 m above sea level)
additional: The race is part of the Czech Cup in Mountain Running. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three in each category and for breaking the course record (500 CZK). The fastest man and woman based on their combined times from this race and the race at Studenec receive a 1,000 CZK prize. A running-themed raffle is held, with race numbers entered into the draw. Runners must wear their race number visibly on the front and participate at their own risk. Basic medical care is provided.

name: Dehtářská 10°
description: Dehtářská 10° is a running race in the Vysočina region, open to the general public and all age groups. It offers 5, 10 and 20 km courses through beautiful countryside with gentle elevation changes. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and its emphasis on personal achievement. It starts at the Kletečná recreational resort near Humpolec, with on-site registration on race day. The main 10 km race has approximately 85 metres of elevation gain and starts at 14:00.
course_highlights: 5, 10 and 20 km courses
Approximately 85 m of elevation gain in the main race
Beautiful Vysočina countryside around the Kletečná recreational resort
additional: Runners can register on race day at the venue from 11:00 to 13:30. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels. Capacity is limited, and registration often fills up quickly.

name: Běh O pohár století
description: The Běh O pohár století is a running race held in the picturesque Castle Park in Pacov. The race features a challenging course full of hills, descents, and turns that tests runners’ endurance and technique. The event is part of Český běh, a Czech Athletics Federation service focused on promoting running and running races in the Czech Republic. Registration is online only, and the race is suitable for the general public, including children.
course_highlights: A 3.2 km course with hills, descents, and turns
The race takes place in Castle Park in Pacov
Children’s races are also held
additional: Registration is online only. The race is part of Český běh, which also offers other running services and races. The course runs along a cinder track and country paths.

name: Beh Galantou – Beh oslobodenia
price_range: 15 € online, 12 € s GALAkartou; štafeta 40 € online, 32 € s GALAkartou; Samsung Run 10 €, 8 € s GALAkartou
description: Beh Galantou - Beh oslobodenia is the 40th anniversary edition of a traditional running event in Galanta, offering a range of disciplines for all age groups. The event is intended not only for athletes, but also for everyone who wants to experience an atmosphere full of emotion, the joy of movement and the challenge of surpassing themselves. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, refreshments and drinks; children also receive a ticket to the Galandia Water World and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners receive cash prizes and valuable prizes, including televisions in special categories. After the race, a cultural programme is planned at the Municipal Cultural Centre in Galanta.
course_highlights: Courses for beginner and advanced runners
A commemorative medal for every participant, including children
More than 40 valuable prizes in the final raffle
additional: Registration opens at 8:00 on the day of the event and closes 20 minutes before the start of each category. Children receive a ticket to the Galandia Water World and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners do not receive cups, but valuable cut glass. Winners in the special categories must hold a GalaKARTA. After the race, a cultural programme is planned at the Municipal Cultural Centre. The event includes various disciplines, prizes, refreshments and a cultural programme. Registration is online, and road closures are expected during the races.

name: Malkovský krosový polmaratón – Memoriál Vlada Dančišina
location: Parkovisko pod Furčou, Borkút, Haniska pri Prešove, Slovakia

name: Ultramaratón Miškolc - Košice
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice–Miskolc Ultramarathon is a prestigious running event held on April 18, 2026. Runners travel from Košice to Miskolc along a demanding ultramarathon course. The event is part of the region’s rich running calendar and offers a unique experience for endurance runners. It is organized by Maratónsky klub Košice, which ensures professional planning and organization.

name: BoleRuN
location: Boleráz, Boleráz, areál TJ Slavoj Boleráz
description: BoleRuN is a running event held at the TJ Slavoj Boleráz sports complex, offering races for different age groups, including children, teenagers and adults. Competitors can choose distances from 50 metres to 10 km. The children’s races start at 13:00 and the adults’ race at 14:00. The event is organised by the Municipality of Boleráz in cooperation with the Boleráz – Get Moving initiative. It is open to runners aged 9 and over who want to enjoy a day of sport in a pleasant setting.

name: Šarišská míľa
location: Šarišské Bohdanovce, Šarišské Bohdanovce, Futbalové ihrisko
description: Šarišská Mile is a running event organized by BK ZasRun in Šarišské Bohdanovce at the football field. The race is intended for various age groups, including children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking participants. The starts are divided into a children’s mile, running, and Nordic Walking for women and men. Participation is free, with the option to make a voluntary contribution during registration. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all abilities and ages.

name: Chlieb náš….
location: Hronský Beňadik, Hronský Beňadik, pekáreň Dumas
description: Chlieb Náš is an artisan bakery in Hronský Beňadik that makes sourdough bread using traditional methods and quality ingredients. It takes pride in honest baking, reflected in the bread’s crisp crust, lively sourdough starter and soft interior. The bakery offers an authentic experience where you can choose fresh bread straight from the oven. In addition to the quality of its bread, the bakery is also known for its unique Baroque ceiling, one of the most original in Trnava.

name: Beh oslobodenia Turčianska Štiavnička
location: Turčianska Štiavnička, Turčianska Štiavnička, futbalové ihrisko
description: The Turčianska Štiavnička Liberation Run is a traditional race with a rich history, held to mark the anniversary of the village’s liberation by the Soviet Army. The 32nd edition will take place on 18 April 2026 at the football field in Turčianska Štiavnička. The approximately 10 km course runs mostly through mountainous terrain and offers runners a challenging but beautiful experience. Competitors are divided into age categories, with awards also given in the children’s categories and to the best runners from Štiavnička. The organizers welcome all runners and look forward to their participation.

name: Banská Bystrica - Bežíme spolu v Banskej Bystrici
description: We Run Together in Banská Bystrica is a running event held in the park below the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica. It offers four routes of different lengths, including a children’s run, suitable for the general public, including children under 6. The route is flat with no elevation gain, making for an enjoyable run for all age groups. The event supports people with disabilities, with €2 from every entry fee going towards motivating them to be physically active.

name: Polus Tower Run
distance_verbose: 534 km, 50 km, Maratón, Polmaratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 11.5 km, 10 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 1 km
description: Polus Tower Run is a unique stair-running event taking place on April 18, 2026, at the Polus Tower 2 office building in Bratislava. Competitors climb the elevation under their own power on two courses: a children’s course with 4 floors and 116 steps, and the main adult course with 19 floors and 416 steps. Runners start individually at 30-second intervals, and times are recorded using an electronic system. The event is organized by the KOTRMELEC Sports Foundation and conducted under current TWA rules.

name: Bėgimas „Tropem Wilczym 2026“
organizer: Lenkijos Respublikos ambasada Vilniuje, Lietuvos lenkų jaunimas, asociacija „Sporto renginiai“
description: The international “Tropem Wilczym 2026” run will take place in Vingis Park, Vilnius, and is dedicated to honoring members of the anti-Nazi, anti-communist, and anti-Soviet underground. The event promotes running and athletics in Lithuania, encourages a healthy lifestyle, and aims to bring together runners of all ages. Participants can choose from several distances, and the event is organized with a strong focus on safety and professionalism. It is a great opportunity for both professionals and amateurs to take part in a meaningful sporting event.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Vingis Park near the band shell
Distances: the symbolic 1963 m run, 5.2 km, 10.5 km, and a half marathon
The course will be closed and traffic restrictions introduced to ensure safety
additional: On race day, the timing system will operate until 13:30; after that, times will not be recorded. The number of participants is limited to 1,200. It is possible to switch to a shorter distance for a €2 fee. Participants must bring an ID document to collect their race bib. The event combines sport and history, offers several distances, including the symbolic 1,963-metre course, and emphasizes the importance of community. Participant age groups apply, and the use of vehicles or personal escorts is prohibited.

name: Kudowska Sztafeta Górska
description: Kudowska Mountain Relay is an international running event held in the scenic areas of Table Mountains National Park and Broumovské Stěny in Kudowa-Zdrój. The event includes a 3x25 km relay for teams of three and a solo run of approximately 75 km. There are also races over 42 km, 21 km, and 10 km, as well as Kids Trail races for children. The start and finish are in Kudowa-Zdrój Spa Park, and the routes follow varied mountain trails, offering exceptional views and challenging climbs.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Table Mountains National Park and Broumovské Stěny
The 3x25 km relay is divided into three different stages
A solo run of approximately 75 km with a challenging mountain profile
additional: The start and finish of all races are in Kudowa-Zdrój Spa Park, by the Teatr pod Blachą. The race office is located in the Mineral Water Pump Room in Kudowa-Zdrój. The event takes place on 10–11 April 2027. Entry-fee waivers are available to athletes with a high ITRA ranking. The organizer does not provide accommodation but recommends Kudowa-Zdrój as a place to stay. There are also races for children in three age categories and over three distances. Volunteering opportunities are available; the coordinator is Sylwia Niezgódka. The event is scheduled for 10–11 April 2027. Online registration is available; the organizer also announces fee waivers and preferential rates for selected athletes with an ITRA ranking.

name: 8. Gdańsk Maraton
description: Energa Gdańsk Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The marathon route passes some of the city’s most distinctive landmarks, including the European Solidarity Centre, the retractable footbridge to Ołowianka Island, the Baltic Philharmonic, the Neptune’s Fountain, the Gdańsk Shakespeare Theatre, and ERGO Arena. The start and finish are at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The event uses staggered start waves, and participants can expect a full race pack and extensive support along the course.
course_highlights: The route passes the European Solidarity Centre and the retractable footbridge to Ołowianka Island
Views of the Baltic Philharmonic, Neptune’s Fountain, and the Gdańsk Shakespeare Theatre
The start and finish are at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, with a visit to ERGO Arena
additional: The marathon starts in waves. The start line will close 5 minutes after the final starting signal. Holders of a Gdańsk resident card receive a 10% discount on the entry fee. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a medal, medical support, course refreshment stations, a hot meal at the finish, and gifts from sponsors. The official marathon T-shirt and backpack are available for purchase. The event is scheduled for 24–25 April 2027; the website lists the marathon, a 5 km race, a relay, and the Junior Marathon. Entry fee details are not provided in the available sources.

name: 15 Półmaraton Henrykowski
description: The 15th Henryków Half Marathon is a trail race that passes through scenic parts of Lower Silesia, including Krzelków, Muszkowice and Muszkowicki Forest. The start and finish are by the historic Cistercian Monastery in Henryków, adding a historical and cultural dimension to the event. The route combines asphalt and gravel surfaces, offering runners varied terrain. The event promotes physical activity, regional culture and local tourism. Participants can expect a commemorative T-shirt, a medal and a recovery meal.
course_highlights: The route passes through Krzelków, Muszkowice and Muszkowicki Forest
Asphalt and gravel surfaces
Start and finish by the historic Cistercian Monastery in Henryków
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:45 on race day. Race numbers with timing chips are issued at the race office upon presentation of a QR code. Participants receive a technical T-shirt, a medal and a recovery meal. Bag drop and toilets are available at the start. Overall and age-group classifications are provided for the 21 km and 10 km races and the 10 km Nordic Walking event. Cash prizes are awarded to the top finishers in the half marathon. The route is not certified by PZLA. A 10 km race and 10 km Nordic Walking event are also available. Information about the 15th edition refers to 19 April 2026; there is no confirmation that the event will take place on 18 April 2027.

name: Bieg Pamięci - wokół Góry Śmierci
location: Ekspozycja Historyczno-Dydaktyczna przy Górze Śmierci, Paszczyna, Poland
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Dębica, Gmina Dębica, Akademia Piłkarska Gminy Dębica „Chemik Pustków” i Kępa Sport
description: The Memorial Run around Góra Śmierci is an annual sporting event held in Paszczyna to commemorate the victims of Nazi labor camps and promote a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. The event takes place at the Historical and Educational Exhibition at Góra Śmierci and includes children’s races over short distances, a 5 km Nordic Walking march, and a 10 km main race. Main-race participants receive a race package, and classifications and prizes are provided for both children and adults in various age categories. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: 10 km main-race route around Góra Śmierci
5 km Memorial Nordic Walking march
Children’s and youth races over distances from 50 m to 1,000 m
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 11:30 and closes 15 minutes before the start of each distance. The main-race entry fee includes a race package. Prizes are awarded for places 1–3 in the main race, as well as in the age-group classifications. OPEN category winners are not also awarded in the age groups. The event takes place at the Historical and Educational Exhibition at Góra Śmierci in Paszczyna. Registration is handled by KępaSport.

name: Bydgoski Bieg Urodzinowy
description: The Bydgoszcz Birthday Run is an annual running event held in Bydgoszcz, taking place on April 18, 2027. The race starts at 11:00. The participant limit is 1,500, and the first 1,300 people to register will receive a T-shirt. The route will be announced soon. The event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels.
additional: Participant limit: 1,500. A T-shirt is available to the first 1,300 people to register. A T-shirt is provided for the first 1,300 registered participants.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Arek Tołłoczko i Rafał Malitkowski, przy wsparciu Stowarzyszenia na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale running event held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The marathon route follows forest and country roads in a peaceful, uncrowded setting, with an emphasis on camaraderie and the recreational nature of the race. The organizers, including Arek Tołłoczko, invite runners to take part in four editions of the marathon each year, offering varied conditions and beautiful views. The start and finish are on Polna Street, and the route is well marked and prepared for runners.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km route along forest and country roads
Start and finish on Polna Street in Chwałowice
Picturesque views of forests and fields, with a peaceful, uncrowded atmosphere
additional: A 7 km running route laid out and marked by the Harcownik Running Club; the event is not mass-participation, with a relaxed approach to competition and prizes; convenient parking; four marathons held each year (in winter, spring, summer, and autumn). Descriptions of previous races indicate a marathon distance of 42.195 km; the organizers have not provided confirmed details for the edition on 18 April 2027.

name: Cross na sześć łap
description: Uniejów Cross on Six Paws is a unique race for dog-loving sports enthusiasts, held in the picturesque Warta River areas near Uniejów Castle. Participants can choose between 5- and 10-kilometre routes, combining sport, adventure and time in nature. The race ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, a canicross world champion, who brings his experience and passion to the course. At the finish, medals, trophies for the top finishers and refreshments await both runners and their four-legged companions. The event is open to anyone who wants to spend active time with their dog and enjoy a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route passes through picturesque areas along the Warta River near Uniejów Castle
Distances of 5 and 10 kilometres are available
Run as a duo with your dog, surrounded by nature
additional: At the finish, participants will receive medals, trophies for the top finishers, refreshments and water, as well as treats for dogs. The event takes place by Uniejów Castle. The race ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, 2025 IFSS Canicross World Champion. Advance registration is required. The previous edition also featured children's races over 100 and 300 m. The event ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, 2025 IFSS Canicross World Champion.

name: Dziki tor run
description: Dziki Tor Run is the inaugural edition of a race held on the motocross track on Hoża Street in Mieroszów. It’s a unique opportunity to test your endurance on natural, challenging terrain where enduro motorcycles compete every day. The course has no technical obstacles, but its natural slopes and bumps challenge participants. The race is open to both beginners and more experienced runners looking for a thrill.
course_highlights: Motocross/enduro track with natural terrain
No technical obstacles, but challenging slopes and bumps
Course in Mieroszów on Hoża Street
additional: Distances: 4 km (one lap) for beginners and 8 km (two laps) for more experienced runners. Registration is open until 15 April at 23:59. The race starts at 11:30. The event takes place on the motocross track on Hoża Street in Mieroszów. Available calendars list an estimated date of 19 April 2027, one day later than the stated date of 18 April.

name: IV Białołęcki Bieg Leśny
description: The 4th Białołęka Forest Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw’s Białołęka district. The race takes place on a forest course, giving participants the chance to enjoy nature and varied running conditions. The organizer, the Małopolskie Szlaki Foundation, provides professional event services and RFID timekeeping. The participant limit is 500, and the start is scheduled for 10:00.
course_highlights: Forest course in Warsaw’s Białołęka district
Professional RFID timekeeping
Participant limit of 500
additional: The participant limit is 500. The event takes place in Warsaw’s Białołęka district. The organizer provides electronic RFID timekeeping. The start is at 10:00. The participant limit for the 2026 edition was 500. Registration closed on April 13, 2026; timekeeping was provided by Time-Sport.pl.

name: IX Bieg Jelenia
description: Bieg Jelenia is the open Tychy cross-country championships, held in the scenic Paprocany forests. The course is approximately 7–8 km long and consists of two 3.5–4 km loops, following forest tracks and terrain with natural obstacles such as roots, mud, fallen branches and soft sand. The event is co-financed by the City of Tychy and also includes Bieg Jelonka for children and young people. The race starts at the Paprocany Recreation Centre in Tychy.
course_highlights: A 7–8 km cross-country course over two loops
Natural obstacles: roots, mud, fallen branches and soft sand
The scenic Paprocany forests
additional: Bieg Jelonka for children and young people also takes place during the event. The start and finish are at the Paprocany Recreation Centre (Parkowa 17, Tychy). The race is co-financed from the City of Tychy budget. Bieg Jelonka for children and young people accompanies the event. Available information about the ninth edition points to 2026, so details of the specified edition and the 2027 date may not be confirmed.

name: Poznań Półmaraton
location: ul. Roosevelta near Międzynarodowe Targi Poznańskie, Poznań, Poland
description: The PKO Poznań Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Poznań, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half-marathon course runs through the city streets, offering an exciting sporting experience and an opportunity to test your fitness. The organizers make sure the event has a family-friendly atmosphere, also offering an activity zone and races for children and young people. The event is well organized and highly regarded in the running community.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course runs through the streets of Poznań.
In 2026, the race started on Roosevelta Street, near the Poznań International Fair.
The previous edition’s course ran through Łazarz, Grunwald, Junikowo and Ławica.
additional: Registration for the 19th PKO Poznań Half Marathon will open in December. The rules and price list are being finalized and will be announced soon.
