The organizers are providing an activity zone and races for children and young people as accompanying events. The course and program are being prepared, and participants are encouraged to follow the official information channels. Registration for the 2027 edition is expected to open in December; the entry form is being prepared.

name: Siedlecki Maraton Na Raty
organizer: Fundacja Ultramaratonu Nadbużańskiego, Agencja Rozwoju Miasta Siedlce oraz Triathlon Siedlce Club
description: The Siedlce Stage Marathon is a unique running event held in Siedlce, offering two distances to choose from: a marathon and a half marathon. The race takes place in three stages at three different locations: City Park, Sekulski Forest, and Muchawka Reservoir, making it an exciting challenge spread over three days. The event has a new format that allows participants to tackle the distance in stages, and also includes races for children. The organizers provide professional event support and an awards ceremony at the finish.
course_highlights: Three stages held at three locations: City Park, Sekulski Forest, and Muchawka Reservoir
Choice of distance: marathon or half marathon
Children’s races during the final stage
additional: The race office is open on April 17 from 17:00 to 18:30 at the Rectorate of the University in Siedlce. The awards ceremony will take place on April 19 at around 15:15 by Muchawka Reservoir. Children’s races take place during the final stage, starting at 14:45. Participants may use poles; Nordic Walking is classified only in the half marathon. The combined participant limit for the marathon and half marathon is 200. Information about fees and details of the 2027 edition is not available in the sources provided. Previous editions also featured children’s races and Nordic Walking competition over the half-marathon distance.

name: TAURON 23. Cracovia Maraton
description: The Cracovia Marathon is Kraków’s most important running event and Poland’s largest spring marathon over the 42 km and 195 m distance. Held since 2002, it attracts runners from around the world, representing more than 80 countries. The course passes through historic and modern parts of Kraków, with the start and finish on the Main Market Square, beside landmarks such as Wawel Royal Castle and the Cloth Hall. The event also offers a weekend full of sporting attractions, including the 10 km Night Run, the Mini Cracovia Marathon, roller-skating races and Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Kraków’s Main Market Square
The course passes Wawel Royal Castle and the Cloth Hall
Views of the Old Town at night during the 10 km Night Run
additional: The event also includes the Mini Cracovia Marathon (4.2 km), the Cracovia Marathon on Skates (the full distance around the Błonia, with a maximum time limit of 3 hours), a 4.2 km Nordic walking event and the 10 km Night Run, with a time limit of 1.5 hours. Participants with disabilities compete in wheelchairs in the handbike, rim push and active wheelchair categories. The event is international in character and is held under the slogan “with history in the background”.

name: VI Oleśnicki Bieg Leśny
location: Miodary, Oleśnica County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 6th Oleśnica Forest Run is a trail race held in the picturesque area of Miłowice. The event attracts runners who enjoy natural forest terrain, offering a challenging course with varied surfaces. Open to all, it is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and compete with runners of varying experience levels.
course_highlights: Forest course with varied surfaces
Picturesque views and natural surroundings
Trail challenges for runners
additional: The available information about the sixth edition concerns an event scheduled for 19 April 2026; it does not confirm a date of 18 April 2027. In the 2026 edition, children’s races were scheduled for 10:00, the half marathon for 10:30, and the 10 km race and Nordic Walking for 11:00.

name: XVIII Bieg Piaśnicki
organizer: Gmina Wejherowo i The North Event
description: The Piaśnica Run commemorates the victims of the German occupation of Poland during World War II. The running and Nordic walking routes pass through places where thousands of innocent people were murdered. The event aims to honor the victims, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring the local community together. The program also includes cultural events such as exhibitions, lectures, and concerts that shed light on the history of Gdańsk Pomerania.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes through historic sites of wartime atrocities
Commemoration of the victims of the German occupation of Poland
Cultural events: exhibitions, lectures, concerts, and meetings with historians
additional: The event includes runs and Nordic walking. It promotes a healthy lifestyle and community integration. The event is commemorative and educational. Previous editions have also included races for children and young people. Details of the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed in available sources.

name: XXXIII Memoriał Uliczny im. Michała Flud...
Amberger Frühlingslauf mit Halbmarathon und 10 km
Hammer Charity Frühlingslauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 6.4 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 1 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: Bolatická 20
location: Local swimming pool, Bolatice, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatek účastníka pochodu 30kč (děti do a včetně 15 let zdarma).

description: Bolatická dvacítka is a traditional running race and walking event held every year in the area around Bolatice. The race offers 20 km and 10 km courses, which run mainly through forest terrain, combining cross-country sections and asphalt. The start and finish are at the local swimming pool. The route is marked in yellow, and the race takes place in normal road traffic, so participants must follow the rules. The event is suitable for runners and hikers and is followed by an informal gathering with country music.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly through the forest around the Strahovské ponds and Chuchelnický forest
A combination of cross-country sections and asphalt roads
The route is marked in yellow
additional: On-site registration for runners is open from 8:00 to 8:55; those registered in advance only need to collect their race number. The walk starts between 7:30 and 9:00. After the race, from 12:00, there will be an informal gathering with the country band CARAVANA. The race takes place in normal road traffic, and participants must follow the rules of the road. The start and finish are at the local swimming pool.

name: Běh kolem Hluboké 25 km - Krajský přebor v silničním běhu
description: The Run Around Hluboká is a traditional regional road-running championship over 25 km, held in the picturesque setting of Hluboká nad Vltavou. The race offers a high-quality course suitable for experienced runners and competitors vying for regional titles. The event is part of the South Bohemian Region athletics calendar and attracts a broad running community.
course_highlights: 25 km road course
Picturesque surroundings of Hluboká nad Vltavou
Part of the regional road-running championship

name: CRAFT Brněnský půlmaraton a Brněnská desítka
location: Brno Velodrome, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The CRAFT Brno Half Marathon and Brno 10K are traditional running races held in the centre of Brno, with the event hub at the Brno Velodrome. The event is open to the general public, from elite runners to recreational athletes, and also includes children’s races. The races have international significance and regularly attract runners of all ages. In addition to the half marathon, 10.5 km and 5 km routes are available, including a relay option.
course_highlights: Event hub at the Brno Velodrome
Road routes of 21.1 km, 10.5 km and 5 km through the city centre
The race is suitable for the general public, including children and veterans
additional: The race is part of the Czech Running Club project. The first category starts at 10:00, and the main category starts at 11:00. The organisers are BehejBrno.com and MARATON BRNO z.s. The event also includes children’s races and relays. The race is a traditional event of international significance, attracting runners of all ages.

name: Chřibská – Studenec
description: We invite all runners to the 15th edition of the Cena města Chřibská Studenec Uphill Race, held in the picturesque, rugged terrain of the Lužické hory. The race is suitable for elite competitors as well as recreational runners and serves as a qualifier for the World Mountain Running Championships for youth. The start is in the town square in Chřibská and the finish is at the Studenec lookout tower. The course is 6.1 km long with 397 metres of elevation gain. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful views.
course_highlights: Course through the rugged terrain of the Lužické hory
6.1 km long with 397 metres of elevation gain
Finish at the Studenec lookout tower
additional: Registration from 8:30 at the Chřibská Municipal Office. Prizes for the first three finishers in each category and a running raffle. According to the information provided, the start is at 10:00 in the square in Chřibská and registration begins at 8:30 at the Municipal Office.

name: Petřín třikrát jinak
description: Petřín Three Ways is a unique race in Prague where runners tackle Petřín Hill in three different ways: an interval start up the 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower, a mass-start uphill run, and an interval climb up a slope on an unpaved path and steps. The total time is the sum of the times from all three races, with bonuses for the top competitors. Children can compete in ten age categories on courses around the Hunger Wall below the tower. The race also offers a relay in which a team of three runners completes all three disciplines.
course_highlights: Interval-start climb up the 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower
1 km uphill run with 118 m of elevation gain, with a mass start
Interval-start 1 km climb up a slope on an unpaved path and steps
additional: Race registration and facilities are in tents near the Petřín Lookout Tower. Interval starts are every 30 seconds, with a break after every 30 runners to allow them to descend from the tower. Children’s races cover 200 m, 365 m and 730 m, with the awards ceremony immediately after the finish. Relay teams consist of 3 runners, each running one discipline, and start together with the individual competitors. Time bonuses also apply to relays. Children’s races include ten age categories, with courses around the Hunger Wall. A three-person relay is also available, with each runner completing one section of the race.

name: Šaratický běh
location: Šaratice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Šaratice Run is a traditional 10 km road race held in the village of Šaratice in the South Moravian Region. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to test themselves on a fast, well-marked course. The main category is scheduled to start in the morning, making for an enjoyable race day in a community setting. The event is organized by the Municipality of Šaratice, which ensures high-quality organization and support. The race is part of the official Czech Running calendar and is open to the general public.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
Start and finish by the municipal office in Šaratice
Race in the South Moravian Region with a pleasant setting
additional: The first category starts at 9:00; the main category starts at 10:30. The event is organized by the Municipality of Šaratice. Contact by phone: 606 333 997. The race is part of the Czech Athletics Association’s services for runners and running events.

name: Charitativní běh Karlštejn
location: Karlštejn Castle, Karlštejn, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Karlštejn Charity Run is a sporting event organized by Charita Beroun, offering runners the opportunity to combine a sporting experience with supporting a good cause. The run takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Gothic Karlštejn Castle and the Velká Amerika quarry, creating a unique combination of adventure and trail running. The start is right in the castle courtyard, and the event is suitable for anyone who wants to run with heart and support Charita Beroun. This year, the run will take place on Sunday, April 19, 2026, from 10:00 a.m.
course_highlights: Start right in the courtyard of Karlštejn Castle
Trail run around the Gothic Karlštejn Castle
The route passes the Velká Amerika quarry
additional: The event is charitable, and the entry fee is donated to Charita Beroun. The run is suitable for all runners who want to combine athletic performance with supporting a good cause. The organizer is Charita Beroun, located at Cajthamlova 169, Beroun.

name: 15 brodů Bílého potoka
location: Javůrek, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: 15 Fords of the Bílý Potok is an off-road running adventure through the beautiful valley of the Bílý Potok, passing the settlement of Šmelcovna. There are three routes: a 22 km long route with 16 fords, a 15 km medium route with 7 fords, and a non-competitive 7 km short route for those who want to enjoy the race atmosphere. The route runs mainly through forests and meadows along hiking trails and cycle paths. It is well marked and suitable for moderately fit athletes. The race is ideal for recreational runners who want to enjoy nature and the challenge of fording streams in one of the most beautiful places near Brno.
course_highlights: Off-road route with 16 fords on the longest, 22 km option
Mainly forest and meadow paths, away from paved roads
A steep 1.7 km climb at the end
additional: The time limit for the long route is 3 hours. The route is thoroughly marked with arrows and course ribbons. Most fords can be bypassed using a footbridge or a log. You can change your route distance during the race. The route surface includes unpaved terrain, gravel paths and asphalt. Three route distances are available: approximately 7 km (non-competitive), 15 km with seven fords, and 22 km, which includes an additional loop and a climb. The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours.

name: Silniční běh kolem Hluboké nad Vltavou
location: Stadion TJ Hluboká, Hluboká nad Vltavou, Czech Republic
description: The road race around Hluboká nad Vltavou is a traditional 25 km road race that starts and finishes at the TJ Hluboká stadium. The route follows paved cycle paths and third-class roads through picturesque villages such as Bavorovice, Vondrov, Munice, Zahájí and Zliv. The race is ideal for runners looking for a combination of athletic challenge and a beautiful experience in the South Bohemian Region. It is organized by TJ KOH-I-NOOR České Budějovice under the leadership of Růžena Smolíková.
course_highlights: 25 km route along paved cycle paths and third-class roads
Passes through the villages of Bavorovice, Vondrov, Munice, Zahájí and Zliv
Start and finish at the TJ Hluboká stadium
additional: The race is organized by TJ KOH-I-NOOR České Budějovice. The route follows paved cycle paths and third-class roads. The start and finish are at the TJ Hluboká stadium. The organizer is Růžena Smolíková, who can also be contacted by phone.

name: Paskovská devítka
location: Paskov, Frýdek-Místek District, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: Hlavní závod a běh pro paskovský zámek

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: Hlavní závod a běh pro paskovský zámek 100 Kč

description: Paskovská Devítka is a traditional running race organized by the town of Paskov, now being held for the eighth year. The event is open to the general public, from young children to adults, and features several categories, including the 9 km main race, youth races, and a non-competitive run for Paskov Castle. This year, the registration and start location for the main race have changed. The race starts at 9:15. The event is an important sporting occasion in the region and also brings traffic restrictions along the route to ensure participants’ safety.
course_highlights: Main race: 9,000 metres
Youth races: 940 m, 480 m, and 160 m for the youngest participants
Non-competitive run for Paskov Castle: 3,000 metres
additional: The race takes place in Paskov, with traffic restrictions on Nádražní, Mírová, Fučíkova, Krátká, U Potoka, Bezručova, Boženy Němcové, Jiřího Wolkra, and U Parku streets from 9:00 to approximately 12:00. Each competitor takes part at their own risk. The race is suitable for all age groups, including the non-competitive run for participants born in 2014 or earlier.

name: Běh okolo Češíku
location: Lesní hřbitov, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50,- kč dětské kategorie (předem na účet i v den registrace na místě)

description: The Běh okolo Češíku is a running race held in the beautiful Hradec Králové forests near the Forest Cemetery in Hradec Králové. The event offers children’s categories with shorter courses and a main race for adults. It is suitable for families and runners of all ages who want to enjoy a day of sport in nature. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: The forest “Finnish” running trail in Hradec Králové
The course runs through beautiful woodland
Close to the Forest Cemetery and an outdoor fitness area
additional: Registration is available online until 15.4.2026 or on site on race day. Children’s categories start between 09:30 and 10:15, followed by the main race between 11:00 and 11:45. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the first three finishers in each category. Results are published within 24 hours after the race. The program includes children’s races without timing and a main race for adults.

name: Prunéřovský půlmaraton
location: Cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice, Kadaň, Czech Republic
organizer: Běžecký klub F - C Kadaň, z.s.
description: The Prunéřov Half Marathon is a certified running race held on the cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice. The course is an out-and-back route, and runners complete two laps with minimal elevation gain, making for a fast and enjoyable run. The race is part of the Summer Running Cup and also offers shorter distances for children and young people, with different distances and turnarounds. It is organized by Běžecký klub F - C Kadaň, z.s., which takes care of high-quality organization and runners’ comfort.
course_highlights: Certified out-and-back course
Two laps with minimal elevation gain
Cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice
additional: The race is part of the Summer Running Cup. Children’s races with shorter distances (250 m, 750 m, 1,500 m) are also available. Registration and payments are handled through the naZávody.cz system, which offers start-list management, automatic age categories, statistics, and other features. Runners can edit their registration themselves, transfer it to another person, or invite other runners.

name: ČSOB Bratislava marathon – desiatka, Minimaratón, deti, lezúni
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratón, Polmaratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km
description: The ČSOB Bratislava Marathon is a family-friendly running event with a long-standing tradition, held in Bratislava and attracting runners from Slovakia and abroad. It offers a range of events, from the marathon, half marathon and relay races to the 10K, minimarathon, children’s races and crawling races. The atmosphere is filled with emotion, fair play and a sense of community, where everyone who takes the start and pushes beyond their limits is a winner. The event also supports charitable activities and emphasizes the value of helping one another and solidarity.

name: Národný beh Devín - Bratislava (5.kolo BP SAZ)
distance_verbose: 534 km, 50 km, Maratón, Polmaratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 11.5 km, 10 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 2.6 km, 1 km
description: TIPOS Devín–Bratislava National Run is Slovakia’s oldest sporting event, with a tradition spanning more than 100 years, and will be held for the 78th time. Runners take on the iconic route from historic Devín Castle to the centre of Bratislava, creating a unique atmosphere that brings history and sport together. The event is suitable for recreational athletes and more competitive runners alike, and attracts thousands of participants of all ages every year. It is organised by STaRZ of the City of Bratislava, which provides all organisational information and registration.

name: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej
location: Sačurov okr. Vranov n. Topľou, Sačurov okr. Vranov n. Topľou, pred budovou Zákl. školy v Sačurove
organizer: Obec Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ Sačurov, MŠ Sačurov
description: Sačurov Fifteen – the 20th Helena Sluková Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Sačurov in the Vranov nad Topľou District. The race starts in front of the Sačurov primary school building and offers categories for various age groups, including children, youth and adults. The main category starts at 13:00, and the children’s race at 12:00. The organizers are the Municipality of Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, and Sačurov Primary and Nursery School. The race is suitable for local runners and beginner athletes.

name: Kajňanská desiatka – Memoriál Jána Osloviča
location: Slovenská Kajňa, Slovenská Kajňa, pred budovou Obecného úradu
organizer: Obec Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, Bežecká akadémia Marcela Matanina
description: Kajňanská Desiatka – Ján Oslovič Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Slovenská Kajňa. The event offers three disciplines: a 10 km long run, a 3.66 km short run, and a 3.66 km short Nordic walking event, all starting simultaneously at 13:00. The competition is divided into several age categories for men and women, welcoming runners of different ages and ability levels. The organizer, MATORE s.r.o., ensures high-quality event organization and timekeeping.

name: Oslobodenie Likavka - Beh oslobodenia o Putovný pohár starostu obce Likavka
location: Likavka okr. Ružomberok, Likavka okr. Ružomberok, Futbalový štadión Obecného športového klubu v Likavke
description: The Liberation Run for the Likavka Mayor’s Traveling Cup is a traditional race organized by the Likavka Municipal Office and Likavka Primary School with Kindergarten. The race takes place at the Municipal Sports Club Football Stadium in Likavka and is part of the 2025 Liptov Running League. Children, pupils, juniors, women, and men can compete in various age categories. The start for pupils is at 10:05 and for adults at 11:40, according to the race regulations. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a chance to test your strength in the beautiful surroundings of Likavka.

name: Čadčianska desiatka
location: Čadca, Čadca, Čadca sídlisko Žarec (Domov dôchodcov)
description: The Čadca Ten is a traditional running race organized by the Kysuce Marathon Club Čadca, the City of Čadca, and the Čadca Žarec Social Services Centre. The 30th edition will take place on April 19, 2026, starting at 10:00 a.m. in the Žarec residential area of Čadca. Runners can look forward to a well-prepared course and a pleasant atmosphere at an event popular with the region’s running community. Online registration is open until April 17, 2026; participants can also register on race day for a higher entry fee.

name: Běh Čedoku
description: The Čedok Run is a 3.7 km race run mostly on asphalt in Prague 4. This run is part of the SABZO series and offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a fast, pleasant race in an urban setting. The course is suitable for those who prefer asphalt and want to experience a competitive atmosphere as part of the running community.
course_highlights: 3.7 km course
Mostly asphalt surface
Urban setting in Prague 4

name: UCM Night Run
description: UCM Night Run is a charity evening run taking place on April 21, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. in Trojičné Square in Trnava. Runners will complete a 5-kilometer route through the historic streets of Trnava’s city center, offering the unique atmosphere of “Little Rome.” The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability, and brings the community together through exercise and support for those in need. Proceeds from the run will go toward rehabilitation and treatment for a child with a disability. The organizers are the City of Trnava, FMK UCM students, and main partner CUKROVAR.

name: Okolo stadionu - silniční pětka
location: Městský stadion Ostrava-Vítkovice, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: Okolo stadionu – Road 5K is a traditional 5 km road race held at Vítkovice Stadium in Ostrava. The race offers a fast course suitable for runners looking to test their speed on asphalt. It is organized by Sdružení sportovních klubů Vítkovice, z.s., and is part of the official Czech Running calendar. The main category traditionally starts in the early evening, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike.
course_highlights: 5 km road course
Loop around Vítkovice Stadium in Ostrava
Fast asphalt surface suitable for personal bests
additional: The first category starts at 17:20, and the main category starts at 18:00. The organizer is Sdružení sportovních klubů Vítkovice, z.s.; contact person: Mgr. Šárka Mokrá, phone 773 004 098. In 2025, the first category started at 17:20 and the main category at 18:00. Details about the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: 399. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Malá cena Monaka is a traditional running race organized by the Chrudim Recreational Runners Club at the Monako restaurant in Slatiňany. The race offers 10 km and 3.6 km courses, suitable for the general public and runners of all levels. The event is popular for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of the Pardubice Region.
course_highlights: 10 km and 3.6 km routes
Start and finish at the Monako restaurant in Slatiňany
Scenic surroundings of the Pardubice Region

name: ITMBWieczorem
location: Bulwar Poleski, near Dębnicki Bridge, Kraków, Poland
description: ITMBWieczorem is a weekly series of free 5 km and 10 km runs along Kraków’s Vistula Boulevards. The runs take place every Thursday at 20:00, starting and finishing on Bulwar Polejski by Dębnicki Bridge. The course follows the Vistula Boulevards to the Field Redoubt on Tyniecka Street, where runners turn around. From March to April and from October to November, the runs are held only over 5 km. Participation is free and open to people over 14 years of age.
course_highlights: Course along the Vistula Boulevards, with a turnaround at the Field Redoubt on Tyniecka Street
Start and finish on Bulwar Polejski by Dębnicki Bridge
5 km and 10 km distances (the 10 km distance is two laps of the 5 km course)
additional: Participation is free. Time limits: 40 minutes for 5 km and 1 hour for 10 km (the latter is recommended for advanced runners). After completing 25, 50, and 100 runs, participants can order a commemorative T-shirt for 25 zł. A small number of belongings can be left at the start area (the organizer is not responsible for items left there). The runs are organized on a friendly, informal basis, with care taken around pedestrians and cyclists. Registration via a form is required. Participants should bring a printed race number or barcode. The runs take place on Thursdays at 20:00; the 2027 season schedule has not been confirmed.

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku Brno – Špilberk

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Brno is a charity running event held at Špilberk, offering participants a choice between a 3 km course (2 laps) and a 6 km course (4 laps). The run starts at 9:00 p.m. and is accompanied by a cultural programme, including a concert. The entry fee is 500 CZK, half of which supports the Světluška project and half goes towards direct assistance for people with severe visual impairments. The event is suitable for runners and walkers and is open to anyone who wants to support a good cause.
course_highlights: The course runs through Špilberk, with a choice of 3 km or 6 km distance
A night run with a choice of entry option that includes a headlamp or a sports headband
An accompanying programme, including a concert during registration
additional: Registration is through the GoOut.cz portal, where participants can choose an entry option that includes a headlamp or a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards receive free entry, but are not entitled to a headlamp or headband. The run has limited capacity for participants’ safety and comfort. A cloakroom and baggage storage are available on site. Medical staff will be present, and participants may also run with a dog (except in Jihlava).

name: Běh okolo Kraví hory

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 150 Kč. Platba startovného probíhá před závodem při registraci závodníků.

description: The Run around Kraví hora is a traditional race in Brno, offering runners an interesting 2.7 km loop. Men and women run two laps, for a total of 5.4 km, while children can race over a distance suited to their age. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Kraví hora, with refreshments and baggage storage available on site. Men and women start together, and the atmosphere is friendly and welcoming to all age groups.
course_highlights: A 2.7 km loop in the natural surroundings of Kraví hora
Men and women run two laps (5.4 km); children race over an age-appropriate distance
Start and finish by the swimming pool, with refreshments and baggage storage
additional: Registration takes place at the race venue from 17:15. The children’s race starts at 17:45 and the main race at 18:00. Parking is available in a limited number of spaces near the venue. Public transport is available via bus 68 and tram 4 to Náměstí Míru stop. Water is available for refreshments after the race. Competitors start at their own risk. According to the available information, the entry fee is paid on site during registration.

name: Trhovosvinenská padesátka
location: Buškův hamr, Trhové Sviny, Czech Republic
description: Trhovosvinenská Padesátka is a long-distance walk through the Trhové Sviny region and its surroundings, offering two main routes of 50 km and 100 km. The event is intended for both hikers and runners, who can choose their start time. The route passes through picturesque countryside, with several refreshment stations, and finishes at the historic Buškův hamr site in Trhové Sviny. The organizers emphasize safety, compliance with traffic rules, and environmental protection. The walk has a long tradition and is popular with both locals and visitors to the region.
course_highlights: The route crosses the Trhové Sviny region and offers scenic views
Refreshment stations along the route (2 on the 50 km route, 4 on the 100 km route)
Finish at the historic Buškův hamr site
additional: The start time for the 50 km route can be chosen freely between 6:00 and 9:00; the 100 km route is a long-distance event, starting at 21:00 for walkers and 22:00 for runners. Mandatory equipment includes a charged mobile phone, a working headlamp, and reflective elements as required by law. Refreshments along the route include water, drinks, fruit, chocolate, and slices of cake. Sausages are available at the finish. Dogs are allowed, provided the rules are followed. The organizers ask participants to respect nature and comply with traffic rules and the Forest Act. The walk is intended for both hikers and runners and takes place in all weather. There are refreshment stations along the routes; refreshments and overnight accommodation are available at the finish.

name: Excalibur Race MOON Kuřim
location: Kuřim, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Excalibur Race MOON Kuřim is an OCR race offering a challenging and varied course around Kuřim. The race combines a quiet forest, Srpek Pond, the challenging Zlobice hill, and the mysterious atmosphere of Kuřim Stonehenge. The course is ideally mixed with flat sections, hills, forest trails, and water sections that will test every brave knight. The main category starts in the evening at 20:30, adding a unique atmosphere to the race.
course_highlights: Quiet forest and Srpek Pond
The challenging Zlobice hill
The mysterious atmosphere of Kuřim Stonehenge
additional: The race is an OCR event and starts in the evening. The course combines flat sections, hills, forest trails, and water sections. It is organized by Překážkové sporty, z. s., Jan Kolář.

name: 7 Bieg Korczaka
organizer: Specjalny Ośrodek Szkolno-Wychowawczy nr 1 dla Dzieci Niepełnosprawnych Ruchowo w Policach im. Marii Grzegorzewskiej
description: The 7th Korczak Run is an annual running event organized by Special Education Center No. 1 for Children with Physical Disabilities in Police. The event includes a 5 km main race, Nordic walking, and children’s races over various distances, including races for children in wheelchairs. The main race route consists of two loops with an additional section, making for an interesting and varied course. The event promotes inclusion and physical activity among people of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The main race route consists of 2 loops with an extra section
The event includes children’s races over distances from 200 to 600 meters
Nordic walking is available over a distance of 5 km
additional: Medals for race participants. Forms are available to download: transfer of a race entry, guardian’s statement/consent, and authorization to collect a race pack. Recommended parking areas are listed on the website. Numerous photo galleries and videos from previous editions are available. The event website provides registration, regulations, and a course map. Electronic timing by B4SPORT is available.

name: XXXVI Biegi im. Tomasza Hopfera
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janowcu Wielkopolskim
description: The 36th Tomasz Hopfer Runs is an annual running event held in Janowiec Wielkopolski. The main event is a 10 km race that attracts runners from various regions. The organizers also offer races for children, promoting physical activity among the youngest participants. The course is certified, ensuring it has been accurately measured and professionally prepared.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km race course
Children’s races tailored to different age groups
Scenic areas of Janowiec Wielkopolski
additional: The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Janowiec Wielkopolski. Phone: +48 452 469 185. The program includes races for children and the main 10 km race. The website includes regulations and results from previous years.

name: PKO Gdynia Półmaraton 35. PZLA Mistrzostwa Polski w Półmaraton
description: PKO Gdynia Half Marathon is one of the largest running events in Poland and will take place on April 24, 2027. The half-marathon course runs through the modern city of Gdynia, showcasing its unique modernist character. The race starts in the evening at 19:30, so runners finish after dark, creating a special atmosphere. The event attracts individual runners, relay teams, and participants in accompanying 5 km and children’s races.
course_highlights: A half-marathon course of over 21 km through Gdynia
Evening start at 19:30, with the finish at City Beach after dark
A PZLA-certified 5 km course, as well as children’s races and relays
additional: The half-marathon participant limit is 15,000. The time limit for completing the half-marathon is 4 hours. The entry fee can be transferred to the next edition up to 14 days before the event. Refunds are available up to 45 days before the race if registration took place within the first 30 days after entries opened. Half-marathon relays consist of teams of 3. The 5 km course is PZLA-certified. The children’s race (Kids Run) takes place on Saturday at midday, with a unique medal at the finish. The event will also include 5 km races, relays, and Kids Run. Early registrants can receive a full refund if they withdraw up to 45 days before the race; the fee can be transferred free of charge to the next edition up to 14 days before the event.

name: 43 Bieg Kujawiaka
location: Stadion Przylesie, ul. Wesoła 16, Włocławek, Poland
organizer: Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy VECTRA we Włocławku
description: The 43rd Bieg Kujawiaka is the oldest sporting event in the region, held in memory of Napoleon Dzwonkowski and Wiesław Wesołowski. The event attracts people who enjoy physical activity and runners from various places, and takes place at Przylesie Stadium in Włocławek. It is a long-standing tradition that brings the local community together and promotes a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Children’s and youth races over distances from 400 m to 2,000 m
Main race: 10 km
5 km Nordic walking event
additional: The races take place at Przylesie Stadium, 16 Wesoła Street. Information about the program and fees is from the 2026 edition and may not apply to the event on 24 April 2027.

name: 8 Bełchatowski Bieg Nocny
organizer: Miejskie Centrum Sportu w Bełchatowie oraz Bełchatowski Klub Lekkoatletyczny
description: The 8th Bełchatów Night Run is a unique sporting event that combines running competition with the one-of-a-kind atmosphere of an evening run through the streets of Bełchatów. Participants cover a 10-kilometre course certified by PZLA, making it suitable for setting personal bests. The start and finish are at Gabriel Narutowicz Square, and the evening timing adds to the event’s distinctive character. The event promotes an active lifestyle and brings the local running community together.
course_highlights: 10-kilometre certified course through the streets of Bełchatów
Start and finish at Gabriel Narutowicz Square
Evening start at 21:00, with a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes
additional: The race office is in the concert hall of the Municipal Cultural Centre at 3 Narutowicz Square and is open from 18:00 to 23:00. A baggage drop is available for participants’ personal belongings. Participants must be over 16; minors must have permission from a parent or guardian. Timing is recorded using chips in the race bibs. The participant limit is approximately 400. Information about the 21:00 start and the 1-hour-40-minute time limit comes from the previous edition. Details of the edition scheduled for 24 April 2027 have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: Backyard Ultra TRICITY
description: Backyard Ultra TriCity is a unique ultramarathon in a format that originated in the USA. Runners start every hour and must complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they can rest until the next full hour, when they begin another round. The race continues until only one runner remains at the start and completes the final loop within the one-hour time limit. This is a demanding and exciting race in which only one winner is crowned.
course_highlights: 6.706 km (4.167 mile) loop
Start every full hour
One-hour time limit to complete each loop
additional: Runners have 15 minutes to rest after completing a loop if they finish it in less than 60 minutes. The race takes place in Gdańsk. The organizer provides the rules for download. The race is for adults. Information for the 2027 edition has not been confirmed; the available registration page is for the 2026 edition.

name: Bieg Zająca
description: Bieg Zająca is one of the Warsaw Grand Prix events, held in the picturesque Kabaty Forest. The event offers running routes of various lengths, suited to runners of different ability levels. Participants can expect professional organization, a race package, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the race. The event has a family-friendly, community-oriented atmosphere, with prizes for the top finishers and special recognition for the oldest participant and the funniest costume.
course_highlights: Routes in Kabaty Forest — natural woodland trails
Time limit: 60 minutes for the 5 km race and 80 minutes for the 10 km race
Start and race office on the clearing beside the Kabaty Metro Technical Depot
additional: The race office opens at 09:00. Race bibs are issued only on race day. A special trophy for the oldest male or female participant and recognition for the funniest costume. Prizes in the overall and age-group classifications. Participant limit: 450.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin is the spring edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, highlighting the scenic qualities of the chosen venue. The race is recreational and athletic in nature and is part of a series of cross-country races in Wielkopolska and other cities. The organizers promote running and a friendly atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the UMCS Botanical Garden
Picturesque and scenic race setting
Organized with passion since 2014
additional: The organizer is a group of running enthusiasts active since 2014 and specializing in cross-country races. In summer 2026, they will celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka. Trzymsie.pl is a partner of the autumn series. Previous editions included races for children over four shorter distances; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in available sources.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026, organized by the Amateur Running Enthusiasts Club “Pędziwiatr.” The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation, under the motto “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!” The 4,219.5 m course runs through a municipal forest, mainly along forest and gravel paths, with refreshment points at the finish after each lap. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps, covering distances from approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon. The time limit is 3 hours for running and Nordic Walking.
course_highlights: A 4,219.5 m course in Gliwice’s municipal forest
Runs mainly along forest and gravel paths, with some sections on asphalt
A refreshment point at the start/finish line is available after each lap
additional: The events take place once a month on Saturdays. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps of the course (from approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon). The time limit is 3 hours for running and Nordic Walking; e-Prowokacja has no time limit. Bib numbers are valid for the whole year and must be returned after each race. After the event, participants receive a drink and a sausage or banana, as well as a chance to win a bar in a prize draw, if permitted by sanitary regulations. Registration is available online and at the race office on the day of the event. The event includes running and Nordic Walking; prior registration and payment of the entry fee are required to be included in the results.

name: III Bieg Pełną Parą dla Dzieciaków
Paratriathlon Kraina Liwca
location: Pałac i Folwark Łochów, Łochów, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Leny Grochowskiej i Stowarzyszenie Arche
description: Paratriathlon Kraina Liwca is a charity team event that brings together people with and without disabilities. It takes place in the picturesque Liwiec Valley at the Łochów Palace and Folwark. The event consists of three stages: a 5.5 km run, a 7 km kayak trip and a 22 km bike race. The running route passes through green spaces and historic buildings, while the kayak trip takes place on the Liwiec River. The event promotes physical activity and social inclusion, and proceeds from entry fees go towards creating supported housing.
course_highlights: 5.5 km run on the grounds of Łochów Palace and Folwark — 3 laps through picturesque green spaces and past historic buildings
7 km kayak trip on the Liwiec River, with equipment provided and life jackets required
22 km bike race through Karczewizna, Twarogi, Matały, Zambrzyniec and Kamionna, returning to Łochów Palace and Folwark
additional: Teams of 3–4 people, with at least 1 person holding a disability certificate. The kayak trip uses equipment provided by the organiser; life jackets are mandatory. Time-trial bikes and road bikes with aerodynamic wheels are prohibited, as is drafting during the bike race. Timing is electronic, using chips. The race office is open on 24 April from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 25 April from 8:30 to 12:30. The organiser provides transport for participants to the kayakers’ start. After the event, there will be an open food area and a concert. The start and event are based at Łochów Palace and Folwark. The 2026 edition’s rules allowed teams without a person holding a disability certificate, but added 30 minutes to their result. Route and organisational information is from the 2026 edition.

name: Pelplin Forest Run
description: Pelplin Forest Run is a running and Nordic walking event held in Rajkowski Mill since 2024. The start, finish, and race office are located at the kayak marina, and the routes pass through the scenic Bukowiec Forest District. The event is co-organized by the Kociewie Sports and Cultural Association and the Pelplin Municipality Sports Club Sprint Kulice, offering participants the chance to enjoy nature and sporting competition in beautiful woodland surroundings.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Bukowiec Forest District
Start and finish at the kayak marina in Rajkowski Mill
Running and Nordic walking in a natural woodland setting
additional: The co-organizers are the Kociewie Sports and Cultural Association and the Pelplin Municipality Sports Club Sprint Kulice. The distances and location provided are from previous editions; details for the edition on 24 April 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Wiosenny Fesiwal Biegowy
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Żywcu
description: The 33rd Spring Running Festival is an annual event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Żywiec. It includes a cross-country race up Grojec and accompanying races for children. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of the Amphitheatre at the foot of Grojec, giving participants the chance to enjoy the outdoors and stay active. Runners of all ages and abilities are invited to take part in this sporting tradition.
course_highlights: Cross-country race up Grojec
Accompanying races for children
Scenic route around the Amphitheatre at the foot of Grojec
additional: The festival features the 33rd edition of the Cross-Country Race up Grojec, as well as accompanying races for children. The rules are available as an attachment on the organizer’s website. Course and programme information is from the 2026 edition; details for the edition scheduled for 24 April 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: XLIV Uliczny Bieg Bartów
location: Stadion w Barcianach, ul. Sportowa 1a, Barciany, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Przy zgłoszeniach internetowych udział osób niepełnoletnich jest bezpłatny.

description: The 44th Jan Liniewski Bart Street Race is a traditional road race held at the stadium in Barciany. The event has a rich history and welcomes different age groups, from preschoolers to adults, including participants with disabilities. The main race course is approximately 3,800 metres long and runs through the streets of Barciany. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping, medals and prizes, as well as a friendly atmosphere and support from spectators.
course_highlights: The main race course is approximately 3,800 m long and runs through the streets of Barciany
Age categories range from preschoolers to adults, including a race for participants with disabilities
Start and finish at the stadium in Barciany, ul. Sportowa 1a
additional: The race office is open from 8:30. Registration and race-pack collection are available until 45 minutes before the start of each category. Electronic timing uses a returnable chip. Medical care is available on site. Prizes are drawn after the race. Bib numbers must be worn on the chest or on a special belt at the front of the body. The co-organiser of the previous edition was the Warmian-Masurian LZS Association. The available information on distances and fees relates to the 2026 edition and therefore does not confirm the participation terms for 2027.

name: XVIII Złotowski Bieg Zawilca
description: The 18th Złotów Anemone Run is an annual running event held in Złotów, aimed at people who enjoy running, active recreation and a sporting atmosphere. The race takes place on courses suited to different groups of participants, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The event is open and welcoming to runners of varying experience levels. The organizers provide professional event management and attractive conditions for starting and competing.
additional: The event is co-organized by the Złotów Municipal Office, Granqvists Manufacturing Sp. z o.o. and the Alfred Sokołowski District Hospital in Złotów.

name: XXIX Bieg o Puchar Dyrektora MOSiR
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Czechowicach-Dziedzicach
description: The 29th Run for the MOSiR Director’s Cup is an annual road race held at the MOSiR Stadium in Czechowice-Dziedzice. The course is 10 km long and clearly marked every 1 km, with a water station at 6.2 km. Runners start with electronic timing, and a commemorative medal, water and a recovery meal await them at the finish. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy friendly sporting competition.
course_highlights: 10 km course marked every 1 km
Water station at 6.2 km
Electronic chip timing, with the chip attached to the race bib
additional: The race office is open from 10:30 to 12:30 before the start. The time limit is 45 minutes for 5 km and 90 minutes for the full race. The race bib must be pinned to the front of the shirt and is non-transferable. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00. The 29th edition took place on 25 April 2026. Registration for this edition was online only; the organiser did not offer race-day registration.

name: XXXV Biegi Uliczne Wiosna Cekowska
location: Publiczne Przedszkole w Cekowie-Kolonii, Ceków-Kolonia, Poland
description: The 35th Wiosna Cekowska Street Races is an annual running event held in Ceków-Kolonia, attracting runners of different ages and ability levels. The races take place on the town’s streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete in a friendly atmosphere and spend time outdoors. The event is local in scope and an important sporting fixture in the municipality’s calendar.
course_highlights: Street race in Ceków-Kolonia
The course runs along the town’s scenic streets
A local event with a long-standing tradition
additional: The available sources concern the 2026 edition, held on April 25; they do not confirm details of the 2027 edition.

name: Lauf Zum Alten vom Müssenberg – VB Sauerland Lauf Cup
Drumlin Lauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: Pyraser HiRo Run 21.1 – Mittelfränkische Meisterschaft Halbmarathon
Brnišťský půlmaraton
description: The Brniště Half Marathon is a traditional running event in the area around the village of Brniště, offering several races, including a half marathon, a shorter run, a relay race and Nordic Walking. The routes pass through the scenic countryside of Podralsko, combining paved and off-road sections and taking runners past ponds, through the forest and along village roads. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in races across several age categories. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and support from the local community, creating an unforgettable experience for runners.
course_highlights: The route passes through Brniště, along the Water Goblin Trail, past ponds and grazing horses
The course is approximately half paved and half off-road
There are three refreshment stations along the course, including a newly added station on the village green by the Ekocentrum Včelín
additional: The first children’s race starts at 10:00, and the main race starts at 12:00. The entry fee includes a drink, a protein bar, a commemorative medal and small prizes from the organizers and sponsors. Runners who register by the end of March also receive a technical T-shirt with the BPM logo. Changing rooms with showers, baggage storage, three refreshment stations for competitors and food stalls for the public are available. The courses are marked with colored arrows, and course marshals are stationed at intersections. Competitors run at their own risk; traffic is not completely restricted.

name: ČEZ RunTour České Budějovice
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: ČEZ RunTour in České Budějovice is a family-friendly running event offering distances for recreational runners and elite athletes: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place in Přemysl Otakar II Square and is part of a series of eight races across the Czech Republic. Participants can enjoy not only the run but also a family-friendly programme and quality services, including a race pack, refreshments and medical support. Every runner contributes to charity by taking part, giving the event a sense of purpose and a friendly atmosphere.

name: POŠUK – Pošemberský ultra kros
location: Údolí Šembery, Český Brod, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Klub pro sportovce a cyklisty českobrodska
description: Pošemberský Ultra Kros is a challenging running race in the beautiful Šembera Valley, near Český Brod. The 16 km course has 500 metres of elevation gain and runs 85% through forest and 15% on roads. The race is for fans of cross-country and trail running who want to experience sweat, mud and tears, as well as panoramic views, climbs and descents. The start and finish are in a meadow deep in the forest, contributing to the race’s relaxed atmosphere.
course_highlights: 16 km course with 500 m of elevation gain
85% forest terrain, 15% roads
Panoramic spots, climbs and descents in the Šembera Valley
additional: The race starts in a meadow deep in the forest between Český Brod and Doubravčice, in the direction of Kostelec. The race is organised by Klub pro sportovce a cyklisty českobrodska. The challenging course has 500 m of elevation gain and combines forest and road sections. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere in the start and finish meadow. The start and finish are in a meadow in the forest.

name: Vysocký krosový půlmaraton
location: Vysoká u Holic, Pardubice District, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Vysoká Cross-Country Half Marathon is a traditional running race in Vysoká u Holic, featuring a challenging cross-country course in the beautiful Polabí countryside. The 21.1 km main race consists of three laps through forest terrain, with no asphalt, making it one of the hilliest half marathons in the region. Shorter 7 km and 3 km options are also available, suitable for a wide range of runners. The organisers emphasise both the sporting challenge and the friendly atmosphere that has attracted runners for fifteen years. The start and finish are located at the sports field in Vysoká u Holic.
course_highlights: The main course consists of three 7 km laps through forest terrain, with no asphalt
Shorter 7 km and 3 km options are also available
The course is considered the hilliest half marathon in Polabí
additional: In-person registration is required at the start venue from 8:30 to 9:45. Race numbers are non-refundable; the chip must be returned after finishing. The time limit for the main race is 3 hours. The organiser donates CZK 33 from each entry fee to Základní škola speciální Neratov. The race sponsor awards a financial amount for every kilometre run.

name: Obřanský kros
description: Obřanský kros is a traditional running race organized by Orel unit Brno-Obřany, bringing together athletes of all generations. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Obřany and is part of activities that support sports education and community life. The event is suitable for children and adults and emphasizes fair play and the joy of sport. Obřanský kros is an important sporting event in the South Moravian Region.
course_highlights: A traditional running race in the Obřany area
Suitable for all age groups
Organized as part of the sporting activities of Orel unit Brno-Obřany
additional: The race is part of the broader sporting activities of Orel unit Brno-Obřany, which also include other sports and cultural events. Registration forms are available in PDF and DOC format on the website. Results from previous editions are published regularly.

name: Běh Přerovským luhem
location: Restaurace Base Camp, Kainarova 3260/13a, Přerov, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Přerovský luh is a hiking race organized by the Czech Tourist Club in the beautiful natural surroundings of Přerovský luh. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy active movement outdoors and is part of the KČT calendar of major hiking events. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes a healthy lifestyle and the region’s hiking tradition in the Olomouc Region.
course_highlights: The route runs through the picturesque woodland of Přerovský luh
A natural, peaceful setting ideal for running and hiking
Part of the Czech Tourist Club’s calendar of major events
additional: The source gives conflicting time limits: 80 minutes in the text and 100 minutes in the meta description.

name: Cross Coutry Race – Hruboskalský půlmaraton
location: Kemp Sedmihorky, Sedmihorky, Karlovice, Czech Republic
description: The Hruboskalský Half Marathon is a running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Český ráj, at Sedmihorky campsite. It offers two main routes: a half marathon of approximately 21 km with 500 m of elevation gain, and a shorter route of around 12.5 km with 300 m of elevation gain. The course follows both paved and unpaved roads, trails, and, in places, stairs and rocks, making for varied and challenging terrain. The race is suited to nature lovers and trail runners, who will appreciate the marked, safe course and refreshment stations. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a raffle, all in the friendly atmosphere of Sedmihorky campsite.
course_highlights: A rolling route with 500 m of elevation gain (21 km) and 300 m (12 km)
The course follows paved and unpaved roads and trails, with stairs and rocks
Every kilometre of the half-marathon course is marked for reference, and the route is clearly marked with streamers and signs
additional: The start and finish are at Sedmihorky campsite, where parking is available (50 Kč/car); you can also arrive by train or bus (1.3 km from the stop). Changing tents, luggage storage, toilets, and hot showers (20 Kč per use via a machine) are available for participants. Weekend stays and trips around Český ráj are also available at the campsite. Participants will receive payment instructions by email after registering; payment must be made within three days or the registration will be cancelled. The awards ceremony and raffle take place after the race.

name: Běh na rozhlednu Veselý vrch
location: Prostřední Lhota, Chotilsko, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run to the Veselý vrch Lookout Tower is a forest cross-country race run mostly over trails along the Vltava River in the Chotilsko–Prostřední Lhota area. The race is 5.3 km long and suitable for all age groups, including children, who start shortly after the main category. The organizer is Libuše Vlachynská, who ensures a friendly atmosphere and smooth organization. The race is part of Český běh, a set of services provided by the Czech Athletics Federation for runners and running in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: Forest cross-country terrain along the Vltava River
Course length: 5.3 km
Suitable for children, who have their own start
additional: Children start at 10:35, shortly after the main category. The event is a cross-country/trail race and is part of Český běh, which also offers other services for runners and organizers. The event also has separate children’s categories. The main race traditionally starts at 10:30.

name: Běh veltruským parkem 2026
location: Areál letního kina Veltrusy, Veltrusy, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Veltrusy Park is a traditional race for children and adults, held in the picturesque grounds of Veltrusy Chateau Park. The event offers a pleasant spring atmosphere and the chance to enjoy sport for all age groups. Hundreds of runners take part each year, including families with children, and the race is known for its friendly, community atmosphere. It is suitable for beginners as well as experienced runners, who can enjoy the park’s beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: The course runs through the grounds of Veltrusy Chateau Park
Categories for children and adults, with different course distances
A pleasant spring atmosphere and a community event
additional: The race has categories for children and adults, with distances ranging from 50 m to 10 km. In 2026, a record 432 runners took part, including 291 children. Results are published online, including live results during the race. Registration for 2027 will open in February 2027. The race takes place at the Veltrusy open-air cinema grounds.

name: Prčický 1/2 maraton
location: TJ Sokol Sedlec-Prčice, Sedlec-Prčice, Czech Republic
description: The Prčice Half Marathon is a road race organized by TJ Sokol Sedlec-Prčice, offering distances of 21.097 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 2 km. All races start and finish at the same location in the TJ Sokol grounds, creating a friendly, family atmosphere for both runners and spectators. Fan zones along the course cheer on runners and make the event a special experience. The race is open to the general public and supports the running community in the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: Road race distances of 21.097 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 2 km
Start and finish in the TJ Sokol Sedlec-Prčice grounds
Fan zones along the course to cheer on runners
additional: All races start and finish at the same location, creating a great atmosphere for runners and spectators. Fan zones along the course cheer on runners. The organizer is TJ Sedlec Prčice; the contact person is Michal Davídek. The event also offers shorter distances for different ability levels.

name: MUTRAVERZ – MIKULOVSKÝ ULTRA TRAIL RUN
location: Mikulov, Teplice District, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run, z. s.
description: MUTRAVERZ - Mikulov Ultra Trail Run is an extreme ultra-trail race held in the picturesque setting of the Ore Mountains in Mikulov. The race is intended for experienced runners over 18 who want to experience challenging terrain and beautiful natural scenery. The organizers emphasize safety, fair play, and high-quality organization so that participants can fully enjoy the atmosphere and challenge of the race. The race is part of the MUTR series, which has become popular among running enthusiasts in the region.
course_highlights: Off-road ultra trail in the Ore Mountains
Hiking-marked trails
Challenging mountain conditions with high-altitude features
additional: The race is open only to people over 18. Participants must be physically and mentally fit and are required to follow the race rules, including those on safety and fair play. The organizer is not responsible for the condition of the course or for any damage or injuries. Runners consent to audiovisual recording of their performance for the purpose of promoting the race.

name: TRAIL HRADEC KRÁLOVÉ
description: Trail Hradec Králové is a race that takes you into nature, with varied courses offering a challenge for your legs and stunning views of the surrounding countryside. Every step takes you through beautiful forest hideaways that you’ll fall in love with. Get ready for a true running experience combining nature, movement and the joy of running at 100%. The race offers an original medal, a race pack, an electronic timing chip, and an accompanying programme with prizes for the best finishers in each category.
course_highlights: Varied nature trails with views of the surrounding countryside
Beautiful forest hideaways
A running experience combining nature and movement
additional: The race pack includes an original medal, a Gladiator Race-branded gift, a race bib and an electronic timing chip. Changing rooms, bag storage, toilets, medical services, refreshments during the race and at the finish, photos and a downloadable certificate are available (photos are not guaranteed for everyone). Parking is available near the race centre. Gladiator Race clothing is also available for purchase, alongside an accompanying programme.

name: Dobroběh Slováckem  – Bílovice
location: Sportovní areál u Základní školy, Bílovice, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: do 23.4.2026 do 20:00 hodin cena startovného 300 Kč/osoba

description: Dobroběh Slováckem in Bílovice is a running race held at the sports grounds by the elementary school in Bílovice. It offers an 11 km main race with gentle elevation and a separate 5 km race, suitable for various age groups. The race is open to runners aged 12 and over; younger participants need written consent from their legal guardians. Registration is available online and on-site on race day, with entry fees offered in several price brackets. The event has a friendly atmosphere and promotes sporting activity in the Slovácko region.
course_highlights: 11 km main race with 38 m of elevation gain and 38 m of descent
Separate 5 km race with 31 m of elevation gain and 31 m of descent
Start and finish at the sports grounds by the elementary school in Bílovice
additional: Race-day check-in takes place from 8:45 to 9:45 at the sports grounds by the elementary school. Runners receive a timing chip and refreshment vouchers. Participants under 18 must have written consent from their legal guardians. The on-site entry fee does not include a race package. Registration is also available on race day. Race-day check-in is scheduled from 8:45 to 9:45. The race is open to runners aged 12 and over; younger participants need written consent from a legal guardian. The race package includes a timing chip and refreshments.

name: Obora Trail Run
location: Dolní Lhota u Ostravy, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní a Kulturní spolek Dolní Lhota, z.s.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 700 Kč při úhradě v období 1.- 30. září 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 800 Kč při úhradě v období 1.- 23. října 2026

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: 900 Kč při úhradě v období 24. října – 6. listopadu 2026

description: Obora Trail Run is a challenging nine-hour extreme endurance trail race held in Dolní Lhota near Ostrava. During the race, participants complete as many 5 km laps as possible over challenging terrain. The race starts at 9 a.m. and ends at 6 p.m. The organizers provide facilities at the start and finish, including a party tent for resting, and recommend bringing your own sleeping mat or blanket for extra comfort. The race is for individuals over 18 only and emphasizes fair play and safety.
course_highlights: Nine-hour non-stop trail race
5 km loop over challenging terrain
Headlamps must be worn from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m.
additional: Headlamps must be worn from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m. Facilities, including a party tent for resting, are provided at the start and finish. Bringing your own sleeping mat and blanket is recommended. The race is limited to 50 participants. Runners must wear their race number visibly on their outer clothing for the entire race.

name: Nížkovský běh u koupaliště
description: Nížkov Run by the Swimming Pool is a traditional cross-country race organized by TJ Sokol Nížkov and held every spring by the swimming pool in Nížkov. The race has a long-standing tradition and is popular with both local and visiting runners. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in the pleasant natural surroundings of the Vysočina region and is part of the activities of the local Sokol association. The organizers focus on a friendly atmosphere and high-quality race organization.
course_highlights: A cross-country race in the natural surroundings by the swimming pool in Nížkov
A traditional spring date, usually one week after the Easter holidays
Organized by TJ Sokol Nížkov, with a long-standing tradition
additional: The race is part of the activities of TJ Sokol Nížkov, which has a rich history and tradition in the physical education movement. Nížkov Run is held as part of Sokol’s sporting events and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization. The organizers also hold other athletics races and events in the region.

name: Rychlebský maraton
description: The Rychlebský Marathon is a popular trail ultramarathon that takes you along a network of superb mountain trails to the most remote parts of the Rychlebské Mountains, the most forgotten mountains in the Czech Republic. The race offers routes of various lengths, passing through deep valleys, remote ridges and beautiful viewpoints, including the highest peak of the adjacent Góry Bialskie in Poland. The routes are mainly on forest trails and paths, with minimal asphalt, making for a challenging yet scenically rewarding experience. The event also includes an evening programme of talks and entertainment, adding to the race’s sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A network of superb mountain trails in the Rychlebské Mountains
Routes passing through deep valleys, remote ridges and mountain meadows
Views from deserted rocky outcrops and a route passing over the highest peak of the Góry Bialskie in Poland
additional: Parking is available around the venue in Račí údolí, including a paid car park with a bus to the venue. Competitors are divided into two age categories (up to 39 and 40 and over) on all routes. Registration fees are non-refundable, and registration changes are not possible after the specified deadline. The routes are mainly on forest trails, with minimal asphalt; the race is challenging and scenically attractive.

name: Běh na Mědník
description: The Run to Mědník is a sporting event held in the Ore Mountains, with the event hub and registration at the Fénix Restaurant in the village of Měděnec. Runners are transported by bus to the start in Klášterec nad Ohří. The event offers beautiful running experiences amid the picturesque scenery of the Ore Mountains and is suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts alike.
course_highlights: Start in Klášterec nad Ohří
Runners are transported by bus from Měděnec to the start
Picturesque scenery of the Ore Mountains
additional: The event hub and registration are at the Fénix Restaurant in the village of Měděnec. At 10:15, runners are transported by bus to the start in Klášterec nad Ohří. Bus transport for runners from Měděnec to the start in Klášterec nad Ohří.

name: VC Krkonoš Horní Maršov - Pomezní Boudy
location: Horní Maršov to Pomezní sedlo, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: VC Krkonoš Horní Maršov - Pomezní Boudy is a mountain trail race with 540 meters of elevation gain. It starts in Horní Maršov and finishes at the former customs house on Pomezní sedlo at an elevation of 1,050 m above sea level. The course is 13.6 km long, and the race is suitable for all fans of uphill running. A cross-country run is also organized for children and young people, making the event appealing to families. The race is organized by Jiří Kostadinov and is included in the official Czech Athletics Federation race calendar.
course_highlights: Mountain trail race with 540 meters of elevation gain
Finish at the former customs house on Pomezní sedlo, at an elevation of 1,050 m above sea level
Course length: 13.6 km
additional: A cross-country run is organized for children and young people. The race is included in the official Czech Athletics Federation race calendar.

name: Bratčická desítka
location: Bratčice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Bratčická desítka is a running race held in the village of Bratčice in the South Moravian Region. It offers a 10 km main race and a 6.5 km accompanying run. The course is 80% on field and forest paths and 20% on paved roads. The main category traditionally starts at 11:00, and the entry fee includes lunch and refreshments at the finish. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an enjoyable run in nature with a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 80% field and forest paths
20% paved roads
10 km main race and 6.5 km accompanying run
additional: The entry fee includes lunch and refreshments at the finish. The first category starts at 9:00, and the main category starts at 11:00. The organizers are Obec Bratčice and Roman Mazal (contact: 602 280 394). Lunch and refreshments at the finish are included in the entry fee.

name: Běh Semicemi
location: Semice, Nymburk District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Semice Run is a traditional running race organized by Semice Elementary School in the Nymburk District. The race has a long history and is held regularly in spring. Participants can look forward to a welcoming atmosphere and a sporting experience in the picturesque surroundings of Semice. The race is open to the general public, including children, young people, and adults. Results from previous editions are regularly published on the school’s official website.

name: Ultramaratón Košice – Miskolc
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice–Miskolc Ultramarathon is a challenging international ultrarunning race held on April 18, 2026. The route runs from the center of Košice to Miskolc, offering runners the challenge of a long and varied course. The event is part of a series of running events organized by the Košice Marathon Club and is intended for endurance runners looking for a unique experience at the limits of their abilities. The race starts on Hlavná Street in Košice, adding a historic atmosphere and support from local spectators.

name: Ultra Kras
location: Cieľ sa nachádza na parkovisku vedľa kina Hviezda v Turni nad Bodvou
description: Ultra Kras is a 57 km mountain ultramarathon with 2,400 metres of elevation gain, running through Slovak Karst National Park. Both the start and finish are in Turňa nad Bodvou, and the race has a 12-hour time limit. It is part of the Slovak Ultra Trail League and features a challenging route with several refreshment and checkpoint stations. Race registration takes place the day before the start and on race day, with a mass start at 7:00 a.m.

name: Demänovský Štvanec
location: Liptovský Mikuláš, časť Demänová, Liptovský Mikuláš, časť Demänová, Demänová rezort
organizer: WinTeam o.z. a Agentúra 8P v spolupráci s Demänová rezort
description: Demänovský Štvanec is a running event for both recreational runners and competitive athletes, held amid the beautiful scenery of Demänovská Valley in Liptovský Mikuláš. The event features three disciplines: the 5 km Malý Štvanec, the 10 km Veľký Štvanec with TUI, and the Štvanček children’s races. Alongside the sporting experience, participants can enjoy a family-friendly atmosphere and additional activities at Demänová Resort. The event is part of a weekend full of movement, games, and fun, organized by WinTeam o.z. and Agentúra 8P in cooperation with Demänová Resort.

name: Račiansky polmaratón, Račianska desiatka
location: Športový areál Tbiliská 4, Bratislava-Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: The Rača Half Marathon and Rača Ten are traditional running events in the Bratislava-Rača borough, offering participants the choice of a half marathon or a 10K. Runners can enjoy a course through the Tbiliská 4 sports complex and the surrounding parts of Rača. The event is suitable for the general public, including recreational runners and more competitive athletes. It is organised by the Bratislava-Rača borough, which provides quality facilities and services for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Tbiliská 4 sports complex in Bratislava-Rača
Choose between the half-marathon and 10K courses
The route passes through the Rača borough in a pleasant urban setting

name: Prešov Running Series 1. kolo
description: Prešov Running, o.z. warmly invites you to Prešov Stars Run 2026, taking place on 25 April in the centre of Prešov. This running evening will immerse you in the atmosphere of the 1990s, with music, retro sportswear and entertainment. Runners can choose from children’s races and 5 km and 10 km courses, accompanied along the way by DJs and a performance by MC Erik. Prešov Stars Run is the first event in the Prešov Running Series 2026, which consists of three separate races in different parts of the city and its surroundings.

name: Gavurky run 2026 + Backyard ultra
location: Dobrá Niva, Dobrá Niva, Námestie SNP
description: Gavurky Run 2026 is a running event in Dobrá Niva, offering various races, including the main race, a fun run, Nordic walking and a Backyard Ultra. The event takes place on 25 April 2026, with registration and starts at SNP Square. It is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, recreational runners and ultramarathon runners, with capacity limited to 400 participants. The organizer is ŠPORTKLUB Dobrá Niva, o.z., which provides professional event organization and timekeeping.

name: Agrotim Race
location: Zemplínska Nová Ves, Zemplínska Nová Ves, Zemplínsky Klečenov pod altánkom v Oáze oddychu
organizer: Obec Zemplínska Nová Ves a AGROTIM spol. s.r.o
description: Agrotim Race is a running event organized by the Municipality of Zemplínska Nová Ves and AGROTIM spol. s.r.o. It takes place in Zemplínsky Klečenov, beneath the gazebo in the Oáza oddychu. The race is open to men and women, with online registration available until April 22, 2025. An early registration discount is available, while registration on the day costs more. The event is suited to runners looking for an enjoyable run in a natural setting.

name: 1000-ročný beh
location: Spišská Nová Ves, Spišská Nová Ves, Tenisové kurty pri nemocnici s poliklinikou v Spišskej Novej Vsi
description: The 1000-Year Run is a running competition organised by SPK Medveď in Spišská Nová Ves. It takes place on 25 April 2026 at the tennis courts near the hospital and polyclinic. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads, with the main race covering approximately 9.6 km and 267 m of elevation gain. The event also includes categories for children, youth, juniors, Nordic walking and a run for health. The start is at 10:00. Competitors are provided with refreshments along the course and at the finish, including goulash or pierogi and a drink. Registration is available online or by email, and the entry fee is paid on site on race day.

name: Beh oslobodenia Chtelnice
location: Chtelnica okr. Piešťany, Chtelnica okr. Piešťany, pri Obecnom úrade
description: The Chtelnica Liberation Run is a traditional race with an unchanged route. It starts at 1. mája Square and passes through the picturesque surroundings of the Little Carpathians.
