name: Sparkassenlauf und Wandertag TuS Bergen von 1867 e.V.
Mistrovství ČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The Czech Republic Men’s and Women’s Marathon Championships is a prestigious race over the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, held in Prague’s historic city centre, starting in Old Town Square. The race is for men and women over 18 who met the qualifying standards in previous years. It is organised by Juniorský maratonský klub, z.s. in cooperation with RunCzech. Runners can use modern timing services, and a professional photography service is available after the race. The start is traditionally at 08:00 in the morning.
course_highlights: Start and finish in historic Old Town Square in Prague
A 42.195 km route through central Prague
Professional timing and the option to download the GPX route
additional: The race office is open on 1 and 2 May 2026 at the Výstaviště exhibition grounds in Holešovice, in the Křižík Pavilions. Photography is provided by witisi.photo, with the option to pre-order during registration or order after the race. Applications are accepted only from runners who met the qualifying standards between 1 January 2025 and the registration deadline. Participation is subject to the qualifying standards and approval by the technical delegate. The available information relates to the 2025 and 2026 editions, not to the date 9 May 2027.

name: Prague International Marathon 2026
description: The Prague International Marathon is a traditional running race held in Prague’s historic center. The race offers a unique opportunity to run through picturesque streets and past the city’s iconic landmarks. Both the start and finish are in Old Town Square, giving the race a festive atmosphere. The marathon is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts a wide range of runners, from amateurs to professionals.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Old Town Square
The route runs through Prague’s historic center, with views of its landmarks
Firm asphalt surface with minimal elevation changes
additional: Marathon weekend includes accompanying runs such as the LAVAZZA Active Breakfast Run (4.2 km), the dm Family Mile (1.609 km), and the dm bambini run (100–200 m). Photography is provided by witisi.photo and can be pre-ordered during registration or ordered after the race. The time limit and rules are available on the RunCzech website. The race pack and further information are available in the RunCzech mobile app.

name: ORLEN Maraton Praha, MČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The ORLEN Prague Marathon is a prestigious race held in Prague’s historic city centre. It also serves as the Czech Republic Marathon Championships for men and women. The race offers runners a unique opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a city rich in history and enjoy beautiful views. The course passes iconic Prague landmarks and is suitable for both experienced and recreational runners. The running weekend also includes companion races for families and children, highlighting the community spirit of the event.
course_highlights: The course runs through Prague’s historic city centre, with views of its landmarks
A flat, fast course profile suitable for setting personal records
Also hosts the Czech Republic Marathon Championships for men and women
additional: The race pack contains everything participants need for the race. Timing is electronic, with official results. Photography is provided by witisi.photo and can be pre-ordered during registration or purchased after the race. The running weekend also includes family and children’s races, an accompanying programme and a virtual package in the RunCzech mobile app.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 4. kolo
description: The 2 Miles Bratislava Run is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race held at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. It is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place at the venue on race day from 9:30, with the start at 10:00. The race is part of a series in which runners earn points toward a traveling trophy based on their categories and performances.

name: Beh 2 míle
description: The 2-Mile Run in Bratislava at Kuchajda is a regular running race over 2 miles (3.218 km), organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. Check-in and registration take place at the venue by the volleyball court from 9:30; the race starts at 10:00. The race is open to various age categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. It is part of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team traveling cup, where finishing times are adjusted using age coefficients and runners earn points based on participation and performance.

name: Stropkovská dvadsiatka
description: The Stropkov Twenty is a traditional road race with a rich history dating back to 1977, held in the town of Stropkov. The course passes through several villages and gives runners the chance to compete over 20 km, with refreshments along the route and at the finish. The event is organized by Klub Bežcov Stropkov, which supports the development of running in the region. Runners can expect high-quality organization, race packs, and the chance to recover after the race at the indoor swimming pool. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Regional Running League.

name: Stropkovská desiatka a  I. ročník Barefoot
location: Stropkov, Stropkov, Námestie SNP v Stropkove
description: The Stropkov 10K and the 1st Barefoot edition are part of the traditional road races in Stropkov, which have a rich history dating back to 1977. The event is organized by the Stropkov Runners Club to support the running movement in the region and across Slovakia. Runners can look forward to well-prepared courses and an atmosphere created each year by hundreds of fans and runners. In addition to the main race, the program also includes a barefoot run, offering participants a new experience.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Řevnice

description: The Berounka Running Series in Řevnice is a race held in beautiful natural surroundings, starting and finishing at the Řevnice Brewery. The route follows a green educational trail for most of its length, is well marked with red-and-white ribbons, and features a combination of long climbs and descents with views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests. The race is ideal for runners who want to enjoy a pleasant run through picturesque countryside, with refreshments and a baggage drop available on site. After the race, category winners receive diplomas.
course_highlights: The route mostly follows a green educational trail marked with red-and-white ribbons
Two long climbs, including a stretch past the Forest Theatre to Píšťák Pond
Views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests on the descent back to Řevnice
additional: Registration is available online or on site from 17:00; please arrive by 17:30 at the latest. Refreshments and a baggage drop are available on site. The top three finishers in each category receive diplomas. The start and finish are at the Řevnice Brewery; refreshments and a baggage drop are available on site.

description: The Hostivař Forest Park Run in Prague is a trail race offering two distance options: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men. The race is part of the SABZO series and takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Hostivař Forest Park in Prague 10. It is suitable for runners seeking a challenge on natural terrain with varied surfaces. Come enjoy a run in beautiful surroundings and test your strength against other runners.
course_highlights: Trail course in Hostivař Forest Park
Two distances: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men
Part of the SABZO series

name: Žďárák – Čerňák
location: Parking lot by the Church of St. John of Nepomuk on Zelená hora, Žďár nad Sázavou, Czech Republic
description: Čerňák is a trail race along the paths of the Černý les forest around Zelená hora and across meadows towards Vysoké. The 7 km route, with 180 m of elevation gain, features challenging climbs and descents, including two crossings over the summit of Černý les. The race starts and finishes in the car park by the church on Zelená hora, a significant UNESCO site, and offers beautiful views of the town of Žďár nad Sázavou and the surrounding countryside. Trail shoes are recommended, as 90% of the route is off-road and 10% is on asphalt.
course_highlights: The route crosses the summit of Černý les twice and has 180 m of elevation gain
A circuit around the pilgrimage Church of St. John of Nepomuk on Zelená hora (a UNESCO site)
Views of the town of Žďár nad Sázavou and the beauty of Černý les and the area around Konventský Pond
additional: The race starts and finishes in the car park by the church on Zelená hora. The route is marked. Trail shoes are recommended. Photos from the race are available on the club website for 2023, 2024 and 2025. The start and finish are both by the car park at the church on Zelená hora. The entry fee will go towards a charity collection for a sports prosthesis for student Alex Vondra.

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice
location: Sportovní hala u Stromovky, České Budějovice, Czech Republic
organizer: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in České Budějovice is a charity run supporting people with severe visual impairments. The start is at 9:00 p.m. by the sports hall near Stromovka, and participants can choose between a 2.3 km course (1 lap) and a 4.6 km course (2 laps). The event offers an accompanying programme, including a concert, and registration is available through the GoOut.cz portal. The entry fee is 500 Kč, half of which goes directly to helping people with visual impairments. The event has a limited capacity for participants’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: Night run with a choice of 2.3 km and 4.6 km courses
Start and finish by the sports hall near Stromovka in České Budějovice
Charity run with an accompanying programme and concert
additional: Registration is through the GoOut.cz portal, where participants can choose an entry option with a headlamp or a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P cards can enter free of charge, but are not entitled to a headlamp or headband. A changing room and bag storage are available on site, and refreshments and medical services are provided. The run has a limited capacity for participants’ safety.

name: VSE City run Košice
description: VSE City Run in Košice is a 4 km charity run taking place on 7 May 2026. The event is open to the general public, including children, students, seniors and people with disabilities. The entry fee is donated to support the Platform of Families of Children with Disabilities. The run takes place in central Košice and is known for its inclusive atmosphere and community spirit. The organizers work with the Košice Marathon Club and other partners. The aim is not only to promote sport, but also to help families with children with disabilities.

name: VR-Bank Abendlauf
location: Neuenkirchen bei Bramsche, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: Sangerhäuser Citylauf
distance_verbose: 12 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 1500 Meter, 1.2 km, 0.6 km

name: Mistrovství ČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km mužů a žen
description: The Czech Road Running Championships for men and women over 1 mile and 5 km take place in the beautiful surroundings of the spa park in Poděbrady. The course is very fast, with no elevation gain and precisely measured 1 km laps along the spa colonnade, offering ideal conditions for personal records. The race is officially recognized by the Czech Athletics Federation and is part of the prestigious Poděbrady Walking program. The event also features an accompanying program and the chance to receive an original finisher’s medal featuring the spa fountain.
course_highlights: 5 km race over five 1 km laps along the spa colonnade
1 mile race featuring an opening 609 m section and a 1 km lap along the spa colonnade
Very fast, flat course certified for the European Race Walking Championships
additional: Registration is available online only, with payment due within 7 days of registering. Late registrations will have no name printed on the race bib. On-site registration is available until 30 minutes before the race starts. Registration can be transferred free of charge until 21.4.2026; a fee applies after that date. Finisher’s medal featuring the spa fountain. Accompanying program throughout the day along the spa colonnade. Available information about the program, registration, and prices applies to the 2026 edition; details for the date 14. 5. 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Běh vítězství zámeckým parkem Lány
location: Zámecký park Lány, Lány, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Sokol Lány a Základní škola Charlotty Garrigue Masarykové
description: The Victory Run through the Lány Castle Park is a traditional race with a history dating back to 1972. It is held annually on May 7 in the castle park in Lány. The race offers a wide range of categories for children and adults, with distances from 60 to 7,800 metres, running mainly on gravel paths and grass. It is organised by TJ Sokol Lány and Charlotta Garrigue Masaryk Primary School in Lány under the auspices of the Municipality of Lány. The race is suitable for all ages and takes place in the pleasant surroundings of a beautiful park.
course_highlights: The courses run mainly on gravel paths and grass in the castle park
The main race follows the 3,900 m red loop; men run two laps and women one
Children’s distances range from 60 m to 1,500 m, with loops marked in different colours
additional: You can register online until 14:00 on the day before the race, or in person on race day, no later than 30 minutes before your category’s start. Check-in takes place on race day from 7:30 at the main entrance to the castle park, below the castle greenhouse. Race numbers are collected at check-in, and participants line up at the start 5 minutes before their category starts. Participants in the “Run for Health” do not pay an entry fee. The race is traditionally held on May 8; the listed date for the 2027 edition is May 7.

name: Čavisovská stovka
location: TJ Sokol sports field, Čavisov, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Čavisovská Stovka is a long-distance walk in the area around Čavisov, with routes of 30, 50 and 100 km. This traditional event offers routes of varying difficulty, from a relaxed 30 km route and a challenging 50 km route to the royal 100 km route for experienced participants. The start and finish are at the TJ Sokol sports field in Čavisov. The event is suitable for athletes who want to experience the beauty of the Moravian-Silesian Region on a long-distance walk.
course_highlights: 30, 50 and 100 km routes around Čavisov
Royal 100 km route for experienced participants
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol sports field in Čavisov
additional: The routes are divided into a relaxed 30 km route, a challenging 50 km route and a royal 100 km route. GPS coordinates for the start and finish: 49° 49' 47.4'' N, 18° 04' 59.1'' E. Registration is via a form on the website, which opens automatically once the time interval has elapsed. Tourist and aerial maps, as well as the route elevation profile, are available on the website. The organizers provide refreshments, toilets and a shower at the start. Participants may bring dogs, with no time limit.

name: Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice
location: Čechtice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice is a 6 km running race on trails around the town of Čechtice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves in a natural setting with some gentle terrain challenges. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts looking for a quality race with a regional tradition.
course_highlights: Trail course around the town of Čechtice
Race distance: 6 km
Part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup

name: Strážnická stovka
location: Strážnice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné dle datumu přihlášení (pouze pro prvních 150 registrací)

description: Strážnická Hundred is an extreme 100 km ultra trail marathon through the beautiful countryside of the White Carpathians in the heart of South Moravia. This race is only for people over 18 and requires real determination and physical fitness. The course is carefully marked, and runners have access to aid stations and the option to have drop bags transported. The entry fee includes an original race bib with the runner’s name and a metal badge as a reward for pushing their limits. The event offers two start waves with time limits of 15 and 24 hours, so everyone can choose their race goal.
course_highlights: The route passes through the beautiful countryside of the White Carpathians and the heart of South Moravia
The course is marked with red flags, spray-painted arrows and reflective stickers
Aid stations and the option to have drop bags transported to the Května aid station
additional: The race offers two start waves: the 24-hour time limit starts on Friday at 19:30, and the 15-hour time limit starts on Saturday at 5:00. Check-in takes place on Friday from 17:00 to 19:00; reserves should report at 18:45. Drop bags must be smaller than 30 L, labelled with the race number and handed in on Friday at 18:45. After the race, belongings can be collected from Saturday at 14:00. The entry fee includes refreshments at the race venue and aid stations, an original race bib with the runner’s name, and a logo T-shirt (if ordered). Runners receive their race number and chip at check-in. A race bib with the runner’s name is not included in the entry fee for the first 150 registrations. The race is only for people over 18.

name: Poděbrady Running - MČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km a veřejný běh na 5 km
description: Poděbrady Running is the inaugural open Czech Republic Championship in the road mile and 5 km, complemented by a public 5 km run. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of the spa colonnade in Poděbrady and features certified, very fast and flat courses, ideal for setting personal records. Come and run alongside the best Czech runners and enjoy the atmosphere of a high-quality road race. Organized by the Czech Athletics Federation with the support of the running community.
course_highlights: Certified courses suited to fast times
A very fast and flat course
Picturesque surroundings of the spa colonnade in Poděbrady
additional: The first and main category starts at 12:00. The organizer is the Czech Athletics Federation. The course is certified and suitable for attempts at personal records. The race is part of the official Czech Running calendar.

name: Běh osvobození
location: Lišany, Rakovník District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: SK Lišany, z.s. / TJ Sokol Díly
description: The Běh osvobození (Liberation Run) is a traditional 7 km road race between the villages of Lišany and Lužná, held on a low-traffic third-class road. It has a long history dating back to 1972 and is also known as the Lišany Road Seven. The race starts in Lišany, follows a route to Lužná and back, and finishes in front of the U Hřiště restaurant. The race is divided into six age categories and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. Cash prizes and bonuses motivate competitors to beat the course records.
course_highlights: A 7 km route along the low-traffic Lišany–Lužná–Lišany third-class road
Start and finish by the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany
Bonuses for the first approximately 500 m and cash prizes for winners and record-breakers
additional: Race registration opens at 9:30 at the U Hřiště restaurant (Sokol hall) in Lišany and closes 30 minutes before the start. Competitors walk to the start in front of the municipal office. The results ceremony is at approximately 12:30. The race has four men’s and two women’s categories. Cash prizes of up to CZK 19,900. Protests may be submitted within 15 minutes after the race with a deposit of CZK 200.

name: Memoriál otce Jožky
location: Stěbořice, Opava District, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Orel jednota Stěbořice, Farnost Stěbořice, Obec Stěbořice
description: The Father Jožka Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Stěbořice, honoring the memory of priest Josef Motyka. The race offers various distances for men, women, seniors, and children, including a main course of over 10 km and shorter circuits of around 4 km. The event is organized by local organizations and is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a day of sport in the pleasant surroundings of the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race has a long tradition and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Main course of over 10 km, with different categories (men, women, 50+)
Short courses of around 4 km for different age groups, including boys and girls
Special 100 m races for preschoolers
additional: The race is organized by Orel jednota Stěbořice, the Stěbořice Parish, and the Municipality of Stěbořice. Course maps and event posters are available. The race has multiple age- and gender-based categories, including categories for seniors and children. Race records are kept for individual categories.

name: Běh Černou Horou
location: Zámek Černá Hora, Černá Hora, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh Černou Horou is the fourth-oldest cross-country running race in the Czech Republic, with its first edition held in 1928. Since 1933, the race has been called Běh Černou Horou - memoriál MUDr. Jaroslava Hubky and has been part of the Blansko District Running League. The course passes around Černá Hora Castle and offers a challenging but beautiful running experience for all age groups, including children. Hundreds of runners take part every year, from children to adults. A new feature is a four-person relay, allowing friends and colleagues to race together.
course_highlights: The course passes around Černá Hora Castle
A challenging and beautiful 9.2 km course for adults
Children’s categories, with courses for up to 200 children
additional: Registration is available online via the OBL website or in person on race day from 8:00. Relays (4 people) can only be registered in person on race day. Runner check-in takes place in the old changing-room building at the sports complex in Černá Hora. Parking is available in the adjacent lot by the sports complex. The relay is open to men’s, women’s and mixed teams, with no age restrictions.

name: Varínsky lesný beh
organizer: Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík, Obec Varín
description: The Varín Forest Run is a running event in the foothills of the Malá Fatra, offering beautiful routes with views of the Malá Fatra ridge. Competitors can choose between a longer route of 13.7 km with 600 m of elevation gain and a shorter route of 6.5 km with 120 m of elevation gain. The event is suitable for runners and nature lovers who want to enjoy a run in scenic surroundings. The program also includes children’s races, and a raffle takes place after the results are announced. The organizers are Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík, and the municipality of Varín.

name: Memoriál brig. gen. Ľ. Kukorelliho
location: Hanušovce nad Topľou, Hanušovce nad Topľou, Mestský úrad
organizer: Mesto Hanušovce nad Topľou, Mestské kultúrne stredisko mesta Hanušovce nad Topľou, ZO SZPB Hanušovce nad Topľou, Hermanovský bežecký oddiel
description: The Brigadier General Ľ. Kukorelli Memorial is a running event in Hanušovce nad Topľou, offering categories for men, women, relays with varying numbers of members, and a fun run. The organizers are the Town of Hanušovce nad Topľou, the Municipal Cultural Centre, ZO SZPB, and the Hermanovce Running Club. There is no entry fee, allowing the general public to take part without financial burden. The start is at the Municipal Office in Hanušovce nad Topľou.

name: Charitatívny beh obcou Bukovec
organizer: Obec Bukovec a občianske združenie Oáza-nádej pre nový život
description: The Charity Run through the village of Bukovec is a traditional sporting event organized by the Municipality of Bukovec and its mayor, together with members of the municipal council. The run takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Bukovec, which is known for its recreational area with water reservoirs and natural beauty. Runners can enjoy a pleasant sporting experience near the local church while supporting charitable causes. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a community experience in a peaceful setting.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Myślenice 2026
description: Garmin Ultra Race Myślenice is a mountain trail race taking place on May 9, 2026, in the picturesque Beskid Wyspowy mountains, near Kraków. The routes follow forest trails with numerous steep climbs and breathtaking views, offering challenges for runners of varying experience levels. Myślenice combines natural beauty, history, and modern infrastructure, making the event an attractive choice for fans of active recreation. The Garmin Ultra Race series promotes running in harmony with nature, fair play, and support for the running community.

name: Bieg Herosa
location: Klucze, Olkusz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg Herosa is a unique running event held in Klucze near Olkusz, offering a variety of distances and race formats on challenging sandy terrain. The most extreme event is Nomada 9h, where runners battle the desert sand and their own limits for 9 hours, relying on strategy and endurance. Shorter distances are also available, including Nomada 3h, dynamic 5- and 7-kilometer loops, children’s races, and special races with dogs that highlight the teamwork and trust between handlers and their four-legged companions. It’s an event for those seeking a sporting challenge and a connection with nature in a unique desert setting.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
location: Plac im. księdza Jana Twardowskiego, Piecki, Poland
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.
price_range: 50 zł za pojedynczy bieg główny lub 150 zł za cały cykl; biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe bezpłatne
description: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur 2026 is a series of races held on the scenic trails of Masuria, promoting outdoor activity and a connection with nature. The first race in the series, Bieg Śladami Dzika, will take place on May 9, 2026, in Piecki, over a distance of 5.2 km. The course runs along asphalt, cobblestones, and forest roads, offering varied surfaces and beautiful views. The event also includes races for children and young people in different age categories, which are free of charge. The organizer provides participants with water, a hot meal, and a commemorative medal at the finish.
course_highlights: A 5.2 km course on asphalt, cobblestones, and forest roads
Races for children and young people in age categories from 5 to 16 years old
Scenic areas of Masuria and a close connection with nature
additional: The participant limit for all distances at each race is 400. The race office opens 1.5 hours before the start; race packet collection and any on-site registration are available until 30 minutes before the race. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. The organizer provides water and a hot meal prepared by local Rural Housewives’ Clubs. The children’s and youth races are free of charge. The start and finish are at Plac im. księdza Jana Twardowskiego in Piecki. Participants in the main race receive a medal, water, and a hot meal. The limit is 400 participants per race.

name: Blue Power Run
organizer: Fundacja Pełnoprawni MY i Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom z Autyzmem SENSE
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organized for people on the autism spectrum, their families, and friends. The event aims to support social integration through a shared sporting occasion that brings participants together and raises awareness of autism. The race takes place on a paved path beside the Arkonka Swimming Complex in Szczecin. Taking part is above all about the satisfaction of overcoming personal challenges, regardless of finishing position. The event also includes group activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers, further encouraging integration.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place on scenic courses that showcase the natural beauty of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature in Łódź.

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: The Red Nordic Walking Route in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie is a scenic and challenging 8.2 km route, serving as the first stage of the 14th edition of the Nordic Walking Grand Prix. The event will take place on May 9, 2026, and offers an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and discovering local attractions such as the largest wooden clog and a communal feast table. Participants can prepare using the certified Nordic Walking routes available in the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality.

name: I Tyski Bieg Majowy
description: The 1st Tychy May Run for the Mayor of Tychy Cup is an annual running event held in Tychy, attracting runners of different age groups and ability levels. The race takes place in the scenic area around Paprocany Lake, offering participants an appealing course and sporting competition. The event is open to all and promotes an active lifestyle and integration within the local community.
course_highlights: The course runs around Paprocany Lake
Scenic views and natural surroundings
A distance suited to different groups of runners

name: III M Park4RUN
location: Centrum Handlowe M Park, Tarnów, Poland
description: The III M Park4RUN Half Marathon is a race of approximately 21.2 km, taking place on May 9, 2026, in Tarnów, at the M Park Shopping Centre. The course is 100% paved, flat, and marked every 1 km, with road traffic restricted for the duration of the race. The event promotes running and recreation and brings the local community together. In addition to the main race, races for children and teenagers are held over distances suited to their ages. Participants in the main race receive a starter pack containing sponsors’ products as well as informational and advertising materials.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: The 4th Płużnica Five is a 5-kilometer race held in the picturesque village of Płużnica. The course features a variety of surfaces, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. Participants start in the village center, and the event also includes children’s races and a formal awards ceremony. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, as confirmed by positive feedback from participants in previous editions.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Bie...
description: The Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality Cross-Country Running Championships are a series of cross-country races held in the Kąty Wrocławskie municipality. The first event will take place in Krobielowice and invites runners to take part in this outdoor sporting competition. The event is local in character and promotes physical activity and community integration.

name: ProviRun for Invisibles IX Mistrzostwa Biegowe Provi Run
description: ProviRun for Invisibles / 9th Provi Run Running Championships is a 5.5 km road race taking place on May 9, 2026, in Łódź. The race is intended for runners of varying ability levels, and participants can use training plans tailored to their individual level and needs. The event is moderately challenging and takes place on an urban asphalt course. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help everyone prepare optimally for the start.

name: Rajd Beskidy Short
description: Rajd Beskidy Short is a European adventure race held in the scenic Beskid Mountains, on the border between Poland and Slovakia. The event features a variety of disciplines, including mountain biking, trekking, kayaking, climbing and orienteering. The routes cross mountainous terrain, with beautiful views and demanding sections. The race is open to two-person teams and solo participants, offering an intense challenge for adventure and outdoor sports enthusiasts. The start and finish are in the Košice area, and the organizers provide professional service and support.

name: VIII Ultramaraton Warmiński Warneland
description: The 8th Warmian Ultramarathon Warneland is a unique running event held in picturesque Olsztyn. The route follows the charming trails of Warmia, along the Łyna River and Lake Ukiel, offering runners a chance to connect with nature and enjoy beautiful views. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively, both for experienced ultramarathon runners and younger running enthusiasts, who can take part in the Ultra Warmiaczek children’s races. The event’s atmosphere encourages people to connect and share a sporting adventure.

name: XXVII Bieg Wilka
description: The 27th Bieg Wilka is a 10 km road race taking place on May 9, 2026, in Grajewo. This moderately challenging event attracts runners of various ability levels. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to their individual levels, with expert support available. The race is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Silgan Ćwierćmaraton
location: SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A., ul. Rokicka 13, Tczew, Poland
description: The Silgan Quarter Marathon is a 10.54 km race held in Tczew County. The start and finish are located at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. in Tczew. The route passes through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny and has a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic, and the route is marked every kilometre. The event is small-scale, with a limit of 200 paid participants.
course_highlights: A 10.54 km route through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny
Mixed asphalt and gravel surfaces
The route is marked with road markings every 1 km
additional: The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. The number of participants is limited to 200 paid entrants. The start and finish are at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. The race route runs with restricted vehicle traffic. Information about the route and organization is confirmed by the 2025 and 2026 editions; details of the 2027 edition were not available in the sources.

name: Hörster Waldlauf im Naturpark Teutoburger Wald
Niedermeiserer Dorflauf
distance_verbose: 18 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.4 km

name: Běh Mánesovou stezkou
location: Sigma Lutín Stadium, Lutín, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Sigma Lutín a TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc
description: The Run Along the Mánes Trail to Kosíř and Back is a traditional running event held in Lutín and its local part of Třebčín. The race follows a scenic route to the summit of Kosíř and back, offering a sporting experience in a natural setting and a chance to discover the surrounding landscape. The event is part of local sporting activities and is suitable for a wide range of people who enjoy running and hiking.
course_highlights: The route goes to the summit of Kosíř and back
Natural and scenic surroundings
Start and finish at the Sigma Lutín stadium
additional: The event is part of the sporting activities of the municipality of Lutín; both the start and finish are at the Sigma Lutín stadium. The route is suitable for runners and hikers and is held as part of local sports club and community events. The first category starts at 9:00 at the Sigma Lutín stadium. The 16.5 km course is for women and men over 60. The information provided comes from the 2025 and 2026 editions; the 2027 edition has not yet been confirmed.

name: Kros Merklín-Plešivec
location: Merklín, Karlovy Vary District, Karlovy Vary Region, Czech Republic
description: The Merklín-Plešivec Cross-Country Race is a 6.5 km uphill running race that follows forest trails and begins on a ski slope. It is part of the Karlovy Vary Region Runners’ League and gives runners the chance to test themselves on challenging terrain amid the natural beauty around Merklín. The race is suited to fans of mountain running and outdoor running challenges.
course_highlights: 6.5 km uphill course
Forest trails and an opening section on a ski slope
Part of the Karlovy Vary Region Runners’ League

name: Memoriál Jana Janovského
location: Sokolovna and Blatná Castle Park, Blatná, Czech Republic
description: The Jan Janovský Memorial is a traditional sporting event held annually in Blatná, featuring races for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The races take place beneath the Sokolovna and in the castle park, on asphalt and forest trails. The first race starts at 9:00, and in-person registration is available until 15 minutes before the start of each category. The event is supported by the South Bohemian Region and has facilities including toilets, changing rooms, and luggage storage.
course_highlights: The course follows asphalt and forest trails in the castle park
The start and finish are beneath the Sokolovna in Blatná
Categories for all age groups, from age 3 to seniors
additional: In-person registration is available until 15 minutes before the start of each category. Toilets, changing rooms, luggage storage, and washrooms are available. The races receive financial support through grant programs of the South Bohemian Region. Toilets, changing rooms, and luggage storage are available. The race is supported by the South Bohemian Region.

name: Novojičínský půlmaratón
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Nový Jičín, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 400,- Kč v rámci on-line registrace do 31.3.2026 i jeden člen štafety

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 500,- Kč v rámci on-line registrace od 1.4.2026 do 30.4. 2026 i jeden člen štafety

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: členové Atletiky Nový Jičín a Atletiky SVČ Fokus 20,- Kč

description: The Nový Jičín Half Marathon is an open race with a maximum capacity of 430 participants aged 18 and over. It takes place in scenic countryside along the award-winning KOLEJE cycle path from Nový Jičín to Hostašovice and back. The route is mostly asphalt, with a small section of paving, and both the start and finish are on Masaryk Square in Nový Jičín. The event also offers a two-leg relay and children’s categories. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish. The race is organized by Zážitky v pohybu, z.s., and takes place in all weather, with a maximum time limit of 2 hours and 45 minutes.
course_highlights: The route follows the award-winning KOLEJE cycle path from Nový Jičín to Hostašovice and back
95% asphalt, 5% paving
Refreshment stations at kilometres 6.5, 11 and 17, and at the finish
additional: Race packs are distributed on race day from 07:00 to 08:30 at the start venue. A changing room is available at the start for storing belongings. Participants must return their timing chip after finishing; failure to return it incurs a 500 Kč penalty. Medical services are provided at the start, at the refreshment stations and at the finish. The relay consists of 2 legs of 10.5 km each, with bus transport between the legs. The maximum time limit for completing the race is 2 hours and 45 minutes. Information about the start, capacity and participation conditions relates to the previous edition and has not been confirmed for 2027.

name: Přísnotický kros
location: Přísnotice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Přísnotický kros is a traditional running race held in Přísnotice as part of the Zajíc League, where it is the second round. The race offers a wide range of categories, from the youngest children to veterans, with courses adapted to different age groups and abilities. Men and women of all ages can take part, on routes through natural terrain suitable for runners of all levels. Registration and race-number collection take place on race day from 8:30. Children who do not score points in the series may also enter directly at the venue.
course_highlights: A range of course distances, from 110 m for the youngest children to 7,500 m for men and veterans
Natural terrain suited to cross-country running
Categories for all age groups, from children to veterans
additional: Registration and race-number collection begin at 8:30 and are available until 30 minutes before the start of each category. Children who do not score points in the series and adult-category entrants may register directly at the venue until 30 minutes before their start. The youngest children who do not score points in the Zajíc League may register directly at the venue. Race-number collection begins at 8:30.

name: 50 mil železnohorských
location: Náměstí Míru, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
description: The 50 Miles of the Iron Mountains is a challenging trail race held in the Pardubice Region, offering runners a unique experience of running through beautiful countryside with significant elevation gain. The race is part of professionally organized events with quality facilities, refreshments, and GPS tracking to support runners and their fans. The race starts at Náměstí Míru in Heřmanův Městec, in front of the church, and participants can use modern technology to track their performance and results. The race is suitable for experienced ultramarathoners looking for a challenge in the picturesque forests of the Iron Mountains.
course_highlights: A challenging trail with significant elevation gain in the Iron Mountains
Start at Náměstí Míru in Heřmanův Městec, in front of the church
GPS tracking with Queclink GL320MG technology
additional: GPS tracking works with or without the QS Trail registration module. The entry fee includes the option to order a T-shirt, drop bag, and overnight accommodation. Apps for Android and iOS are available for tracking the race. After the race, a replay is available, and results are sent by email. The start location is listed as Náměstí Míru in Heřmanův Městec, in front of the church.

name: Vrchlabí - Strážné
location: Kulturní dům Střelnice, Vrchlabí, Czech Republic
description: Vrchlabí–Strážné is a traditional off-road hill race that runs from Vrchlabí to Strážné over three hills and two descents. The varied course features challenging climbs, technical descents and fast flat sections, making it suitable for hill-running enthusiasts. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and the Hradec Králové Region Championships. The start is at the Střelnice Cultural Centre in Vrchlabí, and the finish is in the car park in Strážné. The race is named in honour of Jan “Píďa” Herbs, its spiritual founder.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly off-road along forest and meadow paths
A challenging climb up Jankův kopec and a technical descent past Jankův háj
A fast, nearly 1.5 km-long flat section ending with a short climb and a sprint on asphalt
additional: The start is at the Střelnice Cultural Centre in Vrchlabí (Švejk restaurant). The route is marked with ribbons and arrows, and kilometre markers are provided. Cross-country or trail shoes are recommended. Refreshments are available at the finish. Transport for runners from the finish back to the start is not provided; using the yellow hiking trail is recommended. The race is held in memory of Jan “Píďa” Herbs.

name: Na dvě rozhledny s Nadačním fondem Bernard

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné činí 500 Kč za rodinu (rodiče a děti do 15 let)

description: The Na dvě rozhledny charity run with the Bernard Foundation is a sports and social event organized by the Bernard Family Brewery in Humpolec. Runners start at intervals and aim to pass through two checkpoints: the Bernard lookout tower and the lookout tower at Orlík Castle. The route follows both paved and unpaved paths, and participants can use a map, compass, or GPS navigation. Every participant is entitled to refreshments at the finish, and a medal is provided for the first 100 people to register. The race is intended for people over 15; younger participants must have permission from a legal guardian.
course_highlights: Staggered starts at 30-second intervals for runners and 5-minute intervals for walking groups
Two checkpoints: the Bernard lookout tower and the lookout tower at Orlík Castle
Route along paved and unpaved paths, with navigation by map, compass, or GPS
additional: A medal is provided for the first 100 registered runners. Water is available to runners at the checkpoint at Orlík Castle. The entry fee includes refreshments at the finish (alcoholic and non-alcoholic beer). Runners must have both checkpoints marked on their race card for their time to count. Registration is available online or by email until 8 May 2026; on-site registration is possible subject to the organizer’s conditions. Participants under 15 must provide permission from a legal guardian. The event is intended for people over 15; younger participants need permission from a legal guardian. The first 100 people to register will receive a medal.

name: FREEDOM RUN
location: Harrachov to Jakuszyce, Czech Republic and Poland
description: FREEDOM RUN is a running race offering two route options through the mountain scenery of the Krkonoše Mountains, with a cross-border atmosphere between Czechia and Poland. The shorter Classic route is 9 km long and runs from Harrachov through Nový Svět to the Mýtiny area and the Polish village of Orle. The longer Mega route is 16 km and is more technically and physically demanding, with greater elevation gain and mountain scenery. Both routes start in Harrachov, and the race combines forest trails with the rolling terrain of the western Krkonoše Mountains. The race is organized with an emphasis on quality and the runners’ experience.
course_highlights: The route passes through the mountain scenery of the Krkonoše Mountains on forest trails
A cross-border atmosphere between Czechia (Harrachov) and Poland (Orle)
Rolling terrain with a gradual elevation gain in the Mýtiny area
additional: The entry fee includes a timing chip and a race bib. The 2027 race was canceled for organizational and technical reasons, and its debut has been postponed until next year. Entry fees already paid will be refunded to participants.

name: Charitativní běh pro Emmičku
description: The Charity Run for Emmička is a traditional sporting event held to support little Emmička, who suffers from serious health problems. The run takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Kramolna, by the fire station, and offers routes suitable for runners and families with children, including the option to run with dogs on a leash. The routes follow paved forest paths that are also accessible to jogging strollers and wheelchairs. Participants can choose to run or walk, depending on their abilities. The event is dog-friendly and fosters a community spirit, aiming to help Emmička through sport and voluntary donations.
course_highlights: 3 km and 7 km routes along paved forest paths
Children can take part in a 200 m race
Accessible to jogging strollers and wheelchairs; dog-friendly (dogs on a leash)
additional: The event is dog-friendly. Dogs must be on a leash or in a harness throughout the run. The routes are also suitable for jogging strollers and wheelchairs. Participants can run or walk, depending on how they feel.

name: Košice Peace Half marathon
location: Dolná brána, Hlavná ulica, Košice, Slovakia
organizer: Maratónsky klub Košice, Progress Promotion Košice
description: The Košice Peace Half Marathon is a traditional half marathon held in the historic center of Košice. The course runs along the city’s picturesque streets, including Dolná brána and Hlavná ulica, offering runners a unique experience in an atmosphere of peace and sporting spirit. The event is part of a series of running events in Košice and is organized with an emphasis on quality and safety for all participants.

name: Strážovská 50
location: Trenčianske Teplice, Okres Trenčín, Trenčiansky kraj
description: Strážovská 50 is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike covering 50 km, held in the beautiful surroundings of the Strážov Mountains. The start and finish are in the spa town of Trenčianske Teplice. The route follows marked hiking trails and is ITRA-certified at Mountain level 5. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League 2026 and offers a challenging experience for both runners and hikers.

name: Beh oslobodenia Lietavskej Lúčky
location: Lietavská Lúčka, Lietavská Lúčka, dom kultúry
organizer: Obec Lietavská Lúčka v spolupráci s Bežeckou ligou Žilina
description: The Lietavská Lúčka Liberation Run is a running event organized by running enthusiasts and the municipality of Lietavská Lúčka. The race takes place by the cultural center in Lietavská Lúčka and features a course with asphalt and cooperative-farm surfaces. The 10 km race starts at 9:30, and the children’s race starts at 9:40. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing runners of different age groups to participate.

name: Vertical Chopok
description: Vertical Chopok is a vertical running event taking place on 9 May 2026 in the Low Tatras, on a route from Srdiečko to Chopok South. Runners face a challenging course with nearly 950 metres of elevation gain over 6.4 km. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and also serves as a qualifying race in the vertical category. The course runs mostly along the road to Kosodrevina and through Zadné Dereše, allowing runners to give their best performances. The Vlado Plulík Memorial, after which the event is named, has a long-standing tradition and commemorates a notable figure in Slovak sport.

name: Podhájska Trail
location: Podhájska, Podhájska, areál termálneho kúpaliska Podhájska
description: Podhájska Trail is a community running event at the Podhájska Thermal Swimming Pool, bringing together exercise in nature, a healthy lifestyle, and the local community. The race offers two main courses—a long 18 km route with 353 m of elevation gain and a short 7 km route with 143 m—as well as children’s races of varying lengths based on age. The route runs mostly along forest roads and paved cycle paths, with the start and finish at the thermal swimming pool. The event also has a charitable aspect, supporting local young people by purchasing sports equipment.

name: Squarebizz Ultra maratón na 6 hodinovka a M-SR v behu na 50 km
location: Bratislava - Devínska Nová Ves, Bratislava - Devínska Nová Ves, Areál Squarebizz Business Center Bory
description: The Squarebizz Ultra 6-hour race and Slovak Championships in the 50 km run is a challenging running event held at the Squarebizz Business Center Bory in Bratislava–Devínska Nová Ves. The event offers two main disciplines: a 50 km run and a 6-hour run, with men and women competing in various age categories. It also serves as the Slovak Championships in the 50 km run, adding to its prestige and appeal for endurance runners. The organizer is Michal Šuľa, who also provides contact information for those interested in taking part. Entry fees vary by discipline and registration date, increasing gradually until the beginning of May 2026.

name: Krupanská desiatka
location: Dolná Krupá, Dolná Krupá, areál OŠK Dolná Krupá
organizer: Bežecký klub Dolná Krupá a Obecný úrad Dolná Krupá
description: Krupanská Desiatka is a traditional running race organized by Bežecký klub Dolná Krupá, held at the OŠK Dolná Krupá grounds. The course is 10 km long with 107 metres of elevation gain; 85% of the route is on asphalt and 15% on forest road. In addition to the main 10 km race, the event also includes shorter runs and a 5 km Nordic walking route. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants and offers a pleasant outdoor sporting atmosphere.

name: BTK Run Fest
location: Veľký Biel, Veľký Biel, Areál kaštiela
organizer: Občianske združenie Bežecko Triatlonový klub Veľký Biel
description: BTK RUN FEST 2026 is a running event for everyone, taking place on May 9 in the grounds of the manor house in Veľký Biel. It offers a range of events, including 5 km and 10 km road races, children’s races, a parent + child relay, and an adrenaline-filled obstacle race for children and adults. The routes run mainly on asphalt and paved surfaces around a lake in picturesque surroundings. The event is suitable for recreational runners, families, and experienced athletes, with awards and medals for the top finishers and all finishers.

name: Fiľakovský cross
location: Fiľakovo okr. Lučenec, Fiľakovo okr. Lučenec, štadión FTC
description: The Fiľakovo Cross is a running event organized by OZ FTC Fiľakovo and the Sports and Physical Education Commission of the Municipal Council in Fiľakovo. The races take place at the FTC stadium in Fiľakovo and offer various categories, including children’s, hobby, and Nordic walking. The course combines dirt roads, asphalt, and grass, making the run varied and interesting. The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 12:30. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere.

name: EuroPainClinics Horský beh Bardejov
location: Bardejov, Bardejov, Bardejovské kúpele, Reštaurácia Kúpeľná dvorana (vedľa hotela Alexander)
organizer: EPC Pro Health Team a BarRan Team
description: EuroPainClinics Bardejov Mountain Run is a mountain race held in the picturesque surroundings of Bardejov Spa. Runners can choose from three options: a cross-country half marathon with more than 1,000 metres of elevation gain, a seven-kilometre spa course, and accompanying children’s and youth categories. The event is suitable for all runners who enjoy challenging terrain and mountain running. The organizers provide refreshments along the course, medals, T-shirts, and other benefits for participants who register early.

name: Beh pre Labky
location: Košice, Košice, Košice - Kavečany, chata Hrešná
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: Run for Paws 2026 is a charity run organized by the Union for Mutual Assistance of People and Dogs (UVP). It will take place in Košice, in the Kavečany area near the Hrešná cottage. The event’s 10th edition gives runners a chance to support a good cause while enjoying a pleasant run in nature. The course is 5 km long and suitable for all age groups, including children and runners with dogs. The event is open to the general public and offers various categories based on age and participant type.

name: DOBRObeh
organizer: KERIC Čadca, Centrum voľného času Čadca, Terminovka.sk, Červený kríž, Detské oddelenie KNsP Čadca, Mesto Čadca
description: DOBRObeh is a charity run in Čadca offering five different routes, including the 21.5 km main run named after Mária Marcibálová, with 600 m of elevation gain. The route runs mostly through forest, along asphalt roads and across meadows, and is clearly marked and supported by event staff. The event is for all runners who want to support a good cause, and everyone who takes part is a winner. The start is on Palárikova Street, by the Rybka fountain in Čadca’s pedestrian zone. In addition to the main run, shorter routes are available, including 10 km, 4.5 km and children’s races.

name: RASA Druskininkų maratonas
organizer: Asociacija Sporto renginiai ir Druskininkų sporto centras
description: The RASA Druskininkai Marathon is an international running event held in Druskininkai by Lake Vijūnėlė. The event promotes running as a healthy lifestyle, aims to popularize athletics in Lithuania, and encourages Druskininkai residents to be more active. Anyone may take part in the races, but participants in the marathon and half marathon must be at least 18 years old. Runners compete in various distances, from 500 m to the marathon, and everyone receives a special event medal.

name: 5. Festiwal Gorski Jedlina-Zdroj
price_range: od 120 zł do 250 zł, mieszkańcy gminy 50 zł
description: The 5th Jedlina-Zdrój Mountain Festival is a mountain running event taking place on 10 May 2026 in Jedlina-Zdrój. Participants can choose from three distances: 10 km, 23.5 km and 50 km. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace. The route runs through the scenic Wałbrzych Mountains, including Borowa Mountain, which has a newly built observation tower, and features challenging climbs and varied terrain. The event is a great opportunity to enjoy an active break and discover the charms of the region.
course_highlights: The route passes over Borowa Mountain, with its new observation tower
Varied terrain: gravel roads, asphalt roads, forest trails and mountain paths
Distances of 10 km, 23.5 km and an ultra 50 km, with refreshment and timing checkpoints
additional: The total participant limit is 600. Festival T-shirts can be ordered until 19.04.2026 for 90 zł; they are made from high-quality Attiq technical fabric. The 50 km ultra route has 7 refreshment stations and 5 timing checkpoints. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace, ul. Zamkowa 4. The organizer reserves the right to modify the route up to one week before the start. The mountain route is demanding and features varied terrain. There is a limit of 600 participants, online registration, possible date changes in the event of sanitary restrictions, accommodation options and festival T-shirts for participants.

name: Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race held simultaneously around the world. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the runners and gradually increases its speed until it catches the last participant. In Gdańsk Południe, the race will take place on May 10, 2026, starting at 13:00 near the Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie finish area. The course is an approximately 3 km loop on a paved surface, with a slight uphill section on the connecting path. All entry fees support spinal cord research.

name: 13. PKO Białystok Półmaraton
description: The 13th PKO Białystok Half Marathon is the largest running event in eastern Poland. Organized since 2013, it is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown. Runners cover the half-marathon distance of 21.097 km in the picturesque city of Białystok. The event also includes the PKO Night Run over 5 km, which can be a great warm-up before the half marathon, as well as races for children. It is a true celebration of running, attracting participants from across Poland and abroad.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race in which all participants start simultaneously around the world, running away from the Catcher Car. The race has no traditional finish line—participants run until they are caught by the car. All entry fees go toward research into treatments for spinal cord injuries, making this not only a sporting challenge but also a charity event. You can take part locally or via the app, which lets you run from anywhere in the world.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz, with an emphasis on the aesthetic appeal of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during a spring race.

name: Charytatywna Dycha
description: Charytatywna Dycha is a sports and charity running festival held in Miechów to benefit Caritas Hospice. The event brings the local community together to support hospice patients by raising funds for essential medical equipment. The race takes place around the park, and participants, donors, and organizers come together to create an atmosphere of empathy and solidarity. This unique initiative not only promotes physical activity but also raises public awareness of hospice care.

name: II JBL Run Katowice
description: The II JBL Run Katowice is a charity street race taking place on May 10, 2026, in Katowice, with 3 km (family walk&run), 5 km, and 10 km routes. All proceeds from entry fees will be donated to the Dla Ludzi Potrzebujących Pomocy „Gniazdo” Foundation. The start and finish are located at Sławik and Antall Square, and the route passes iconic Katowice landmarks such as Spodek, MCK, NOSPR, the Silesian Museum, and the Silesian Insurgents’ Monument. The race promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants will receive commemorative medals and can enter a prize draw.

name: II Olkuski Test Coopera
description: The 2nd Olkusz Cooper Test is an annual sporting event held at the MOSIR stadium in Olkusz. The competition consists of a 12-minute Cooper Test, a popular measure of running endurance. The event is open to everyone, with participation limited to 100 people. Starts begin at 9:00, and participants can choose a convenient start time between 9:00 and 13:30. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness and compete in a friendly atmosphere.

name: IX Bieg Pilicy
description: The 9th Pilica Run is a small-scale running event held in the charming town of Białobrzegi on the Pilica River. The start and finish are located in the centrally situated, revitalized Zygmunt Stary Square, and the route runs along the town’s main streets. The event combines sport, passion, and a family-friendly atmosphere, offering distances for different ability levels: a 10 km main race, a 3 km recreational run, and a 3 km Nordic walking event. Colorful races tailored to participants’ ages are organized for children and teenagers. Every participant can enjoy a hot meal, drinks, and a voucher for local ice cream.

name: Wings for life world run App
description: The Wings for Life World Run App is a unique race held simultaneously around the world on May 10, 2026. Participants start at the same time wherever they choose, with the goal of outrunning a virtual Catcher Car that starts chasing them 30 minutes after the start. All entry fees go toward research into spinal cord injuries, and the mobile app provides motivation and a unique audio experience during the race. It’s a race for everyone—from beginners to professionals, runners, wheelchair users, and amateurs.

name: XV Działoszyńska Dziesiątka
description: The 15th Działoszyńska Dziesiątka is a road race held in Działoszyn on May 10, 2026. The event is organized by Stowarzyszenie Atelier Sportu, which specializes in professional timing and running-event organization. The race is scheduled to start at 16:00. The event attracts runners who value well-organized races with electronic timing.

name: XXIX Górski Bieg Magurki
description: The 29th National Magurka Mountain Run is an annual running event organized since 1997 by the “Groniczek” People’s Student Sports Club in Bielsko-Biała. The event is open to the public and promotes mountain running and an active lifestyle. The 8.8 km course, with 509 m of elevation gain, leads from the Straconka district to the summit of Magurka, passing through the scenic area of Mała Straconka and forest trails. The race attracts leading Polish mountain runners as well as competitors from abroad, and the course is professionally secured and clearly marked.

name: XXXIII Biegi Żnińskie
description: The 33rd Żnińskie Runs is an annual running event held in Żnin, scheduled for May 10, 2026. The event includes road races over 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are located at Freedom Square. The 10 km race counts toward the Pałuki Grand Prix. Participants receive a race pack containing a commemorative medal from the “Great People of Żnin” series, a recovery meal, and souvenirs from Pałuki. The race office is open on race day from 9:00 to 11:45 at Primary School No. 1 in Żnin.

name: Běh ve Skalce – Memoriál Radomila Večeři
location: Skalka u Prostějova, Prostějov District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh ve Skalce - Radomil Večeřa Memorial is a traditional running race organized by the Prostějov Marathon Club in the beautiful surroundings of Skalka near Prostějov. The race gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on challenging routes through a natural forest park with good signage. The event is suitable for both amateurs and experienced runners who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of the Olomouc Region. The club also regularly organizes other running events and supports the local running community.
course_highlights: Skalka forest park near Prostějov
Well-marked routes along cycle paths and partly on roads
Beautiful natural surroundings of the Drahany Highlands
additional: Registration has been handled through a partner system since 2026. The race is part of the Prostějov Marathon Club’s regular events. Maps of the routes and information about other running races in the region are available on the website.

name: Běh kolem Babího lomu
location: Kulturní dům, Kuřim-Podlesí, Kuřim, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 100 Kč (zahrnuto občerstvení po závodě, pro děti je startovné dobrovolné)

description: The Run around Babí lom is a traditional race in the Kuřim Running League, held in the picturesque surroundings of Kuřim-Podlesí. The race offers a hilly 8.4 km course that runs almost entirely through the forest, providing runners with an enjoyable trail experience. Children can take part in a fun run on a shorter loop. Race facilities are available at the cultural centre, where participants can change, and refreshments are provided after the race. The start and registration take place at the sports field by the cultural centre.
course_highlights: Hilly 8.4 km course, almost entirely through the forest
Children’s fun run on a shorter 2.6 km loop
Changing facilities and refreshments at the cultural centre
additional: Registration takes place from 9:00 to 9:45 at the race venue. After the race, refreshments are available at Hospůdka U Anděla in exchange for returning the race number. Online registration is available, with the possibility of a discount on the entry fee. The race is part of the Kuřim Running League and takes place off public roads. Refreshments are provided after the race.

name: Běh choceňskými sady
location: Park u choceňského zámku, Choceň, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Choceň Gardens is a traditional running race organized by the Choceň Ski Club, held in the picturesque park by Choceň Castle. The race offers various courses for adults and youth categories, allowing participants to enjoy running in a natural setting with high-quality organization. It is part of the ISCAREX Cup and attracts runners of all ages and ability levels. It is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners looking to enjoy a pleasant day of sport in Choceň Gardens.
course_highlights: Run in the park by Choceň Castle
Various course distances from 0.15 km to 15 km
Categories for children and adults
additional: The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and offers a wide range of categories based on age and course distance. It is organized by the Choceň Ski Club. The total number of participants across all editions exceeds 4,500. Registration is available through the ISCAREX Cup website.

name: Polevský běh
location: Lyžařská bouda na Jedličné, Polevsko–Kytlice, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: předem přes web nazavody.cz do 8.5. za zvýhodněné startovné

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: předem přes web nazavody.cz do 8.5. za zvýhodněné startovné

description: The Polevský Run is a traditional running race organized by the Ski Polevsko club in the picturesque Lusatian Mountains between Polevsko and Kytlice. The race features a varied route across rolling, hilly terrain, partly following winter ski trails, forest paths and pastures, with beautiful views of the surrounding peaks and landscape. Choose between 5 km and 10 km routes; children’s races are also included, making the event suitable for all ages and abilities, including families with children. Race facilities are at the ski lodge in Jedličná, where registration, the start and the finish take place.
course_highlights: Rolling, hilly terrain in the Lusatian Mountains
The route follows winter ski trails, forest paths and pastures
Beautiful views of Klíč, Ještěd, Jedlová, Ralsko, Bohemian and Saxon Switzerland, Bezděz and the Česká Lípa region
additional: You can register online until 8 May for a discounted entry fee. Payment is accepted on site in cash or via QR code. Race numbers must be collected in good time, no later than half an hour before the start; otherwise, runners will not be allowed to start. Parking is available in the nearby parking area in Jedličná and, if it reaches capacity, in the winter car park below Jedličná. The race is part of the Česká Lípa District Running League. The programme also includes children’s races.

name: Lesní běh Kalichem
location: Besedice, Koberovy, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Kalich Forest Run is a traditional sporting event organized by TJ Sokol Koberovy in the beautiful countryside of the Bohemian Paradise, in an area called Kalich. The race is open to all age groups, from preschoolers to seniors over 60 who enjoy running in nature. Starts are divided into several age categories so everyone competes against evenly matched opponents. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, excellent refreshments, and the participation of dozens to hundreds of runners each year. The organizers provide full event management, including timing and refreshments featuring traditional dishes and drinks.
course_highlights: A run through the beautiful countryside of the Bohemian Paradise in the Kalich area
Age categories ranging from preschoolers to seniors
Traditional refreshments including chicken legs, sausages, and draft beer
additional: Race-day registration runs from 8:00 to 9:15, with the first category starting at 9:25. The event is held under the patronage of the Koberovy Municipal Office and is supported by a grant program of the Liberec Region. The organizers provide timing, course setup, and refreshments at the race venue.

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Bratislava
description: The Wings for Life World Run Bratislava is a unique event where runners and wheelchair participants start simultaneously and race against a virtual Catcher Car that gradually catches up with them. There is no finish line; runners keep going until the car passes them. The course runs through Sad Janka Kráľa, one of the oldest parks in Europe, and combines a variety of settings. The event supports spinal cord injury research, with 100% of registration fees going to this cause. The race starts at exactly 1:00 p.m.

name: Benefičný beh PRO AUTIS
location: Soblahov, Trenčín, Soblahov, Trenčín, Soblahov - bývalá horáreň
description: The PRO AUTIS Charity Run is a charitable running event whose proceeds go to the PRO AUTIS autism center in Trenčín. The race takes place in Soblahov near Trenčín and offers various distances, including children’s races and 5 km, 10 km, and 13.3 km courses. The event is open to runners of all ages, and the organizers emphasize personal achievement and pushing your own limits. Online registration is open until May 8, 2026, with the option to register in person on race day.

Stropkovská päťka a Nordic walking
