description: Stonařov Alleys is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1978, held in the picturesque surroundings of Stonařov in the Vysočina Region. The main race follows dirt and forest paths along a stream and along Green Alley to a hunting lodge. The course has a gentler elevation profile and is mostly soft underfoot, with about 30% asphalt. The event offers races for various age groups, from preschoolers to veterans, with distances ranging from 200 metres to 10 km. Every participant receives a commemorative prize, while category winners receive prizes and medals.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race follows dirt and forest paths, with 30% asphalt.
The route runs along a stream and Green Alley to a hunting lodge.
A gentler elevation profile and mostly soft surfaces.
additional: The start is at the football pitch. Categories are for participants aged 3 and over. Youth runners can take part for free. Every participant receives a certificate and a small pack. The first three finishers in each category receive prizes; youth participants receive medals. The travelling Stonařov Runner’s Cup is awarded to the best man and woman in the main race. According to the available description, participants receive a commemorative prize and certificate, while category winners receive prizes and the travelling Stonařov Runner’s Cup.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas „Laisvės taku 2026“
description: The traditional “Laisvės taku 2026” run will take place on May 22, 2026, in the town of Šimkaičiai, Jurbarkas District, to mark the 117th anniversary of the birth of General Jonas Žemaitis. This is an 11 km cross-country race starting at General Jonas Žemaitis’s command post. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and honours the memory of a Lithuanian freedom fighter. Participants are invited to register in advance and take part in this community sporting event.
course_highlights: An 11 km cross-country race in the Šimkaičiai area
Start at General Jonas Žemaitis’s command post
Bus transport to the start from Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School
additional: Participant registration is open from 9:00 to 9:30. Bib pickup is on 2025-05-23 from 9:00 to 9:30. Registration venue: Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School. The bus to the start leaves from the school at 09:45. Awards are scheduled for 13:00. Participants must have a doctor’s permission or have had a health check. Results will be published publicly. Photos and video footage will be taken during the event for marketing purposes. The event will take place at Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School; age groups and online registration are available.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultrarun held in the picturesque Low Beskids, with routes of varying difficulty. The event draws inspiration from the historic “Jaga-Kora” Courier Route from World War II, giving the race a distinctive character and historical significance. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 19 km to 101 km, passing through the areas of Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój. The race is certified by ITRA and UTMB, underscoring its standing in the mountain running community.

name: Maraton Zagłębiowski
organizer: Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji w Dąbrowie Górniczej
description: The Zagłębie Marathon is a prestigious marathon held at ArcelorMittal Park - ZPS Sosnowiec. The course is officially certified by the Polish Athletics Association, guaranteeing an accurately measured distance and reliable results. The event is for runners of varying ability levels and combines sporting competition with the satisfaction of overcoming personal challenges. The organizers provide professional organization and extensive support for participants.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden in Gdynia. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Poland since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who value being close to nature and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors among the greenery and enjoy a unique atmosphere.

name: I Górski Pólmaraton Szczytniański
description: The 1st Szczytniański Mountain Half Marathon is a unique running event held in picturesque Szczytna, on a 21.1 km course featuring numerous mountain climbs. The race offers beautiful views of this charming town in the Kłodzko region and a chance to connect with nature, creating unforgettable experiences for every participant. The event also includes a 10 km Nordic walking race, an excellent option for those who enjoy being active without time pressure. The event organizer, the Szczytna Biega Association, promotes a healthy lifestyle and brings the local running community together.

name: Pancerna Piątka
organizer: Zarząd Wojewódzki NSZZ Policjantów województwa podkarpackiego
description: Pancerna Piątka is the Podkarpackie Police Championships in a 5 km road race, held in Żurawica. The event is held under the Honorary Patronage of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship Police Commander in Rzeszów. More than 400 participants take part, and the route runs along roads through Żurawica. The organizer is the Regional Board of the Police Officers’ Independent Trade Union of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship.

name: 23. Półmaraton Hajnowski
description: The 23rd Hajnówka Half Marathon is a unique and unforgettable race held in the picturesque area of Białowieża, near Hajnówka. The half-marathon course runs through the charming grounds of Hajnówka Municipal Park, giving participants a chance to enjoy nature and beautiful views. The event is very popular and is organized by the Hajnówka Sports and Recreation Centre, which ensures runners’ comfort and safety. The race office is open the day before the race and on race day. Participants can expect race packs and a coffee buffet.

name: 48 Zdrojowy Bieg Zwycięstwa
description: The 48th Zdrojowy Victory Run is an annual running event organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Gołdap. The race takes place on May 23, 2026, and attracts runners from various regions. Temporary traffic disruptions occur during the race, reflecting the strong involvement of the local community. The event combines sport and recreation and is an important fixture in Gołdap’s sporting calendar.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of Gołdap
The course runs through the area around the Sports and Recreation Center
Temporary traffic disruptions during the race underscore the event’s significance
additional: Temporary traffic disruptions related to the race organization will occur on race day, May 23, 2026.

name: Bieg Lwa
description: The Lion Run is an annual half marathon held in Tarnowo Podgórne, attracting both elite runners and amateurs. The event is known for its excellent organization, appealing course, and enthusiastic crowds. The festival also features children’s races and a variety of accompanying events, such as cheering competitions and concerts. The Lion Run is a great opportunity for sporting competition and family fun in beautiful surroundings.

name: Bieg Poznaniaka
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na Rzecz Edukacji Dzieci i Młodzieży z Autyzmem „Aperio”
description: Bieg Poznaniaka dla Przedszkolaka is a family running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in the scenic Wielkopolski National Park and on the grounds of the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa. The program includes main races of 11 km and 5.5 km, a Nordic Walking march, and children’s and youth races over various distances. The event is charitable, with all proceeds going to support children with autism. Organizers provide electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals, and numerous activities for participants and their families, including free museum admission and outdoor games for children.

name: Maraton Sztafet Ekiden
description: The 20th Onet Marathon Relay is Poland’s largest team running event. It will take place on May 23, 2026, at the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw. This unique event brings together runners of all ability levels, with teams of six covering the marathon distance together in the Japanese ekiden relay format. The event promotes team spirit and cooperation, offering relay legs of different distances to make it easier for beginner runners to take part. It’s a great opportunity for friendly competition and for friends, families, and coworkers to come together.

name: Nowomiejska Dycha
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Nowym Mieście Lubawskim
description: Nowomiejska Dycha is a special night-time street race taking place on 23 May 2026 in Nowe Miasto Lubawskie. The course runs along the town’s atmospheric, historic streets, offering participants a unique experience and the chance to compete for attractive prizes. The programme includes two races: a 5 km race at 18:00 and a 10 km race at 20:00. Both start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, post-race meals and a great time in charming surroundings.

name: Phoenix RUN
organizer: Klub Biegowy Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska i Opalenicki Klub Biegacza
description: Phoenix RUN is a unique sporting event held in a picturesque forest near the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. It is the second edition of the race, organized by the Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska Running Club, bringing together running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The event offers a range of distances for adults and children, encouraging active time with family and friends. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, commemorative medals and attractive prizes, as well as a chance to socialize and enjoy the chillout zone.

name: Sieprawska Piątka
description: Sieprawska Piątka is an annual race held in Siepraw, attracting runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event takes place in a picturesque area, and the course runs through Słoneczny Park and the Orlik sports complex, offering participants comfortable conditions for competition and recreation. The race brings people together and promotes physical activity among residents and visitors. The organizers provide extensive sports facilities and support during the event.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultrarun held in the scenic Low Beskids, near Rymanów-Zdrój. The course follows the historic Beskid Courier Route “Jaga-Kora,” which was used during World War II. The event features five races of varying difficulty and distance, from 19 km to 101 km. The races are certified by ITRA and UTMB, underscoring their prestige and high standard of organization. Join us for the 10th edition, taking place on May 23, 2026.

name: VII Skaryszewski Bieg Konia
description: The 7th Skaryszew Horse Run is an annual running event held at the Hubertus Stud Farm in Skaryszew. The main event is the 10 km Horse Ten, which follows field, unpaved and forest roads, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and enjoy sporting competition. The event aims to promote running as a form of active recreation and a healthy lifestyle, as well as to bring the local community together. In addition to the main race, children’s races are also held, making the event appealing to the whole family.

name: X Leśne Bieganie dla Zdrowia
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Miedźnej, Szkoła Podstawowa we Frydku, Nadleśnictwo Kobiór
description: The 10th Forest Run for Health is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Miedźna, based in Wola. The race takes place on forest trails measuring 5.5 km and 10 km, which can be downloaded in GPX format to a smartwatch or smartphone. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and outdoor activity, encouraging runners of different ages and ability levels to take part. Registration is online, and the rules are available on the organizer’s website.

name: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach
description: The 15th Run Through the Wichrowo Forests is an annual running event organized by the Wichrowo Forest District, attracting people who enjoy spending active time outdoors in nature. The main event is a 10 km race through scenic forest areas. There are also races for children and young people, people with intellectual disabilities, and a Nordic walking event. The start and finish are located at the Wichrowo Forest District office, and participants can take part in a familiarization run on the course.

name: XVI Bieg Koziołków
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Kędzierzynie-Koźlu
description: The 16th Koziołki Run is an annual running event held in Kędzierzyn-Koźle, aimed mainly at children and young people. The event takes place on May 23, 2026, and features professional RFID timing to ensure accurate results. It is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle. A family-friendly sporting event, it promotes physical activity among the youngest participants. The race starts at 4:00 p.m., and registration is open until May 18, 2026.

name: XX Bieg Lupusa
description: The 20th edition of the Lupus Run will take place on May 23, 2026, in Bartkowo, Dobroszyce. This race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and offers professional timekeeping, a medal, a meal, and excellent organization and atmosphere. The event attracts athletes from across the country, creating a unique atmosphere of competition and camaraderie. Registration is now open on the dedicated website.

name: XXI Cross Maraton przez Piekło do Nieba
description: The 21st Cross Marathon “From Hell to Heaven” is a unique running event organized by the PTTK Branch in Końskie. The event will take place on May 23, 2026, and attracts both runners and recreational running enthusiasts, offering a challenging course in a picturesque area. The marathon is known for its interesting and demanding route, which passes through places called Piekło and Niebo, highlighting its character and challenge. The organizers provide professional service and support for participants.

name: XXVIII Bieg Święców
description: The 28th Święców Run in Sławno is an annual running event taking place on May 23, 2026. The 10 km main race follows city streets, including asphalt roads, basalt paving and asphalt bike paths. The course is secured and marked, with water stations along the route. The event also includes races for children and young people at the athletics stadium, over distances from 50 to 600 metres. The organisers promote community togetherness and a healthy lifestyle.

name: XXXIV Bieg Uliczny po Ziemi Makowskiej
II Podgórski Bieg i Marsz Leśnymi Ścieżkami
V Ultra Nordic Walking World Records
Wälster Lauf
description: The Wälster Lauf is a traditional fun run and road race in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde, organised annually by Fortuna Walstedde. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and offers runners and walkers of all ages an appealing opportunity to get active. The event traditionally opens the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract growing numbers of participants. Alongside competition, the focus is also on the enjoyment of exercise and community.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde
Fun run and road race with various distances
Traditional opening event of the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde
additional: The Wälster Lauf offers running and walking on a DLV-measured course. The event includes various age groups and distances, including a Bambini run, children’s races, a fun run, 5 km and 10 km road races, and walking. Start times are staggered from 15:30 to 17:15. The event opens the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract growing numbers of participants. It is a well-established regional running tradition, with courses known for their accuracy and fairness. It is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.

name: Jistebnický VH maraton
location: Sportovní areál TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: Maraton, Maraton, Půlmaraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 3.6 km
description: The Jistebník VH Marathon is a traditional running event held amid the picturesque countryside on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area, with routes ranging from 3.6 km to a marathon. The start and finish for all races are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. The races offer beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains and also include a children’s Olympics with an accompanying program, making the event appealing to whole families and runners of all ages. The event is organized by Jistebník v pohybu z. s., which focuses on a friendly atmosphere and quality facilities for participants.
course_highlights: Routes run through the countryside on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area, with views of the Beskydy Mountains
Start and finish at the TJ Jistebník sports complex
A varied selection of routes from 3.6 km to a marathon, including relay races
additional: Registration for all races opens at 7:00 and closes 20 minutes before the start of each race. Refreshments are available on the course, and one refreshment is provided at the finish; additional drinks and food are available at the local pub, known for its Marathon Soup. Parking is available near the sports complex and at the railway station; using train and bus connections is recommended. Runners can receive a discount on their entry fee if they donate blood or blood plasma.

name: Vrané – Zvole
description: Vrané - Zvole is part of the KOPEC series, which features hill races in Prague and the surrounding area. This race offers a challenge in the form of a demanding climb and is intended for runners who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. The KOPEC series is a long-running and popular circuit where participants are automatically included in the overall standings without needing to register separately. The races are organized with an emphasis on fairness, safety, and sportsmanship.

name: Štramberská desítka
description: Štramberk Ten is a traditional road race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place in the picturesque town of Štramberk and offers a 10 km route over mixed terrain, mostly on roads. The race is open to the general public and is known for its friendly atmosphere and rich history. Participants can expect refreshments at the finish and prizes for the top runners in various categories. The race takes place amid road traffic, and all participants run at their own risk.

name: Berounská desítka
description: Berounská Desítka is a revived running race with a long tradition, taking place on May 23, 2026, in the village of Zdejcina near Beroun. It offers three distances: the 10 km main race for experienced runners, a shorter 4 km route suitable for everyone, and a free 500 m children’s race. The course follows forest trails with 252 metres of elevation gain and reaches its high point at the Děd lookout tower, 491 m above sea level. Runners can look forward to refreshments during and after the race, as well as a welcoming atmosphere that brings the local running tradition back to life.

name: Orelský běh lesoparkem Skalky, memoriál prof. P. Leopolda Benáčka
description: The Orel Run through Skalky Forest Park is a traditional sporting event organized by Orel, a Christian sports organization, in Olešnice in the South Moravian Region. The Prof. P. Leopold Benáček Memorial gives runners the chance to compete in the beautiful natural surroundings of Skalky Forest Park. The event is part of Orel’s broader program, which promotes sport for everyone in the spirit of fair play and a healthy lifestyle. The race is suitable for the general public and helps develop sporting activities in the region.

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov
location: Letkov u Plzně, Sportpenzion Pohoda, Plzeňský
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov is a traditional trail running race near Plzeň, offering scenic routes of varying lengths and difficulty. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Letkov and is part of the celebrations marking the village’s 750th anniversary. The course passes Jandova skála and Čilina, and also includes a marathon with climbs to Maršál and Radyně. A multigenerational relay is available for children and families, encouraging people of all generations to stay active.

name: Libouchecký UltraMaraton
description: Tisá Ultra Trail is a new event that continues the tradition of the Libouchec Ultramarathon. It offers several routes of varying lengths and difficulty in the beautiful surroundings of Tisá and the surrounding area. The races run mostly off paved roads, along forest and field roads and trails, with clear course markings. The event facilities are well equipped, with showers, changing rooms and refreshments, as well as the option to spend the night in your own tent or car. The organizers emphasize safety and environmental responsibility, for example by limiting the use of plastic cups at refreshment stations.

name: Běhej lesy Brdy
description: Běhej lesy Brdy is a trail race held in the Brdy Protected Landscape Area, not far from Prague and Příbram. The race offers various routes, including short and long distances, which are part of the international UTMB Index Races. Runners can enjoy beautiful natural scenery, technical sections, and competitions for valuable prizes. The finish straight has been extended to 500 metres, adding an exciting feature for all participants. The Běhej lesy series is known for its community atmosphere and respect for nature.

name: Běh pro hospic Litoměřice
description: The Run for the Litoměřice Hospice is a charity sporting event held to support St. Stephen’s Hospice in Litoměřice. Participants run to help those nearing the end of their lives, contributing to the funding and support of hospice care. The event takes place in beautiful surroundings and features professional timekeeping. “Those who run help” is the race’s main motto.

name: Milada Run
description: Milada Run is part of the popular Milada Tour sports series, held in the unique landscape of a former lignite mine transformed into the natural Lake Milada. The 10th-anniversary edition offers a friendly, family atmosphere, with routes for children and adults. The races follow rolling and flat paths, with beautiful views of the lake and surrounding countryside. The event’s high standard and popularity are confirmed by the participants themselves.

name: Salomon Valašský Hrb
location: Horský hotel Čarták, Hutisko - Solanec, Zlínský
description: Salomon Valašský Hrb is a mountain running race suitable for beginners and endurance runners, held in the picturesque surroundings of Horský hotel Čarták in Hutisko-Solanec. The race offers distances of 50 km, 30 km, 20 km, and 10 km, following a paved ridge trail with stunning views. This race is ideal for mountain running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of nature while enjoying a sporting challenge. Come and enjoy the atmosphere and challenge of mountain terrain in the heart of the Zlín Region.

name: VolšoHEC RUN
description: VolšoHEC RUN is a traditional charity relay race held in the beautiful surroundings of Olšovec pond in the South Moravian Region. The race offers two relay formats: 4×5.5 km and 2×11 km, covering a total half-marathon distance of 21.1 km. The event supports children in need, with all entry fees and voluntary contributions for original running jerseys going directly to the Život dětem public-benefit organization. The program also includes free children’s races and a non-competitive scooter ride. The race is ideal for teams looking to combine athletic achievement with supporting a good cause.

name: Krok za Šimonka
description: A Step for Šimonek is a sporting event organized to support a fundraiser for Šimonek, a boy living with the rare metabolic disorder Lesch–Nyhan syndrome. The event offers a fun-filled day of sports for the whole family at Skalka near Nový Jičín. Its aim is not only to support treatment and rehabilitation, but also to raise awareness of the disorder and the strength of the community. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to support a good cause.

name: Běh pro úsměv – Pelhřimovský půlmaraton
description: Běh pro úsměv is a sporting event for the whole family, held at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov. This half marathon in Pelhřimov is suitable for sporty and non-sporty families, active seniors, and children from the age of 1. You don’t have to run the race—you can walk it. Half of the entry fees go to the Julinka Endowment Fund, which fights childhood obesity. The children’s and parents’ races take place one after the other, and while waiting for their parents, children can enjoy activities such as face painting, a bouncy castle, scooter rides, or learning first aid.

name: Memoriál Ivana Belobrada
description: The Ivan Belobrad Memorial is a traditional running race held in Dlouhoňovice and is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The race offers courses of up to 9 km, running along village roads, forest and field paths, with varied surfaces. The event is suitable for the general public, including young people and children, with an option for the youngest participants to start individually. It takes place in a pleasant sports complex and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Přibyslavský kros
organizer: Město Přibyslav ve spolupráci s ACO Industries k.s.
description: Přibyslav Cross-Country Run is a cross-country and trail run held in the picturesque surroundings of Přibyslav near Nová Paka in the Hradec Králové Region. The race offers two courses, 8 km and 4 km long, running through nature and along forest paths. The main category starts at 11:00, making it convenient for both the general public and competitive runners to take part. The event is organized by the Town of Přibyslav in cooperation with ACO Industries k.s. and David Myslivec, who ensure the event is well organized.

name: Běh do vrchu Poniklá – Rezek
location: Tuláčkova náves, Poniklá, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Poniklá–Rezek uphill race is a traditional sporting event held in the village of Poniklá. The race starts at Tuláčkovo náves and climbs uphill to Rezek. It is suitable for runners who enjoy challenges on natural terrain and want to spend an active day in beautiful surroundings. The organizer is Petr Holec, who ensures the race runs smoothly.

name: Bóžovo 59ka
description: Bóžovo 59ka is a traditional race organized by the Jasan Ski Club in Aš, Karlovy Vary Region. The race takes place on May 23, 2026, and offers a sporting experience in beautiful surroundings, with the opportunity for club members and the public to take part. Jasan Club is known for its long-standing tradition and active approach to training and races in the region.

name: Běh o štěně okolo Poděbrad - memoriál Zdeňka Slepičky
description: Běh o štěně - Zdeněk Slepička Memorial is a 7.2 km cross-country race held in Hejčín, Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners and offers runners an interesting course through natural terrain. It is suitable for cross-country running enthusiasts who want to test themselves on a challenging course with varied surfaces. The race has a long tradition and is named in memory of Zdeněk Slepička.

name: Žlutavská 11
description: Žlutavská 11 is a running race that takes you through the picturesque hills around the village of Žlutava. It offers courses for all age groups, from the youngest children to a race over 11 km long. Runners can enjoy plenty of refreshments and comfortable facilities, including changing rooms and showers. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful countryside around Žlutava.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Brno
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Brno is a sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place by the Anthropos Pavilion and offers timed runs of 6 km and 10.5 km, a 4 x 2.5 km relay, and untimed family and children’s runs. The route follows the Svratka River on paved paths and asphalt. Participants’ entry fees help fund the recording and preservation of witnesses’ stories and educational programs.

name: Jistebnický vodohospodářský půlmaraton
description: The Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running event, now in its sixteenth year, held in the picturesque countryside on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. Races range from 3.6 km to a marathon, with relay races and a children’s Olympics also on offer. They start and finish at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. The routes pass through the countryside, with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains, and run between the villages of Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou and Klimkovice. The event also features a varied programme of activities and is suitable for a wide range of runners and families with children.

name: Krušnej seběh
description: Krušnej seběh is a traditional running race organized by Bike Team Nejdek, held in the picturesque surroundings of Nové Hamry in the Karlovy Vary Region. The race offers two courses: the longer FullHD, approximately 14 km long, and the shorter HD, 7 km long. They run mainly along forest trails and paved paths, with hilly terrain and technical sections. The start and finish are in Nové Hamry, and the start time has been moved earlier so the race takes up only part of the morning. The race is suitable for all runners looking to experience a challenging but appealing cross-country run in the Ore Mountains.

name: Běšinský běh
description: The Běšinský Run is a traditional running race held in Běšiny near Klatovy, featuring a 4.8 km course. The race is mixed-category and includes a mountain prize, adding to its appeal and challenge for runners. The start is at the football pitch, and the race takes place in all weather. It is organized by Sokol Běšiny, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and a safe event.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Olomouc
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Olomouc is a sports and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of people who witnessed historical events. The race takes place on May 23, 2026, in Smetana and Čech Gardens and offers timed 5 km and 10 km runs and a 4x2.5 km relay, as well as untimed children’s and family runs. The start and finish are by the exhibition greenhouses in Smetana Gardens. The event is suitable for all age groups and helps commemorate heroism and freedom.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Jihlava
organizer: Post Bellum, z. ú. a Parlament Gymnázia Jihlava
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Jihlava is a sporting and community event held in support of the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Český mlýn grounds, with the start and finish behind the skatepark. Runners can choose between timed 4 km and 10 km runs or untimed children’s and family races. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant setting on the paved paths of the cycling trails. The entry fee is a donation for a good cause and support for the Memory of the Nation.

name: Zaječice
location: Přehvozdí, Kolín District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

name: ČEZ RunTour Brno
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

name: Sudický hraničák
location: Fotbalové hřiště, Sudice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: Memoriál Františka Daniša – cezpoľný beh
description: The František Daniš Memorial Cross-Country Run is a running event held at the football field in the village of Trstín, Trnava District. The course runs mainly along field and grassy paths, with a short section on an asphalt footpath. Men, women, juniors and residents of Trstín compete in different age categories, with some categories running two laps. The event is suitable for runners who enjoy natural surfaces and cross-country running in the pleasant surroundings of Trstín.
course_highlights: Three quarters of the course is on field and grassy paths
One quarter of the course is on an asphalt footpath
The race takes place at the football field in Trstín
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender; some categories run two laps, and residents of Trstín have their own category. Local contacts: Trstín Municipality, tel. 033/558 92 62, email outrstin@slovanet.sk; Mayor Peter Hlávek, tel. 0918 775 109, email starosta@trstin.sk. The event includes several categories and is part of the Spring Health Run. On-site registration is also possible. Registration is available by contacting the organizers.

name: Turčiansky beh
description: Turčiansky Beh is a charity race taking place on May 23, 2026, at the football stadium in Belá-Dulice. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes through gently undulating terrain on dirt roads and gravel, with 40 to 80 metres of elevation gain. The event supports a good cause: all funds raised will go towards treatment for a 4-year-old boy with autism and the “Children of My Heart” project. Participants will receive gifts, raffle tickets and commemorative medals, and there will be entertainment for children, so parents can run while their children are looked after. Refreshments and parking are available at the start and finish.
course_highlights: The route follows dirt roads and gravel
Gently undulating terrain with 40 to 80 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the Belá-Dulice football stadium
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 8:00 to 11:00. Before the start, each participant will receive a drink, a fitness bar and a gift from the partners. The entry fee includes one raffle ticket, with additional tickets available to purchase. Every finisher will receive a commemorative medal. Professional entertainers and attractions will be available for children. Parking is available by the start/finish area. Refreshments and drinks can be purchased on site. Virtual runners will be sent a gift and medal to their address after the event. The terrain consists of dirt roads and asphalt. Changing rooms, showers and refreshments are available on site. Registration is available online, with a virtual participation option.

name: Night Run Trenčín
location: Trenčín, Trenčín, Klub Lúč – Mierové námestie 17
description: Night Run Trenčín is a running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in Trenčín, at Klub Lúč and, weather permitting, on Mierové Square. Runners can challenge themselves in the pleasant atmosphere of the city at night. Registration is available online until May 21, 2026, or on race day if the participant limit has not been reached. The organizer provides electronic timing and refreshments along the course. The event is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants need the consent of a legal guardian.

name: Dynasport beh na Vtáčnik
location: Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom, Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom, Farma pod Vtáčnikom
distance_verbose: 50 km, 27 km, 24 km, 10 km, 8.4 km, 5 km
description: The Dynasport Run on Vtáčnik is a challenging mountain race in the area around Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom, offering three courses of different lengths and elevation gains. Runners can choose from a 50 km course with 2,000 m of elevation gain, a 27 km course with 1,000 m of elevation gain, or an 8.4 km course with 380 m of elevation gain. Each course has its own time limit and categories for women and men under and over 40. The race starts at a farm below Vtáčnik, with refreshments available at several points along the route. The organizer emphasizes mandatory equipment and runner safety.

name: Petržalská 10
description: Petržalská 10 is a popular running race in Bratislava, held at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka. The race offers various categories, including a children’s run, a 10 km main race, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race at 11:30. The organizer, Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization for all participants.

name: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety
location: Salgótarján (HU) - Lučenec, Salgótarján (HU) - Lučenec, Hlavné námestie
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a relay marathon held on May 23, 2026, along a route between Salgótarján, Hungary, and Lučenec, Slovakia. The course is 42.2 km long and divided into four legs, run by four relay team members. The race is open to men’s, women’s, and mixed teams, with a minimum ratio of 50% women and 50% men. Refreshment stations are provided along the route, and goulash, sports cups, and cash prizes await the best relay teams at the finish. The race starts at 10:00. Registration is open until May 21, 2026, online or on site if places are still available.

name: Hlbocký boyard – extrémny beh s prekážkami
location: Hlboké nad Váhom, Hlboké nad Váhom, Areál pri futbalovom ihrisku
description: Hlbocký Boyard is an extreme individual race taking place on May 23, 2026, in the village of Hlboké nad Váhom. This 6th edition features a single-lap course with plenty of adrenaline-pumping obstacles and steep hills on a motocross track. Competitors will race in nine categories by age and gender, including children’s categories. Runners can enjoy the fresh air and challenges on the course, followed by awards, refreshments, and keepsakes.

name: Jacovská dvadsiatka
description: Jacovská dvadsiatka is a running race held in Jacovce at the football stadium. The event offers two courses: the main 22 km race and an 8 km hobby run, both along asphalt and gravel farm roads. The 22 km race starts at 10:00 and the 8 km run at 10:15. The event is suitable for various age groups and genders and is organized by ATK Javorina Jacovce. Entry fees are affordable, making the event accessible to a wide running community.

name: Kostolanský májovec
location: Veľké Kostoľany, Veľké Kostoľany, futbalový štadión
description: Kostolanský májovec is a running event organized by run ForRest run o.z., held at the Michal Podolan Football Stadium in Veľké Kostoľany. Runners can choose between two courses, 10.90 km and 5.40 km long, both with 64 meters of elevation gain and a surface combining asphalt and meadow. The start is scheduled for 11:00. Competitors are divided into age categories, with awards for the fastest Kostolanec and Kostolanka. The event offers a refreshment station and is suitable for runners looking for a pleasant run with moderate elevation gain in a beautiful setting.

name: Sninský trailový polmaratón
description: The Snina Trail Half Marathon is a running event in Snina, Slovakia, offering two courses: the main 21 km course and a shorter 7.5 km course. The race is for all trail-running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of nature and the challenges of the terrain. The organizers welcome runners of all levels and offer the lively atmosphere of a quality sporting event.

name: Beh Soviou Poľanou
location: Podolínec - Podolínske lesy, Podolínec - Podolínske lesy, Kaplnka sv. Huberta
description: The Run Under Soviou Poľanou in Podolínec is a forest running race that offers quality training and a chance to test your abilities on mountain terrain. The race is suitable for runners who want to enjoy an exhilarating day in nature and prepare for important races in the season. The route passes through picturesque forests around Podolínec and offers a challenge even for experienced runners.

name: Mravenčárska míľa
location: Plavecký Štvrtok okr. Malacky, Plavecký Štvrtok okr. Malacky, futbalový štadión
description: The Ant Mile is a running event held at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok. The races offer categories for men and women across various age groups, as well as for children, school-age participants, youth, juniors, Nordic walking, and canicross. The school-age race starts at 10:10 and the main category at 12:00. The event is organized by the Plavecký Štvrtok Municipal Office, which provides a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization for all participants.

name: Niže Linča
location: Zeleneč,, okr. rnava, Zeleneč,, okr. rnava, Vinohrady Zeleneč
organizer: Dobrovoľníci z obce Zeleneč, Obecný úrad Zeleneč, Vinársky spolok vinárov a vinohradníkov Zeleneč, DHZ Zeleneč, Zdravotnícka služba Zeleneč
description: Niže Linča is a running event in Zeleneč organized by volunteers from the village together with local associations and the medical service. The race is open to men, women, and juniors under 18, with prizes also awarded to the fastest local man and woman. The entry fee includes admission to a wine tasting during the St. Urban festivities, giving the event a unique atmosphere and bringing sport and culture together. Online registration opens on April 13, 2026, and the race takes place on May 23, 2026.

name: Martinský offroad maratón a polmaratón
description: The Martin Off-Road Marathon and Half Marathon is a running event held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Fatra region, in Tomčany near Martin. Runners can enjoy running across meadows, hills, and the foothills of the Fatra, with stunning views of the Lúčanská, Krivánska, and Veľká Fatra ranges. The course is off-road, with natural obstacles such as mud and fallen trees, adding to its appeal and challenge for runners. The event is intended for runners of different abilities, who can choose a trail that suits their skills and preferences.

name: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu
location: Bratislava, Bratislava, Mestská časť Dúbravka, Ul. Pod záhradami (pri Lidli)
description: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu is a running event in Bratislava offering races for children and adults. The race takes place in the Dúbravka district, starting on Pod záhradami Street (by Lidl). You can compete in the 10 km AZ-pneu Vertical, the 5 km Dôverun, or the children’s races. The event is organized by Beh si ty, o.z., together with the Dúbravka District Municipality. The race is suitable for the general public and offers categories by age and gender.

name: Beh s vlkmi pre život
description: Run with the Wolves for Life is a charity running event organized by the CHADIM’S CHARITY Foundation. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Čierne, at the tripoint of Slovakia, Czechia, and Poland. The event offers six different courses, including a half marathon, a 10K, a 5K, Nordic walking, and children’s races. The courses run mainly along paved and forest roads, with beautiful mountain views. Runners can expect well-organized routes with clear markings, refreshment stations, and a support vehicle carrying water. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes a healthy lifestyle and charitable causes.

name: Hutňanská šelma
location: Novoveská Huta, Novoveská Huta, Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou
description: Hutňanská šelma is a running event in Novoveská Huta, offering races for both children and adults. The races take place in the pleasant setting of Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou and are divided into several age categories, with awards for the top three finishers. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the races for adults and older children start at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and ability levels.

name: If Vilniaus Pusmaratonis 2026
description: The “If” Vilnius Half Marathon is Vilnius’s biggest spring running festival, held in the city’s Old Town. The event welcomes runners of all ages, from children to half-marathon participants. It promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and community spirit. Participants can feel safe knowing that all runners are insured against accidents. The event features a range of distances and a friendly atmosphere that helps build lasting connections among participants.
course_highlights: Start at Cathedral Square in Vilnius Old Town
Half-marathon distance: 21.098 km
Children’s and youth races for different age groups
additional: Participants who register by April 4 receive personalized bibs. Event T-shirts are available for an additional fee. The event includes children’s races starting from age 2, a 4.2 km youth race, and 5 km and 10 km distances with no age limits. Participants receive race packs with a timing chip. The event program includes warm-ups and awards for each distance. Runners of various age groups take part, with several start times and additional activities in Vilnius and the Old Town.

name: Atviros „Trakų Dainiaus bėgimo taurės“ 1000 m rungties varžybos
location: Trakų stadionas, Trakai, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The open 1000 m event of the “Trakai Dainius Running Cup” is an official 1000-meter race held at Trakai Stadium. The event is for both young athletes and recreational runners who want to test their speed and experience a true sporting atmosphere. The competition takes place in a professionally prepared setting, with a clearly marked stadium track. It is a great opportunity to challenge yourself in a classic running event and enjoy the spirit of sport in Trakai.
course_highlights: 1000-meter distance on the stadium athletics track
Professionally prepared stadium course
The competition takes place at Trakai Stadium, Birutės St. 44
additional: Registration is available by email at drasutisbarkauskas@gmail.com. The event takes place at Trakai Stadium, Birutės St. 44. This is an official 1000 m event for both young athletes and recreational runners. The event is included in the endurance sports calendar, and participants can compete and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in Trakai.

name: Bėgimo varžybos Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio r. Kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams laimėti
organizer: Kupiškio r. kūno kultūros ir sporto centras
description: The running competition for the prizes of Pavel Fedorenka and the Kupiškis District Physical Education and Sports Centre invites participants to register and compete. The event is held in Kupiškis to promote sporting activity and community spirit. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities and enjoy running in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The event is open to all age groups
Compete for prizes from Pavel Fedorenka and the Kupiškis District Physical Education and Sports Centre
Location: Kupiškis, Lithuania
additional: The event will take place on May 29, 2027. Registration is available online and via social media.

name: Biegi Śnieżnickie
description: The Śnieżnickie Runs are legendary mountain races held in picturesque Międzygórze, in the heart of the Śnieżnik Massif. The routes feature challenging climbs and technical descents, taking runners along beautiful forest trails and gravel roads, as well as to the very summit of Śnieżnik. This event has a rich tradition dating back to the 1990s and attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes from across Europe. Participants can choose between the classic 9.6 km alpine race and the Śnieżnik Half Marathon, approximately 21 km long, which loops around the Crown of Śnieżnik.

name: 14. Bieg Firmowy Wrocław
description: Bieg Firmowy is Poland’s largest charity relay, taking place on May 24, 2026, in Wrocław. Corporate teams of 5 cover a total distance of 25 km, with each participant running or walking 5 km. The event brings together sport, team building, and support for the beneficiaries of the Everest Foundation, who are facing serious health challenges. Participants can choose the in-person format at the University of Physical Education and the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław, or take part online from anywhere in the world. Bieg Firmowy is not only a sporting event but also an important social and charitable initiative.

name: 12 Bieg Elegant na 5
description: The 12th Elegant na 5 Run is an annual running event held in Mosina, scheduled for May 24 in 2026. The event offers a variety of distances for children, young people and people with disabilities, as well as a 5 km main race that runs through the streets of the Mosina municipality. The start and finish are at Plac 20 Października, and the main race begins at 11:15. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a T-shirt, making the event appealing to a wide range of runners.

name: Bieg o rogatywkę rotmistrza Witolda Pile...
description: The Witold Pilecki Cavalry Captain’s Cap Race is organized by the “Zielone Światło Dla Wrząsowic” Association in Wrząsowice. The race takes place on June 8, 2025, at 10:00. Timing is provided electronically and professionally by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in timing at sporting events in Poland. This sporting event combines the spirit of competition with a tribute to Cavalry Captain Witold Pilecki, giving it a distinctive character.

name: Biegamy, nie klikamy!
organizer: Biegamy, nie klikamy i Rotary Club Warszawa Konstancin
description: We Run, We Don’t Click! is a charity 5 km run taking place on May 24, 2026, in the picturesque Chojnowski Landscape Park in Konstancin-Jeziorna. The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all experience levels. The start and finish are located at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, offering easy access and convenient conditions for spectators. The event is inclusive and charitable, and all proceeds will be donated to the Special Needs School Complex in Pęchery. Participation is free for primary and secondary school students.

name: BoryRun
description: BoryRun 2026 is the largest running festival in the Lower Silesian Forests, taking place on May 24, 2026, in Osiecznica. The event combines sport, health, and mindful time offline, promoting intergenerational connection and the joy of movement without the pressure of competition. The routes pass through the scenic Lower Silesian Forests and the historic setting of Kliczków Castle, offering a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. Children can take part in the special Boryrun Active race, featuring activities that build fitness and self-confidence.

name: Gontyniec Ultra Trail
description: Gontyniec Ultra Trail is a mountain trail race held on the picturesque Gontyniec Hill in Chodzież, the highest elevation in the Greater Poland Lake District. The courses run mainly along forest trails marked with red and yellow signs, offering runners a variety of distances and elevation gains. Organized by the Gontyniec Ultra Trail Foundation, the event attracts cross-country and ultrarunning enthusiasts from across Poland, offering unique challenges over distances from 12 to 52 km. This iconic event combines sporting competition with the beauty of nature and the history of the region.

name: IV Honorowy Bieg Kadecki
description: The 4th Honorary Cadet Run is a special sporting event organized by I LO PUL Kutno – Uniformed Services High School, held to mark the Regimental Day of the 37th Infantry Regiment. The run pays tribute to local history and uniformed-services traditions. Participants tackle a 5.5 km obstacle course at the military training ground in Kutno. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Kutno, Mariusz Sikora, and welcomes everyone who enjoys physical activity to compete and have fun. The run is scheduled to start on May 24, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. at the AMZ S.A. Training Ground in Kutno, on Metalowa Street.

name: Kęcka Piątka
description: Kęcka Piątka is a 5 km road race held in the picturesque town of Kęty. The certified course runs through the town streets, with key turns and junctions secured to ensure participants’ safety. The race is a local sporting celebration that promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among residents and visitors. It is organized by the Kęty Sports and Recreation Centre under the patronage of the Mayor of the Kęty Municipality. Runners aged 14 and over are invited to take part in this energetic event.

name: Mucharskie Pętle
description: Mucharskie Pętle Run is a unique running event held in the picturesque setting of Lake Mucharskie and the hills of the Little Beskids. The course is suitable both for beginner runners and for those looking for a more challenging trail run. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to join this event and enjoy its great sporting atmosphere. It will take place on May 24, 2026, in Mucharz. Places are limited, and registration is online.

name: Prusice Biegają - etap 2
description: The 13th edition of Prusice Biegają is a sporting event held on Żmigrodzka Street, next to the Prusice Fitness Center in Prusice. The course runs along the streets of Prusice and through Pietrowice Małe, offering participants scenic and runner-friendly conditions. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively and compete within the local running community.

name: VI Niechanowska Dyszka i Piątka
description: The 6th Niechanowo 10K and 5K is an annual race held in the picturesque Planty Park in Niechanowo. The event offers two popular race distances: 10 km and 5 km, attracting both recreational and more experienced runners. It is an athletics event and a great opportunity to spend time outdoors in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and technical support.

name: XII Bieg z książką
description: The 12th Run with a Book, ON THE TRAIL TO THE FINISH, is an open running event organized by the Nicolaus Copernicus University Alumni Program and the NCUM Marathon Club. It is dedicated to the Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń community and to fans of running and reading. The race takes place on the university campus in Bielany, Toruń, and its route follows forest paths and lanes through the campus woodland. Participants must complete the course while holding a book weighing at least 100 grams, highlighting the event’s unique combination of sport and the promotion of reading. The race is sponsored by Robert Małecki, a crime fiction author and NCUM alumnus, who takes part in the race and meets participants after the competition.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (5)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach
description: The 14th Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a 10 km road race taking place on May 24, 2026, in Katowice. It is an excellent opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness on a scenic course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using dedicated training plans tailored to their individual level. The event is open and runner-friendly, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.

name: XVII Bieg Uliczny o Łaziskie Liście
organizer: Miasto Łaziska Górne, MOSiR Łaziska Górne
description: The 17th A. Kaleja “Łaziskie Liście” Street Race is an annual running event held in Łaziska Górne. In 2026, it will take place on May 24 at the municipal stadium. Runners can compete over 5 km and 10 km distances; the 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km course. The event also includes races for children, young people and seniors, held the day before, bringing generations together through sport. Registration for the main races and Nordic walking is online only. The event is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Łaziska Górne, which works to ensure accessibility and support for all participants.

name: XXII Bieg Sanguszków
organizer: Uczniowski Klub Sportowy „OGRODNIK” i Zespół Szkół Ekonomiczno-Ogrodniczych w Tarnowie
description: The 22nd Sanguszko Run is an annual running event taking place on May 24, 2026, in Sanguszko Park in Tarnów. The event is organized by Kępa Sport, LKS Burzyn, and the “OGRODNIK” School Sports Club. The aim of the run is to promote running and bring the running community together. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping and professional event organization.

name: IX Bieg Uliczny Z Siódemką na 7-kę
XXII Bieg Patrona Miasta św. Andrzeja Boboli
Myślenicki Półmaraton
description:
As part of the First Myślenice Running Festival, the organizers are planning four race formats: a PZLA-certified half marathon, the 4×5 km Business Relay, the 5 km Saturday Night Rave Run, and children’s races.
The event will also feature a Runner’s Village with an EXPO zone and space for families.
The organizers are especially keen to welcome people who will run their first half marathon in Myślenice.

name: Freigerichter Benzinglauf
description: The Freigerichter Benzinglauf is a scenic fun run that follows varied trails over the first hills of the Spessart. The start and finish for all routes are at the DJK clubhouse in Freigericht-Neuses. The three different routes mainly follow woodland, forest and gravel paths, with a small proportion on asphalt. Plenty of refreshments are available along the course and at the finish. The event offers various distances for runners, walkers and children, with suitable options for all age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: 90% woodland, forest and gravel paths; 10% asphalt
Routes climb the first hills of the Spessart
Start and finish at the DJK clubhouse in Freigericht-Neuses
additional: Bib pickup and late registration at the DJK clubhouse in Neuses. Starts for the half marathon (21.2 km), 10 km and 5 km runs, as well as 10 km and 5 km walking/Nordic walking. Bambini and schoolchildren’s races for different age groups. Food and refreshments are provided. A running event with several distances, including races for children and young people, starting and finishing at the DJK clubhouse in Neuses. The event offers a challenge ranking for participants who take part in several races.

name: Spatzenberg-Lauf
description: The Spatzenberg Run is a traditional fun run in Löhne, following a hilly circular course around and over the Spatzenberg in the nature reserve. The route runs mostly on paved paths and roads and offers an attractive running opportunity for all age groups. In addition to the 9 km main race, there are shorter 6 km and 3 km races for schoolchildren. The event is organised by Turn- und Rasensportverein Löhne 1910 e.V., running group, and takes place at the Obernfeld sports field.
course_highlights: Hilly circular course around and over the Spatzenberg (nature reserve)
Route on paved paths and roads
Distances: 9 km, 6 km and 3 km schoolchildren’s race
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the back of the race bib. Race materials can be collected from 9:00 on the event day at the Obernfeld sports field. Late entries are possible on the event day until 10:15, while race bibs are available. Payment by SEPA direct debit for online registration or in cash when collecting race materials. Hilly course around the Spatzenberg, registration online or on the event day, timing with a disposable chip, water at the finish station

name: MAXiLauf 2026
organizer: Stadt Hamm, Amt für Konzernsteuerung und Sport
description: The MAXiLAUF in Hamm is an annual running event featuring flat, record-eligible courses that appeal to runners of all ability levels. Events include a half marathon, a 10 km run, a 5 km run, and children’s and toddlers’ races. The courses run through the city of Hamm and offer an attractive, approved circuit route passing many landmarks. All participants receive an exclusive medal, and trophies are awarded to the leading runners. The event is family-friendly and part of the Landesturnfest LTF26.
course_highlights: Flat, DLV-measured circuit courses through the city of Hamm
Courses eligible for inclusion in best lists
Attractive routes passing many landmarks
additional: Bib-number distribution from approx. 8:30 a.m. at the Stadtsportbund tent. Timing uses a race|result® chip attached to the bib. On-site registration is available. Cut-off times: half marathon 150 min, 10 km 90 min, 5 km 50 min. Personalised medal engraving can be booked for an additional fee. Certificates are available on-site and online. Official merchandise is available in the shop. The race features a DLV-measured circuit, medals for all finishers, online and on-site registration, and a festive atmosphere for runners and spectators.

name: Vysocká pětka - vzpomínka na Jirku S.
location: Vysoká nad Labem, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Vysocká pětka is a 5 km running race held in the village of Vysoká nad Labem. The race is held in memory of Jirka S. and traditionally follows a cycle path. The start is scheduled for 9:00, with check-in from 8:00. The event is open to all runners and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with a chance to win a prize in the raffle.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Race along a cycle path
Friendly atmosphere with a raffle
additional: Participant check-in from 8:00; race starts at 9:00; the race follows a cycle path; chance to win a prize in the raffle. The race is part of the local sports calendar and is open to the general public. Exact course distances and registration information have not yet been published.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Kladno
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Libčice nad Vltavou is a sports and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The event offers timed 5 km and 10 km races with a mass start, along paved paths and roads through a forest park and along a cycle path. It is suitable for all age groups and helps commemorate the history and courage of freedom fighters. Race numbers are issued at the registration venue on race day. The event also includes a children’s race and the option of a symbolic “Anywhere!” run outside the official courses.

name: Půlmaraton údolím Moravské Sázavy
description: The Moravská Sázava Valley Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Zábřeh na Moravě. The 21.0975 km course is certified according to IAAF rules and runs mostly over flat terrain, with a gentle climb between Nemile and Hněvkov. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners and offers quality facilities, including refreshment stations and a children’s race. The race starts at the swimming complex in Zábřeh, which is also the finish venue. Participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments at the finish.

name: Lesní půlmaraton Říčany
location: Sportovní areál U školy - Říčany, Středočeský
description: The Říčany Forest Half Marathon is a running race held entirely on beautiful forest roads and trails, with no asphalt. The surrounding countryside around Říčany is particularly scenic in late May, adding to the enjoyment of the run. The race is ideal for lovers of natural terrain and cross-country running who want to experience the forest atmosphere and the challenge of a half-marathon distance. The organizers welcome runners of all levels and encourage them to share their race experiences.

name: Příbramský půlmaraton
description: The Příbram Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Příbram, offering a half-marathon course, a relay race, a fitness run, and children’s races. The event is known for its new route and magical atmosphere, especially on the descent to the square. It attracts a wide running community every year and provides quality facilities, including refreshments and parking.

name: Běh cestou necestou 13 km Prahou 13
location: Centrální park Stodůlky, Praha 13, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh cestou necestou is a running race held in Prague 13, offering 13 km and 5 km courses. The race takes runners through the scenic corners of Centrální park Stodůlky and Přírodní park Prokopské údolí. The start is on Sunday, May 24, 2026, at 13:13:13, and runners can make use of refreshments along the course and at the finish. The race is open to everyone and is run in the spirit of fair play, with an emphasis on following the marked route.

name: Teplýšovický běh
description: The Teplýšovice Run is a charity race held in the picturesque village of Teplýšovice near Benešov. In 2026, its 6th edition will feature 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km trail races, an 11 km Nordic Walking event, and children’s races. The main course passes the Špulka lookout tower and offers beautiful scenery and a challenging route. All courses are timed using chip timing, and every participant receives a medal. Part of the entry fee supports the restoration of fruit-tree avenues in the surrounding area.

name: Suchdol běží
description: Suchdol Runs is part of the seventh edition of the Běhej s námi 2026 running series, which is open to the general public. The race takes place on Sunday, May 24, 2026, in Prague 6 – Suchdol, with the start and finish at the Community Garden. The route follows paved farm and forest roads and has 96 meters of elevation gain. It offers runners a pleasant flat section, a descent into the valley, and a return along forest roads. Categories are divided into children’s and adults’ age groups. Runners under 18 may take part only with written consent from a legal guardian.

name: VeganRun
description: VeganRun Slovakia is the first official Slovak vegan running event, organized by the Slovak Vegan Society. The event brings together sport, health, and compassion, offering more than just a run—it is a shared step toward a healthier body, a cleaner planet, and a more informed society. The routes start at the iconic Rača Amphitheatre and follow the boundary between the Carpathian forest and vineyards, offering forest therapy, varied terrain, and epic views of Bratislava. Runners can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and Canicross, which lets them run with their dog.

name: Bytčiansky Kros
organizer: Behači Bytča a okolie, v spolupráci s Mesto Bytča
description: Bytčiansky Kros is a traditional running race in Bytča, offering four courses of varying lengths and difficulty, including the 21 km Super Kros with 500 m of elevation gain. The course runs mostly over natural terrain, such as farm tracks, meadows and cycle paths, with 80% off-road and 20% paved surfaces. Runners can expect three refreshment stations on the longer courses and clearly marked routes. Competitions are divided into age categories for both men and women, with the top three in each category receiving awards.

name: Bėgam už Marijampolę - 2026
description: Bėgam už Marijampolę is a traditional annual running event held in Marijampolė, bringing together participants of all ages. It is not only a competition but also an outdoor gathering for local residents that encourages an active lifestyle and a sense of community. The event features an updated running course where participants can test their endurance in a beautiful Lithuanian city. It also includes the “Einam už Marijampolę” walking tour, with 8 km and 14 km distances and free registration.
course_highlights: Updated running course in Marijampolė
Walking tour with 8 km and 14 km distances
Outdoor event that encourages a sense of community
additional: The “Einam už Marijampolę” walking tour takes place alongside the running event, and registration for the tour is free. The event brings together more than 1,000 participants, from the youngest to the oldest. Organized by the Marijampolė Athletics Sports Club. Event date: May 30, 2027; participant numbers and race distances are not specified.

name: 01. Godelheimer See Marathon
description: The 1st Godelheim Lake Marathon/Ultra in Höxter takes place on May 25, 2026, and is a premiere with DUV scoring. The event gives runners the opportunity to experience a new route around Godelheim Lake. The race is aimed at marathon and ultramarathon runners and promises a varied and challenging course in a natural setting. The organizer is the 100 Marathon Club Deutschland, a club for experienced marathon runners.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo Sporty, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors, running or walking in a friendly atmosphere.
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. This evening sporting event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. There is no information about participant limits, fees, or start waves. Previous events have taken place in the evening; available results from one edition indicate a distance of 5 km.

name: TEMPO MAKERS RUN Plzeň – květnový závod
description: TEMPO MAKERS RUN Plzeň is a regular running race held in Plzeň, featuring an 8 km course. The race takes place on the cycle path in the Pytel area and is open to all age groups. The start is scheduled for the evening, allowing runners to enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and spend time with fellow running enthusiasts. The organizers emphasize safety and fair competition. Times are recorded manually, and the race goes ahead in all weather except under extreme conditions.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - květen
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a running race organized by Plzeňští Tempo Makers, who organize running races, charity runs, and running training sessions. The event takes place in the picturesque Pytle area of Plzeň and offers an opportunity for runners of all levels. The race is part of a running community that supports an active lifestyle and enthusiasm for sport.

name: Okolo svaté Juliány
description: Okolo svaté Juliány is a running race in Prague-Přední Kopanina, with a 5,600-metre course that runs mostly along forest paths with minimal elevation gain. The start and registration are at the tourist shelter on the cycle path on K Juliáně Street, easily accessible by public transport. The race is open to various categories, including juniors, adults and veterans, and offers a friendly atmosphere with parking available nearby. The entry fee is symbolic, with a voluntary fee for some categories.

name: Sternchenlauf
description: The Sternchenlauf in Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock is a traditional fun run held annually on the Wednesday before Corpus Christi. The event offers various races for all age groups, from races for toddlers and children to 5 km and 10 km races, as well as walking. The course follows a varied 2.5 km loop with forest trails, gravel and asphalt, lined with enthusiastic spectators. In addition to individual categories, there are team and relay categories, making the race especially appealing to groups.
course_highlights: A varied 2.5 km loop with forest trails, gravel and asphalt
Flat course with clear signage
Out-and-back courses for the toddler, children’s and schoolchildren’s races on Falkenstraße
additional: Start times: toddler race 17:00, children’s race 17:15, 1.0 km schoolchildren’s race 17:30, 2.5 km schoolchildren’s race 17:45, 5 km race 18:30, 10 km race and 5 km walk 19:30. The walk starts at the same time as the 10 km race, at the back of the field. Participant limit: approximately 2,000; relays are limited to 50. Event shirts can be purchased during registration or on site. Changing rooms and showers are available. Start and finish at the Waldstadion Schwarz-Weiß Sende e.V. Registration is available for individual and group races. The 5 km race is fully booked; remaining places will be available on site from 16:00 on the day of the event. The event is part of the region’s running events and offers a welcoming, family atmosphere.

name: B2Run Hannover
description: The B2Run Hannover on May 27, 2026, is a company run over a largely flat route of around 6.5 km along the Maschsee, finishing spectacularly in the Heinz von Heiden Arena. The event is aimed at companies, organizations, and individual participants from Hannover and the surrounding area, and promotes team spirit, motivation, and a sense of community. It offers a professional supporting program with hosting and music, and is ideal for beginners, walkers, and experienced runners. The focus is on fun, togetherness, and team building, not on personal bests.

name: Seligenstädter Marathonstaffel
description: The 44th Seligenstadt Asklepios Marathon Relay is a unique relay race for teams of six from clubs, recreational groups and companies. It takes place on 27 May 2026 on the banks of the Main in Seligenstadt. The fast out-and-back course along the river offers an attractive route, with the start and finish at the newly redesigned festival grounds. The event is organized by LG Seligenstadt and the Friends of LG Seligenstadt e.V. support association. Alongside the sporting experience, runners can enjoy pasta dishes from MAIN'E KÜCHE. Bib number distribution and the awards ceremony also take place at the festival grounds.

name: Steglitzer Volkslauf
description: The Steglitz Fun Run is a long-standing running event taking place on 27 May 2026 at Stadion Lichterfelde in Berlin-Lichterfelde. Organized by TuS Lichterfelde von 1887 e.V., the event offers a sporting opportunity for runners of all ages. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organized event. The races start and finish at Stadion Lichterfelde, providing an attractive setting for participants and spectators.

name: Koutecká vertikála
description: Koutecká Vertikála is a 2.5 km uphill race with 510 metres of elevation gain, held at the Kouty nad Desnou ski resort. The race has a staggered start and is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which includes cross-country races in Šumperk and the surrounding area. This race offers a demanding, dynamic uphill run, ideal for fans of mountain running and vertical challenges.

name: Rasokros
location: Krčský les, Prague 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Rasokros is a running race in Krč Forest in Prague 4, offering men a 7.5 km course and women a 2.5 km course. The race is part of the SABZO series and is suitable for runners looking for an enjoyable cross-country run in a natural setting. The route runs through forest terrain and offers the chance to enjoy a run in a peaceful part of Prague. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to test their strength in this attractive event.

name: 3. Pekelný kilometr
description: Pekelný kilometr is an uphill running race held at the Peklák ski resort in Česká Třebová. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026 series and features a 1 km course with staggered starts, climbing the ski slope over grass, snow and paths depending on the current weather. The children’s race starts at 17:00, and the main 1 km race begins at 18:00. The race is suitable for a wide range of age categories and is known for its atmosphere and challenging climb.

name: BĚKODO – květen III
location: Teplice-Doubravka, Teplice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: BĚKODO is the traditional 40th edition of a running series in Teplice, intended for recreational, fitness and competitive runners aged 15 and over. The series consists of the ten best-scoring starts during the season; in the event of a tie in points, the better time decides. The time limit for official timing is 35 minutes; runners who exceed it are recorded as 35+. A separate Mladé BĚKODO series is available for younger runners. The event is organized by TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and BK Běkodo.

name: Bėgimas „Kutaliai – Kaltinėnai“
description: The “Kutaliai–Kaltinėnai” run is a traditional cross-country race held to commemorate the 141st anniversary of the birth of Aleksandras Stulginskis, President of the Republic of Lithuania, and the Day of the Constituent Seimas. The race takes place over hilly terrain, encouraging physical activity and respect for sport. The start is in Kutaliai village, and the finish is at the stadium of Aleksandras Stulginskis Gymnasium in Kaltinėnai, Šilalė District. The event is for athletes from city and district schools and anyone else who meets the health requirements.

name: Leśna Piątka Pikuś
description: Leśna Piątka Pikuś is a cross-country race held in the picturesque forest of the Karnieszewice Forest District in Koszalin. The 10 km route passes through charming woodland, with numerous uphill and downhill sections and a stretch alongside a deep ravine, making the race challenging and full of excitement. Every participant who completes the distance will receive a commemorative medal. The start and finish are at the car park by the educational trail, providing easy access and convenient logistics.

name: Leihgesterner Volkslauf
description: The Leihgestern Volkslauf takes place annually on Corpus Christi in the beautiful woodland landscape of Linden. Participants can choose from a 5 km walk, a 5 km run, or a 10 km run. The courses run mostly along comfortable forest paths with moderate elevation changes and are suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Timing is chip-based, and race bibs require a deposit that is refunded when the bib is returned.
course_highlights: 5 km loop with 95% forest paths and approximately 50 m of elevation gain
10 km loop with 95% forest paths and approximately 110 m of elevation gain
A nature-filled route through the woodland landscape of Linden
additional: Race bib deposit: EUR 2, refunded when the bib is returned. Online registration is available until 03.06.2026 at 18:00 (group registration) or 04.06.2026 at 08:30 (individual registration). On-site late registration is not possible. Gross and net times are recorded using a chip. The start venue is the TSG Leihgestern sports clubhouse, Waldstraße 32, 35440 Linden. Run through nature, starting at the sports clubhouse; online registration available until 04.06.2026

name: Tolarova pětka
description: Tolarova Pětka is a running race held in Stříbro, offering a 5-kilometer course. The race is part of the Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro calendar and is intended for amateur and recreational runners. The route runs through the town park and is suitable for all age groups. After the race, there is a results ceremony and refreshments for participants.

name: Černovírská osmička
description: Černovírská osmička is a traditional running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Černovír. The race is part of the Haná Running Cup, which offers courses of various lengths and is open to all runners, regardless of age or performance level. The course runs through the picturesque landscape of the Olomouc Region and is suitable for beginners and experienced endurance runners alike. The organizers emphasize a relaxed atmosphere and high-quality race organization.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa - Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in picturesque locations, and the night edition stands out for its unique medals for participants. The race is ideal for runners who value scenic routes and a sense of community.

name: XXVII Bieg na Groń Jana Pawła II
location: Ponikiew, Wadowice County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Abendlauf Wilstedt bei Nacht
description: The Wilstedt Night Run takes place on 29 May 2026, transforming the village of Wilstedt into an atmospheric race course.
