The event is family-friendly and open to everyone, from beginners to experienced runners. The new course offers lovely views of the village at night. Cheering spectators and an evening fireworks display add to the atmosphere.
course_highlights: New course through Wilstedt with lovely views of the village
Atmospheric setting with cheering spectators along the course
Floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt after the run until 22:30
additional: The start and finish are at the Wilstedt sports grounds. The event begins with the mini run at 20:15, followed by the jogging and walking starts. Late entries are available on the event day from 18:30 to 20:00 and cost 9 euros. T-shirts or functional shirts are only available to participants who register in advance and will be handed out on the event day. After the run, floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt is free until 22:30. Fireworks bring the event to a close at around 22:45. Nordic walking poles are not allowed on the course. Child and running strollers are permitted only for the hiking/walking event. Shower and changing facilities are available on a limited basis. New course through Wilstedt, family-friendly, evening event, registration until 17 May, including a mini run, fireworks and musical entertainment.

name: Lauf Rund um Burg
description: The 37th Run Around the Castle is part of the Cross and Forest Run Series and takes place around Burg in Dithmarschen. The event gives runners the opportunity to run scenic routes of 4.8 km and 10 km. The race is distinguished by its natural surroundings and varied course. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a well-organized event.

name: Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf
description: The Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf is a charity run with the unique concept “Sport meets Music,” supporting the Mitteldeutschland Children’s Hospice. The event offers various races for children, teenagers, companies and individual runners, as well as walkers. Alongside the sporting event, there is musical entertainment and a KinderGarten concert, making the run a special experience for participants and spectators. Race materials can be collected the day before, and an AfterRöblinglauf Party takes place after the run.

name: Nacht von Hasbergen
description: The Night of Hasbergen is a traditional road race held on Friday, May 29, 2026, in Hasbergen. The event offers exciting races for all ages, from the Bambini run and relay race to the 10 km main race. The races take place on a new course that was changed because of construction work. The event begins with an opening ceremony and a show for the Bambini runners and concludes with awards ceremonies for the various races.

name: Kamenická 15
description: Kamenická 15 is a traditional running race in Kamenice near Jihlava. Adult runners take on a 15 km loop along paved roads and paths. Younger runners can choose from shorter 1.75 km and 0.4 km loops on paved roads in the village. The course passes through scenic spots in the surrounding area, including the hamlet of Brodek, Zátiší Chateau and the Cípy forester’s lodge, and finishes at the starting point. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages, from 3 years old, and offers a pleasant atmosphere, refreshments and prizes for winners and young participants.

name: Kapličkobraní
location: Hřiště TJ Ludgeřovice, Ludgeřovice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Kapličkobraní is a non-competitive charity event that follows a route past 13 chapels around Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice, with a total of 14 stops including the finish. The 10–12 km route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, or even taking a stroller. The event has a deeper purpose, and all proceeds go to the family of Jan Rieml to support his sons Šimon and Matěj. Participants receive a commemorative magnet, light refreshments at the finish, and a tasting of sacramental wine at one of the chapels. Kapličkobraní received an award for the best low-budget sports project for small organizations.

name: Běh mimoňským parkem
description: The Run through Mimoň Park is a race held in the chateau park in Mimoň, offering a flat course on paved paths along the Ploučnice River. The race is divided into 7-kilometre laps, with 7 km and 21 km distances available. The event is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners and is organised by Lenka Zeťová. The main category starts at 17:00, while the first category starts at 9:00. The race is part of the Czech Running Club and is held under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Nové Město na Moravě
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Nové Město na Moravě is a charity event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps preserve historical memories. The race takes place in and around Vysočina Arena, with 2 km, 5 km and 10 km routes; the 5 km route is one lap and the 10 km route is two laps. The event offers timed and untimed runs, including family and children’s races, and is suitable for the general public, including pupils, students and seniors, who may be eligible for a discount on the entry fee. The start and finish are at the Vysočina Arena stadium, where facilities include changing rooms, baggage storage and refreshments.

name: Ružindolský víchor
location: Ružindol okr. Trnava, Ružindol okr. Trnava, športový areál Ružindol
description: Ružindolský Víchor Run is the 12th edition of a road race held at the Ružindol sports complex. The course runs on asphalt and dirt roads through the village and includes a grass loop around the stadium. Runners can choose between a 7 km run and 4 km Nordic Walking. The start is scheduled for 17:30, with categories for men, women, local runners and Nordic Walking. Participants receive a race number, a timing chip, refreshments and a participant medal.

name: XIII Smolecka (za)Dyszka
location: Smolec, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The XIII Smolec (za)Dyszka is a 10 km road race around the village of Smolec, taking place on May 30, 2026, at 6:00 PM. The race follows a certified course and is organized by running enthusiasts and volunteers who ensure plenty of fun and sporting excitement. The event attracts recreational runners, families, and residents of the Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality and Lower Silesia. The organizers provide professional event management and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Bieg na Sleze
description: The Bieg na Ślężę is one of the oldest mountain races in Poland, held in Sobótka on the slopes of the Ślęża Massif. The approximately 5 km course, with over 500 metres of elevation gain, follows scenic, challenging mountain trails and finishes at the summit of Ślęża, next to the mountain shelter. The race attracts both top competitors and amateurs who want to take on the legendary climb to the “Ślężański Olympus.”

name: Ultraroztocze
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a unique running event taking place on May 30, 2026, in Józefów, in the Roztocze region. Participants can choose from a variety of courses, from short night runs to ultra distances of 60 km and 120 km, which lead through the picturesque Roztocze countryside. The event is organized by the Janosik Race Series Foundation, which has promoted an active and mindful lifestyle through sport since 2014. The race attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering unforgettable experiences and a chance to connect with nature.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – Spring 2026 edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Botanical Garden of the University of Zielona Góra. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland and other regions since 2014. The route in Zielona Góra consists of two loops, allowing participants to enjoy the charms of nature and a challenging yet attractive terrain profile. The organizers are running enthusiasts who emphasize the aesthetics and character of cross-country routes.

name: RockRun Jarocin
description: Rock Run Jarocin is a unique running event taking place on May 30, 2026, combining sport, music, and the atmosphere of Jarocin, a city known as the heart of Polish rock. The race attracts both experienced runners and first-timers, offering a route through the most interesting parts of the Jarocin municipality. It is not only a sporting competition, but also a community of enthusiasts and a great sporting adventure that stays with you for a long time. The event is part of the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix and emphasizes good organization and enthusiastic support from spectators.

name: 13 Bieg Konopielki
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury w Gminie Juchnowiec Kościelny
description: The 13th Konopielka Run is an annual running event held in Juchnowiec Dolny, scheduled for May 30 in 2026. The main 10 km race starts at noon, preceded by the traditional Family Run. After the competition, participants are invited to a social gathering in Frampol, the birthplace of Edward Redliński, author of the novel “Konopielka.” The race pack includes a soft blanket that can be used for a picnic after the race. The event’s family-friendly and literary atmosphere makes it unique.

name: 8 Borowiacka Dycha
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Tuchola Forest. The event attracts runners who enjoy being close to nature and competing on a moderately challenging course. The organizers, Stowarzyszenie Biegające Śliwice, ensure professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere for participants. The race is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich, highlighting its importance in the local running calendar.

name: Bieg o Złotą Kaczkę
description: The Golden Duck Run is an annual running event held in Toszek. Its aim is to promote running and Nordic walking as recreational activities, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and foster social integration, including for people with disabilities. The main race course is approximately 10 km long and runs over mixed terrain, including cobblestones, asphalt, country roads, and park paths, with soft surfaces predominating. The start and finish are at Toszek Castle. The organizers offer numerous age and special categories, as well as trophies for the top competitors.

name: Bieg Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema
description: The Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema Run is a 10 km road race taking place on May 30, 2026, in Żelkowo, Kashubia. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers encourage runners to use the training plans and expert support to prepare for the race as effectively as possible. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, a platform supporting runners across Poland.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.
description: The Masurian Running Grand Prix is a series of races held in the picturesque Masuria region, promoting running close to nature. The routes pass through forests and along lakes, giving participants the chance to enjoy the beauty of nature. The event attracts runners who value outdoor activity and the charm of Masurian landscapes.

name: Dolska Dycha
organizer: Centrum Promocji, Kultury i Sportu w Dolsku
description: Dolska Dycha is a 10 km road race taking place on May 30, 2026, in Dolsk. The course is certified by the PZLA and marked every kilometer. It runs through the Dolsk municipality with traffic closed to vehicles. The event also includes a 3 km race, “Kozia Trójka.” Runners can expect aid stations, medical care, and a post-race recovery meal. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the town and municipality of Dolsk.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Running Challenge is an annual running event held in the scenic park behind Piast Stadium in Gliwice. The event combines sport, a great atmosphere, and time in the city’s green spaces, making it suitable both for experienced runners and for anyone looking to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The race traditionally starts in the clearing behind Piast Stadium. The race office opens at 9:00, and the start is at 10:00. Advance registration and an entry fee are required. It’s a great opportunity to start the new month actively.

name: Kresowe Trail #6
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races held amid the scenic natural surroundings of Eastern Poland and the Vilnius Region. The routes are marked according to cycling standards to make navigation easier. Distances include the shorter Szpurt (approx. 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), which features elements of ultra trail. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature and local communities, and builds a community of runners in the spirit of passion, competition, and friendship. The competition runs throughout the season and concludes with overall and team standings.

name: Patrol Graniczny 7
description: Border Patrol 2026 is a race held in Opava that attracts outdoor enthusiasts and fans of off-road sports. The event is an endurance challenge, taking place on routes with varied terrain. The organizers invite both experienced runners and amateurs to take part, offering unforgettable sporting experiences in scenic surroundings.

name: Roztocze Ultra Race
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a unique ultrarunning event held in the picturesque Roztocze National Park in Józefów. The race offers a variety of courses, from shorter distances to challenging 60 km and 120 km ultras, taking runners through the charming landscapes of Roztocze. It’s an event for running enthusiasts who want to discover lesser-known natural areas and take on off-road challenges. The organizers, the Janosik Race Series Foundation, ensure professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Run4aSmile
description: Run4aSmile is a 10 km race taking place on May 30, 2026, in Nowy Sącz. Participants can use training plans tailored to different experience levels to prepare optimally for the race. The event is a road race and offers a great opportunity to test your fitness and spend time actively in the picturesque surroundings of Małopolska. The organizers encourage both beginners and experienced runners to take part.

name: Wadowicka Dycha
description: Wadowicka Dycha is a 10 km road race held in the picturesque town of Wadowice and the surrounding areas, including Zawadka and Chocznia. The asphalt course has approximately 100 m of elevation gain and runs through the town center, starting and finishing at the Market Square in Wadowice. Before the main race, events for children and young people are also held over 200 m and 400 m, with separate classifications for girls and boys. The race is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and connect with the local running community.

name: XI Bieg Memoriałowy
description: The 11th Adam Lewandowski Memorial Run in Orchowo is an annual running event organized by the Orchowo Municipality. The run commemorates Adam Lewandowski and attracts runners from various age categories. The event takes place in Orchowo and offers an opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the local community together. The organizers warmly invite all running enthusiasts to take part.

name: XI Bieg Pamięci Grupy Kampinos Żołnierzy...
location: Zespół Sportowo-Rekreacyjny, Leszno, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Kampinos Group Home Army Soldiers Memorial Run is a race commemorating the soldiers of the Kampinos Group of the Home Army. The event takes place in Leszno, and the start and finish of the main race and the Children’s Races are on the track at the Sports and Recreation Complex. The main race is 11 km long and is held in a spirit of historical remembrance.

name: XV Kwidzyński Bieg Papiernika
organizer: MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. oraz Fundacja Opiekuńcza MM Kwidzyn
description: The 15th Kwidzyn Paperworkers’ Run is an annual running event established in 2010 out of a passion for running and promoting physical activity for health and fun. The 10 km race runs through the center of Kwidzyn and brings together the local community and runners from all over Poland. The event accompanies Paperworkers’ Day, a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees, and participation in the race and other attractions is free. It is organized by MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. and the MM Kwidzyn Care Foundation.

name: XV Żmigrodzki Bieg Smoka
description: The 15th Żmigród Dragon Run is an annual running event taking place on May 30, 2026, in Żmigród. Participants cover a 10-kilometer route through the town streets, enjoying the sporting excitement and unique atmosphere of the event. The race attracts both experienced runners and people looking to spend time actively and test their abilities. It is also an opportunity to promote a healthy lifestyle and celebrate sport together as a local community.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Grand Prix of Mysłowice is a series of running events organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing runners of all ability levels together. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running abilities. The races are free, and registration is available only at the Race Office on race day. Truchtacz Mysłowice is a community that motivates and supports participants as they discover the joy of running.

name: HIT-felder Volkslauf
description: The HIT-felder Volkslauf is a long-standing race in Seevetal, organised by TSV Eintracht Hittfeld. It offers courses for the whole family, from short runs at the Peperdieksberg sports grounds to longer routes along country and forest paths. The event takes place on 30 May 2026 from 13:30 and is known for its friendly atmosphere and extensive supporting programme. All participants receive a finisher’s medal. Team rankings and cash prizes are also awarded to the largest groups of runners who register in advance.
course_highlights: Routes along country and forest paths, as well as partly paved side roads
Races over 600 m, 1000 m, 2.5 km, 4.5 km and 10.6 km, with small and large loops
Electronic timing; spikes are not permitted
additional: Start and finish at Hittfeld School Centre, Peperdieksberg sports grounds. Changing rooms and showers are available at the school centre. Late registration is possible on the day of the event, up to 30 minutes before the start, with cash payment (except for the Roland-Witt family run). Supporting programme with coffee, cake, grilled sausages and drinks. Certificates are available online at www.stgk.de. Team rankings apply to certain races. The group with the most advance registrations receives a challenge trophy and cash prizes. The event takes place in May, with typical temperatures of around 20°C for the low and 10°C for the high, and offers children’s races, walking and Nordic walking alongside the running courses.

name: Leegebrucher Straßenlauf am 30.05.2026
price_range: Kinder frei; Jugendliche 3 Euro; Erwachsene 4 Euro
description: The Leegebruch Road Race takes place on May 30, 2026, and is a traditional running event in Leegebruch that welcomes runners of almost all ages. Participants run laps on the sports field and through the streets of Leegebruch. The event promises a lively atmosphere and is open to athletes of all ability levels. Registration is online via an external platform.
course_highlights: Laps on the sports field and through the streets of Leegebruch
Traditional running event with a family-friendly atmosphere
Suitable for runners of almost all ages
additional: Registration is online only; on-site registration is not possible. There are no age categories and no awards ceremony. Changing rooms and showers are not available. Cold and hot drinks and snacks are available at the kiosk. Parking is available at the fairground on Lindenstraße. Run on roads and at the stadium, online registration, no changing rooms or showers, parking on Lindenstraße

name: 08. Dünenfeld Marathon
description: The Dünenfeld Marathon in Augustdorf is a special race held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large loops of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is partly trail-like. The start is at the level of the viewing platform, where runners can enjoy a beautiful view of the large dune fields. This is a private race with self-support and manual timekeeping; a photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof.

name: 34. Emder Matjeslauf
description: The 34th Emder Matjeslauf takes place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, in Emden city center. This long-standing city race has been organized by Emder Laufgemeinschaft e.V. since 1991 and is known well beyond the region. In addition to the 10 km main race, there are school class and team competitions, making the event suitable for all age groups. The course has been adjusted due to construction work on Neutorstraße but still offers an attractive city loop. Emder Laufgemeinschaft looks forward to welcoming many participants and wishes everyone the best of luck.

name: Aegidius-Lauf
description: The Aegidius Run is a charity run in Hanover that has been established for over 20 years. It takes place on May 30, 2026. The event offers several distances, including children’s races, a wheelchair race, 5 km and 10 km races, and walking options. The start and finish are at Aegidiushaus AUF DER BULT, and all entry fees go exclusively to charity. The course is attractive, and times are recorded using a clock rather than chip timing. All participants receive a certificate, and the best runners are honored with non-cash prizes.

name: Limbacher Marktlauf
description: The Limbach Market Run will take place for the 30th time on May 30, 2026, at the Waldstadion in Limbach-Oberfrohna. The event offers a great running atmosphere, with new courses, new competitions and a finisher medal. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can look forward to an extensive supporting program. The run is organized by LV Limbach 2000 e.V. and is a popular event in the region.

name: Nienburger Spargellauf
description: The Nienburg Asparagus Run is a traditional race taking place on May 30, 2026, in Nienburg, offering various distances for children, teenagers, and adults. The routes are officially measured and follow flat, partly shaded circuits, starting and finishing at the Wesavi parking lot. In addition to individual and children’s races, there is a 10 km relay race, as well as company and club rankings. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive prizes for the top runners.

name: Turm zu Turm Lauf
description: The 21st Turm zu Turm Run on May 30, 2026, in Georgsmarienhütte offers runners a varied and scenic experience. The main 24-kilometer course connects the prominent Hermannsturm and Varusturm viewpoints and passes through forest sections with around 520 meters of elevation gain. There are also races for children, a fun run, a 10-kilometer scenic run, and a walking course. The event is a sporting highlight of the Osnabrück and Westphalia region, with suitable distances for all ages and ability levels.

name: Běh osvobození – Lišanská silniční sedmička
description: The Liberation Run – Lišany Road Seven is a traditional 7 km road race between the villages of Lišany and Lužná. The race takes place on a quiet third-class road and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. The start is in Lišany, where registration also takes place, and the finish is by the U Hřiště restaurant. The race has four men’s and two women’s categories and offers cash prizes, as well as a bonus for breaking the course records. The start time is 11:15. Entries are accepted on site on race day.

name: Běh Emericha Ratha
description: The Emerich Rath Run is a revived cross-country race held in Broumov, inviting runners to take part in the picturesque surroundings of Schroll Park near Cyklodům Broumov. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy a run in nature, with access to amenities such as bike rental, luggage storage, and an e-bike charging station. Registration takes place in the morning before the start, traditionally at 10:00. The organizers warmly invite all runners to join this sporting event with its friendly atmosphere.

name: Tuháčkův běh
description: Tuháček’s Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chrást u Příbrami as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The main race is approximately 8.2 km long and runs mostly along paved and gravel cycle paths around Chrást. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in dedicated children’s races. The main race starts at 11:00 at the Valcha complex. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to compete with other runners in beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton České Budějovice 2026
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival České Budějovice 2026 invites you to an unforgettable half marathon through the heart of the city’s historic centre. The start is on the second-largest square in the Czech Republic, Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., and the course offers a unique atmosphere and views of historic buildings and special places. This race is part of the popular RunCzech running series and is suitable for all runners who want to experience the charm of the South Bohemian capital during a day of sport. Join thousands of runners and enjoy a great sporting event in České Budějovice.

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
description: The Chlum Three Ways race is the fourth event in the Rozhledny v pohybu series, held near Plzeň. Competitors tackle the prominent Chlum summit in three ways: a mass-start uphill race, an interval hill run, and a stair climb to the observation tower. The overall standings are based on the combined times from all three events, with bonuses for the top three finishers. Children can compete in ten age categories on courses around the observation tower. A relay is also available, with teams of three runners completing all three disciplines.

name: Třanovická 10
description: Třanovická 10 is a traditional running race held in the village of Třanovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The routes run along clay-gravel, forest, field and asphalt roads within the cadastral areas of Třanovice and Dolní Domaslavice. The event is open to the general public and includes a 10 km main race, a 5 km race and a relay. The start and finish are by the municipal office, and the race begins at 9:00. Registration is available online and on-site, with race bibs and medals available for collection by those who register early.

name: DEVIL’S CHALLENGE – ČERTOVSKÁ VÝZVA – 666km aneb superantikontramultiextraunikátní běžecký závod
location: Hamr na Jezeře, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Čertovská výzva 666 km is an 8-day stage running race through the beautiful countryside of northern Bohemia. It offers a 666 km route or a shortened 4-stage option. The race passes through Kokořínsko, the Máchův kraj region, the Lusatian Mountains, the Ještěd Ridge and Bohemian Paradise. The final stage follows the same course as the Čertovský ultratrail 66.6 km. The race is open to individuals, pairs and teams of three, with the option to take turns running the stages. Individual stages can also be selected. The start and finish are in Hamr na Jezeře, with group transfers to the stage starts and GPS navigation. The entry fee includes a pre-race buffet.

name: 1/2Maraton Bělský les
description: The Bělský les Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque setting of Bělský les in Ostrava-Zábřeh. It offers several distances, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 4 × 5 km relay, and the Nachmelená 25 km hiking event. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and the general public, and supports charitable causes. The start and finish are at Vodní areál Jih, providing a pleasant atmosphere and good facilities for participants.

name: Běh pro Paměť Národa – Ostrava
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Ostrava is a charity sports and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place on May 30, 2026, in Komenského sady, with timed 4 km (1 lap) and 8 km (2 laps) races. The event is open to all age groups, including children’s races, and offers the option of a symbolic run anywhere. The start and finish are by the statue of J. A. Comenius, with refreshments and restroom facilities available for participants.

name: Běh přes tři vsi
description: Běh přes tři vsi is a modern cross-country race that continues the tradition of a road race organized by Spartak Sedlec. The race is intended both for athletes and for runners who want to enjoy the beauty of the countryside. The youngest runners are not forgotten either, as running can bring them lifelong joy. The route passes through three villages—Sedlec, Lhůta, and Tymákov—in the area around Starý Plzenec.

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
description: Chlum Three Ways is a hill race to Chlum, a prominent peak near Plzeň, tackled in three different ways. It starts with a mass-start uphill race over 1.75 km. The event is appealing to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain and wanting to try different routes up the same hill. It is part of the running community and offers an enjoyable experience in nature close to Plzeň.

name: Běh na Děvín
description: Běh na Děvín is an uphill running race offering two distances: 4.4 km and 9.1 km. The route runs mostly over trails and finishes at the summit of Děvín, offering beautiful views and a challenging profile. The race is part of the Czech Cup in Uphill Running and is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in the natural surroundings of the South Moravian Region. The start is by the church in Perná and the finish is at the summit of Děvín, guaranteeing a unique mountain running experience.

name: Běžecké závody AC Praha 1890
description: The AC Praha 1890 Praha–Brandýs races are traditional race-walking events with a history dating back to 1892. The race takes place in Arborka Forest Park in Prague 14 and offers courses for men, women, juniors, and children. The course is a paved circuit suitable for fast running and walking. The race is part of the men’s and women’s leagues and is open to both amateur and club athletes. Race numbers and chips are issued at registration; timing is provided by chips and a finish-line camera.

name: Čertovská výzva - jednotlivé etapy
description: Čertovská výzva is a unique 8-day, 666 km stage running race through the beautiful countryside of northern Bohemia. Shorter options are also available: a 4-stage race or individual stages. The route passes through Kokořínsko, Máchův kraj, the Lužické Mountains, the Ještěd Ridge and Český ráj. The final stage follows the same course as the 66.6 km Čertovský ultratrail. The race is open to individuals, pairs and teams of three, with the option to take turns. Chip timing and a GPS tracker are provided. The start and finish are in Hamr na Jezeře, with group transfers available to the stage starts. The entry fee includes a pre-race buffet.

name: WEBER Jičínská10 (CityRun Jičín)
description: Jičínská 10 is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Jičín. The race offers a 10 km course suitable for the general public and runners of all levels. The event takes place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, and includes a training run on the course to help participants prepare. The atmosphere is friendly, welcoming all runners who want to take on a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: Beh v Raji – prológ
location: Stratená, okr. Rožňava, Stratená, okr. Rožňava, Dobšinská Ľadová Jaskyňa - parkovisko
description: The Run in Paradise is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the Dobšinská Ice Cave and its vicinity. Participants can choose from several distances, including a prologue, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, which run mainly on asphalt roads with partial traffic closures. The prologue is a hilly 1 km run along a forest trail from the car park to the ice cave. The event is suitable for the general public and also offers Nordic walking.

name: Salibský polmaratón, Hornosalibská desiatka, Hornosalibská trojka
location: Horné Saliby okr. Galanta, Horné Saliby okr. Galanta, Areál futbalového ihriska TJ Horné Saliby
organizer: Obce Horné Saliby a Dolné Saliby
description: The Saliby Half Marathon, Hornosalibská 10 and Hornosalibská 3 are traditional running events organized by RoniRun Club in the village of Horné Saliby. The races offer certified courses of 21.1 km, 10 km and 3 km, running through a picturesque area, with refreshment stations and chip timing. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in special kids’ races. Alongside the sporting experience, visitors can look forward to a varied accompanying program featuring music, martial arts demonstrations and a raffle.

name: Self-Transcendence 6/12h a 100km beh / Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 100km beh
location: Šamorín, Okres Dunajská Streda, Trnavský kraj
description: The Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 6/12-hour and 100 km race in Šamorín is a traditional ultrarunning event taking place on May 30, 2026, in Pomlé City Park. It is the 24th edition of the 6-hour race and the 15th edition of the 12-hour and 100 km races, with categories for both individuals and relay teams. Runners can compete in various age categories, including veterans aged over 50. Relay teams consist of a maximum of three runners, who may take turns in any order, with each member required to complete at least one lap after taking over. Results are measured by the actual distance covered, to the nearest meter.

name: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom
location: Veľké Lovce (okr. Nové Zámky), Veľké Lovce (okr. Nové Zámky), Športový areál
description: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom is the fourth edition of a running event taking place on 30 May 2026 at the sports complex in Veľké Lovce. The races run through the village streets and surrounding countryside along paved and dirt roads. The event also includes children’s categories with distances varying by age, as well as the main 5 km and 10 km races. It is suitable for the general public and offers awards in age and gender categories. The organizers emphasize convenient online registration and accurate chip timing.

name: Memoriál Jozefa Gabčíka
location: Žilina - Poluvsie, Žilina - Poluvsie, rodný dom Jozefa Gabčíka
organizer: Žilinský pluk Jozefa Gabčíka, Klub vojenských výsadkárov Slovenskej republiky, Železničná spoločnosť Slovensko, Ministerstvo obrany SR
description: The Jozef Gabčík Memorial is an annual running race held in honour of paratrooper and hero Jozef Gabčík, a prominent figure in the anti-fascist resistance. This 11 km cross-country race over mixed terrain runs from Žilina–Poluvsie, the birthplace of Jozef Gabčík, to the sports complex of the 5th Special Forces Regiment in Žilina. The event brings together civilian and military runners and promotes physical fitness and community spirit. The entry fee includes a race pack, refreshments, a commemorative medal, and chip timing.

name: Kurimské pobehaňe
location: Kurima, (okres Bardejov), Kurima, (okres Bardejov), Pred kaštieľom
description: Kurimské pobehaňe is a running event organized by the Aktívna Kurima civic association, held in the village of Kurima in front of the manor house. The course follows asphalt and dirt roads, with dirt and gravel surfaces. The race is open to a range of age groups, from schoolchildren to veterans, with men and women competing in different age categories. Online registration is available, with different entry fees depending on when you register. A school run for children is also provided. The event is ideal for runners looking for an enjoyable, community-oriented running experience in nature.

name: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso
location: Štrbské Pleso, Štrbské Pleso, na hlavnej ceste medzi hotelom FIS (adresa: k Vodopádom 26) a hotelom Patria
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso is a traditional night run in the stunning surroundings of the High Tatras, now being held for the 14th year. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes that pass around Malé and Veľké Štrbské Pleso, Jazierka lásky, and through the Snow Cross-Country Skiing Area. The event is part of the Grand Prix series and offers an unmistakable atmosphere, with views of Rysy and a nighttime finish in the dark. In addition to the adult races, children’s runs and Nordic walking are also on offer. Telekom Night Run is a popular annual stop for runners who enjoy beautiful running experiences in a mountain setting.

name: Turbo TV detské behy Štrbské Pleso
location: Štrbské Pleso, Štrbské Pleso, na hlavnej ceste medzi hotelom FIS (adresa: k Vodopádom 26) a hotelom Patria
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso is a traditional night run in the stunning surroundings of the High Tatras, taking place for the 14th time. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes leading around Malé Štrbské Pleso and Veľké Štrbské Pleso, with beautiful views of the Tatra peaks. The event also includes Turbo TV children’s races, with various distances for everyone from the youngest runners to teenagers, offering unforgettable experiences and medals. The atmosphere is exceptional, with spectators cheering along the route and runners crossing the finish line after dark, making this run a popular fixture in the season.

name: Fatranský Vĺčko
location: určianske Jaseno, určianske Jaseno, Lezecká stena Ovčín
description: Fatranský Vĺčko is an endurance sport for people and dogs, combining hiking and running in the beautiful countryside of Veľká Fatra. The event takes place on May 30, 2026, in Turčianske Jaseno and offers two routes: the longer MID, 44 km long with +2,350 m of elevation gain, and the shorter SHORT, 14 km long with +500 m of elevation gain. You can compete in the dog trekking category (person with a dog) or the trail category (running without a dog). Dogs must remain on a leash or in a harness throughout the route; allowing a dog to roam freely results in disqualification. The organizers recommend the MID route for experienced participants and SHORT for newcomers or those with less training.

name: „Vilties bėgimas“
description: The Run of Hope is a civic initiative dedicated to fostering a culture of solidarity and hope in support of people with cancer and their loved ones. The event takes place in Klaipėda Old Town and offers a range of distances, from 0.2 km for children to a full marathon of 42.195 km. The race follows loop courses, allowing participants to enjoy views of the city while contributing to an important social mission. This traditional event brings athletes and the community together for a shared purpose.

name: 1. Zielony Półmaraton
location: Konstancin-Jeziorna (Park Zdrojowy im. hrabiego Witolda Skórzewskiego)
description: “We Run, We Don’t Click! – Konstancin-Jeziorna 2026” is a charity 5 km race taking place on May 24, 2026, in the scenic Chojnów Landscape Park. The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all abilities. The start and finish are at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, offering easy access and convenient conditions for spectators. The event combines sporting competition with community engagement and support, and all proceeds will go to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery.

name: 13. Bieg 10km Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run is one of the most important 10 km running events in Wielkopolska, held since 2012. It attracts leading Polish athletes as well as runners from abroad, creating a unique atmosphere filled with sporting excitement and energy. The course is interesting and varied, with wooded sections and a route through the streets of Swarzędz. The event also includes a Family Run and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, adding even more excitement to the running festival.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Szpot
description: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival is a special running event taking place on May 31, 2026. The festival features three races: the 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon, the 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10K, and the 6th Szpot Swarzędz Family Run. The half-marathon course follows two loops around scenic Lake Swarzędz, while the 10K offers a dynamic route with forest sections and urban stretches. The event brings together sport, education, and charity. Participants can enjoy a well-stocked food zone, a partner expo, a post-race meal, massages, and a charity auction. The festival is open to everyone, including athletes using active wheelchairs and seniors over 70, who can take part free of charge.

name: 2. Uliczna Mila / 3. Parkowa Piątka
description: Uliczna Mila (1,609 m) and Parkowa Piątka (5 km) are road races held entirely on the paths of TAURON Park Śląski in Chorzów. The courses are certified by PZLA and World Athletics, ensuring their high quality and the opportunity to achieve official results. The races are designed to help athletes achieve their best performances. The next edition will take place on May 31, 2026, and you are warmly invited to take part.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon is a special running event taking place on May 31, 2026, in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops, covering a total distance of 21.097 km, and runs along a scenic route around Lake Swarzędz. The race combines sporting excitement with professional organization, a unique atmosphere, and support from spectators, creating an unforgettable celebration of running. The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival also features 10 km races and a Family Run, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.

name: Bieg z okazji Dni Ziemi Ropczyckiej 2026
description: The Run to Celebrate the Ropczyce Region Days is a 10 km race taking place on May 31, 2026, in Ropczyce. Organized to mark a local celebration, this running event attracts runners looking to spend time actively on a moderate-distance course. The route passes through the scenic area of Ropczyce, and participants can expect typical May weather, with temperatures around 20 degrees Celsius. All running enthusiasts are welcome to take part.

name: Marceliński Bieg Wiosenny 2026
description: Marceliński Spring Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on popularizing cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience surrounded by beautiful natural scenery.

name: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN Kupienino 31.05.2026
description: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN is a new running event taking place for the first time on May 31, 2026, in Kupienin near Świebodzin. The race offers a fast 5-kilometre distance, ideal for runners looking for a dynamic challenge. The event is organised for running enthusiasts who want to test their speed on a scenic course.

name: 16 Kogeneracja Biegaj w Siechnicach
description: The 16th Kogeneracja Biegaj w Siechnicach is a road race over 5 km and 10 km, taking place on May 31, 2026. The course runs along the streets of Siechnice, with participants completing a 5 km loop; runners in the 10 km race complete it twice. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and the recreational attractions of the Siechnice municipality. In addition to the main races, races for children and young people are also held. The start and finish are on Kościelna Street, at its intersection with Jana Pawła II Street, and the race is scheduled to start at 9:00.

name: 3 Zduńskowolski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 3rd Zduńska Wola Running Festival is a celebratory road race through the city of Zduńska Wola, organized to mark the 200th anniversary of the city being granted municipal rights. Races are held over 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon (21 km) distances, with the start and finish at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street. The route runs through the city streets and the municipality of Zapolice to the village of Brzeski in the municipality of Sędziejowice, where the half-marathon turnaround point is located. Several hundred runners take part in this urban road race.

name: 4 Bieg Zawierciański
organizer: Klub Sportowy „Warto Biegać” i Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Zawierciu
description: The 4th Zawiercie Run is a running event organized by the “Warto Biegać” Sports Club and the Sports and Recreation Centre in Zawiercie. The event takes place at the OSIR Stadium in Zawiercie and features two distances: a main 10 km race and an accompanying 5 km race. The course runs along the streets of Zawiercie, is properly secured and closed to traffic, and is marked at every kilometre. The event aims to promote running and bring runners from across the country together.

name: Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dopiewie
description: The Run for the Crown of Princess Dąbrówka is the 15th-anniversary edition of a running event traditionally held on the last Sunday of May. The main 10 km race follows forest trails surrounded by greenery, offering pleasant conditions for running on soft ground. Nordic walking enthusiasts can take on a 7.5 km route, while the youngest participants can compete over shorter distances ranging from 200 to 1,000 metres. The start and finish are located at the edge of the Palędzie–Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting physical activity among residents of the Dopiewo Municipality.

name: Bieg Rodzinny Radia Wrocław
description: The Radio Wrocław Family Run is a special event held to celebrate Children’s Day, bringing children and adults together in running teams. Each child runs with a guardian, highlighting the family-friendly nature of the event and the experience of covering the course together. It is not only a sporting competition but also a great opportunity to spend time together and promote physical activity among families. The event takes place in Wrocław and is organized by Radio Wrocław, which invites everyone to join this joyful run.
course_highlights: A family run with child-and-adult teams
A course suited to the family-friendly nature of the run
Organized by Radio Wrocław to celebrate Children’s Day

name: Krakowski Bieg Swoszowicki
description: The Kraków Swoszowice Run is a family-friendly running event held in the beautiful Spa Park in Swoszowice, in southern Kraków. It offers a variety of races: a 10 km main race, a 5 km race, a family mile, and races for children aged 1 to 11. The event brings generations together, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle while connecting residents of Kraków and the surrounding area. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can look forward to attractive race packs and a family picnic.

name: LoveLasTrail
description: Love'Las Trail Przystań is a unique forest race held in the picturesque forests of the Mazovia region, in the heart of the Ostrołęka Forest District. This sporting and recreational event combines competition with a love of nature, promoting a healthy lifestyle and social integration. Routes of varying difficulty are available to runners of different ability levels, as well as to families and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The race has an atmosphere full of positive energy and respect for nature, as participants in previous editions can attest.

name: Mazowiecka Piętnastka
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mińsku Mazowieckim
description: Mazowiecka Piętnastka is the 30th-anniversary edition of a nationwide road race organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Mińsk Mazowiecki. The event will take place on May 31, 2026, and is a great opportunity to celebrate through sport in this picturesque town. The road race attracts runners from all over Poland, offering an appealing course and professional organization.

name: Mokotowski Bieg SGH
description: The SGH Mokotów Run is the largest charity run organized by students in Poland, combining sport with support for those in need. The event takes place in the heart of Mokotów, Warsaw, and attracts hundreds of participants—students, alumni, local residents, and running enthusiasts. The route runs through the streets of Mokotów and finishes in the SGH Rector’s Gardens. Every step makes a real difference in the lives of those in need, thanks to the support of the “Akogo?” Foundation. It’s not just about sport, but also community, solidarity, and the energy of student engagement.

name: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challange
description: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challenge is a virtual challenge that takes you along a route through the vibrant streets and breathtaking landscapes of Rio de Janeiro, known as the Marvelous City. Participants can track their progress using a mobile app by logging different physical activities, which are automatically converted into distance covered. The challenge lets you choose your own pace and timeframe, and take part individually or as a team. In addition, for every milestone in the challenge, the organizers plant trees or prevent plastic bottles from reaching the ocean, supporting environmental protection.

name: Stryszów w Biegu
description: The Stryszów Municipality invites you to the sporting event “Stryszów on the Run,” which will take place on May 31, 2026. The course runs through the municipality’s scenic countryside, including fields and forests, with views of Lake Mucharskie and the surrounding hills. The event offers three distances to suit different experience levels: 6 km for families and beginners, 10 km for runners seeking a challenge, and a 21 km mountain half marathon for experienced athletes. The event aims to promote physical activity, bring residents together, and showcase the region’s natural attractions.

name: UltraPark Weekend
description: UltraPark Weekend is an ultra-running festival held in Pabianice from May 29 to 31, 2026. The event features three main competitions: UltraPark 48h, UltraPark 24h, and UltraPark 100 km, which are also the Polish Championships in their respective categories. The races attract long-distance runners with challenging courses and a unique competitive atmosphere. The organizer is the "O Co Biega" Sports Club from Pabianice.

name: V Półmaraton Po Kolei
organizer: Powiatowe Centrum Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji w Szczytnie
description: The 5th Po Kolei Half Marathon is a race covering approximately 21.1 km, taking place on May 31, 2026, in Lemany near Szczytno. The route follows a cycling path along a former railway line and local roads, offering scenic views and well-prepared hydration and refreshment stations. The event is organized by the Szczytno County Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre and the Szczytno County Local Tourism Organization. In addition to the half marathon, there are children’s races and a 5 km race, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.

name: X Charytatywny Gminny Bieg Między Wiatra...
description: The 10th Municipal Charity Run Between the Windmills is an annual running event held in Łukaszów, aimed at promoting running, sports, and a healthy lifestyle. The event is charitable, and all funds raised are donated to support people in need. The course follows a scenic loop around the windmills in Łukaszów, and participants can choose from several distances, including a children’s race, 5 km, 10 km, and Nordic walking. Organizers provide electronic timing, as well as a hot meal and drinks for participants.

name: XI Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski
description: Sieradz Cross Social Run is an annual running event organized by the Sieradz Biega Sports Club, which promotes running and brings together the running community in the city of Sieradz. The race takes place in A. Mickiewicz Municipal Park on a 2 km loop covered with gravel, with markers every 500 m. The run lasts 6 hours, during which participants compete to complete as many laps as possible, with the option to take breaks and return to the course. The event is social and aimed at popularizing running, and participants receive electronic lap and time tracking.

name: XII Biegnij Dla Aniołów
description: TAURON Run for the Angels is a charity race held in Katowice in support of the children cared for by Dom Aniołów Stróżów. The event takes place in Kościuszko Park and combines sport with helping children in need. Participants can choose the 5 km main race, races for children in various age categories, or a virtual race. All entry fees go towards educational, therapeutic, and academic support for nearly 600 children from disadvantaged backgrounds. The event is also a family picnic packed with attractions, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and a gift.

name: XIV Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji w Kostrzynie
description: The 14th Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka in Kostrzyn is an annual race organized by the Municipal Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Kostrzyn. The event offers 10 km and 5 km running races, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking march, with overall, age-group, and municipality residents’ classifications. The start and finish are on Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street, by Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn. The organizer plans a prize draw for participants, and the race office is open for several hours before the start.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej Żukowo oraz Gminny Ośrodek Turystyki i Sportu w Gniewinie
description: The 39th Stolemów Run is an annual 10 km race held at the “Arena Mistrzów” Sports Stadium in Gniewino. The event also includes races for children and young people, a 5 km Nordic walking event, and a recreational run-walk. Participants can expect electronic timing, medals for everyone, and prizes for the top finishers. For those who want to take part virtually, a virtual race option is available from May 27 to June 4, 2026.

name: Świętokrzyski Bieg Europejski
description: The Świętokrzyski European Run is a 5-kilometer road race held in Kielce, promoting physical activity and the spirit of European community. The route runs through the city streets, offering participants a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the Funduszowy Maj 2026 activities in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, encouraging exercise and bringing the local community together.

name: IV Marszobieg Politechniki Częstochowskiej
location: Olsztyn, Częstochowa County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Elsterlauf
organizer: SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda e.V. und Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Elsterlauf in Bad Liebenwerda is a traditional running and walking event, taking place for the 46th time on May 31, 2026. The event offers a variety of distances, including a marathon, half marathon, several walking and hiking routes, and children’s races. The course runs through the spa town of Bad Liebenwerda, with a family-friendly atmosphere and classifications for individual participants, teams, and companies. All participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate, and awards are presented by age group. The event is organised by SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda and Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
course_highlights: A variety of distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km, 5.7 km, 2 km, walking, and hiking
Start and finish at Roßmarkt in Bad Liebenwerda, near the primary school centre with changing rooms and showers
Guided 11 km hike and family-friendly races such as the Bambini and taster runs
additional: Late registration is available on May 30, 2026, from 12:00 to 15:00, and on May 31, 2026, from 07:00 to 09:30. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Bad Liebenwerda primary school centre; baggage storage is available from 7:00 to 14:00. The finish closes for all distances at 13:15. There is a company and club classification, with teams of three participants. Cyclists and hikers start without timing or classification. All participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate. Results will be published online. Running event with online registration and various categories for runners, walkers, and families, including award ceremonies and finisher’s medals.

name: Urwaldlauf
description: The Urwaldlauf is a six-hour race in which participants can run as many laps as they like on a 1.85 km course through the forest near Saarbrücken within six hours. The start time is flexible from 10 a.m., and participants can enter individually or as part of a team. The course combines wide forest paths with idyllic singletrack trails and offers a challenging 46 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event places great emphasis on flexibility and fun, with an electronic lap counter and refreshments at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus.
course_highlights: 1.85 km lap through the forest near Saarbrücken
46 metres of elevation gain per lap; more than 1,000 metres over marathon distance
A mix of wide forest paths and idyllic singletrack trails
additional: Bib pickup is available on site from 9 a.m. Flexible start time from 10 a.m.; the finish closes at 4 p.m. Electronic lap counter and refreshment station at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus. The field is limited to 350 participants. Late registration is possible online or on site; the late-registration fee is payable on site. Team classification available; make sure the team name is spelled consistently. Six-hour race, 1.85 km lap, approximately 46 metres of elevation gain per lap, forest paths and singletrack trails, flexible start time from 10 a.m., finish at 4 p.m., online registration until the Friday before the event, participant limit of 350.

name: ADAC-Tine-Flugplatzlauf
description: The ADAC Tine Airfield Run in Husum is a unique running event held on an actual airfield. The event is for the whole family and offers a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. Experience sporting ambition and a sense of community in the beautiful surroundings of Husum on the North Sea.
course_highlights: Run on an actual airfield
Family-friendly event
Beautiful North Sea surroundings in Husum
additional: Run on the Husum airfield, distances from 500 m to 10 km, family and children’s races, charitable support

name: Freystädter Volksfestlauf
price_range: Erwachsene: 10,00 Euro, Schüler: 5,00 Euro, Bambini: 4,00 Euro
description: The Freystädter Volksfestlauf is a traditional running event in Freystadt, Bavaria, held annually as part of the Freystädter Volksfest. The races start and finish at the town hall on the market square and offer various distances for adults, schoolchildren, and Bambini. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with awards for the best runners and teams as well as special categories. Changing rooms and showers are available at the TSV sports clubhouse, and the awards ceremonies take place in the festival tent or outdoors.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the town hall on the market square in Freystadt
Course routes can be viewed online in advance
Race distances for different age and ability groups
additional: Late entries are possible at the town hall until 1 hour before the respective start; a late entry fee of 3.00 euros applies. The awards ceremony for schoolchildren takes place at around 11:00 at the town hall, and the ceremony for adults and youth takes place from around 13:00 in the festival tent or outdoors. Changing rooms and showers are available at the TSV sports clubhouse, Allersberger-Straße 23, Freystadt. There are honorary prizes for the top finishers, certificates for places 1–3, and additional certificates available online. Special and team categories are also included. Courses for different age groups, online registration, awards ceremonies at the town hall and in the festival tent, changing rooms at the TSV sports clubhouse

name: 10K Hamburg - Elbe
description: The 10K Hamburg - Elbe is an exciting 10-kilometer race held at attractive spots in Hamburg, the city on the Elbe. The course follows fully closed and secured out-and-back routes on paved and asphalt paths. The race is open to runners of all ability levels and is officially measured in accordance with international competition regulations. The event is part of a cup series spanning several 10K Hamburg races, with attractive prizes.

name: 16. Campuslauf Technische Universität Braunschweig
description: The 16th Campus Run of Technische Universität Braunschweig takes place on May 31, 2026, on the university campus. The run gives students and staff the opportunity to get active and spend time together being active on university grounds. The event is part of the university sports program and promotes a sense of community and the health of participants.

name: 32. Tangerlauf
description: The 32nd Tanger Run in Tangerhütte is a traditional race through the Tanger lowlands, organized by SV Germania Tangerhütte. The course follows the River Tanger through the scenic Altmark countryside, which is especially beautiful in spring. The race has a long history dating back to the GDR era and was revived after reunification. The organizers wish all participants good weather and an enjoyable race.

name: 40. Göttinger Frühjahrs-Volkslauf
description: The 40th Göttingen Sparkassen Volkslauf takes place on 31 May 2026 at Jahnstadion Göttingen and offers a varied running program for runners of all ability levels. The event combines tradition and community, inviting both experienced runners and recreational joggers to enjoy an active day of fun and exercise. The distances are 2 km, 5.4 km and 10.8 km; unfortunately, the half marathon is not taking place this year. The event emphasizes health, well-being and community in the region.

name: 5. Urwaldsteig-Ultratrail
description: The Urwaldsteig Ultratrail is a challenging ultratrail race covering approximately 66 km with around 2,000 metres of elevation gain around Lake Edersee. Starting in Waldeck, the route runs counterclockwise through varied natural landscapes, including dense forests, narrow paths, the Kahle Haardt nature reserve and Kellerwald-Edersee National Park. Runners can look forward to impressive views of the lake, historic sites such as Hünselburg, and varied trail sections rich in natural beauty and memorable experiences. The start and finish are at the Schloss Waldeck car park, and the race begins at 8 a.m.

name: 9. Hellmich Parkhauslauf
description: The HELLMICH Parking Garage Run in Lehrte is a unique running event held in the Lehrte parking garage. Participants run a course of about 1 km through the garage, with the inclines and views of the city creating a special running experience. There are three different races with varying numbers of laps, suitable for both children and adults. Each race is limited to 50 participants to ensure safety, and every finisher receives a medal as a keepsake.

name: Erfurtshäuser Lauf
description: The Erfurtshausen Run is a traditional running event in Amöneburg-Erfurtshausen that welcomes runners of all ages. It offers various races, including Bambini, youth, fun run, and main race, as well as walking/Nordic walking. The course is marked, every kilometer is indicated, and refreshment stations are set up along the route. At the finish, the organizer provides food and drink for participants. Times are recorded electronically, with stopwatches as a backup, and certificates can be issued on request.

name: Wandermarathon TSV Bollensen
description: The TSV Bollensen Hiking Marathon warmly invites all fans of recreational sports to enjoy a pleasant hike through the beautiful Solling Vogler forest. The routes are circuits starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports center and run exclusively along forest trails. In 2022, the region was awarded the “Wanderbares Deutschland” quality designation. Refreshment stations along the route, as well as food and drinks at the finish, are provided. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and a relaxed get-together after the hike.

name: Nekořský kros
description: Nekoř Cross-Country Race is a traditional running race held in Nekoř, Pardubice Region, and is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The routes follow varied terrain along forest paths and meadows, with some sections on asphalt, making for an interesting and varied running experience. The start and finish are by the ice rink in Nekoř, where registration also takes place. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, including young people, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and practical prizes for winners in the individual categories.

name: Běh mezi náměstími
description: Běh mezi náměstími is a traditional running race held at Svobody Square in Frýdek-Místek, attracting a wide range of participants, from children to adults. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere, beautiful weather, and the chance to compete on a course that runs to Zámecké Square and back. Special races are prepared for children, with medals, prizes, and refreshments, while adults run the main course, approximately 4.7 km long. Winners and all participants take home not only prizes, but also the joy of exercise and socializing.

name: Chodsko Grand Prix
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeň Region, Czech Republic
description: Chodsko Grand Prix is a 9.6 km race with 130 meters of elevation gain, running mostly on roads from the village of Klenčí pod Čerchovem to Hrádek Hill. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska competition and offers runners an interesting route with a gentle climb. It is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in the picturesque Plzeň Region.

name: Festivalový půlmaraton MONET+ Zlín 2026
description: The MONET+ Zlín Festival Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.097 km road race open to the public, with no club membership required. The race takes place on the streets of Zlín, starting near the Zlín Congress Centre, and also offers other options, including a quarter marathon, relays and a 5 km run. The programme also includes a 1,400-metre Family Run. Part of Zlín’s festival programme, the event offers a unique atmosphere and the chance to run alongside well-known personalities.

name: Zahořanská 10 (Běh okolo Pleše)
description: BOS Zahořanská 10 is a traditional running race organized by SK Zahořany under the auspices of the municipality of Zahořany. The eighth edition will take place on May 31, 2026, and features a 10.2 km main race for men and women with 250 m of elevation gain on forest trails around Zahořany and Pleš. There is also a 5.5 km fun run and children’s races of various distances. Timing and results are provided by the 4Timing agency using chip technology. Registration is available online and on site, with different price categories for adults, juniors, and children.

name: Maraton a půlmaraton okolo Hracholuské přehrady
description: The Marathon and Half Marathon around Hracholusky Reservoir is a race held on May 31, 2026, offering a beautiful natural loop around the reservoir. The route runs mostly on paved paths along the water, with a few short sections of natural terrain, giving it a slightly trail-like feel without unnecessary difficulty. A standout experience is crossing the Pňovany Bridge, with breathtaking views of the reservoir and surrounding landscape. The race loop is 21.1 km long—the exact half-marathon distance—and is suitable for runners seeking a combination of beautiful scenery, a motivating atmosphere, and a pleasant course profile.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Lesná
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Lesná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km, an adventure route covers 20 to 30 km, and children’s races are also held. The routes are suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers, offering a varied sporting challenge for all age groups. The series is organized by Živé Sokolovsko z.s. and Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. in cooperation with local municipalities.

name: Mezinárodní běh Měška a Doubravky
description: The International Měšek and Doubravka Run is a summer race for adults covering 12.5 km. It starts in Mirošov and finishes at AQA Land swimming pool in Meziměstí. The race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix and follows the picturesque landscape of the Polish-Czech border region, through meadows and forests. The start is at the amphitheatre on Parkowa Hill at 11:00; the finish and awards ceremony take place at the swimming pool. Free bus transport from Meziměstí to Mieroszów is provided for Czech competitors. Registration is free and available online or at the venue on race day.

name: Beh Rajeckým rínkom
description: The Run Around Rajec Square is a traditional running race organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. The race gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty and surroundings of Rajec on a May day. The event is suitable for the general public, including children and minors, who must have the consent of a legal guardian. The organizers emphasize safety and thorough preparation for participants.

name: Beh na Zniev
location: Kláštor pod Znievom okr. Martin, Kláštor pod Znievom okr. Martin, areál bývalého Prvého slovenského gymnázia
description: Beh na Zniev is a championship uphill race held in Kláštor pod Znievom, offering a challenging 5,650-metre course with 475 metres of elevation gain. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from children to veterans, including men, women, juniors and youth. The main race starts at 14:00 in the grounds of the former grammar school. The organizers are the Kláštor pod Znievom Municipal Office, Strive sport, TRIMAT and the Slovak Athletics Association. The race is part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup.

name: Pivovarsko-hradná sedemtisícovka
location: Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, areál TJ Slavoj V. Šariš
description: The Brewery-Castle Seven-Thousander is a running event organized by the town of Veľký Šariš in cooperation with Šariš Brewery and the Sports Commission of the Municipal Council in Veľký Šariš. The race takes place at the TJ Slavoj Veľký Šariš grounds and offers categories for various age groups, as well as Nordic walking. The start is scheduled for 15:00 for the run and 15:05 for Nordic walking. The event is suitable for the general public, including adolescents, juniors, and women and men in various age categories.

name: Beh rajeckým rínkom
location: Rajec, Žilina District, Žilina Region, Slovakia

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Zadní Třebaň
description: The Berounka Running Series in Zadní Třebaň is a scenic race held amid the beautiful countryside of the Central Bohemian Region. The route follows the Berounka River, crosses meadows with panoramic views, passes the Liteň nature trail, and winds through picturesque countryside reminiscent of Tuscany. The race culminates with a climb to the course’s highest point in Doubce, followed by a final descent to the finish at a pleasant campsite with refreshments. Every participant receives a race number, and the top three in each category receive diplomas and medals.

name: Běh Advenťáka PLZEŇ
location: Krašovské Activity Centre, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Běh Advenťáka Plzeň 2026 is a charity run held in support of people who are facing difficulties in life. The race takes place on June 2, 2026, at the Krašovské Activity Center and offers a 6.45 km course along paved paths around Krkavec. Children’s categories with shorter courses are also available. Participants receive a race bib, a certificate with their time, a gingerbread cookie, and other gifts. Part of the entry fee goes to support heroes.

name: Münsteraner Urban Run
location: Innenstadt Münster, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld beträgt 19,00 Euro inklusive hochwertigem Laufshirt

description: The 1KOMMA5° Urban Run on June 3, 2026, is a special run through Münster’s city centre, taking place for the third time. The approximately 5-kilometre course passes through several notable buildings, including the city administration, the LWL Museum of Art and Culture, and the youth church, as well as familiar landmarks such as Prinzipalmarkt and Domplatz. This is not a timed race, but a shared experience at a relaxed jogging pace with running guides. The event combines fun, culture, and exercise and is open to runners aged 16 and over. Participation is limited to 1,000 people, and the entry fee includes a high-quality running shirt.
course_highlights: Approximately 5-kilometre loop through the city centre, including several municipal buildings
Past historic landmarks such as Prinzipalmarkt, St. Lamberti Church, and Domplatz
Along the Promenade, Münster’s green belt in the heart of the city centre
additional: This is not a timed race and will be run in several groups with running guides. The minimum age is 16. There are no changing facilities at the start/finish area. The entry fee includes a high-quality running shirt, which will be distributed in the start area from 17:30. Participation is limited to 1,000 people. Registration filled up quickly, and the waiting list is also closed. The course passes through buildings and attractions in Münster. There are no changing facilities; bag storage is limited. The run is not timed, and the minimum age is 16.

name: Crosslauf Offene Kreismeisterschaften 2026
location: Sportplatz Rote Wiese, Wangelnstedt, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Open District Cross-Country Championships in Braunschweig are a traditional competition organized by NLV Kreis Braunschweig. The event takes place on February 7, 2026, at the Rote Wiese sports field and gives runners in various age groups the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The event is open to children, youths, senior athletes, and masters, and promotes regional running in a varied cross-country setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country running at the Rote Wiese sports field in Braunschweig
A wide range of age groups, from children to masters
Traditional district championships with regional significance
additional: Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. The event offers a great opportunity to compete against other runners and improve your performance in a sporting setting.

name: Krčská 12
location: Velký altán, Kunratický les, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Krčská 12 is a traditional running race organized by the Sabzo Praha running club in Krčský Forest. The race is run on asphalt and features a 12.5 km course consisting of four loops. The start is at the Great Gazebo in Kunratice, usually in the early evening. The event is part of the regular sports and entertainment program in Nové Roztyly Park, which is also suitable for families with children.

name: Běh Advenťáka Praha
description: Běh Advenťáka Prague 2026 is a charity running race taking place on June 3 in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague. The race offers a 6.45 km course on paved paths, suitable for trail shoes, as well as children’s categories with shorter courses. The event combines the joy of running with support for people facing difficulties in life, and participants contribute to a good cause. It also includes activities for children and facilities with refreshments and a cloakroom. The race is part of the Běh Advenťáka series, held in several cities.

name: Štafeta 4 × 5 km v Braníku 2026
description: The 4 × 5 km Relay in Braník is a team running race taking place on June 3, 2026, on the cycle path in Braník, Prague. The race is for teams of four runners, each of whom runs a 5 km loop. The event offers a chance to enjoy a team atmosphere, cheer each other on, and celebrate after the race at the Hamr Braník venue. The course follows cycle path A2 along the Vltava and is suitable for a wide range of runners, with a time limit of 2 hours and 20 minutes for the entire race.

name: Okolo Peperku
location: Najdek, Hamry. Za mostkem u hřiště, Vysočina
description: Žďárák - Around Peperk is a cross-country race with mostly off-road terrain, held in the picturesque Vysočina region in the village of Najdek, Hamry. The 7 km course consists of 85% trails and 15% asphalt, with 180 metres of elevation gain, making for an interesting and challenging route. The race starts on 3 June 2026 at 17:00 by the small bridge near the sports field and is organised by SK Žďárák. This race is ideal for trail-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in nature.

name: Pohár města Třemošnice
description: The O pohár starosty města Třemošnice fire sport competition is a traditional sporting event held in Třemošnice and is part of the Chrudim District League. Men’s and women’s teams compete, showcasing top-level performances in fire sport. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and plentiful refreshments for participants and fans. It is organized by the Třemošnice Volunteer Fire Brigade in cooperation with the town of Třemošnice. Everyone is welcome to the next edition, which will take place on June 3, 2026.

name: „Vilnius 5 in 5“ (1 diena)
organizer: VšĮ „Maratomanija“ ir VšĮ “100 marathon club Lithuania”
description: “Vilnius 5 in 5” is a unique five-day running challenge in Vilnius, where participants can complete five marathons, half marathons, 12.6 km or 4.2 km distances on consecutive days. The event encourages endurance, determination and returning to the course each day, offering the chance to experience a true stage-running adventure. It is the first event of its kind in Lithuania, inspired by a global tradition, and takes place at the Vingis Park bandstand. Participants can choose their distance and start time. The event is organized by VšĮ “Maratomanija” and VšĮ “100 marathon club Lithuania”.
course_highlights: Vingis Park bandstand in Vilnius
Option to choose a 9:00 or 15:00 start time on the first three days for the 4.2 km and 12.6 km distances
Five starts over five days, with different distances: marathon, half marathon, 12.6 km and 4.2 km
additional: Time limits: 8 hours for the marathon, 4 hours for the half marathon, 3 hours for 12.6 km and 1 hour for 4.2 km. The course GPX file is available online. Participants must bring an identity document to collect their race number. Parents, guardians or coaches are responsible for minors. There will be a refreshment station on the course during the event. Participants agree that their photos and video footage may be used for marketing purposes. A multi-day run on courses in Vilnius’s Vingis Park, with various distances; registration and a health check are required.

name: Wydminy Night Run 5K
