description: Wydminy Night Run 5K is a night race held on Wydmińska Island in Wydminy. The event attracts runners who want to take on a 5-kilometer course in picturesque surroundings. The race combines recreation and sport, offering a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers promise a unique atmosphere and unforgettable experiences during the night run.

name: III Ryszewkowy Bieg o Puchar Strażaka
Berliner Wasserbetriebe 5x5 km TEAM-Staffel
description: The Berliner Wasserbetriebe 5 x 5 km TEAM-Staffel is a unique relay race in Berlin’s Tiergarten, putting team spirit and shared experiences at the heart of the event. Five team members each run 5 km on a scenic course between the Victory Column and the Federal Chancellery. The event is ideal for anyone who wants to take on athletic challenges together and have fun, regardless of ability level. The exchange zone in the start-finish area is a lively gathering place full of motivation and emotion. After the race, all participants receive a special medal symbolizing team unity.

name: Sonnefelder Wald-Cross-Lauf
description: The 5th Sonnefeld Forest Cross-Country Run takes place on June 4, 2026, in Sonnefeld and offers runners of all ability levels an appealing event in scenic surroundings, on country and forest trails. There is an 8.3 km main race with 110 meters of elevation gain, a Nordic walking event on the same course, and a 1.7 km youth race. The event is open to ambitious runners, Nordic walkers, and young athletes, and is conducted in accordance with official athletics regulations. Refreshments, showers, and changing facilities are provided, and all finishers receive a medal.

name: Volkslauf Wacker Frohnhausen
description: The Wacker Frohnhausen Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Gladenbach-Frohnhausen, organized annually by SV Wacker Frohnhausen. The races run around Donnerberg and offer routes for different ability levels. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and involvement of the local community. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with varied routes.

name: 3. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro zdraví is a charitable running series organized by the TJ Jäkl Karviná athletics club in the beautiful setting of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run is 3 km long and is suitable for anyone who wants to do something for their health while supporting people in need, as the proceeds from entry fees are donated to help those in need. The event is friendly and open to the general public, with participants free to run at any pace. Registration begins at 17:00 and the start is at 17:45. Everyone is warmly invited to take part in this regular sporting event.
course_highlights: A 3 km route in the beautiful setting of Božena Němcová Park
The route follows a cycle path suitable for running
A charity run with proceeds going to help people in need
additional: Registration begins at 17:00, with the start at 17:45 at Lodičky in Božena Němcová Park. A series of seven runs for health, where everyone can run the route at any pace. Charity run; proceeds from entry fees go to help people in need.

name: Běh na Vysoký vrch
description: The Run to Vysoký vrch is a mountain race to the highest hill in the Kladno region. It offers a challenging but short run, with 200 metres of elevation gain over a route approximately 2.8 km long. The race is divided into age and gender categories, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place in Malé Kyšice and is organised by TJ Sokol Unhošť. The race is scheduled to start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for both runners and spectators.

name: Rozkvetlá Kaštanka
description: Rozkvetlá Kaštanka is a popular running race held in Lhota, Central Bohemian Region, traditionally in June. The race features a 7.5 km route along paved roads and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and the atmosphere of spring, when the surrounding area bursts into bloom with gorgeous chestnut blossoms. The race is suitable for runners of all abilities and is a welcome opportunity to meet the local running community.

name: Heider Abend-Stadtlauf
description: The Heider Evening City Run is a long-standing race in Heide, organized by MTV von 1860 e.V. Heide. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to compete on an attractive route through the city. The race is known for its welcoming atmosphere and the support of the local sports club. The course is well marked and offers a varied running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Heide.

name: Saalfelder Bambini-Schloßparklauf
distance_verbose: 13.5 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 2 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km
organizer: Saalfelder Leichtathletik-Verein e.V. und Thüringer Leichtathletik Verband e.V.
description: The Saalfeld Bambini Castle Park Run is a traditional children’s race taking place on June 5, 2026, from 5:00 p.m. in the castle park in Saalfeld. The event is for children born between 2017 and 2023, who run one or two laps depending on their age. Organized by Saalfelder Leichtathletik-Verein e.V., the race offers a child-friendly atmosphere for the youngest runners. Registration is available online, at the start, or by phone.

name: Spargellauf
description: The WERNER Asparagus Run in Deinste is a 5.5 km relay race held annually, celebrating its 20th anniversary in 2026. Teams of five run together through the asparagus fields, using an asparagus spear as the baton. The race is suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to professionals, and the focus is on fun, as the winning team is selected by drawing lots. In addition to the race, there is a food mile featuring regional specialties and a family program with a bouncy castle and other attractions. A special race shirt will be offered for the anniversary, and a big after-show party will take place.

name: Stapelmoorer Run-Fun-Loop
description: The Stapelmoorer Run Fun Loop is a 10 km DLV-measured race that starts and finishes at the Teutonia Stapelmoor sports field. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Stapelmoor, with sections along farm tracks, school routes, and village streets. The event is part of the Teutonia Stapelmoor running community and offers runners a well-organized, varied course in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Warnemünder Stapellauf
description: The Warnemünder Stapellauf is a small running event held in June in Rostock, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Germany. It offers short distances of 555 meters and 9.3 kilometers, ideal for runners looking for a straightforward race experience. The courses have local nautical names that reflect Warnemünde’s coastal identity, including the 5 Seemeilen-Lauf (9 km) and the 3 Seemeilen-Lauf (6 km). Results are managed via my.race|result, and the event is listed in the laufen.de calendar.

name: Kolem Trpaslíka v Hybrálci
description: The Kolem Trpaslíka race in Hybrálec is a 10 km running race that runs mostly along unpaved forest paths in the Hybrálec area near Jihlava. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and offers runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural terrain of the Vysočina region. The course is suitable for fans of forest running and a pleasant sporting experience in nature.

name: Valašské kilo
description: Valašské Kilo is a challenging 100 km ultramarathon through the beautiful, hilly landscape of Valašsko, with at least 3,500 metres of elevation gain. The race challenges not only experienced athletes but also those who want to push their limits and experience an off-road adventure. After the mass start at 22:00, runners plan their own routes between checkpoints within the 30-hour time limit. Race headquarters are at Žerotínova Elementary School in Valašské Meziříčí, where a gym, showers and a dining hall are available. Valašské Kilo offers the freedom to navigate the terrain and is one of the best ultramarathons in Czechia.

name: Ultramaraton Babia Góra
description: Ultramaraton Babia Góra is a prestigious mountain race taking place on June 6, 2026, in Lipnica Wielka. The event features various distances, including multi-lap ultramarathons around Babia Góra and shorter races such as SkyRace®. The course runs through the scenic landscapes of Babia Góra National Park, offering challenging climbs and spectacular views. The event promotes an active lifestyle and supports the charitable work of the Rak’n’Roll Foundation. The organizer provides aid stations, medical support, and the option to have drop bags delivered to the course for the longest distances.

name: 12. Tarczyński Nocny Wrocław Półmaraton
description: The 12th Tarczyński Night Wrocław Half Marathon is one of Wrocław’s most important sporting events and will take place on June 6, 2026. Runners will follow a new, wide and safe course starting and finishing at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. The half marathon symbolizes activity, health and the city’s openness, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad, as well as numerous spectators. The event aims to join the ranks of Europe’s largest half marathons, offering a record 21,975 race packages—a number that references the race distance.

name: II Półmaraton Miasteczkowskich Lasów
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Góra Jerzego w Miasteczku Śląskim
description: The 2nd Miasteczko Forests Half Marathon is organized by the Góra Jerzego Association in Miasteczko Śląskie and will take place on June 6, 2026. The half-marathon course is approximately 21.5 km long and runs through the town’s streets, the Świerklaniec Forest District, and the Tarnowskie Góry municipality. The start and finish are at the stadium by the Sports and Recreation Centre, making it easy for spectators to follow the race. The event will also include a 5 km run and races for children over various distances, promoting physical activity in the local community.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
description: Poznań Beer Mile is an annual cross-country race held in Poznań, attracting runners who value scenic routes and a sporty atmosphere. The event is part of a series of races organized by enthusiasts from the Greater Poland region, who have been promoting running and the beauty of local areas since 2014. The race is divided into start groups with participant limits, ensuring a comfortable experience and smooth organization. Special emphasis is placed on the scenic qualities of the route and bringing runners together.

name: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk Bieg Szlakiem Schronów Bojowych SGO "Narew"
description: The Kurpie Pśejåk Half Marathon is a run along the route of the SGO “Narew” combat bunkers in Nowogród. The half-marathon course passes through historic areas dotted with combat bunkers, giving the race a distinctive character and combining sport with history. The event attracts runners who appreciate both off-road challenges and the atmosphere of the Kurpie region. It’s an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and learn about local history.

name: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84
description: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84 is a race held in Wieluń and part of the Running League, a platform promoting physical activity and running competition in Poland. The event is open to runners competing at various distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon. The Running League allows participants to earn points and compete in numerous rankings throughout the year, encouraging regular running and athletic development. The race is open and inclusive, welcoming both recreational and more experienced runners.

name: Kwietny Bieg
description: The Flower Run in Lisowice is a unique 24-hour relay race that commemorates the spirit of freedom awakened by the Holy Father John Paul II during his first pilgrimage to Poland. The race takes place on a certified 1,352-meter loop, which is clearly marked and illuminated after dark. The event is open to everyone and is growing in popularity, attracting a record number of participants. Everyone who completes the distance of 10 Flower Miles (35.3 km) receives a certificate and commemorative medal. It is not only an athletic competition, but also a community event with an atmosphere full of positive energy.

name: MnO Jaszczur i Czerwony Most
description: The "Jaszczur i Czerwony Most" Orienteering Marathon is an event organized by Zgromadzenie Wędrownicze in Koszalin. It is an orienteering race that combines sporting competition with adventure and exploration. Participants can test their navigation skills and physical fitness in scenic surroundings. The event is open and welcoming to people of different ages and experience levels.

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique road race set in the magical surroundings of Toruń, the city of Copernicus. Participants can choose from the 10 km and 5 km distances, as well as Nordic walking, and there is also a special race for children, “Odkrywcy Mocy” (“Power Explorers”). The event takes place at night, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and appeal. The start and finish are located in the city center, and the organizers provide full logistical support and attractive race packages.

name: Sudecki Festiwal Biegów Gorskich
description: The Sudetes Mountain Running Festival continues the Riese Trail Runs in a new format, set in the picturesque area around Głuszyca. The festival offers three distances: Sudecki Olbrzym (43 km), Riese Trail Half Marathon (22 km), and Historic Ten (10 km), with routes available in GPX format. The event attracts mountain running enthusiasts with challenging yet beautiful routes in the Sudetes. The organizer provides professional support and rankings in the international ITRA and UTMB Index systems.

name: XII Festiwal Biegu Rzeźnika
description: The 12th Rzeźnik Run Festival will take place from June 3–6, 2026, in Cisna. This unique running event in the Bieszczady Mountains offers a wide range of distances, from 5 km to an extreme 500 km, including ultraruns, marathons, and children’s races. The routes pass through the picturesque mountain landscapes of the Beskids, offering unforgettable views and challenges for runners of varying experience levels. The festival is also an opportunity to take part in hiking and cycling events, as well as other accompanying activities.

name: 19. Lauf zwischen den Meeren
description: The Lauf zwischen den Meeren is a unique relay race that takes participants as a team along a 92.2-kilometre course from Husum on the North Sea to Damp on the Baltic Sea. The route crosses Schleswig-Holstein and connects the coasts of the two seas, with up to ten athletes per team running together. The race promotes both individual performance and a sense of community, attracting up to 800 teams from recreational and elite sports. The fastest relay teams take around 5 hours and 10 minutes and reach the finish at approximately 14:15.
course_highlights: 92.2-kilometre route from Husum to Damp
10 varied stages ranging in distance from 6.9 to 11.5 kilometres
The route passes through flat North Frisia, historic towns, along the Schlei and through the terminal moraine landscape of Schwansen
additional: The entry fee is per team (5–10 runners). Teams entering the corporate category pay an additional 19% VAT. Race packs can be sent by post (the shipping option can be booked until 31.03.2026) or collected at one of two collection times (22 May, 10:00–18:00; 29 May, 13:00–20:00). The race starts at the Hafenspitze in Husum and is organised by LAV Husum. The route includes 10 changeover points and is temporarily closed at level crossings. Relay marathon, registration opens on 13 June 2025, various stages, team and individual participation, refreshments and accommodation on site

name: 3. Abend-Kanallauf Rethmar
location: Sportgelände des MTV Rethmar, Sehnde, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: MTV Rethmar von 1900 e.V. - Sparte Laufen
description: The 3rd Evening Canal Run Rethmar 2026 is a varied running event at the MTV Rethmar sports grounds in Sehnde. Distances range from 400 m for Bambini runners to the Kalimandscharo Half Marathon over 21.1 km. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured and eligible for rankings, with a slight cross-country character. The event takes place in all weather and is open to runners of all ages, whether or not they belong to a club.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km and 10 km courses with a slight cross-country character
Kalimandscharo Half Marathon course over 21.1 km
A range of distances from the 400 m Bambini run to the half marathon
additional: The €3.00 late-entry fee does not apply to the 400 m and 1,500 m events for all U18 age groups. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured and eligible for rankings. The event takes place in all weather. Age groups are determined in accordance with the DLO. Measured courses, cross-country character, online registration, results published after the race, participation in all weather, various age groups

name: Lingelbacher Windmühlenlauf
description: The Lingelbach Windmill Run is a long-standing running event in Lingelbach near Alsfeld, taking place for the 21st time in 2026. The run is organized by TSV Lingelbach 1925 e.V. and offers various race distances for children, school students, and adults. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and scenic course around Lingelbach. Entry fees are paid in cash at the race-number collection.
course_highlights: Various distances (700 m, 5.3 km, 10 km)
Hilly routes offering a sporting challenge
Suitable for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers
additional: The entry fee must be paid in cash at race-number collection. The event takes place in June, with typical temperatures of around 23°C; there are various categories, including children’s races and walking. Cash payment is available on site.

name: Silberberglauf
price_range: regulärer Preis bis 01.06.2026, Last Minute bis 05.06.2026, vor Ort ab 08:30 Uhr

description: The 41st Silberberglauf on 6 June 2026 offers runners and walkers varied routes around the Silberberg near Ilmenau. With distances of 21.1 km, 11 km and 6 km, as well as children’s races over 2.5 km and 0.6 km, there is something for all ages and ability levels. The event is part of the Sparkassencup Saalfeld-Rudolstadt and the TLV-Cup, and promises a lively sporting atmosphere with refreshments, medals and award ceremonies. The children’s sports festival in the afternoon makes the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: Half marathon with approximately 600 metres of elevation gain
11 km route with approximately 250 metres of elevation gain and a Nordic walking category
Children’s races and children’s sports festival in the afternoon
additional: Race number collection on race day from 07:30 to 08:45 for the main races; children’s race numbers from 14:00. Last-minute registration on site until 08:30 for the main races and until 14:40 for the children’s races. Refreshments along the routes and at the sports ground, changing facilities, toilets, finisher medals and certificates. Carrying poles is compulsory on the 11 km route; running is prohibited. Baby joggers, dogs and bicycle accompaniment are not permitted for safety reasons. The finish closes for all routes at 13:00. Trail terrain, online registration via Race Result, safety rules concerning equipment, participation in multiple cups

name: Wolfhager Volkslauf Rund um den Graner Berg
2. Jenaer Backyard Ultra
description: The 2nd Jena Backyard Ultra is a unique “Last Human Standing” race in Jena-Cospeda, Thuringia. All participants start together every hour on a 6.7 km loop, which they must complete within one hour. Anyone who fails to complete the loop or gives up is eliminated. The race ends when only one runner remains who completes the loop within the time limit. In addition to the individual competition, there is a team competition for teams of up to three participants, with the team that completes the most loops over the course of the event winning.

name: 41. Internationaler Sollinglauf
organizer: Laufgruppe des Dasseler Sport-Clubs von 1920 e.V.
description: The 41st International Solling Run takes place on June 6, 2026, in the Solling region near Dassel. The event offers a range of distances from 400 m to the 42.5 km Leaders Akademie Solling Marathon. The routes pass through the varied landscape of the Solling and offer suitable options for both competitive and recreational runners, as well as walkers. The event is organized by Dasseler Sport-Club von 1920 e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and attractive prize money.

name: Below- Gedenk- und Heidelauf
description: The Below Memorial and Heath Run is a traditional race through the Wittstock Heath and forest, held annually by LC Dosse Wittstock e.V. The 8.5 km course is open to women, men and young people and offers varied natural scenery. In addition to the main race, there are classifications for young people and schoolchildren, as well as a school cup classification. The event is part of the Brandenburg Cup and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with trophies for the overall winners and certificates for all participants.

name: Finkenwerder Insellauf (mit HH-Meisterschaften 5 km)
description: The Finkenwerder Island Run takes place on June 6, 2026, in Finkenwerder, Hamburg, and offers a varied program of running events for all age groups. The main races follow an accurately measured, flat 5 km loop through green oases and along the Elbe, ideal for fast times and the Hamburg 5 km Championships. In addition to the main distances, there are age-appropriate races for children and young people, as well as relay and walking events. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, its start and finish right at Finkenwerder Market Square, and its sustainable approach, including reusable cups and recycled medals.

name: Hahnenkammlauf
description: The Hahnenkamm Run in Edelsfeld is an idyllic forest run, taking place for the 23rd time in 2026. The event is open to runners of all ages, from children to experienced athletes, and offers varied routes around the sports grounds at Hahnenkamm. The course has been adjusted due to renovations to the sports field. The run is part of the Amberg-Sulzbach District Cup and motivates around 250 participants each year to achieve sporting success in a natural setting.

name: Oranienburger Stundenlauf
description: The Oranienburg Hour Run is a varied track running competition behind Oranienburg Palace. The event offers various races with time limits of 15, 30 and 60 minutes, as well as a 400-metre children’s race and Nordic walking. Races are divided by age group and gender, and all laps completed within the time limit count. Every finisher receives a medal, and certificates and awards ceremonies are provided for the top runners.

name: Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow LC/NLC
description: The Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow is a traditional running event taking place on June 6, 2026, in Güstrow, Germany. The event is organized by Tri Fun Güstrow e. V. and offers various distances for different age groups. The main event is a 10 km race for runners in the U20 age group and older, supplemented by shorter races for young people and children. The 48th edition of this local event takes place at the Badestrand InselseeHeidberg and promises a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany’s first beach marathon and takes place on June 6, 2026, on the island of Usedom. The races run exclusively on sand along the Baltic Sea beach, with no asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique experience of nature and running right by the sea. Participants can choose from the marathon, half marathon, 10 km short distance, or marathon relay. The event combines a sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional supporting program in the finish area in Ahlbeck.

name: Volkslauf des MTV Soltau powered by Stadtwerke Soltau
Wremer Deichlauf
description: The Wremen Dike Run is the traditional highlight of TuS Wremen 09’s sports season and warmly welcomes all running enthusiasts. Two distances are offered: a short 5,300-meter loop and a long 15,900-meter course through the green marshland. The routes run mostly along paved cycling and farm roads and also pass outside the dike, directly alongside the water and tidal flats. The short loop also features a separate walking event.

name: Čertovskej Trail

tiers.description: Startovné stejné pro obě trasy: 1 222 Kč

description: Čertovskej Ultratrail is a challenging trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of the mysterious Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj regions. It offers a main 66.6 km route that is also suitable for beginner ultrarunners thanks to well-stocked aid stations and a friendly atmosphere. A shorter 33.3 km course, called Letní půlčert, is also available. The race is part of the prestigious Ultracup series and offers ITRA points to runners. Capacity is limited, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: A trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj
Well-stocked aid stations along the course
Scenic countryside and a family-friendly race atmosphere
additional: A personal drinking cup is mandatory equipment. You can order one during registration, along with a Čertovskej cup, T-shirt or socks. Race capacity is limited. Categories are available for individuals and relay teams, including a family relay with a child under 15. The route is marked with ribbons and arrows. The time limit for the Čertovskej Wintertrail is 7 hours. Post-race refreshments are provided at the finish, including soup, a main course and drinks. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races and ITRA National League. A personal cup is mandatory at the aid stations. A running cup, T-shirt or socks can be ordered during registration.

name: Jesenická šedesátka
description: Jesenická šedesátka is a hiking and running event along the ridges of the Hrubý Jeseník Mountains, offering beautiful natural surroundings and the chance to test yourself against the clock. The 60 km route is intended for more experienced participants aged 16 and over and includes refreshment stations. The event is a long-standing favourite, with chip timing and results announced at the finish. The organizers emphasize safety and a relaxed atmosphere, and the event is suitable for both runners and hikers.

name: Čertovskej ultratrail
description: Čertovskej Ultraltrail is a trail race across mountains, mines, castles and waters through the mysterious countryside of Kokořínsko and the Máchův kraj region. It offers a main 66.6 km route through beautiful scenery, with well-stocked aid stations, and is suitable for beginner ultrarunners too. The race is part of the Ultracup series and is also the final stage of the 8-day Čertovská výzva 666 km. The atmosphere is family-friendly, and runners will enjoy unforgettable experiences on the picturesque course.

name: Běh Zelenským údolím
location: Přírodní park Zelenov, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic

name: Skřipovská lítačka
description: Skřipovská lítačka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of fields, meadows, and forests around the village of Skřipov near Opava. The seventh edition will take place on June 6, 2026, with its hub at the TJ Sokol Skřipov football field. The race offers courses for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, along with a varied accompanying program including an inflatable maze, face painting, and refreshments. All courses are clearly marked, and volunteers at intersections point runners in the right direction. The event is organized by Běžecký klub Skřipov, z. s.

name: Happy run
description: Happy Run is a charity run held on June 6, 2026, in Studenec u Třebíče in the Vysočina Region. It is open to everyone—athletes and non-athletes, families with children, and individuals—with several routes to choose from to suit their abilities. The event supports Viktorka, a boy with serious health complications, and the proceeds from the run will go toward his rehabilitation stay. In addition to the run itself, there will be a varied programme of activities and an evening social party.

name: Běh napříč republikou
location: Česko (867 km po celé republice), Vysočina
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event, now taking place for the fifth year. Participants run together from different parts of the Czech Republic to its geographical center in Čihošť, at a pace suited to recreational runners and comfortable for conversation. The routes are divided into individual sections, with pacers who help maintain the right pace and follow the route. This is not a race, but a shared experience that offers a chance to discover new places and meet other runners.

name: Z Hejnic do Pekla
description: Z Hejnic do Pekla 2026 is the second edition of a running race held in the Liberec Region, starting at the Hejnice Skatepark. The race offers a welcoming atmosphere, refreshments, medical support, and a race packet for every participant. It is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and seniors, who receive special entry fee conditions. The organizers prioritize runners’ comfort, providing changing rooms, showers, and luggage storage.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S01 – Machnín-Výpřež
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique event that is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace. In 2026, it will take place for the fifth time, with four parallel routes heading from different parts of the Czech Republic (including a route from Liberec-Machnín) to the country’s geographical center in Čihošť. The run follows a precise schedule, with pacers on every section to set the pace and guide the route. Participants can choose how many sections they want to run, and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S02 – Výpřež-Rašovka
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event taking place for the fifth time. It brings together four starts from different corners of the Czech Republic, all heading to the country’s geographical center in Čihošť. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on each section responsible for the pace and route guidance. Participants can choose any number of sections to run, and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape. The event is suitable for recreational runners and offers a chance to discover new places and meet like-minded people.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S11 – Ledce-Loučeň
description: Run Across the Republic, S11 - Ledce-Loučeň is a planned running race taking place on June 6, 2026, in the area around Ledce and Loučeň in the Central Bohemian Region. Exact details about the course, distance, or registration are not available in the sources, but the race is part of a broader concept of running or hiking events in the Czech Republic. It offers runners and hikers an opportunity to discover the region’s beauty and enjoy active recreation outdoors.

name: Běh na Kohout a zpět
description: Běh na Kohout is a traditional uphill race that has been held since 2006 in Besednice, by the swimming pool. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup, and most editions follow the same course, making it possible to compare times. The start and finish are at the swimming pool in Besednice, which offers excellent facilities. Each year, there is an accompanying programme and a raffle with attractive prizes. The race will take place on Saturday, June 6, 2026, and welcomes runners in all categories.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Ústí nad Labem
description: Barvám Neutečeš in Ústí nad Labem is a colorful run full of joy, friendship, and fun, taking place on June 6, 2026, in the Severní Terasa district. Participants can choose between a 5 km route with five color zones or a shorter 1.5 km route with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about sharing the experience, enjoying bursts of color, and soaking up a great atmosphere for all ages. Race packs include a T-shirt, colors, a medal, and other accessories that add to the event’s unique character. Come with family or friends, or on your own, and enjoy a day full of color and fun.

name: Běh na Čerchov
description: The Run to Čerchov is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series, which offers runners a range of routes around the Chodsko region. It is suitable for all running enthusiasts looking to experience a challenging yet beautiful run in nature, with views of Čerchov. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Běh okolo Hostěnic
description: The Run Around Hostěnice is a running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Hostěnice. It offers a flat 5.83 km course combining paved and forest paths. The race takes place on Saturday, June 6, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. and is suitable for the general public, including children, who have a shorter course tailored to their age. Organizers David Šálek and Jan Řebíček warmly invite all runners to take part in this traditional event.

name: 5, 10, 21 km trail okolo hory pro každého
description: The Trail Running Cup is a traditional series of trail races with a history dating back to 2011, offering courses of various distances from 5 to 50 kilometers amid the beautiful scenery of the Czech Republic. The races are suitable for all runners, including children, and provide great entertainment for the whole family. The series features a variety of terrain and difficulty levels, so everyone can find a course to suit them. The overall standings are based on points awarded for results in individual races held throughout the season.

name: Běh dobroučským krajem
description: The Běh dobroučským krajem is a traditional running race organized by the ISCAREX Athletics Club in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Dobrouč in the Pardubice Region. The race offers technically interesting courses with gentle undulations and a number of turns, running along paved paths. The event is open to the general public and welcomes experienced runners, recreational athletes, and families with children. It is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and offers a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for runners and spectators alike.

name: Běháme pro radost - Help4Africa
description: Běháme pro radost is a traditional charity run held in the village of Smidary, celebrating its 10th edition in 2026. The event supports children’s projects in Africa through the organization Help4Africa, founded by Marcel Doubrava. The run combines physical activity with helping children in need, and participants can see the direct impact of their support through photographs from the projects. It is not only a sporting event, but also an opportunity to find joy in helping others.

name: Kounovský kros
description: Kounovský kros is a running race organized by TriClub Dobruška, held in the picturesque surroundings of Kounov near Dobruška in the Hradec Králové Region. The race is part of the Dobruška Cup and offers a sporting experience for the general public, including amateur runners. TriClub Dobruška is known for its long-standing tradition and for actively involving its members and the public in sporting events. The race is suitable for all age groups and levels of running ability.

name: Řepočetův výběh
description: Řepočetův výběh is a unique sporting and social event in Rokytnice nad Jizerou, taking place on June 6, 2026, at the open-air theatre grounds in Horní Rokytnice. The race offers two routes: 19.1 km with 650 m of elevation gain for Řepáci and 12 km with 400 m of elevation gain for Dumliky. The event supports the Run for the Memory of the Nation initiative and offers original race bibs, with the option to donate to the nonprofit organization Post Bellum. The race starts at 14:00, registration opens at 12:00, refreshments will be provided after the race, and the venue is accessible only on foot, with parking available within walking distance.

name: Heroes Race
location: Hradec nad Moravicí, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: Banskobystrický maratón
location: Banská Bystrica, Okres Banská Bystrica, Banskobystrický kraj
description: The Banská Bystrica Marathon is the largest recurring sporting event in central Slovakia, offering a magical evening atmosphere and a fast, certified course that delivers a memorable experience. Runners can choose from several events, including the marathon, half marathon, 10K, STEFE 5K and relay. The course is well supported, with refreshment stations and sound systems, ensuring a great experience for all participants. The event is suitable for both active runners and families looking to enjoy exercise and a sporting atmosphere.

name: Poludnica Run
description: Poludnica Run is a mountain race in the Low Tatras, with a 23 km course and 1,600 metres of elevation gain. The route runs mostly along marked hiking trails, through beautiful south-facing forest singletracks, a rock city and the summit of Poludnica, with panoramic views of the Liptov region and the Tatras. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League and the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia, and also serves as a qualifying race for the Skyrunning World Championships. The atmosphere is friendly, and the course is among the toughest in Slovakia in its category. The 2026 event will be the final edition.

name: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou
location: Vyšná Myšľa okr. Košice okolie, Vyšná Myšľa okr. Košice okolie, futbalové ihrisko
description: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou is a running event organized by the Vyšná Myšľa Running Club and the municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The races take place at the football field in Vyšná Myšľa and offer categories for men, women, and children across different age groups. The event also includes a two-person relay of 2 x 3 km. The children’s races start at 14:00 and the adults’ races at 16:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including club members and residents of the municipality, who receive discounts on the entry fee.

name: Trail Run
location: Družstevná pri Hornáde, Družstevná pri Hornáde, Okružná ulica pri multifunkčnom ihrisku
description: Trail Run in Družstevná pri Hornáde is a running competition featuring a natural setting and varied terrain. The race takes place on June 6, 2026, with a choice of 8 km and 15 km loops, running along asphalt, concrete, forest, and field roads, with elevation gain of up to 309 metres. The event also includes children’s categories with different course distances, making it suitable for runners of a wide range of ages. The start and finish are located by the multifunctional sports field on Okružná Street in Družstevná pri Hornáde.

name: Starostovská desiatka
location: Hôrka okr. Poprad, Hôrka okr. Poprad, futbalové ihrisko Kišovce
description: Starostovská desiatka is a running race held in the village of Hôrka, Poprad District, at the Kišovce football pitch. The race offers a 10 km course with age- and gender-based categories, as well as a 5 km hobby category and races for children and pupils. The main categories start at 16:30, and the children’s categories begin at 13:00. The organizers are the Hôrka Municipal Office and TJ Baník Hôrka, who welcome runners of all ages and abilities.

name: Beh pre dobrú vec
description: Run for a Good Cause is a running event in the village of Pača, offering a 4.4 km course. The race is open to a broad age range, from younger to older runners, with categories for men and women. This community run combines sport with a good cause, and participants can compete in various age groups. The event is part of the pretekaj.sk platform and offers simple online registration.

name: Beh na vrchol Minčola
location: Lipany okr. Sabinov, Lipany okr. Sabinov, Lúčka-nad obecným úradom
organizer: Turisti a priaznivci behu na Minčol v spolupráci s Mestom Lipany
description: The Run to the Summit of Minčol is a traditional running race in Lipany, offering a challenging 7,300-meter course with 649 meters of elevation gain. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from the youngest children to seniors, and also includes a competition in the 2025 Eastern Slovak Hill Running League. It is organized by Tourists and Running Enthusiasts of Minčol in cooperation with the City of Lipany. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys hill running and wants to test their strength in a beautiful natural setting.

name: Single-Trail run 30
location: Ruská Nová Ves, Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom (/budova obecného úradu)
description: Single-Trail Run 30 is a running race in Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom, offering three distances: 25 km, 15 km, and 7 km. The race is open to men and women with no age restrictions and is organized by O.z. Single-Trail Run 30. Registration is available online and on site, and the event offers the chance to experience a challenging trail run in nature. The organizers provide contact information for anyone seeking further details.

name: Samogitia Ultra 2027 - Where Dreams Go to Die
description: Samogitia Ultra is a unique endurance race held in the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai, Lithuania. Participants run a 6.7 km forest trail loop every hour on the hour, continuing until only one runner remains, known as the Last Man Standing. The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.
course_highlights: 6.7 km forest trail loop with about 70 meters of elevation gain
Course runs through the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai
100% forest single- and double-track trails and gravel; the same loop is run day and night
additional: Runners must complete each 6.7 km loop within one hour or be eliminated. A minimum of 7 loops (46.9 km) is required to earn a medal. Runners receive warnings 3, 2, and 1 minute before each loop. Personal tents can be set up from 6 PM the day before the race near the start gate. Toilets are available about 50 meters from base camp. Water and hot water are available at base camp. There are no showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents, but are not the organizer's responsibility. The event has a tent base and aid stations, but there are restrictions on support along the course.

name: Vilnius 5000 2027
location: Vilnius Vingio parko stadionas, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Vilnius 5000 is a unique 5,000-metre race held at Vilnius Vingis Park Stadium. Participants have the opportunity to compete alongside the fastest runners from Lithuania and abroad, enjoy live DJ music and a festive atmosphere. The event offers various races, including individual 5,000 m runs, a 5x1000 m relay and a 2x400 m father-and-child relay. It is a great opportunity to improve your personal best and experience unforgettable support and community spirit.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Vilnius Vingis Park Athletics Stadium
5,000 m run, 5x1000 m mixed relay and 2x400 m father-and-child relay
Live DJ music and a festive atmosphere, with a food truck after the finish
additional: Participants are grouped according to their personal bests or predicted finish times. Elite-group participants must wear World Athletics-approved track running shoes and have a certificate of completion for an anti-doping course. The 5x1000 m relay teams are mixed, and there are no age restrictions for the 2x400 m father-and-child relay. A food truck will be available during the event, and participants agree that their results and photo/video material may be published publicly. The event takes place at Vilnius Vingis Stadium, participant registration takes place on the day of the event, and both professional and amateur runners may take part.

name: Olimpinės dienos bėgimo renginiai
description: The Olympic Day running events in Kaunas invite city residents and visitors to take part in a range of free sports activities. The event offers several running distances: a 500-metre children’s run, a 1,988-metre Lithuanian Olympic Mile, and 5- and 10-kilometre races. In addition to running, participants can try an extreme obstacle run, orienteering, and a 3×3 basketball tournament. The event aims to bring communities together and promote an active lifestyle, while also offering the chance to meet professional athletes and Olympians.
course_highlights: 500-metre children’s run
1,988-metre Lithuanian Olympic Mile
5- and 10-kilometre races
additional: More than 15,000 prizes will be handed out to participants. Visitors can also take part in educational and Olympic education events and games, and meet Olympians. The event is free and focused on mass participation and bringing communities together. More than 100 activities, runs, tournaments, educational events, a concert, and a film screening.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
description: The Run Beneath the Thousand-Year-Old Oaks is a unique sporting event held in picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of the Bieniszew Forest. The race combines sport, history, and the beauty of the local landscape, taking participants along an avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, recreational runners, and families, with races over various distances as well as a Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Active Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Municipality of Kazimierz Biskupi, and its tradition dates back to the beginning of the 21st century.

name: Bieg Śladem Konia
description: The Śladem Konia Run is an annual running event organized by the Wrocław PIAST Running Club and held at the Partynice horse racing track in Wrocław. The run is recreational and athletic in nature, attracting both casual runners and more experienced athletes. The route takes runners through scenic surroundings, combining elements of the natural landscape with the urban environment. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the running community together.

name: I Bieg po Jagodę Kamczacką
location: PLANTIN Haskap Berry Plantation, Muniakowice, Poland
description: The 1st Haskap Berry Run is a unique sporting event that combines a passion for running with the idea of a healthy lifestyle and closeness to nature. The race takes place at PLANTIN’s haskap berry plantation in Muniakowice near Kraków, with the start, finish and race village located in the heart of the plantation. The race is part of the Berry Relay and promotes mindful food choices and local products. It is not just a competition, but also a gathering of people who value outdoor activity and authentic experiences.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Warszawa
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Warsaw is a prestigious triathlon held in the heart of Poland’s capital, combining a swim in Lake Zegrzyńskie, a 90 km bike ride to central Warsaw, and a half-marathon run. The event attracts both experienced triathletes and amateurs, offering the opportunity to qualify for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. The atmosphere is filled with sporting excitement and the historic spirit of Warsaw, and the finish line is at the Multimedia Fountain Park, adding a unique character to the race.

name: Pogórzański Festiwal Biegowy - Lato
description: Pogórzański Running Festival – Summer is a running event held on June 7, 2026, in Burzyn near Tuchów. The event promotes running and a healthy lifestyle among residents of Małopolska, offering races at various distances, including a 22 km mountain run, a 10 km race, a 5.5 km race, and Nordic walking. The start and finish are at the LKS Burzyn stadium by Burzyn Primary School, where changing rooms and showers are also available. Participants receive a race pack with a gift, water, and snacks along the course and at the finish.

name: Test Coopera dla wszystkich
description: The Cooper Test for Everyone is a nationwide, free fitness test in which participants cover as much distance as possible in 12 minutes. It is open to everyone, regardless of age, gender, or running experience. Participants receive a race bib, a certificate with their result, and a bottle of water. It’s a great opportunity to check your fitness and get motivated to stay physically active.

name: VI EKO Bieg z Gwizdkiem po Zdrowie
description: The 6th Eco Run with a Whistle for Health takes place on June 7, 2026, in Jerzmanowice. The event is organized by Tomasz Gwizdała, Mayor of the Jerzmanowice-Przeginia Municipality, and KKS Jura Moto Sport. The run has an environmental focus and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can use the official race-package exchange to safely buy or sell entry packages. The start and race office are at Chochołowy Dwór in Jerzmanowice.

name: X Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Akt...
description: The 10th Festival of Runs of Northern Poland and Physical Activity in Wdzydze is a celebratory, tenth edition of an event promoting running and physical activity in the scenic Kashubian region. The event takes place on June 5–7, 2026, with its base at the sports field on Leśna Street in Wdzydze Kiszewskie. The festival brings together the running community of Northern Poland, promotes a healthy lifestyle, and celebrates local culture and nature. The programme includes races of various distances, Nordic walking, and cycling rallies.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
description: The 13th DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon in memory of Barbara Karaczyńska is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie, organized by the Daszrade Foundation in cooperation with the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Center. The marathon course is entirely paved, running through the picturesque fields and forests of Kociewie. It is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and features numerous, fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race takes place on a June morning and offers unforgettable views and a unique atmosphere. After the race, participants can look forward to a recovery meal, and everyone who finishes will receive a commemorative medal, diploma, and T-shirt.

name: XV Bieg Pszczyński
description: The 15th Carbo Asecura Pszczyna Run is an annual running event held in Pszczyna since 2012. The main race follows a familiar and popular 10 km course, run according to tried-and-tested rules. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, making it appealing to families and participants of all ages. All runners are invited to take part in this friendly, traditional sporting event.

name: 10 Bieg po Gminie Świerczów
location: Dąbrowa, Świerczów Municipality, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: III Bieg Charytatywny Dookoła Jeziora Cz...
IV Bieg Charytatywny Nagronik
location: Stryszawa, Sucha County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XXX Bieg Łagowskiego Lata
location: Łagów, Świebodzin County, Lubusz Voivodeship, Poland

name: 17. Klingenthal Salzkotten Marathon
description: The 17th Klingenthal Salzkotten Marathon offers a unique running weekend with an exhilarating atmosphere in the heart of Salzkotten. The routes pass through the town and the district of Verne, are officially measured, and offer a top-level sporting experience. In the shade of the Salzkotten saltworks, runners can enjoy a first-class refreshment area and a relaxed chill-out area. All event proceeds go directly to youth programs run by local clubs, supporting sport in the region.
course_highlights: Attractive loop course of approximately 10.55 km through Salzkotten and Verne
Marathon and half-marathon courses officially measured and compliant with IWR/DLO rules
Loop course with around 25 metres of elevation gain; flat 10 km course ideal for personal bests
additional: Start times vary by distance: the marathon and half marathon start at 08:30, the 10 km race at 10:30, the 5 km race at 11:30, and the Bambini races from 15:30, with different start times for each age group. The courses are officially measured and comply with international competition rules. On event day, roads through the town and side streets will be closed from approximately 06:30 to 16:00. A supervised bicycle parking area is available at the Sälzerhalle car park in exchange for a voluntary donation. The NUNAV app is recommended for a stress-free journey and parking search. The marathon places particular emphasis on community and team spirit, with company teams able to take part in the team competition. The event also offers parking, pacemaker teams, and a family program.

name: Harzgeröder Klippenlauf
description: The Harzgeröder Klippenlauf on 7 June 2026 is a varied popular and cross-country running event in the Lower Harz, suitable for runners of all abilities. Distances range from 1 km for children to a challenging half marathon of 21.1 km with 450 metres of elevation gain. The routes follow the Selke Valley along the Selketalstieg, passing through the districts of Mägdesprung and Alexisbad, with rocky sections, narrow trails and a rock tunnel. Alongside the sporting challenge, the Klippenlauf offers fun for the whole family, including a raffle and other events. The start and finish are at the dog training club grounds in Harzgerode.
course_highlights: Rocky sections and challenging climbs
Narrow trails along the Selketalstieg
Rock tunnel on the 15 km and half-marathon routes
additional: The start and finish are at the dog training club grounds in Harzgerode, where the race office and race-number collection are located. Safety pins may not be used to attach race numbers; race belts are available for 5 EUR. Separate starts are offered for the Fun Run (1 km), Schoolchildren’s Run (2.5 km), Everyone’s Run (5 km), Main Run (15 km) and Half Marathon (21.1 km). A raffle with great prizes is held for participants. The event is one of the region’s major running and sporting events. Participants can pre-order a running shirt, registration is available online, and running with dogs is prohibited. The event is limited to 600 participants.

name: Deichlauf
organizer: TSV Winsen (Luhe) von 1850 e.V. und SV Greven
description: The Deichlauf in Hohnstorf/Elbe offers a varied running programme with races for children and teenagers, an Olympic school relay, and 5 km and 10 km races. The event is sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The scenic course follows the dike and offers a sporting challenge in a family-friendly atmosphere. Special and team classifications add to the excitement of the competition.
course_highlights: Running routes along the Elbe dike
A range of distances from 1000 m to 10 km
The Olympic school relay as a special highlight
additional: Showers are not available. Medical services will be stationed at the finish and along the course. Late entries are possible online until 11 June 2026 and on the day of the event until 1 hour before the respective start. Photos and videos will be taken by a commissioned service provider and may be published. The Deichlauf in Greven drew over 800 participants in June 2026, with distances from 2 km to 10 km, including climbs, and suitable for all age groups. The event is a community event with a particular focus on families and nature lovers.

name: Lingener Citylauf
description: The Lingener City Run is a long-standing event held each year on and around Lingener Market Square. For the 35th time, the city centre will become a sporting stage full of energy and community spirit. The event offers various distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 10-kilometre relay with up to 100 teams. The course runs through the city centre and is part of the EL Cup. The event is a highlight for runners and spectators from the region and beyond.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Lingener Market Square
Route through the city centre of Lingen
Part of the EL Cup, with 5 km and 10 km runs
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the start for a fee of €3.00. Bib number distribution begins at 10:00 on race day. Changing facilities and restrooms are available in the Bäumerstraße gym, about 500 m from the market square. Timing is recorded using transponders attached to the bib numbers, which must be handed in after the race. Parking is available, among other places, in the Marktplatz underground car park and at the Alter Pferdemarkt car park. Due to road closures, access to parking in the city centre will be restricted on the event day. Start and finish on Lingener Market Square, parking in the city centre, changing facilities at the Bäumerstraße gym, no timing for the children's race

name: Mainauenlauf 2026
description: The Mainauenlauf 2026 takes place on June 14 on the grounds of the former State Garden Show in Bayreuth. The scenic, challenging, undulating course runs through green parks with wonderful panoramic views over the city. Various distances are offered, including 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, Nordic walking, and children’s and youth races. A special highlight is the atmospheric finish in the Finisher Park, with excellent refreshments and a unique finisher medal. City championships will also be held across all distances for the first time.
course_highlights: Challenging, undulating 5 km loop with 85 meters of elevation gain per lap
Highest point on the course: Col Bellota
Finish in the Mainauenlauf Finisher Park, with refreshments and a medal
additional: Showers are open at the Ost school center until 3:00 p.m. There is a photo booth in the start/finish area. Bag drop is available in the Finisher Park, with bags to be collected by 3:00 p.m. Group warm-up run on Saturday at 6:30 p.m. in the Finisher Park. Refreshment stations at km 2, 3, 6, and 7 provide water, isotonic drinks, baked goods, and fruit. Restrooms are available near the finish area and at the Ost sports center. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, relays, Nordic walking, and children’s and youth races; start on the State Garden Show grounds; refreshments at several points; finish in the Finisher Park

name: Neustädter Stadtlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: 14. Stadtlauf des TSV Neustadt
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: TSV Neustadt am Rübenberge von 1862 e.V.
description: The 14th TSV Neustadt City Run on June 7, 2026, is an accessible community race in Neustadt am Rübenberge that promotes community and inclusion. The event celebrates togetherness and brings friends together through shared exercise. Every step strengthens social ties and signals support for an inclusive future. The race is open to all age groups and combines a sporting event with social commitment.

name: 21. ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf
description: The ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf in Potsdam is a unique running event that combines tradition, culture, and sporting challenge. The course passes through the historic palaces, gardens, and landmarks of the state capital of Brandenburg, offering runners an unforgettable experience in a UNESCO World Heritage Site. With more than 4,500 participants, the race is a popular event for runners of all abilities. Experience the special atmosphere and the diverse sights along the route through the city’s history.

name: 45. Wehlheider Volkslauf
description: The Wehlheider Volkslauf is a traditional recreational running event in Schönfeld Park in Kassel-Wehlheiden and is part of the Nordhessencup. The course runs mainly along paved paths and through wooded areas, with various distances for all age groups. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. Changing and shower facilities are available, and runners are provided with refreshments along the course.

name: Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf
organizer: Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. und Freunde des Vogelberglaufes
description: The Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf is a traditional race taking place on 7 June 2026 in Bleicherode. The event offers four distances (2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 20 km) on road and trail routes, starting at the former Schneckenhengst youth hostel building. The race is organised by Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. and Freunde des Vogelberglaufes. Results are ranked according to the age-group system of the German Athletics Association, with special age restrictions for younger participants. Trophies and certificates are awarded to the top runners in various categories.

name: Norderstedter Stadtlauf
description: The Norderstedt City Run is a popular running event held annually by Norderstedter Sportverein e.V. On June 7, 2026, runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in various races, including 5 kilometers, 10 kilometers, a fun run, and a Bambini run. The event offers a sporting atmosphere on closed, traffic-free routes and is supported by the police, THW, and volunteers. The run promotes community, fun, and health and is a highlight of the regional sports calendar.

name: Altöttinger Intersp. Siebzehnrübl Dultlauf mit Staffeln
description: The Altöttinger Siebzehnrübl Dultlauf is a traditional running competition held annually at the Altötting stadium. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a 10 km run, relay races, and shorter courses for children and young people. The course is a paved loop through the beautiful surrounding area. All participants receive a Dult pretzel as a small snack, and the awards ceremony takes place after the races.

name: Everstener Brunnenlauf 2026
description: The Eversten Brunnenlauf is a long-standing running event in Oldenburg, taking place on June 7, 2026. Various races are offered, including student races, a 6.3 km company and fun run, and a 10 km public race. The course runs through the Eversten district, starting on Wienstraße and finishing in Eversten Holz. The event is known for its large number of participants and family-friendly atmosphere, appealing to both recreational and ambitious runners.

name: Haster Volkslauf
description: The Haster Volkslauf 2026 takes place on June 7 in Osnabrück-Haste and offers races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini races, an inclusive fun run, and short- and long-distance races. The course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Haste and is recognized as an officially sanctioned race by the German Athletics Association. Participants receive medals and trophies, with the awards ceremony held immediately afterward at the sports field. The entry fee also supports a fundraising campaign for “Jede Oma zählt.”

name: Hopfengarten-Pokallauf - Landescup 9
description: The Hopfengarten Cup Run is part of the Novo Nordisk State Cup Saxony-Anhalt and takes place on June 7, 2026, in Magdeburg. The event is organized by the Athletics Association of Saxony-Anhalt (Leichtathletik-Verband Sachsen-Anhalt e.V.) and is open to runners of all age groups. The State Cup provides a sporting platform for ambitious runners and promotes running in the region. Runners must register via the LADV registration portal, and the association’s age-group and distance recommendations apply.

name: Lauf um die Himmelsschaukel Bründersen 2026
description: The Run around the Sky Swing in Bründersen is a traditional scoring race in the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup. Various distances are offered, from 400 meters to 20 kilometers, suitable for all age groups, from Bambini to seniors. The event takes place at the Bründersen sports field and offers a varied course through the beautiful surrounding area. The race is part of TSV Bründersen 1967 e.V. and combines sporting competition with community and regional ties.

name: Pfreimdtaltrail 2026
description: The Pfreimdtal Trail is a trail half marathon around Trausnitz, taking place on June 7, 2026. The course covers approximately 21 kilometres with around 450 metres of elevation gain and features varied landscapes along the Pfreimd, including steep climbs, downhill sections and scenic stretches on the Goldsteig. The event is registered as a UTMB Index Race and is open to runners aged 16 and over. Alongside the sporting challenge, the race offers a friendly, family atmosphere with refreshments, an awards ceremony and catering provided by TSV Trausnitz.

name: ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau
description: The ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau takes place for the 36th time on June 7, 2026, offering races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 400 m Bambini run. The courses are officially measured and suitable for setting personal bests, with the start and finish at TSV Ratekau’s sports field. There are suitable races for all ability levels, including a school cup that runs throughout the calendar year. The event places great importance on safety, with road closures, and offers refreshments along the course and in the finish area.

name: Mnichovohradištská patnáctka, memoriál ing. Josefa Hrona
description: The Mnichovohradištská Fifteen is a road race with a gently undulating out-and-back course measuring 15 km. It takes place in Mnichovo Hradiště, on T. G. Masaryk Square. The course is well paved and has marked kilometres, helping runners pace themselves. The race is held in memory of Ing. Josef Hron and offers a pleasant atmosphere for all runners. The start is at 10:00, and the organiser is Vladimír Koudelka. The race is suitable for runners looking for a quality road run with a long tradition.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all age groups. Each participant competes primarily against themselves, creating a friendly and motivating atmosphere. The race takes place in the beautiful setting of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, adding to the enjoyment of the run. It is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to test their speed over a short distance.

name: Běh přes Červený vrch
description: The Run over Červený vrch is a traditional running race organized by Atletický klub ISCAREX in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Čermná in the Pardubice Region. The race features a technically engaging course with gentle undulations and plenty of turns, suitable for a wide range of runners, from recreational athletes to experienced competitors. The event is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and provides quality facilities for both runners and spectators. You can register online or on site on race day, June 7, 2026.

name: Babický trail 1/4 maraton 2026
location: Sportovní areál Babice, Topolová 500, Babice, Czech Republic

description: Babický Trail 1/4 Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Babice forest. It offers two main distances, 10.55 km and 5.95 km, with 160 m and 60 m of elevation gain, respectively. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, who can take part in shorter races. The course runs mainly along forest roads and trails, offering a pleasant experience in nature. The main race is limited to 200 participants, creating an intimate atmosphere. The organizers emphasize fair competition and safety, including course adjustments for the children’s categories.
course_highlights: Main race course: 10.55 km with 160 m of elevation gain
Mostly forest roads and trails (94% of the surface)
Specially adapted courses for children’s races (300 m, 1,000 m, 1,500 m)
additional: Registration and race bib collection take place from 08:30 to 09:45. The children’s races start between 09:45 and 10:01; the main race, combining the 1/4 and 1/8 marathons, starts at 11:00. The main race is limited to 200 participants. Parking is available at the sports complex and on surrounding streets; please be considerate of local residents. Online registration is also available on race day, but a 100% surcharge applies after registration check-in opens. The courses have been adjusted because of logging in the forest; this year, a course similar to the 2024 route returns. The race course consists of 38–51% forest roads, 43–56% forest trails, and 6% road. Start and event facilities: Sportovní areál Babice, Topolová 500. Entry fees are 400 Kč for the main races and 50–150 Kč for the children’s races; a parent + 1 child package costs 490 Kč. Capacity for the main race is limited.

name: Skalecký kros
description: Skalecký Cross-Country Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Baroque grounds of Skalka in Mníšek pod Brdy. It offers 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races, running along forest paths and paved roads. The main race starts at 11:30 and is suitable for the general public, including children and teenagers. The event is organized by SK Mníšecko, z.s., which ensures high-quality organization and a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Červenkovská desítka
description: Červenkovská Desítka is a 10 km road race held in Červenka near Olomouc. The race is part of the 2026 Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners. The course is an out-and-back route from Červenka through Dětřichov to Renoty and back, mostly on roads. Runners are divided into age categories, with prizes awarded to the winners in each category. The results ceremony will take place at the race venue, Hostinec u Nádraží, and the results will be published on hanackybeh.cz.

name: Milada Run
description: Milada Run is a popular sporting event held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural surroundings of Lake Milada. The event offers various routes, including a half marathon, 10 km race, and children’s races, which follow undulating and flat paths with views of the lake. The atmosphere is family-friendly and welcoming, making it suitable for all ages and running abilities. All races are part of the Milada Tour series, which runners themselves praise for its high standards and popularity.

name: Konopišťská desítka
description: The Konopiště 10K is a traditional 10 km running race held in the beautiful natural amphitheatre and park at Konopiště near Benešov. The race is part of the Benešov Running Festival and offers the chance to compete in the main race, relays, and children’s categories. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy a run in picturesque countryside with high-quality organisation. The 30th anniversary edition will take place on 7 June 2026.

name: Bolfánek třikrát jinak
description: Bolfánek Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities in Chudenice, in the Plzeň Region. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and offers an unusual format in which runners tackle the course in three different ways. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own age categories. The organizers emphasize a sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Mnichovická běhna
description: The Mnichovická běhna is an amateur running race through the beautiful Central Bohemian countryside, featuring a challenging course approximately 7–8 km long with around 200 meters of elevation gain. The varied terrain includes steep climbs and descents, running on paved paths, through forest, meadow, and pasture, accompanied by domestic and forest animals. The start and finish have been newly located at the Podhorky playing field by the Šibeniční vrch sports complex. All runners receive a commemorative medal and certificate; category winners receive trophies and a small surprise. The Mnichovická běhna is part of the Ladův kraj Cup running race series, and everyone who finishes the race healthy and alive is a winner.

name: Bathory Run
location: Sedliska, (okr. Vranov nad Topľou), Sedliska, (okr. Vranov nad Topľou), futbalové ihrisko
organizer: Obec Sedliska a MV Running team Sedliska
description: Bathory Run is a running event in the village of Sedliska near Vranov nad Topľou, offering courses for children, juniors and adults. Runners follow a varied route through an orchard, giving the race a pleasant natural character. The children’s categories start at 10:30, while the men’s and women’s races start at 13:00. The event is organized by the Municipality of Sedliska and MV Running team Sedliska, who ensure a high-quality race experience for all age groups.

name: Spoznaj Trebišov behom – Charity Run
location: Trebišov, Trebišov, námestie pod OD Billa
organizer: Mesto Trebišov, Stredná odborná škola služieb a priemyslu sv. Jozafáta
description: The Charity Run in Trebišov is a traditional event that brings together running, walking, Nordic walking and cycling. This charity run offers an opportunity to discover the city of Trebišov while supporting a good cause. The event is organised by Majcher-Production s.r.o. and is suitable for the general public who want to spend time actively and contribute to charity.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 4. kolo
description: The Šamorín Running League (ŠBL) is a series of races organized by 3klub Šamorín, open to the general public with no age or performance limits. Runners compete in the men’s, women’s, boys’ and girls’ categories, with shorter distances for children’s races. The league runs throughout the year and includes the traditional Pomlé Run. The entry fee covers race bibs, timekeeping, refreshments and league scoring. The overall league standings are officially announced and the top runners are awarded in the final round.

name: Šebešská pätnástka
location: Vyšná Šebastová okr. Prešov, Vyšná Šebastová okr. Prešov, futbalové ihrisko Vyšná Šebastová
description: Šebešská Pätnástka is a running race organized by the MTC Vyšná Šebastová club in cooperation with the Vyšná Šebastová municipal office and sports associations. The main course is 15.5 km long and includes a climb to Nevická chata, complemented by a recreational 3 km course and children’s events for various age groups. The race takes place every year on the Sunday of the first weekend in June, with a morning start and a rich cultural and social program that attracts hundreds of visitors. The event is part of several running competitions and a league, and the organizers emphasize promoting sport and building the village’s reputation. Šebešská Pätnástka received the Running Diamond award in 2011 and 2012.

name: Bėgimas Tėvo dienos proga 2026
description: The Father’s Day run in Tauragė is a festive event inviting all running enthusiasts to take part with family and friends. It is a great opportunity to celebrate Father’s Day actively and have fun as part of the city festival. The event takes place during Tauragė City Festival, offering a chance to experience community spirit and sporting enthusiasm.
course_highlights: A festive run during Tauragė City Festival
A friendly atmosphere for families and friends
A chance to celebrate Father’s Day actively
additional: The event is part of Tauragė City Festival, takes place outdoors, and encourages active leisure and family participation.

name: 5000 m bėgimo varžybos „Vilnius 5000“.
description: Vilnius 5000 is a unique 5,000-meter running event held at the athletics stadium in Vilnius’s Vingis Park. The event offers not only individual 5,000 m races, but also relay races—a mixed 5x1000 m relay and a 2x400 m parent-and-child relay. Participants can enjoy live DJ music, a festive atmosphere, and support to help them achieve their best results. The competition is open to both professionals and recreational runners, and the organizers aim to promote athletics in Lithuania and encourage a sporting community.
course_highlights: The competition takes place at the athletics stadium in Vilnius’s Vingis Park
5,000 m race, 5x1000 m mixed relay, and 2x400 m parent-and-child relay
Live DJ music and a festive atmosphere, with a food truck after the finish
additional: Participants are divided into groups according to their personal bests or predicted finish times. Elite-group participants must wear running shoes approved by World Athletics for track use and have a certificate of completion for an anti-doping course. The 5x1000 m relay teams are mixed, and there are no age restrictions for the 2x400 m parent-and-child relay. A food truck awaits participants after the finish. The winners and runners-up are awarded sponsor prizes and cash prizes for outstanding results. The competition will take place on June 13, 2027, with various categories on offer, including elite and recreational runners, and detailed schedule information. The event promotes sport and family participation.

name: 37. Campuslauf Technische Universität Clausthal
description: The 37th Campus Run at Clausthal University of Technology takes place on June 9, 2026, offering runners a sporting challenge on the campus grounds. The event features several race distances, including one lap and three laps, as well as a children’s race. This popular university sports event welcomes students, staff, and guests alike. In addition to the sporting competition, there is also a Campus Open Air, creating a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Mladé BĚKODO
location: Doubravka, Teplice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Mladé Běkodo is a series of running races for children and young people aged 2 to 15, held around Doubravka in Teplice. The races offer distances from 200 to 1,650 metres and are divided into age categories. Each race is followed by an awards ceremony for individual and team results. BK Běkodo is part of TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and has a long tradition dating back to 2001.

name: Běh Advenťáka BRNO
description: Běh Advenťáka Brno 2026 is a charity race held on June 9 by the Medlánky Pond in Brno. The race offers a 6.45 km course on paved paths, suitable for runners of all levels, with trail shoes recommended. The event also includes children’s categories with shorter courses. Participants’ entry fees support people who face challenges in life, and runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere, sports prizes, and other benefits.

name: Pivní míle Heřmanův Městec
description: The Beer Mile in Heřmanův Městec is an original race on the Bažantnice athletics track, where runners complete four laps of 400 metres with beer breaks. This unconventional sporting experience combines running and fun in a friendly atmosphere. This year marks the 10th edition of this popular event, which is part of the Heřmanův Městec running club.

name: Otevřený přebor SABZO v přespolním běhu
description: The SABZO Open Cross-Country Championship is a traditional running race organized by the SABZO Running Club in Prague. The race gives amateur runners the chance to test their strength in cross-country running in a pleasant sporting atmosphere. The SABZO Club is known for its long history and for regularly organizing running events in Prague and the surrounding area. The race is part of the club’s broader calendar of running events, which promotes an active lifestyle and a community of runners.

name: Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The 19th MittSommerNachtsLauf on 10 June 2026 is an open-to-all run at a steady pace of approx. 6 min/km, or 6 km/h for walkers. The start is at 7 p.m. in the center of Marklohe, and the finish is at the heated Wietzen outdoor pool, where the swimming pool will remain open until 10 p.m. and the support association will provide refreshments.
