The running route is a maximum of 18 km, with additional starting points at 13, 10 and 5 km; the walking route is a maximum of 10 km or 5 km. The event promises a sporting evening in beautiful surroundings and is open to everyone who enjoys running or walking.

name: Běh Advenťáka OSTRAVA
description: The Advenťák Ostrava Run 2026 is a charity running race held on June 10 in Komenského sady. The race offers two main categories: adults running 6.45 km and children, called little elves, on courses from 0.2 to 1 km. The route follows paved and firm-surface paths, and road-running shoes are recommended. A large portion of the entry fee supports heroes who face challenges in life, and participants receive a race number, certificate, gingerbread cookie, and other benefits. The event is friendly, charitable, and suitable for all age groups.

name: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The VAŠÍ LIGA Trail of Zlíchov Viewpoints is an amateur trail race held in Prague, offering runners the experience of running in nature across varied terrain and enjoying interesting views. The races are part of VAŠÍ LIGA, the largest amateur league in the Czech Republic, which promotes the joy of sport and a community atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a friendly environment and the chance to test themselves against runners of all ages. Winners are regularly announced and awarded medals in the under-40 and 40+ categories.

name: 189 Pobino i 73 popekspres
location: Brynek, Tarnowskie Góry County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Ekstremalny Półmaraton Górski
location: Lipowa, Żywiec County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 42. Bugasee-Marathon
description: The 42nd Bugasee Marathon takes place on June 11, 2026, in Kassel and is organized by Laufwerk Kassel under the direction of Sylke Kuhn. The course is 42.3 km long and runs on flat, paved park paths around Bugasee in the Fuldaaue. The marathon consists of an opening section of 1.7 km followed by 10 laps of 4.06 km each. The event is designed as a birthday marathon and offers a personal atmosphere with no entry fee, as this is covered by the birthday celebrant.

name: Červnová Krásná Morava
description: The June Krásná Morava is a running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Hejčín. It is part of the rich tradition of running events in the Olomouc Region, which are open to runners of all ages and abilities. The race offers a chance to experience the picturesque Haná countryside and join a community of sports enthusiasts. STMSVS is known for its long-standing organization of endurance sports and its support for running, cycling, and triathlon disciplines in the region.

name: 41. AZ-Abendvolkslauf

price_tiers.distance: 5,0 km, 10,0 km, Walking, NordicWalking (Schüler und Jugendliche unter 18)

description: The 41st AZ Evening Fun Run takes place on June 12, 2026, in Uelzen and offers a varied programme for runners of all ages. There is something for everyone, from short taster runs for children to the main 5 km and 10 km races, as well as walking, Nordic walking and recreational hiking. The route passes through Uelzen’s historic city centre and along the Ilmenau meadows, among other places. The event is well established and supported by dedicated volunteers and numerous regional sponsors.
course_highlights: The route passes through Uelzen’s historic city centre
The 10 km circuit is run twice
Sections along the Ilmenau meadows and across the Katzenbuckel Bridge
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until approximately one hour before each event; the late entry fee is €3.00 (except for the taster run and hiking). All children’s and schoolchildren’s races up to 2.0 km award medals at the finish. Certificates can be printed online after the event. All events start on Albertstraße in front of the turning circle. Race routes, registration, sponsors, volunteers, virtual runs, parking, start on Albertstraße, registration deadline: June 9, 2026

name: Holstenköstenlauf
organizer: SVT Neumünster in Kooperation mit BMS Die Laufgesellschaft mbH
price_range: 10 km Lauf: 23,00 Euro bis 26,00 Euro, 5 km Lauf: 13,00 Euro bis 16,00 Euro, Holstenkösten-Becher: 12,00 Euro
description: The Holstenköstenlauf in Neumünster is a traditional city race held as part of Schleswig-Holstein’s largest city festival, the Holstenköste. The event offers races for all ages, from Bambini to adults, and runs through various parts of Neumünster. The 10 km course is officially measured in accordance with DLV rules and promises an attractive route through the city centre, Tungendorf and Brachenfeld. All finishers receive a coveted festival medal as a memento of the event.
course_highlights: Attractive course through the city centre, Tungendorf and Brachenfeld
10 km course officially measured in accordance with DLV rules
Start and finish at Kleinflecken, with the same start and finish line
additional: Race-pack collection on 10 and 11 June 2026; timing by transponder (timing fee €3.00, waived if you have your own BMS chip); race number is non-transferable and must be worn on the front of your sportswear; Holstenkösten cup can be pre-ordered (€12.00) and collected at race-pack collection. Participation is available for various age groups; registration online or on site; race-number collection in the foyer of the Stadthalle; refreshments on the course and at the finish; award ceremonies in the evening.

name: Oesterweger Feuerwehrlauf
description: The Oesterweg Fun Run and Firefighters’ Race in Versmold offers a varied running program for all ages and ability levels on June 12, 2026. From short, free Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to an officially measured 10 km road race and a 6 km team and firefighters’ race, there is something for everyone. The flat, paved courses run through the town center, with spectators providing plenty of encouragement. Walkers can also enjoy a scenic 6 km route through the countryside at the same time.
course_highlights: Flat, paved courses through the center of Oesterweg
10 km loop with four identical laps plus an introductory lap
6 km laps for the team and firefighters’ race and walking
additional: The Bambini race (450 m) and schoolchildren’s race (1.2 km) have no entry fee. The schoolchildren’s race is for participants up to age 11 in the standings; the fun run is for those up to age 15. The team and firefighters’ race consists of teams of four participants each. Walkers start at the same time as the firefighters’ race from the back to avoid disrupting the runners. Various race distances, online registration, race brochures available to download, special categories for firefighters and teams, results on TimeTeamJung

name: Voxtruper Volkslauf
description: The 13th Voxtruper Volkslauf on June 12, 2026, in Osnabrück offers a varied range of races for all ages and ability levels. The event includes distances from 0.4 km for Bambinis up to the 9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain. The races follow a very scenic route, with several refreshment stations to look after participants. Late entries are possible on the day of the event, and the event prioritises a safe, smooth experience; dogs and baby joggers are not allowed.
course_highlights: Very scenic race with a range of distances
9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain
Several refreshment stations depending on the distance (up to four for 9.8 km)
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 45 minutes before the respective race. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. Certificates can be printed online, and results are available at www.laufen-os.de. Refreshment stations: 1 at 3.9 km, 2 at 5.5 km, 4 at 9.8 km. Participants can register on site; dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. The routes are designed to be scenic.

name: Internationaler Brüder-Grimm-Lauf
organizer: Verein zur Förderung des Brüder-Grimm-Laufes e.V.
price_range: Startgebühr, ermäßigt für Mitglieder: 5 Euro Rabatt, sonst unklar
description: The International Brothers Grimm Run is a long-standing three-day event that covers approximately 82 km from Hanau, the birthplace of the Brothers Grimm, to Steinau, where the collectors of fairy tales spent their childhood. The route is divided into 5 stages and offers a challenge for recreational runners as well as competitive athletes. It follows historic trade routes, passing historic buildings, scenic attractions, and spa and recreation resorts in the Spessart and picturesque villages in the Kinzig Valley. The event takes place from 12 to 14 June 2026, and registration opens on 11 November 2025.
course_highlights: Approximately 82 km from Hanau to Steinau, divided into 5 stages
Follows centuries-old trade routes and passes historic buildings
Scenic attractions and spa resorts in the Spessart and Kinzig Valley
additional: The route is mostly paved, with some sections through open countryside and forest. The elevation profile is flat, with only minimal inclines (maximum elevation approximately 130 m). The stages include cycle paths, forest trails, and paved paths, among other surfaces. Stage starts and finishes are in various towns along the route, such as Niederrodenbach and Neuenhaßlau. The event is open to recreational runners and competitive athletes alike. Multi-day running event, 5 stages, registration opens on 11 November 2025, participant limit: 550, individual stage registration available.

name: 14. Garbsener Citylauf
description: The 14th Garbsen City Run on June 12, 2026, is Garbsen’s largest sporting event and offers races for all ages and ability levels. There are six different races, from a 500-meter parent-child run to the 10,000-meter Agon Tax Run. The routes pass through Rathausplatz and the IGS grounds, along Meyenfelder Straße, and by Lake Berenbostel. The event is family-friendly and emphasizes fun and community, supported by a dedicated organizing team and numerous volunteers.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2026 Lauf 1: 36. Donoper Volkslauf
description: The Lippe Summer Series 2026 is a three-part running event taking place from 12 to 26 June 2026 in the Schieder-Schwalenberg region. The first race, the 36th Donop Volkslauf, is organized by SC Donop 1948 e.V. and features a varied 7,777-meter course around the Donop sports ground in Blomberg-Donop. The series combines athletic challenge with nature and community, and is open to runners, walkers, and hikers.

name: Aschauer Bankerl-Lauf
description: The Aschauer Bankerl-Lauf is a sociable evening run in the idyllic Chiemgau countryside, open to everyone who enjoys running. For the fifth time, organizer Lauffeuer Chiemgau e.V. invites runners to an untimed event where the joy of running takes center stage. Various distances are offered, from approximately 1 km (children’s run) to 7 km. Part of the proceeds will be donated to charity, making the event a socially minded one as well.

name: Derentaler Löwenlauf
description: The Derental Lion Run is a traditional race in the Weser Uplands, designed as a family-friendly sporting event for all ages. The event offers various distances through the beautiful Derental countryside and the Steinbach Valley. It places particular emphasis on diversity, tolerance, and working together, supported by a donation to the “augen auf!” Foundation for every participant. The race is organized with great care by the Weserbergland Runners Derental and promises an unforgettable day for children, young people, adults, and seniors.

name: Kleinbahn-Lauf
description: The Kleinbahn Run in Rhauderfehn is a fun run without timekeeping, welcoming runners and walkers on 5- and 10-kilometer routes. There are also children’s races for kindergarten and primary school children, enthusiastically cheered on by parents and grandparents. The 10 km loop starts at the marketplace and runs along the Hauptfehn Canal, through the villages of Holtermoor and Rhaude, and back to the finish via the Ostfriesland hiking trail. The 5 km route also starts at the marketplace and follows the Ostfriesland hiking trail back to the finish. The race offers a lovely opportunity to experience the region along varied routes.

name: Krackenlauf 2026
description: The Krackenlauf Großlangheim takes place on Friday, June 12, 2026, and offers races for different age groups and ability levels. The events include an 800-meter Bambini run, a 2,000-meter student run, a 7,500-meter main race, and a 6,000-meter walking event. This popular local running event features unchanged start times and distances and is open to all running enthusiasts. Registration is through the RaceResult platform.

name: Mittsommerlauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 1 km

name: Sparkassenlauf Geislingen
location: 73312 Geislingen an der Steige, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

name: Přes tři hráze Opatov
description: Přes tři hráze Opatov is a traditional running race held in Opatov in the Vysočina Region and is part of the Vysočina Runner’s Cup series. The race offers various distances, including the 8.8 km main course for men and veterans up to 69 years old, as well as shorter courses for women, veterans over 70, juniors, youth, and children. The course runs mainly along field and forest paths, including a route over the dams of three local ponds, giving the race its unique character. The event is open to a broad range of age groups and emphasizes sporting experiences and support for the local running community.

name: Angličák night run Pezinok
description: Angličák Night Run Pezinok is a 5-kilometer night race held at the Rozálka Health Complex in Pezinok. Runners can enjoy a fast, dynamic run along a route through the Little Carpathians, illuminated by artificial lighting to create a unique atmosphere. The event is open to everyone aged 15 and over, with starting corrals organized by ability. The organizers prioritize safety, so headphones are prohibited and reflective gear or headlamps are recommended. Registration is available online and is tied to the runner’s name; pre-registration is possible until June 9, 2026.

name: Runway Run
location: Kamenica nad Cirochou Airport, Kamenica nad Cirochou, Slovakia

name: The Run Slovakia
location: naprieč Slovenskom, naprieč Slovenskom, Košice, ul. Hlavná, resp. Teplička nad Váhom
description: THE RUN SLOVAKIA 2026 is a national relay race across Slovakia, held over three days. Runners cover more than 530 km together from Košice to Bratislava, passing through beautiful natural scenery, historic landmarks and picturesque towns. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, teamwork and many unforgettable experiences. The route passes notable sites such as Spiš Castle, the High Tatras, Orava Castle and the Little Carpathians, and runners can also enjoy a varied programme of accompanying activities.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4th Skolwińska Mile is an annual street race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event takes place on June 13, 2026, and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the entry form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile (1,609-meter) course in a scenic recreational area
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes
additional: The event also includes children's races over a distance of approximately 200 meters. Participants can use the entry form available on the website to contact the organizer and system administrator quickly. Participants can use training plans lasting from 8 to 20 weeks. The event is supported by a local building-supply store, and the participant limit is 60.

name: IV Bilczańska Dycha
organizer: Zakład Gospodarki Komunalnej i Rekreacji w Morawicy
description: The 3rd Bilcza 10K is a 10 km road race held in the recreational areas of Bilcza Park in the municipality of Morawica. The event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages. On race day, children’s races and a family festival are also held. The race is open to all and promotes active recreation in the scenic Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship.

name: 23 Wilcza Dycha
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association. The event promotes an active lifestyle and attracts runners from the region, offering a scenic course surrounded by the Tuchola Forests. The race takes place in Osieczna and is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. Participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Night Five is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level and earn recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime character. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by offering refreshments after the race and awarding the winners.

name: 8 Bieg Chwalisza
description: The 8th edition of the Chwalisz Run is an annual charity race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Ściernie. The start and finish are located at Preschool No. 1 – Ściernie branch. The 5 km course runs mainly along forest trails, with minimal asphalt, offering both challenges and the joy of running for experienced competitors and beginners alike. All entry fees will go toward supporting Antoś Synowiec, a child with a rare genetic disease, underscoring the charitable nature of the event. The organizers also invite participants to join group training sessions every Thursday at 19:00.

name: Bieg Iskry
description: Bieg Iskry is a unique running event taking place on June 13, 2026, at Mielec Airport. Participants will cover a 6.5 km route along the runway beneath the illuminated lights and setting sun, creating a one-of-a-kind aviation atmosphere. The organizers provide professional medals, T-shirts featuring an Iskra aircraft, and prizes in the form of trophies and tandem-flight vouchers. After the run, participants can admire the aircraft and enjoy refreshments and dietary supplements.

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
description: The eighth nationwide “Prescription for Health” run will take place on June 13, 2026, at Arturówek in Łódź. This healthy running event promotes physical activity, integration between the running and pharmaceutical communities, and a healthy lifestyle. The routes follow a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest, with 5 km and 10 km race distances and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Shorter races for children and young people will be held on the same route. A family picnic with free screenings and consultations will take place near the start and finish.

name: II Leśny Bieg Gminy Brzeźnio - Tumidaj
Leśna ZaDyszka
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin municipality, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in woodland surroundings. The course consists of a 5 km loop that runs along forest tracks and an asphalt section, showcasing the beauty of the Masovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (two loops), and 5 km Nordic Walking. A 1.5 km fun run without rankings is planned for children. The start and finish are located in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.

name: Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Radomsku
description: The 13th Radomsko Street Run, the Marian Szymański Memorial, is an annual running event held in Radomsko in memory of Marian Szymański. The race takes place on the city streets, offering participants the chance to compete in a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the City of Radomsko and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Radomsko, with timing provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 17:30, and online registration is open until June 10, 2026.

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The 8th Kwidzyn zaDyszka is a 10 km road race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Kwidzyn. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is open to runners with varying levels of experience who want to spend time actively and compete on a moderately challenging course. The organizers provide expert support and access to a platform for managing race information.

name: XII Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar ...
description: The 12th Provincial Badger Cup Cross-Country Run is a running event organized by the Municipality of Murów. It will take place on June 13, 2026, in Zagwiździe, on the grounds of the historic Ironworks complex. The event includes several categories: a 12 km run, a 3.5 km run, children’s races, and Nordic walking. The race office will be open from 8:00 to 9:30, and timing will be electronic. This sporting event combines competition with a beautiful historic setting, encouraging physical activity and community engagement.

name: XIX Bieg Marszałka
description: The 19th Marshal’s Run is an annual road race held in Sulejówek, commemorating the tradition of the pre-war Sulejówek–Belweder marches. The main race, approximately 10 km long, takes place in June, recalling Józef Piłsudski’s settling in Sulejówek. The event also includes accompanying races, including the 3.6 km Halina Zielińska Memorial and races for children. The race has a patriotic and sporting character, with uniformed services and museum professionals taking part. The start and finish are at 94 Paderewskiego Street, beside Villa Bzów.

name: XV Bieg Szlakiem Króla Zygmunta Starego
description: The 15th Run Along the Trail of King Sigismund the Old is an annual race held in Kozienice, commemorating the historic route associated with King Sigismund the Old. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering a scenic route and sporting competition. The organizers provide professional support and a friendly atmosphere for participants.

name: 200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
XIX Bieg Zajączkowski
location: Zajączki Drugie, Gmina Krzepice, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVI Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku
location: Morzyczyn, Stargard County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 55. Bartenwetzer Volkslauf
description: The Bartenwetzer Volkslauf is the oldest people’s race in North Hesse and takes place on 30 May 2026 at Waldstadion Melsungen. The event includes children’s and schoolchildren’s races over 400 m and 1,000 m, as well as races over 5 km, 10 km and 19 km on firm paths through Melsungen city forest. As the 10th scoring race in the Nordhessencup, it offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, award ceremonies and a buffet. The start and finish areas are centrally located at Waldstadion, which also has changing facilities.
course_highlights: Races on firm paths through the beautiful Melsungen city forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Melsungen, on the edge of the city forest
Distances: 5 km, 10 km and 19 km, as well as children’s races on the track
additional: Race-pack collection from 14:30 at the MT clubhouse in Waldstadion. Same-day entries are not possible. Changing rooms are available at the MT clubhouse. Refreshments include water on the longer courses, hot tea at the finish, and a buffet with coffee, cake and bratwurst from 15:30. Medical services provided by the German Red Cross. Certificates and medals for the Bambini and 1,000 m races; certificates can be printed on site or accessed online. The event is subject to the applicable regulations for road races and running events held away from a stadium. Register online via RaceResult. The event at Waldstadion Melsungen includes award ceremonies, refreshments and medical support.

name: SV Greven Deichlauf
description: The SV Greven Deichlauf on May 30, 2026, offers an unforgettable running experience along the idyllic Ems dike and through the town forest. The route, surrounded by nature, is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes, and is accompanied by numerous spectators. Around 1,000 runners take part, seeking both a sporting challenge and an experience in nature.
course_highlights: Loop course from Emsaue Stadium along the Ems dike
Route passes through the town forest
Nature-filled running route with many spectators
additional: Running event, loop course, experience in nature, approx. 1,000 participants, official timing, medals for children and age groups

name: Ketteler-Lauf, Lauf dem Krebs davon
description: The Ketteler Run is a charity run taking place on June 13, 2026, in Offenbach under the motto “Run away from cancer.” Proceeds from the run support care for cancer patients. The starting gun will go off at 3:00 p.m. on Obere Grenzstraße in Offenbach. Participants who register in advance can collect their race numbers and finisher T-shirts at Ketteler Hospital on June 12. The event is an established tradition that combines athletic commitment with a social purpose.
course_highlights: Start on Obere Grenzstraße, approximately at house number 119, Offenbach
Charity run supporting care for cancer patients
Race numbers and finisher T-shirts can be collected in advance at Ketteler Hospital
additional: Race numbers and finisher T-shirts can be collected on June 12, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. in the reception area of Ketteler Hospital. On the day of the event, collection is also available from 12:00 p.m. to 2:00 p.m. in the hospital courtyard. The run includes distances of 5 km and 7 km, with on-site registration available. The event is part of an annual series of charity runs to combat cancer and offers finisher T-shirts to participants.

name: Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf
location: Kurpark Bad Nenndorf, Bad Nenndorf, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf is a long-standing, DLV-approved public race and part of the Schaumburg Running Series. It takes place in the beautiful Kurpark in Bad Nenndorf and offers distances for different age and ability groups, including 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5 km, 10 km, and 5 km walking and Nordic walking. The event is family-friendly and attracts many participants, who run on paved paths through the park. In addition to the sporting competition, there is an attractive supporting program and good facilities, including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through the Kurpark
Start and finish on Kurpromenade by the Wandelhalle
A range of distances from 1,000 m to 10 km, plus walking options
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports center, which can be reached by bus shuttle. Insurance coverage is provided through an LSB contract. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Medical support is provided. A maximum of 300 participants in the 1,000 m and 2.5 km races. The 5 km Nordic walking and walking events are timed, with no placings. First race for the Samtgemeinde Cup. Scoring race in the Schaumburg Running Series. The race takes place as part of the State Garden Show, with various distances and a family-friendly atmosphere. Early registration is possible, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: Mut-Lauf
description: The MUT-LAUF Kiel is an annual running event that promotes greater openness and courage in addressing mental illness. Its aim is to take a stand against stigma and raise awareness of mental health. The event celebrates moving together without pressure to perform and is open to everyone, regardless of age, fitness level or physical limitations. Alongside the run, there is a varied program featuring music, interviews, food and drink, and a marketplace with information on mental health and prevention.
course_highlights: A run for everyone, with no pressure to perform, including wheelchair users
Event held at Moorteichwiesen in Kiel
Program featuring music, interviews and a marketplace
additional: Registration is available online via the Davengo portal or in person at KIELER FENSTER, Ambulantes Zentrum. The event takes place every year on the Saturday before Kiel Week begins. The program includes activities for the whole family and a marketplace featuring self-help groups and social services. The MUT-LAUF 2026 takes place on June 13, 2026, with registration via the Davengo portal. Entry fees are €10 for adults and €5 for children. Information about self-help groups and a sociable accompanying program will be provided.

name: Oelder Citylauf
description: The Oelde City Run is a traditional running classic in the heart of Oelde that has delighted runners of all ages for over 45 years. The event offers a varied programme featuring Bambini, schoolchildren’s and inclusive races, as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The races take place before a large crowd in a festival-like atmosphere and are part of the Volksbank Cup race series. The course is measured to international standards and runs through Oelde city centre, with the start and finish at the Market Square.
course_highlights: An internationally measured 2.5 km lap, repeated as required for each distance
The course runs through Oelde city centre, with the start and finish at the Market Square
A variety of races for all ages, including Bambini and inclusive races
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a late-entry fee of EUR 3.00. Race packets can be collected at the event centre on the Market Square. Certificates for the schoolchildren’s and Bambini races are available on site; certificates for the other races are available online. Showers are available at the Oelde Comprehensive School sports hall, approximately 300 m from the finish. Registration is via Raceresult; the event is known for its diverse categories and friendly atmosphere.

name: Straßenlauf Gollhofen mit Mittelfränkischer Meisterschaft über 10 km
location: Gollhofen, Landkreis Neustadt an der Aisch-Bad Windsheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Gollhofen Road Race will take place for the 26th time on June 13, 2026, and includes the Central Franconian 10 km Championship. The event is hosted by FC Gollhofen and gives runners the opportunity to take part in a long-established competition. Further details and information are available in the announcement on the website. The event is aimed at ambitious runners and running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km road race with the Central Franconian Championship
Established race with more than 25 years of history
Event in the municipality of Gollhofen, Würzburg district
additional: The German Sports Badge event will take place on June 14, 2026, from 1:00 p.m. The girls’ taster training session is on July 4, 2026, from 10:00 a.m.; registration by email is required by June 26. Registration for the road race is via the link provided on the website. Further details are included in the flyer and event announcement. The race takes place on a road course at the Gollhofen sports grounds. Registration is online, and the event also includes youth categories. The event offers a good opportunity to meet the running community in the region.

name: Söltjerlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 3,- € Kinder und Jugendliche bis einschl. Jg. 2007

description: The Söltjerlauf in Bad Münder is a charity run in the beautiful Süntel, where every lap counts. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, from children to marathon runners, and features a shaded forest loop of approx. 3.8 km with a refreshment point. Participants have four hours to run as many laps as possible, with the proceeds going to a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health, and invites participants to stay after the run for catering and the awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Shaded forest loop of approx. 3.8 km
Refreshment point on the course
Atmosphere at the Bergschmiede restaurant, with catering
additional: A shuttle service will be available from 09:30 to get participants to the 11:00 start on time. Online late registration is possible until 12.06.2026, with a late-registration fee of 3 euros. Every participant receives a certificate stating the distance they ran. Prizes will be awarded to the top individual runners and the top 10 teams. Parking is limited, so using the alternative parking areas and bus shuttle is recommended. Dogs are allowed only on a short leash and may not participate as members of a team. Competition open to all age groups; sponsors donate for local projects for every lap completed. Venue at Bergschmiede, supported by local sponsors including Sparkasse Hameln-Weserbergland and Ardagh Group.

name: Volksbank Haren Citylauf
description: The 27th Volksbank Haren City Run takes place on June 13, 2026, and offers an attractive, fast course through the center of Haren. The 5 km and 10 km races are measured by the DLV and eligible for official rankings, making them ideal for competitive athletes and recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in dedicated 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km races. There is also a team competition in the 5 km race, with teams from companies, clubs or other groups eligible to compete.
course_highlights: Attractive, fast course through the center of Haren
The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for official rankings
Dedicated races for children and young people over 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km
additional: All participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive a finisher shirt. Entry fees are paid by direct debit. The 5 km race has a team competition for teams of at least 3 people. Children attending Haren's daycare centers and schools can take part for free if their institution participates. Large trophies and certificates are awarded in the school competitions. Free entry for children on school and daycare teams, registration until June 7, 2026, prizes for winners and teams, parking nearby

name: Gellershäuser Abendlauf
location: Sportplatz in Gellershausen, Edertal, Hesse, Germany
organizer: Turn und Sportverein Hessen 1848 Frankenberg Eder e.V.
description: The Gellershausen Evening Run takes place at the sports ground in Gellershausen, Edertal, and offers races for children and school students, as well as a 10-kilometer race and a half marathon. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup and attracts runners of various age groups. The course runs through scenic surroundings and offers a pleasant running atmosphere in June. Information about registration, the course, results, and photos is available.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10-kilometer courses starting at Gellershausen Sports Ground
Children’s and school students’ races included
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup
additional: Typical June weather: around 23 °C during the day and 13 °C at night, mostly sunny, with an average of 65 mm of precipitation. Children’s and youth races with distances of around 400 m and 1,000 m; the event promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.

name: 12. Heilwald Marathon
description: The 12th Heilwald Marathon takes place on June 13, 2026, in Bad Lippspringe. The course consists of six large loops of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and runs through the unique Heilwald, whose calming low-mountain climate and species-rich forest offer a special running experience. The event is a private, self-supported race with manual timekeeping; a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participation is at your own risk, and voluntary donations for tree planting are welcome.

name: 13. Himmelswegelauf
description: The 13th Himmelswegelauf on June 13, 2026, takes participants through a unique cultural landscape around Nebra (Unstrut). The race routes connect important archaeological sites such as the Pömmelte Ring Sanctuary, the Goseck Solar Observatory, and the find site of the Nebra Sky Disc. The start and finish are at the Arche Nebra visitor center, near the Sky Disc, considered the oldest concrete depiction of the cosmos. Alongside the marathon, half marathon, and 10 km Sky Disc Run, the event also offers walking, cycling tours, and hikes to the find site. Held under the patronage of the Minister-President of Saxony-Anhalt, the event offers an appealing blend of culture and sport.

name: 15. Fullestrand-Ultramarathon
description: The Fullestrand Ultramarathon takes place on June 13, 2026, in Kassel and features a challenging 46.5 km course along the Fulda with approximately 350 meters of elevation gain. The route heads upstream from Kassel, follows the Fuldahöhenweg, and returns along the Fuldaradweg, passing through varied landscapes and natural areas. The event is organized by Laufwerk Kassel under the direction of Sylke Kuhn and combines a sporting challenge with the beauty of North Hesse’s nature and culture.

name: 18. Edeka Ladage-Lauf
description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen is a long-standing community race with a variety of events for all age groups. The event takes place at the Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School sports facility and offers varied loop courses for everyone from kindergarten children to experienced runners. The longer races follow a slightly modified 2.5 km loop, with the start and finish close to the event area, creating a special atmosphere. Alongside the competition, the event also emphasizes a sense of community, supported by a prize draw and a dedicated team of volunteers.

name: 23. Sudenburg-Lauf - Der Lauf mit dem Lächeln
description: The Sudenburg Run is held under the motto “By runners, for runners” and takes place on June 13, 2026, at Heinrich Germer Stadium in Magdeburg. The event is distinguished by a passion for running and for the Sudenburg district. There are various running routes for children, young people, and adults, leading through the city and the stadium. The focus is on getting as many people as possible running and putting a smile on their faces.

name: Ottermeerlauf
description: The Ottermeerlauf in Wiesmoor is a traditional race taking place on June 13, 2026. The event offers a varied course and a motivating atmosphere, and is open to individual runners and relay teams. A particular highlight is the 6-hour ultramarathon, which is part of the Nordcup and is open to runners aged 18 and over. Every finisher receives a custom medal shaped like the outline of the Ottermeer, featuring the mascot Otti.

name: 24h Lauf Halberstadt
description: The 24-hour run at the Friedensstadion Halberstadt takes place on June 12, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. and is organized by VfB Germania Halberstadt in cooperation with the Halberstadt Leisure and Sports Center. The goal is to keep runners on the track continuously for the entire 24 hours. The event is part of VfB Germania’s club festival, where various sports departments introduce themselves and invite visitors to take part. Alongside the run, there are traditional activities such as pulling a coach on the track. The event offers a sporting challenge and a sociable program for participants and spectators.

name: Fischland-Darss-Zingst-Ultramarathon (FDZU)
description: The Fischland-Darss-Zingst Ultramarathon (FDZU) is the longest nature experience run in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and will take place for the 10th time on June 13, 2026. The course runs through the unique Baltic Sea coastal landscape from Rostock to Stralsund, offering runners a special nature experience along the region’s peninsulas and islands. The race is shaped by its tradition and distinctive atmosphere, created by the combination of nature, challenge, and community. Registration opens on July 1, 2025, and closes on May 31, 2026.

name: Harsefelder Lauf- und Musikfestival
organizer: Lauftreff Harsefeld, LSC Harsefeld, Stadtmarketing Harsefeld
description: The 20th Running and Music Festival in Harsefeld takes place on June 13, 2026, combining sporting challenges with musical entertainment. Runners of all ages can take part in various distances, from children’s and toddler races to short-distance and long-distance races and relays. In the evening, Marktstraße becomes a lively party zone with an open-air disco and live music. The festival is a fixture on Harsefeld’s events calendar and, in addition to sports, offers a colorful children’s program and food stalls.

name: Kalimandscharolauf 2026
description: The 13th Kalimandscharolauf 2026 takes place on 13 June 2026 in Zielitz and is organised by SV Kali Wolmirstedt e.V., Athletics Department. The event is hosted by K+S Minerals and Agriculture GmbH, Zielitz plant. The race is held away from the stadium and offers runners an attractive course in the Magdeburg/Börde region. Registration is open until 6 June 2026.

name: Kidsmarathon
description: The Pillenstein KIDSmarathon on June 13, 2026, is an inclusive running event for up to 4,000 children aged 1 to 11. Children can choose their own distance, with fun and participation at the forefront. There is no timing, and every participant is a winner. The event offers a great atmosphere and a varied program, and is designed to be accessible so that children with disabilities can also take part.

name: Lauf um den Senftenberger See
description: The 49th Run Around Senftenberg Lake takes place on June 13, 2026, offering runners a choice of distances around scenic Senftenberg Lake. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, from the Bambini race to the challenging 17.7 km lake loop. Races start from 09:00 in front of the Seesporthalle Großkoschen, with a friendly atmosphere, comprehensive refreshments, and changing and washing facilities. Registration is online via myRacePartner, with late registration available until race day for a small fee.

name: Luckenwalder Turmfestlauf
description: The Luckenwalde Tower Festival takes place from 12 to 14 June 2026 around the Market Tower in Luckenwalde. It is a traditional town festival, open and accessible to all visitors, regardless of their budget. The festival offers a varied cultural programme and invites guests from near and far to celebrate together. The city is committed to an open festival by the people of Luckenwalde, for the people of Luckenwalde, and welcomes voluntary donations to support the event.

name: OSTSEE Run
description: The OSTSEE Run by ROTEC is a sporting highlight as part of the OSTSEE Sports Games in Cottbus. The race offers an attractive course for runners and walkers and is part of a varied sports and leisure program featuring numerous other competitions and activities. The event welcomes sports enthusiasts of all ages and, in addition to the sporting competition, offers a lively program of activities and a large OSTSEE party with free admission. This combination of sporting event and celebration makes the OSTSEE Run a special experience in the region.

name: OSTSEE Sparkassen Halbmarathon
description: The SPARKASSEN Half Marathon takes place on June 13, 2026, in Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee. The course covers 21 kilometers and starts at 10:00 from the Möbel Höffner grounds. Race bibs can be collected from 7:00 in the start and finish area. The race is suitable for participants aged 18 and over and offers an attractive route along the Baltic coast. On-site registration is not available; participants must register in advance.

name: Panorama-Baumwipfel-Lauf 2026
description: The Panorama Treetop Run 2026 is an appealing running event in the Steigerwald that attracts runners from all over Germany. The varied routes pass through vineyards and the Steigerwald Nature Park, along winding trails and forest paths. The half-marathon and 12 km routes go via the tower of the Steigerwald Treetop Walk and return via Oberschwarzach Herrenberg. The start and finish are at the Panorama Terrace at the sports facility / Sebastianihaus Oberschwarzach, and the course offers beautiful new views around every bend.

name: Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg
description: The Skatstadt Marathon Altenburg is a challenging running event taking place on 13 June 2026 in Altenburg. Participants can choose from various distances, including the marathon, marathon relay for pairs, half marathon, 13.3 km run, fitness run, student and children’s races, and walking events. The course takes runners through the historic town of Altenburg, with varied sections including climbs in the town forest and along the Großer Teich. In addition to the sporting challenge, the accompanying programme offers a wide range of entertainment, including music, a children’s festival, and a talk by running legend Uta Pippig.

name: Tollenseseelauf
description: The Neubrandenburg Tollensesee Run is a scenic race around Lake Tollensesee that attracts more than 2,000 runners each year. With distances for young and old, the event offers a varied running festival in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is challenging, with several climbs, which is why the race is also known as “The Toughest in the North.” More than 300 volunteers help create an unforgettable running experience, with certificates, technical T-shirts, and trophies for the top finishers.

name: Waaker Bystopen-Attacke
description: The Waaker Bystopen Attack is an obstacle race in Lower Saxony, held around the Waaker Büsteppe in the Göttingen Forest. The event offers distances of 2.5 km (family run), 5 km and 10 km, with more than 30 natural and artificial obstacles. You can participate individually or as part of a team; team scoring requires at least 4 runners. Alongside the main race, there is also a Bambini Attack for the youngest participants, which does not require registration. The event focuses on fun, team spirit and exercise in nature.

name: Bürgerlauf Visbek
description: The 1st Visbek Citizens’ Run takes place on June 13, 2026, at Park Visbek (Pastors Wisk) and offers a varied program for runners of different ages and ability levels. The event includes Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, as well as intermediate and main races over 5 km and 10 km, complemented by a walking or hiking route. Race number distribution begins at 3:00 p.m. on the event day, and all races are professionally measured. Proceeds go to the Visbek Citizens’ Foundation, making this a sporting event with a social commitment.

name: Drebber-Marathon
description: The Drebber Run on June 13, 2026, offers a diverse selection of competitions for all age groups and ability levels. The course follows an officially measured 2.34 km loop through the Jacobidrebber district, with the start and finish at the sports field. In addition to individual and relay events ranging from a children’s race to a marathon, there is an attractive supporting program for spectators and participants. Emergency services personnel are especially invited to take part in the Blue Light Cup as a relay team and showcase their performance.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Olomouc 2026
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc 2026 is a traditional half marathon that takes you through the beauty of Olomouc’s historic center. The start and finish are on Upper Square, where you can admire the Holy Trinity Column and the town hall with its unique astronomical clock. During the race, you’ll enjoy the city’s atmosphere, historic buildings, and beautiful parks. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also offers an accompanying program.

name: Horem dolem Chospílem
description: Horem dolem Chospílem is a 9.2 km interval-start running race that follows meadows and farm tracks around Postřekov in the Chospíl area. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series and offers runners pleasant terrain in a natural setting. The interval start makes for an interesting race format. This race is suitable for runners looking for a mix of nature and sporting challenge in the Plzeň Region.

name: Sokolovský  ¼ maraton
organizer: Živý kraj – Destinační agentura pro Karlovarský kraj, z.s.
description: The Sokolov Quarter Marathon is a running event taking place on June 13, 2026, in Sokolov in the Karlovy Vary Region. The course runs mainly through scenic parts of the city and the surrounding countryside, and is approximately 10.5 km long. The event is intended both for recreational runners and for those who want to experience the atmosphere of a race in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience for all participants.

name: Dobročinný běh po stopách Silver A
description: We invite you to the 3rd annual charity run and walk, In the Footsteps of Silver A, organized by the Zámeček Memorial in Pardubice. The event is suitable for athletes and non-athletes, children and adults, and the entry fees go to charitable causes. The run offers two routes—a shorter 5-kilometer route and a longer 10-kilometer route—as well as a children’s race of approximately 1 kilometer. There will also be a guided walk through the city to places associated with the Silver A parachute group, starting at the Zámeček Memorial.

name: Hradecký koloběh
description: Hradecký Koloběh is a mixed-pair race held in the beautiful surroundings of the city forests, starting at Biřička. The race combines running and cycling: one team member runs while the other rides a bike. Competitors can switch at any time during the race, adding strategy and excitement. The event celebrates team spirit and the joy of movement, with OPEN and FAMILY categories. It is held with the support of the City of Hradec Králové and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Jinecký kros
organizer: Městys Jince a Jinečáček, z. s.
description: Jinecký kros is a traditional running race held in Jince, offering a challenging course approximately 5.7 km long with around 178 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are at the football pitch by the Biokoupaliště, which provides facilities for runners, including parking, changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The course runs along asphalt roads, forest paths and meadows, and includes crossing a wooden footbridge, running on asphalt roads and climbing Vystrkov hill. The race is suitable for adults and children, who have their own categories. The main race starts at 11:00.

name: Jindřichohradecký půlmaraton
description: The Jindřichův Hradec Half Marathon 2026 is the tenth anniversary edition of a running race offering a unique experience that combines the town’s picturesque historic centre, sections along the water, and natural stretches with significant elevation gain. The race is open to individuals running 21.1 km, as well as relay teams, families, and schools taking part in shorter races. The atmosphere is enhanced by fans and music, with race services including refreshment stations and showers. A special Rebel Run is also planned for schools, focusing on teamwork rather than time. The race starts on 13 June 2026. Participants will receive original medals and can win prizes.

name: Neveklovské běhy
organizer: kulturní a sportovní komise města Neveklov
description: Neveklov Runs is a traditional running event held in the picturesque Castle Park in Neveklov. The race offers runners of all abilities the chance to enjoy a run in the park’s pleasant surroundings and friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the wider Běžec Podblanicka running race calendar, which promotes an active lifestyle and brings athletes in the region together.

name: 7 pohoří Jeseníky
description: Jeseníky 2026 is a technical trail race in the beautiful countryside beneath Králický Sněžník, offering three courses of varying distances and elevation gain. The routes have been prepared by members of the local mountain rescue service and run mostly through natural terrain. Participants can enjoy a professionally marked course, chip timing, refreshments along the route and at the finish, and a commemorative medal. The event takes place in all weather conditions and is suitable for all trail-running enthusiasts looking for epic views and an atmosphere they won’t find anywhere else.

name: Okrouhelský běh
description: The Okrouhlá Run is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, held in the picturesque village of Okrouhlá in the Liberec Region. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to enjoy a run in a natural setting with a friendly atmosphere. The Okrouhlá Run is part of a series of regional running races that promote an active lifestyle and community sports.

name: Extrem Run 5Hills
description: Extrem Run 5 Hills is an ultratrail running race in the westernmost part of the Czech Republic, offering a challenging 91-kilometre course with 2,174 metres of elevation gain. The route crosses five peaks of Egerland and combines paved roads, cycling and hiking trails, and forest terrain. The race is intended for experienced runners seeking an extreme sporting challenge and stunning panoramas. The organizers place emphasis on accurate timekeeping and participant safety. The race takes place in the scenic Vojtanov area and also offers relay and two-person duathlon options.

name: Běh na Pajrek
description: Běh na Pajrek is the second edition of a running race organized by TJ Nýrsko, taking place on June 13, 2026, at the venue below the ski slope in Nýrsko. The race offers men an 8.6 km course (2 laps) and women a 4.2 km course (1 lap), with 152 meters of elevation gain per lap. The finish is at the same location as the start. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Ešus League, with refreshments available at the venue. The organizers note that the course may change due to construction work and provide prizes in kind for the top finishers in each category.

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: Ultra Nízke Tatry is the first edition of a mountain running event that follows the ridge of the Low Tatras from west to east. The course is 49.7 km long, with 2,650 metres of elevation gain, and follows hiking trails from Donovaly to Srdiečko. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and also serves as the Milan Styko Memorial, honouring the renowned runner and mountaineer who tragically died in 2025. The start is scheduled for 13 June 2026 at 7:00 a.m. in Donovaly, by the Donovalský pivovar.

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska Mašľa is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike around Strečno, taking place on 13 June 2026. The race offers two routes: a challenging 50 km course with approximately 2,985 metres of elevation gain and a shorter 25 km course, which is also suitable for runners with dogs. The routes follow marked hiking trails through both parts of the Malá Fatra and part of the national park. The start and finish are at the Radinové football field in Strečno. The organisers provide race packs, prizes for the top finishers, and quality facilities for participants.

name: Krosak pod hradom
location: Trnava pri Laborci, okr. Michalovce, Trnava pri Laborci, okr. Michalovce, Obecný úrad
organizer: Mgr. Ján Podstavský, Vladimír Adam, Ing. Ladislav Ondrik, Vladimír Sikorai, Gabriel Sabo, Štefan Karafa
description: Krosák pod hradom is a running race in Trnava pri Laborci, offering various categories, including the 10 km Big Cross, the 5 km Small Cross, a health run, and Nordic walking. The course follows farm and forest roads with asphalt surfaces, and the Big Cross consists of two 5 km loops. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League and is suitable for a wide range of runners, from juniors to veterans. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Trnava pri Laborci, with children’s categories starting at 9:00 and the main race at 11:00.

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca
description: The Kysuce Marathon is the second-oldest marathon in Slovakia and a major sporting and social event in the Kysuce region. The course follows the picturesque Kysuce Valley along the Kysuca River, with a safer and more attractive route on the cycling path for runners from 2025. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, a marathon relay, and a minimarathon for children. The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca, in front of the House of Culture. Runners compete in various age categories and have access to aid stations and facilities including changing rooms and wellness services.

name: Beh Hodkovským parkom
location: Žehra časť Hodkovce, Žehra časť Hodkovce, Kaštieľ Hodkovce 1, Žehra, areál DSS DOMOVINA no.
description: The Run Through Hodkovce Park is a running event held in the grounds of Hodkovce Manor in Žehra. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads with an asphalt surface. The event is divided into categories: an 8 km competitive run for men and women in various age groups, and non-competitive 4 km categories for Run for Health and Nordic walking, with no age limit. The organizer, DOMOVINA n.o., ensures a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization for all participants. Online entry is available at a discounted price, encouraging early registration.

name: Beh Kalváriou
description: The Kalvária Run is a charity race held in the beautiful surroundings of Kalvária in Považská Bystrica. The event offers courses for both adults and children, with forest roads making up the course surface. This fourth edition is an opportunity to experience community, exercise and joy, while the proceeds from the run go to children in need. The organizers emphasize high-quality organization and support for charitable causes.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo
location: Lemešany, Lemešany, Lúka nad obcou Lemešany
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany, Záhrada pohybu
description: The 2nd Summer Round of the Lemešany Running League is a running event held in Lemešany, on the meadow above the village. The race is divided into several categories by age and gender, including children’s categories and Nordic walking. The main categories start at 17:00, and the children’s categories start at 17:10. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for a summer race.

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranské Matliare, Tatranské Matliare, Kežmarská Biela voda, pri zastávke SAD
description: The Run to the Green Lake Hut is a mountain race for sports and nature enthusiasts, suitable for both amateur and professional athletes. The event has been held regularly since 2005 on the second weekend of June and commemorates Karel Jakeš, a prominent Czechoslovak mountaineer. The route crosses challenging mountain terrain with significant elevation gain, making the race a test for all participants. The aim is to bring together different sporting groups and offer them a unique experience in the beautiful surroundings of the High Tatras.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Krakės - Laiko ratu“
organizer: Krakių bendruomenės centras, Krakių kultūros centras, Krakių seniūnija
description: The “Krakės - Laiko ratu” running event is a traditional national race held in the town of Krakės, Kėdainiai District. The race welcomes everyone, from professionals to beginners and recreational runners, with a range of distances for different age groups. The start and finish are in the town centre, at Laisvės Square. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and awards in various age categories. Participants are served traditional šiupinys, and wooden outdoor games by “LPA GAMES” are available during the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Laisvės Square in the town of Krakės
Different distances for age groups: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
The 600 m “Pagauk gandrą” race on the Krakių garbės ratas for children and families
additional: Race numbers are issued from 11:00. The opening ceremony and the 600 m “Pagauk gandrą” race begin at 11:30. All participants are served šiupinys prepared by the Krakės Community Centre. Wooden outdoor games by “LPA GAMES” are available during the event. Awards are given to age-group winners, the youngest and oldest participants, and the fastest 10 km runners. Advance registration is online, and the entry fee is paid by bank transfer. Various distances and age groups are available, with games and activities also taking place during the event.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: TATRA FEST 2026
description: Tatra Fest is a unique mountain festival held in Zakopane, bringing together a variety of outdoor disciplines, including trail running, climbing, cycling, trekking, and family activities. The event includes challenging races along Tatra trails, such as the 68 km Tatra Fest Bieg and the 22 km Tatra Fest Run, offering participants unforgettable experiences amid the Tatras’ picturesque landscapes. The festival attracts both professionals and amateurs, promoting physical activity, connection with nature, and environmental responsibility. The organizers invite everyone to celebrate life and the mountain spirit together.

name: Zawojski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Zawoja Running Festival is one of the largest sporting events in the region, held amid the picturesque scenery of Babia Góra and the Police Mountain Range. The festival attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering a variety of mountain race distances and a unique atmosphere. The event aims to popularize mountain running and promote the beauty of Babia Góra National Park, combining a sporting adventure with an opportunity to discover the region’s natural and cultural wealth.

name: XVII Elbląski Bieg Piekarczyka Mini Bieg Piekarczyka
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Elblągu
description: The 17th Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is an annual running event held in Elbląg, attracting runners to the 5 km and 10 km races, as well as the Mini Piekarczyk Run for children. The event is known for its unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and community, and participants receive exclusive collectible medals. The organizers provide comfortable race-day facilities, including a race office where participants can collect their race packs, a baggage deposit, and sanitary facilities. The race is a great opportunity to enjoy an active day and compete on the city’s scenic routes.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The CZTERY PORY ROKU Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking march along the same route. The event is charitable and coordinated by the „Biegnij Oławo” Association of Active People and the Oława Municipal Office. The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30, and the start is scheduled for the same day. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.

name: Dziki Trail
description: Dziki Groń is a demanding mountain course in the Pieniny Ultra-Trail® series, following hiking and courier routes as well as the pastures of the Little Pieniny Mountains. The race offers scenic views of the Tatras and the Beskid Mountains, with the start and finish at Dietl Square in Szczawnica. The course is intended for experienced mountain runners looking to take on challenging natural terrain. The event is part of the Pieniny Ultra-Trail mountain running festival, which promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region.

name: IV Charytatywny Bieg z Żonkilem
organizer: Zespół Szkół Ekonomicznych im. Gen. Stefana Roweckiego "Grota" w Opolu
description: The 4th Charity Daffodil Run is a sporting event organized by the Gen. Stefan Rowecki “Grot” School of Economics in Opole. The event will take place on June 14, 2026, on Bolko Island by the Laba Café. Participants can take part in a 5 km run, a 2.5 km Nordic walking event, or support the cause without participating. The run is a charity event that promotes physical activity and support for those in need.

name: Rozbiegane Suwałki
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Rozbiegane Suwałki is an annual citywide celebration of running held in June in Suwałki. The three-day event attracts hundreds of participants of all ages and ability levels. The program includes children’s races, the Bieg na Piątkę (5 km), the Suwalska Ćwiartka (10.5 km), and the Śniadaniowy Bieg na Wyspę (approx. 3.5 km). The courses are flat and fast, making them ideal for personal bests, and the atmosphere is full of sporting competition and community spirit.

name: Suszecki dziki bieg
description: Suszecki Dziki Bieg is a running event organized by the Suszec Municipal Sports Centre, promoting an active lifestyle among children, young people, and adults. The races will take place on June 13–14, 2026, at the Gwaruś Recreation Centre in Suszec. Participants can compete over 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon (21 km) distances, as well as in races for children and young people. Combined classifications over 5+21 km and 10+21 km, with prizes in kind, are available for the most determined runners. The friendly atmosphere welcomes both recreational and more experienced runners.

name: VIII Rodzinny Festiwal Biegowy o Złotą K...
description: The 8th Family Running Festival for the Golden K takes place in Dobczyce and is organized by the Rozbiegane Dobczyce group, which has brought together runners from Dobczyce and the surrounding area since 2016. This family running event promotes physical activity and the integration of the local community. The festival welcomes all participants, regardless of age or experience level.

name: X Bieg o Złotą Monetę
description: The 9th Charity Run for the Golden Coin in Olsztyn is an annual running event organized by the Future for Children Foundation, which supports sick and disabled children in Warmia and Mazury. The 5 km main race takes place by Lake Ukiel and is suitable for everyone, including first-time runners. The event also features a family picnic and numerous attractions. Taking part is not only a sporting competition, but above all a way to support children in need. The main race is scheduled to start at 16:30, and the scenic course is also accessible to those who prefer walking.

name: Maraton Smolecki
location: Smolec, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Mrowna Run Grodzisk łączy w biegu
Kefenröder Dorflauf
description: The 35th Dorflauf in Kefenrod takes place on June 13, 2026, and is organized by Turnverein 1908 Kefenrod e.V. The event gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in a long-standing race in the idyllic surroundings of Kefenrod. Registration is via the Oberhessencup website, making it easy to sign up in advance. The race is an established part of club life and promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.
course_highlights: Four laps through Kefenrod with varied elevation
Distances of 1 km and 10 km for different ability levels
Festive awards ceremony with food and a community atmosphere
additional: Registration is via the Oberhessencup website (ohc18). No start times or pricing tiers are listed directly on the website. The race is part of the club life of TV 1908 Kefenrod e.V. It is also part of the local running calendar and, alongside the competition, offers a sociable atmosphere, with coffee, cake, beer, and grilled food at the awards ceremony.

name: Barmstedter Stadtlauf
description: The 22nd Barmstedter City Run takes place on 14 June 2026 in Barmstedt. The event features measured, course-record-eligible 5 km and 10 km circuits. In addition to the main races, there are Nordic walking, walking, children’s races and Bambini races. The start and finish are at the Market Square in Barmstedt, and the course runs through the town centre and around Lake Rantzau, over a variety of surfaces including cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths.
course_highlights: Measured, course-record-eligible 5 km and 10 km circuits
Course through Barmstedt town centre and around Lake Rantzau
Varied surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths
additional: Timing uses a rental chip worn around the ankle (except in the children’s races); the chip is collected at the finish. Unreturned chips will be charged at 40 euros. Baby joggers and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. Different age categories and minimum ages apply to the races. The course may vary slightly due to construction work; information will then be posted on the website. Courses are measured; online registration is available; no late entries; refreshments and medals included.

name: Donatus-Lauf
location: Sportgelände SC Fortuna Liblar, Hamburg-Rissen, Hamburg, Germany
description: The Donatuslauf takes place on June 14, 2026, around Lake Donatus at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds in Hamburg-Rissen. The event offers various race distances, from a 400 m Bambini run and 1,200 m children’s races to a half marathon and a 10 km main race. The races are designed for different age groups and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with additional walking and family races. The course is varied and well marked, with the start and finish area close to Erftstadt railway station. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races, and certificates can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400 m to the half marathon
Start and finish area near Erftstadt railway station, with easy access
Family run and Nordic walking as additional options
additional: Late entries are accepted only until the participant limit is reached and incur a €3 late-entry fee. Award ceremonies take place at the sports grounds immediately after each race. Parking is available only at Erftstadt railway station, just 100 m from the start and finish area. Certificates can be downloaded online as PDFs and printed. Courses around Lake Donatus; online registration; parking at Erftstadt railway station; start and finish area at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds.

name: Kirschlauf
description: The Kirschlauf in Kleinfahner, organised by USV Erfurt, is a long-standing race with a history spanning more than 20 years. The 24th edition takes place on 14 June 2026, taking runners along scenic routes with challenging highland trails. The event offers several distances, including a 14-kilometre main race, a 4.5-kilometre fun run, and races for schoolchildren and younger children. The awards ceremony is traditionally conducted by the Thuringian Cherry Queen, and the race is part of the TLV Running Cup.
course_highlights: 14-kilometre main race featuring a scenic highland trail and views across the northern Thuringian Basin
4.5 km fun run with challenging terrain in the Imtal valley
Finish through a cherry orchard above Kleinfahner, with a magnificent view
additional: Race-pack collection from 8:00 a.m. at the event tent by the mill. Late registration is available online from 2:00 a.m. on 13 June and on race day until 30 minutes before the race, with a €5 late-entry fee. Awards ceremonies take place from approximately 9:45 a.m. for the schoolchildren’s races and from approximately 11:30 a.m. for the other races. Registration until 9 June 2026; late registration is available. The route includes a highland trail and finishes in Kleinfahner. Children’s races and Nordic walking are also offered.

name: Handewitter Sommerlauf
description: The Handewitter Summer Run on June 14, 2026, offers a varied running event for the whole region, with distances for every ability level. From the Bambini race to 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, Nordic walking, relay, half marathon, and wheelchair race, there is something for everyone. The event takes place around the Wikinghalle in Handewitt and stands out for its excellent organization, great atmosphere, and unforgettable finish-line experience. The courses, measured by the DLV, are flat with few elevation changes, making them ideal for beginners and experienced runners alike.

name: Drei-Länder-Lauf
description: The Three-Country Run takes place on 14 June 2026 in Arenshausen and connects the regions of Thuringia, Lower Saxony and Hesse. The event offers various race distances, including 1.2 km, 2 km, 5 km and 13 km, some on loop courses and others as out-and-back runs. In addition to the main races, there is a fun run for preschool children with no timing, as well as Nordic walking as a non-competitive event. The run has a long tradition as a symbol of the region coming together after German reunification.

name: Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf
description: The Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf is a long-standing running event in Schackensleben, about 25 km west of Magdeburg in the Börde district. All distances start and finish at the sports field. The event offers several distances: 400 m for children, 1.4 km for young people, and 6.0 km and 10.8 km for adults. The longer routes pass through the village and the surrounding countryside, with the typically rolling terrain of the Börde region, on roads and paved farm tracks. Drinks, coffee, cake, and grilled food are available, and after the finish there is a raffle with attractive prizes. The Hopfenlauf is part of the Novo Nordisk Landescup and the Elbe-Ohre-Cup.

name: REWE Women´s Run Hamburg
description: The REWE Women’s Run Hamburg is a road race for beginners and ambitious runners in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg. The event offers a measured 10 km loop course starting and finishing at Ballindamm. In addition to the main race, there is also the REWE Girl’s Run for girls aged 5 to 10 over 1 kilometer. Participants receive a finisher medal and can use showers and changing facilities after the race.

name: Heidenheimer Sparkassen-Stadtlauf
description: The Heidenheim Sparkasse City Run on June 14, 2026, offers a range of races for everyone from beginners to half-marathon runners through downtown Heidenheim. The half marathon follows two nearly identical laps through the city, passing landmarks such as St. Paul’s Church, the city library, and Brenzpark. The event also includes 10 km and 5 km races, as well as races for schoolchildren and toddlers. All participants receive timekeeping with a transponder integrated into their race number and a generous selection of refreshments at the finish.

name: Herzogstadtlauf Straubing
description: The Herzogstadtlauf in Straubing is a traditional popular running event taking place on June 13 and 14, 2026, and welcoming runners of all ages. From the children’s race and various distances to the BMW Half Marathon, the event offers a varied program with attractive routes through the historic city and city park. Alongside the sporting challenge, an extensive program of stage performances and DJ music creates a lively atmosphere. The event promotes community and health and is a highlight of the running calendar in eastern Bavaria.

name: Metropolmarathon
organizer: Laufteam Fürth 2010 und Team Klinikum Nürnberg
description: The Sparkassen Metropolmarathon 2026 will take place on June 13 and 14 in the cities of Fürth and Nuremberg. The running event connects two cities with varied routes, numerous competitions and a colorful supporting program. With around 9,000 participants and 600 volunteers, the Metropolmarathon offers a weekend full of exercise, fun and community. The events range from the marathon and half marathon to 10 km races, Nordic walking, and races for children and young people.

name: Sparkassenlauf
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a long-established running event with DLV-certified courses over 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. The races take runners through Wittringer Wald on a flat, fast loop course featuring paved walking paths, asphalt and a tartan track. All participants receive a personalised race number bearing their name and a finisher’s medal. The event also hosts the district road running championships and offers net times and live timing.

name: Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund
description: The Kappeln City Run is a traditional running event held annually in Kappeln in the Schleswig-Flensburg district. The event gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to run a varied course through the town and surrounding area. The run is organized by TSV Kappeln and is a popular event for sports enthusiasts from the region. The atmosphere is welcoming and motivating, with a well-organized event and friendly support.

name: Alfelder Bernd Meyer Staffelmarathon
description: The Alfeld Bernd Meyer Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay marathon taking place on June 14, 2026, in Alfeld (Leine). The event welcomes runners from across the region and is jointly organized by several local running clubs and the City of Alfeld. The course is an approximately 3 km loop, run twice, with the start and finish on the Market Square. Each team consists of 7 runners, who must be registered by name. Timing is electronic, using single-use transponders. In addition to the relay marathon, there is also a children’s run of approximately 700 m.

name: Bad Kohlgruber Schluchtlauf
description: The Bad Kohlgrub Gorge Run is a scenic race in the Alpine foothills that, despite its name, is not a mountain race. The course is gently undulating and consists of 20% asphalt and 80% forest paths. The event takes place at the Sport and Leisure Center at Erle in Bad Kohlgrub and offers free drinks along the route and at the finish. Coffee, cake, food, and drinks are available, and all participants receive certificates, with trophies for the age-group winners.

name: Barsbütteler Volkslauf
description: The Barsbüttel Fun Run is a long-standing running event held every June at the sports field in the Barsbüttel Sports Center. It offers a range of distances from 400 m to 10 km, which are mostly flat and run along paved or firm, sandy farm tracks. Most of the routes pass through the traffic-free Barsbüttel countryside and offer scenic views, particularly the longer 5 km and 10 km routes. Times are measured electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterward. Food and refreshments are also available for runners and spectators.

name: Famberglauf
