price_range: Kinder/Jugendliche/Wanderer/Walker 4,00 Euro; Erwachsene 8,00 Euro; Halbmarathon 12,00 Euro; Nachmeldung 2,00 Euro

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kinder, Jugendliche, Walker und Wanderer 4,00 Euro

description: The Nordholz Windmill Run is a long-standing running event in Wurster North Sea Coast offering various distances for children, young people and adults. The courses follow measured road routes officially recognised by the German Athletics Association (DLV). There are also hiking and walking options open to all age groups. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and every participant receives a medal and certificate.
course_highlights: Measured road courses with DLV certification
Distances from the 400 m Bambini run to the half marathon (21.0975 km)
Competition at Willi-Wicke Sports Ground, serving as the start and finish area
additional: Race-pack collection from 14:00 at the clubhouse at Willi-Wicke Sports Ground. Timing is by transponder, loaned with the race pack (20 euro fee if not returned). Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the start/finish area. The Bambini run is free, and accompaniment is permitted but not timed. The 5 km race counts as the district championship. Late entries are possible up to 1 hour before the start for an additional fee. Every participant receives a medal and certificate; walkers and hikers receive a certificate of participation. Courses are measured; timing is by transponder; changing rooms, showers and toilets are available; district championship on the 5 km course.

name: Samstagslauf Großenmeer
description: The Samstagslauf Großenmeer is a traditional recreational running event taking place for the 15th time on June 20, 2026. Organized by Großenmeerer Turnverein 1921 e.V., the race offers a sporting opportunity for runners from the region and beyond. The event is open to various distances and welcomes all age groups. Registration is conveniently available through Laufmanager.net, and the organizers look forward to welcoming many participants.
course_highlights: A variety of courses for different ability levels
Run through the scenic region around Großenmeer and Ovelgönne
A traditional race with a friendly atmosphere and strong regional ties
additional: Registration is available through Laufmanager.net. The race is organized by Großenmeerer Turnverein 1921 e.V., which also supports other sports activities in the region. No start times or pricing tiers are explicitly listed on the website. The event is part of the Sportverbund Ovelgönne-Jade. Course routes, online registration, various running distances, regional sports activities

name: 3. Schluchthof Backyard Ultra
description: The 3rd Schluchthof Backyard Ultra takes place in Kleinostheim on the Main, near Aschaffenburg. This lovingly organized, private backyard ultra race emphasizes a family atmosphere and a small field of participants, so every lap is run together. The event offers a distinctive setting in a green corner between the Rhine-Main region and the Spessart, with runners setting off hour after hour until only one runner remains.

name: 41. Volkslauf in Baunatal
description: The 41st Baunatal Fun Run is a mass-participation sporting event with the motto “Baunatal Runs,” open to everyone regardless of club membership. The running routes are mostly on paved paths and largely through wooded areas. The 5 km route is an out-and-back course, while the shorter races, from 200 m to 1,000 m, take place in Parkstadion. The event is part of the Nordhessencup, a popular running series in the region.

name: Hennigsdorfer Feuerwehr- und Bahnenlauf
description: The Hennigsdorf Fire Brigade and Railways Run is a sporting event taking place on June 20, 2026, at the OSZ sports field in Hennigsdorf. The 6th edition features various races from 400 m to 5 km, including the HandiCap Race, children’s race, fun run, and Nordic walking. Alongside runners from the volunteer fire brigade, the police and THW will also take part. The Hennigsdorf Fire Brigade will provide entertainment and safety with emergency vehicles, joined by the DLRG and an information stand from EMB Energie Mark Brandenburg. All finishers receive medals and certificates, and refreshments will also be available.

name: Suderburger Abendlauf
description: The Suderburg Evening Run is a recreational sporting event for the whole family, held annually in June in Suderburg since 2022. The races run through the heathland and surrounding forests of the Lüneburg Heath on sandy, all-weather forest and farm tracks. In addition to traditional individual races, there is also a 3 x 1.9 km relay. The start and finish are at the sports ground on Tannrähm, and the event is attracting growing numbers of participants.

name: Fuffy Twister - From Dusk Till Dawn
description: The Fuffy Twister - From Dusk Till Dawn is a 50 km trail ultra in Langenhagen, Germany. It starts at night and has an 8-hour time limit. The race takes place in June and features straightforward organization, a low entry fee, an on-site finisher medal, and results and certificates published online. The small field makes it a more local and challenging test of endurance. The route runs along the northern edge of Hanover, near Hanover Airport, through the Bissendorfer Moor and Kananoher Forst, over varied terrain with moderate elevation gain.

name: Babenberger Volkslauf
description: The Babenberger Volkslauf is a family-friendly scenic run held since 1999 on the Saturday of the parish fair at St. Urban in Bamberg. The event offers running enthusiasts a wonderful opportunity to meet in a friendly atmosphere and run together for a good cause. The start and finish are at St. Urban Church, and the event supports social projects in the neighborhood each year. The organizers look forward to welcoming many participants and hosting a successful event in June 2026.

name: Binner Abendlauf
description: The Binner Evening Run is a long-standing running event held as part of the sports festival of Sport- und Jugendbund Binnen e.V. The run offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, family atmosphere in Binnen. The event attracts runners of all ages and is a fixture on the regional sports calendar. Alongside the run, there is a varied sports festival with other activities and offerings for the whole family.

name: FORT FUN Westernlauf
description: The FORT FUN Western Run on June 20, 2026, is a popular running event at the FORT FUN Abenteuerland amusement park in Bestwig-Wasserfall. Families and runners of all ages can choose from 12 different races across the park grounds and the surrounding forests. The event is especially family-friendly and offers wonderful views, as well as the chance to enjoy the amusement park’s attractions afterward. The event is held in collaboration with TuS Valmetal and is ideal for active children, teenagers, and families.

name: Hofmann-Flechtkulturlauf-Obermain
description: The Hofmann-Flechtkulturlauf Obermain (FKLO) is a large-scale fun run in Lichtenfels, taking place for the 14th time on June 20, 2026. The event offers a variety of running and Nordic walking routes along the flat “Flechtkultur Path” and welcomes both recreational and ambitious runners without putting much emphasis on performance. The Lichtenfels Wine Festival takes place alongside the race, making the day a sporting and social community event. Highlights include the emergency services championship and categories for company executives and teams on the 10.4 km route.

name: Hüttlinger Muffigellauf
description: The Hüttlingen Muffigelläufe on June 20, 2026, offer a varied running and activity experience for all ages and ability levels. From the Bambini Run for the youngest participants to children’s, school and youth races, as well as more challenging routes such as the 10 km Kocherknie Run and the 7 km Limes Run, there is something for everyone. The Walk around the Limes also invites participants to join in at a relaxed pace. The event is organized by the dedicated running group of TSV Hüttlingen and places great importance on fun, community and unforgettable moments.

name: km Staffellauf-100 jahre TSV Brokstedt
description: The 100 km relay race celebrating the 100th anniversary of TSV Brokstedt is a special endurance event held in Brokstedt. Teams of 7 to 15 young people and adults, including at least 2 women, run in pairs for a total of 50 laps to cover 100 km. Children up to 13 years old can take part in a shorter version with 25 laps and 50 km. The event takes place at the sports field in Brokstedt and offers a sporting challenge for teams who enjoy running together.

name: Referees Run
description: The Referees Run is a 10-kilometer race held annually in Borgholzhausen since 2005, as part of the “Nacht von Borgholzhausen” public race. The Gelsenkirchen Referees’ Association traditionally forms one of the largest groups at the race. The event promotes camaraderie among referees and offers an athletic challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, and is overseen by Stefan Tendyck.

name: Saucony Berlin 10K
description: The Saucony BLN 10K is a spectacular new race on June 20, 2026, at the historic Tempelhofer Feld in Berlin. The event combines fast-paced urban running with a unique atmosphere at one of the city’s most historically significant sites. The start and finish are located in the heritage-listed Hangar 6, alongside a Cool Down Zone with DJs, drinks and street food. The course consists of two fast 5-kilometer laps, passing historic aircraft and running through the hangar, offering an unforgettable experience that combines urban lifestyle and music.

name: Sommerlauf Waren(Müritz) (LC/NLC)
description: The 4th Summer Run Waren (Müritz) is a running event organized by the SV Waren 09 e.V. running team. The race takes place at Müritzstadion in Waren (Müritz) and is open to children, young people, active runners and Masters. The event offers runners of all ages a sporting opportunity in beautiful surroundings. Registration is through the tollense-timing.de platform.

name: Stuifenläufe
distance_verbose: Ultramarathon, 50 km, 16 km, 10 km, 10 km, 3.7 km, 2.3 km, 1500 Meter
description: The Stuifen Runs in Wißgoldingen are a long-standing running event, taking place for the 74th time on June 20, 2026. The event includes various races, including children’s races, a kindergarten run, the Stuifen Circuit Run, a mountain run, and Nordic walking. The routes pass through varied terrain, with forest tracks and a challenging steep climb to the summit. The races are suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels, offering a beautiful combination of nature and sporting challenge.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
description: Velíšskej přespolňák is a cross-country race for experienced runners, enthusiasts, and amateurs, held in the picturesque Podblanicko region. The race offers two routes, 10 km and 5.2 km long, running mainly along field and forest paths for an enjoyable running experience in nature. This race is ideal for anyone who wants to enjoy running in a clean environment while testing their abilities against other runners. Velíšskej přespolňák is a traditional event that attracts a wide running community.

name: Prague Park Race – Divoká Šárka
description: Prague Park Race – Divoká Šárka is a running race taking place on June 20, 2026, amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. The race offers a unique atmosphere and breathtaking views for runners to enjoy on routes of 8 and 14 kilometres. The routes follow paved and unpaved roads, meadows and trails, as well as some asphalt roads with limited traffic. The race is suitable for the general public and offers refreshments along the course and at the finish. The start and registration take place at the SK ARITMA grounds in Prague-Vokovice, which are easily accessible by public transport and by car.

name: Krosový běh Chudenickým Žďárem
location: Chudenice, sportovní areál Jalovčí, hřiště pod Bolfánkem, Plzeňský
description: The Run through Chudenice’s Žďár is a young cross-country race founded in 2016. It takes place amid the picturesque autumn scenery of Žďár Hill above the village of Chudenice. The course is a challenging cross-country run with no asphalt sections, a gently undulating profile, and an appealing climb up the forest steps to Bolfánek. The start and finish are located at the local sports club grounds. The main race is 6.2 km long and offers runners both a challenge and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Příborský běh
organizer: město Příbor, Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice
description: The Příbor Run is a traditional running race organized by the town of Příbor in cooperation with the Scout troop and the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race is open to both competitive runners and recreational runners, who can choose a distance to suit their abilities. The options include a 4.6 km recreational race, a 9.2 km competitive race, and relays made up of four runners (2 men + 2 women), with each runner completing a 2.3 km lap. There are also children’s races over various distances. The race has a friendly atmosphere and supports the region’s broad running community.

name: Běh Jana Opletala
description: The In the Footsteps of Jan Opletal Run and Jiří Vacek Memorial is a traditional running event organised by the Jan Opletal Grammar School in Litovel. The race commemorates notable figures and the history of the school and town. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Litovel region and is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a sporting experience with a historical dimension.

name: Běh okolo Vraní skály
description: The Run Around Vraní Skála is a traditional running race held in Černín near Zdice, featuring a challenging course approximately 9 km long. The race combines a steep uphill road section, forest trails and narrow paths leading to the summit around Vraní Skála, followed by a rolling, mostly downhill section with a steep descent to the finish. The race starts in the square in Černín near Zdice, and the main race begins at 10:30. It is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for runners who enjoy a combination of road and trail running with significant elevation gain.

name: Běh na Kozlovský kopec
description: The Kozlovský kopec Run is a traditional road hill race in Česká Třebová, taking place on 20 June 2026. The race starts at 10:00 on Habrmanova Street, in front of the Secondary Vocational School building, and finishes at Max Švabinský Cottage on Kozlovský kopec. The 5.2 km course climbs 230 metres on asphalt and is among the more challenging races in the regional ISCAREX Cup series and the Czech Hill Running Cup. Race facilities are in the school building, where registration, changing rooms and toilets are available. You can register online in advance for a reduced entry fee or on race day.

name: Běh Memoriálu Petry Hézlové - MPH 2026 Louny
description: The Petra Hézlová Memorial is a charity sporting event held in Louny, offering running races for adults and children. The main race features 5 km and 10 km courses for men, women, and students, timed using chip timing. The event is part of a family sports afternoon and offers a varied programme of activities alongside the races. All participants receive a wooden commemorative medal, and there is a prize draw for a LIFEFIT.PRO treadmill. The memorial supports health and social projects, especially oncology.

name: Krakonošova pětadvacítka - B25
description: Krakonošova pětadvacítka (B25) is a 25-kilometer trail run held in Vrchlabí and part of the Krakonošova stovka race series. The course crosses mountainous terrain with approximately 903 meters of elevation gain and offers challenging conditions suited to experienced runners. The event takes place every June and attracts participants from across the Czech Republic who want to enjoy the beauty of the Krkonoše Mountains and the challenge of a mountain run.

name: FarmaRun
description: FarmaRun 2026 is a family sports event organized by the Libchavští chlupáči animal sanctuary farm in Horní Libchava. The race offers a main 5 km run along a pleasantly shaded, flat cycle path, suitable for both runners and walkers. Children can take part in a short 300 m run, and there is an exhibition race for the youngest children, aged 4 and under, right on the farm grounds. After the race, participants receive a commemorative medal, a refreshing drink, and light refreshments. There is also an accompanying program for the whole family.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
description: Velíšskej přespolňák is a traditional cross-country race with a long history, held in Louny in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race is open to all age groups and offers a range of distances, from children’s races to the men’s 7,800-metre event. The Lucky Náprstková Memorial commemorates a tragic event and is part of this sporting event. The organizer is the Czech Union of Sport, which encourages the general public to stay active and participate in sport.

name: Revírní POHO běh
description: The Revírní poho běh project is a unique running race for adults and children alike, set amid the breathtaking natural surroundings of the Karviná Sea. Inspired by the region’s mining history, it makes use of the potential of the post-mining landscape and its revitalized environment. Its aim is to introduce this unique place to the public and to athletes. With the motto “Run in POHO!”, the race offers routes for everyone and the joy of movement.
additional: Also featured: a 4 × 6 km relay race, children’s races, and a health festival

name: Beh Ludrovskou dolinou
organizer: Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, Ružomberskie Strely o.z.
description: The Run Through Ludrovská Valley is a running event held in Ludrovská Valley near the football stadium in Ludrová. The races offer starts for children’s categories on grass and adult categories on forest trails and asphalt. The event is suitable for a wide range of ages, from children to seniors, with categories divided by age. The organizers are the Municipality of Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, and Ružomberskie Strely o.z., who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization.

name: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo
description: The 2nd round of the Prešov Running Series, known as Šariš Run, is a running event held on the banks of the ponds in Veľký Šariš, beneath the historic Šariš Castle. This venue is new to the series and has become very popular with runners. The event is full of sporting spirit, community, and a love of nature, and also offers a rich program of activities, including musical performances, health booths, a relaxation zone, and activities for children. The friendly, family atmosphere makes the run an unforgettable experience for all participants.

name: Beh cez Zalužické poľa
location: Zalužice, okr. Michalovce, Zalužice, okr. Michalovce,
description: The Run Through the Zalužice Fields is the second edition of a running event taking place on June 20, 2026, in Zalužice. This run gives participants the opportunity to experience the nature and beauty of Zemplín in summer. The event is part of the Zemplín Extreme series, which offers a range of running challenges in the region.

name: toRunská vrtuľa
location: Stará Turá, Stará Turá, ATC Dubník (KEMP53 - reštaurácia)
organizer: Zuzana Jankovičová, Lívia Skurská, Monika Tomisová
description: toRunská vrtuľa is a charity running and community day in the beautiful surroundings of the Dubník Reservoir in Stará Turá. The event focuses on exercise and helping others, with all proceeds from entry fees donated to fund rehabilitation for Simonka Zigová. Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps around Dubník as possible, in a friendly and supportive atmosphere. The organizers and volunteers run the event without compensation, emphasizing its community and charitable spirit.

name: Ruskovská deviatka
location: Športový areál, Nový Ruskov, Trebišov District, Slovakia

name: Tatry charity run
location: Tatranská Lomnica, Tatranská Lomnica, Relax Park Jazierko
organizer: Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, mesto Vysoké Tatry, TANAP
description: Tatry Charity Run is a running event held in Tatranská Lomnica at Relax Park Jazierko. The course is mainly on asphalt and hard-packed terrain, ensuring a comfortable run for all participants. The race is open to the general public and offers categories for men and women in different age groups. It is organized by the Kotrmelec Sports Foundation, the town of Vysoké Tatry, and TANAP, who ensure the event runs smoothly. Online registration is available, with a limit of 300 runners. On-site registration is also available on race day.

name: Beh k Iliašovskej kapličke
description: The Run to the Chapel of Iliašovce is a running event held in Iliašovce at the FK56 football pitch. The race offers two main routes, 5.6 km and 10.8 km long, which run mainly along farm and forest roads. The main category starts at 10:00, and the children’s race starts at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners of a wide range of ages, including children, and offers a pleasant atmosphere in nature.

name: Doby vežu – extrémny prekážkový beh a trail
location: Brezno, Brezno, Lidl Brezno, Československej Armády 2612/68
description: Doby vežu is an extreme obstacle race and trail run held in Brezno, Slovakia. Racers must tackle challenging obstacles and complete a course leading to the top of Slovakia’s second-highest observation tower, which stands 40 metres tall and offers beautiful views. The course runs mainly along forest paths, meadows and a stream, with very little asphalt, and includes steep climbs and descents. In addition to the sporting experience, a fun program of activities is planned for all age groups. The organizer is M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., and the race director is Marek Janoštiak.

name: Birštono pusmaratonis. Lietuvos 10 km bėgimo plentu čempionatas.
location: Birštonas, Birštono savivaldybė, Kauno apskritis, Lithuania
organizer: Všį Birštono sportas, Asociacija Sporto renginiai
description: Birštonas Half Marathon Powered by Vytautas is an annual running event held in Birštonas, bringing together both beginner and experienced runners. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 10 km race—which is also the Lithuanian 10 km Road Running Championships—a 5.2 km race, and a relay. The course passes through the town center, along the Nemunas riverbank and promenade, and near the Žvėrinčius Forest, offering runners the chance to enjoy both the competition and the scenery. Birštonas is known for its wellness traditions, and the event promotes an active lifestyle and a sense of community.
course_highlights: The course passes through the town center, along the Nemunas riverbank, and along the promenade
The half marathon consists of 4 laps; the 10 km race consists of 2 laps
The 2x5 km relay is mixed (1 man + 1 woman)
additional: Start times: 10 km race at 9:00 in Basanavičius Square; half marathon at 9:05 on Jaunimo Street; 5.2 km race at 9:05; 2x5 km relay at 9:05; children's 800 m race at 12:15. Participants' footwear must comply with LLAF recommendations. Participants in the 10 km championship must have a valid anti-doping education certificate. Registration must be in the participant's own name; transferring a race number is prohibited. Participants agree that photographs and video footage taken during the event may be used for marketing without separate consent. Participants are invited to register by completing a form, and the event rules state that a doping control certificate is required for the 10 km race. The event also includes an awards ceremony and sponsor gifts.

name: Pasvalio maratonas
location: Pasvalio kultūros ir poilsio parko stadionas, Pasvalys, Pasvalio rajonas, Lietuva
organizer: Bėgimo mėgėjų ir sveikos gyvensenos klubas „Vėtra“, Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija, Pasvalio sporto mokykla
description: The Pasvalys Marathon is a traditional running event held in the city of Pasvalys. It aims to promote running among young people and adults and encourage a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place at the stadium in Pasvalys Culture and Recreation Park, where participants compete in the marathon, half-marathon, and children’s race. The course length and number of laps are adjusted for the different distances, with water and refreshment stations every 5 km. Participants receive prizes and commemorative medals, and the event is part of the Pasvalys City Festival “Vys par to ãlo” programme.
course_highlights: 10 km course; 4 laps for the marathon and 2 laps for the half-marathon
Water and refreshment stations every 5 km
Start and finish at the stadium in Pasvalys Culture and Recreation Park
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 8:00 at Pasvalys Stadium. The children’s 400 m race starts at 11:00. Participants must have a doctor’s permission or an application bearing a doctor’s approval; otherwise, they are responsible for their own health during the competition. Participants who finish within the time limit receive commemorative medals. Various distances are offered, and participants can look forward to medals, certificates, prizes, and refreshments.

name: Perly Malopolski Wapienne Magura
location: Wapienne, Sękowa, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Lotnej Kompanii Szturmowej
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Wypoczynku w Haczowie oraz Urząd Gminy w Haczowie
description: The 8th “Lotna” Run in Haczów is an annual running event commemorating Lieutenant Stanisław Maczek’s Lotna Assault Company and the Heroes of Haczów who fought for Poland’s independence in 1918–1921. The event features courses of approximately 12 km and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking route, mostly on paved and gravel roads in the Haczów municipality. The run promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and local community integration. Free children’s races are also offered, with shorter distances suited to different age groups. The race office and event base are located in the Manor Park by the Municipal Centre of Culture and Recreation in Haczów.

name: Gryf Arena Run
organizer: Starostwo Powiatowe w Gryficach, Powiatowe Centrum Sportu Rekreacji i Promocji w Gryficach, PLMKS Chrobry Gryfice, Zarząd Dróg Powiatowych w Gryficach, Klub Sportowy "RunGryf"
description: The 9th edition of Gryf Arena Run will take place on June 21, 2026, in Gryfice. The race route runs through the city streets, offering participants a great atmosphere, sporting excitement, and positive energy. The event is family-friendly, with children’s races ranging from 100 to 600 meters, tailored to different age groups. Every child taking part will receive a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish. It is one of the largest running events in the region, combining sporting competition with fun for the whole family.

name: Klon Biega i Chodzi Dla Zdrowia
description: Klon Runs and Walks for Health is a local initiative organized by the Association for the Development of the Village of Klon and Surrounding Areas. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and supporters of the region. The run and Nordic walking event take place in the scenic surroundings of Klon, making them ideal for recreation and community interaction. The event is open and welcoming to all age groups.

name: X Bieg STO-nogi
organizer: Społeczne Liceum Ogólnokształcące Nr 5 STO w Milanówku
description: The X STO-nogi Run in Milanówek is a traditional 10 km road race held in the picturesque town of Milanówek. The T-shaped course consists of two 5 km loops along the town’s streets, with turnarounds by the wayside shrine and Brzozowa Street. The start and finish are at Social General Secondary School No. 5, at 41 Herberta Street. The race is organized by running enthusiasts from the STO-nogi group, who promote running among residents and visitors.

name: X Ostródzki Półmaraton św. Jerzego
organizer: Grupa Ostródzkich Biegaczy „Ostróda Runners”, Klub Sportowy PLAY, Ostródzkie Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji
description: The 10th Ostróda St. George’s Half Marathon is the anniversary edition of the half marathon held in Ostróda. The course runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through the city streets, comprising two identical loops with a total distance of 21.098 km. The race starts and finishes at the Amphitheatre at 17a Mickiewicza Street, and hydration stations are located along the course approximately every 4 km. Organizers provide a commemorative medal, a voucher for a recovery meal, and the option to choose a race package with or without a T-shirt. The event is charitable and supports the rehabilitation of a girl named Maja.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Trail Run takes place in the wooded areas of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The course features varied surfaces, climbs and descents of different lengths and gradients, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. Its cross-country character attracts runners looking to get off the pavement or prepare for mountain races. The event offers three distances: 4, 8, and 12 km, as well as a 4 km Nordic walking event and races for children and young people. Participants receive symbolic medals inspired by raspberries, while the top women and men in each distance receive trophies.

name: Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna
description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna is an annual running event held in the scenic area of Deczno near Świecie. The main 10 km race runs through the Recreation and Leisure Centre grounds, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. The event also includes free children’s races, making it a family-friendly and inclusive occasion. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and race packages with T-shirts for early registrants. The main race is limited to 300 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.

name: XI Cienińska Szóstka
location: Cienin Zaborny, Słupca County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Gorch-Fock-Lauf Wilhelmshaven
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 0.6 km
description: The Gorch-Fock-Lauf in Wilhelmshaven takes place annually in June and offers distances for all age groups, including children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon and a marathon. The course runs mostly along the coastline and the inner harbor, starting on Jade-Allee and finishing in Pumpwerk Park. The course is measured by the DLV, ensuring fair competition. In addition to the sporting event, there is also a club and school race with attractive prize money to promote youth sports in the region.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course with a quality seal
Route along the coastline and the inner harbor
Start on Jade-Allee, finish in Pumpwerk Park
additional: The start area is on Jade-Allee, and the finish is in Pumpwerk Park. Timing uses a chip integrated into the bib number. A runners’ service will be held on June 13, 2026, at 6 p.m. in the Christus-Garnisonkirche. There are several refreshment stations along the course. The club and school race offers prize money to the five clubs/schools with the most participants. Changes of registration can be made online via a self-service link; no changes are possible on site. The event also includes a running service, club and school competitions, medals, shirts and prize money. Registration is online, with early-bird discounts available. The race starts on Jade-Allee and finishes in Pumpwerk Park.

name: RVB Harlingerland Volkslauf
description: The RVB Harlingerland Volkslauf will be held for the 43rd time in 2026 and is organized by Lauftreff Schafhauser Wald e.V. in Dunum, Lower Saxony. The event is supported by Raiffeisen-Volksbank eG, Aurich, and offers runners and walkers of all ability levels a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. The routes pass through the beautiful Harlinger landscape, with the start and finish in Dunum. In addition to the Volkslauf, walking and Nordic walking options are available, along with an extensive photo and results archive from previous years.
course_highlights: Start on Vorackkerweg, finish at Dunum School
10 km Volkslauf with 2 laps
Half marathon and other routes with interactive course maps
additional: The event includes various distances: 10 km Volkslauf (2 laps), half marathon, 5 km Volkslauf, 7.5 km walking, and Bambini and schoolchildren's races. The start and finish are in Dunum, and the routes are available as interactive maps. The running group's training sessions are on Mondays at 19:00 and Wednesdays at 18:00, meeting at the NIGE sports ground or, from September, at the stadium on Peldmühle. Everyone is welcome, from beginners to professionals. The event takes place in June, with officially homologated courses for official performance records. It supports the German solidarity system in sport and is aimed at runners of all ages, including children and young people.

name: Globus-Theißen-Lauf
description: The Globus-Theißen Run is a community running event in Theißen, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place for the sixth time on June 21, 2026. The event offers distances for all age groups, from the Bambini race through 1.5 km, 3 km, and 7 km to 14 km. It is held at the Miners’ Stadium and is part of the Burgenland rankings for adults and the Wiesen-Grundcup for children and young people. Cake, coffee, and hearty food will be available, and there will be entertainment for children during the awards ceremony. The event is a joint project by Globus-Theissen, local clubs, and residents.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 m (Bambini) to 14 km
Start and finish at the Miners’ Stadium in Theißen
Course routes available as GPS tracks and PDFs
additional: Food and refreshments include homemade cake, coffee, and hearty dishes; proceeds support the clubs’ youth programs; entertainment for children during the awards ceremony; start and finish at the Miners’ Stadium; ample parking nearby; certificates for children at the finish; the event is part of the Burgenland rankings and the Wiesen-Grundcup. Courses for children, young people, women, men, and seniors; virtual routes are possible; a community event of regional significance

name: Reinhardswaldwalking
location: VfL Veckerhagen, Reinhardshagen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: VfL Veckerhagen 1897 e.V. warmly invites you to the 15th Reinhardswald Walking Day on 21 June 2026. Routes of 3 km, 6 km and 11 km are offered, leading through open countryside, along the edge of the forest and through the Reinhardswald. The start and finish are at the VfL Veckerhagen sports facility. Refreshment stations will be available along the way, and drinks, coffee, cake and bratwurst will be served at the finish. The three groups with the most participants will receive cash prizes.
course_highlights: Routes through open countryside, along the edge of the forest and through the Reinhardswald
Start and finish at the VfL Veckerhagen sports facility
Refreshment stations along the way
additional: The three groups with the most participants will receive cash prizes. For planning purposes, please provide a non-binding estimate of your group’s participant numbers by 13.06.2026. Participants are advised to bring a completed registration form to speed up registration on site. Participants can choose from 3 km, 6 km, 8 km and 11 km routes. The event promotes a sense of community and enjoyment of nature, with refreshments and prizes for the largest groups.

name: Sachsenlauf Coswig
price_range: 2 € erste Stunde, danach 1,50 € (Parkgebühren im Parkhaus an der Moritzburger Straße)
description: The Sachsenlauf Coswig is a long-standing sporting event held annually in June since 1980. The races follow forest roads, woodland trails and field paths through the Friedewald and into the Moritzburg Hills. A special highlight on the 21.1 km route is running through the Moritzburg State Stud to the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel. In addition to running distances, walking and hiking options cater to different fitness levels and ambitions. The event is part of the Meißner Sparkassencup and the Niederlausitzcup, and also features dedicated races for children and Bambinis, with surprises at the finish.
course_highlights: Running routes on forest roads, woodland trails and field paths in the Friedewald and Moritzburg Hills
Route through the Moritzburg State Stud, past the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel (21.1 km route)
Hiking routes on the Karras circular trails, passing natural features such as Moselwiese and Seerosenteich
additional: Start and finish are at the corner of Friedewaldstraße and Sachsenlaufweg. Awards ceremonies take place in the schoolyard. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available in the neighboring Spitzgrund sports hall. The course closes for all distances at 14:00. Paid parking is available in the Moritzburger Straße car park. Travel by public transport (VVO bus routes 400, 401 and 405) is recommended. Children and Bambinis have their own out-and-back races (500 m and 800 m) with small surprises at the finish. Race bibs include a single-use timing transponder. Late registrations are possible on race day until 10:00; payment on site is cash only. Course adjustment due to the state championships, parking in the car park, travel by bus and train recommended, refreshments and awards ceremonies in the finish area, children’s and hiking routes

name: Wallernhäuser Dorflauf
description: The Wallernhausen Village Run is a traditional village race in Nidda-Wallernhausen, Germany, starting at 9:00 a.m. on Sunday morning. The event offers two distances: a short 1.6 km run and a longer 10 km run. This makes it suitable for younger runners and beginners, as well as runners looking for a classic longer distance. The course runs through the village of Wallernhausen and offers a friendly, family atmosphere away from large urban areas. Now in its 18th edition, the run is a popular local sporting event.
course_highlights: Run through the village of Wallernhausen
Two distances: 1.6 km and 10 km
Friendly village-run atmosphere
additional: Typical June weather, with an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny days. The event is suitable for beginners and younger runners. It takes place in June, with typical temperatures around 23 °C and a low probability of precipitation. This is a local event focused on community and the enjoyment of running.

name: 10K Hamburg - Volkspark
description: The 10K Hamburg Volkspark is an exciting 10-kilometer race on fully closed and secured out-and-back courses in Hamburg. The route follows firm, paved paths and offers an appealing running experience for runners of all ability levels. The event is part of the 10K Hamburg series, held at various attractive locations in the Elbe metropolis. Registration is online only, and the event is already sold out.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 2
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands off the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. It takes place annually and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. Participants can run all seven stages or individual stages, each of which is about 10 kilometers long. The event places great importance on creating an enjoyable running experience and protecting the islands from overcrowding.

name: Barsinghäuser Fuchsbau Spendenlauf
description: The Barsinghausen Fuchsbau Charity Run is a running event in support of the “FUCHSBAU” association, which provides bereavement support for children and young people. Since 2010, the association has supported young people facing the death of people close to them. The charity run was launched in 2024 to fund Fuchsbau’s important work, as the association has relied entirely on donations since 2023. The event promotes community and social engagement in Barsinghausen and will take place again in 2026.

name: Bestenseer Seenlauf
organizer: Heimat&Kulturverein Bestensee e.V. und WSG 81 KWeV
description: The Bestensee Lakes Run is a traditional race held annually in Bestensee since 2002. It offers three different distances of 2 km, 7.5 km, and 16 km, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The race starts at the Landkost Arena, surrounded by the region’s idyllic lakes and woodland. The event is open to all age groups, and children and young people up to age 13 can take part for free.

name: Buchholzer Stadtlauf
location: Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Buchholz City Run is a long-standing event with a cult following in the Nordheide, taking place on June 21, 2026. The course runs through the heart of Buchholz city center, with large crowds of spectators creating a special atmosphere and providing motivation. Various distances offer suitable challenges for all ages and ability levels, from the children’s run to the popular team relay. Running training with certified coaches is also available, and all participants receive special medals and certificates.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Norderney (2. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. It takes place from 20 to 27 June 2026 and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad. The stages follow varied routes with a maritime atmosphere, dune landscapes and the UNESCO World Heritage Wadden Sea. The event offers a unique running experience, with the start and finish on each island and comprehensive facilities including race-number collection, sports-bag storage and on-site award ceremonies.

name: Lamspringer Klosterlauf
description: The Lamspringe Monastery Run is an annual running and walking event starting and finishing at Lamspringe Forest Stadium. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including children’s races, and is part of the South Lower Saxony Cup. Runners, Nordic walkers, and hiking enthusiasts are warmly invited to enjoy the varied routes through the countryside around Lamspringe. The event combines sporting ambition with fun and a sense of community in beautiful surroundings.

name: Sababurger Tierparklauf
description: The 16th Sababurg Zoo Run takes place on June 21, 2026, in the picturesque Sababurg Zoo and the adjacent Reinhardswald forest. Runners are accompanied by enthusiastic spectators and experience a unique natural setting on carefully selected routes. The run is a charity event supporting the planned AmphibienWelt, which is to become a new nature learning center at the zoo. The zoo run is also part of the Reinhardswald Running and Walking Cup and offers routes for different age groups and ability levels.

name: Schlossinsellauf Lübben
description: The Schlossinsellauf Lübben is a traditional running event held on the idyllic Schlossinsel in the town of Lübben in the Spreewald. It offers races for children, teenagers, and adults, including Bambini races, children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, and a Run & Bike half marathon. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and varied course, which runs both on the Schlossinsel and through the surrounding Spreewald area. The race is part of the Spreewaldcup and attracts numerous runners every year.

name: Spessarthelden - Laufen gegen Gewalt
description: The Spessarthelden Run Against Violence is a charity run in Bad Soden-Salmünster, organized by Tuğçe Albayrak e.V. and the city. The event sends a strong message against violence and is supported by former German President Christian Wulff as its patron. There are various running distances suitable for all age groups, and the event promotes community and social engagement in the region.

name: Töpfermarktlauf Bürgel
description: The Töpfermarktlauf in Bürgel is a long-standing race that has been a sporting highlight in the Saale-Holzland district since the 1990s. The event offers various distances, including the challenging 12 km main race and the 6 km introductory race, which take runners through the varied landscape around Bürgel. All participants receive a handmade, ceramic medal as a memento. The event is family-friendly, with races for children and school students, and takes place on Sunday morning to make it possible for as many running enthusiasts as possible to take part.

name: Běhej lesy Týmovka - týmový závod
description: Běhej lesy Týmovka is a unique team relay running race held in the heart of the Vysočina region, offering an adventure for teams of 4 to 8 runners. The race consists of three different loops with a total distance of approximately 27.5 km, which each runner must complete over the weekend. The race also takes place at night with headlamps, adding to its uniqueness and challenge. In addition to the race, a rich programme of sports activities, cultural events and workshops is planned, while the facilities include a comfortable campsite with sanitary facilities and refreshments.

name: Velichovská sedmička
description: Velichovská sedmička is a friendly family running race held in the village of Velichovky, offering a main 7 km course along forest trails and local roads. The race is open to all age groups, including children, and encourages active leisure time in nature. The event is part of the Primátor Cup series and is ideal for sports enthusiasts and families looking for a shared sporting activity. It takes place on the last Saturday in June, with the option to take part in other shorter routes and children’s categories.

name: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň
description: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň is a family-friendly running event with a joyful, relaxed atmosphere, suitable for both recreational and elite runners. It offers a range of distances, from children’s races to 3, 5 and 10 km runs and a half marathon. The race takes place in the centre of Plzeň and is part of a series of events held throughout the Czech Republic. Participants can enjoy not only the race but also a family-friendly entertainment programme and high-quality service from start to finish.

name: Dobratický běh
description: The Dobratice Run is a traditional running race in the picturesque village of Dobratice, attracting sports enthusiasts of all ages. The race offers beautiful routes through nature and scenic surroundings, suitable for both experienced runners and families with children. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, themed categories, and valuable prizes for winners and participants. Each year brings a new theme, giving the race a unique atmosphere and adding to the joy of running.

name: Hamelika třikrát jinak
description: Hamelika Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities at the Hamelika site near Mariánské Lázně. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and the Plzeň Region Running Cup, offering a sporting experience for the general public. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels, with an emphasis on a welcoming setting and a sporting atmosphere. Pro Sport Activities has a long tradition of organizing running races and looks forward to welcoming participants in 2026.

name: Sunrise Marathon / Halfmaraton
description: The Sunrise Marathon and Half Marathon take place on June 21, 2026, at Olympia Brno, Modřice. The race starts early in the morning at 4:46 so runners can experience the magical atmosphere of sunrise during the run. The course is flat and consists of five equal-length laps, running partly through nature and partly along shaded sections. The organizers provide electronic timing and support at key points along the course. The race is suitable for all runners who want to welcome summer actively and enjoy a unique running experience at dawn.

name: Hradecký kros
description: Hradecký kros is a traditional 10 km trail race held in the forests around Biřička in Hradec Králové. The race offers a unique experience on natural terrain with fewer asphalt sections, making it suitable for the general public and recreational runners alike. The event is part of the East Bohemia Running Grand Prix and attracts runners of all levels every year. The course consists of two 5 km laps over mildly undulating terrain, highlighting the race’s beauty and challenge.

name: Ivčin kopeček
description: Ivčin kopeček is a 3.4 km uphill race with 240 metres of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců series in Prague and the surrounding area. The race offers runners a challenging yet appealing course in the beautiful natural surroundings of Beroun in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and uphill running who want to test their endurance and strength on a short but intense route. The race is open to the public and welcomes all runners looking to enjoy a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Grobský Runfest
location: Chorvátsky Grob – Čierna Voda, Chorvátsky Grob – Čierna Voda, Areál za MŠ a ZŠ Javorová Alej
organizer: SBT Spid.com, s.r.o., Susedský Hi o.z., PavúčikSport Team o.z., obec Chorvátsky Grob
description: Grobský Runfest is a two-day sports festival in Chorvátsky Grob, bringing together professional athletes and recreational enthusiasts of all ages. It offers running courses of various distances, children’s races, cycling races, and a rich cultural and entertainment program, including a food zone and musical performances. The event promotes community and a healthy lifestyle in a pleasant setting, with a variety of activities for all visitors.

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava is Slovakia’s largest obstacle race, held at the Divoká Voda complex in Čunovo. Competitors tackle more than 20 obstacles on a course of approximately 5 km, with different participation options, including a non-competitive fitness mode and timed racing. After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments and watch strength competitions. The race is also suitable for children aged 8 to 14 and includes a medal, photos and a race video as keepsakes.

name: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš
location: Veľký Krtíš, Veľký Krtíš, Veľký Krtíš
description: The Run Through the Streets of Veľký Krtíš is a traditional running race organized by the Bežci VK civic association. It offers various categories, including children, recreational runners, and Nordic Walking. The race takes place in the town of Veľký Krtíš, with distances ranging from 3,000 m to the main 11,000 m race. The children’s race starts at 09:45, and the main category and Nordic Walking start at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers discounts for seniors over 60.

name: Moldavský pohár Bodvy
location: Moldava nad Bodvou, Moldava nad Bodvou, Hlavné námestie
description: The Moldava Cup of the Bodva is an international road race, cycling and inline skating event held in Moldava nad Bodvou. The event offers various categories for runners, cyclists and inline skaters, with routes passing through the surrounding countryside and villages. It is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, with the start and finish on the Main Square in Moldava nad Bodvou. It also includes a mass run for health, which is open to the general public.

name: Mano MAMA juda – Gelgaudiškio TRAIL spalvų bėgimas 2026
description: Mano MAMA juda - Gelgaudiškio TRAIL Color Run 2026 is an event for families and running enthusiasts, held in Gelgaudiškis Manor Park and the surrounding area. The event aims to promote running in the Šakiai District and encourage physical activity. The course includes forest trails and asphalt, while color stations along the route add extra fun for participants. The event takes place on June 21 and offers a 400 m children’s run and 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: The 5 km loop is mainly on forest trails
The 10 km distance consists of two 5 km loops
Course surface: forest trails and asphalt
additional: Race bibs are distributed from 9:00 to 10:00. The 400 m children’s run starts at 10:00, and the 5 km and 10 km distances start at 10:30. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 12:00. Minors must have written consent from a parent or guardian. Participants agree that organizers may use photos and video footage taken during the event for marketing purposes. The event includes a color run, various distances, challenges, and varied terrain. Participants’ results are recorded using a professional timing system, but the most important things are the experience and emotions.

name: 55-asis bėgimas – pusė maratono „Aplink Elektrėnų marias“
description: The 55th “Around the Elektrėnai Reservoir” run is a traditional half marathon in Elektrėnai Municipality, set in the beautiful surroundings of the city of Elektrėnai. The event brings together sports enthusiasts and people who enjoy an active lifestyle, offering the chance to run around the vast Elektrėnai Reservoir. It is a great opportunity to discover the nature and history of the Elektrėnai region while enjoying sport and a sense of community. The event takes place in June, traditionally starting in the morning and continuing into the afternoon.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 2
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon that divides the classic distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The route follows loop courses through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the Harz foothills. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, and also offers a kids’ stage for younger participants. Organized by regional clubs, the event will take place for the 18th time in 2026.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 3
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a long-standing stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of around 10 km each, travelling from island to island. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere, dune landscapes and the Wadden Sea UNESCO World Heritage Site. Due to limited ferry capacity and infrastructure, the number of participants is limited, ensuring an exclusive and well-organised event.

name: Sommerlauf Baierbrunn
description: The Baierbrunn Summer Run is a traditional race held annually since 2015 that brings the entire Baierbrunn community together. The event is open to professional and recreational runners of all ages and offers various routes through the surrounding forests across varied terrain. After the races for different age groups and distances, a summer party is held for all participants and friends of SC Baierbrunn. The course is marked and closed to traffic, with drink stations along the way.

name: Kros Sázava
description: Kros Sázava is a running race in Pikovice, Central Bohemian Region, offering three routes of varying distances and elevation gains. The longest route is 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain, the medium route is 10 km with approximately 230 m, and the hobby route is 5 km with 120 m. All routes run exclusively through nature, offering beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of various levels who want to enjoy cross-country running in a picturesque setting.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Už vaikų rytojų“
description: The “For Children’s Tomorrow” running race is an event aimed at encouraging the public to become foster parents to older children and changing negative attitudes toward children in foster care. The race takes place in Kaunas Oak Grove, with the start and finish near the main building of the Lithuanian Sports University. The event draws attention to children over the age of 10 who are waiting for foster families and promotes the services provided by the foster care centre. Participants can choose from several distances, and every finisher receives a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: 5 km distance — 2 laps of 2.5 km each
Start and finish near the main building of the Lithuanian Sports University
The race takes place in Kaunas Oak Grove, near the monument to S. Darius and S. Girėnas
additional: There are three distances: 500 m (for those born in 2014 or later; start at 18:30), 1 km (start at 18:45), and 5 km (start at 19:05). Participants must wear their bib on the front of their shirt. Winners and runners-up are awarded in various age groups, and every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Participants and supporters are not allowed to use vehicles or personal escorts during the race. Registration is online. The event is intended for children and young people and aims to encourage an active lifestyle and social engagement.

name: V Charytatywny Bieg dla Dzieci Bohaterów Biegaj - Pomagaj
VI-asis Alaušo maratonas
location: Sudeikių ežeras, Sudeikiai, Utenos rajonas, Lithuania
organizer: VšĮ Utenos verslo ir turizmo agentūra
description: The 6th Alaušas Marathon is a traditional running event held in the town of Sudeikiai, in Utena District, on the eve of Joninės night. The marathon offers sports enthusiasts the chance to experience a unique atmosphere and test their endurance in beautiful natural surroundings by Lake Sudeikiai. The event begins in the evening on June 23 at 19:30 and invites participants and spectators to enjoy an active and fun evening of sport.
course_highlights: Held in the town of Sudeikiai, by Lake Sudeikiai
The event begins on the eve of Joninės night, June 23 at 19:30
The marathon takes place in Utena District, surrounded by nature
additional: Registration is available through the official website, with the option to sign in via Facebook. The event takes place on the eve of Joninės night, so the start is scheduled for the evening. The venue is marked on Google Maps in the town of Sudeikiai. The event includes not only running but also other active activities; registration takes place online, and it is an important part of the local sports festival.

name: Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 4
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon held in seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each around Osterode am Harz. The fourth stage runs through the beautiful Beber nature reserve in Schwiegershausen, along varied paths of gravel, concrete and grass. The start and finish are at the Schwiegershausen sports hall, and the route offers a great view of the Harz as well as a mix of gentle and steep sections. The race is open to everyone physically able to run about 7 kilometres without stopping and promotes community among the regional clubs.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 4
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of about 10 km on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and a chance to enjoy nature. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and sells out quickly.

name: Erfurter Campuslauf
description: The Erfurt Campus Run is a sporting event organised by the University of Erfurt in cooperation with Universitätssportverein Erfurt e.V. On 24 June 2026, runners can take part in various races, including a 10-kilometre individual race, which also counts as the Thuringian University Championship in the 10-kilometre road race. There is also a 25 x 400-metre team race and a Bambini run for children. The event features a varied course on the university campus and is open to all age groups and ability levels.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Juist (4. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Stage 4 takes place on June 24, 2026, on the island of Juist, the longest of the islands at 17 kilometers, which impresses with its dunes and the Juist Water Tower. The start and finish are at Kurplatz, and the event offers runners and walkers a unique running experience surrounded by nature and the sea. The race number is valid for all stages and is issued with an integrated timing chip.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (7) – červnový
description: Come and run on a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava River in Prague’s Braník district, where personal records are often set! The race is part of the 16th edition of VAŠE LIGA’s regular 5 km and 10 km runs, held every month. The course has been measured by a certified measurer, and the 10 km race offers the chance to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, you can review your performance and refuel at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. We reward both the top runners and our loyal participants.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 5
organizer: TG LaPeKa, MTV Osterode, MTV Förste, TSV Schwiegershausen, TSC Dorste, MTV Freiheit, SFC Harz-Weser
description: The 18th Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The runs follow loop courses through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the Harz foothills. The event starts on Sunday, June 21, 2026, in Förste, with a new stage each day through Saturday, June 27, 2026. Walkers and Nordic walkers are also very welcome. There is also a 750-meter kids’ stage on June 27 in Schützenpark.

name: Bremer Firmenlauf zur Spätschicht
description: The Bremen Company Run for the Late Shift is a community running event covering approximately 5 km around the Weser weir in Bremen, with a focus on team spirit and togetherness. The event is for companies, groups of friends, and running clubs who want to run or walk together without the pressure to perform. New for 2026, official timing will be available for the first time for everyone who wants to test their athletic ambition. After the run, a lively after-run party with music, food, and drinks offers a relaxed end to the evening.

name: DAK FIRMENLAUF Nordhessen 2026
description: The DAK Nord Hesse Corporate Run has been organised by FTSV Heckershausen 1890 e.V. since 2011 and is held under the motto “Running together—for your health. A lifetime long.” The run promotes health and the enjoyment of exercise and is open to teams and individual runners. The course is approximately 5.3 km long and runs mostly along unpaved paths, with a short asphalt section. The event takes place on June 25, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. Refreshing drinks and changing facilities are available on site.

name: Firmenlauf Bremerhaven
description: The 9th Bremerhaven Company Run takes place on Thursday, June 25, 2026, and is open to employees and apprentices of companies, public authorities, and other organizations. Participants run a 6 km loop course starting at the Nordsee-Stadion and passing through Speckenbüttler Park. With a participant limit of 500, the run offers teams a great opportunity to compete athletically and have fun together. Groups receive a free-entry discount when at least 10 participants are registered by the end of May. The event is well established and very popular in the region.

name: Běh Vídrholcem
description: The Vídrholec Run is a popular running race held in Prague 9-Klánovice. It is part of the local running calendar and attracts runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. The event is held under the auspices of the Czech Running Association and the Czech Athletics Federation, and offers not only competition but also the joy of exercising in nature.

name: GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way is a mountain race by the sea, taking place on June 26–27, 2026, in Gdynia and the surrounding Kashubian region. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 14 km to 160 km, with varied elevation gain and scenic routes. The start and finish are at different locations, and the organizer provides transport to the start of the longest distance. It is a unique opportunity to take on a challenging course and enjoy the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: 160 km distance with +/- 2,502 m of elevation gain, starting in Puck at 10:00
100 km distance with +/- 2,267 m of elevation gain, starting in Gdynia at 21:00
Routes pass through Kashubia and coastal areas, with checkpoints and time limits
additional: For the start of the longest distance (160 km), participants are transported by coach from outside the Gdynia Sports Center – National Rugby Stadium (paid transport). The time limit for the 160 km distance is 31 hours. The course has checkpoints with time limits and drop bags. The event includes both summer and winter editions, with routes passing through different towns in the region and offering unforgettable experiences for runners of all ability levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences. The event is part of a series of races organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who focus on the beauty of the courses and promoting running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, making them worth collecting. It’s a special opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings and enjoy the atmosphere of the night.

name: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku
description: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku is a 10 km race taking place on June 26, 2026, in Siemianowice Śląskie, in Pszczelnik Park. The course consists of four laps, and all participants start together. After each lap, the 20 runners who took the longest to complete it are eliminated and receive a so-called “almost medal” at the finish. The final lap is run by the top competitors battling for the win. The race is open to people over the age of 16.

name: Biegaj z Duchami
description: Run with Ghosts is a unique night trail run taking place on June 26, 2026, in Leśniów. Participants will take on two courses, 15 km and 9 km long, full of dark corners and surprises that create a one-of-a-kind atmosphere filled with thrills. Runners are encouraged to dress up as spectres, ghosts, and other spooky characters, adding magic and atmosphere to the event. It is not just a race, but also a test of endurance and courage in the dark, where participants face their own weaknesses and mysterious figures along the course.

name: MidSummerRun 2026

late_fee.price: 3,00 Euro für Jugendliche, 5,00 Euro für Jahrgang 2007 und älter
3,00 Euro für Jugendliche, 5,00 Euro für Jahrgang 2007 und älter

description: The MidSummerRun 2026 takes place on June 19 in Hamburg and is being organised for the fifth time by Lauftreff Alstertal e.V. This sustainable running event offers three races: a children’s run of approx. 970 metres, a 5 km run and a 10 km run along the wild upper reaches of the Alster, one of Hamburg’s most beautiful running areas. The start and finish are on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, where a Future Fair featuring sustainability partners and a food truck will also be on hand. The MidSummerRun champions environmental protection and sustainability, and was awarded second place in the Hanse Environmental Prize.
course_highlights: Route along the wild upper reaches of the Alster
Start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel
Sustainably organised race focused on environmental protection and the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals
additional: The entry fee includes free travel to and from the event on the HVV. The participant limit is 200 for the children’s run and 600 across all races combined. Late registration is available from 10 June 2026 and on race day, provided the limit has not been reached. First aid is available on an outpatient basis in the finish area. Picnic blankets made from recycled advertising banners and a food truck will be available for a relaxed gathering after the race. Children’s run approx. 970 m, 5 km, 10 km, sustainable organisation, start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, eco-friendly medals, sustainable refreshments

name: Mittsommernachtslauf Hannover
location: Vereinsheim des HRC Hannover, Weddigenufer 23, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Mittsommernachtslauf Hannover is an urban running event held on the longest day of the year along the idyllic Leine floodplains in Hannover. Various distances are offered: a 7.7 km individual race, a 21.1 km individual race, and a 23.1 km relay with three participants. The event is part of the Hannover Region Running Pass and offers a special atmosphere, with the start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse. Two aid stations along the course provide refreshments, and timing is done using rental chips. Late registration is possible on the day of the event from 17:00.
course_highlights: Route along the idyllic Leine floodplains in Hannover
Two aid stations with water, isotonic drinks and energy gels
Start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event from 17:00. Timing is done using rental chips, which are worn on the foot and returned at the finish. Showers and changing rooms are available in limited numbers at the neighboring Angaria clubhouse and at the University Sports Center (100 m walk). Bags can be dropped off before the start at the tent opposite the clubhouse. Travel by light rail to Königsworther Platz, followed by a walk of approx. 500 m; parking is available at the University Sports Center. Distances: 7.7 km, 21.1 km, relay 23.1 km; start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse, Weddigenufer 23; online registration until 25.06.2026, on-site late registration available.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 5
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Over eight days, participants run, walk, or Nordic walk approximately 10 km per stage on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog, and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and encounters with nature. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and sells out well in advance.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Langeoog (5. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. It takes place in 2026 from June 20 to 27 and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. Stage 5 takes runners to the car-free island of Langeoog, renowned for its 14 km-long sandy beach, dunes, tides and salt marshes in the Wadden Sea National Park. The start and finish are centrally located at the corner of Barkhausenstraße/Gartenstraße/Kurstraße, and the event offers a unique combination of athletic challenge and nature experience.

name: Osnabrücker Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The Charity Midsummer Night Run in Osnabrück-Sutthausen takes place on 26 June 2026 from 18:00 and offers a relaxed running event for all age groups in support of the nonprofit association Zusammen-Bewegen e.V. The route starts at the RW Sutthausen sports ground and leads into the Hörner Bruch woodland, where one lap is about 3 kilometres long. Distances range from 500 m for Bambinis to 10 km for adults, with no individual timing. After the run, participants can wind down the evening over food and drinks.

name: Altstadtfestlauf in Lauf
description: The Altstadtfest Run in Lauf an der Pegnitz takes place every year on Friday evening, opening the Altstadtfest on the last weekend in June. It is considered the world’s largest class reunion and offers runners a special experience, with a setting found nowhere else, such as the runners’ pack on the Laufer Water Bridge. There is a 10 km main race with a turnaround point at Lebenshilfe in Schönberg, as well as a 5 km race, including Nordic walking, with a turnaround point on Ottensooser Straße. The event combines sporting competition with a social gathering and also supports social projects.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2025 Lauf 3: Sommerlauf um den SchiederSee
description: The SchiederSee Summer Run is part of the 2025 Lippe Summer Series and takes place on June 26, 2026, in Schieder-Schwalenberg. The event offers two distances, 1 km and 8.3 km, and is suitable for runners of all ability levels. The scenic course runs around SchiederSee, with pleasant summer weather expected: average temperatures of 23 °C and mostly sunny days. Results may be included in official athletics rankings.

name: Retzbachlauf Gaimersheim
description: The Retzbachlauf in Gaimersheim is a traditional running event taking place on 26 June 2026 in Retzbachpark. The event includes races for various age groups, from Bambini to youth, as well as a fun run and main race. The course is a flat loop, mostly on gravel paths, and counts toward the Sport IN Laufcup standings. The races start in the late afternoon, and results are published soon after the races. The event is family-friendly and offers a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: Wiesengrundlauf
description: The Wiesengrundlauf in Haselbachtal is a regional running event held every year on the Friday evening after the summer solstice. The municipality of Haselbachtal invites runners of all ages to take part in distances ranging from 600 m to 11.6 km. The event is part of the Sachsen Energie Läufer-Cup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for overall and age-group winners. The start and finish are at the “Wiesengrund” sports field in Bischheim. The 2025 premiere was a great success, with numerous participants and a varied supporting programme.

name: Osterrönfelder Moorlauf
description: The Osterrönfeld Moor Run takes place on June 26, 2026, in Osterrönfeld and offers runners of all ages a varied running experience. The event includes a 1.17-kilometer children’s run, a 5-kilometer fun run, and the 10-kilometer Moor Run. The course starts at the sports field on Aukamp Street and leads through the scenic moorland. Timing is handled using transponders, and participants receive certificates, medals, and trophies. The event is family-friendly and offers showers and on-site parking.

name: Excalibur Race MOON Zámek Duchcov
description: Excalibur Race MOON Duchcov Castle is an obstacle race taking place from June 26 to 28, 2026, in the historic grounds of the state-owned Duchcov Castle and its surroundings. Runners will follow in the footsteps of the legendary Giacomo Casanova and take on a fast course with beautiful views of the Ore Mountains, the Central Bohemian Uplands, and the foothills of the Bílina mine. The race features modern, certified obstacles on professional ALU structures, with an emphasis on safety and quality. The atmosphere is enhanced by a medieval-knight theme that connects the physical challenge with the values of honor, loyalty, and cooperation. A varied program and facilities, including refreshments and services, are available for runners and fans.

name: Supermaraton Gor Stolowych
description: The Table Mountains Supermarathon is a demanding mountain race held in the picturesque Table Mountains near Karłów. The route follows hiking trails and is technically challenging, with numerous rocks, turns, and significant elevation gain. Participants can expect changing conditions, including possible snow and ice, and are required to carry suitable equipment. The event is part of the Grand Prix DFBG mountain-running series and attracts fans of ultrarunning and mountain half-marathons.

name: Sudecka 100
description: Sudecka 100 is Poland’s oldest night ultramarathon, held in the mountain setting of Boguszów-Gorce. The race course is challenging and full of excitement, giving participants the chance to test themselves over the 100 km distance. In 2026, the organizers are introducing two new events: the Sudecki Morning Half Marathon, covering 21 km, and the Night Mountain Marathon, covering 42 km. The event attracts runners from across the country and offers generous race packages and numerous attractions, including personalized medals and aid stations along the course.

name: XIII Dycha Anny Wazówny
description: The 13th Anna Vasa 10K is a 10 km road race taking place in Brodnica. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness over a middle distance, and the organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The race is open and runner-friendly, offering expert support and the chance to take part in a sporting event in the picturesque Kuyavian-Pomeranian city.

name: 7 Maraton Pędziwiatra
organizer: Amatorski Klub Miłośników Biegania Pędziwiatr Gliwice
description: The 7th Pędziwiatr Marathon is organized by the Pędziwiatr Gliwice Amateur Running Club and will take place on June 27, 2026. Participants will complete 10 laps of a 4.2195 km loop, running mainly along sheltered park paths. The race is amateur in nature and dedicated to the memory of Marek Dworski. Individual, team, and relay classifications are planned. The race starts at 10:00, at the same time as the Gliwice Park Running Challenge.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026, organized by the Amatorski Klub Miłośników Biegania „Pędziwiatr”. The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation, with the motto “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!” The approximately 4.2 km route runs mainly along forest tracks and gravel paths, with a refreshment point at the start/finish. Events take place on Saturdays once a month, starting at 10:00, in the clearing behind Piast Stadium in Gliwice.

name: III Bieg w Sławicach
description: The 3rd Sławice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on June 27, 2026, in Sławice, Mazowieckie Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness over a middle distance in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers welcome both beginners and experienced runners.

name: X Lubeński Cross
description: The X Lubeński Cross is a mountain cross-country race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Lubenia municipality. The start and finish are at the market square in Lubenia. The main race routes are 13.8 km and 22.3 km long, crossing varied terrain: asphalt, paved roads and dirt trails, as well as 3 or 5 green hills. The race is challenging and offers beautiful views, creating a unique sporting celebration. Children’s and youth races are also held at the stadium, divided into age and gender categories.

name: XIII Bieg Cichociemnych
description: The 13th Cichociemni Run is a cross-country race held in Sochaczew in honor of the Polish heroes, the Cichociemni soldiers. The course is challenging, with numerous natural and artificial obstacles of varying difficulty that require participants to get wet, jump over obstacles, and crawl underneath them.
