Held once a year in June, the race attracts people who want to challenge their limits and aren’t afraid of mud. It’s a unique opportunity to explore the banks and riverbed of the Bzura River and feel the wind in your hair during a sporting competition.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners from the region and beyond. The races take place on a permanent course familiar to participants, and the atmosphere is welcoming to both experienced runners and amateurs. The event attracts large groups of runners, Nordic walkers, and canicross participants, and entry is free. The organizers ensure the event is well run and support the growth of the local running community.

name: XXI Dziesiątka Unisławska
description: The 21st Unisław 10K is an annual 10 km race and Nordic walking event held in Unisław as part of the Unisław Days celebrations. The race route follows paved roads through the scenic Chełmno Landscape Park, passing through the towns of Unisław, Stablewice, and Gołoty. The race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and is part of the 2026 Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running. All running and Nordic walking enthusiasts are welcome to take part in this sporting event.

name: XXVII Bieg Górski Żar
organizer: Urząd Gminy Czernichów i Stowarzyszenie Bajeczne Beskidy
description: The 27th Żar Mountain Run is a 10 km mountain race taking place on June 27, 2026, in Międzybrodzie Żywieckie. It is an excellent opportunity for mountain-running enthusiasts to take on a challenging course and test their fitness. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to different experience levels. The race combines sporting competition with the beauty of the mountain scenery.

name: XXXVII Cross Świętojański
description: The 37th Jan Marek St John’s Cross-Country Race in Pogórze is a traditional race organized by LKS Pogórze, taking place on June 27, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. The event is held in the picturesque town of Pogórze and attracts runners who enjoy competing on off-road courses. The organizers provide professional RFID timing and comprehensive technical support to ensure the event runs smoothly. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this special sporting event.

name: Besenbinder Lauf - Rund um Hainrode
description: The 1st Besenbinder Run – Around Hainrode is a running event in the southern Harz, organized by ASV 1902 Sangerhausen. The event takes place on 27 June 2026 in Hainrode and offers runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs around Hainrode and promises varied natural surroundings. The event is open to children, young people, adults and masters.
course_highlights: Run around Hainrode in the southern Harz
Event in a natural setting
Suitable for a range of age groups and ability levels
additional: Registration is open until 24 June 2026; the venue is Hainröder Hauptstraße 60A, Hainrode; no specific terrain details are available.

name: Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon
description: The Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon in Löningen is an established running event in northern Germany, taking place for the 24th time on 27 June 2026. The flat, scenic course is a loop through the Hasetal valley, half of it on the Hasetal cycling and walking trail, and is officially measured by the DLV and eligible for the rankings list. In addition to the marathon, the event offers a half marathon, marathon relay, corporate relay, Nordic walking, walking and student races. The event is known for its great atmosphere, support from spectators and volunteers, and the Marathon Night afterwards, featuring a live band on the market square.
course_highlights: Flat course through the Hasetal valley with scenic surroundings
Loop course with 2 laps for the marathon, half of it on the Hasetal cycling and walking trail
Start and finish at Löningen market square, followed by the Marathon Night party
additional: Start and finish at Löningen market square, with information and sales stands as well as an event stage. The course passes through the Werwer Fuhren forest and varied Geest landscapes. There is a Marathon Night party in the evening with a TOP-40 live band. The Bambini run starts separately from the Gelbrink car park. Refreshments are organised by the St. Vitus Löningen altar servers. The event is certified as a “Three-Star Run.” It also includes the charity initiative “Laufend helfen in Löningen,” a marathon brochure, and is usually held in June.

name: Glückstädter City-Lauf
description: The Glückstadt City Run warmly welcomes runners of all ages to experience the picturesque town of Glückstadt. The event offers various distances from 250 m to 10 km, running through the beautiful town centre and along the harbour. Participation is at your own risk. Age-group rankings are provided, with trophies for the top runners in the 5 km and 10 km races. Race materials can be collected on race day from 9:00 a.m., and late entries are possible until 60 minutes before the respective race.
course_highlights: Courses through the picturesque town centre of Glückstadt
Races along the harbour head and past the Legends Park
A range of distances from 250 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: Race materials can be collected at the harbour head on race day from 9:00 a.m. Late entries are possible until 60 minutes before the respective race, with a late-entry fee of €5. Changing facilities and tents are available; showers are available at Fortunabad. For safety reasons, headphones may not be worn and animals or jogging strollers may not be brought along during the race. The event offers shower and changing facilities, safety and data protection provisions, as well as medals and trophies for the winners.

name: Isselhorster Nacht
description: The Isselhorster Nacht is a traditional running event in Gütersloh-Isselhorst, taking place for the 26th time on June 27, 2026. It offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including a Bambini run, Schoolrunning, a fun run, a corporate run, speed skating and the main race. The event combines sporting commitment with social engagement by supporting the German Stroke Foundation. A special preparation programme, “Fit in 100 Days,” motivates and accompanies participants on their way to the event. The races take place in the centre of Isselhorst, with a lively atmosphere, plenty of spectators and a varied supporting programme.
course_highlights: Various race distances from 500 m to 9,200 m for all age groups
Route through the centre of Isselhorst, with several laps
Popular corporate race featuring team rankings and outlandish costumes
additional: Late entries are possible up to two weeks before the event, subject to a late-entry fee, except for the Bambini and school races. On the day of the event, registration is available on site from 16:00. The event supports the German Stroke Foundation, with the option to donate based on kilometres run. There is an extensive preparation programme, “Fit in 100 Days,” with weekly training sessions and individual support. The races take place in the centre of Isselhorst, with spectators lining the route, and there is a warm-up for children before the first races. A running event with a fundraising campaign against stroke, a varied programme, music and a party.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 1
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The first stage starts on Sunday, June 21, 2026, in Förste and leads through the beautiful Söse Valley, with views of Lichtenstein and a route past the famous Lichtenstein Cave. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, and also offers a 750-meter kids’ stage in Schützenpark. Stages take place daily through June 27, 2026, and are organized by regional clubs.

name: 6. Hofer Backyard Ultra
description: The Hofer Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarunning event taking place on June 27, 2026, in Hof, Bavaria. The race starts at 09:00 and is, by definition, open-ended: it ends only when one runner remains or everyone has dropped out. The course follows a 6.706-kilometer loop with around 80 meters of elevation gain over forest and woodland trails and asphalt. The event attracts participants from across Germany and beyond, offering a special challenge for runners who want to discover and push beyond their limits.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Spiekeroog (7. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian North Sea islands, attracting running enthusiasts from Germany and other countries for more than two decades. The 7th stage takes place on 27 June 2026 on the car-free island of Spiekeroog, known for its unspoilt nature, endless beaches and relaxed atmosphere. The stage starts and finishes on Gartenweg, level with the Kurpark. The event offers a unique running experience in a distinctive island landscape, combining a sporting challenge with the enjoyment of nature.

name: Fischerhuder Sommerlauf
description: The Fischerhude Summer Run, organized by Sportfreunde Fischerhude e.V., takes place on June 27, 2026, starting at 18:00. Events include a 1 km race for children and 5 km and 10 km races for teenagers and adults, run on an officially measured 5 km loop. There is also a 2x5 km relay for friends, families, and colleagues. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with free hot and cold drinks in the finish area and changing and shower facilities after the race. A DJ provides entertainment, and after the races there is an after-run party with a barbecue, cocktails, and drinks.

name: Berglauf 2026
description: The Kyffhäuser Mountain Run is a traditional running event at the Kyffhäuser Monument in Thomm, attracting numerous runners each year. The route climbs uphill and offers a sporting challenge with impressive views. In addition to the main race, there is also a tower stair race, in which participants climb 306 steps inside the monument tower. The event thrives on the commitment of runners, supporters, and volunteer helpers, and promises an unforgettable running experience in a unique landscape.

name: Brauerschwender Basaltlauf
description: The Brauerschwender Basaltlauf takes place on June 27, 2026, in Brauerschwend and offers runners of all ages an athletic challenge in beautiful surroundings. The courses have gentle elevation changes, are well marked, and display kilometer markers. Drinks are available along the course, and the organizer provides refreshments at the finish. The race is for both competitive runners and anyone who enjoys being active as part of a group.

name: DJK-Willibaldslauf
description: The DJK-Willibaldslauf is an inclusive running event in Eichstätt, taking place for the second time on June 27, 2026. All age groups and ability levels are welcome, with events ranging from a children’s run and inclusive runs to the main race and Nordic walking. The scenic route follows the Altmühl and leads to the cathedral. The start and finish are at the DJK Eichstätt parking lot. The event focuses on community and fun, with no timing, and all participants receive high-quality running shirts and commemorative medals.

name: Fuchsburg Lauf
description: The Fuchsburg Run is organized by TV Vohburg and takes place as part of the Vohburg Fuchsburg Festival on June 27, 2026. The event offers runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to run on attractive routes through the region. The races include a 10 km main race, a 2.3 km schoolchildren’s race, and a 600 m Bambini race. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and the joy of sport, supported by a dedicated TV Vohburg team.

name: Göllnitz-Schmooksberglauf (LC/NLC)
description: The 2nd Göllnitz-Schmooksberglauf (LC/NLC) takes place on 27 June 2026 in Diekhof (Laage) and is hosted by Sportclub Laage. This athletics event is held away from a stadium and invites runners to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Diekhof and offers an attractive challenge for all participants. Registration is open until 24 June 2026.

name: Lubaster Waldlauf
description: The 13th Lubaster Forest Run takes place on June 27, 2026, in Kemberg and offers runners two distances: 1 km and 6.3 km. The event is ideal for anyone looking to experience a short but varied forest route. The race promises pleasant summer weather, with an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny conditions. Participants can look forward to a friendly, family atmosphere and a well-organized event.

name: MÜRITZ-LAUF
description: The MÜRITZ-LAUF is a race around Germany’s largest inland lake, the Müritz, and takes place on 27 June 2026 in Waren (Müritz). The route reflects the full variety of the northern German landscape and has a gently rolling profile, making it ideal for runners who want to enjoy nature while also running fast. The event is organised by ESV Waren e.V., a long-standing sports club that, with the support of numerous sponsors and volunteers, ensures everything runs smoothly.

name: Schöneicher Eichkaterlauf
description: The 14th Eichkater Run on June 27, 2026, in Schöneiche offers a varied running program for all ages and ability levels. From short races for toddlers and children to fun runs and the challenging 12 km premier event, there is something for everyone. The routes pass through the beautiful natural surroundings of Schöneiche and offer an enjoyable sporting experience for the community. The event is family-friendly, and registration is conveniently available online, with late registration also possible on race day.

name: Stadtlauf Abensberg 2026
description: The Abensberg City Run takes place on June 27, 2026, at the new stadium in Abensberg. The event is a special highlight of TSV Abensberg’s athletics department, which is committed to promoting recreational sport. By taking part in the city run, you support local running and help foster a vibrant sporting culture. The race is a great opportunity to come together and raise funds for a new tartan track and modern training equipment.

name: Volksbank-Bever-Lauf
description: The Volksbank-Bever-Lauf takes place on June 27, 2026, at Beverstadion in Ostbevern. The event offers various races, including a half-marathon relay and individual races for runners born in 2012 or earlier. The course is measured by the DLV and is part of the Volksbank-Cup running series. Drinks and refreshments are available in the finish area, and changing rooms and showers are located directly at Beverstadion.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 7
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk approximately 10 kilometers per stage, enjoying the unique natural surroundings, maritime atmosphere and healthy sea air. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a fair competition in a friendly, family-like atmosphere. Because capacity on the islands is limited, the number of participants is capped, ensuring an exclusive running experience.

name: Běh týnišťskými pralesy
description: The Run through the Týniště Forests is a charity race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Týniště nad Orlicí, offering courses for different fitness levels and age groups. The race takes place in a forest, mainly on firm forest paths, with some paved sections. The event includes a free family run for children under 18 and main races of 6, 10 and 21 km. It brings sport, families and support for a good cause together, benefiting RENEDA, a nonprofit organization that helps children facing neurological challenges.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v dlouhém horském běhu
description: The World Masters Long Mountain Running Championships will take place on June 27, 2026, in the picturesque setting of Janské Lázně in the Hradec Králové Region. This race is intended for masters athletes and offers a challenging long mountain run that will test runners’ endurance and strength amid beautiful mountain scenery. The event is part of the prestigious trail-running calendar and attracts runners from around the world. For more information, we recommend checking the organization’s official website.

name: ROZKOŠný 1/2 Maraton
description: The ROZKOŠný 1/2 Marathon is a half marathon held in Česká Skalice, following a new cycle path around the Rozkoš Reservoir. The event offers a main 21.1 km race and an accompanying 2 km run for children and mothers with strollers. The event also features entertainment, refreshments, and the option of accommodation at the campsite, creating a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators alike. The main category starts at 12:30, and the first category starts at 10:00.

name: Běh lužanskými hvozdy
organizer: Obec Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., TJ Sokol Lužany
description: Běh lužanskými hvozdy is a traditional running race held in the recreational area of the village of Lužany near Jičín, specifically at the campsite by Marešák Pond. The 50th anniversary edition will take place on 27 June 2026 and offers a range of categories and race distances suitable for a wide variety of runners, including children. The race is supported by the Hradec Králové Region and organized by the Municipality of Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., and TJ Sokol Lužany. Participants can expect medals, prizes in kind, and cash awards for the top finishers in each category.

name: Žhavé běhy Slováckého léta
description: The Hot Runs of Slovácké léto are traditional running races held in the historic center of Uherské Hradiště. Participants can choose from three routes of 5, 10, and 21 kilometers, which pass through picturesque countryside along the Morava River, through Kunovský les forest park, and by the Novoveská lakes. The races are suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offer a unique opportunity to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of Slovácko. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, adding to the atmosphere of the city’s historic heart.

name: Malofatranská stovka
description: The Malofatranská Stovka is a mountain ultramarathon in the Malá Fatra range, featuring demanding routes with significant climbs and descents. The race is intended for experienced runners in excellent physical condition and crosses the entire range, including Krivánska Fatra and Lúčanská Fatra. The event is a registered ITRA member and serves as a qualifying race for other prestigious ultratrails. It is organized by Slovak Ultra Trail in cooperation with volunteers and partners.

name: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši
location: Domaša, Domaša, Domaša rekreačné stredisko Dobra , parkovisko pri Bogárke
description: The St. John’s Run at Domaša is a traditional running race held at the Domaša Dobrá recreational resort. Runners can choose between two courses—a short 5 km course and a long 13 km course—which run mostly along forest roads and trails with varied elevation. The event is suitable for the general public, with categories by age and gender. The organizers provide refreshment stations, changing rooms, toilets, and medical services. The atmosphere is friendly and competitive, with valuable prizes in kind for the winners.

name: Beh za zdravie – Záhorská Bystrica
location: Záhorská Bystrica, Záhorská Bystrica, pri BYS3T PARK-u, na ulici Ota Holúsku - Krče
description: Run for Health in Záhorská Bystrica is a charity running event that brings together sport and support for health and the community. It will take place on 27 June 2026 at BYS3T PARK, offering a chance to enjoy a great atmosphere and inspiring stories, while every participant contributes to a good cause. The event is open to all age groups and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and support for disadvantaged people. Run for Health was established in 2023 and each year supports selected individuals or foundations through physical activity.

name: Velvet Run Košice
location: Košice, Košice, pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici.
organizer: Progres Promotion Košice, s.r.o., Maratónsky klub Košice
description: Velvet Run in Košice is a running event taking place on June 27, 2026, at Urban’s Tower on Hlavná Street. Participants can choose from the 5 km, 10 km, and 5 km Velvet Nordic Walking events. The event is exclusively for women and offers valuable non-cash prizes for winners in various categories. The organizers provide timing using the MyLaps system, and results will be published on the official websites.

name: Čergovský umirak
location: Drienica, okr. Sabinov, Drienica, okr. Sabinov, Chata Ride pub
organizer: Marián Gargalovič, Ondrej Janiga, Slavomír Uličný
description: Čergovský Umirak is a mountain race of approximately 30 km with around 1,000 metres of elevation gain, intended for trained runners. The race takes place at the Drienica recreation centre, where refreshments and additional activities for families are available. The course follows a marked hiking trail, and runners are required to wear their bib visibly attached to their chest. Safety on the course is provided by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service, and each participant takes part at their own risk. After the last runners finish, there is a ceremony to announce the results and award prizes to the top men and women.

name: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky – Memoriál Františka Hečka
location: Horné Orešany okr. Trnava, Horné Orešany okr. Trnava, futbalový štadión
organizer: Bežecký klub Viktoria, Obecný úrad Horné Orešany
description: The Run through the Hornoorešanské Hills – František Hečko Memorial is a running race in Horné Orešany, featuring a 10,300-metre course with 100 metres of elevation gain. The course is 50% asphalt and 50% trail, making the race interesting and challenging. The race is open to all age groups, from children aged 1 and up to seniors, with categories for men, women, juniors and local runners. It is organised by Bežecký klub Viktoria together with the Municipal Office in Horné Orešany. The start for schoolchildren is at 15:35, and for everyone else at 17:00.

name: Rajec RunTour Bratislava
description: Rajec RunTour Bratislava is a family-friendly running festival offering courses for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose from 3, 5 and 10 km races, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place at two locations and offers a race pack with everything runners need. In addition to the races, there is a varied programme of activities, refreshments on the course and at the finish, medical and driving services, and facilities including changing rooms and baggage storage. The whole day is designed as an experience for runners and their families, with a raffle and the option to have personal details engraved on medals.

name: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina
location: Bachledová dolina, Bachledová dolina, Bachledka Ski & Sun
description: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a trail run in the stunning natural surroundings of the High Tatras, offering runners a unique experience on soft terrain with fresh mountain air. The route passes through the Treetop Walk, Monkova dolina and the ridge of Spišská Magura, with the start accessed by cable car. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series, which combines sporting achievement with support for local families and charitable causes. Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a challenge for experienced runners and newcomers alike who want to experience mountain nature and unforgettable views.

name: Skyrun Kubínska
location: Kubínska hoľa, Okres Dolný Kubín, Žilinský kraj
description: Skyrun Kubínska is a mountain run in the beautiful natural surroundings of Orava, offering 24 km and 11 km courses. The race is dedicated to the memory of Barnabáš Üvegeš, and runners can enjoy challenging terrain with views of the surrounding countryside. Participants will experience a combination of mountain trails and natural scenery that makes this event a unique experience.

name: Wielka Pętla Izerska w ramach Izerskiego Weekendu Biegowego
location: Szklarska Poręba, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Great Jizera Loop is a scenic half marathon held as part of the Jizera Running Weekend in Szklarska Poręba. The course runs through the town streets and along trails in the Jizera Mountains, offering runners a chance to connect with nature and enjoy mountain scenery. The event combines recreation and sport, promoting physical activity and the popularity of running. Participants use electronic timekeeping, and the time limit for completing the course is 3 hours.

name: XVIII Bieg w pogoni za żubrem
description: The 15th Bieg w Pogoń za Żubrem is an annual running event held in Niepołomice, attracting runners to a range of distances. The event offers 8- and 15-kilometer courses as well as a children’s race, making it appealing to a wide range of participants. The route passes through scenic areas, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the surrounding nature. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and compete in a friendly atmosphere.

name: 5 Półmaraton Zbucki
additional: The start of the 5th Zbucki Half Marathon is scheduled for June 28, 2026, at 09:00 in Zbuczyn.

name: Izery Ultra-Trail
description: Izery Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the heart of the picturesque Izera Mountains, with the start and finish in Świeradów-Zdrój. Routes of varying lengths and difficulty levels lead through wild, lesser-known areas, offering runners unforgettable views and challenges. The event attracts both experienced ultramarathoners and trail enthusiasts looking to take on demanding terrain and enjoy the beauty of nature. The organizers provide full support at aid stations and require specific equipment, ensuring participants’ safety and comfort.

name: Kresowe Trail #7
description: Kresowe Trail is a small-scale, non-commercial trail running event held amid the scenic natural surroundings of eastern Poland and the Vilnius Region. The routes pass through pristine forests, varied climbs, sand and roots, offering challenges for both beginners and experienced runners. The race is held over two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), which is an ultramarathon. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature, and connections among runners from different backgrounds.

name: Roztoczański Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Roztocze Running Festival 2026 is one of the largest running events in the Roztocze region, organized by the Lubaczów Municipality. The three-day festival takes place in Basznia Dolna, at Kresowa Osada, the start and finish venue for all races and Nordic walking events. Participants can choose from ten different distances, ranging from night races and Nordic walking events to an ultramarathon and half marathon, on routes through the picturesque Lubaczów region. The event combines sporting competition with a festival atmosphere, attracting both experienced runners and amateurs.

name: Łabiszyński Bieg Świętojański
organizer: Łabiszyński Dom Kultury, Urząd Miejski w Łabiszynie, F.W. Martex, Uczniowski Klub Sportowy Łabiszynianka
description: The Łabiszyn St. John’s Eve Run is an annual running event taking place on June 28, 2026, at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn. The main 5 km race starts at 10:00, followed by children’s and youth races in four age categories. Participants in the main race will receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger runners will receive a medal and a surprise. The best runners will be presented with awards after the races. The event is part of a running series and offers starter packages to the first people to register.

name: 3 Otwarty Bieg Sejmowy o Puchar Marszałka
Bieg Powitania Lata
location: Strzelce Wielkie, Pajęczno County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków
description: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków is a cross-country race held in Reduta Park in Kraków, with 5 km and 10 km courses. The route runs mainly along trails and forest tracks, with one significant uphill section, combining sport with history. After the race, participants and their companions can take a guided tour of historic sites of the former Kraków Fortress, making the event a unique blend of physical activity and education. The race’s mission is to promote running and knowledge of local heritage.
course_highlights: Cross-country route along trails and forest tracks
One substantial uphill section
Guided tours of historic Kraków Fortress sites after the race
additional: After the race, participants can take a guided tour of sites of the former Kraków Fortress, including forts, earthworks, caverns, field batteries and shelters. The race route is off-road and green, with history in the background. Unique trophies made from 100-year-old bricks are awarded to the top competitors in each category. After the race, participants and their companions can also take a guided tour of sites of the former Kraków Fortress, including forts, earthworks, caverns, field batteries and shelters. Information about the edition scheduled for 27 June 2027 has not been confirmed in available sources.

name: V RUNda Żubra Biegi i Nordic Walking
Dahlenburger Moorlauf
description: The Dahlenburg Moor Run is a popular community race with manual timekeeping, attracting around 200 participants each year. The event offers races for children, walking, and two main races over 4,600 m and 8,800 m. The course is flat and mostly paved, and the children’s races take place on the tartan track. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and picturesque setting in the Dahlenburg Moor.
course_highlights: Flat, mostly paved course
Children’s races on the tartan track
Run through the picturesque setting of the Dahlenburg Moor
additional: Race number pickup from 08:30 at the DSK sports facility/Dornweg in Dahlenburg. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for an additional fee of €3.00. Manual timekeeping. Showers are available at the swimming pool (admission required) or in the clubhouse. Refreshments include drink stations along the course, as well as coffee, cake, and soft drinks at the sports field. Parking is available in front of the swimming pool and the school. Courses, registration, community spirit, various types of running

name: Tippkötter Sommerlauf in Rheine
location: Bentlager Wald, Rheine, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Tippkötter Summer Run in Rheine takes place on June 28, 2026, in Bentlage Forest and offers scenic, nature-filled routes with views of the salt works and Bentlage Monastery. The spectacular finish is in the FC Eintracht Rheine stadium, where all runners cross the finish line at the penalty spot. Music, professional commentary and surprises make this a special running experience for participants of all ages. Alongside the main race, there is also an elementary school run, making the event a family-friendly sports festival.
course_highlights: Scenic routes through Bentlage Forest
Route passing the salt works and Bentlage Monastery
Finish in the FC Eintracht Rheine stadium at the penalty spot
additional: Electronic timing with a transponder race bib. Race packets can be collected in the VIP room at FC Eintracht Rheine. Headphones are prohibited and may result in disqualification. Bambini run participants receive a participation medal. Trophies for the overall winners of the 2 km, 5 km, 5 km walking and 10 km races. Age-group awards with medals only for the 2 km race. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. Ample changing rooms and showers are available. Food and drink available on site, including drinks, fries, bratwurst, steaks and waffles. Parking is available at Rheine Zoo. The 5 km and 10 km routes are officially measured and eligible for rankings. The event takes place in June 2026 and features various race distances, electronic timing, on-site refreshments and parking at Rheine Zoo; there is no parking directly at the event venue.

name: 19. Muko-Spendenlauf Hannover
description: The 19th Muko Charity Run Hannover is an inclusive race taking place on 28 June 2026 at the VfL Eintracht Hannover sports field. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, whether you run, walk or stroll, with or without a disability. The goal is to raise donations for Haus Schutzengel, a guesthouse for parents and patients from families affected by cystic fibrosis, near Hannover Medical School. Sponsors donate one euro for every lap completed on the 400-metre cinder track. The race promotes community and solidarity in the fight against cystic fibrosis.

name: 32. hella hamburg halbmarathon
description: The hella hamburg half marathon is a major running event in Hamburg, held annually on the last Sunday in June. On an officially measured, flat, paved 21.1 km course, up to 24,000 runners experience a unique running party through the Hanseatic city. The route passes around 50 sights and is accompanied by numerous event zones featuring DJ support and live music. The event is known for its great atmosphere and traffic-free course, secured by police and marshals.

name: 24-Stunden Burginsellauf
description: The 24-hour Burginsel Run in Delmenhorst is a challenging ultramarathon on a flat, approximately 1.3 km loop along Burginsel and the Graftwiesen. The event offers individual and team competitions, as well as a 6-hour run and a 3-hour schoolchildren’s run. The course is closed to traffic, illuminated and mostly shaded, making it ideal for endurance runners who want to test their limits. There is a refreshment station open around the clock during the run, as well as a tent area for rest breaks. The German 24-hour running championships are held as part of this event.

name: BikeNavy Run
description: The BikeNavy! Run is a unique running event held on the grounds of Nordholz Airfield, which is otherwise not open to the public. The course runs within the controlled airspace of the Nordholz Naval Air Base and offers participants a special atmosphere, with views of historic and modern aviation. After the race, participants can visit the AERONAUTICUM Naval Aviation and Airship Museum. The event is ideal for runners looking for an extraordinary and unforgettable running experience.

name: Kreuzwertheimer Landschaftsläufe
description: On June 28, 2026, the Kreuzwertheim scenic runs offer three varied races for different age groups. The 14 km “Run to Himmelreich” passes through a nature conservation area and vineyards, with challenging climbs. The new 7 km run around Kaffelstein features gentle climbs and beautiful views of the Main Valley. Children and teenagers can take part in a hilly 2.2 km forest run. The event is family-friendly, with team rankings, prizes, and a floral surprise at the finish.

name: Ohndorfer Volkslauf
description: The Ohndorf Fun Run is a family-friendly running event held annually in Ohndorf and is part of the Schaumburg Running Series. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. Online registration is open until race day, with on-site registration available up to 30 minutes before the start. The run is attracting increasing numbers of participants and offers a great opportunity to exercise together and enjoy a sense of community.

name: Seester Sternenlauf
description: The Seester Star Run takes place for the tenth time on June 28, 2026, and is a charity run in support of the Kinder-Hospiz Sternenbrücke in Hamburg. The event offers a range of distances for runners, walkers, Nordic walkers, and Bambinis, including a special 10 km loop through the historic Lindenallee at Gut Seestermühe. Grill sausages, coffee, and cake will be available, and the route will be lined with decorated streets and a wonderful atmosphere. The organizing team looks forward to welcoming many participants and spectators to this cheerful and successful event.

name: Uni-Lauf Bamberg
description: The Uni-Lauf Bamberg is an open public race and will take place for the 12th time in 2026. It features several race distances, including a 10 km main race, which also serves as the Bavarian University Championships and the Upper Franconian Championships, a 10 km relay, a 2 km girls’ race, and a 500 m children’s race. The flat, officially measured course runs through ERBA Park, along the Main-Danube Canal, through the Hain and Bamberg’s city center, with picturesque views of historic buildings. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and welcomes female runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu - nahoru
description: The 2026 World Masters Mountain Running Championships in Janské Lázně is a prestigious international mountain running event for masters athletes, attracting competitors from more than 30 countries. The races take place on challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing runners’ endurance and strength. The event is organised by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open until 24 May 2026, and the event offers several course options of varying distances and elevation gains.

name: Sloupský lesní běh
description: The Sloup Forest Run is a traditional road race held in the picturesque surroundings of Sloup in the Moravian Karst. The course is 11.5 kilometres long and is characterised by significant elevation gain, making it a challenging and appealing race for runners. The event has a long history and attracts runners from the surrounding area, who enjoy the beauty of nature and the sporting atmosphere.

name: Lochovice - Plešivec
description: Lochovice–Plešivec is a running race in the Brdy Running Cup, taking place on June 28, 2026, in Lochovice. The course is approximately 5.5 km long with 350 metres of elevation gain. It starts with 2 km on asphalt, then continues along forest paths, with a steeper climb around the 3 km mark. The finish is at the summit of Plešivec, which offers beautiful views. The event also includes children’s races and a family run supporting the Mezi břehy home hospice.

name: Půlmaratón okolo Nového Veselí
description: The Half Marathon Around Nové Veselí is a traditional running race organized by AO TJ Sokol Nové Veselí, now being held for the 25th year. The main 21.1 km race follows a turnaround loop repeated three times on asphalt paths and third-class roads, with minimal elevation gain. Shorter races are also available for youth, school-age children, and preschoolers, making the event appealing to runners of a wide range of ages. Refreshments are provided after the race, and the winner of the main race receives a cash prize. The start is traditionally on the square in Nové Veselí.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Potůčky
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Potůčky, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and the experience route covers 20 to 30 km. In addition to running, walking routes and children’s races are also available. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers the chance to discover the beautiful nature of the Ore Mountains.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu – nahoru
location: Janské Lázně, Janské Lázně, nám. Svobody – kolonáda Janské Lázně
description: The 2026 World Masters Mountain Running Championships is a prestigious international mountain running event for masters athletes, held in the picturesque setting of Janské Lázně. The races offer several challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing the endurance and strength of athletes from more than 30 countries. The event is organized by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open until 24 May 2026, and athletes can look forward to professional organization and sponsor support.

name: Beh údolím Idy
description: The Run through the Ida Valley is a traditional race organized by the Košice-Šaca City District and the municipality of Malá Ida. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of the cultural center in Košice-Šaca and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories. The entry fee is symbolic, while local runners can take part for free. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Beh na Poludňový Grúň
location: Terchová okr. Žilina, Terchová okr. Žilina, Vrátna Paseky o 10,00 hod. na údolnej stanici štvorsedačky
organizer: Občianske združenie Grúň, Chata na Grúni
description: The Run to Poludňový Grúň is a mountain running race in the picturesque Vrátna Valley, in the Malá Fatra mountain range. The course crosses challenging mountain terrain, with beautiful views of peaks such as Poludňový Grúň, Stoh, and Veľký Rozsutec. The race is ideal for nature lovers and mountain runners who want to experience a unique atmosphere and challenge in the heart of Malá Fatra. The organizers warmly invite you to enjoy this sporting event in the beautiful surroundings of Terchová.

name: Montagslauf Rund um Mackenzell
description: The Montagslauf Rund um Mackenzell is a traditional fun run held in the idyllic surroundings of Hünfeld-Mackenzell. The event offers several distances, including a Schülerlauf, 5.3 km, 10 km, and a 14.3 km course with an additional loop. The routes pass through varied landscapes, with refreshment points along the way. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and medical support from the German Red Cross. Showers are available after the run, and Nordic walking is also offered without timekeeping.

name: Sonnwendlauf Großostheim
description: The Sonnwendlauf Großostheim is a traditional race that attracts many running enthusiasts from the region every year. The event offers various distances for different ability levels, from children’s races to a 10 km race for ambitious runners. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Großostheim, combining a sporting challenge with an experience of nature and a family-friendly atmosphere. The race is a fixture in the regional sporting calendar and welcomes both recreational and competitive runners.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Boskovická etapa
description: MUM – the Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage race held in Boskovice and forms part of a seven-day ultramarathon covering seven marathons. The race is known for its difficulty and long tradition, attracting runners seeking the challenge of a stage race. The Boskovice stage gives runners the chance to experience the beauty of the Moravian countryside while testing their endurance on demanding terrain. The race is suitable for experienced ultramarathoners who want to compete against others in a prestigious international event.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červen
description: Tempo Makers Osmicka is a running race in Plzeň with an 8 km course. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and over. The start and finish are at the same location, with registration and race number collection from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race, the top runners are presented with awards and a raffle is held. The race is limited to 75 participants, and each participant takes part at their own risk.

name: 36. Göttinger Altstadtlauf
description: The Göttingen Old Town Run is a long-standing running event in downtown Göttingen, taking place for the 36th time in 2026. The event combines running with the special charm of the old town and attracts runners of all ages. In addition to the main race, there are various school races and a popular corporate race with team scoring. The course leads through the historic city center and offers a lively atmosphere full of excitement and activity.

name: Lachtan
location: Zoo Praha, U Trojského zámku 3/120, Prague 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: In Prague 6, Prague, the sea lion is primarily associated with the breeding and conservation of the South African fur seal at Prague Zoo. A theater performance called “The White Sea Lion” is also held here, aimed mainly at children and school groups, and offering interactive experiences with an environmental theme. The program is suitable for families and schools looking to combine education with entertainment and raise awareness of nature conservation.

name: Kolem Libotína
description: The Run Around Libotín is a traditional race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice and held in the area around Štramberk. The race features a challenging 6.5 km loop whose course was modified in recent years, resulting in new course records. The event is part of the Lašská Running League and attracts runners in various categories, who enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and sporting atmosphere. Category winners are announced after the race, and a raffle is prepared for all participants. The Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice organizes the event and ensures its smooth running while supporting the running community.

name: 32. Lippesee Marathon
location: Lippesee, Paderborn-Sande, Paderborn, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 32nd Lippesee Marathon in Paderborn-Sande is a private marathon held in accordance with the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, around Lippesee, a popular recreation area and water sports center. Participants must be self-sufficient, as there are no aid stations, and time themselves manually; a photo of the watch must be submitted by email as proof. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, with a limit of 18 participants, and takes place only if at least five people register.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Lomnická etapa
location: Olešnice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: MUM – the Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage race held over seven consecutive days, with the Lomnice stage as one of its parts. It is one of the most demanding ultramarathons in the Czech Republic, challenging runners with long distances and demanding terrain in the South Moravian Region. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners who want to test their endurance and strength in beautiful countryside. The Lomnice stage takes place around Olešnice and Lomnice near Tišnov and is part of the full ultramarathon series.

name: Büsumer Volkslauf
description: The Büsum Volkslauf is an annual running event suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike. Various distances are offered, from 400 metres for children to 10 kilometres for experienced runners. The new route follows the waterfront promenade, loops around the Familienlagune and returns, with the start and finish at Büsumer Hauptrand. The event promises a sporty day on the North Sea coast with a beautiful running backdrop.
course_highlights: New route along the waterfront promenade
Loop around the Familienlagune
Start and finish at Büsumer Hauptrand
additional: Three race distances: 400 m Bambini Run at 18:15, 5.5 km health run at 19:00, and 10 km race at 19:00. Registration is also possible by phone at 0176 96204634. Running event on the North Sea coast in Büsum, with routes for Bambini runners, health runners and competitive runners; finish at the swimming pool; registration online and by phone; start and finish at Büsumer Hauptrand; route along the promenade and around the Familienlagune.

name: Marburger Nachtmarathon
description: The Marburg Night Marathon will take place for the 27th time on 3 July 2026 and is the largest running event in the Central Hesse region. The event offers a classic marathon, a half marathon, and a relay marathon with up to four participants. The course passes through Marburg’s picturesque old town and along the Lahn, following a flat, record-eligible loop with views of Landgrave Castle and St. Elizabeth’s Church. The race starts in a special atmosphere at 7 p.m. in the historic market square, and the finish is at the University Stadium. All participants receive a high-quality medal featuring a notable Marburg landmark each year.
course_highlights: Flat, record-eligible loop course
Route passes through the old town and along the Lahn
Views of Landgrave Castle and St. Elizabeth’s Church
additional: The relay marathon consists of four runners, each completing a leg of around ten kilometres. The first relay runner starts in the market square, and the exchange zone is on Frankfurter Straße. Each team receives one race number attached to an elastic race-number belt. Safety pins are provided at registration. The number of participants is limited to ensure safety and an enjoyable running experience. The start and finish are at the University Stadium, about 1 km from the starting point. Course in Marburg’s city area, start at Georg-Gaßman-Stadion, relay exchange on Frankfurter Straße, registration opens on 1 March 2026

name: Rotenburger Strandfestlauf - Rotenburg rennt
location: Rotenburg an der Fulda, Hesse, Germany
price_range: 1 Euro Startgeld für Bambini, vergünstigte Preise für Schüler- und Jugendläufe
description: The Rotenburg Strandfest Run takes place every year on the first Friday in July as part of the traditional Heimat- und Strandfest in Rotenburg an der Fulda. The flat, fast course runs through the town centre and offers various events for young runners, main-race participants, elite runners and teams, as well as walking. New features include precisely measured school and elite races, plus the Beer Mile, where having fun is the main focus. The event combines sporting ambition with a friendly, social atmosphere and is a highlight of the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Rotenburg town centre
School race: exactly 1,248 metres—a tribute to the year Rotenburg was founded
Elite race over 1.609 km (land mile), with entry requirements
additional: No on-site registration is possible; advance registration is available only through specialist portals. The 5 km and 10 km courses are no longer offered; instead, the main race covers a 1.5 km course five times. The Beer Mile has no timing and includes four alcohol-free beer breaks at 400 m intervals. Elite race entry requirements: men, 03:10 min/km; women, 03:30 min/km. Events for young runners, main-race participants, elite runners and teams, plus walking. Preparation through a running group; supported by Sparkasse.

name: Traunreuter Stadtlauf
description: The 23rd Traunreut City Run takes place on July 3, 2026, as a major mass-participation sports event in Traunreut, Bavaria. The course is a flat, measured, paved 7 km loop that starts and finishes at the Rathausplatz. The event welcomes runners of all ages and also features a main race, Bambini races, and relay races. Drinks and food stalls at the Stadtplatz will provide refreshments, and an after-race party will offer entertainment.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Bystřická etapa
description: MUM – Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage race consisting of seven marathons on seven consecutive days. The Bystřice stage is one part of the race, offering a challenging, long run in the picturesque surroundings of Moravia. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathoners seeking the challenge of long stages and beautiful nature. Come test your strength in this prestigious ultramarathon and experience the unique atmosphere of a stage race.

name: Grill Run=Fun 2026
description: Grill+Run=Fun 2026 is a race held in Palowice that combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and fun. The event starts at 08:00, and participants can expect professional RFID timing and comprehensive technical support. The event is organized by the LUXTORPEDA Association, which ensures high-quality organization and support for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and experience the spirit of sporting community.

name: XXIV Atlantis Bieg Opolski
description: The 24th Atlantis Opole Run is an annual race held since 2003 on the first Saturday of July on Bolko Island in Opole. The route runs through a designated quiet, green area in the city center, offering participants the opportunity to compete over 5 km and 10 km distances. Since 2015, the race has been called the Atlantis Opole Run, thanks to the support of Atlantis-Deweloper. The event is organized by the Opole Run Association, which promotes physical activity and sports-based community integration.

name: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny
description: The Kalisz Night Amber Hellena Half Marathon is a unique nighttime half marathon held in Kalisz. The event attracts hundreds of runners from different cities, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a running challenge after dark. The half-marathon course passes through charming parts of the city, giving participants an unforgettable experience. The event has become a tradition and is popular with both amateur and professional runners.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, combining sport with charity. The 10th anniversary edition takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to make Marlena, one of the foundation’s beneficiaries, dream come true: a trip to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and every kilometer brings them closer to achieving this goal. It is not only a sporting challenge, but also an opportunity to work together to support children in need.

name: VI Półmaraton Gęstwinami Murckowskimi
description: The 5th Murckowski Forest Half Marathon is organized by the W Kręgu Natury Association and takes place in the picturesque forests of Murcki in Katowice. The half-marathon course winds through varied woodland terrain, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and enjoy a unique atmosphere. The event is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors, whether you are an experienced runner or a beginner. The organizers provide convenient access by public transport and parking near the start.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowo ZaDyszka is an annual road race held in Janikowo, attracting runners of different ages and ability levels. The race covers 10 km, with professional timekeeping provided using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Janikowo Sports and Recreation Centre, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, ensuring high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and welcoming to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

name: XI Krokowska 10
description: The 11th Krokowska 10 is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series, taking place on July 4 in Żarnowiec. The race offers a 10 km distance through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the region. Kaszuby Biegają is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from pieces awarded at the individual stages.

name: XXVI Bieg o Kryształową Perłę Jeziora Na...
description: The 26th National Run for the Crystal Pearl of Lake Narie is the main race, covering a distance of 31.13 km. It takes place in the scenic surroundings of Lake Narie in Kretowiny. The start and finish are located at the Main Beach in Kretowiny. The event includes age categories for men and women, and participants can look forward to a formal opening and closing ceremony, with awards presented. The event is national in scope and attracts runners from various age groups.

name: Bieg i Nordic Walking O Buławę Sieniawską
Letnia Dwunastka
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Turbacz Summer Trail
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Schwandorfer Charity Stadtlauf
organizer: Alpin Ski · Triathlon · Laufsport · Schwimmen · Nordic Walking · Radsport · Skilanglauf · Snowboarding

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Haupt- und Firmenlauf mit Stadtmeisterschaft: 15,– Euro

description: The Schwandorf Charity City Run takes place for the 20th time on June 20, 2026, offering runners of all ages a varied selection of events. The event combines sporting ambition with social commitment, as net proceeds go to local nonprofit organizations such as Wasserwacht Schwandorf and Bund Naturschutz Schwandorf. Events range from the Bambini Run to school and main races, as well as Nordic walking and a Run & Bike team competition. All participants receive a charity medal and an online certificate, and medical support helps ensure their safety. The event is family-friendly and also features a Stutz’n relay rally as a fun special event.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 200 m to 10 km, including the Bambini Run, school races, main race and Run & Bike
Courses can be viewed digitally on Google Maps, and the Zwergerl Run takes place at Sepp-Simon Stadium
Nordic walking with timing and walking without poles are also available
additional: Late registration and bib collection are possible on the day of the event during various time windows until 1:30 p.m. All participants receive a Charity City Run medal and an online certificate. Medical support is provided by the Johanniter local branch in Schwandorf. Children and school students receive small surprises. Drinks, bratwurst rolls, coffee and cake are sold for charity. Registration deadline: June 14, 2026; family-friendly; net proceeds go to Wasserwacht Schwandorf, Bund Naturschutz Schwandorf and the self-help group for people affected by post-COVID, post-vaccine syndrome and ME/CFS.

name: Oberlichtenauer Sommerlauf
description: The 44th Oberlichtenau Summer Run takes place on 27 June 2026 and invites runners of all ages to a sporting event that has brought together the Saxon running community and guests from near and far for over four decades. The day begins with children’s races over 800 metres and 2.2 kilometres for the U12 and U14 age groups. These are followed by the recreational run of approx. 5 kilometres and the challenging 13-kilometre main race, which tests stamina and skill with steep climbs and fast descents over the Keulenberg. The running group of Sportgemeinschaft Oberlichtenau looks forward to welcoming all participants.
course_highlights: Children’s race: 2 laps around the sports field (800 metres)
U12 and U14 children’s race: 2.2 km along Keulenberstraße
Main race: 13 km with challenging climbs and descents over the Keulenberg
additional: Race day starts with the children’s race at 09:45, followed by a new children’s race for U12 and U14 at 09:55. The awards ceremony takes place immediately after the children’s races. The recreational run starts at 10:25 and the main race at 10:30. The running group is led by Patrick Thomschke (department head) and Jens Schäfer (manager). The event usually takes place in summer temperatures of around 23°C. Registration and further details are available on the official website. The race is a great opportunity for runners to achieve personal bests and experience the beautiful Saxon landscape.

name: 10. Hochkippenlauf
description: The 10th Hochkippenlauf takes place on 4 July 2026 at Stadion Profen and is organized by SV Eintracht Profen. Various races are offered for different age groups, from a children’s race to distances for young people and 10 km races for adults. The event is part of a sports festival running from 3 to 5 July 2026. The race is a great opportunity for sports enthusiasts of all ages to compete in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 400 m children’s race (one lap of the stadium)
Distances of 2.1 km, 4.2 km and 5 km for young people
10 km race for U18, U20 and adults
additional: The race is part of a sports festival running from 3 to 5 July 2026. The children’s races take place over one lap of the stadium. The race is held at Stadion Profen, with warm, sunny weather in July. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to win prizes in various categories.

name: 46. Küstenkanallauf
description: The 46th Küstenkanallauf takes place on 04.07.2026 in Friesoythe. The event offers races over 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km, as well as walking and hiking routes. The scenic course runs along the Küstenkanal and is suitable for runners of all ability levels. This traditional event is organised by KC Ikenbrügge von 1971 e. V.
course_highlights: Scenic course along the Küstenkanal
Distances of 5.5 km, 11 km and 22 km
Walking and hiking routes available
additional: Start times: Runners in the 5.5 km, 11 km and 22 km races start at 17:00; walking and hiking start at 16:15. Registration is via an online form on the website or through the contact option, providing your name, year of birth, club and town. This is a local event with a friendly atmosphere that attracts numerous runners from the region each year. Registration, results and further details are available on the official website and in the race information.

name: 9. Bremer Brückenlauf
price_range: ab 8,00 € bis 45,00 € je nach Kategorie und Frühbucherstatus
description: The Bremer Brückenlauf on July 4, 2026, invites runners to experience Bremen from a unique perspective. The course crosses bridges spanning the Weser, the Kleine Weser and the Werdersee, offering a maritime atmosphere in the heart of the city. Several distances are available, including a half marathon, 10 km run, 5 km run, a special 5 km underwear run and children’s races. The event promises good spirits, a summery atmosphere and breathtaking views of Bremen and the Weser.
course_highlights: Run across several bridges in Bremen
Course over the Weser, Kleine Weser and Werdersee
Officially measured, record-eligible courses
additional: Optional medal engraving (€10 for adults, €7.50 for children). Start times vary by distance, from 16:30 (underwear run) to 18:15 (5 km and 10 km walking). All main races are measured by the DLV and are record-eligible. Children’s races are measured privately. Walkers and Nordic walkers are listed in alphabetical order in the finish results. Participation rules and age categories are clearly defined. Loop course with official measurement, age categories and competition categories; medal engraving available; Nordic walking included.

name: Benkhauser Schlosslauf
location: Schloss Benkhausen, Espelkamp, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 600 m Kinderlauf kostenlos, 2 km Schülerlauf 4,00 € (bis 14.06.), 6,5 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), 10,8 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), 20,8 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), Preise steigen nach dem 14.06.
description: The Benkhausen Castle Run is a sporting event taking place for the second time in 2026, set in the unique surroundings of Benkhausen Castle. The event offers varied running routes along paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Benkhausen. The start and finish are at Benkhausen Castle Square, where race bibs are also distributed. The event is open to running enthusiasts of all ages and includes various distances, including children’s and schoolchildren’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes along paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Benkhausen
Start and finish at historic Benkhausen Castle Square
Kilometre markers along the route for guidance
additional: Late registration is possible on race day from 12:30 p.m. until 60 minutes before the start, provided the participant limit has not been reached; a late-registration fee of €2 applies. The number of participants is limited to 200 runners per main race (6.5 km, 10.8 km, 20.8 km), with a maximum of 600 registrations in total. Race packs will be available from 30.06.2026 at Drogerie Emmerling and on race day at the castle square. Timing uses disposable-chip technology. Showers and changing facilities are available at Benkhausen Primary School. All participants in the children’s and schoolchildren’s races receive medals; there is no timing or awards ceremony. The well-known announcer Heino Krüger will accompany the races. Registration opens on 01.02.2026; late registration is available on site; the participant limit for the main races is 200 per distance, with a maximum of 600 registrations in total; chip timing; event held as part of a sports festival

name: Fichtelgebirgsmarathon mit Halbmarathon und 10km-Lauf
description: The Fichtelgebirge Marathon on July 4, 2026, is the largest running event in the Fichtelgebirge, with three different courses for all ages. The races feature challenging elevation gains and beautiful scenery, guaranteeing participants a unique experience in nature. For over 20 years, the event has been organized by sports-loving club members of IfL-Fichtelgebirge, who ensure everything runs smoothly. Online registration is open until July 2, 2026.
course_highlights: Marathon with 42 km and 800 meters of elevation gain
Half marathon with 21 km and 400 meters of elevation gain
10 km run with 225 meters of elevation gain and a finish in Kurpark Bad Alexandersbad
additional: The event is organized by volunteer club members. There are three courses with different elevation profiles and distances. All courses finish in Kurpark Bad Alexandersbad. Detailed course information is available on Komoot. The event is known for its challenging course with significant elevation gain and the beautiful natural scenery of the Fichtelgebirge. Online registration is open until July 2, 2026.

name: Hochstraßenlauf
description: The Hochstraßenlauf in Weisendorf is a traditional running event taking place for the 40th time on July 4, 2026. The start and finish are at the Weisendorf Local History Association Museum. Due to the high temperatures in recent years, the start time has been moved to the morning to offer runners better conditions. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with scoring for the Weisendorf town championship.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Weisendorf Local History Museum
Run through the surroundings of Weisendorf on scenic routes
Various age categories and scoring for the Weisendorf town championship
additional: Please bring safety pins for your race number. The terms of participation and a data protection form must be brought for children under 16. To be included in the Weisendorf town championship, provide the postcode 91085 and register accordingly. The event takes place in the morning to avoid the heat and offers a wide range of running and walking options. Registration is open until July 2, 2026.

name: Stadtlauf - Nördlingen läuft rund
description: The Stadtlauf Nördlingen läuft rund takes place on 4 July 2026 and offers races for children, school students, adults and walkers. The approximately 6 km main race runs through and around Nördlingen’s historic old town. Team spirit and the enjoyment of exercise are the main focus, and every participant receives a medal at the finish. The event is open to individual and group entries and encourages people to enjoy running together.
course_highlights: Approximately 6 km main race through and around Nördlingen’s old town
Children’s and school races with 400 m and 800 m laps
Start and finish area at the Market Square, with the route passing Daniel, Obstmarkt, Hallgasse and Schäfflesmarkt
additional: Advance registration is possible until 19 June 2026. Late entries are possible on the event day for an additional fee of 2 euros. If participant numbers are high, school races will start separately for girls and boys. There are individual and team rankings, and the three fastest teams in the main race (6 km) will be recognised. There is no awards ceremony for walkers; the focus here is on health. Tables for socialising after the race can be reserved by email. Distances: 400 m children’s race, 7 km main race; medals for all finishers; prizes for the fastest company teams and those with the most participants; registration until 19 June 2026; the event takes place in all weather.

name: 01. Okertalsperren Ultra-Marathon
description: The 1st Okertalsperren Ultra-Marathon takes place on July 4, 2026, in Altenau in the Harz. The course covers 47.4 km and consists of three laps of a 15.8 km route, mostly flat, around the main arm of the Okertalsperre. The route runs along the forebay, over the dam and the main dam wall, offering a scenic course with only gentle climbs. The event is suitable for experienced runners. Bringing your own refreshments is recommended, and runners are responsible for their own timekeeping. After the race, participants receive certificates by email, and the results are published on the website.

name: 23. Schneekopflauf
description: The Schneekopflauf is one of the most beautiful and challenging mountain races in Germany, held in the Thuringian Forest. The course runs from Schmiedefeld via Großer Finsterberg to Schneekopf and covers distances of 12.7 and 22.2 kilometers, with plenty of climbs and elevation gain. This race is especially suitable for experienced runners who want to test their limits. Since 2025, there has also been a Schneekopf hike for Nordic walkers and hikers, who are also rewarded with a medal at the summit.

name: 40. Schweriner Fünf-Seen-Lauf
description: The Schwerin Five Lakes Run is a traditional race in northern Germany, taking place for the 40th time on July 4, 2026. The event offers various race distances around Schwerin’s five lakes, including a half marathon, 15 km run, 10 km run, 5 km run, and a children’s one-mile race. Runners can enjoy a scenic course starting and finishing at Bertha-Klingberg-Platz. The event is known for its excellent organization, family-friendly atmosphere, and a variety of rankings, including company and school rankings.

name: Auenwaldlauf
description: The Auenwaldlauf is a long-standing running event in Auenwald-Hohnweiler, taking place on July 4, 2026. The event offers various race distances for children, young people, and adults in a friendly, family atmosphere. The start and finish are at the Hohnweiler multipurpose hall, and all finishers receive a medal. The races are divided into age groups, with trophies, certificates, and prizes awarded.

name: Degmarner Kocherlauf (Wertungslauf zum Drei Flüsse Cup)
description: The Degmarn Kocher Run takes place on 04.07.2026 in Degmarn and is a sporting highlight of the region. The 10 km main race is the fourth scoring race in the renowned 3-Flüsse-Cup, which brings together six regional fun runs. Alongside the main race, there are events for different age groups and running levels, including walking and children’s races. After the races, the sports festival invites everyone to stay and enjoy music, food and drinks—a celebration for the whole family.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - červenec
description: The 2-Mile Run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children under 12, who run 1.6 km. The race is ideal for anyone who runs for fun, wants to improve their personal best, or simply enjoys a pleasant run in the beautiful surroundings of the park. After the finish, every participant is treated to a warm cinnamon pancake. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children run one. Everyone is timed, and the results are published online.

name: Třtická punčocha
description: Třtická Punčocha is a traditional summer running race held in the village of Třtice since 1980, always on the first Sunday in July. The race is 8.8 km long and attracts runners from all over Bohemia. Originally intended for children, it now offers age- and gender-based categories for adults as well. In addition to the summer race, the village also hosts the 4.8 km Christmas Run, held on December 26. The races are popular and have a long-standing tradition, with results and photos archived on the village website.

name: Náchod - Dobrošov
description: Dobrošov Fortress is located near the town of Náchod, in the Kladské pomezí area of the Orlické Mountains. The fortress is an important part of Czechoslovakia’s northern border fortifications and offers visitors tours of its main bunkers, ammunition store, barracks, and infirmary. An educational trail runs through the fortress, taking visitors along the line of fortifications to the Běloves spa. The area around the fortress has numerous hiking and cycling routes, offering a chance to explore the beauty of the Orlické Mountains and nearby historic towns.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Cimrmanova etapa
location: Lomnice, Tišnov District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon / Cimrman Stage is the seventh and final stage of an international stage race held in Lomnice near Tišnov. The race offers challenging and varied terrain with 740 metres of elevation gain, making it a test for experienced ultramarathon runners. The start is staggered according to the results of the previous six races, adding to the competition and suspense. This race is ideal for runners seeking a combination of technical challenges and stage racing amid the beautiful scenery of the South Moravian Region.

name: Na hoľu
description: Na hoľu is an ITRA-certified vertical kilometer event held on Kráľova hoľa in Horehronie. Runners start from the square in the village of Šumiac, and the route follows the blue hiking trail directly to the summit of Kráľova hoľa. The event is a qualifying race for the 2024 Skyrunning World Championships and offers quality support, including refreshments and medical services. Registration is open until July 1, 2026, with a participant limit. The entry fee includes a souvenir and refreshments.

name: Špačinský trojuholník
location: Špačince, okr. Trnava, Špačince, okr. Trnava, Základná škola s materskou školou
organizer: Obec Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, Základná škola s materskou školou v Špačinciach, Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Špačince
description: The Špačinský Triangle is a running race held in the village of Špačince in the Trnava District. The race starts at 17:00 in the centre of the village, by the Primary School with Kindergarten. Men compete in the overall category regardless of age, and women aged 40 and over compete. The organizers are the Municipality of Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, the Primary School with Kindergarten in Špačince, and JDS Špačince. The entry fee is €10, except for village residents, who can enter for free.

name: Trail Relay Banská Štiavnica – Visegrád – štafety
location: Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica, Atletická dráha
description: The Banská Štiavnica–Visegrád Trail Relay is a unique 220 km relay race connecting two historic royal towns through the natural beauty of the Štiavnica Mountains and the Danube–Ipoly National Park. The race is open to teams of 3, 4 to 8, and 6 runners, with categories for experienced runners and larger teams. The route runs mainly along hiking trails and through nature reserves, offering a chance to discover the region’s cultural and historical landmarks and natural beauty in Slovakia and Hungary. The organizers emphasize building good neighborly relations and promoting the region.

name: Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 05.07.2026
description: The 7th Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 2026 is an annual running event held in Wilkowo near Świebodzin. The race attracts runners from various categories and offers the chance to compete on a route combining road and off-road sections. The organizers provide professional timing and technical support, while participants can expect efficient organization and a friendly atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to get active and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: A route combining road and off-road sections
Scenic surroundings of Wilkowo near Świebodzin
Professional electronic timing
additional: The event is organized by Super Sport, a company from Zielona Góra, which provides timing, race bib printing, and technical support. No details are available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Registration will be available at super-sport.com.pl, and the event attracts local runners and sports enthusiasts.

name: Pogoń za Jednorożcem
description: The Unicorn Chase is an annual running event held in Jednorożec, taking place for the eighth time in 2026. The event includes a 5 km race and Nordic walking over the same distance, as well as children’s races over shorter distances. It is organized by the “Jednorożec robi co może” Association in cooperation with local partners and patrons, offering participants sporting competition, numerous attractions, and prizes. The start and awards ceremony take place on the same day, and participants can expect professional organization and chip timing.

name: XV Limanowa Forrest
description: The 15th International Limanowa Forrest Anglosaxon Mountain Run is a unique mountain race that takes runners up Miejska Góra, 716 m above sea level, where the Millennium Cross—the tallest steel cross in Poland—is located. The course follows an Anglosaxon format and features varied terrain, including hiking trails, forest and field roads, rocky sections, and stretches of asphalt and sidewalk. The start and finish are on Bulwary Street in Limanowa, near the race office. The race takes place on July 5, 2026, at 12:00 and is organized by the Limanowa Forrest Sports Club.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (6)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach, Państwowa Straż Pożarna Katowice
description: The Panewniki Wild Boar Run is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the scenic Panewniki forests in Katowice. The competition takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times, with markers every kilometre. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about proper conduct in forest areas. Both amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs may take part. The organizers are the Jerzy Kukuczka Academy of Physical Education in Katowice and the Katowice State Fire Service.

name: 34 Bieg po Plaży
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Postominie
description: The 34th Beach Run in Jarosławiec is an annual running event organized by the Centre for Culture and Sport in Postomino. The race follows a scenic route along the beach, offering participants a unique seaside running experience. It attracts both recreational and experienced runners, creating a sporting atmosphere and promoting active leisure. The event has a long tradition and is an important sporting occasion in the region.

name: Jutrosińska Dycha
additional: Modern timing. Training sessions from the time of registration until the race count. Average training paces listed on the website: 4.43 min/km and 4.84 min/km.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale marathon held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The 42.195 km route follows forest and country roads, with the start and finish on Polna Street.
