The event has a friendly, informal atmosphere, without crowds or competitive pressure, and promotes physical activity in a natural setting. The organizers offer a varied, clearly marked course, with convenient access and parking.

name: Dorfener Stadtlauf
organizer: Förderkreis Dorfen e.V. und die Stadt Dorfen
description: The 23rd Dorfen City Run takes place on July 5, 2026, and offers runners a choice of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, which has been part of the program since 2023. The routes lead through the green Isental, a peaceful landscape occasionally punctuated by music. The finish at the town square is accompanied by many spectators and provides a crowning end to the race. Popular children’s races are also offered, making the city run an event for all ages.
course_highlights: Route through the green Isental
Peaceful natural sections with musical accompaniment
Finish at Dorfen’s lively town square
additional: Practice run on June 16 at 7 p.m. at Marktkirche Dorfen; children’s races on the program; finish at the town square with many spectators; organized by Förderkreis Dorfen e.V. Race distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; start at Unterer Marktplatz; passes through the Isental; children’s races available

name: VR-Bank-Lauf - Rund um die Veste Coburg
price_range: 10 km – 15,00 Euro; Kinder- und Jugendlauf – 8,00 Euro; Nachmeldungen – 4 Euro

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 km VR-Bank-Hauptlauf „Rund um die Veste Coburg“- 15,00 Euro

description: The 44th VR-Bank Run “Around Veste Coburg” on 5 July 2026 is one of the most popular running events in the Coburg region. The 10 km main race runs through the idyllic Hofgarten, past the imposing Veste Coburg, to the airfield and back to the TV 1848 Coburg sports grounds. In addition to the main race, there is a 1.6 km children’s and youth race and a 400 m Bambini run for the youngest participants. The event offers a lively atmosphere, with refreshment stations and a fan zone providing runners with extra motivation.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Hofgarten and past Veste Coburg
Refreshment station at kilometre 3.5 by the airfield
Fan zone at kilometre 8 for extra motivation
additional: Race numbers must be attached using your own safety pins. Race packs can be collected on 4 July from 14:00 to 17:00 and on 5 July from 7:30 to 8:45. Late entries incur a €4 fee (except for the Bambini run). The first 800 entrants in the main and children’s races receive a finisher T-shirt. Free refreshments, including fruit, mineral water and non-alcoholic Kapuziner beer, are available in the finish area. Certificates and results are available online. The Bambini run has no timing or rankings; all participants receive a medal. Register by 02.07.2026. Race numbers include a chip. Certificates and finisher T-shirts for the first 800 entrants. Flat course on city and club grounds.

name: VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrücker Staffelmarathon
location: Schloss- und Rosengarten, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrück Relay Marathon is a long-established relay marathon taking place on July 5, 2026, in the castle and rose gardens in Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The flat, well-maintained course follows a two-kilometre loop through the historic castle park, to be completed 21 times. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which has been hosting this relay marathon since 2013 and has built a dedicated running community. The relay marathon offers runners an attractive and varied route through beautiful parkland, with no disruptive road crossings.
course_highlights: Flat, well-maintained 2 km loop through the castle park
Start and finish in the rose garden, with a view of the historic castle
No disruptive road crossings on the course
additional: The relay marathon consists of 21 laps of 2 km each, run in Rheda Castle Park. The course is flat and has no road crossings. Registration is available online. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which also runs other races. Photos and videos of previous relays are available on the website. Registration is via my.raceresult.com; the race is held as a relay marathon, and results are available on the day of the event.

name: Dorflauf TSV Wiera
description: The 6th TSV Wiera Village Run takes place on July 5, 2026, in Schwalmstadt and is officially registered with the German Athletics Association. The event offers races over 600 meters and 10 kilometers. The results are included in the official athletics rankings, making the competition particularly attractive to ambitious runners. The race takes place in typical July weather, with pleasant temperatures and usually sunny conditions.

name: Eselsburger-Tal-Lauf
description: The 28th Eselsburger Tal-Lauf takes place on July 5, 2026, in Herbrechtingen. This long-standing running event warmly welcomes runners of all ages. The varied courses wind through the scenic Eselsburger Tal and offer ideal conditions for both competitive athletes and recreational runners. Younger participants can test themselves in the Bambini Run and the schoolchildren’s run, while the half marathon—the premier event—covers two laps through the nature reserve. Alongside the competition, the focus is on sharing the experience in a friendly atmosphere, supported by dedicated volunteers.

name: Neuendettelsauer Kirchweihlauf - 10 KM DLV-genehmigt
description: The 27th Neuendettelsau Kirchweih Run is a DLV-approved 10-kilometer race taking place on July 5, 2026, in the town center of Neuendettelsau. The event is organized by BLV Kreis Ansbach and hosted by TSC Neuendettelsau Athletics Department. The race offers an attractive course for runners of all ages and ability levels in the Middle Franconia region. Registration is open until June 30, 2026.

name: Petersberg Berg-Crosslauf
description: The Petersberg Mountain Cross-Country Run in Marktbergel is a challenging trail run featuring new 5.2 km and 10.0 km courses, taking place on July 5, 2026. The event offers races for various age groups, from a Bambini run and student races to main and recreational races. Timing is electronic, and late entries are possible until 60 minutes before the start. Alongside the sporting competition, there is an extensive program featuring refreshments, games and fun for children, and an awards ceremony with prizes for the fastest participants.

name: Stadtlauf Wolfratshausen
description: The Wolfratshausen City Run is a flat, officially measured loop through the historic old town of Wolfratshausen, ideal for personal bests. With a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run and relay events, it offers a varied program for all ages and ability levels. The event is part of the Raiffeisen Oberland Challenge and is known for its friendly atmosphere, prizes for children and team competitions. The 25th City Run takes place on 5 July 2026 and warmly invites runners to take part.

name: SVE-Steinwiesenlauf
description: The Steinwiesenlauf organised by SV Eidelstedt Hamburg is a popular running event that attracts numerous participants every year. The event offers various races for all age groups, from a kids’ run and school races to the 5 km and 10 km main races. The course includes a motorway bridge and offers exciting competitions in a family-friendly atmosphere. The race traditionally takes place on a weekend and continues to attract more participants.

name: Širokodolská časovka
description: The Široký Důl Time Trial is a short interval running race held in Široký Důl near Polička and is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026. The race takes place on an 800-metre asphalt course with 80 metres of elevation gain. Runners set off at one-minute intervals from 10:00. Registration takes place at the venue from 8:45 to 9:45. A cycling event follows the run but is not part of the running cup. The entry fee is a symbolic 50 CZK, making the race accessible to the general public.

name: Běh pod Slunečnou
description: Běh pod Slunečnou is an 8.3 km cross-country race held in Moravský Beroun in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance and gives runners the chance to test themselves on natural terrain. The course is suitable for cross-country running enthusiasts and offers interesting natural scenery. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and a challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 6. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2 Miles Run is a regular 2-mile race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place at the venue from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The event also includes a competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with runners scored according to their performances and participation in individual rounds.

name: Žaškovský minimaratón
location: Žaškov okr. Dolný Kubín, Žaškov okr. Dolný Kubín, Žaškov na začiatku obce pri rieke Orava
description: The Žaškov Mini Marathon is a traditional running race, now being held for the 55th year in the village of Žaškov in Orava. The course runs mostly along forest roads and village streets, covering approximately 12.4 km with around 600 m of elevation gain. Runners are warmly welcomed by local residents of all ages, creating a pleasant, family-friendly atmosphere. This mini marathon is part of the Šípsko–Fatranské Runs series and is suitable for all running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of Orava’s nature and the spirit of sport.

name: Cyrilometodský beh Kolonickým vrchom – Memoriál Jozefa Chomaniča
location: Kolonica, okr. Snina, Kolonica, okr. Snina, športovo-rekreačný areál Bejvoč
description: The Cyril and Methodius Run over Kolonický vrch – Jozef Chomanič Memorial is a running event held at the Bejvoč sports and recreation complex in Kolonica, Snina District. The race offers categories for children and adults, including several age groups for men and women. The children’s races start at 13:30 and the adults’ race at 15:00. The event is held in memory of Jozef Chomanič and gives runners of all ages the chance to compete in a beautiful natural setting.

name: Domašská desiatka na Eve
location: Vranov nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, rekreačná oblasť Domaša, Eva, pizzeria Palermo
description: Domašská Desiatka na Eve is a traditional running race held in the Domaša recreational area, Eva, near Vranov nad Topľou. The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses, which are part of the Vranov nad Topľou District Road Running Championships. Runners can enjoy a course with refreshment stations, and after finishing they receive a race pack with a medal, food, and a drink. The organizers provide medical services. The race takes place on roads open to traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Hlásná Třebaň
description: The Berounka Running Series in Hlásná Třebaň is part of a community trail race series held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The course passes through Karlštejn National Nature Park, with views of Karlštejn Castle, and offers runners varied terrain with forest paths and hilly sections. The race is suitable for all runners, whether beginners or experienced, and is part of a series of 12 races that encourage regular exercise and sporting activity. Refreshments, bag storage, and certificates for the top finishers in each category are provided on site.

name: Naktinė bėgimo šventė „Kaišiadorys 2026/10“
location: Kaišiadorių Teofiliaus Matulionio aikštė, Kaišiadorys, Lithuania

description: The night running festival “Kaišiadorys 2026/10” is dedicated to commemorating Statehood Day (the Coronation of King Mindaugas of Lithuania). The event will take place in Teofilius Matulionis Square in Kaišiadorys and will include a range of age groups and distances, giving runners the opportunity to compete and enjoy running on city streets and nature trails. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take part and promote a healthy lifestyle. The event will be filmed and photographed, and participants agree that the material may be used for marketing purposes.
course_highlights: Event venue: Teofilius Matulionis Square in Kaišiadorys, city streets, the Girelė nature trail, and the Gandriukas trail
Distances from 436 m to 8 km, suitable for various age groups
Night run with the option to purchase special running T-shirts
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the event venue from 17:00 to 20:45, depending on the distance. No participation fee applies to students and employees of the Kaišiadorys Education and Sports Centre. Special running T-shirts (light or dark) are available for €15. Safety requirements must be followed during the event. The running venue is Teofilius Matulionis Square in Kaišiadorys and the surrounding areas; registration on race day; T-shirt sales; various distances.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Czerwonak Physical Culture Development Center. Held in the evening, it combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It has become a long-standing tradition, attracting participants who want to spend time outdoors running or walking in a friendly atmosphere. The event takes place around Bolechowo and lasts approximately two and a half hours.
course_highlights: Evening runs and walks outdoors
Route around Bolechowo and Czerwonak
Bringing the local community together through physical activity
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. It is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees, or online registration.

name: 41. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a private marathon run held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.10 km each, around 42.7 km in total, and offers a quiet, self-supported running environment, with refreshments at runners’ own cars after each lap. The event is limited to 22 participants and is open to runners aged 18 and over. Marathon times are recorded with a manual stopwatch, and a voluntary donation to environmental or social projects is requested.

name: Gütersloh Läuft - für den guten Zweck
description: Gütersloh Läuft is a diverse charity running event taking place for the 18th time on July 8, 2026, in Gütersloh City Park. The event offers races for all age groups, from Bambini and school races to Nordic walking, corporate and individual races, as well as a 10 km summer evening run. All participants support the German Stroke Foundation with their entry fee, as €1 is donated for every registration. The routes lead through the beautiful city park and offer a sporty, community atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Göppingen
description: The AOK Göppingen Corporate Run is a popular team event taking place on July 8, 2026, at the Dr. Heinrich Zeller Stadium. The approximately 5 km course offers a great opportunity to get active with colleagues and strengthen team spirit. In addition to the run, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program featuring music, a warm-up session, and complimentary refreshments at the finish. The corporate run is part of the BW-Running series and places great importance on inclusion and shared experiences.

name: City-Sport-Abendlauf
description: The City-Sport Evening Run in Rostock is a popular summer race held annually in Barnstorfer Wald. Hundreds of runners come together for an evening run that combines the joy of running with a good cause. Proceeds from the race are donated to charitable organizations, most recently to the Rostock hospice at Klinikum Südstadt. The race has become a fixture on Rostock’s running calendar and continues to attract growing numbers of participants.

name: Freisinger Sparkassenlauf
description: The Freising Sparkasse Run is a popular summer race in the Isar meadows around the SC Freising stadium. It offers races for children and young people, as well as 5.5 km and 10 km main races, which run mostly on gravel and forest paths along the Isar. The event is for athletes of all abilities and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, with individual and team categories. Catering is available on site, and there is a raffle with attractive prizes.

name: VRun Dachau 12. Dachauer VR Firmen- und Schülerlauf
description: VRun Dachau is the popular running event for corporate teams and students in the Dachau region. For the twelfth time, Volksbank Raiffeisenbank Dachau eG is organizing the event together with ASV Dachau, putting team spirit and community center stage. The races include a 2.8 km students’ run and a 5.6 km corporate and public-sector run. In addition to the sporting experience, there are attractive prizes and a raffle for all finishers.

name: run4healthineers
description: Run4Healthineers is a community running event that brings together employees on site in Erlangen and virtually across Germany. The event offers various distances, including three main routes, a Bambini run for children, and an inclusive running group for the first time. With more than 2,000 participants and around 17,400 kilometers run, the focus is on the joy of physical activity and supporting a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health among Siemens Healthineers employees.

name: 5. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Run for Health is a charity running series organised by the TJ Jäkl Karviná athletics club, held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run is 3 km long and is open to everyone who wants to support their health while helping those in need, as the entry-fee proceeds are donated to charity. The start is traditionally at 17:45 by the Lodičky, with registration beginning at 17:00. Everyone is warmly invited to take part in this friendly, health-promoting run.

name: Běh okolo Bílé hory
description: The Run Around Bílá hora is a regular running race in Brno, offering a 1.7 km loop. Men and women run three loops, for a total of 5.1 km, while children can race over a distance adjusted to their age. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Bílá hora, near the playground, and is suitable for all age groups. The evening start is at 18:00, and runners can enjoy the community-run atmosphere, with refreshments and a place to store their belongings.

name: Ultramarathon Górski - 3 x Sniezka = 1 x Mont Blanc
description: The 3 x Śnieżka = 1 x Mont Blanc Mountain Ultramarathon is a challenging mountain race held in Karpacz. It is also a qualifier for the prestigious UTMB and a member of ITRA. Runners can choose from three distances with varying levels of difficulty and elevation gain, earning ITRA points. The course follows scenic trails in the Karkonosze Mountains, including multiple ascents of Śnieżka, offering challenges for experienced ultrarunners as well as an opportunity to take part for beginner mountain runners.

name: Borener Meile
description: The Borener Meile is a traditional 1,609.34-meter road race, taking place for the 35th time on July 10, 2026, as part of the Borener Dorftage in Boren. The race is organized by Borener SV, an active sports club on the Schlei with a particular focus on running and triathlon. The event offers runners a short, fast course and is a popular competition in the region. Results and photos from previous races are available on the website.
course_highlights: Road race over exactly 1,609.34 meters (one mile)
Traditional event held as part of the Borener Dorftage
Organized by the regional sports club Borener SV
additional: Road race, registration available, results and photos from previous events available

name: Schwaigfeldlauf
description: The Schwaigfeldlauf is a popular running event in Olching, organized by Bürgervereinigung Schwaigfeld e.V. It offers a sporting challenge in a friendly neighborhood atmosphere and has become a regular event. The course runs through Schwaigfeld and features a new route premiere, suitable for both experienced runners and running enthusiasts. The race brings together sport, fun, and community and is supported by numerous sponsors.

name: VUM – Valašské Ultramaraton – DEN1 – Zahřívání 🏃‍♂️

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: DEN1 - Zahřívání / DAY1 - Warm-up 999 Kč do / until 15.12.2026

description: VUM – Valašský Ultra Marathon is a demanding three-day stage ultramarathon in the heart of Valašsko and the Beskydy Mountains. The race is for runners seeking a challenge and discomfort, with progressively tougher stages that test physical and mental endurance. Each day is longer and more demanding, emphasizing self-sufficiency and the ability to recover. The race is not about speed, but about finishing safely and managing fatigue and decisions along the course. The organizers emphasize respect for nature and provide basic facilities, accommodation, and refreshments.
course_highlights: Three days, three stages with progressively increasing distance and elevation gain
Routes pass through the landscape of Valašsko and the Beskydy Mountains, including hiking trails, cycle paths, and forest roads
Maximum self-sufficiency for runners, with no conventional aid stations
additional: The entry fee includes camping in your own tent at the race venue, with the option of accommodation at a school (limited capacity). Refreshments during the race include coffee, tea, and basic refreshments before each stage, followed by fruit, vegetables, meat products, and sweet snacks after the stage. One liter of water per runner is available on the course at approximately the halfway point of each stage. Electronic timing and online runner tracking are provided. If exhausted, runners can use the organizers’ transport from the course. Every runner who completes at least one stage receives a finisher medal, while the exclusive finisher T-shirt is reserved for those who complete all three stages. The date differs between sources: the supplied date is July 11, 2027, while the event pages list July 9, 2027.

name: VUM Valašský ultramaraton
description: The Valašský Ultra Maraton (VUM) is a challenging three-day stage ultramarathon in the heart of Valašsko and the Beskids. The race is for runners seeking a challenge and discomfort, with progressively tougher stages that test both physical and mental resilience. Each day is longer and more demanding than the previous one, with an emphasis on self-sufficiency and the ability to recover. VUM is not a race for speed, but for endurance and safely completing all stages. The organizers emphasize respect for nature and runner safety.
course_highlights: Three days and three stages, with progressively increasing distance and elevation gain
Routes pass through the landscapes of Valašsko and the Beskids, including hiking trails, cycle paths, and forest roads
Maximum self-sufficiency for runners, without traditional aid stations
additional: The entry fee includes a participant pack with a cotton T-shirt, a race bib with your name or nickname, access to facilities with toilets and showers, accommodation in your own tent or at a school (limited capacity), refreshments before and after the stages, 1 liter of water on the route halfway through each stage, electronic timing, and online runner tracking. Every participant who completes at least one stage receives a finisher medal, while the exclusive finisher T-shirt is awarded only to those who complete all three stages. If you become exhausted, you can use the organizers’ transport from the course. This is not a team race, but you can run as a pair while competing as individuals. The race is self-supported: runners carry their own refreshments, and the course is not routinely marked, so navigating with GPX is mandatory. Approximately one liter of water per runner is available halfway through each stage. The ALL entry package includes access to facilities and the option of accommodation in your own tent or at a school.

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a moderately challenging course. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, providing convenient event facilities. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.

name: VI Warmiński Bieg Uliczny
description: The 6th Warmian Street Run in Reszel is an annual sporting event that attracts both amateurs and experienced runners. The race follows the streets of Reszel, giving it a unique atmosphere and allowing participants to experience the city from a different perspective. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively, enjoy sporting competition, and meet fellow running enthusiasts. The organizers welcome everyone, regardless of experience level, emphasizing the importance of exercise and positive energy.

name: X Świerczyniecki Bieg Uliczny
description: The 10th Świerczyniec Street Race for the Mayor of the Gmina Cup is an annual running event held in Świerczyniec. The race takes place on the town’s streets, with the start scheduled for 10:00. It is organized by the Świerczyniec Volunteer Fire Brigade, and timing is professionally provided using RFID technology. The race attracts both local runners and sports enthusiasts from the surrounding area, offering exciting competition and a chance for the community to come together.

name: Bieg na Bucze
location: Górki Wielkie, Brenna, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Pozytywny Bieg Przełajowy - reaktywacja
location: Kalej, Wręczyca Wielka, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIII Otwarte Mistrzostwa Zakopanego w Bi...
Wybelsumer Polderlauf
description: The Wybelsumer Polder Run is a running event for children and adults held at the Wybelsum sports ground in Emden. Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V., the event offers a sporting opportunity for the whole family in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. It is part of Emden’s diverse events calendar and promotes the local community and sport.
course_highlights: Running event for children and adults
Venue: Wybelsum sports ground, Emden
Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V.
additional: The event includes various running distances for all age groups and is a popular regional event in the Krummhörn region.

name: Taubertaltrail
description: The Taubertal Trail is a spectacular trail running event through the breathtaking landscapes of the three valleys in the Taubertal. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels to test their limits and experience nature on challenging routes. Organised by SC Adelshofen e. V., the Taubertal Trail offers a unique combination of sporting challenge and scenic beauty.
course_highlights: Run through three picturesque valleys in the Taubertal
Marked trails with varied terrain
Breathtaking views of nature and the landscape
additional: Mandatory equipment for distances of 11 km and above: at least 0.5 litres of fluid, your own cup or flask, a mobile phone with emergency numbers, ID and health insurance card, weather-appropriate clothing and suitable footwear. Wear your race number clearly visible at the front. Weather conditions may make route markings difficult to see; a GPX file is recommended. Litter may only be disposed of in refreshment zones. Medical support is provided by medical services, the fire brigade and course marshals along the route. Distances range from 5 km to 60 km and include trail and hike disciplines, as well as a children’s trail, across varied terrain through fields, meadows, forests and vineyards. Participants receive medals and certificates and have access to showers and on-site refreshments.

name: 6. O-SEE Backyard Ultra
description: The O-SEE Backyard Ultra is a unique elimination race around Lake Olbersdorf near Zittau. The Backyard Ultra format tests endurance, mental strength, and team spirit, as all runners start together every hour on the hour to complete a 6.7 km lap, until only one runner remains. The winner qualifies directly for the German Championships and has the chance to compete at the World Championships in Tennessee. The race is limited to 200 participants and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with genuine team spirit.

name: Aichacher Stadtlauf
description: The Aichach City Run is a long-standing running event organized by LC Aichach for over 40 years. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including races for schoolchildren and teenagers, as well as competitions through Aichach’s historic old town. The races take place in the Wittelsbacher Land region and are known for their family-friendly atmosphere and good organization. Training opportunities to prepare for the event are offered at the Landkreisstadion.

name: Bergheide-Cross 2026
description: SCB Langendamm invites you to the 4th Bergheide Cross 2026. The course runs from the access road to the clubhouse of the local small-bore rifle club through the “Osterberg” recreational and landscape conservation area. The race offers three distances for different competition and age categories, as well as walking on the shorter course. There is also a 1,000-meter race for children and young people. The event is approved by the DLV and takes place on July 11, 2026, from 4:00 p.m.

name: Crosslauf Fichtenau
description: The Fichtenau cross-country race is a long-standing running event taking place on 11 July 2026 as part of the Fest am See. The event offers two varied routes through the beautiful municipality of Fichtenau: a 5.2 km fun run for everyone who enjoys being active, and a challenging 10 km cross-country race for those seeking a sporting challenge. The races take place in the so-called “Magic Triangle” of Crailsheim/Dinkelsbühl/Ellwangen and attract runners of all ages. The organizing team looks forward to welcoming many participants and offers convenient registration by SEPA direct debit.

name: Dietfurter 7-Täler-Lauf
description: The 33rd 7-Täler-Lauf in Dietfurt an der Altmühl takes place on July 11, 2026. This long-standing race is part of the BLSV Läufercup 2026. For the first time, participants can enter the Walking category. New this year is also the Team Fun Run, where teams of at least three people compete for prizes for the fastest team, coolest outfit, and Lucky Loser. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with race number collection, changing rooms, and showers at the 7-Täler-Halle, as well as medals for Bambini and awards for the best in each age group.

name: LAUF10
description: LAUF10! is a training project by the Bavarian Athletics Association that gets people who are not keen on sports fit to run 10 kilometers in ten weeks. The program is aimed at anyone who wants to go from zero to running ten kilometers and has already inspired many thousands of participants. In addition to the run, there is an official fan T-shirt that can be ordered. LAUF10! promotes the joy of running and fitness in a supportive community.

name: Tanzenhaider Weiherlauf
description: The Tanzenhaider Weiherlauf is a traditional running event in Oberreichenbach, taking place on July 11, 2026. The course passes through picturesque landscapes featuring ponds, forests, and historic paths, offering a varied, nature-filled running experience. There are events for participants of all ages, including a main race, youth and Bambini races, and Nordic walking. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event offers Franconian specialties and a family-friendly atmosphere, with award ceremonies and on-site medical services.

name: Běhej lesy Klínovec
description: Běhej lesy Klínovec is a trail race in the Ore Mountains, taking place on July 11, 2026. The race offers various routes, including a short and a long course, as well as a charity race. The start is at the summit of Klínovec, with the option to take the cable car up before running down to the Klínovec Ski Area. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races and features special speed sections, Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, with attractive prizes.

name: Libečovská 14
description: Libečovská 14 is a 14.2 km race with approximately 170 metres of elevation gain, running on both paved roads and trails. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and offers runners an interesting mix of paved and off-road sections. The course is suitable for runners looking for a challenge with gentle climbs and varied terrain. The race takes place in the picturesque Podkozí area of the Central Bohemian Region and attracts runners from the wider area.

name: Králický Sněžník Beze stopy
description: Králický Sněžník BEZE STOPY is a challenging mountain run covering 14 km with 1,050 m of elevation gain. The route starts in Heřmanice and passes via Klepáč and Malý Sněžník to the summit of Králický Sněžník. It features beautiful ridge running with views of Poland’s Kłodzko Valley and the Dolní Morava valley, as well as short, demanding descents. The race is for lovers of mountain terrain and is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Iscarex Cup. Younger runners can take on a shorter 5 km course with 440 m of elevation gain. The main race starts at 9:30, and the junior race at 11:00.

name: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov
description: Hvězdonice–Ondřejov is a 5.75 km uphill race with 255 metres of elevation gain, starting in Hvězdonice. This running race offers challenging terrain and beautiful views in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for runners looking for the challenge of an uphill course and wanting to test their strength in a mountain run. The race is part of the Svět běhu running calendar and attracts runners from a wide area.

name: Nízkotatranská stíhačka
description: Nízkotatranská stíhačka (NTS) is an individual ultra-trail race with a 98 km main loop from Telgárt to Donovaly, crossing the main ridge of the Low Tatras, and a half-distance route finishing at Čertovica. The race is a qualifying event for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc and is ITRA-certified. It is organized by the civic association Time Out - OZ in cooperation with STS HIKING and Slovak Ultratrail. NTS offers a challenging mountain course with beautiful views and challenges for experienced mountain runners.

name: Rozbehni Majerovce
location: Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, pred Obecným úradom
description: Rozbehni Majerovce is a running event held in the village of Majerovce, in Vranov nad Topľou District, in front of the Municipal Office. The race offers categories for children and adults, with main races of 5 and 10 km. The children’s races start at 09:15 and the main race at 10:15. Organizer Martin Folenta and the Municipality of Majerovce warmly invite runners of all ages to enjoy a pleasant day of sport.

name: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto
location: Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Námestie SNP Rajecké Teplice
description: The KL Auto Run through the Rajec Valley is a running event set in the scenic Rajec Valley, offering a combination of paved and country roads. The course runs mostly along country roads, with approximately 20% paved surface, creating an enjoyable and varied running experience. The event is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere, attracting runners of all levels. The start is at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The organizer is Ján Valúch Jr., who is available for information and support.

name: Beh malý Caesar
location: Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Námestie SNP
description: The St. Andrew’s Run and the Little Caesar Children’s Run are traditional events in Rajecké Teplice, bringing a sporting and family-friendly atmosphere to SNP Square. The St. Andrew’s Run is a 4.5 km road race with online registration, while the Little Caesar Children’s Run is for children aged 1 to 9 and is free of charge. The event also includes a competition for the best-decorated children’s stroller, adding to the experience for participants and spectators alike. The event takes place in the afternoon, with registration and the start on the square.

name: Beh zvrchovanosti Chrenovec – Brusno
location: Chrenovec-Brusno, Prievidza District, Trenčín Region, Slovakia

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race taking place on July 12, 2026, in Starogard Gdański. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a moderately challenging event on an asphalt surface, ideal for improving your fitness and competing in a friendly atmosphere.

name: II Galicyjska 10
description: The 2nd Galician 10K of the Subcarpathian Regional Chamber of Civil Engineers is a sporting event bringing together Chamber members and their families. It will take place on July 12, 2026, in Urzejowice, in the park by the stadium. The event features 10 km races, a 7 km Nordic walking event, and children’s races in various age categories. It’s a great opportunity to spend active family time outdoors, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring together the civil engineering community. Participants can look forward to a sporting atmosphere and fun at the finish.

name: 43 Bieg o Złoty Kłos
location: Kołaczkowo, Września County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

organizer: Leichtathletik Gemeinschaft Eder (LG Eder) / TSV Dodenau

description: The Dodenau Volkslauf is a recreational running event open to everyone, starting and finishing at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall in Battenberg-Dodenau. The event offers a range of distances from Bambini races to a half marathon, as well as Nordic walking. To be included in the rankings, participants must belong to an athletics club or an LG. Online registration is available until about one week before the race; late registration is possible at the start.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall
Distances for Bambini, short, middle and long races, as well as a half marathon
Nordic walking over 5 km and 10 km
additional: Late registration at the start is possible from 07:45 until 45 minutes before the respective start. To be included in the rankings, participants must provide their club or LG on the registration form. Terrain: Dodenau multi-purpose hall, online registration, various running distances, Nordic walking

description: The 41st Pönitz Volkslauf takes place on 12 July 2026 in Pönitz and invites runners, walkers and Nordic walkers to a sporting and social event. The course runs through the scenic Holstein Switzerland, with romantic hedgerows, summer fields and peaceful meadows. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, show performances and an awards ceremony at the Pönitz Sports Park. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and attractive prizes are awarded to the winners.
course_highlights: Scenery of Holstein Switzerland, with hedgerows, fields and meadows
Start and finish at Pönitz Sports Park, with a summer atmosphere
Refreshments and show performances at the venue
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal. The awards ceremony begins at 11:15, with medals for the overall winners (places 1–3) and trophies and certificates for age-group winners and finishers. Members of SVG Pönitz pay half the entry fee. The event offers refreshments, show performances and a friendly atmosphere for athletes, companions and spectators. Runners can choose between the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and Nordic walking. Starts are from 8:30. A shared experience of community and nature.

name: 27. Gläserner Mönch Lauf
description: The Gläserner Mönch Run is a traditional trail race in the Harz foothills, returning after a seven-year hiatus. The course is known for its undulating profile, with more than 100 meters of elevation gain per lap, and the legendary climb up 222 steps to the “Gläserner Mönch.” Participants can choose from a range of distances, from the Bambini Run to the 18 km Extreme Run, and enjoy unspoiled nature among rocks and forests. The event combines a sporting challenge with local pride and takes place around the Landhotel Schäferhof in Halberstadt.

name: 8. Barigauer Turmlauf
description: The Barigauer Turmlauf is a traditional race in Oberhain near Königsee, taking place on July 12, 2026. The event offers runners an attractive course with scenic sections around the Barigauer Tower. It is aimed at ambitious runners and running enthusiasts looking for a sporting challenge in a natural setting. The race is organized by Laufverein Königsee, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and smooth event operations.

name: Dinkelsbühler Staffellauf
description: The Dinkelsbühl relay race takes place on 12 July 2026 in the historic old town of Dinkelsbühl. Each relay team consists of four runners, each completing a lap of approximately 3 kilometres around the old town. The route passes landmarks such as the Alte Promenade, Wörnitztor, Stadtpark and Musik-Pavillon, accompanied by an inclusive drumming group. Children can take part in the Funtasia Kids-Run, with age-appropriate circuits. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers a varied programme featuring music, a bouncy castle and refreshments.

name: Kappelseelauf Rentweinsdorf
description: The Kappelseelauf in Rentweinsdorf is a popular running event held annually since 2008 and has become a fixture for recreational runners. The event offers a varied program for all ages and ability levels, from Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to Nordic walking and a half marathon. The diverse routes pass through idyllic natural surroundings around Kappelsee, along Hutseedamm with views of the castle, and through Rentweinsdorfer Hauptwald and Eichelberg. Refreshments are provided along the route and at the finish, with drinks, fruit, cake, and bratwurst.

name: Steinenberger Waldlauf
description: The Steinenberger Waldlauf is a traditional running event set in picturesque woodland near Rudersberg. The event offers a range of distances, from 2 km for students to a half marathon, suitable for both ambitious runners and families and beginners. The race features challenging, varied routes with some hilly terrain and is designed as a family-friendly summer sporting event. In addition, every participant supports local clubs and institutions with a donation.

name: S-Race
description: S-Race is an OCR race in Mariánské Lázně, held in front of the Ferdinand Spring Colonnade. The race offers 6 km, 12 km and 18 km courses, which run mainly along surfaced forest paths and feature more than 20 obstacles per lap. Age-group races are available for children. The start and finish are located right by the colonnade, with facilities including changing rooms, toilets, baggage storage and refreshments. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages and features staggered starts, with activities for children during the main race.

name: Koblížkový pasecký běh
description: The Koblížkový Pasecký Run is a traditional road race in Paseka near Olomouc, offering an 8.2 km course. The route runs on asphalt, paving stones and park paths, passing through the village, along the cycle path to the sanatorium and through the park of the Specialist Medical Institute, before returning to the start by the municipal office. The first categories start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. The event is organised by Ivan Elischer, who ensures everything runs smoothly and supports the runners.

name: Halda Trail Run
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running adventure in Kuřimská Nová Ves, through the picturesque landscape of the Halda Stream valley and the Libochovka River. The longest route is approximately 24 km long and includes 23 stream crossings, all runnable and pleasantly refreshing in summer. The race offers three distance options (4, 14 and 24 km), which connect to one another and allow runners to change their distance during the race. The route runs mainly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, with panoramic views, two short, steep climbs and varied terrain—something both casual runners and ambitious trail runners will appreciate.

name: Běh o Ludgerův meč
description: The Run for Ludger’s Sword is the third edition of a running race organized by Běžecký klub Náchod in cooperation with the municipality of Hořičky. The race is part of the Primátor CUP running series and the Velká cena východních Čech cup. The routes pass through the area around Hořičky, offering beautiful views of the Kladské pomezí region. They run over gently rolling terrain on gravel and forest roads, with very little asphalt. Courses are available for children, as well as the 8 km main race and a 4 km FIT route. The start and registration take place at the complex by the football pitch in Hořičky.

name: Malý Štrbský maratón
location: Štrba okr. Poprad, Štrba okr. Poprad, Nám. pred Kultúrnym domom
organizer: Obec Štrba, Obec Liptovská Teplička, Športový klub Štrba
description: The Malý Štrbský Marathon is a traditional running race held every year on the second Sunday in July in the village of Štrba in the Tatras. Runners can choose between two main distances—31 km and 10 km—which follow an asphalt road between Štrba and Liptovská Teplička. The event is part of the Tatry v pohybe project and attracts runners from several countries. The atmosphere in the square in front of the Cultural Centre is always lively and full of sporting spirit. The organizers are the Municipality of Štrba, the Municipality of Liptovská Teplička, and Športový klub Štrba.

name: V-asis maratonas „Vilniaus tiltai“
location: Vilniaus Laisvalaikio zona prie Baltojo tilto, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: The “Vilnius Bridges” Marathon is a traditional running event held in Vilnius’s leisure area near the White Bridge. Participants can compete in various distances, from a 500 m children’s race to the full marathon of 42.195 km. The routes wind along the banks of the Neris River and across Vilnius’s bridges, offering runners a unique view of the city. The event is for both recreational and professional runners, promoting running culture in Lithuania and raising Vilnius’s profile.
course_highlights: The route winds along the banks of the Neris River and across Vilnius’s bridges
The marathon distance consists of 4 laps of 10.6 km each
Distances range from 500 m to 42.195 km
additional: Race number pickup begins at 6:45. Warm-up for participants in the marathon, half marathon and 10.6 km races is at 7:50. Awards are given in the men’s and women’s marathon categories, as well as for the largest and most enduring teams. Time limits: marathon 7 hours, half marathon 3 hours, 10.6 km 2 hours, 5.3 km 1 hour, Nordic walking distances 6 hours. The event takes place in Vilnius’s leisure area near the White Bridge; registration and a health check are required. The event promotes community spirit and an active lifestyle.

name: Dvě kola při zdi
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Dvě kola při zdi is a traditional cross-country race in Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve, with courses for men, women, and children. Men run the 7.8 km main course along the reserve’s perimeter walls. Women have a shorter 4 km course, but can also run the men’s course. Two shorter loops are available for children. After the race, participants can enjoy a raffle and hearty refreshments.

name: REWAG-Firmenlauf
description: The REWAG Company Run on July 15, 2026, is one of the largest running events in the Regensburg region and offers a unique opportunity to run, connect and celebrate with colleagues in a relaxed atmosphere. The event is limited to 3,000 participants and attracts numerous companies and runners. In addition to the sporting experience, the run supports Jumpakids, the Regensburg Center for Obesity in Children and Adolescents, with a donation. Registration opens on May 1, 2026, for individuals and groups.

name: SUNSET Hamburg 2026
description: Altra Sunset Hamburg takes place on Wednesday, 15 July 2026, at Wilhelmsburger Inselpark. The event features an appealing approx. 5 km loop on asphalt and paths, which can be run 1 to 3 times, allowing distances of approx. 5 km, 10 km or 15 km. Participants can choose how many laps they want to complete on the day, with a checkpoint counting the laps. There is also a relay race in which the course is run four times, with teams of 2 to 4 runners. The event is open to anyone who is fit and has no medical concerns; club membership is not required.

name: Lauf um und am Gartower See
description: The run around and along Gartow Lake is a longstanding running event held on the lake’s north shore in Gartow. The course offers a natural setting with views of the lake and the surrounding Gartow pine forest, making it ideal for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the sports club SV Gartow, which has fostered sporting commitment and community in the region since 1946. The start and finish are centrally located in town, creating a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Halda
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running race through the beautiful landscape of the Halda stream valley and the Libochovka River. It offers three routes of 4, 14 and 24 kilometres that connect to one another, allowing participants to change the distance during the race. The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, and features 23 stream crossings, two short, steep climbs and panoramic views. The race is suitable for both casual runners and ambitious trail runners, and is thoroughly marked with arrows and course ribbons.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 3 etapas
description: The Jonava Running Cup is an open running tournament held in the Jonava District to promote sport and physical activity. The competition consists of five stages in different locations, where runners compete against one another and collect points toward an overall ranking. Each stage has its own course and start time, and participation is free. The tournament is organized by the Jonava Sports Centre together with the Lithuanian Amateur Runners Association and other partners.
course_highlights: Five stages in different locations across the Jonava District
Courses ranging from 6 km to 8.4 km
Evening start at 19:30; race bibs collected before the competition
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the start location on race day from 18:30 to 19:20. Registration for each stage is completed separately online. Participation is free. The courses may cross roads open to traffic, so participants must obey traffic rules. A five-stage series, online registration, open to participants from Lithuania and abroad, with starts usually at 19:30.

name: Leśna Eko Piątka
description: Leśna Eko Piątka is a race held in Piekary Śląskie that promotes the city and supports integration and the prevention of addiction among children and young people. The course follows asphalt and gravel roads through Dioblina Forest, with the start and finish at the MOSiR stadium at 3 Olimpijska Street. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Piekary Śląskie. Participants receive a race package including a bib, timekeeping, a medal and medical support. The time limit is 45 minutes, and the field is limited to 500 participants.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a 5-kilometer night race held on the shores of the Baltic Sea as part of IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, with city lights reflected on the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set off on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. The event has become an important and eagerly anticipated part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining athletic competition with the unique atmosphere of a night run.

name: XIII Bieg po Chrust
location: Chróścice, Dobrzeń Wielki, Opole County, Poland

name: Schwanberglauf Iphofen-Castell
description: The Schwanberglauf is a traditional 10.4-kilometre race from Iphofen to Castell, taking place for the 42nd time on July 17, 2026. The course combines challenging climbs through vineyards and stretches through woodland with an idyllic finish in Castell Castle Park, accompanied by a wine-festival atmosphere. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ability levels, and its proceeds support social institutions. It is organised by volunteers from TG Kitzingen in collaboration with the SBL team.
course_highlights: Start at the Rödelseer Tor in Iphofen, followed by a steep climb through vineyards
Water stations at kilometres 3 and 6.5, and shortly before kilometre 7
Finish in Castell Castle Park with a wine-festival atmosphere
additional: Race-bib collection from 15:30 at the Karl-Knauf-Halle in Iphofen. Start groups are arranged according to your own 10-kilometre race time. Toilets are available at the Karl-Knauf-Halle. Free bus transfer from the finish in Castell back to the start in Iphofen (departures from 16:50 to 17:45, approximately every 10 minutes). Luggage transport by VW van. Medical services provided by the Bavarian Red Cross. Showers are available in Castell (men at the Meierei, women at the sports club). Every finisher receives a bottle of mineral water from Franken Brunnen. Course: 10.4 km; start in Iphofen, finish in Castell; refreshments along the course; showers in Castell; electronic timing; awards ceremony at the wine festival; online registration; overnight accommodation in Iphofen is recommended.

name: Běh o Neplachovský Hrneček
description: The Běh o Neplachovský hrneček is a traditional running race held in Neplachov, South Bohemian Region. The 14th edition takes place on Friday, July 17, 2026. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is supported by the South Bohemian Region’s budget. The event offers a sporting experience in the region’s beautiful surroundings and attracts runners from across the wider area. The organizers warmly invite all runners to take part in this popular event.

name: Kružberský Tesák
description: Kružberský Tesák is a sporting event held at the Kružberk Reservoir grounds, offering routes and categories for experienced racers, intermediate participants, and complete beginners. The event is suitable for solo runners, hikers, and families with children. It also includes Pejskiáda, a fun show and competitions for dogs of all sizes and breeds. Organizers Kateřina and Lucie, nature lovers and dog-sport enthusiasts, aim to create a friendly atmosphere and ensure an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Nocna zaDyszka 2026
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piekarach Śląskich
description: Nocna zaDyszka is a 10 km race held as part of the 7th PKO Piekarski Half Marathon, which will take place on July 18, 2026, in Piekary Śląskie. The event attracts many runners, and the participant limit for this distance is 900. The day before, on July 17, the accompanying 5 km Leśna Eko Piątka race will also take place. The organizers invite everyone to take part and expect nearly 3,000 runners across all distances in 2026.

name: 12. Nocny Portowy Maraton Szczeciński oraz 7. Nocny Portowy Półmaraton Szczeciński
description: The 12th Szczecin Night Port Marathon and the 7th Szczecin Night Port Half Marathon are night road races held in Szczecin, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The marathon course consists of two identical laps measuring 42,195 m, while the half marathon is one 21,097 m lap; both courses are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The start is at 23:00. Participants can expect original T-shirts and a special classification for people connected with the maritime industry. The event is organized by Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia, Zachodniopomorska Federacja Sportu, and RAZ Event, with support from the City of Szczecin and port partners.

name: 7. PKO Piekarski Półmaraton
description: The 7th PKO Piekary Half Marathon will take place on 18 July 2026 in Piekary Śląskie. This running festival appeals to both running enthusiasts and people just starting out in the sport. The event is organised by the city of Piekary Śląskie, which invites all runners to take part. Details of the course and programme will be available closer to race day.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail race taking place on July 18, 2026, in the scenic Elbląg Upland area by the Vistula Lagoon. The route follows wild trails through varied elevation and quiet, natural surroundings, offering runners a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity in harmony with nature, and welcomes both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support, and a comprehensive race pack.

name: 2 Chojnicka Piątka
description: 1. Chojnicka Piątka is a road race held in Chojnice, taking place on July 26, 2026. The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich and attracts runners from various places, offering sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants attractive views and the opportunity to test their fitness over a distance of 5 km.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
location: Kosewo, Mrągowo County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Puchar Polski Nordic Walking - II etap
XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: OYLER Berglauf
description: The 27th Oyler Berglauf takes place on July 18, 2026, as part of Sports Promotion Week in Marklohe. Organized by Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle, the race offers a sporting challenge on Oyler Berg. The event is part of a varied sports program and is aimed at runners looking to experience a hilly course in a friendly club atmosphere. The exact route and further details can be found on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Race on Oyler Berg
Venue: Sportplatz Oyle
Part of Sports Promotion Week 2026
additional: The Oyler Berglauf is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026, which takes place from 18.07.2026 to 26.07.2026 at Sportplatz Oyle. The organizer is Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle von 1953 e.V. No pricing or registration details, start times, or wave information have been published on the website. The event is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026 and takes place at Sportplatz Oyle; no specific registration information is available.

name: 22. Wiesenlauf
description: The 22nd Wiesenlauf on July 18, 2026, in Klein Meckelsen gives runners the opportunity to compete on officially measured, DLV-approved 5 km and 10 km courses. The event includes district championships over both distances and a regional championship over 5 km, with classifications starting from age group M/W 14. The start and finish are at the Klein Meckelsen sports field, and the event is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners.

name: 4. Fachberg 100
description: The Fachberg 100 is a 100 km road race in Northeim, Germany, starting on July 18, 2026, at 6:00 a.m. The course consists of 15 laps and a short out-and-back section, alternating between asphalt and dirt tracks. Each lap includes about 75 meters of elevation gain, for a total elevation difference of 1,125 meters. This is a small ultrarunning event with limited entries and no entry fee. Runners must bring their own refreshments.

name: HAKRO Stadtlauf
description: The Hakro Stadtlauf in Schrozberg is a charity running event that donates €5 for each participant to Jugendhilfe Creglingen. The race is open to all age groups and promotes running together across generations. Individual competitions are organized by registration category, along with a team competition for companies, clubs, families, and friends. The event prioritizes a smooth schedule and asks participants to register in advance by July 16, 2025.

name: Heizomat Altmühlseelauf
description: The Heizomat Altmühlseelauf is a long-running race event held every July around Lake Altmühlsee in Gunzenhausen. The event features several competitions, including a half marathon, a relay race, a public race, a student race and a Bambini race. The courses are officially measured and pass through the scenic surroundings of Lake Altmühlsee. The event gives both individual and team runners the chance to test their endurance and enjoy a day of sport together.

name: Lautersteiner Panorama-Lauf
description: The Lautersteiner Panorama Run on July 18, 2026, offers runners breathtaking views across the Swabian Alb. The varied course follows forest-edge trails and open sections around Weißenstein, rewarding the effort with fantastic panoramas. Organized by TV Weißenstein, the event celebrates the joy of sport in nature and a great atmosphere. Runners can choose between a short 4.5 km loop and the challenging 11.5 km main race.

name: Maintal Ultratrail / Bayerische Trail Meisterschaften 30km
description: With its three scenic routes in Franconian wine country, the Maintal Ultratrail offers an enjoyable trail-running experience. The 30 km route with 720 meters of elevation gain leads through picturesque vineyards, nature reserves, and varied forests along the Main. The event is aimed at trail-running enthusiasts of all experience levels who appreciate nature and the shared running experience. The motto for all participants is: fun and experiencing nature come first, not just athletic performance.

name: Zkus Noční Kuks
description: Try Noční Kuks, a night running race in the picturesque Baroque setting of Kuks. It offers two routes—10 km and 5 km—that pass historic landmarks such as Braun’s Nativity Scene and Kuks Hospital. Running in the dark, lit only by headlamps, offers a unique experience and atmosphere that runners will remember for a long time. The 10 km route includes the pilgrimage route of the 21st-century Stations of the Cross, while the shorter 5 km route runs along the Elbe at night and through the Count’s Alley, lined with 222 trees.

name: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc
description: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc is a family-friendly running event offering races for recreational and elite runners over 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetanovy sady and is part of a nationwide series featuring unique courses. The organizers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, with an accompanying programme and a charitable component. Every participant receives a race pack and can look forward to refreshments and support from the pacer team. ČEZ RunTour is not just a sporting event, but a full-day experience for all age groups.

name: Noční běh Rusava
description: Noční běh Rusava is an unforgettable night race in the Hostýnské vrchy, offering a 12-hour run on a single loop as well as a 5 km race. The race is suitable for both individuals and relay teams, and runners are not required to run for the full 12 hours. Race facilities include a gymnasium for resting, an all-night buffet, and aid stations. The event takes place amid the scenic ski slope and forests around Rusava, creating a unique sporting experience beneath the starry sky.

name: 7 pohoří Krušné Hory
description: The Krušné hory 2026 race is a technical trail run that takes you through the beauty of the Krušné hory mountains and the former mining landscape, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The route starts in Abertamy and passes the former Eva mine, Jelení, the Swiss Chalet on Plešivec, Merklín, the former settlement of Kaff, Pstruží and the ski area before reaching the finish. It offers three courses of varying lengths and elevation gains, appealing to both experienced runners and beginners. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments along the route and at the finish.

name: Rokytnice nad Jizerou - Dvoračky
location: Horní náměstí, Rokytnice nad Jizerou, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The route from Rokytnice nad Jizerou to Dvoračky is a popular hiking trail in the western Krkonoše Mountains, starting at Horní náměstí in Rokytnice. The blue-marked trail follows the Huťský stream to the picturesque Huťský Waterfall and continues to the Dvoračky mountain lodge, known for its history and traditional cheese-making. The route offers beautiful natural scenery, especially in autumn, when the surrounding beech forests burst with color. It is suitable for hikers, ski mountaineers, and cross-country skiers, who can enjoy the snowy landscape and refreshments at the Štumpovka restaurant at Dvoračky.

name: Kordícky Extrém
location: Kordíky okr. B. Bystrica, Kordíky okr. B. Bystrica, Obecný úrad
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Kordícky Extrém is a challenging mountain run through the picturesque surroundings of Kordíky in the Banská Bystrica District. The course is designed for runners seeking extreme challenges in nature, with significant elevation gain and technical sections. The event is part of the Marathon Tour series and offers a unique running experience in beautiful mountain scenery. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test their endurance and courage on this extreme terrain.

name: Mesciské pancaky
location: Mestisko, okres Svidník, Mestisko, okres Svidník, futbalové ihrisko
description: Mesciské Pancakes is a running event in Mestisko, Svidník District, offering 5 km and 10 km routes for men and women with no age restrictions. The route runs mostly on asphalt, with sections across grass and a dirt road, providing runners with varied terrain. The race starts at the football field in Mestisko. Registration is available online or at the event venue.

name: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra
description: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra is a trail race in Veľká Fatra National Park, offering runners unforgettable views of the Low Tatras, forest singletracks, and special forest roads. The routes pass through the UNESCO site of Vlkolínec and also include a cable car and Sidorovo. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, where runners earn points based on their performance and the length of the course. Three courses of varying distances and elevation gains are available, catering to runners of different levels.

name: Trakų naktinis pusmaratonis 2026
description: The Trakai Night Half Marathon is a unique running event held around Trakai Castle. The race starts on Karaimų Street and finishes on Birutės Street by the church. The event attracts running enthusiasts who enjoy its special atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Trakai. Registration is online until July 17, and race bibs can be collected the day before the race.
course_highlights: Start at Karaimų St. 13
Finish at Birutės St. 4 by the church
The area around Trakai Castle and the nighttime atmosphere
additional: Race bibs and timing chips can be collected on July 18 from 5 p.m. in Trakai, at Birutės St. 4. An evening night run, a hilly course, illuminated Trakai Castle, the peninsula, museums, an Orthodox church, Lake Luka, start by the peninsula castle, distances: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, a 500 m children's run; preparation and nutrition are recommended.

name: 14. Dolnośląski Festiwal Biegów Górskich
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, 100 mil, Ultramaraton, 100 km, Ultramaraton, 50 km, 33 km, Półmaraton, 14 km, 10 km
description: The Lower Silesian Mountain Running Festival is a prestigious trail-running event held in picturesque Lądek-Zdrój. As part of the festival, runners can take on a variety of courses with different distances and elevation gains, from short night races to mountain ultramarathons. The event attracts mountain-running enthusiasts, offering unforgettable views and technically challenging courses. In 2026, the festival will take place from 16 to 19 July, and participants can look forward to a varied programme of accompanying events and professional organisation.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The race is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, known for its scenic courses and friendly atmosphere. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this special summer edition.

name: Kaszubski Festiwal Biegowy VII Kaszubski Maraton o Wschodzie Słońca
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: The Kashubian Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on July 19, 2026, along a scenic route through the towns of Rozewie, Swarzewo, Jastrzębia Góra, and back to Rozewie. The festival offers a range of distances: a marathon, half marathon, and 15 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, so every runner, regardless of experience level, can find a suitable route. The marathon starts at 04:35, allowing participants to experience the remarkable atmosphere of sunrise over Kashubia. After the races, the organizers provide refreshments and a prize draw, creating a festive, sociable atmosphere.

name: Piątka Królowej Bony
organizer: Gmina Różan, Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki
description: Piątka Królowej Bony is a 5 km race held at the Municipal Stadium in Różan. The event takes place on July 19, 2026, and is open to people over the age of 15. Minors must have written consent from a parent or guardian. The start and finish are located at 3 Szkolna Street. The event is organized by the Municipality of Różan and Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki, and participants can expect professional event support and timekeeping.

name: VII Bieg Górski o Złotą Paproć
description: The 7th Golden Fern Mountain Run is a 10 km mountain race taking place in picturesque Tymbark. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a demanding route with varied terrain. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using dedicated training plans tailored to different skill levels. This event attracts runners who value challenges and contact with nature.

name: XXII Bieg Szlakiem Partyzantów z Lubatowej
Aalener Stadtlauf
description: The Aalen City Run takes place on 19 July 2026 at Sparkassenplatz in Aalen and offers a varied running event with several races, including the Bambini Run, Schoolchildren’s Run, AOK Active & Healthy Run, Team Run, and the Youth and Sparkasse Main Races. The event is known for its great atmosphere and sporting challenges. New this year is the Stadt-Land-Fluss Cup ranking, which combines races in different landscapes and offers a special challenge. Registration is now open, and all running enthusiasts are warmly invited to take part and enjoy the urban and natural running experience.

name: Barbarossalauf 2026
description: The Barbarossalauf 2026 returns as a city run to Erlenbach am Main on July 19. The new course starts centrally at the old fire station and follows a flat, scenic route along the Main before passing through Erlenbach’s old town to the finish. The event offers races for different age groups and distances, from children’s races to the 10 km main race, which consists of two laps. The course is ideal for beginners and ambitious runners aiming for fast times, and showcases Erlenbach at its best.

name: Flughafenlauf Barth
description: The Barther Airport Run takes place on July 19, 2026, at Stralsund-Barth Airport on the Baltic Sea and offers a varied program of seven races for runners and walkers of all ages. From short distances for young runners to the half-marathon distance, there is something for everyone. The event promises a morning full of activity, fun, and exciting races in a unique setting right at the airport. Walkers are also very welcome, and refreshments will be available on site.

name: run4trees
description: Run4Trees is a running event in Unterhaching taking place on July 19, 2026. The route runs through the idyllic Perlacher Forst, with the start and finish at the Unterhaching fairground. By taking part, runners show their support for climate protection, as proceeds are donated to Plant for the Planet and the TSV Unterhaching youth program. The event combines sporting commitment with environmental awareness and a sense of community.

name: Vogelsberger Südbahnlauf
description: The Vogelsberger Südbahnlauf will be held for the 21st time on July 19, 2026, organized by Lauftreff Unterreichenbach. The event offers runners of all ages and ability levels a varied running experience on well-marked routes that follow the paved Vogelsberger Südbahn cycle path as well as surfaced forest and field paths. Races range from the Bambini run and junior races to 5 km events and a half marathon. The team places great importance on a relaxed, sporting atmosphere, supported by refreshment stations and chip-free timing.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Fojtovice
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. Across six races in different locations, you can choose from main races of 6 to 9 km, experience routes of 20 to 30 km, a walk with checkpoints to find, and children’s races. The series is suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a varied range of routes amid the picturesque scenery of the Ore Mountains. The Fojtovice race takes place on 19 July 2026 and offers a main race, an experience route, a walk, and children’s races.

name: Šachty - Štěpánka
organizer: Český Ski klub Vysoké nad Jizerou
description: Běh Šachty - Štěpánka is a traditional race organized by the Czech Ski Club in Vysoké nad Jizerou. The race is part of the Maratonstav Czech Cup in mountain running and offers runners a challenging course in the beautiful Krkonoše Mountains. The event attracts athletes and mountain-running fans, who can enjoy both the challenge and the atmosphere of a mountain race. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test themselves on this traditional course.

name: Bančanská desiatka
description: The Bančanská Ten is a traditional running race in the village of Banské, in Vranov nad Topľou District, held in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské. This popular sporting event has a long history and attracts a record number of participants each year. The race is known for its challenging uphill course and beautiful surroundings, and is organized by Športový klub Banské. In addition to the main race, uphill time trials and other accompanying events are held.
course_highlights: Uphill race in the village of Banské – Mláčky
Traditional start in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské
Challenging course profile, with a new course record of 14:35 min
additional: The event is organized by Športový klub Banské, which has a long tradition dating back to 1985. It is held regularly, and in 2025 the 30th edition of the Bančanská 10/5 will take place. The event also includes the JANTEX Banské–Mláčky uphill time trials, which have their own history and categories. The race includes 10 km and a 5 km relay; registration is available online or on site. There is also a varied accompanying programme, including a bouncy castle and performances.

name: YOUNG RUN Nestlé
location: Prievidza, Prievidza, Námestie J. C. Hronského
description: YOUNG RUN Nestlé is a running event in Prievidza featuring 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races. Competitors are divided into categories by age and gender, and relay events are also available for children. The races start at J. C. Hronský Square, with different start times for each distance. The organizers are YOUNG RUN, Nestlé and the City of Prievidza, providing a quality sporting experience for all age groups.

name: Ipelský Beh
location: Lučenec - Kalonda, Lučenec - Kalonda, hrádza na Ipli
description: Ipelský Beh is a running event held in Lučenec–Kalonda, on the embankment of the Ipeľ River. The course runs mostly over grass and includes a 100-metre section of disused railway track. The race is open to various age categories for men, women and youth, and also includes Nordic walking. The organizers are the town of Lučenec, the municipality of Kalonda and OZ-Novohrad, who warmly invite runners of all levels to take part in this traditional event.

name: Běh za Sliveneckou saní
description: Běh za Sliveneckou saní is an uphill race in Prague 5–Velká Chuchle, covering 2.54 km with an elevation gain of 130 metres. The race is part of the Runs in the Hills of Prague and Surroundings series and challenges runners with a demanding climb. It is suitable for anyone looking to test their strength and endurance on hilly terrain.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Schwäbisch Hall
description: The AOK Corporate Run Schwäbisch Hall is a popular team event taking place on July 22, 2026, at Optima Sportpark. The course is approximately 5 kilometers long and is run twice, offering a great opportunity to get active together with colleagues. In addition to the run, participants can look forward to a varied program featuring a DJ, a group warm-up, award ceremonies, and complimentary finish-line refreshments. The corporate run promotes team spirit and combines exercise with socializing.

name: 402. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Little Monaco Prize is a traditional running race organized by KRB Chrudim. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race gives athletes the opportunity to test themselves on various courses and enjoy the atmosphere of the running community. The event is part of a long-standing tradition and attracts runners of all ages. The organizers emphasize quality event management and a friendly race atmosphere.

name: 34. Lippesee Marathon
location: Lippesee, Paderborn-Sande, Paderborn, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 34th Lippesee Marathon in Paderborn-Sande is a private marathon run held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, around Lippesee, a popular recreational area and water sports center. Participants must provide their own refreshments, as there are no aid stations, and record their time manually. A photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof. The event is designed for experienced runners aged 18 and over, with a limit of 18 participants, and takes place only if at least five people register.

name: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák
description: Tobiáš’s Kazín–Cukrák Run is part of the KOPEC series, which features hill races in Prague and the surrounding area. This traditional race gives runners the chance to test themselves on challenging hilly courses in the picturesque surroundings of Kazín.
