The KOPEC series is known for its community atmosphere and support for runners of all categories, who are automatically included in the overall standings. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and the challenges of hilly terrain.

name: Tatra SkyMarathon 2026
description: Tatra SkyMarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the heart of the Tatras, in Zakopane. The course crosses the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch, featuring two demanding vertical-style climbs, each with around 1,200 m of elevation gain, interspersed with challenging Tatra descents. The race is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of Podhale and Orawa, giving participants and spectators an unforgettable experience. The organizers invite everyone to take part and cheer along the course.

name: Bokeler Windmühlenlauf
description: The 20th Bokeler Windmühlenlauf takes place on 24 July 2026 in Bokel. This long-standing anniversary race is organised by ALG-VfL Bokel. The number of participants is limited to 300, and registration is via the RaceResult platform. The race offers runners a special atmosphere in the region and is a popular event for enthusiasts of endurance sports and athletics.
course_highlights: Various race distances (5 km, 10 km, children's race)
Local club atmosphere
Limited to 300 runners
additional: The number of places is limited to 300. The organisational fee covers provision costs and is non-refundable, including in cases of force majeure. Registration is via RaceResult; places are limited to 300. Date: 24.07.2026

name: Fun-Lauf "Durch den Wewerschen Wald"
description: The 33rd Fun Run “Through the Wewer Forest” in Paderborn is a community run with no timing and no entry fee, taking place on 24 July 2026. The event supports children in need through many thousands of steps and asks participants to donate instead. The races take place on flat loop courses with little elevation gain and are suitable for everyone. There are also races for children and young people.
course_highlights: Flat loop course (one lap)
Little elevation gain (30 to 40 metres uphill)
Distance options: 5 km and 7 km
additional: Run with no timing and no entry fee; donations are requested instead. There are races for children and young people. The finish location is not publicly displayed (RUNME Premium required). Runs on flat loop courses, various distances, no timing, no entry fee, donations for charitable causes.

name: Sparkassen-Adam-Riese-Nachtlauf
description: The Sparkassen-Adam-Riese-Nachtlauf is an evening running event in Bad Staffelstein, Bavaria, offering races for children, recreational runners and experienced participants. The event takes place in summer and is part of the Bavarian running calendar. Distances range from short races for schoolchildren to main races of about 9 kilometres. Its night-race format gives runners the chance to run under the evening sky, setting it apart from typical daytime races.
course_highlights: Various distances from 780 m to approx. 10 km
Night-race atmosphere under the evening sky
Summer event in Bad Staffelstein, Bavaria
additional: The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including races for children and recreational runners. July weather is usually sunny, with an average temperature of 25 °C during the day and 15 °C at night. Night race with multiple distances, part of the Bavarian running calendar, held in summer in Bad Staffelstein.

name: 13. Heilwald Marathon
description: The Heilwald Marathon in Bad Lippspringe is a special race held in the heart of the 200-hectare Heilwald, a unique therapeutic and recreational forest in Europe with a soothing low-mountain climate. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and has been carefully measured using a measuring wheel and GPS. This is a private, self-supported race. Times are recorded manually, and a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participants take part at their own risk. There is no entry fee; instead, voluntary donations for tree planting are welcome.

name: 38. Heiligenhafen Mitternachtslauf
description: The 38th Heiligenhafen Midnight Run takes place on July 24, 2026, offering runners a special experience with late-evening start times. The main race covers 10 km through the town of Heiligenhafen, along the waterfront promenade and around the inland lake, with plenty of support along the course. Additional events include the Binnenseelauf (approx. 5.5 km), the Midnight Run Double Mile (approx. 3.2 km) for young people, and the Mini Midnight Run (approx. 1 km) for children. The event is organized by TSV Heiligenhafen and is a popular tradition, featuring electronic timing and a lively program on race day.

name: WAREMA Lauf
description: The 19th WAREMA Run in Marktheidenfeld offers a varied running experience for all ages and ability levels. From the short Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to the motivating 5 km company run and the challenging 10 km main race, there is something for everyone. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and lively spirit, which delight both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at the district sports complex, which serves as the event’s central venue.

name: 3Kings3Hills Trailrunning-Festival
distance_verbose: 100 Meilen, Ultramarathon, 50 km, Marathon, 25 km, 14 km, 5 km
description: The 3Kings3Hills trail running festival in the border region near Haidmühle offers challenging trails with steep climbs, fast descents, and flowing sections. Distances range from 6 km to 168 km, with options for all ability levels. The festival combines a sporting challenge with the unique scenery of the Bavarian Forest and Bohemian Forest. Finishers receive a fresh slice of pizza at the finish, along with a keepsake. The event is internationally recognized and awards ITRA points and a UTMB Index.

name: 26. Bieg Dookoła Morynia i Jeziora Morzycko
description: Join us for the 26th edition of the Run Around Moryń and Lake Morzycko, a unique event combining sporting competition with the beauty of Western Pomerania. The course follows a scenic route around Lake Morzycko, offering participants unforgettable views and a sense of sporting community. It’s a great opportunity for runners and fans of an active lifestyle to meet in Moryń and enjoy exercising outdoors. Whatever your experience level, there’s something here for everyone.

name: Tatra SkyMarathon
description: Tatra SkyMarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the heart of the Tatra Mountains, in Witów in the Podhale region. The course runs along the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch, featuring two demanding vertical-style climbs with approximately 1,200 m of elevation gain each, interspersed with challenging Tatra descents. The race is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of the Podhale and Orava regions, offering participants and spectators an unforgettable experience. The organizers invite everyone to take part and cheer along the course.

name: Bieg Powstania Warszawskiego
description: The Warsaw Uprising Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw, commemorating the Heroes of the Warsaw Uprising. The event attracts thousands of participants, who take part in the 5- and 10-kilometer races, creating a unique, solemn atmosphere of patriotism and historical remembrance. The race starts in waves and takes place in the evening, further highlighting its distinctive character. The organizers also offer a virtual edition, allowing participants to take part from anywhere in the world.

name: 24 Bieg Uliczny św. Jakuba
description: The 24th St. James Street Run is an annual sporting event held in Lębork to celebrate the city’s patron saint. The race follows a certified 10 km course through the city streets, with appropriate security provided by the authorities. The ceremonial start takes place at Pokoju Square, and the race start is on Armii Krajowej Street. The finish is at Pokoju Square in front of the stage. Participants must be at least 16 years old and obey traffic regulations.

name: 9 Bieg Lubliniecki
description: The 9th Lubliniec Run is an annual running event organized by Mafia Team Lubliniec, taking place on July 25, 2026. The main distance is 10 km, and participants can also take part in races for children and young people. The race office is located at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec. The course will be announced soon, and the event is highly regarded, with numerous awards in the categories of small-scale races and 10 km races.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the location. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the beautiful surroundings of Gdynia.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwice Park Running Challenge is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026. The events take place on Saturdays, once a month, on a 4,219.5-metre course in a municipal forest, starting and finishing by Piast Stadium. The event promotes a healthy, active outdoor lifestyle and encourages regular physical activity under the slogan “Let yourself be challenged to fight laziness!”

name: Pogórze Ultra Trail
description: Pogórze Ultra Trail is a mountain race organized by the Pogórze Ultra Trail Association, which brings together a passion for running and exploring the natural environment of the Strzyżów Foothills. The routes pass through scenic, diverse landscapes, including old deciduous forests, coniferous forests, loess ravines, and unique rock formations. Participants have the chance to run through historic shelter tunnels in Strzyżów and Stępina, as well as admire the Brzeżanka range, the Kiczora massif, Herby, and Mount Chełm. It is the region’s largest running event, attracting trail running and ultramarathon enthusiasts every year.

name: Hel - Rysy
location: Hel, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: I Memoriał Pamięci o Funkcjonariuszach i...
DJK Jakobuslauf
description: The Augsburg St. James Run, organized by the DJK Diocesan Association, is a special mass-participation event held as part of Augsburg’s oldest folk festival, the Jakober Kirchweih. The run is open to joggers and walkers and deliberately has no official timekeeping, embracing the motto “Experience over Results.” The event includes children’s races and three distances for adults, including a quarter marathon along the Lech. The start and finish are at Jakobsplatz by the famous Fuggerei, giving the run a historic and atmospheric setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Jakobsplatz by the historic Fuggerei
Route along the Lech
10.5-kilometer quarter marathon for adults
additional: The run has no official timekeeping, putting enjoyment and the experience first. The ecumenical event is organized by the Catholic DJK Diocesan Association of Augsburg. The Fuggerei opens to visitors free of charge during the Jakober Kirchweih for the run. Distances are available for children, walkers, and adults; there is no official timekeeping, with a focus on community and experience; start and finish at Jakobsplatz in the Fuggerei.

name: 10. NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf
price_range: 25 EUR für Erwachsene, 20 EUR für Kids
description: The NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf is a maritime race held annually on the North Sea island of Norderney since 2016. The event offers a unique running experience amid the island’s natural surroundings and special atmosphere. The routes pass through the historic Kurplatz and by landmarks such as Napoleonschanze, Schwanenteich and the island windmill. The race is suitable for all age groups and includes distances from the Bambini Run to the half marathon.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Kurplatz, beside the Conversationshaus and Badehaus
Past Napoleonschanze, the oldest monument on Norderney
Through the lively shopping streets, with spectators cheering runners on
additional: The official technical T-shirt can be ordered during registration and is distributed with the race pack. It costs EUR 25 for adults and EUR 20 for children. Late entries are possible online until 22.07.2026 for a fee, and in person on 24 and 25.07.2026. Timing is by ChampionChip; chip rental costs between EUR 3 and EUR 5, depending on the race. A preferred race number is available for an additional EUR 3. Cut-off times: 1:15h for 10 km and 2:30h for the half marathon. Island and maritime theme, sustainable technical T-shirt, in-person registration, online results, ferry connections for participants, test run on the day before the race, certificates and medals for children

name: 6. GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon
description: The GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon is a 50 km trail run starting in Kaltenweide, Langenhagen, Germany. The route has a modest elevation gain of about 350 meters and must be completed within 8 hours. The course passes through forest and trail sections, by Brelinger Berg with its geological nature trail, and back along Bissendorfer Moor. The event is registered with the German Ultramarathon Association and offers online results, certificates, and finisher medals.

name: FriesenCross
description: The Friesencross in Schillig is one of Germany’s most extraordinary cross-country running events and takes place on July 25, 2026. The course runs right along the beach and offers a unique natural experience along the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea. Runners cross soft sandy beaches, green meadows and even the muddy seabed, perfectly combining a sporting challenge with a North Sea feel. The event is hosted by running-sports presenter Heino Krüger, who guides the day with extensive experience. The Friesian Festival takes place alongside the race, bringing atmosphere, music and culinary highlights.

name: Allersberger Kirchweihlauf
description: The Allersberg Kirchweih Run takes place annually on the last weekend in July in Allersberg and is part of the Raiffeisen Runners’ Cup in the BLV Middle Franconia-South district. The event offers various races, including a 400-meter Bambini run and other competitions for students and adults. The route is a very flat loop that starts and finishes at Allersberg Market Square. Water stations and refreshments at the finish are provided, and the event is organized by an experienced team.

name: Mulsumer Speckenlauf
description: The Mulsumer Speckenlauf is a traditional running event held annually by TSV Mulsum. The event takes place at the Mulsum sports ground in the Wurster North Sea Coast municipality and attracts numerous runners. The course offers a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main race, there is also a children’s sports festival featuring classic events, underscoring the family-friendly nature of the occasion.

name: Rechberghäuser Sommernachtslauf
description: The 14th Rechberghausen Summer Night Run takes place on July 25, 2026, in Rechberghausen. Officially registered with the German Athletics Federation, this event allows participants to run times that are recognized for athletics rankings. The run supports solidarity in sport and offers a sporting challenge in a pleasant summer atmosphere. The event includes two distances suitable for both children and experienced runners.

name: Crazy Runners Frankenwald Trail
organizer: TSV Dürrenwaid und Crazy Runners Team Frankenwald
description: The Crazy Runners Frankenwald Trail is a family-friendly trail running event in Frankenwald Nature Park, taking place on 25 July 2026 in Geroldsgrün. Organized by TSV Dürrenwaid and the Crazy Runners Team Frankenwald, the event features natural trails and paths with up to 2,000 metres of elevation gain. There are four distance options and a Kids Race, all running mainly on unpaved trails. The event is known for its great atmosphere, starter pack and ITRA points.

name: Smilovice pomáhají - Běh pro Theu
description: Run for Thea is a charity race organized by the Smilovice Help Foundation, taking place on July 25, 2026, at the Sportcentrum Smilovice grounds. The race supports the treatment and rehabilitation of young Thea, who is facing serious health complications. Participants can choose from several routes of varying lengths and age categories, whether they want to race or simply take a walk. The event is open to everyone who wants to support a good cause and enjoy the pleasure of movement in a community atmosphere.

name: Běh na Lysou horu
description: The Run to Lysá hora is a traditional race held every year on the last Saturday in July in Krásná–Nižní Mohelnice. This 41st edition welcomes runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, all aiming to conquer Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains. The race starts near the Zlatník restaurant, at the crossroads leading to Lysá hora; registration and the awards ceremony also take place there. The course follows an asphalt road along a forest service road operated by Lesy ČR all the way to the summit of Lysá hora.

name: Borovská desítka
description: Borovská desítka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque village of Havlíčkova Borová in the Vysočina Region. The race offers a 10 km course with gentle elevation changes, running mostly through forest and along paved roads. The trees provide shade, making for a pleasant running experience even on sunny days. The start and finish are in the centre of the village, with aid stations along the course and at the finish. After the race, refreshments are provided, followed by an awards ceremony for winners in various categories.

name: Dobra Run a Dobrá dvojka
location: Domaša, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Domaša, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, RO Domaša - Dobrá
description: Dobra Run and Dobrá dvojka is a running event in Domaša, Vranov nad Topľou District, offering 7 km and 2 km courses. The race is suitable for various age categories of men and women, including children. It is organized by Matore s.r.o. Humenné and BAMM Bratislava. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to compete in different age groups. Registration is available online or on site until the participant limit is reached.

name: Night city run Piešťany
description: Piešťany Night City RUN is a traditional night race held at Námestie Slobody in Piešťany. Runners can take part in the 10 km race, which runs through the city and offers the unique atmosphere of a night run under the auspices of the City of Piešťany. The event is open to various age categories, and all participants receive a commemorative medal. Electronic timing is provided during the race, and the award ceremony takes place in the evening after the run.

name: Extrém maratón Košice – Furča
location: Košice - Furča, Košice - Furča, pred SBD III, Furčianska 60
description: The Košice–Furča Extreme Marathon is a challenging running race organized by the O5 Furča Košice Running Club. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Furča, where runners can enjoy the course challenges and the atmosphere of a traditional marathon. It is intended for endurance runners seeking a more extreme experience over the marathon distance. The organizers provide quality conditions and support for all participants.

name: Beh na Krivošťanku
location: Baffone Family Restaurant, Krivošťany, Strážske, Slovakia

name: XRUN - Ucieczka Św. Kingi
description: Saint Kinga’s Escape is a mountain trail race held in Krościenko nad Dunajcem, combining scenic routes through the Sącz Beskids and the Pieniny Mountains. Participants can choose distances from 14 km to 40 km, with different time limits and Sunday morning starts. The 40 km route passes through Przysłop, the Przechyba mountain shelter, Wielka Przechyba, and Pieniny National Park, finishing along a scenic path beside the Dunajec River. The event is organized by the Beskid Foundation and takes place at the amphitheatre in Krościenko nad Dunajcem.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
description: The Nadmorski Health Resort Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Dąbki in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the attractions of the Dąbki Health Resort and the Darłowo Municipality. It includes races for children and young people, a 10 km race, and special accompanying events such as the Health Resort Sea Mile. The organizers offer a full program and attractive prizes, and the course runs through charming health resort grounds.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
organizer: Zachodniopomorskie Centrum Kultury Obszarów Wiejskich i Edukacji Ekologicznej
description: Botaniczna Piątka — Summer Edition is a 5 km race held in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden. It’s a great opportunity to combine physical activity with relaxation amid greenery and nature. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series and is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants receive a commemorative medal shaped like a water lily, and the main race starts at 10:00.

name: Kresowe Trail #8
description: Kresowe Trail #8 is a 10 km race taking place on July 26, 2026, in Chełm. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic trail course designed for runners of varying experience levels. The organizers encourage participants to use training plans tailored to their individual abilities to help them prepare optimally for race day. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, a platform that supports runners in their development and race planning.

name: V Festiwal Biegowy pod Chełmcem Bieg Babinicza
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Szczawnie-Zdroju
description: The 4th Chełmiec Mountain Running Festival – Babinicz Run is a running event held in picturesque Szczawno-Zdrój, at the foot of Chełmiec Mountain. Participants can choose from a range of distances, from 1 km to a full marathon, making the festival appealing to runners of varying abilities. The course runs through charming surroundings, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event takes place in July, when the weather is typically summery, with temperatures around 25°C and sunny skies.

name: V Bursztynowy Półmaraton Jantar
location: Jantar, Gmina Stegna, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Altmühl-Jura Halbmarathon
description: The Altmühl-Jura Half Marathon is a long-established race in the picturesque region around Greding. The course winds through the varied landscape of the Altmühl-Jura region, offering runners a challenging yet scenic experience. The event is open to runners of all abilities and is organised by the City of Greding. The Greding Tourist Information Office is available as a point of contact.
course_highlights: Altmühl-Jura landscape
Varied and scenic course
Traditional running event in Greding
additional: The point of contact is the Greding Tourist Information Office, which can be reached at 08463 904-20. The event takes place in Greding. Further information and registration are available via the official websites. Terrain: roads and paved cycle paths; online registration; finisher’s medal included, certificates available online; race in July 2026

name: Hausener Volks-Waldlauf (TGS-Hausen)
location: Sportplatz TGS Hausen, Obertshausen, Hesse, Germany
price_range: Nachmeldung 5 € für Erwachsene, online Anmeldung bis 25.07.2025, Kinder frei
description: The Hausener Volks-Waldlauf, organised by TGS Hausen, takes place on 26 July 2026 and offers races over various distances, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and shorter schoolchildren’s and Bambini races. The start and finish are both at the TGS Hausen sports ground in Obertshausen. The routes run mainly on well-marked, flat forest trails, with the half marathon covering the 10 km loop twice. Timing is by transponder with gun-time results, and there is a 100 km team competition. The event is open to all age groups and offers a family-friendly atmosphere and good organisation.
course_highlights: Well-marked, flat forest trails
The half marathon covers the 10 km loop twice
Start and finish at the TGS Hausen sports ground
additional: Late registration is possible on race day up to 15 minutes before the start, with a €5 late-entry fee for adults and no fee for young people or Bambinis. Spikes are prohibited on the sports ground. Timing is provided by R.S.T. Volkslauf GmbH. There is a 100 km team competition, in which runners from the half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races may take part (maximum 20 participants per team). Routes on forest trails, gun-time and net-time results, refreshments on the course and at the finish, late registration possible shortly before the start.

name: Wallenstein-Halbmarathon
location: Altdorf bei Nürnberg, Nürnberger Land, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Wallenstein Half Marathon is a traditional fun run around Altdorf near Nuremberg, taking place on July 26, 2026. The half-marathon course runs through the picturesque Schwarzachtal valley, offering wonderful views, and includes roads, cycle paths, and forest trails. In addition to the half marathon, there is a 12 km fun run and a family-friendly 5 km route for runners and walkers. The event offers well-organized amenities, including refreshment stations and an attractive start/finish area at the TV 1881 Altdorf sports park. The city championships for the half marathon and 12 km race will also be held, with prizes awarded by the mayor.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course through the Schwarzachtal valley with scenic viewpoints
Refreshment stations at km 7, 11, 15, 18, and at the finish
Route on roads, cycle paths, and forest trails around Altdorf
additional: Start and finish at the TV 1881 Altdorf sports park (Heumannstr. 5a). Isotonic drinks and water available at several refreshment stations. Free admission to the outdoor swimming pool for all finishers, sponsored by Stadtwerke Altdorf. City championships and team competitions will be held. Scenic route through the Schwarzachtal valley, team competitions, family-friendly 5 km, race-day logistics and amenities at the Altdorf sports park.

name: 38. Frankenwaldlauf
description: The 38th Frankenwaldlauf in Oßla offers races over 18.5 km and 9 km, as well as Nordic walking. There are also shorter distances for children and young people, including the Oßlaer Gimpel-Lauf. The course runs through the Thuringian Forest and features beautiful natural scenery. The event is part of regional running cups and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and an awards ceremony on site.

name: Blutenburglauf
description: The Blutenburglauf takes place on July 26, 2026, in Munich-Untermenzing and offers attractive running routes along the Würm and around the historic Blutenburg. The event includes 5 km and 10 km distances, both taking runners through scenic natural surroundings. Times are recorded electronically using transponders in the race bibs, and refreshments are available along the course and at the finish. The event is organised by Rotary Club München-Blutenburg Gemeindienste e.V. and offers an entertainment programme in the start/finish area in addition to the sporting competition.

name: Langauer Inklusionslauf
description: The 3rd Langau Inclusive Run takes place on July 26, 2026, in cooperation with Tri-Team Schongau as part of the 14th Schongau Triathlon. The run is open to everyone wishing to take part individually, in pairs, or with assistance; participation in a wheelchair is also possible. The course is a flat out-and-back route, starting and finishing on Lechuferstraße by the ice rink. Entry is free, and donations to support Langau are welcome. Every registered participant receives a running shirt and a finisher’s gift, and trophies are awarded to the top finishers in various categories.

name: Oscheffer TSG-Lauf
description: The 17th Oscheffer TSG Run will take place on July 26, 2026, in Mainaschaff. The event offers various races for different age groups and ability levels, including a schoolchildren’s and youth race, the Sparkassen Run (5 km), the agilimo Run (10 km), a Bambini race, and a relay race. The races are part of a long-standing sporting event organized by TSG Mainaschaff 1973 e.V., welcoming both recreational and competitive runners. Online registration is now open, and further information is available in the event announcement.

name: Rainer Volkslauf
description: The Rainer Volkslauf takes place on Sunday, July 26, 2026, in Rain and offers runners of all ages a varied and motivating running experience. The 10 km main race starts at 9:30 a.m., followed by 5 km races and the shorter 1 km and 2 km Spatzenläufe. The focus is on the joy of exercise and preventive healthcare, supported by enthusiastic spectators and a varied program of events as part of SC Rain 1928 e. V.’s sports week. Register by June 15, 2026, and a popular Volkslauf T-shirt is included in the race pack. In addition, one euro per participant will be donated to the “Freunde durch Helfen” aid initiative.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The Volkswandertag in Bollensen is an annual event held on the last Sunday in July, open to hikers of all ages. A range of family-friendly routes takes participants along forest trails through the beautiful Solling region. The marathon and half-marathon hikes are circular routes starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports hall. All routes are marked and have refreshment stations. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with food and drinks in the finish area and a strong sense of community.

name: Běh na Kozubovou
description: The Run to Kozubová is a traditional mountain race held in Dolní Lomná. It follows hiking trails over challenging elevation changes. The race starts by the bakery in Dolní Lomná and goes via Polana and the Pod Kykulou saddle to the tourist lodge on Kozubová. The course is approximately 5 km long, with around 500 metres of elevation gain, challenging runners with steep climbs and offering beautiful mountain views. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and generous prize raffle for participants.

name: Beh na chatu pod Chlebom, mem. J. Morgoša
location: Turany okr. Martin, Turany okr. Martin, Turany - Šútovo – Zajacová
organizer: BS TATRAN Turany, LK NÁDEJ Turany
description: The Run to the Chata pod Chlebom, J. Morgoš Memorial, is a mountain running race held in the areas of Turany, Šútovo and Zajacová. The course is 3.1 km long, with an elevation gain of 680 metres, and follows mountain roads and trails. The race is part of the 2025 Turiec Running League and is open to various age categories for men and women. It is organised by BS TATRAN Turany, the town of Turany and LK NÁDEJ Turany. The race offers a challenge for runners who enjoy demanding mountain terrain.

name: XXXV-asis tradicinis estafetinis bėgimas „Medininkai - Vilnius“
description: The 35th traditional “Medininkai–Vilnius” relay race is Lithuania’s oldest traditional relay race. It commemorates those who were killed at the Medininkai border post. The event takes place in July, starting at the Medininkai Memorial. The relay consists of seven 5 km stages on paved roads, with participants running in teams. It is a special opportunity to take part in a meaningful historic sporting event that connects Medininkai and Vilnius.
course_highlights: 7 × 5 km relay on paved roads
Start at the Medininkai Memorial
The route commemorates those killed at the border post
additional: The event is organized by the Police Department under the Ministry of the Interior, the Customs Department, and LBMA. The results will be published on the organizers’ official website. The route is on paved roads, so suitable running shoes are recommended. The event commemorates the victims of Medininkai and was held in Vilnius. Officials participated. The route is 34 km long and consists of 7 stages. The relay baton contains symbolic soil. Medals and refreshments are provided at the finish.

name: Pajūrio basatlonas
description: Pajūrio Basatlonas is a unique barefoot run on the seaside sand, held in Smiltynė, Klaipėda. The event takes place during the Sea Festival and gives participants an unforgettable experience of running between the sea and the dunes. The race promotes running culture in Lithuania and encourages a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose from several distances and enjoy the beautiful coastal scenery and gentle breeze.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on seaside sand
Start on the beach by the southern pier, Kopgalis, Smiltynė
Distances of 500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, with a 2-hour time limit
additional: A 2-hour time limit applies to all distances. Participants must have an identity document, a race number attached, and an electronic timing chip attached to their shirt. Participants run voluntarily and assume all risks associated with taking part. Barefoot running on seaside sand, various distances (500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km), online registration, regulations and rules, awards and commemorative medals.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon is part of Zátopek’s Golden Week, a series of running races held in Plzeň in honour of Emil Zátopek’s Olympic victories. The main marathon takes place on 27 July and also offers accompanying races, including a half marathon, marathon and half-marathon relays, and a 10.5 km road race. The races start in the afternoon in Štruncovy sady and the surrounding area, with a varied programme and categories for men, women, and young people. The event is known for its tradition, high-quality organisation, and welcoming atmosphere for all runners.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červenec
description: Tempo Makers Osmička is a regular running race in Plzeň, held along the Úslava River. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and over and offers a friendly atmosphere for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The field is limited to 75 starters, making it an intimate and relaxed event. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking available nearby. After the race, the top finishers are announced and prizes are drawn in a raffle.

name: 4 PolandRockowy Bieg Policz się z cukrzy...
location: Broczyno, Czaplinek, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 43. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a private marathon run held under the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large loops of 6.10 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is marked with arrows or barrier tape depending on the weather. The event emphasizes self-sufficiency, as runners pass their cars after each loop. Marathon times are recorded with a handheld stopwatch, and a certificate is sent by email. Participants must be at least 18 years old. There is no entry fee, but a voluntary donation of €5 is requested.

name: 07. Stadtholz Marathon
description: The Stadtholz Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a run at Heideteich, with a 6.14 km trail per lap. The event is not competition-focused, but is aimed at runners who enjoy running in nature. The marathon is being held to mark Evi Köppe-Neeb’s linen wedding anniversary and offers a special atmosphere at Heideteich. The course features natural trails and a peaceful setting.

name: Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf
description: The Springe-Deister Summer Run on July 31, 2026, features a measured 5 km loop course at the foot of the Kleiner Deister. The course is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), so results can be included in rankings. Kilometer markers are clearly signposted, and the course is gently hilly, with an elevation difference of about 20 meters. The run starts at 5:45 p.m. at Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe and is aimed at runners looking for an attractive, officially sanctioned race in the region.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic courses that showcase the beauty of their settings. The organizers aim to promote running and offer participants a unique sporting and scenic experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and join a close-knit running community.

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994, and an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. The race attracts more than 1,200 participants and tens of thousands of spectators, offering a unique atmosphere in the city’s historic centre. The course runs through the picturesque streets of Gdańsk’s Old Town, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration. The running festival features several races, including the 5 km Women’s Run, the 5 km Men’s Run, and the Polish 10 km Championships.

name: Arm Race Kamień
description: ARM Race Kamień is an extreme OCR obstacle course race that welcomes both professionals and amateurs looking for an adrenaline rush. It’s a challenge for the whole family, including children, offering unusual entertainment and the opportunity to overcome personal weaknesses. The race is among the elite events of its kind in Poland and continues to grow, giving participants unforgettable experiences.

name: Bieg o Wronkę Szlakiem Świętego Jakuba
description: The Wronka Run along the Way of St. James is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Wronka near Giżycko. The competition includes various age categories, including 500 m races for children and main races of 5 and 10 km on gravel roads. Organizers provide a race pack containing a bib, medal, and voucher for a post-race meal. The event is family-friendly and community-oriented, with routes passing through the charming countryside around Wronka.

name: IX Rudzki Półmaraton Industrialny
organizer: RUDA Śląska i MOSiR Ruda Śląska
description: The 9th Ruda Śląska Industrial Half Marathon will take place on August 1 at 9:00 p.m. in Ruda Śląska. The 10.5 km route runs through the central part of the city, showcasing the region’s industrial character and post-industrial landmarks such as Chebzie railway station, the Mikołaj Shaft, the Kaufhaus housing estate, and the blast furnace at Pokój Steelworks. In addition to the half marathon, an accompanying run of approximately 10 km is organized for those who do not feel up to running the full distance. The start and finish are at the athletics stadium on Czarnoleśna Street, which also houses the race office and organizational facilities.

name: XI Czastarska Piątka
description: The 11th Czastary Five is an annual road race held in the Czastary municipality, attracting runners from various regions. The event combines sport and recreation and takes place on a 5-kilometer route through the municipality’s scenic surroundings. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and support for participants, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together.

name: Bieg z okazji 82. Rocznicy Wybuchu Powstania Warszawskiego
II Wielgomłyński Dycha
location: Wielgomłyny, Radomsko County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Półmaraton Cross Laskowa
location: Laskowa, Limanowa County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Markttagelauf
description: The Markttage Run in Bredstedt is an international charity run, with entry fees donated to a good cause. There are different distances for children, beginners and experienced runners, taking them through Bredstedt’s town centre. The event fosters community spirit and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups. Registration is online, and the entry fees are moderate to make it accessible to as many people as possible.
course_highlights: Different routes for children, beginners and experienced runners
Run through Bredstedt’s town centre
International charity run
additional: Registration is online only, until 30.07., at www.my.raceresult.com. Entry fees are donated. Note: The event information PDF is currently not accessible. Several distances for different ability levels; event in August 2026; children participate for free, adults pay up to 5 euros.

name: 18. Ottonenlauf
description: The Ottonenlauf is a scenic race in the Harz that brings runners from three different villages to a shared finish in Quedlinburg, a UNESCO World Heritage city. The 21.1 km, 42.2 km, and 69 km routes start in Stiege, Alexisbad, and Meisdorf, respectively. The route runs mostly along forest and woodland trails through the Selke Valley, with shaded forests, rural sections, and moderate climbs that call for a good pace. Walking and Nordic walking options are also available, making the event open to a wide range of participants. Electronic timing and finisher medals round out the event.

name: 24. Hella Marathon Nacht
description: The hella marathon night rostock is an atmospheric sunset run set against the picturesque backdrop of the Haedgehalbinsel in Rostock’s city harbor. The event offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 km, and a children’s race. All start at dusk and finish in a brightly lit finish area. The route passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, and is kept traffic-free. The event combines a sporting challenge with Northern German hospitality and a holiday atmosphere.

name: 5. TCW Backyard Ultra
description: The TCW Backyard Ultra in Wölfersheim is a unique running event focused on camaraderie and endurance. A 6.706 km loop starts at the top of every hour and must be completed within that hour. The race continues until only one runner remains, who is declared the winner. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and motivating community, welcoming runners of all abilities.

name: adidas Runners City Night
description: The adidas Runners City Night Berlin is a unique summer event that combines running and inline skating with a big party on the famous Kurfürstendamm. The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes for runners, as well as a 10 km inline skating route through the vibrant City West. Live bands, cheering zones, and enthusiastic fans create an electrifying atmosphere that makes the race an unforgettable experience. The finish at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, with its illuminated finish arch, rounds off the sporting night perfectly.

name: hella marathon nacht rostock
description: The hella marathon nacht rostock is an atmospheric sunset run along the Warnow, with a maritime flair and Hanseatic hospitality. The event takes place in August in Rostock and offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 and a students’ run. The start and finish are at Rostock’s city harbor, where runners set off at dusk and finish beneath bright lights. The course passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, making for a unique running experience.

name: Hemfurth-Edersee-Abendlauf
description: The Hemfurth-Edersee Evening Run is a traditional late-summer race that brings runners of all ages together in the beautiful surroundings of Edertal-Hemfurth. In pleasant temperatures and as the sun sets, the focus is on the joy of movement and a sense of community. At the finish, participants can enjoy refreshments, good music, and a sociable get-together in a relaxed atmosphere. The race is organized by volunteers from TSV 08 Hemfurth-Edersee e.V. and is a popular event for ambitious runners, recreational joggers, and families.

name: Pörndorfer Sommernachtslauf
description: The 15th Pörndorfer Sommernachtslauf on August 1, 2026, in Aldersbach is a running event with a family-friendly atmosphere and genuine race-day excitement. The event offers suitable challenges for all age groups and fitness levels, from the Bambini run and children’s and youth races to the main race. Nordic walking is also part of the program. The event combines sporting ambition with a shared summer spirit and attracts runners and spectators from the region.

name: Schwindegger Schlosslauf
description: The Schwindegg Castle Run is an annual sporting event in the idyllic community of Schwindegg. Participants run along picturesque paths and through forests, with views of Schwindegg Castle. There are various categories for all age groups, including children and teenagers. The event is also an opportunity to strengthen the community and support the sports club. Before and after the run, a summer festival with food, a drinks stand and a bar offers a cheerful atmosphere for celebrating and socializing.

name: Krkonošská 50
location: Areál Svatý Petr, Špindlerův Mlýn, Czech Republic
description: Krkonošská 50 is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque setting of the Krkonoše National Park, starting in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The field is limited to 300 starters, and the race is divided into several age categories for men and women. The organizers emphasize environmental responsibility and safety, including a requirement to carry a mobile phone and a ban on littering outside refreshment stations.

name: Běhej lesy Bílá
description: Běhej lesy Bílá is a mountain trail race held in the beautiful surroundings of the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area. The race offers several routes, including a short and a long course; the long ČSOB 20 km route is included in the international UTMB Index. Runners can take the cable car to the summit and look forward to the special Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add extra competitive elements and rewards. The race is suitable for all mountain trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of the Beskydy Mountains and compete on well-marked routes.

name: Zlatá stezka
description: The Golden Trail is a historic international hiking route connecting Bohemia with the Danube region. It winds through the beautiful landscapes of Šumava and the Bavarian Forest. At 631 km long, it offers a unique experience, linking up with Germany’s Golden Trail and passing through several national parks and nature reserves. Hikers can explore historic towns, castles, observation towers, and cultural landmarks along the trail, which is equipped with information boards and rest areas. The Golden Trail is ideal for hiking and discovering the region’s natural and historical attractions in the South Bohemian and Plzeň regions.

name: Běh na Kamenný stůl
description: The Run to the Stone Table is a traditional running race held in Rataje nad Sázavou, celebrating its 10th anniversary this year. The race offers a challenging and beautiful route from the castle courtyard to the Stone Table landmark, with varied surfaces and hilly terrain. It is open to professional runners, amateurs, and families with children, with shorter routes available for the latter. The race is part of the Běhej zámky series, which brings together running races at attractive locations near castles.

name: Mšecká sedmička
organizer: Městys Mšec a TJ Sokol Mšec
description: Mšecká sedmička is a traditional running race held in Mšec in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 7 km long and follows forest and field paths, offering runners pleasant natural terrain. It starts at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field and is suitable for the general public. The event is organized by the Mšec Municipality and TJ Sokol Mšec, who ensure a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.

name: Libeř - Radlík
description: Libeř–Radlík is a 2.47 km uphill race with 170 m of elevation gain, part of the Runs in the Hills in Prague and Surrounding Areas series. The course is not entirely uphill: it includes several flat sections and one downhill, adding interest and variety to the race. The atmosphere is pleasant and the entry fee is symbolic, with generous prizes for the winners from Botanicus. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain near Prague.

name: Trail Running Cup - Krkonošská padesátka
location: Mšec, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Krkonoše Fifty is a traditional trail race held in the scenic surroundings of Špindlerův Mlýn in the Krkonoše Mountains. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The start is at the Svatý Petr resort, and participants can use the central car park in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race is limited to 300 starters. Overall winners are named for both men and women, along with winners in ten age categories for men and women.

name: Bear Foot Poľana
description: BEAR FOOT POĽANA 2026 is a mountain race set in the wild and unique Poľana Mountains, the highest and best-preserved volcano in Central Europe. The race offers two main courses: 24 km with over 1,300 metres of cumulative elevation gain, and 10 km with over 600 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through popular hiking spots such as Bystrô Waterfall, the Kaľamárka Celtic hillfort, and the summit of Predná Poľana. Runners can enjoy the beauty of deep forests, mountain streams, and pastures. The race is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association league and is limited to 150 runners per course.

name: Porubska 11-ka
location: Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka
description: Porúbska 11-ka is a running race held in the village of Porúbka in Bardejov District. It features gently rolling, hilly to flat terrain at an elevation of 196 m. The course passes through the Carpathian region, which offers a combination of flat stretches and hills, ideal for runners looking for an enjoyable run in nature. The race is organized by the municipality of Porúbka and is part of local sporting activities with a tradition and community spirit. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Island Gladiator Slovakia
location: Lednické Rovne, Medné, Lednické Rovne, Medné, Medné
description: Island Gladiator Slovakia is an OCR race that will test your strength, endurance, and determination in Slovakia’s authentic natural surroundings. The course runs through meadows, forests, streams, and hills, with a variety of technical sections and obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing, and carrying loads. The race is open to men and women, from beginners to experienced athletes, with a time limit of 3 hours. Every participant receives an official T-shirt, a medal, a race pack, and electronic timing. Island Gladiator is not just a competition, but a challenge to overcome yourself and become a stronger gladiator.

name: XI Gorce Ultra-Trail
description: Gorce Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the picturesque surroundings of Ochotnica Dolna. Participants can choose from five varied routes, ranging from 5 to 102 km and suited to different experience levels, from beginners to seasoned ultramarathoners. The routes pass through the beautiful Gorce Mountains, featuring challenging climbs and spectacular views. The time limit for the longest route is 20 hours, underscoring the event’s challenging nature.

name: Kresowe Trail #9
description: Kresowe Trail is an intimate trail-running event organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The event in Narewka offers two race distances: Szpurt (7 km) and Wertep (16.6 km), along scenic routes marked with course signs and featuring an aid station. Participants can expect electronic timing, commemorative medals, and a hot post-race meal. The event emphasizes ecology and the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: XI Bieg Wśród Krasnych Pól
organizer: Gminne Centrum Czytelnictwa i Kultury w Krasnopolu
description: Bieg Wśród Krasnych Pól is a forest race held in the Krasnopol municipality, offering courses of approximately 10 km and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The course runs exclusively along forest gravel and grass roads, offering a connection with nature and pleasant running conditions. The race office is located at the Municipal Reading and Culture Centre in Krasnopol, and the race starts in the afternoon. The event is open to all and is organised for people who enjoy outdoor activities.

name: XXXIV Bieg Jezior
location: Stary Uścimów, Lubartów County, Lublin Voivodeship, Poland

name: virtueller St.-Anna-Jedermannslauf
description: The virtual St. Anna Jedermannslauf in Amerdingen is a popular running event held annually in July. Participants can run the original courses of 10 km, 5.8 km jogging, 5.8 km walking, or 3.5 km for youth. The route leads from St. Anna Chapel through the forest south of Amerdingen, past historic sites such as the Celtic square enclosure and the Three Stones, as well as a small lake. Times are recorded via an app and transferred immediately to a leaderboard, making the event especially modern and accessible. The race is attracting increasing numbers of participants and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups.
course_highlights: Start at St. Anna Chapel
Forest course south of Amerdingen, with historic sights such as the Celtic square enclosure and the Three Stones
Route marked with directional arrows, with app-supported timekeeping
additional: The race is virtual and takes place in July, allowing participants to complete their runs at a time that suits them. Multiple entries and a second free attempt are possible. Results are recorded via an app and transferred immediately to the leaderboard. There are different course distances for different age groups and ability levels. Virtual race, route towards the Celtic square enclosure, online registration, event period from 01.07. to 27.07.2025, start times between 06:00 and 20:00, participation from age 8, donations to preserve the chapel

name: Hirschbachschleiferl
location: 85414 Kirchdorf an der Amper, Bavaria, Germany

name: 10. Charity-Lauf Koldingen
description: The Koldingen Charity Run is part of the Sparkassen Laufpass of the Hanover Region, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. Runners can explore the Hanover Region on foot and collect stamps in their running pass each time they take part. The run offers a varied course in the beautiful surroundings of Pattensen and promotes recreational sport in the region. The event is open to everyone who wants to be active while doing good.

name: 55. Volkslauf Rund um Wellen
description: The 55th Rund um Wellen Fun Run will take place on August 2, 2026, in Beverstedt-Wellen. It is one of Germany’s oldest marathon races and has a family-friendly atmosphere. The event offers challenging courses over four distances: the marathon, half marathon, 11 km and 5 km, some of which are officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The route passes through varied landscapes, including forest paths and surfaces of different types. The event is organized by TSV Wellen and is supported by many volunteers from the village.

name: Hilpoltsteiner Burgfestlauf
description: The Hilpoltstein Castle Festival Run is a long-standing running event held as part of the Hilpoltstein Castle Festival. It takes place every year on the first Sunday in August. The event offers races for different age and ability groups, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s, fun and main races. A special highlight is the castle hill sprint in the main race, where the fastest runners can earn the title of Castle Hill King or Queen. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive course, with the start and finish on Marktstraße near the town hall.

name: Kapellenlauf Vorra
description: The Kapellenlauf Vorra is a traditional race held annually by DJK SC Vorra. It offers several distances, including a half marathon, a quarter marathon of 10.55 km, and a fun run and Nordic walking, newly added in 2025. The course passes through the rural surroundings of Abtsdorf and offers both competitive racing and a more leisurely running experience. The race also hosts the Upper Franconian Half Marathon Championships and attracts many participants from the region.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Moldava
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in different destinations, including Moldava, with routes for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers. Each race offers a main running race of 6 to 9 km, an adventure route of 20 to 30 km using a map, a 5 to 8 km walk with checkpoints to find, and children’s races from 200 to 1,600 metres. The series is suitable for a wide range of people who want to explore the beauty of the Ore Mountains in an active and sporting way.

name: Klokočovská päťka
location: Obecný úrad, Klokočov, Michalovce District, Slovakia

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 8. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race covers 2 miles (3.218 km), with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The competition is part of a race series in which runners earn points toward a travelling cup based on their performances and participation in individual rounds.

name: Malý Kavečianský maratón
location: Kavečany - Košice, Kavečany - Košice, Futbalový štadión
organizer: TJ Mladosť Kavečany a MÚ MČ Košice - Kavečany
description: The Malý Kavečianský Marathon is a running event in Kavečany near Košice, offering 21 km and 7 km races as well as children’s runs. The race starts at the football stadium and is open to a wide range of categories, from children to veterans. It is organised by TJ Mladosť Kavečany together with the Košice-Kavečany Municipal District. The event is suitable for runners of various ages and ability levels, with affordable entry fees and online registration available.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Karlštejn
description: The Berounka Running Series in Karlštejn is a community trail race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Autokemp Karlštejn. The route crosses fields, meadows, and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry, continues along the red-marked St. James’s Way to Karlštejn Castle, and finishes with a downhill run to the finish line. The race offers a friendly atmosphere, a marked route, refreshments, and bag storage. Every participant receives a race number, and the top finishers in each category receive certificates and medals.

name: Berglauf zur Schuhbräualm
description: The 41st Berglauf zur Schuhbräualm is a challenging mountain race taking place on 5 August 2026 in Raubling. The course covers 7.5 kilometres with an elevation gain of around 678 metres. The race starts at 19:00 and offers runners a challenging mountain route. The event is aimed at mountain-running enthusiasts looking for a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: 7.5 km course
678 metres of elevation gain
Very challenging mountain terrain
additional: Start and finish are provided for all competitions; exact location details require RUNME Premium. Accommodation is available near the start and finish. The race starts in Großholzhausen, with parking, changing facilities and clothing transport. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a festive atmosphere, with a raffle and commemorative gifts. Early registration is recommended.

name: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón
description: The Rozdělov Quarter Marathon is a running race organized by Maratón klub Kladno and held in Kladno-Rozdělov. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing races in the region. The race offers runners of all levels an opportunity to test themselves over a quarter-marathon distance in the pleasant surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The event is part of the club’s running calendar and supports the running community around Kladno.

name: Krčský lomcovák
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Krčský Lomcovák is a traditional running race held in Krčský Forest in Prague 4. The race offers a 5 km course starting by the Velký altán, open to both men and women, with separate start times. The event is part of a fun sports afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and families with children can try various activities, such as slacklining, sack racing and disc golf. The race is organized by Krčák žije magazine, which covers activities and news from Krčský Forest and its surroundings.

name: Esenser Volksbanklauf - 31. Stadtlauf
description: The 31st Esens City Run, held as the 6th Esenser Volksbank Run, takes place on Friday, July 31, 2026, in Esens. The traditional “Around St. Magnus” run offers exciting races in the city center for runners of all ages. The event begins with the 670-meter Bambini run, followed by student races over 1,340 meters. Adults can compete over five and ten kilometers, with both races starting at the same time. The awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races.
course_highlights: “Around St. Magnus” run in Esens city center
670-meter Bambini run
Adult races over 5 and 10 kilometers
additional: Start times: Bambini run at 18:10, student race at 18:30, and adult 5 km and 10 km races at 19:30. Awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races. Online registration is available. Start and finish at Esens Market Square; online registration available; July weather: approx. 25°C, sunny

name: Berglauf
description: TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. warmly invites you to the hill run in Höxter, which features a challenging course with varied terrain. The event includes a children’s hill run of approx. 1 km and a main race of approx. 3.2 km, with a steady climb and an elevation gain of about 170 meters. The course starts at the sports field and runs over grassy areas, asphalt paths, meadow trails, and narrow gravel and forest paths, finishing in the woods. This long-standing running event welcomes runners of all ages.

name: Gifhorner Friedhofslauf
description: The Gifhorn Cemetery Run is a special event held at the St. Nicolai Protestant Lutheran Cemetery in Gifhorn. Runners can choose between 4- and 8-kilometer routes. After the run, participants gather for a relaxed barbecue and drinks under the apple trees. Traditionally held in the evening, the event combines sporting activity with a relaxed atmosphere in a historic setting.

name: Sparkassen-Festungslauf
description: The Sparkassen Fortress Run in Königstein is a summer-evening running adventure at one of Europe’s most architecturally and historically valuable hilltop fortresses. The challenging 9.4-kilometre main course climbs 470 metres, with the final kilometres running across the fortress plateau and offering magnificent views of Saxon Switzerland and the Elbe. Alongside the main race, there is a 7.7 km course, as well as a mini run and an inclusive run, each 1.2 km long, on the fortress plateau. The event has been established for over 20 years and offers a special atmosphere, with the awards ceremony held at sunset in the fortress market square.

name: niedamiRUN - Ultramaraton Sudecki
organizer: Stowarzyszenie NIEDAMIRÓW WIOSKA CUDÓW i Foxter Sport
description: NiedamiRUN is a Sudetes ultramarathon taking place on August 8, 2026, in Niedamirów, a picturesque village located at the crossroads of three cultures. Participants can choose from four distances: 10K, 20K, 50K, and 100K, which lead through the Karkonosze Mountains, the Lubawka Gate, and the Bóbr Valley, offering challenging elevation gains and beautiful views. The routes pass through the region’s historical and natural attractions, with the start and finish in Niedamirów. It’s a unique opportunity to take on a Sudetes ultra amid the wilderness and local culture.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
description: Śliwicka Dyszka is an annual race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association to promote an active lifestyle and running. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of Śliwice and offers participants an attractive 10 km course. The race attracts both amateur and experienced runners, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition and bringing the local community together.

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny is a unique one-hour race held in Koszalin on a challenging, approximately 1-kilometre loop through forest terrain, featuring significant elevation changes and varied surfaces, including sandy sections. Participants compete to complete as many laps as possible within one hour, and must start their final lap before the hour is up. The race promotes sport, recreation, volunteering and active tourism. At the finish, runners receive an exceptionally heavy medal and a drink. The event is organised by the „SFX” Association and Rozbiegany Koszalin.

name: Bieg Zbója
description: Bieg Zbója is a mountain race held in the scenic area around Bielsko-Biała, on routes around the summit of Klimczok. The race’s name refers to the legend of the bandit Klimczok, who formed a gang that helped the poor and left traces behind in the form of a mountain shelter and a cave. The course is challenging, with significant elevation gain and technical climbs that test the runners’ character and endurance. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a unique atmosphere and beautiful mountain views.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a race series that has promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate the scenic appeal and character of cross-country routes. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.

name: I Jura Night Dog Run
location: Klucze, Olkusz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 1st Jura Night Dog Run is a night canicross race taking place on August 8, 2026, in Klucze, Poland. The event offers two main courses: 10 km and a 21 km half marathon, with the option to compete individually or as part of a team. The event is limited to 500 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere and a comfortable racing experience. The race starts at 8:00 PM, highlighting the unique character of a nighttime run with a dog.

name: Złota Dycha
description: The 6th Złota Dycha is a road race held in the heart of Złotoryja, the oldest city in Poland. The event is scheduled for August 8, 2026, combining the excitement of sport with the European Gold Panning Championships. The race offers two distances—5 and 10 kilometers—and participants can compete on the city’s picturesque streets. It is organized by Złotoryja City Hall and the Złotoryja Cultural Center, with support from the local running community.

name: 16. Piesauer Glasmacherlauf
description: The 16th Piesauer Glasmacherlauf takes place on 1 August 2026 in Piesau, Thuringia. The event offers 2 km races for children and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a 10 km Nordic walking competition on forest paths. It is part of the Sparkassen-Cup and the TLV Running and Nordic Walking Cup, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with changing and shower facilities and refreshments on site. Trophies and awards are presented to the fastest runners and by age group.
course_highlights: 2 km children's race
10 km main race exclusively on forest paths
10 km Nordic walking with poles; running is prohibited
additional: Changing, washing and shower facilities are available. Food, drinks and cake are available for purchase on site. Trophies go to the fastest runners on each course (places 1–3 in each gender category), with awards for the top three in each age group. Team classification for the 10 km race, based on the 2 fastest women or 3 fastest men from a club. Forest paths, team classification, trophies for the fastest on each course, awards, registration until 29.07.2026

name: Oettinger Stadtlauf
description: The Oettingen City Run takes place on August 8, 2026, as part of the “Summer in the City” festival in downtown Oettingen. The event offers races for children, teenagers and adults, with timing for the main race, the youth races and the walking event. The routes lead through the historic city centre and offer a sporting challenge for all age groups. The event is organised by TSV Oettingen, Running, Triathlon and Athletics Department, and is a popular local race with a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the historic city centre of Oettingen
Children’s race: approx. 0.8 km, untimed
Main race and walking event: approx. 7 km, timed
additional: Children’s race is untimed; registration is available through the Oettingen holiday programme; late registration is possible on the event day for an additional fee; medals and drinks for the children’s and youth races; prizes for the first three boys and girls in the youth race; walking event and main race are timed; staggered start times from 16:00. The route is mostly flat, on asphalt and cobblestones; start and finish at the market square; open to all physically fit participants; city championship for Oettingen residents.

name: CJ Schmidt Hafentagelauf
description: The CJ Schmidt Harbour Day Run takes place in Husum, a city on the North Sea in Schleswig-Holstein, as part of the Husum Harbour Days festival. The event offers flat road races over various distances, including children’s and youth races, a 5 km race, a 10 km race, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. There is also the Husum Corporate Cup, in which company teams of four compete. The course runs through the city centre and along the harbour, combining urban streets with waterfront paths, accompanied by the fresh North Sea breeze.
course_highlights: Flat road races through Husum’s city centre and harbour
Course along the North Sea coast with a fresh sea breeze
A range of distances for children, young people and relay teams
additional: The organiser is Husumer Sportverein seit 1875 e.V. Timing is provided by Race Result, and registration is managed by LAV Husum. Typical August weather in Husum is around 25 °C, with mostly sunny days and average precipitation of 60 mm. The event also includes team and corporate races as well as family races, with a festive atmosphere in the harbour area. August weather is usually sunny, at around 25°C.

name: Volkslauf um den Mittelpunkt Deutschlands
description: The Volkslauf around the geographical center of Germany is a sporting running event on August 8, 2026, in Krebeck, suitable for young and old as well as both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers various running and walking routes with changing elevation profiles, some of which are challenging and run along paved or asphalt paths. The races start and finish at the Krebeck sports field, and all participants receive fruit and drinks during and after the competition. Medals and prizes are awarded to the top finishers, and there is an age-group classification as well as on-site medical support.

name: Volkslauf um den Auesee
description: The 5th race in the Mühlenkreis Series takes place on 08.08.2026 at ATSV Espelkamp, by Auesee. The course follows paved and partly asphalted paths around Auesee and is almost flat, with no significant elevation changes. The race is part of a popular regional running series with a total of nine events. The organizer is ATSV Espelkamp, which provides a well-organized and pleasant race atmosphere.

name: Měřínský kros
description: Měřín Cross-Country Run is a traditional cross-country race through the beautiful Vysočina countryside. It offers a 13 km main race over Dědkovská hora and a relaxed 8 km course suitable for recreational runners. Children aged 5 to 12 can take part in the Junior Cross obstacle race, which features a giant bouncy castle. The race is timed using chip timing, and after the run there is an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments. The start and finish are at the sports field behind the primary school in Měřín, where parking, a baggage drop, toilets, changing rooms and showers are available.

name: Mořice Run
location: Mořice, Prostějov District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Mořice Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque village of Mořice near Olomouc. The race is part of a series of running events focused on recreational and competitive running, which the club organizes in Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting regular running and endurance races, and Mořice Run offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a quality race atmosphere. The club also provides support and advice to runners who want to get started or improve their training.

name: Slatinická sedmička
description: Slatinice Seven is a 7 km charity run that follows mostly off-road routes around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc. The race is dedicated to the memory of Šárka Krčková and offers runners a pleasant route surrounded by nature. The event is suitable for all runners who want to combine sport with supporting a good cause.

name: Vnorovská desítka
description: Vnorovská Desítka is a popular 10 km race held every year in August in the village of Vnorovy. The race is part of the Moravian-Slovak Running Cup and attracts over 200 runners from various countries, including Czech elite athletes and African runners. The course follows a closed asphalt loop with minimal elevation gain, with the start and finish at the elementary school. The atmosphere is lively, thanks to the large crowd and high number of participants; nearly 700 runners take part across all categories.

name: Východniarska
location: Kluknava, parkovisko pred Kaštieľom hotela Biela dáma, čierny rytier – 8.8.2026 o 9:00
description: Východniarska is a mountain ultratrail and long-distance hike for individuals, building on the popular Východniarska stovka. The route runs through the eastern part of the Slovak Ore Mountains, mostly through the Volovské vrchy, and offers a challenging 85 km run with +4200 m of elevation gain. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak, with a time limit of 22 hours. The event is open to the public to participants aged 18 and over and requires proper registration and payment of the entry fee.

name: Hámorská dvadsiatka
location: Obecný úrad Remetské Hámre, Remetské Hámre, Slovakia
description: Hámorská dvadsiatka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre. Despite the cancellation of the last two editions due to the Covid-19 pandemic, the organizers are looking forward to bringing the event back and welcoming a large turnout of runners. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains, which offer attractive routes for sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through the natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains
Beautiful views and tourist attractions in the area
Organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre, with a long-standing tradition

name: Rajecký maratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held in the picturesque surroundings of Rajec and the surrounding area. Runners can expect a challenging course with elevation gain and beautiful natural scenery that will test their endurance and fitness. The event has a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere, reflected in its side events and the hospitality at the finish. In addition to the marathon, a half marathon, relay, cross duathlon, and the popular Rajec Borošovec are also held. The Borošovec is a cross-country classic with more than 200 meters of elevation gain.
course_highlights: A course with more than 200 meters of elevation gain
The Rajec Borošovec cross-country classic, 14.1 km long
Natural scenery in Rajec and the surrounding area
additional: The Rajec Borošovec is part of the events that kick off the running season in the Rajec Valley. After the races, participants are served goulash and homemade cakes. The Rajec Borošovec course is dry and fast, with possible obstacles such as fallen trees. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also attracts younger runners and juniors.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký In-line Half Marathon is a competitive inline skating race held in Rajec at SNP Square. The course runs from Rajec to the village of Čičmany and back, with the finish at the marathon turnaround point in Čičmany. Skaters must wear a helmet throughout the course and use the rented timing chips, which must be returned at the finish. The organizer provides refreshments, changing rooms and showers, as well as free transport back to Rajec for inline skaters. The final finishing straight is reserved for runners, so participants must follow the organizer’s rules.

name: Rajecká štafeta
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Relay is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is a relay race that is part of the Rajec Marathon and gives athletes the opportunity to compete in teams. The organizer provides race bibs, timekeeping, and full support for participants during the race. The event is suitable for runners of various levels and promotes community spirit and enthusiasm for sport in the region.

name: Rajecký detský beh
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký Children’s Run is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is aimed at children and underage runners, with an emphasis on safety and responsibility: a parent or legal guardian must sign for them to participate. The event is part of a wider running program in Rajec and gives young runners the opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a race in a pleasant urban setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at SNP Square in Rajec
For children and underage runners
Safety is supported by a parent or legal guardian’s signature
additional: Children and underage participants must bring a signed declaration from a parent or legal guardian. Participation will not be permitted without it.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Jurbarkas 2026“, skirtos Nemuno metams paminėti
description: The “Jurbarkas 2026” running race, held to mark the Year of the Nemunas, will take place on August 8, 2026, in Jurbarkas, on Nemunas Street. Children, young people, and adults are all invited to participate, with three distances on offer: 400 m, 3 km, and 12 km. The event starts at 11:00. All participants who finish will receive commemorative gifts, and the best athletes will receive trophies. It’s a great opportunity to mark the Year of the Nemunas actively and run together in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Three distances to choose from: 400 m, 3 km, and 12 km
