The race takes place on Nemunas Street in Jurbarkas
The 12 km distance consists of 4 laps
additional: Race bib distribution starts at 10:00. Age groups by distance: 400 m — B12/M12 (born in 2014 or later); 3 km — B14/M14, B18/M18 (older participants compete without age-group ranking); 12 km — men and women in separate age groups. All participants who finish receive commemorative gifts, and the best receive trophies. Race distances: 400 m, 3 km, 12 km; age groups; advance registration; registration on the day of the event will not be available.

name: Šilutės naktinis bėgimas „ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026“
location: Šilutė, Šilutės rajonas, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lithuania
description: The Šilutė night run “ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026” is a nighttime running event for everyone who enjoys an active lifestyle—from families and beginners to experienced runners. The event takes place in Šilutė, with an illuminated night course, music, a great atmosphere and various activities. Participants can choose the 1 km run for families, children and pets, or the 5 km and 10 km distances. Participants will receive finisher medals, prizes will be awarded to the fastest runners, and tasty food will be available.
course_highlights: Illuminated night course
Location: Kiškio dauba, Šilutė
Distances: 1 km, 5 km and 10 km
additional: Event schedule: 18:00 bib collection, 19:30 official event opening, 20:00 1 km run for families, children and pets, 21:30 5 km and 10 km runs. Participants can enjoy music, prizes for the fastest runners, various activities and tasty food. Registration is open until August 7, 2026. The event program includes various distances and activities, and participants receive medals and prizes.

name: Druskininkų naktinis bėgimas 2026

price_tiers.distance: Bėgimo rungtys (1 km, 4 km, 8 km, 16 km, estafetė 2x4 km)

description: The Druskininkai Night Run is a unique summer night run in Druskininkai, inviting participants to experience the rhythm of running beneath the stars. The event features a vibrant atmosphere, music, light effects, and a scenic route around Lake Druskonis. Participants can choose from several events, including running, a relay, and roller skating, making it a great activity for families and friends. The run symbolizes friendship between Lithuania and Poland and is part of sports projects that promote cooperation between communities.
course_highlights: Scenic route around Lake Druskonis (1.2 km loop)
Night run with music, light and smoke effects
Option to participate in running and roller-skating events
additional: Race bibs and race packs are distributed at the event village from 20:00 to 21:40. Warm-up with a Zumba instructor. 21:25 – 1.2 km roller-skating event (untimed). 21:40 – 1,200 m run (untimed). 22:00 – 4 km and 12 km roller-skating events. 22:30 – starts for the 4 km, 8 km, and 16 km runs, and the 2×4 km relay. The event is part of the “Run Together with a Friend in Druskininkai” project, funded by the state budget. The event is funded by the Interreg Lithuania–Poland Programme. Participant bibs are issued on August 8; the start is in Druskininkai; several hundred participants are expected; this is an international project.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce - Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the locations. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and nature experience. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively in beautiful surroundings.

name: Chudy Wawrzyniec
description: Chudy Wawrzyniec is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Żywiec Beskids, offering six distances from 3 km to 100 km. The event takes place on August 8–9, 2026, starting in Rajcza and finishing in Ujsoły. The courses are technically demanding, with significant elevation gain and beautiful views, and the 80 km race serves as the Polish Mountain Running Championships over the ultra distance. The organizers provide professional race management and aid stations along the course, as well as the option to transfer a race entry.

name: VII Charytatywny Bieg świętego Dominika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Bieg Świętego Dominika w Ustroniu
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious annual running event held in Gdańsk since 1994, as an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. This unique sporting event attracts both amateur and professional runners, offering races over various distances in the picturesque city centre, on a course that loops around Neptune. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration, and creates an unforgettable atmosphere with thousands of spectators cheering on the runners and a rich programme of accompanying events. It is valued by local authorities and sponsors, underscoring its status and importance in Poland’s running calendar.

name: XI Bieg Lucka
description: The 11th Bieg Lucka is a memorial race honoring Lucjan Chorąży, held on August 9, 2026, in Skawinki near Lanckorona. The event includes a main race of approximately 14 km, a recreational run and a Nordic Walking event of approximately 5.2 km, as well as shorter races for children. The main race course leads to Mount Chełm, and after the events participants can gather for refreshments. The race has a family-friendly, mountain character and honors Lucjan, who was passionate about mountains and running.

name: Bieg na Wielką Sowę
location: Ludwikowice Kłodzkie, Gmina Nowa Ruda, Poland

name: Brunnenlauf
location: Iburg-Stadion, Bad Driburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bad Driburg Brunnenlauf is an annual running event organized by TV "Jahn" Bad Driburg e.V., welcoming runners of all ages. The challenging course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa gardens and the town, and finishes at Iburg Stadium. The event emphasizes fairness and sportsmanship and uses timing with a reusable chip. Registration is online only; late entries are not possible.
course_highlights: Challenging out-and-back course with hills
The course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa gardens and the town
Finish at Iburg Stadium, Bad Driburg
additional: Timing is provided exclusively with the reusable race result chip, worn on the foot using a chip strap. The chip deposit is 10€ and is refunded when the chip is returned. Late entries are not possible. Participants may be disqualified for violations of fairness and good conduct. Online registration only; no late entries. Participation from age 18; children and school students participate free of charge.

name: Karbener Stadtlauf
price_range: zwischen 2,00€ und 15,00€ je nach Lauf und Jahr
description: The Karben City Run is a traditional running event held every year in Karben at Günter-Reutzel-Weg. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to compete on varied courses through the town and surrounding area. An accompanying program provides entertainment and a chance to socialize. The run is a popular event for the whole family and promotes local sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Course through the town of Karben
Finish at Günter-Reutzel-Weg
Varied running courses for different age groups
additional: An accompanying program is part of the event. Registration is via the separate registration page. The event is organized by Karbener Sportverein. Various race disciplines; online registration is open until approximately 60 minutes before the start; late registration is available for a fee.

name: Rother Kirchweihlauf
description: The Rother Kirchweihlauf is a traditional running event organized by TSG 08 Roth. The race takes place annually in Roth and offers runners a great opportunity to get active and experience a sense of community. Despite occasional weather-related challenges, the event is held with great dedication. It welcomes runners of all ability levels and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: A traditional race in Roth with regional significance
An outdoor event with a varied course
Part of the Middle Franconian 10 km Championships (when held)
additional: Certificates can be downloaded online after the race. The event is organized by TSG 08 Roth, which also offers other sports activities and classes. The event takes place on a flat, paved course, with various race categories for all ages and ability levels. Results and photos are available.

name: Diekseelauf
description: The Sparkassen Diekseelauf is a traditional fun run around Lake Dieksee in Bad Malente-Gremsmühlen. The event takes place on August 9, 2026, and offers runners an attractive course with modern transponder timing. Participants can conveniently view and download their results and certificates online. The race is organized by TSV Malente and is open to runners of all ability levels.

name: Oberpfalzmeisterschaft Waldlauf 2026
description: The Upper Palatinate Cross-Country Championships 2026 will take place on 9 August 2026 at the Jacob family brewery in Bodenwöhr. The event is hosted by the Upper Palatinate District and organised by TV Burglengenfeld. The cross-country race offers runners an attractive course in a natural setting and is part of the Hammerseelauf. The championships are open to various age groups, from youth to masters, and promise exciting competition in the Upper Palatinate region.

name: v-office-Europalauf
description: The 39th vOffice Europalauf on 9 August 2026 is an international race connecting the Baltic seaside resorts of Neustadt, Pelzerhaken and Rettin over the half-marathon distance. The course offers a wonderful view across Neustädter Bucht and returns to Neustadt along the beach promenade, parallel to the beach. In addition to the half-marathon, there are races over 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km, as well as a Bambini run. The event is a popular sporting occasion in the region and is organised by TSV Neustadt.

name: Černovírský kros
location: Černovír u Ústí nad Orlicí, Pardubický
description: Černovír Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event held in Černovír near Ústí nad Orlicí. Its hilly courses combine paved and unpaved forest and field paths with asphalt. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. The start and registration are at the Sokol hall in Černovír, and the main race covers a distance of up to 5 km. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is popular with local and visiting runners.

name: Běh na Krušnou horu
description: The Run to Krušná hora is a traditional uphill race held in the village of Hudlice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race starts at the end of Dolejší Street by the forest and follows a wide gravel forest road to the Máminka lookout tower at the summit of Krušná hora. The course is 2.7 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering runners a challenging but beautiful experience in nature. The event is organised by TOBI Sport s.r.o. and is part of the Czech Running Club.

name: Beh na Kráľovu studňu
location: Lenartov, okr. Bardejov, Lenartov, okr. Bardejov, Motorest Javorina Lenartov
description: The Run to Kráľova studňa is a traditional uphill race held in the picturesque village of Lenartov, near the historic Kráľova studňa, a meeting place of three kings. The course winds through beautiful countryside and offers a unique mountain-running experience, rich in history and scenic views. The event is part of the local running league and attracts runners from across the region. The organizers create a friendly atmosphere and welcome all participants, regardless of ability.

name: VI Ilgų nuotolių bėgiko Piotro Silkino jubiliejinis 85-mečio bėgimas
location: Kretingos Vasaros estrada, Maironio g. 15, Kretinga, Lithuania
description: The 85th-birthday run of long-distance runner Piotr Silkin is a traditional race held at Kretinga Summer Amphitheatre. The competition follows a lap format, with marathon participants completing one 2.2 km lap and twelve 3.3 km laps. The event celebrates longtime runner Piotr Silkin and attracts running enthusiasts from various places. Participants can enjoy both athletic competition and a welcoming community atmosphere.
course_highlights: The marathon course consists of 1 lap of 2.2 km and 12 laps of 3.3 km each
The competition takes place at Kretinga Summer Amphitheatre
The lap format lets spectators follow the race and support the participants
additional: Various distances and age groups will be offered at the event; results will be published, and registration is online.

name: Stezka mužů
description: Men’s Trail is a 3 km road race that is part of the SABZO series and will take place on August 12, 2026, in Prague 4. This race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to spend time actively in a friendly atmosphere. Although the main focus is on running, the event is part of a larger sports and social program in the region. Come and race, and enjoy a day full of activity and fun.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 4 etapas
description: The Jonava Running Cup is a traditional running series held in Jonava District to promote sport and physical activity. The competition is open to all runners, who can compete in different stages and age groups. Participants earn points at each stage toward the overall standings, while the courses run through various locations in Jonava District, offering an interesting and varied running experience. Registration is online, and race numbers are collected at the start venue on race day.
course_highlights: Stages take place in various locations in Jonava District: Šilai–Jaugeliškiai, Ragožiai, Juškonys, Salupiai–Bartoniai, Jonava
The start time for each stage is 19:30
Race numbers can be collected at the start venue on race day from 18:30 to 19:20
additional: Participants register separately for each stage. Participation is free. The courses may cross roads open to traffic, so participants must follow traffic rules. Registration deadlines vary by stage; race numbers are collected at the start venue on race day. Registration is online, the races take place in various locations in Jonava District, and participants are divided into age groups.

name: 15 Diecezjalna Pielgrzymka Biegowa Radom...
description: The 15th Diocesan Running Pilgrimage is a unique running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The race follows a route from Radom to Częstochowa and combines a passion for sport with the spiritual dimension of a pilgrimage. It is not only a competition, but also a community experience that attracts runners from different backgrounds. The event takes place on August 11–13, 2026, and is an important fixture on the region’s running calendar.

name: 6. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Run for Health is a charity series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that everyone can complete at their own pace. Proceeds from the entry fee go to help those in need, giving the event purpose and added value. Registration opens at 17:00 and the run starts at 17:45 at Lodičky. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.

name: 8. Wisent-RUN
location: Wisentgehege Springe, Springe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wisent-RUN is a popular race at Wisentgehege Springe, taking place for the eighth time on August 7, 2026. The event offers various race distances, including children’s races and timed competitions, set in a natural environment. With a family-friendly atmosphere and free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00, the race is a sporting highlight for all ages. The event is organised by VfV Concordia Alvesrode e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Köhlerhütte in Wisentgehege Springe
Race routes through the natural surroundings of Wisentgehege
Children’s races with timing and an awards ceremony
additional: Free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00. The 500 m children’s race “Frischlingsrennen” is untimed and open to children born in 2021 or later. The 1 km children’s race is timed and includes an awards ceremony for children born from 2016 to 2021. Ample parking is available. The event is open to everyone, with free admission for visitors. It offers an opportunity to explore the wildlife at Wisentgehege while getting active.

name: 24. Dammer Stadtlauf
description: The 24th Damme City Run is an evening road race through the center of Damme, organized by OSC Damme in cooperation with the City of Damme. The program includes three starts: a schoolchildren’s race, a general race for all participants, and the main evening race. After a two-year pandemic-related break, the race returns with an expected field of over 500 runners. The event is characterized by an open, local atmosphere, with on-site registration available, as runners fill the streets of the town center.
course_highlights: Evening road race through Damme city center
Three starts: schoolchildren’s race, general race, and main race
The course stays in the city center, with a lively atmosphere
additional: On-site registration is available, encouraging open, local participation. August weather is typically sunny, with temperatures between 14 and 25 °C. The event includes several categories, including children’s races and the main race, on a route through the city, with a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere.

name: 24. Knesebecker Einhornlauf
description: The Knesebecker Unicorn Run is a traditional running event in the Isenhagen region, held annually in August. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on varied courses. Online registration is conveniently available via the RaceResult platform, where all results and certificates can also be accessed. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Wittingen and attracts numerous running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Nordic walking option
Event held on the school grounds in Knesebeck
additional: Registration is online via RaceResult. Results and certificates are also available via RaceResult. The race takes place on Friday evening. Participant numbers are limited to 100; registration and results are available online; the event is held on the school grounds in Knesebeck.

name: 17. VSB Dresdner Nachtlauf
description: The VSB Dresden Night Run offers a beautifully illuminated route with views of the Dresden skyline. Torches and glow sticks create a special atmosphere. The 11.5 km route follows the Elbe to the Blue Wonder and returns along the Neustadt side of the river, while the 6.2 km route also runs along the Elbe and crosses the Albert Bridge to the finish. Alongside the sporting experience, there are children’s races and a special team competition for clubs and organizations. The event takes place at Heinz-Steyer-Stadion and is a highlight of the region’s running calendar.

name: 35. Speller Sparkassen-Sommernachtslauf
description: The 35th Speller Sparkassen Summer Night Run is a traditional race in Spelle, organized by SC Spelle-Venhaus. The event offers runners an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of Wählehof. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels and takes place in a relaxed atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: 303 Maraton Antoniego Fili
organizer: Polska Fabryka Wodomomierzy i Ciepłomierzy FILA Sp. z o.o.
description: The 303 Antoni Fili Marathon is a marathon taking place in Sztum, Mazowieckie, Poland, scheduled for August 15, 2026. Runners have access to a professionally prepared training plan tailored to different ability levels to help them prepare optimally for race day. The event is an excellent opportunity for runners looking to take on the marathon distance in scenic surroundings. Organizers provide expert support and access to a platform for managing race information.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the locations. The organizers’ goal is to popularize running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. Join this friendly and dynamic running event.

name: XII Rozłaziński Bieg po radość z życia
XXXIII Bieg im. Marszałka Józefa Piłsudskiego
Schierker Sommerlauf
description: The Schierker Sommerlauf is a traditional race in the Harz Mountains, taking place for the 24th time on 8 August 2026. The event offers varied distances from 1 km to 16 km, running through the impressive landscape around Schierke. Runners can enjoy breathtaking views, a unique atmosphere and great support in the finish area at the Schierker Feuersteinarena. The race is part of the new Harzer Laufcup 2026 and is open to runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Run on paved forest roads, with two laps for the 8 km main race
Breathtaking views of the Brocken and the Harz landscape
Start and finish at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, with a great atmosphere
additional: The start and finish are at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, which has changing rooms and showers. The course runs along paved forest roads. There is a refreshment point at the newly built toboggan run. Registration is online, with personalised race numbers for those who register in advance. Use of the showers is included in the entry fee. The event is part of the Harzer Laufcup 2026. Courses on paved forest roads, online registration, personalised race numbers, refreshments included, electronic timing, certificates and trophies for the winners.

name: Gederner Stadtlauf
location: Lauterbacher Straße, Gedern, Wetteraukreis, Hesse, Germany
description: The 24th Gedern City Run on August 15, 2026, offers runners of all ages a special running experience through Gedern’s historic old town. With distances of 500 m, 1,500 m, 5 km and 10 km, there is an option for children, teenagers, beginners and ambitious runners alike. The longer distances follow a varied loop course of four 2.5-kilometre laps, combining sporting challenge with history. The route follows historic paths such as the Eisenpfad, Basaltweg, Barbarossaweg and Fürstenweg, with a notable climb to Schlossberg and a section through the castle gardens. The start and finish are on Lauterbacher Straße near Kirchplatz. Changing facilities are available at Gedern gymnasium.
course_highlights: Gedern’s historic old town
Four 2.5 km laps on a varied loop course
Sections along the Eisenpfad, Basaltweg, Barbarossaweg and Fürstenweg, with a climb to Schlossberg
additional: Start and finish on Lauterbacher Straße near Kirchplatz. Changing facilities at Gedern gymnasium (Franseckystraße 32A). The longer distances consist of four 2.5 km laps. The route includes a paved castle courtyard and the castle gardens. The event is organized by the Top-Time timing team. Distances for children, teenagers and adults; start/finish on Lauterbacher Straße; changing facilities at Gedern gymnasium.

name: 100MeilenBerlin - Der Mauerweglauf
description: The 100MeilenBerlin – The Wall Trail Run is a historically significant ultramarathon that follows the route of the former Berlin Wall around western Berlin. The course of approximately 161 kilometers runs mostly on paved paths, but also includes trail-like and sometimes uneven sections. The start and finish are at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Sportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. The race commemorates the victims of the division of Germany and is held annually, with the running direction alternating.

name: 2. Backyard Ultra-Marathon Tharandter Wald
description: The 2nd Backyard Ultra Marathon in the Tharandt Forest is organized by SC Freital e.V. and takes place in one of Saxony’s most beautiful forest regions. The course is a 6.7 km loop, mostly on forest trails, run alternately clockwise and counterclockwise. The start and finish area is at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg. A total of 100 starting places are available, and registration is via RaceResult.

name: Kelheimer Volksfestlauf
description: The Kelheim Volksfest Run is a traditional running event held every August at the Am Pflegerspitz festival grounds in Kelheim. It offers different distances for various age groups, including 2 km for schoolchildren, 5 km for young people, and 10 km for adults. The event is a regular fixture in the city of Kelheim’s calendar and is organized by run & bike Kelheim e.V. Race packets are available from 12:00 on the day of the event in the beer tent, and the award ceremony takes place there after the races.

name: Städtedreieckslauf
description: The Städtedreieck Run is a long-standing race through the three towns of Burglengenfeld, Teublitz and Maxhütte-Haidhof. On 15 August 2026, the 16th edition of this event will bring together numerous runners for a good cause across five competition categories. The course is flat and follows field paths and public roads; traffic regulations must be observed. The race is a great opportunity to experience the region through sport and cross the finish line together.

name: Städtelauf Plauen - Hof
description: The Plauen–Hof City Run is a traditional race in the Saxon-Bavarian border region, celebrating its 35th edition in 2026. The route connects the Vogtland metropolis of Plauen with the Bavarian city of Hof and attracts runners and Nordic walkers from the region and beyond. The race is known for its sporting atmosphere and cross-border city partnership. Every year, numerous participants take part in ideal running weather and enjoy the scenic route.

name: Reuter Run Boršov nad Vltavou
description: Reuter Run in Boršov nad Vltavou is a 12.5 km running race taking place on 15 August 2026 from 11:00 at Kemp Poslední štace. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and offers runners the chance to test themselves on an interesting course in the South Bohemian Region. The organiser is Zdeněk Richtr, and the race is suitable for a wide range of runners, including registered Cup members and other runners. The course surface is not specified in detail, but the race is part of a long-standing series with clear rules.

name: Běžecký mítink Bohuňovice
description: The running meet in Bohuňovice near Olomouc is a cross-country race offering men a 12.2 km course and women a 6.1 km course. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners and attracts runners who enjoy more challenging terrain. The meet is suitable for anyone who wants to test their strength in a natural setting with varied terrain. The event is a traditional gathering for the region’s running community.

name: 7 pohoří Šumava
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races feature technical trails, epic views, and a unique atmosphere that will test every runner’s strength, willpower, and determination. Whether you’re an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains challenges you to conquer every course and become a legend. The Šumava race offers routes that pass over the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř, around glacial lakes and through deep forests, with up to 900 m of elevation gain.

name: Jablonská osmička
description: Jablonská osmička is a running race in Jablonné nad Orlicí, held on 15 August 2026. This fifth edition features an 8 km main race, children’s races, and a fun beer relay for teams of four. After the race, the programme continues with a Food Festival and Jabloffest, featuring music and activities for children at the swimming pool grounds. The race is suitable for both athletes and recreational runners, and includes a generous raffle and gift bags for registered participants.

name: Křivinský kros
description: Křivinský Cross is a running race held in Křivice, featuring a 7.5 km main course with 275 metres of elevation gain and an 800-metre children’s course. The race runs mostly along forest roads and trails through hilly terrain, making for a challenging and interesting run. Starts are staggered from 9:30 a.m.: children go first, followed by juniors and then the main categories. The race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix and is open to the general public, with a voluntary entry fee. After the race, the results are announced and a short raffle is held for participants.

name: Chminianskonovovesský beh
location: Chminianska Nová Ves, okr. Prešov, Chminianska Nová Ves, okr. Prešov, futbalové ihrisko OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves
organizer: ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný a obec Chminianska Nova Ves
description: The Chminianskonovovesský Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chminianska Nová Ves and ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný. The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football pitch in the Prešov District and offers categories for different age groups of men, women, and youth. It is a community sporting event that promotes an active lifestyle and enthusiasm for sport in the region.

name: Runica Nevoľné
location: Nevoľné, okr. Žiar nad Hronom, Nevoľné, okr. Žiar nad Hronom, futbalové ihrisko
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Runica Nevoľné is a running event held at the football field in Nevoľné, Žiar nad Hronom District. The race offers a unique experience in the heart of Slovakia, where runners can enjoy a welcoming atmosphere and well-organized event. The course is suitable for runners of various levels, and the event is part of the Marathon Tour running series. The organizers welcome all runners looking to enjoy a sporting event in a beautiful setting.

name: Štafetový beh 345 km od Tatier k Dunaju Jasná – Bratislava
location: Demänovská dolina, Demänovská dolina, Jasná, Demänovská dolina
description: The Relay Run from the Tatras to the Danube is the largest relay race in Slovakia, covering a distance of 345 km. Teams of 6 or 9 to 12 members start in Jasná in the Low Tatras and run nonstop through day and night, finishing on the Danube embankment in Bratislava. The course is mostly paved, with approximately 3,990 metres of total ascent and 4,870 metres of descent. Runners complete 36 legs of varying length and difficulty; in a 12-member team, each member runs three legs. The race is a test of team spirit and endurance in Slovakia’s beautiful surroundings.

name: VIII-asis Žolinių maratonas
description: The VIII Žolinių Marathon is a traditional running event held in Vingis Park in Vilnius, celebrating the Žolinės holiday in a healthy, fun, and meaningful way. Both professional athletes and beginners can take part, with a range of distances from a children’s run to a full marathon. Each participant receives a metal statuette symbolizing a Žolinės plant. The course is a 5.275 km loop, which runners complete according to their chosen distance. The event promotes community spirit and an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course is certified by LAF measurer Alfonsas Kazlauskas
The loop is 5.275 km long; the marathon consists of 8 laps
The start is opposite the Vingis Park bandstand
additional: Participants can choose from 6 distances: marathon (42.2 km), 31.6 km, half marathon (21.1 km), 10.6 km, 5.3 km (one lap), and a 600 m children’s run. Each participant receives a metal statuette whose design changes each year, representing different Žolinės plants. The event celebrates tradition and community, offering a range of distances and symbolic awards featuring herbal plants.

name: Marceliński Bieg Letni 2026
description: Marceliński Summer Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.

name: XXI Bieg Lesoków
description: The 21st Lesoków Run is an annual race held in Szemud as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event offers two routes, 5 and 10 km long, through the picturesque Kashubian countryside, encouraging participants to enjoy the outdoors. It attracts runners of different ages and experience levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See
location: Kurpark am Kanal, Bad Bederkesa, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See is a running event for participants of all ages and abilities, held on the third Sunday in August in Bad Bederkesa. The course passes through a natural setting and offers a motivating challenge for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event promotes community and the joy of being active, making it a special experience for both race participants and recreational runners. The start and finish are in Kurpark am Kanal, and timing is by transponder.
course_highlights: Scenic course around Beerster See
Start and finish in Kurpark am Kanal
Free drinks on the opposite side of the lake and at the finish
additional: Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune opposite the castle. Showers are available at the Moortherme upon presentation of your race number. Timing is by transponder, which must be returned after the race. The cut-off time for the main races is 1 hour 45 minutes. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Course distances: 7.6 km; hiking, walking and Nordic walking: 1.1 km, 0.5 km and 14.6 km. Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Timing is by transponder.

name: Breitunger Pleßlauf
location: Sporthalle am Riegelsweg, Breitungen/Werra, Thuringia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start- incl. Chip­ - Gebühren 6 Km Lauf: 9€

description: The Breitunger Pleßlauf takes place on 23 August 2026 in Breitungen/Werra and offers running distances from 1 km to 30 km, as well as 10.7 km Nordic walking. The event is organised by SV Lauftreff Breitungen e.V. and starts and finishes at the sports hall on Riegelsweg. The varied courses are suitable for both children and experienced runners. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event offers timing with a single-use chip, trophies and non-cash prizes for the fastest participants, and finisher medals for the main distances.
course_highlights: Running distances from 1 km to 30 km
10.7 km Nordic walking
Start and finish at the sports hall on Riegelsweg in Breitungen
additional: Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start, with a late-entry fee of €5 for the main distances and Nordic walking. Timing is provided using a single-use chip from GO timing. Race packs can be collected at the sports hall on 22.08.2026 from 12:00 to 15:30 and on race day from 07:00. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the sports hall. Trophies are awarded to the three fastest finishers in the main distances, along with non-cash and cash prizes for the winners. All finishers in the main distances receive a laser-engraved medal. Course profiles, mountain run, online registration, results, photos, videos, dates in 2024–2026

name: Ronneburger Stunden-Paarlauf des Laufprojekt Büdingen
description: The Ronneburg Hourly Team Relay, organized by Laufprojekt Büdingen e.V., is a unique running competition in which teams of two runners take turns completing laps on the 400 m synthetic track at the stadium in the Ronneburg Youth Center. The event takes place on 16 August 2026 and offers three competitions lasting 15, 30 and 60 minutes. The laps completed are added together and converted into a total distance, with the pair covering the greatest distance winning. The event is open to all gender combinations and promotes team spirit and endurance in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Run´n Roll for Help
description: Run’n Roll for Help is a long-standing city race in Giessen that has been inspiring runners for over 28 years. Every year, the city-centre streets are transformed into a sporting highlight, where the charitable cause is just as important as the competition. With over 1,200 participants in 2025 and more than €19,000 raised for Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe, the event is a major charity running festival in the region. The event offers a great atmosphere and warmly welcomes all running enthusiasts to take part in August 2026.

name: Wohldenberger Waldlauf
description: The 21st Wohldenberger Forest Run on August 16, 2026, offers runners of all ability levels varied courses through the Wohldenberg Forest. For more than two decades, this event has been one of the most popular in the Hildesheim region, attracting 200 to 300 participants each year. The route follows natural forest trails with changing surfaces and hilly sections, making it a true trail-running experience. There are suitable distances for beginners, families, walkers, and ambitious runners, from short children’s races to the challenging half marathon.

name: Wolfsburg Staffellauf powered by VfL Wob e.V.
description: The Wolfsburg Relay Race, organized by VfL Wolfsburg e.V., is a special team experience that brings together runners of all ages and backgrounds. On August 16, 2026, the second edition of this relay marathon will take place, giving teams from schools, clubs, and companies the chance to experience team spirit through sport. The course runs through the green city forest, with the start and finish at VW-Bad, where music will also create a lively atmosphere. Children’s relay teams are supported by Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V., making participation especially appealing.

name: Žebrácká pětadvacítka
description: The Žebrák 25 is a traditional August road race on roads and forest trails in the Křivoklát region, held annually in Žebrák. It offers several distances, including the main 25 km race, a 10 km run, a 10 km walk, and a family run for children. The main race starts at 10:00 by the elementary school in Žebrák, while the senior categories start at 9:00. The event is part of the celebrations of the St. Lawrence pilgrimage fair and offers a wonderful sporting experience in the picturesque Křivoklát region.

name: MFB MarathOn LABE
description: MarathOn LABE is a traditional international running festival held in Kolín and Poděbrady, offering a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, and other running events. The marathon course is an out-and-back route on forest, paved, and asphalt roads, certified by the Czech Athletics Federation (ČAS). The event is suitable for runners of all levels and features a rich program, including children’s races and family entertainment. It is organized by the Kolínská 14 association, which has supported an active and healthy lifestyle in the region since 2011.

name: Tyršův běh na Sokol
description: The Tyrš Run to Sokol is a traditional forest race in Malá Skála, offering a challenging 2 km course with 300 metres of elevation gain. The race is for nature-running enthusiasts who don’t mind hills and technical terrain full of roots, holes and rocks. Runners start at one-minute intervals, and the race has a long tradition; in 2021, it was held for the 36th time. Everyone interested in this type of race is warmly welcome.

name: Jazerný maratón
location: Košice - sídlisko Nad Jazerom, Košice - sídlisko Nad Jazerom, splav Jazero 0-tý km /Jenisejská ul./Košice
description: The Jazerný Marathon is a running challenge held in Košice, in the Nad Jazerom neighbourhood, offering distances from 5 to 42 km. The race follows a 2.5 km stretch along the Hornád River embankment, with a high-quality asphalt surface and minimal elevation gain, making it suitable for runners of varying levels. The event has a 15-year tradition and is ideal for those looking for a fast and enjoyable run in nature close to the city. The organisers welcome all runners who want to test themselves over different distances.

name: Žvahov - Ivův běh
description: Žvahov - Ivův běh is a 3.7 km trail race held in the Děvín area of Prague 5. The race is part of the SABZO series and gives runners the chance to enjoy running in a natural setting, with gentle hills and interesting views. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys short but more challenging trail courses. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test yourself against other runners amid the beautiful Děvín Hills.

name: ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival
description: The ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival is a traditional sporting event in Lipno nad Vltavou, offering a wide range of races for all ages and sports enthusiasts. The festival includes running races such as the Lipno Half Marathon, the 10 km COOP RUN and a family run, as well as cycling races, including 60 km and 20 km gravel and MTB routes. The event also features children’s races and evening runs along the scenic Čertovy proudy cycling path. Participants can enjoy the beautiful Šumava countryside and a varied programme of cultural activities.

name: Běh okolo Olympie
description: The Run Around Olympia is a running race in Brno, taking place on August 20, 2026, in the Chrlice area. The race features a 5.3 km loop, with men and women competing in a single category and starting together. A separate race is held for children, with the loop distance determined before the start. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere, refreshments, and on-site baggage storage.

name: Šárecká 5
description: Šárecká 5 is a 5.3 km cross-country race held in the picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. This varied race gives runners the chance to enjoy a run in one of Prague’s most beautiful areas, with more challenging terrain. It is organized by SABZO Praha under the direction of Michal Procházka and is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s running activities. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys trail running and natural scenery.

name: Bürener Volkslauf - Hochstift-Cup
description: The Bürener Volkslauf is a traditional running event in Büren, taking place on 21 August 2026. The races cover various distances, including Bambini, children’s, schoolchildren’s and corporate races, on paved routes with minimal elevation changes through the scenic Aftetal valley. All participants receive certificates, and the top runners are awarded trophies. The event is part of the Hochstift-Cup and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 5 km out-and-back course through the scenic Aftetal valley
Fully paved course with minimal elevation changes
800 m schoolchildren’s and children’s races on the 400 m track
additional: Certificates for all participants. Trophies for places 1–3 (men/women/diverse) in the overall standings. The City of Büren’s challenge trophy for first place in the team standings. Special prize for the largest team (corporate runners only). Certificates can be printed via the “race result” software after the event. Race numbers and transponders will be provided. Changing and shower facilities are available. Parking and travel information will be provided. The courses are challenging, with minimal elevation changes. The registration deadline is the day of the event. Registration is via MY RACERESULT.

name: Schleswiger Treppenlauf
description: The Schleswig Stair Run takes place for the 13th time in 2026 and features a new, attractive course starting and finishing at the Polierteich. Participants complete 10 laps with a total of approximately 940 steps, mostly on firm sand. The event offers both individual and duo competitions, with ample parking available at Stadtfeld. It is a sporting challenge in Schleswig, organised by the Spiridon Schleswig running club.
course_highlights: 10 laps with approximately 940 steps
Mostly firm sand underfoot
Start and finish at the Polierteich
additional: Start and finish at the Polierteich; ample parking at Stadtfeld; event runs from 18:30 to 21:00; individual and duo competitions available; mostly firm sand underfoot. Registration is open; parking at Stadtfeld; running time from 18:30 to 21:00.

name: 11. Lichterlauf Tangermünde
description: The Tangermünde Lights Run is an atmospheric race right by the Elbe in the historic imperial town of Tangermünde. On August 21, 2026, runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in races of various distances, including a children’s race, a 5 km fun run, a 10 km main race, and a team relay. The course runs along the picturesque Elbe promenade and offers a special atmosphere, followed by an after-run party in Tangermünde. The race is a community sporting event that puts fun, exercise, and team spirit first.

name: 19. Barßeler Hafenfestlauf
description: The 19th Barßeler Hafenfestlauf takes place on August 21, 2026, near Barßel Harbor. The event offers races for various age groups, including Bambini races, student races, a 5-kilometer race, Nordic walking, and a 10-kilometer main race. The course follows paved roads and is suitable for all age groups. The event is organized by Sport- und Turnverein Barßel and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with an accompanying program and refreshments.

name: Buntekuhlauf
description: The Buntekuhlauf in Lübeck-Buntekuh is a long-standing running event taking place for the 18th time on 21 August 2026. It offers various races for all ages and ability levels, from short runs on the sports field to longer routes on sidewalks. The races take place on traffic-free sidewalks and sports-field grounds, creating a safe and pleasant atmosphere for all participants. SC Buntekuh e.V. organizes the event with the aim of making exercise fun for everyone.

name: Volkslauf Um die Taakener Ähren
description: The “Um die Taakener Ähren” fun run is a popular, family-friendly running event in Taaken, taking place on August 21, 2026. The event offers various races for all age groups, from a toddlers’ run and races for schoolchildren and joggers to the competitive 10 km main race and a relay race. The course runs through Taaken and its idyllic fields of grain, with fun and community at its heart. All participants receive pastries at the finish, and the winners are awarded traditional winner’s loaves. The village provides food and drink stalls to create a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Mottenburger Meile
description: The Mottenburger Meile is a traditional cult race on the Elbe in Hamburg, held annually on the Friday after the Hamburg school holidays. The precisely measured out-and-back course is 7.5 km, equivalent to a Prussian land mile. The race starts and finishes on the banks of the Elbe below Halbmondweg/Elbchaussee and offers a romantic atmosphere with evening lighting. In addition to the sporting competition, the race supports the Hamburger Spendenparlament and remembers the Jewish victims of the Holocaust with a Stolperstein.

name: Běh městem Strakonice
organizer: Město Strakonice, Okresní sdružení Česká unie sportu Strakonice
description: The 23rd Strakonice City Run is a traditional running race held on August 21 at the Summer Cinema in Strakonice. Runners of all ages can test themselves on 3.3 km and 6.6 km courses through the city. Both distances start together at 18:00. All participants have a chance to win prizes in a large raffle drawn from race numbers. Entries can be submitted by email or on race day.

name: Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho
location: Trebišov, Trebišov, priestor pri Mestskom kultúrnom stredisku
description: The Count Július Andrássy Route Run takes place in Trebišov near the Municipal Cultural Centre and offers several categories, including running, a summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking and a virtual race. The start is scheduled for August 21, 2026, at 16:15 for children and 16:25 for the main category. The event is suitable for all ages, including children up to 7 and older children up to 13. The organizer, Ing. Michal Majcher, ensures a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality race organization.

name: XXXV-as tradicinis tarptautinis estafetinis bėgimas „Baltijos Kelias“
description: The 35th traditional international relay race “Baltic Way” will take place on August 21–24, 2027. The race symbolically retraces the 1989 Baltic Way, when millions of Lithuanians, Latvians, and Estonians joined hands in pursuit of freedom and independence. The approximately 650-kilometer route runs from Vilnius through Riga to Tallinn, with runners taking turns to cover stages of varying lengths. This is not only a sporting event, but also a living history lesson and a celebration of community, bringing together participants and supporters from the three Baltic countries.
course_highlights: An approximately 650 km route from Vilnius through Riga to Tallinn
A relay race through the three Baltic states
A symbolic reenactment of the historic human chain of the Baltic Way
additional: The race lasts four days, during which runners cover up to 200 kilometers each day. The event opens at Cathedral Square in Vilnius. Participants take turns in relay format, and the race is accompanied by meetings with people from towns and communities along the way. The event is part of the national physical activity program. It takes place over four days, with opportunities to meet and support the runners along the route, and commemorates the unity of the Baltic peoples.

name: IV Festiwal Pustelnika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz rozwoju Wysowej-Zdroju „Przekrocz Granice”
description: The 4th Pustelnik Festival is an annual sports and recreation event organized in the picturesque town of Wysowa-Zdrój by the Przekrocz Granice Association. The festival brings together sport, culture, and nature, offering participants the chance to take part in runs, marathons, and MTB and E-BIKE races. It’s a unique opportunity to discover the charms of the Low Beskids, spend time actively, and connect with the local community.

name: Maraton Wigry
description: The Wigry Marathon is a unique marathon held in Wigry National Park, around scenic Lake Wigry. The approximately 42.2 km course runs mainly along forest and unpaved trails, with a small amount of asphalt, offering runners pristine air and beautiful views of the Suwałki and Sejny regions. This is not a marathon for setting personal bests, but for those who want to enjoy its remarkable nature and atmosphere. The event takes place on August 22, 2026, starting at the Monastery in Wigry and finishing at the Municipal Square in Stary Folwark.

name: XI Bieg Obrońców Płocka 1920r
description: The International Run of the Defenders of Płock 1920 is an annual running event organized by the Płock Biega No Age Limit Club. The run commemorates the defenders of Płock in 1920 and attracts runners from various places. The event is international in character and takes place in the picturesque city of Płock, offering participants sporting competition and a chance to connect.

name: Detmolder Residenzlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt 11,00 Euro für Erwachsene und wird per Bankeinzug nach der Anmeldung gezahlt.

description: The Detmold Residenzlauf is a long-standing running event taking place on 15 August 2026 in Detmold. The event offers various races for children, young people and adults, including a Bambini run, school races, a 5 km fitness run and the 10 km main race. The start and finish are on the Market Square in Detmold, providing a central and lively setting. The event is supported by Stadtwerke Detmold and AÜG NETZWERK as title sponsors and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and a range of categories.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Market Square in Detmold
Various distances from 1.5 km to 10 km
Timing with the Raceresult timing system
additional: Race bib collection on the event day from 15:30 at the Rathaus am Markt in Detmold. Timing is provided by the Raceresult timing system; personal chips are not permitted. Free admission to the Aqualip leisure pool upon presentation of the race bib. Medals for all participating children and young people. Awards ceremony on the Market Square: school races from around 18:30, 10 km race from 20:00. Friedrich-Brakemeier Challenge Trophy for the school with the highest participation rate. Vouchers for schools, teams and groups with the most advance registrations. The race attracts numerous participants from the region and, alongside the main distances, also features children’s races and special competitions. Results and certificates are available online.

name: Exter FlexRun! 2026
location: Sparkassen Sportpark Exter, Vlotho, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Exter FlexRun on 22 August 2026 at Sparkassen Sportpark Exter offers a flexible running format for all ability levels. Participants can choose their distance and run up to four laps of 10.5 km each, covering up to the full marathon distance. There are also relay events, walking and Nordic walking courses, and a children’s run. The event takes place in a scenic setting and offers a great atmosphere, with refreshments and entertainment on site.
course_highlights: Loop courses on paved paths and mostly asphalt roads in and around Vlotho Exter
Refreshment stations at 4.0 km, 8.5 km, and in Sportpark Exter
Showers, changing rooms, and a wide range of refreshments at Sportpark Exter
additional: The start and finish for all events are at Sportpark Exter. Flexible distance choice, with up to 4 laps (10.5 km each). 4 x 10.5 km relay for teams. Walking/Nordic walking: 10.5 km and 21 km. Children’s run: 1.6 km, from age 6. Team and company rankings with awards. Courses are marked and staffed by marshals. Registration is via Race Result; the event offers showers, changing rooms, refreshments, and is family-friendly.

name: Heideköniginnenpokal
description: The Heideköniginnenpokal (HeiPo) in Amelinghausen is a traditional fun run, taking place for the 31st time in 2026 as part of the Heideblütenfest week. The challenging routes pass through scenic landscapes, including along Lopausee. The race attracts many participants and is a mainstay of regional running events.
course_highlights: Scenic stretches
Route along Lopausee
Part of the Heideblütenfest week in Amelinghausen
additional: The Amelinghausen running group meets regularly on Mondays and Wednesdays to run together. There is also a beginners’ course that gradually introduces participants to running. The event is part of a lively running-group community that takes part in many fun runs and marathons across Germany. The race takes place in August, with typical summer weather around 25°C and possible rain. There are also children’s races and other fun runs as part of the festival week.

name: Jahn-Gedenklauf
description: The Jahn Memorial Run in Lanz is a traditional running event organized by SV Jahn Lanz e.V. The event takes place at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium and offers various distances, which also count toward the Prignitz Cup. The start time is 10 a.m., and the run is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is supported by Kreissportbund Prignitz e.V. and is a fixture in the regional sports calendar.
course_highlights: Short course: 6.6 km
Long course: 12.5 km
Outside the Prignitz Cup: 3 km
additional: Courses are not suitable for spikes; on-site registration is possible; start at the stadium

name: Michelsmarktlauf
description: The Michelsmarktlauf is a traditional running event in Reichelsheim, held annually in August. The 30th edition of the Michelsmarktlauf takes place on 22 August 2026, featuring a 10 km main race, a 1.4 km school race and a 400 m Bambini race. The event is organised by the athletics department of KSV Reichelsheim and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
1.4 km school race
400 m Bambini race
additional: The event offers a variety of distances and is very popular with families, school groups and running enthusiasts from the region. Online registration is available.

name: Münsterland-Sternlauf - Benefizlauf
location: Universitätsklinikum Münster, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Münsterland Star Run is a charity run in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster e.V. at Münster University Hospital. Five routes lead in a star shape from various towns in the Münsterland region to the shared finish at Leonardo Campus in Münster. The run is designed as a stage event, allowing participants to set their own pace and run one or more stages. 100% of the proceeds are donated to Verein zur Förderung krebskranker Kinder Münster e.V. to support the treatment and care of the children affected.
course_highlights: Five routes lead in a star shape from various towns in the Münsterland region to Münster
Mostly farm tracks, footpaths and cycle paths, as well as traffic-calmed streets
Accompanied by stage leaders and a German Red Cross broom wagon; refreshments at stage points
additional: This is not a race, and participants set their own pace. They can run one or more stages, and can start and finish at any stage point. Participants are responsible for their own return transport. For the first time, donations can be made cashlessly. Donation receipts are issued for donations of €200 or more. The run is accompanied by stage leaders and a German Red Cross broom wagon. Refreshments are offered at stage points in cooperation with Kolping families. The run takes place in Münster and promotes social cohesion through sporting commitment.

name: 4. Rammelsberger Steigerlauf
description: The Rammelsberger Steigerlauf is a challenging mountain race in the northern Harz, held at the Rammelsberg UNESCO World Heritage Site in Goslar. The event offers a range of courses with gradients of up to 30%, winding through historic mining landscapes and varied forest and mountain sections. Participants can look forward to professional timing and a unique running experience with an alpine character. Courses range from a short race for children to a marathon and trail race with up to 1,110 meters of elevation gain. The event is aimed at runners, walkers, and trail runners looking to challenge their fitness and sure-footedness.

name: Osnabrücker 6-Stunden-Lauf
organizer: Norbert Dulle, Heinz Hagen, Maik Mittmann, Holger Schulze, Florian Siebelmann, Frank Wilke
description: The Osnabrück 6-Hour Run takes place on August 22, 2026, at Rubbenbruchsee in Osnabrück and celebrates its 10th edition. The run is a charity event supporting HelpAge’s “Every Grandma Counts” campaign and is open to all runners who want to cover as many kilometers as possible within six hours. Whether you’re an ambitious runner, training for a marathon, or simply looking to run, walk, or hike together in the beautiful landscape around the lake, everyone is welcome. The event offers individual and relay entries and emphasizes community and supporting a good cause.

name: Sieber Berg- und Panoramalauf
description: The Sieber Mountain and Panorama Run returns on August 22, 2026, after a 14-year break, offering three challenging routes in the Harz Mountains with up to 900 meters of elevation gain. The event is hands-on and welcoming, and challenges runners of all abilities. There’s something for everyone, from the family-friendly 4.5 km Nature Experience Route to the 12.5 km Panorama Loop and the 27.5 km queen stage with 900 meters of elevation gain. The routes pass through impressive natural scenery with panoramic views and offer a true Harz experience. Alongside the sporting challenge, there will be a pasta buffet and a community village festival to round off the day.

name: THE HUMBLE CLUB Backyard Run IV
description: The Humble Club Backyard Run IV on August 22, 2026, on Okerinsel in Braunschweig is a unique running experience that combines a sporting challenge with social commitment. The run supports the “Boxen gegen Parkinson” project and stands for exercise, community, and social responsibility. The event starts at 10:00 a.m., with admission from 8:30 a.m., and provides participants with basic refreshments of still water and fresh fruit, as well as an exclusive finisher’s medal. Participants are asked to bring their own refreshments so they can stay properly fueled.

name: Arnstädter Bach-Ultra
description: The Arnstädter Bach Ultra is a 60-kilometer ultramarathon taking place on August 22, 2026, in Arnstadt. It was created in response to runners’ desire to run the 60 km relay course as a standalone ultramarathon. The event is organized by SG Motor Arnstadt in cooperation with the Arnstadt city administration and offers a challenging course through the region. The race is an interesting initiative that will hopefully attract strong support and become part of Arnstadt’s diverse running tradition.

name: Barumer Stick and Stone Run
description: The Barumer Stick and Stone Run is a challenging obstacle race taking place on August 22, 2026, at the Barumer Forest Stadium and in the surrounding wooded, hilly landscape of the Lüneburg Heath. The course follows sandy, muddy, and partly overgrown trails, with water obstacles such as ditches and a village pond. The event offers runners a varied challenge in a natural setting and is suitable for both individual participants and groups. Participants receive a medal and refreshments at the finish area.

name: Jan Schüpp Bürgerlauf Wittmund
description: The Jan Schüpp Wittmund Citizens’ Run is a running event organized by MTV Wittmund. It starts at the stadium on Breslauer Straße in Wittmund. The route runs through the town center, past the market square and Schlossplatz, and offers a challenging and varied course. In addition to the main races, there are children’s and youth races, which are free to enter. The event is well organized with support from the police, fire department, and German Red Cross (DRK), and is popular with runners and spectators.

name: middenmang-Loop 2. Emder Vielfaltslauf
description: The middenmang-Loop is an inclusive diversity run in Emden, taking place for the third time on August 22, 2026. The run is open to all age groups and to people with and without disabilities, bringing everyone together to enjoy running. A variety of events and distances, from the Kinner-Loop for children to the 10-km middenmang-Loop for experienced runners, offer something for everyone. The run is part of the Ostfriesische Sieben race series and promotes community, physical activity, and inclusion.

name: Morava Run - proti proudu
description: Morava Run – Against the Current is a relay race that runs across Moravia along the River Morava. Teams consist of 7 to 12 members. The approximately 280 km route is divided into 30 sections of around 9 km, which teams allocate according to their abilities and strategy. The race starts in southern Moravia in the Soutok Protected Landscape Area and follows the river upstream through Slovácko, Haná and the Litovelské Pomoraví Protected Landscape Area to the source of the Morava on Králický Sněžník. The event is aimed at amateur runners and emphasizes teamwork and team building, with no pace limit.

name: Brdský půlmaraton
description: The Brdy Half Marathon is a traditional trail running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Kytín in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers two routes: a more challenging 21 km course with 430 m of elevation gain and a shorter 9 km course with 158 m of elevation gain. Both have refreshment stations. On the longer course, overall winners and age and gender categories are recognized, while the shorter course awards the fastest men and women overall. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series and is suitable for those who enjoy running in nature, with beautiful views and varied terrain.

name: Hrabovský 1/2 a 1/4 maraton
description: The Hrabová Half and Quarter Marathon is a traditional running race held in Ostrava-Hrabová, offering half-marathon and quarter-marathon courses. The race is part of the Hrabová Cup and the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup. Participants receive medals, and refreshments, changing rooms, and an accompanying program are available. The start and registration take place at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports field. The course runs through an urban setting with a pleasant atmosphere and is suitable for a wide range of runners.

name: Jesenický maraton
description: The Jeseníky Marathon is a legendary and challenging mountain marathon in the Czech Republic, held in the Jeseníky Mountains since 2009. The marathon and half-marathon follow the same course every year, but changeable weather and mountain terrain make it feel different each time. Runners traverse the ridge of forested mountains, passing springs, primeval forests, stone fields and peat bogs, creating a unique atmosphere and challenge. The Jeseníky Marathon is for experienced endurance runners looking to conquer the highest mountain range in Moravia and Silesia.

name: Běh na Svatý Hostýn
location: Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Svatý Hostýn is a mountain race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem in the Zlín Region. Part of the Czech Hill Running Cup, it offers a challenging 5 km race with 422 metres of elevation gain, with most of the course on paved roads. The race is open to both experienced runners and the general public, attracting running enthusiasts from across the country. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.

name: Běh k Božímu hrobu
description: The Run to the Holy Sepulchre is a traditional running event held at Svatý Hostýn in the Zlín Region. It is part of the broader range of pilgrimage activities and sporting events at the site. The event features an uphill run finishing at the Holy Sepulchre and is an important part of the regional sporting calendar. Get ready to experience the atmosphere of this pilgrimage site and enjoy a sporting challenge in the beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.

name: Běh na Čupek
description: The Run to Čupek is a newly established race in Metylovice that has already attracted two hundred runners. The course is scenic and challenging, providing participants with an interesting experience. The race is part of the calendar of Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, and its future place on the schedule is eagerly anticipated.

name: Vavřinecký běh Moravským krasem
description: The Vavřinec Run through the Moravian Karst is a sporting event held in the village of Vavřinec in the South Moravian Region and is part of the District Running League. The event takes place on August 22, 2026, and offers various running categories suitable for the general public. It is an ideal opportunity for running enthusiasts who want to discover the beauty of the Moravian Karst and enjoy an outdoor sporting experience.

name: Rusínska 100 a 66
description: Rusínska 100 and 66 is a late-summer ultrarun and long-distance walk starting and finishing in the town of Stropkov. The routes lead through the Ondava Highlands in Zemplín County and continue into Šariš County via the town of Svidník, crossing a region of Rusyn villages and following the border with Poland. The R100 route partly passes through the Eastern Carpathians Protected Landscape Area. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, is certified by ITRA, and is included in the ITRA National League. It is organized by o.z. Klub bežcov Stropkov, which provides a warm welcome and high-quality organization.

name: Hradný gaštanový beh Modrý Kameň
location: Modrý Kameň, Modrý Kameň, park pred vstupom do Hradu Modrý Kameň
organizer: Mesto Modrý Kameň v spolupráci s občianskym združením Bežci VK
description: The Modrý Kameň Castle Chestnut Run is a running event held in the park in front of the entrance to Modrý Kameň Castle. The race offers various categories, including a 5 km hobby race for children and juniors, a 10 km main race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking. The course runs along paved roads, meadows, and forest and field paths, offering a varied and enjoyable running experience. The event is organized by the Town of Modrý Kameň in cooperation with the Bežci VK civic association. The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 11:00.

name: Čachtický polmaratón
location: Čachtice okr. Nové Mesto n. Váhom, Čachtice okr. Nové Mesto n. Váhom, námestie
description: The Čachtice Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon race taking place on 22 August 2026 in the village of Čachtice. The course is mostly on asphalt, running through the streets of Čachtice to Višňové and Hrachovište, with a short section on a forest road. The route is gently rolling, with a maximum elevation gain of up to 90 metres. The start is in the square in Čachtice, and the finish is on the grounds of the Čachtice Elementary School. Refreshment stations are provided at several points along the course.

name: Forbaský beh pomoci
location: Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, areál Ščava
description: The Forbasy Charity Run is a charity race held at the Ščava grounds in Forbasy, in the Stará Ľubovňa district. The event has a voluntary entry fee and supports aid and solidarity. Runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere while contributing to a good cause. The organizer is Valer Kuffa, who is available to provide information and support to participants.

name: Lukačovská 5
location: Lukačovce, okr. Humenné, Lukačovce, okr. Humenné, Futbalové ihrisko
description: Lukačovská 5 is a running race held on the football pitch in Lukačovce, Humenné District. The event offers a 5 km main race and children’s races, with categories for men, women, and a non-competitive Nordic Walking category. The organizer is the Municipality of Lukačovce, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race begins at 11:00.

name: Harhovská desiatka
location: Spišský Hrhov, Spišský Hrhov, pred Obecným úradom
description: Harhovská desiatka is a running event in Spišský Hrhov, offering a 10 km course and a shorter 3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners. The races are divided into several age categories for men and women, including a special category for residents of Spišský Hrhov. The event is organized by the municipality of Spišský Hrhov, and the start is in front of the Municipal Office. The entry fee is paid at registration and is €10 for the 10 km course and €5 for the 3.5 km course.

name: Brezovský letný beh
location: Rimavské Brezovo, Rimavské Brezovo, Športové ihrisko
description: The Brezov Health Run is a traditional running race in the village of Brezov, Bardejov District. Its route runs along asphalt, field, and forest roads. The race is open to men and women, including participants aged 15 and under and those over 15. The organizers offer two entry categories, with a large or small package, making it possible to take part in this sporting event in pleasant surroundings near the Municipal Office in Brezov. The race is suitable for runners of various ages and ability levels.

name: Behaj lesmi Čičmany
description: Behaj lesmi Čičmany is a running race set in the picturesque Slovak folk village of Čičmany. The course winds through the Strážov Mountains, surrounded by beautiful scenery, unspoiled forests, and expansive meadows. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, giving it international recognition and ranking. Choose from several distances: a long 20 km run with 718 m of elevation gain, the intermediate 11 km Lesnícka course with 380 m of elevation gain, or a short 5 km course. The event also features a special Conti Speed Section, where the top runners can win valuable prizes.

name: Vilniaus bėgimo klubų taurė
location: Vingio parkas, Vilnius, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: The Vilnius Running Clubs Cup is a running competition held at the Vingis Park Athletics Stadium in Vilnius. The event is intended for running clubs from Vilnius and other Lithuanian cities, sports clubs, families, children, young people, adults, seniors, and people with disabilities. The main event is a 5×1000 m team relay with five participants. Individual 1000 m races and a children’s 60 m race are also held. The event promotes physical activity, community spirit, and a healthy lifestyle in Vilnius.
course_highlights: The competition takes place at the Vingis Park Athletics Stadium
The main event is a 5×1000 m team relay
Individual 1000 m races and a children’s 60 m race are also held
additional: Competition schedule: 12:00 children’s 60 m race; 13:00 women’s 1000 m race and women’s tricycle race; 13:15 men’s 1000 m race and men’s tricycle race. The women’s, mixed, and men’s team relay events have been cancelled. The organizers reserve the right to adjust start times. The event includes various running events, including races for children, adults, and people with disabilities, and will take place on 28 August 2027.

name: 7. PKO Tarnogórski Półmaraton oraz Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka
description: The 7th PKO Tarnogórski Half Marathon and Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka are the region’s biggest running celebration, taking place on 23 August 2026. The 21.0975 km half-marathon course runs entirely on paved streets in Tarnowskie Góry, with vehicle traffic partially closed. Refreshment and hydration stations are provided for participants, and the half-marathon time limit has been extended to 3 hours so everyone can cross the finish line with a smile and earn a medal. The Srebrna Dyszka is a run of approximately 10.5 km, complementing the event’s running programme.

name: IV BIEG PEŁNEJ MISKI
description: Bieg Pełnej Miski is a charity running event held in Szubin, aiming to support animal shelters through the “Pełna Miska” campaign. The race has been held annually since 2023, and the next edition is scheduled for August 23, 2026. The event combines sporting competition with the goal of helping homeless animals, engaging the local community and running enthusiasts. The organizers encourage people to take part and work together to support animals.

name: Biegi wokół Bursztynowej Góry
description: The Runs Around Bursztynowa Góra are an annual running event held in picturesque Bąkowo as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The races attract runners from various age categories, offering appealing routes and the unique atmosphere of Kashubia. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors amid beautiful nature and local culture. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: XVI Festiwal Biegowy Dziki Weekend
description: The 16th Dziki Weekend Running Festival is an annual sporting event held in Police, West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Organized since 2010 by the DZIK Running Club Association, the festival is one of the most recognizable races in the region. The event promotes an active lifestyle, cross-country running, and sporting competition for children and young people, while also showcasing the natural attractions of the Wkrzańska Forest. The start and finish of all races are at the sports clearing at 99 Piaskowa Street in Police.

name: FlorSTADT Halbmarathon 2026
description: The FlorSTADT Half Marathon is a popular race in Florstadt, Hesse, taking place for the 11th time on August 23, 2026. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers races over 10 km, 5 km, 1.8 km and 300 m, so the whole family can take part. The course runs through a beautiful forest and is secured, with plenty of aid stations and medical support. The race is part of the Main-Kinzig Challenge and is an excellent preparation for the Frankfurt Marathon. Food and drinks are available, and participants can download a personalized certificate.
course_highlights: Hesse’s most beautiful forest half marathon
Plenty of aid stations along the course
Secured course with medical support
additional: Commentary by Runningvoices, free photo downloads, organic fruit at the finish, warm-up with Smarttraining Ortenberg, playground right by the start/finish area, an event for the whole family, personalized certificate to download, refreshments provided by the Gadde-Crew. The event is part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge and offers electronic timing, medical support and a photo service. August weather is typically warm, around 25°C.

name: ews Volks- und Spendenlauf
description: The 14th ews Volks- und Spendenlauf runs through Bad Segeberg, past scenic spots such as Kalkberg and the Great Segeberger Lake. Since 2011, the race has been a regular part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining athletic achievement with the enjoyment of exercising together and charitable engagement. The event supports selected projects each year, with donations divided among three projects in 2026. It is a community event that brings together exercise and social commitment.
course_highlights: Through Bad Segeberg
Past Kalkberg
Along the Great Segeberger Lake
additional: Team entries are only possible using a paper form, which must be sent by email to info@volkslauf-bad-segeberg.de by 02 October 2023. Race number collection takes place at the registration desk on 23 August 2026. Registration is online and requires agreement to the liability waiver and data protection terms. The focus is on enjoying exercise and charitable engagement. The race runs through Bad Segeberg and includes walking and Nordic walking. Donations support local projects. Registration is open until June 2026. Team and individual starts are possible.

name: TuS Hiltrup Halbmarathon
location: Stadion am Osttor, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The TuS Hiltrup Half Marathon is an established running event in Münster, starting and finishing at the Osttor Stadium. The course includes a lap of the stadium, runs along the canal promenade and through the Hiltrup residential area, offering a varied and attractive running environment. In addition to the classic half marathon, there is also a relay race, which is especially appealing to teams. The event is open to runners born in 2008 or earlier (individual race) and 2010 or earlier (relay), and offers a family-friendly atmosphere at a large sports club.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Osttor Stadium
Run along the canal promenade with views of the canal
Course through the Hiltrup residential area, with varied terrain
additional: Individual entries for the half marathon are sold out; only relay places are still available. The course closes at 12:00, after 3 hours of racing. The course is accessible, and detailed information is available for local residents about the route and traffic regulations on race day. Measured course, start at Osttor Stadium, individual and relay races, online registration, start times at 9:00 and 9:05, course closes after 3 hours.

name: Rotherbaum 10K Hamburg - K Rotherbaum
description: The 10K Rotherbaum is an officially measured 10-kilometer race in Hamburg, held in accordance with international competition regulations. The course is a loop registered with the German Athletics Association and AIMS, making finish times eligible for rankings. The event is open to runners of all age groups and offers a cup competition across all 10K Hamburg races, with attractive prizes. Registration is online only, and participants are asked to travel by public transport.

name: Der Alstertallauf
