description: The Alstertallauf is a family-friendly race along the upper Alster hiking trail, considered Hamburg’s most beautiful running route. It welcomes running enthusiasts of all ages and recreational athletes, and offers several distances. The event takes place near the Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium in Hamburg and is known for its friendly atmosphere. In 2022, more than 200 runners took part, with distances ranging from 410 m to 10 km.

name: Gettorfer Staffelmarathon
description: The Gettorf Relay Marathon is a team marathon taking place on 23 August 2026 at Sportpark Gettorf. The course is a loop of approximately 4.2 km, run ten times. Teams consist of 5 to 10 people who pass the chipped relay baton in the exchange zone. Alternatively, two people can take part in the Duo Marathon and freely divide the ten laps between them. Timing is electronic, using transponders and shoe chips, and split times are recorded for each runner.

name: Bielebohlauf
description: The Bielebohlauf Oppach is a running event in the Lusatian Highlands, offering a range of distances from 400 m to 20 km. The routes follow forest, meadow, and field paths as well as small roads around the Bieleboh. The longer distances are challenging and include steep climbs. Special Bambini and children’s races are available. Refreshments and entertainment are provided at Oppach Stadium, and finishers receive certificates and online clips.

name: 1. Laufchallenge Mellendorfer TV
description: The 2026 Sparkassen Running Pass for the Hanover Region features 43 running events, making it the largest series of its kind in Germany. Participants can collect stamps at various events across the Hanover Region and discover the region as they run. Each successful participation earns a stamp, and frequent runners can qualify for attractive gold, silver or bronze rewards. Participants register directly for the individual runs, which take place at many beautiful locations and offer a variety of activities. There is also a Running Pass app with an event calendar and digital running log.

name: Die Generalprobe
description: The dress rehearsal is an urban road race in Berlin, serving as perfect preparation for the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON. On August 23, 2026, runners can test their form on a super-flat loop through the Berlin districts of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf and Zehlendorf. Events include a quarter marathon, a half marathon, and races for children and young people. The event features a lively atmosphere and a personalized medal for all finishers.

name: Slopenská desítka
description: Slopenská desítka is a traditional cross-country running race held in the picturesque village of Slopné near Luhačovice. The race offers a challenging course with varied terrain, including asphalt roads, steep climbs and descents through forest terrain. The start is located below the church and the finish is on the sports field, where a rousing crowd awaits the runners. The event is suitable for the general public, including junior categories and family relay teams. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín series and the KRAKONOŠ Czech Mountain Running Cup.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Stříbrná
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in different locations, including Stříbrná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and the adventure route covers 20 to 30 km. In addition to the main races, there are children’s races and walking routes with map-based checkpoints. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a beautiful natural setting in the Ore Mountains.

name: Běh pro Střížák
description: Běh pro Střížák is a traditional race held on Střížovický vrch in Ústí nad Labem, now in its 16th year. The course is a loop run three times, with one significant climb and descent; otherwise, it is gently undulating. The event also includes shorter children’s and youth races, making it accessible to the wider public. The race has an interesting story: the course passes through an area that was once threatened by a planned development, which was cancelled thanks to local residents’ opposition.

name: Minimaratón
location: Banská Bystrica, Banská Bystrica, Atletický štadión na Štiavničkách
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT OZ, Minimaratón OZ
description: The Mini Marathon is a unique running event exclusively for families with children, held at the Štiavničky athletics stadium in Banská Bystrica. The event offers different age categories, from the youngest runners to older children, including mothers with strollers. The course is adapted to each age group, with 400 m and 200 m circuits. Alongside the sporting experience, there is an accompanying program with activities for children and meetups with athletes. Every participant receives a commemorative race bib, a medal, and refreshments after finishing.

name: Beh na boso Tatry
location: Veľká Lomnica, Veľká Lomnica, Golfový rezort Black Stork
description: Beh na boso Tatry is a running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Black Stork Golf Resort in Veľká Lomnica. Participants can choose between non-competitive runs for children and adults and a competitive 5 km run. The course runs across mown grass, paths and pebbles, giving it a cross-country character. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere in the nature of the Tatras. The organizer, OZ Beh na boso Tatry, ensures the event runs smoothly.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Czerwonak Physical Culture Development Centre. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors, running or walking in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km distance confirmed for the 2026 edition
Evening event format in Bolechowo
Part of the Active Czerwonak at Night series
additional: The event is free and takes place in the evening, usually from 19:30 to 22:00. It is a recreational sporting event and part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees or required equipment. Previous editions took place in the evening; 82 participants took part in 2026.

name: B2Run Hamburg
description: The B2Run Hamburg on August 25, 2026, is a corporate run covering around 5.6 km and ending with a spectacular finish in the Volksparkstadion. The varied course is mostly flat, making it ideal for beginners, walkers, and experienced runners. The event promotes team spirit, motivation, and a sense of community, and is perfect for companies and individual entrants from Hamburg and the surrounding area. Alongside the sporting experience, the run offers a professional supporting program with commentary and music.

name: Běh Smetánkou
location: Smetánka Park, Prague 9, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh Smetánkou is a 3.5 km trail race held in Prague 9 and part of the SABZO series. The race gives runners the chance to enjoy a run in natural surroundings on varied terrain. It is suitable for anyone looking for a short but dynamic race in a pleasant atmosphere. The race is a longstanding part of Prague’s running season and attracts runners from the surrounding area.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (9) – srpnový
description: VAŠE LIGA’s 5 km and 10 km races are a regular running series in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The races are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to pros, and personal records are often set here. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant. The series is part of its 16th edition and rewards not only the top runners but also loyal participants.

name: Běh Modřanskou roklí - Memoriál Zdeňka Buriana
description: The Běh Modřanskou roklí – Zdeněk Burian Memorial is a 4 km race along a gently rolling course in the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series and features a staggered start, allowing the event to run smoothly. The course is suitable for runners who want to enjoy a run in nature with moderate elevation changes. It is ideal for anyone looking for a short but technically interesting race in beautiful surroundings.

name: Letni Ultra Świr
description: Letni Ultra Świr is a unique 24-hour ultramarathon held on a 15 km loop near Grybów. It is a challenge for runners who want to test the limits of their endurance and enjoy an atmosphere full of sweat, dust and fatigue, but also laughter and madness. The event attracts long-distance running enthusiasts, offering a one-of-a-kind experience and intense emotions.

name: 7. Ahnepark-Lauf der Laufgemeinschaft Vellmar
description: The 7th Ahnepark Run, organized by Laufgemeinschaft Vellmar, is a late-summer running event in Vellmar. This club race offers two distances, 200 meters and 17.3 kilometers, and is designed primarily as a community run. Registration and results are managed through my.raceresult.com. The race is listed in the laufen.de running calendar and features officially measured courses that are relevant for rankings.
course_highlights: Two distances: 200 m and 17.3 km
Event in Ahnepark in Vellmar
Officially measured courses for rankings
additional: Registration and results are handled through my.raceresult.com. The race takes place in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny days. It is a local club race without major branding or destination elements. Distances: 200 m, 17.3 km; registration and results through my.raceresult.com; listed in the laufen.de running calendar

name: Lemgoer Hanselauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmeldung am Veranstaltungstag ab 16 Uhr möglich

description: The Lemgo Hanselauf is a traditional running event held annually on the last or second-to-last Friday in August in Lemgo. The event offers 3.3 km, 6.6 km and 10 km courses along the city’s ramparts. Children and Bambinis can also take part over shorter distances, making the Hanselauf a family-friendly event. With around 1,000 participants, the Hanselauf is a sporting highlight in the region that brings together fun and community.
course_highlights: Course along Lemgo’s historic ramparts
Distances of 3.3 km, 6.6 km and 10 km
Children’s and Bambini runs over 1.5 km and 400 m
additional: Bib collection and late registration on the event day from 4 p.m. in the right-hand school wing of Engelbert-Kämpfer-Gymnasium. No timing or placings for the children’s and Bambini runs. Assemble at the start from 4:55 p.m. Participation is free. Run along the ramparts, children’s and Bambini runs, registration at Engelbert-Kämpfer-Gymnasium, late registration available on the event day.

name: Ibbenbürener Aaseelauf 2026
description: The Ibbenbüren Aasee Run is a long-standing running event taking place for the 41st time in 2026. The event offers races for children of kindergarten and primary-school age, as well as a 5 km fun run, a 5 km team run, and a 10 km main race for competitive and recreational runners. The course runs around Lake Aasee, with the start and finish at Stadion Ost in Ibbenbüren. The event is limited to 1,000 participants and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good on-course support.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stadion Ost, Ibbenbüren
Loop course around Lake Aasee, with three laps in the 10 km main race
Drinks stations along the course and in the finish area
additional: Late registration is available on event day from 15:00 until 1 hour before the start of each race for a fee of €2.50. Changes to entries are also possible on event day for a fee. €1 per registration is donated to a charitable organization. Free parking is available at Stadion Ost. Race bibs can be collected on event day from 15:00. Timing is recorded using transponders on the back of the race bib. Registration is online only, with a limited number of places. Late registration costs €2.50; charitable projects can be supported.

name: Straßenlauf Rund um den Holtenauer Leuchtturm
5. LSG-Waldauer-Wiesen-Lauf
description: The 5th LSG-Waldauer-Wiesen-Lauf is an evening running event held at the Waldauer Wiesen sports ground in Kassel. The event offers various distances for all age groups, from a 500 m Bambini run to an 18 km run. The shorter children’s races start first, followed by the longer races in the early evening. The routes are well marked and include sections around Bugasee and Wahlebach, with refreshment stations and childcare available on site.

name: Sparkassen-Tauchscher-Stadtlauf
description: The Sparkassen-Tauchscher City Run is a long-standing running event organized by the Leichtathletik Club Taucha e. V. in the town of Taucha on the Parthe River. The 21st edition of this city run takes place on August 28, 2026, and also includes the Saxon State Championships in the 10 km road race. The event offers runners of all age groups an attractive opportunity to compete in a lively atmosphere. Registration opens in February 2026.

name: Beskydská sedmička
description: IMOS Beskydská sedmička is an extreme mountain marathon across the entire Beskydy Mountains, running from Třinec to Frenštát pod Radhoštěm. This demanding race is approximately 101 km long with 5,500 m+ of elevation gain. It is the Czech Mountain Marathon Championship for individuals and is open to both solo runners and pairs. The race starts at night at 23:00 from the athletics stadium in Třinec, and the finish line closes after 28 hours on Sunday morning. The race offers a unique experience of the Beskydy mountain landscape and well-stocked aid stations along the course.

name: Naktinis bėgimas 2026
description: Night Run 2026 invites you to feel the rhythm of the night and immerse yourself in the end-of-summer buzz in Kaunas. It’s a unique opportunity to unwind from everyday life and end the summer with an energetic run featuring music, a sea of lights, and the company of enthusiastic runners. The event takes place in Town Hall Square and Santaka Park, offering spectacular views and an unforgettable nighttime adventure. Participants compete in the 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances, and the event is intended for both amateurs and professionals.
course_highlights: Course in Town Hall Square and Santaka Park
Night run with music and a sea of lights
Races over 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
additional: Participants must attach their bib with the timing chip to the front of their shirt. Registration details and race distance can be changed until 2026-08-23 for a €5 fee. A participant’s time may not be recorded if they do not complete the course within the set time limit. The use of vehicles on the course is strictly prohibited. The event will take place in Kaunas; the course features a night run with lights, music, and a lively atmosphere. Registration and further information are available on the official website.

name: Półmaraton Roztoczański im. Czesławy Kwoki , Nielisz - Zamość
UKIEL Susnet Run Olsztyn
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie
description: UKIEL Sunset Run Olsztyn 2026 is an evening road race taking place on August 29, 2026. Participants can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances, running through central Olsztyn with scenic views of the Old Town and CRS Ukiel Beach. The course is certified by PZLA, and the finish line is located on the beach, where a finisher zone with music and lighting awaits. It’s a great opportunity to combine sporting competition with the atmosphere of a city event.

name: 11 Bieg Kurierów Sądeckich
description: The Sądecki Couriers Run is a historic mountain race held in the Sądecki Beskids, on a route from Rytro to the PTTK mountain shelter on Przehyba. The course is marked and features varied surfaces: 15% asphalt, 5% gravel roads, and 80% forest trails, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and tackle challenging terrain. The race commemorates couriers from World War II, and the course record is just under an hour. The organizer provides timekeeping, medical support, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the race.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwice Park Running Provocation is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026. They take place once a month on Saturdays in the park behind Piast Stadium. The 4,219.5-metre route runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some sections on asphalt. A refreshment point is located at the start/finish line. The event aims to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation under the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!”

name: Kunicki Bieg Reggae
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Kunicach
description: Kunicki Reggae Run is a nationwide sporting event held on the picturesque Lake Kunickie in Kunice. Participants can choose from three certified running routes: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. The start and finish are in front of the GOKiS in Kunice at 11 Słoneczna Street. The event combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and reggae music, attracting a growing number of participants from across Poland.

name: Mały Wielki Bieg
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Pruszcz Gdański
description: Mały Wielki Bieg is the largest race in the Pruszcz Gdański municipality. After a one-year break, it returns to Straszyn. The organizer is the Pruszcz Gdański Municipality Sports and Recreation Center, which promotes sport and recreation among local residents. The event takes place on August 29, 2026, and is an important sporting event in the region.

name: NorDan RUN
description: NorDan RUN is a race held in the picturesque town of Wolsztyn, with routes following paths through the municipal park along Lake Wolsztyńskie. Participants can choose from several distances, from shorter races for children to challenging 48 km routes with checkpoint and refreshment stations. The start and finish are located at the “Fala Park” venue, offering convenient race arrangements and beautiful views. The race is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the surrounding nature.

name: Tatraman
description: Tatraman is a challenging half-Ironman-distance triathlon held in the scenic areas of Polish and Slovak Spiš and the Tatra Mountains. The course starts in Niedzica on Lake Czorsztyn, crosses mountainous terrain, and finishes at the summit of Kasprowy Wierch. The event is aimed mainly at experienced athletes, but amateurs can also test their skills on this extreme course. Tatraman combines sporting competition with beautiful views and highland hospitality.

name: VIII Dycha nad Wisłą
description: The 8th Dycha nad Wisłą is an annual road race held in Tczew and forms part of the 9th Kociewie Running Grand Prix. The race attracts runners from various regions and offers a scenic route along the Vistula. The event combines sport and recreation, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: X Jubileuszowy Charytatywny Cross
description: The 10th Anniversary Charity Cross-Country Run and Nordic Walking event in Iwonicz-Zdrój is an annual sporting event held at Dietl Square in Iwonicz-Zdrój. The event combines a cross-country run and a Nordic walking march, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in this beautiful spa town. This anniversary edition attracts participants of different age groups and ability levels. The organizers invite everyone to take part and emphasize the event’s charitable nature.

name: XVI Bałtycki Maraton Brzegiem Morza
description: The 16th Baltic Seaside Marathon is an annual running event held in the picturesque towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. Participants can choose between the marathon and half-marathon distances, both of which follow the coast, offering exceptional views and atmosphere. The event attracts runners from various age groups, including the K60+ and M65+ categories. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.

name: Piąteczka dla każdego
location: Nowy Dwór Mazowiecki, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XI Bieg Dożynkowy
location: Kobylarnia, Gmina Nowa Wieś Wielka, Poland

name: XVII Maraton Pieszo i Rowerem Dookoła Lubina
32. Zeitzer Stadtlauf
description: The Zeitz City Run takes place in Moritzburg Castle Park in Zeitz and is organized by SG Chemie Zeitz. The event begins at 9:15 a.m., with the main races starting at 10:00 a.m. The race office is located in front of the main stage in the city park, and changing and shower facilities are available at the Klinkerhallen on Albrechtstraße. The park entrance is on Stephanstraße. The run is a great opportunity to get active and enjoy the atmosphere in the castle park.
course_highlights: Run through the historic Moritzburg Castle Park in Zeitz
Main races start at 10:00 a.m.
Changing and shower facilities at the nearby Klinkerhallen
additional: The race office is located in front of the main stage in the city park. Changing and shower facilities are available at the Klinkerhallen, Albrechtstraße. The park entrance is on Stephanstraße. The run starts at 10:00 a.m., with changing and shower facilities at the Klinkerhallen. The park entrance is on Stephanstraße. August weather is usually sunny, ideal for an outdoor run.

name: 37. Heideblütenlauf
description: The 37th Heideblütenlauf takes place on Saturday, August 29, 2026, in Schneverdingen. This traditional running event is held as part of the Heideblütenfest. Organized by TV Jahn Schneverdingen, it offers runners of all ages the chance to experience the beautiful heathland. The course passes through the picturesque surroundings, with numerous volunteers and supporters helping ensure that everything runs smoothly. Participants can look forward to a friendly, well-organized event.
course_highlights: Running routes through the heathland around Schneverdingen
Start in front of the town hall on Schulstraße
Event held as part of the Heideblütenfest
additional: The event is supported by numerous local partners and volunteers, including the City of Schneverdingen, the German Red Cross, Johanniter, the Volunteer Fire Brigade, and the Heide Queen. Certificates can be printed for all participants, including Bambini children. Registration is handled by TV Jahn Schneverdingen; further details are available on the website. Online registration opens on 01.04.2026. Start and finish are on Schulstraße in front of the town hall. Results and certificates are available online.

name: 39. Jever-Fun-Lauf
price_range: 4,00 € bis 36,00 € je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The 39th Jever-Fun-Lauf on 29 August 2026 is a traditional running event in Jever that brings together people of all ages and ability levels. The route passes through the town centre and by well-known landmarks, with cheering spectators lining the course. The focus is on the enjoyment of exercise and community, not competition. There are various races for children, young people and adults, including walking, company and team categories, as well as a main race over 10 English miles.
course_highlights: A 2.864 km loop through Jever town centre
The route passes by well-known landmarks
Cheering spectators line the course
additional: The official technical T-shirt can be ordered until 07 June 2026 for 20.00 euros, and thereafter for 25.00 euros (while stocks last). Merchandise such as sports socks, caps and multifunctional scarves is also available and can be collected in Jever on Wednesdays. Late registrations are possible on the event day until one hour before the respective start. The time limit for the main race (10 English miles) is 150 minutes. Several race categories, registration deadlines, start times and further event details are available on the official website. The event takes place on 29 August 2026.

name: Edersee-Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1.2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Edersee Run is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup and takes place on August 29, 2026, in Vöhl-Herzhausen on Lake Eder. The run is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, a club that promotes sport and community for all age groups. The event is very popular and offers runners an appealing opportunity to get active and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Eder. Pre-registration opens soon, and the club extends its heartfelt thanks to its supporters and sponsors.
course_highlights: A variety of running distances for all age groups
Flat, fast courses on Lake Eder
Family and children's races included
additional: The run is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup. The event is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, which also offers other sports activities and training groups. Race bibs are supported by sponsors. Pre-registration for 2026 opens soon. Various running distances, family-friendly, event held as part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup, start and finish at the Herzhausen barbecue hut.

name: Mindener Volkslauf
description: The Mindener Volkslauf is SV 1860 Minden’s largest running event, with more than 1,000 participants every year. The 50th anniversary run takes place on 29 August 2026, featuring many new highlights along the course and in the stadium. At the same time, the club is celebrating the 10th anniversary of the merger that formed SV Minden, with numerous activities. The event offers a great atmosphere and an after-run party following the company run, inviting everyone to join in the celebrations.
course_highlights: A course featuring new highlights and varied sections
Start and finish in the stadium, with a special atmosphere
After-run party following the company run
additional: The 50th Mindener Volkslauf features an after-run party following the company run. Registration is expected to open in May 2026. In 2025, 1,467 participants crossed the finish line. The event also celebrates the 10th anniversary of the merger that formed SV Minden, with many individual activities through the end of the year. The event takes place in August, with registration opening in May 2026. It is the club’s largest event, with a special focus on community and anniversary celebrations.

name: 8. Stolberger Schloss-Lauf
description: The Stolberg Castle Run 2026 is a charity run in the southern Harz region, starting and finishing right at historic Stolberg Castle. The event offers a range of races for runners of all abilities, including a half marathon, relay, 10 km, 5 km, walking, and fun runs for all ages and children. The varied routes pass through the historic old town, along forest trails and over the heights of the southern Harz, combining a sporting challenge with scenic and cultural highlights. By taking part, every runner supports regional projects in and around Stolberg, giving the event a special charitable purpose.

name: SUNSET Wattenmeer
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is an extraordinary relay race covering approximately 250 kilometers, from Hamburg-St. Pauli to St. Peter-Ording. The route passes through the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea National Park and offers breathtaking natural scenery, idyllic towns, and marshland with a sea breeze. The event lasts more than 24 hours and challenges teams of 5 or 10 runners to complete it together. Start times are assigned based on the reported average pace, and digital map materials are provided before the race.

name: Birklauf
description: The MTV Gelting 08 Birk Run is a traditional running event taking place on August 29, 2026, from 3:45 p.m. at Birkhalle Gelting. The event celebrates sport, fun and nature, giving runners of various age groups the opportunity to compete. Times are recorded on all courses except the 750-meter Sprottenlauf, and all finishers receive a medal. Results are categorized by age group, and prizes are awarded to the top three runners.

name: Elstertal-Lauf
description: The Elstertal Run, organized by 1. SV Gera, is a traditional running event offering various distances for runners of all ages. On August 29, 2026, individual races over 10 km and 15 km will take place, along with relay races for companies and school students. There will also be children’s races and a challenging stair race with around 1,300 steps. The event is part of the Thuringian and Gera Running Cup series and offers a varied course through the region.

name: Karlis Härtetest
description: Karlis Härtetest is a long-running race organized by Läuferteam Pretzsch. The race takes place every year in autumn near Leipzig and features a challenging cross-country course that tests runners of all ages. The club SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V. has a long history in running and promotes community and sporting ambition through this event. The race is known for its special atmosphere and the opportunity to prove yourself on a varied course.

name: Lauf rund um Tiefwarensee
description: The 20th Run around Lake Tiefwarensee in Waren (Müritz) is a traditional running event taking place on 29 August 2026. Organised by Müritzer LSV, the course circles picturesque Lake Tiefwarensee and offers runners an attractive and varied setting. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.

name: Salzbergener Raffinerielauf
description: The Salzbergen Refinery Run is a popular road race in the beautiful town of Salzbergen, taking place on August 29, 2026. Various distances are offered for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a school mile, a 5 km fun run, and a 10 km main race. The event is part of the EL-CUP and, alongside exciting races, offers a varied program for runners and spectators. The races start at Salzbergen Secondary School and promote both individual and team competition.

name: Umpfertallauf
description: The 13th Umpfertal Run offers a range of race distances, including the 10 km main race, a 10 km relay, a 5 km fun run, and races for schoolchildren and young children. The flat out-and-back course, with around 33 metres of elevation gain, is ideal for less experienced runners. The event starts early on Saturday evening, with the start and finish at the market square, and follows the cycle path to Schweigern. The awards ceremony takes place in the festival tent, rounding off the sporting event.

name: 4. S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz"
description: The 4th S-RUN Sparkassenlauf “Rund um das Dünkreuz” is a nature-focused community race in Eichsfeld, welcoming runners of all ages and fitness levels. The varied routes wind through breathtaking natural scenery around the Dünkreuz and offer exciting challenges for experienced runners and beginners alike. Alongside the competition, the event puts community spirit at the forefront, supported by an attractive program at the sports field. The race is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and is organized by SG Birkungen 07.

name: Kácovský běh
description: The Kácov Run is a traditional running race held on the last Saturday in August in the picturesque Posázaví region. It offers three main routes—the Nineteen, the Ten, and the Loop—with varied terrain and elevation that will challenge both experienced runners and beginners. The start and finish are in the center of Kácov, with aid stations on the longer courses. The race is timed using chip timing and accompanied by a varied program, including children’s races and a raffle.

name: Cross Parkmaraton
description: Cross Parkmaraton in Krásná Lípa is a traditional running race in the picturesque setting of Bohemian Switzerland National Park. It offers a range of events, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, Nordic walking, relays and canicross. The course crosses hilly terrain, mainly along forest paths, with beautiful views of the Lusatian Mountains. The race is suitable for the general public and welcomes runners of all ages, as well as families with children.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain, mainly along forest paths
Picturesque scenery in Bohemian Switzerland National Park
Views of the Lusatian Mountains
additional: The Canicross and 42 km Marathon start at 8:00; the other events (5 km, 10 km Nordic Walking, 10 km, 21 km and relays) start at 10:00. Relays are for teams of four, with each runner covering approximately 5 km on the half-marathon course. Categories are awarded by age and gender. Runners who do not meet the marathon cutoff may switch to the half marathon. Results are announced in stages from 10:05 to 14:00. The organizer provides changing rooms and showers. Canicross starts in C. Dittrich City Park; the other events start at Křinické Square. The official website also lists 10 km Nordic walking, relays, canicross and children's races.

name: Chomutovský půlmaraton
description: The Chomutov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Chomutov in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a fast and scenic course through the town’s historic center, past the unique Kamencové Lake and beautiful natural areas such as Bezruč Valley. The event also includes children’s races and relay races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. Participants in the main race can look forward to refreshments along the course and at the finish, as well as a finisher’s medal.

name: Běhej lesy Jizerská
description: Běhej lesy Jizerská is a trail race held on August 29, 2026, in the picturesque Jizera Mountains in Bedřichov. It offers various routes, including short and long distances and an ultramarathon, passing through beautiful natural locations such as Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka, and Olivetská hora. The race is part of the Běhej lesy series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, offering international ranking points. Runners can also take part in the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add extra competitive elements and prizes.

name: Proběhni si Zoo Ústí nad Labem
description: Run through Ústí nad Labem Zoo is a running event held on the grounds of the zoological garden in Ústí nad Labem. The run offers a unique opportunity to combine sporting activity with a visit to the zoo and admire the animals in their natural surroundings. The event is suitable for all age groups and encourages active leisure time in nature. We look forward to your participation and sharing an experience in the beautiful setting of the zoo.

location: Pamätník SNP u Rehušov, Prietrž, Senica District, Trnava Region, Slovakia

description: The Northern Lithuania Half Marathon 2026 will take place in Pakruojis District, in the northern part of Lithuania. The event aims to promote running culture and encourage residents to be active, offering scenic routes in popular tourist areas. The race will start and finish in Pakruojis City Park, where participants can enjoy not only the sport but also discover the nature and culture of northern Lithuania. The event brings together people of different ages and social groups to spend time actively and healthily.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in popular tourist areas
Start and finish in Pakruojis City Park
Discover northern Lithuania while running
additional: Bib collection is open from 8:00 to 10:00. The half marathon starts at 11:00, and the other distances start at 10:00. Registration will not be available on race day. Participants agree that photographs and video footage taken during the event may be used for marketing purposes. The event includes different distances and categories, and online registration is open until the end of August. The event date is September 4, 2027.

name: TEMPLE Kauno pusmaratonis `26
organizer: TK Temple Kauno pusmaratonis TS Temple social club
description: TEMPLE Kaunas Half Marathon '26 is the hottest summer running celebration in Kaunas, taking place on August 29. The event offers four distances: a half marathon (21.089 km), 10 km, 5 km, and a 400 m children's race. It is not just a competition, but a complete experience full of excitement, adrenaline, and community spirit, welcoming both those aiming for personal bests and those looking to enjoy the atmosphere of a running celebration. The event fills the city with participants' smiles and invites you to become part of its story.

name: 11 Bieg po Oddech
description: The 11th Bieg po Oddech is a charity 5 km run through the streets of Zakopane, taking place on August 30, 2026. The event supports people with cystic fibrosis, and every participant receives a T-shirt and a medal. After the race, a family picnic with games and competitions is held. The run promotes physical activity as part of rehabilitation and support for people with the condition, as well as social integration.

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: The Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY are challenging cross-country races held in scenic Przewodziszowice near Żarki, in the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The courses run across Jurassic hills, limestone outcrops, dense forests, winding trails, rocky climbs, and open spaces with panoramic views of the Jurassic Landscape Park. The event offers a variety of distances, from short races for beginners and Nordic walkers to the demanding Trentaraton for experienced runners. It’s a great opportunity to compete and enjoy the beauty of nature.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon is an annual running event taking place on August 30, 2026, in Szczecin. Participants can choose between the half-marathon distance (21.0975 km) and a 10 km race, both following a single loop through the city streets. The start and finish are located at Jan Paweł II Jasne Błonia Square. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and marked every kilometre, with times recorded electronically using chips in the race bibs. The organizers offer wave starts and high-quality Ventus technical shirts in the extended race packages.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held on the shores of historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim, a fast and flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań, and a run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds—a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Maratony Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are open to both beginners and experienced runners, and aim to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. They are non-commercial and small-scale, with a limited number of participants to ensure safety and high-quality organization.

name: Półmaraton Buski
organizer: Buski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Busku-Zdroju
description: The Busko Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Busko-Zdrój. In 2026, it will take place on August 30. The race starts at the Municipal Stadium at 8:30 a.m. The half-marathon course passes prominent hotels and sanatoriums, the picturesque Spa Park, and charming pedestrian streets, giving the race a distinctive atmosphere. The time limit for completing the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The race is open to both experienced runners and amateurs.

name: VII Maraton od Zmierzchu do Świtu
Burgwald Märchen Marathon
description: The Burgwald Märchen Marathon in Rauschenberg is a varied running event with distances for an ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, 3/4 marathon, fun runs and a costume run. The event offers a well-organized course with refreshments, timing and medals for all finishers. Bib pickup takes place the day before, and the races start from 8:00 a.m. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy the race in a fairytale setting.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 5 km to an ultramarathon (52 km)
Start and finish close to the sports hall and outdoor swimming pool in Rauschenberg
Cutoff time for all races is 16:00
additional: A maximum of 1111 entries are available across all races. Bib pickup is on 29.08.2026 from 17:00 to 19:00 at the Rauschenberg sports hall. Late registration is available on 29.08. from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 30.08. until one hour before the respective start, subject to late entry fees (€3 for the ultra, marathon and half marathon; €2 for other races). All finishers who reach the finish by 16:00 receive a medal. Certificates can be printed online or collected in the finish area. The start and finish are close to the sports hall and outdoor swimming pool in Rauschenberg. The course runs mostly through the forest, partly on paved paths; refreshments are available every 5±2 km; dogs are allowed.

name: Mühlhäuser Altstadtlauf
organizer: Stadtverwaltung Mühlhausen, Kreissportbund Mühlhausen, SV 1899 Mühlhausen e. V.
description: The Mühlhausen Old Town Run is a traditional race through the historic old town of Mühlhausen, held annually since 1997. With three distances of 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km, it offers a sporting alternative to the Mühlhausen Kirmes and brings runners from the region together. The traditional start and finish are at Untermarkt in Mühlhausen. The event is organized in cooperation with the athletics club SV 1899 Mühlhausen e.V. and attracts around 800 to 1,100 participants each year.

name: 22. Eilenriederennen Hannover
description: The Eilenriederennen Hannover is an established summer running event through the green heart of Lower Saxony’s state capital. The public race offers three different distances: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course is officially measured, mostly paved and almost completely flat, making fast times possible. The event has a pleasant atmosphere, with a musical programme in the beer garden, and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass-Serie der Region Hannover.

name: 23. Windmühlenberglauf
description: The 23rd Windmühlenberglauf takes place on August 30, 2026, in Fallersleben (Wolfsburg), at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg. The event is hosted by VfB Fallersleben and offers runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a traditional race. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Windmühlenberg and promises a varied running experience. Registration is open until August 25, 2026.

name: 30. Lauf um den Arendsee
description: The 30th Run around Lake Arendsee (LUDA) takes place on August 30, 2026, at Arendsee Beach. This anniversary edition offers runners from the region and beyond a scenic natural setting. In addition to the race, there will be a small party on the evening before to celebrate sport and community together. Organized by Kersten Friedrich Events, the event promises professional delivery with strong regional ties.

name: 45. Königseer Stadtwaldlauf
description: The Königsee City Forest Run is a traditional running event in Oberhain near Königsee, held annually. The event offers runners of various ability levels an attractive course through the city forest, with varied terrain. Its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings make the run a special experience for participants and spectators.

name: 6-Stunden-Sparkassenlauf
description: The 6-hour Sparkassen Run in Fleestedt takes place on August 30, 2026, on a 1,200-meter loop at the Seevetal Sports Center. The course runs mostly over paved surfaces and partly over grass, and is easy to see from the start/finish area, keeping spectators on the edge of their seats. In addition to the individual competition, there are team and relay events, with a separate classification for the marathon (42.2 km). The race is open to runners born in 2008 or earlier; for the first time, the relay is also open to young people born in 2014 or earlier. Younger participants can take part in a 5,000-meter run and earn the DLV running badge.

name: Blankeneser Heldenlauf
description: The Blankeneser Heldenlauf on August 30, 2026, offers five varied routes with different distances and profiles, appealing to both beginners and experienced runners. The races pass through the picturesque Blankenese Treppenviertel, along the Elbe, and through varied parks and residential areas. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and unique combination of urban and nature-filled running. At the finish, participants can look forward to a finisher’s medal and a lively awards ceremony.

name: Grafschaftslauf
description: The Grafschaft Run connects the historic towns of Rietberg, Verl and Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock, offering runners a varied route rich in history and atmosphere. The race starts at Gut Rietberg, passes historic buildings and runs through the town centre, then follows the Ems to the garden show grounds. The route continues through atmospheric locations, with several relay handover points, and finishes in the Holter Wald at Jagdschloss zur Holte, which provides an impressive backdrop for the finish. The race features varied rural paths, enthusiastic spectators and a special connection between sport and regional history.

name: Altra Sunset Wattenmeer
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is a unique team relay race taking place on August 29 and 30, 2026. The route covers around 250 kilometres through the impressive natural landscapes along the Elbe and the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea National Park. The race starts in Hamburg on St. Pauli Hafenstraße and finishes in Bad, a district of St. Peter-Ording. Teams consist of 5 or 10 runners, each covering several sections of the route, making the race a special shared experience.

name: CrossFunRun
description: The CrossFunRun on 30 August 2026 in Ahrensburg offers varied courses for all age groups and ability levels. The races take place in Wulfsdorfer Park, with the start and finish at Heidkoppelhof. The event is family-friendly, with special Kids Cross-Run courses and relay competitions. All participants receive medals, certificates and prizes. The event is organised by WEcycle e.V., which ensures a great atmosphere and exciting cross-country running experiences.

name: Stundenlauf des TuS Fleestedt
description: The 6-hour SPARKASSENLAUF in Fleestedt takes place on August 30, 2026, on a 1,200-meter loop at the Seevetal Sports Center. The course is mostly paved, with some grassy sections, and is clearly visible from the start/finish area, adding excitement for spectators. Alongside the individual race, there are team and relay events, with a separate classification for the marathon distance (42.2 km). The race is open to participants born in 2008 or earlier, with special events for young people and children.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The 40th Volkswandertag organized by TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. is a traditional hiking event in Tiftlingerode, taking place on August 30, 2026. The event is for hiking enthusiasts and offers a great opportunity to enjoy nature and the surrounding area. It is a sociable and active event suitable for all age groups. Organized by TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V., it is part of the German Athletics Association’s competition calendar.

name: Öko-Run
description: The Öko-Run in Wächtersbach is part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge and takes place on August 30, 2026. The course is fully paved and traffic-free, running along meadows and fields beside the Kinzig. Races are offered over 5 km and 10 km, as well as a 1,000 m students’ race in various age groups. Every finisher receives a race shirt, and the event is part of a race series featuring scored races and attractive prizes in kind.

name: Běh teplickými skalami
description: The Run through the Teplice Rocks is a public trail race held every year on the last Sunday in August in Teplice nad Metují. The race dates back to 1994 and is part of the sports program of the International Mountaineering Film Festival. The 9 km course follows the Metuje River to the rock city, includes sandy sections and stairs, and returns along the same route. Since 2011, the event has also included a children’s race with age categories. The start and finish are at the TJ Slavoj football field.

name: Běh zámeckou zahradou
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The Castle Garden Run is a traditional running race held in the castle park in Lysá nad Labem. The 62nd edition takes place on 30 August 2025 and is open to a wide range of participants, from preschoolers to seniors. The race offers a pleasant setting in a historic park and encourages sporting activity for all age groups. It is organised by T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem, which has long supported sport for everyone.

name: Běh Bezděkovem
description: Běh Bezděkovem is a traditional cross-country race covering approximately 9 km, held in the picturesque surroundings of Bezděkov pod Třemšínem. The course runs mainly along forest paths through hilly terrain with moderate elevation changes and includes a mix of paved and stony sections. The race starts at the hunting lodge and features a challenging climb with gradients of up to 7% that will test runners’ fitness. After this demanding section comes a final descent and a flat finish, giving runners a chance to show their speed. The event also includes children’s races, making it appealing to a wide audience.

name: Kolínská desítka
description: Kolínská desítka is a 10 km out-and-back race on paved roads and a well-maintained forest path around the Mirka Tučka sports stadium in Kolín. The race is part of the Kolín Grand Prix and offers runners a pleasant mix of paved surfaces and natural surroundings. It is suitable for all runners looking for a fast yet scenic run in nature. Come enjoy the race atmosphere and test yourself against other runners in the beautiful surroundings of Kolín.

name: Rakovnická 15
description: Rakovnická Patnáctka is a 15 km road race whose start alternates each year between the towns of Rakovník and Křivoklát. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and offers runners the chance to test themselves on an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for all runners looking for a quality road race with a tradition and the atmosphere of a regional running cup.

name: Sázava - Lázek
description: Sázava-Lázek is an uphill race covering 7.9 km with an elevation gain of 375 metres. The course starts on asphalt and continues along field and forest paths, with the steepest climb near the finish. This race offers challenging and varied terrain for runners seeking a challenge in the natural surroundings of the Pardubice Region.

name: Běh okolo Hříšné Milady
description: The Run Around Hříšná Milada is a cross-country race near Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region, offering two distances of 12 km and 6 km. The route runs mainly along forest roads and hiking trails that are open to regular traffic. The race is part of the District Running League and is suitable for trail running enthusiasts looking for natural terrain with technical challenges. The main category traditionally starts at 11:45, making it easy for a wide range of runners to take part.

name: Všenory - Jíloviště
location: Všenory, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

name: Draždiak Run
location: Bratislava - Petržalka, Bratislava - Petržalka, Veľký Draždiak (Pláž pri bufete Barracuda).
description: Draždiak Run is a running event held in Bratislava, in the Veľký Draždiak area of Petržalka. Runners can expect courses along gravel and hiking trails, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The event includes children’s races, 5 km races for adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. It is organized by Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Beh pod Sninským kameňom
location: Snina, Snina, Rekreačná oblasť Sninske rybníky - OMW Snina
description: The Run beneath Sninský kameň is a running event in the Sninské rybníky recreational area in Snina, offering races for children and adults. The courses are on asphalt and dirt roads, while the children’s categories cover distances from 50 to 600 metres depending on age. The main category starts at 16:30 and is divided into men’s and women’s age groups. The event is organised by BehajmeSpolu o.z. in cooperation with the city of Snina. The entry fee is €15 for online registration and €20 on the day.

name: Alytaus Pusmaratonis – 2026
description: Alytus Half Marathon 2026 invites all running enthusiasts to a special summer finish in Alytus. The event starts and finishes in Alytus Town Hall Square, and the course passes through the city’s most beautiful spots—lush green parks, charming streets, and the banks of the Nemunas. Participants will experience a sense of community, movement, and excitement, with a festive atmosphere and support awaiting them at the finish. It’s a great opportunity to discover Alytus and take home unforgettable memories, whether you’re aiming for your best result or simply spending a meaningful day.
course_highlights: The course passes through lush green parks
Charming city streets
Inspiring banks of the Nemunas
additional: Various race distances, registration required, medals for all participants, awards for top finishers

name: Běh Anny-Marie
description: The Anna-Marie Run is a race held in Prague 4, offering a 6.6 km course over mixed terrain through Milíčovský Forest and over an artificial hill. The event is organized by the SABZO Praha association and is part of its running series, attracting runners of all levels. The course includes both forest paths and paved sections, making the race appealing to different types of runners. The race takes place on September 2, 2026, and offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere in Prague.

name: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie is a cross-country race held in Koszalin on September 3, 2026. The course runs in the opposite direction from usual, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies awarded to the top finishers in various categories. The race is the season finale of the Leśne Piątki series and part of the Tour Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, encouraging people to stay active throughout the year.

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Kėdainių miesto gimtadieniui, „NAKTINIAI KĖDAINIAI 654”
Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3
description: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3 is a nighttime 10 km race taking place on September 4, 2026, in Jelcz-Laskowice. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for autumn races. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels so everyone can prepare for the race effectively. The event is for runners who enjoy the atmosphere of running at night and the thrill of competition.

name: 24. Duderstädter Sparkassenlauf
description: The 24th Duderstadt Sparkassenlauf takes place on 28 August 2026 in Duderstadt’s historic pedestrian zone. The event starts at 16:00 with the opening ceremony in front of the town hall, which is also the finish point for all races. Distances include a 600 m Bambini run, 1.25 km school races, and 5 km and 10 km races. Children and young people receive finisher medals; participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive neckerchiefs, and winners are rewarded with cake. The event is supported by the City of Duderstadt, Sparkasse Duderstadt and other sponsors.
course_highlights: Races through Duderstadt’s historic old town and pedestrian zone
Finish in front of the beautiful town hall
A range of distances from 600 m to 10 km, including races for children and young people
additional: The event opens at 16:00 with remarks by patron and Mayor Thorsten Feike and the board of Sparkasse Duderstadt. The Bambini races have a participant limit of 250, while the school races have limits of 300 to 400 participants. Neckerchiefs are given as finisher gifts for the 5 km and 10 km races. On-the-day registration is not available. The awards ceremony starts at 18:00. Several race distances, registration via the website, medals for children, neckerchiefs for longer races, event in the historic city centre

name: Höinger Heidelauf
location: Ense-Höingen, Kreis Soest, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Höinger Heidelauf is a traditional running event held annually on the first Friday in September in Ense-Höingen. Known as the toughest 10 km race in the Soest district, the event offers distances for different types of runners, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course runs along mostly paved paths and gravel trails through the Sauerland hills and features challenging terrain. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event puts community and atmosphere at the forefront, making it a special experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Toughest 10 km race in the Soest district
Course along paved paths and gravel trails
Run through the hilly Sauerland landscape
additional: Children’s races start at 16:45, the 5 km and half marathon at 17:30, and the 10 km race at 18:30. The start and finish are at Karl-Kleine-Stadion. The event offers great refreshments and a strong sense of community. Temporary road closures and safety measures should be taken into account. In the past, the event has set participation records despite adverse weather conditions. Running event with children’s races and main races, a challenging course with elevation gain, and online registration available.

name: IHK-Ausbildungslauf move-on
location: Rostrup bei Oldenburg, Ammerland, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The training run “Move On!” is organised by the Oldenburg Chamber of Industry and Commerce (IHK) and takes place on 4 September 2026 around the Zwischenahner Meer. The course is approximately 12 km long and runs from BBS Ammerland in Rostrup via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen, returning to Rostrup. The event is aimed at trainers, apprentices, examiners, teachers and other people involved in vocational education and training in the Oldenburg region. In addition to the run, the event offers a programme including race-number collection, team photos, a barbecue evening with music and an awards ceremony. The event takes place in all weather. Parking is available at BBS and Bau-ABC Rostrup.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km circuit around the Zwischenahner Meer
Start and finish at BBS Ammerland in Rostrup
Route via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen
additional: Race numbers and T-shirts can be collected at BBS Rostrup on event day from 14:00 to 15:30. A walking group starts at 15:00. The run starts in four groups from 16:00, at four-minute intervals. After the run, a barbecue with a musical act will take place from 18:00 at Bau-ABC, near the finish. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 18:30. The IHK accepts no liability for accidents or theft. The event takes place in all weather. Valuables cannot be stored. Parking is available at BBS and Bau-ABC. Run on 4 September 2026; registration opens on 1 June 2026; takes place in all weather; parking available at BBS and Bau-ABC Rostrup.

name: Sparkassen Pütt-Tage-Lauf 2026
organizer: Sparkasse Münsterland Ost, SG Rote Erde Beckum, Ski-Club Beckum, TV Beckum, Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen
price_range: online registration, exact fee not specified
description: The Sparkassen Pütt-Tage Run is a road-running event held on Fridays in downtown Beckum as part of the city’s Pütt-Tage festivities. The program includes short children’s races, a youth race, a charity run, and the 10 km main race, which also serves as the FLVW 10 km Road Running Championships. The course covers several laps through the streets around Hühlstraße, where the start and finish are also located. The event is organized by several local clubs and the Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen. Timing uses a RaceResult transponder in the race bib.
course_highlights: City streets around Hühlstraße in Beckum
10 km main race over several laps
Charity run of approximately 4.2 km over about five laps
additional: The program begins with a 400 m Bambini Run, followed by 1 km children’s races (ages 6–9), a 2 km youth race (ages 10–15), and the 10 km main race (ages 16 and up). Timing uses a RaceResult transponder in the race bib, and results are published online. Multiple race types, including children’s, youth, charity, and main races; held as part of the Pütt-Tage festivities; city-street race; timing with a RaceResult transponder.

name: 23. Lehrter CityLauf
description: The 23rd Lehrte City Run takes place on September 4, 2026, and is a long-standing running event in downtown Lehrte. The races cover distances of 2, 4, and 10 kilometers, including children’s and school races, as well as a 2-kilometer inclusion run. The corporate competition over 4 and 10 kilometers will once again be sponsored by the KURTULUS GRUPPE. Musical accompaniment and a varied program of activities featuring the LSV departments will create a great atmosphere.

name: Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč
location: Ľubotín, Ľubotín, Polyfunkčný dom Ľubotín (budova za obecným úradom)
description: The Run from Ľubotín to Plaveč Castle is a traditional race that starts in the village of Ľubotín, by the Multifunctional Building. The race offers categories for men, women, juniors, Nordic walking, and a 4 km hobby run. The main race starts at 17:30, and the children’s categories begin at 16:30. The organizers are the municipalities of Ľubotín and Plaveč, which welcome runners of all ages and abilities. The race is ideal for anyone looking to run in beautiful surroundings, with the finish at Plaveč Castle.

name: RAWki na Surowo
description: RAWki na Surowo is a mountain trail race held in the magical Bieszczady Mountains, taking runners across the scenic alpine meadows of Mała and Wielka Rawka. The 29 km course with 1,550 m of elevation gain passes through Bieszczady National Park, requiring the race to be held without aid stations or course markings. The event is certified by ITRA and UTMB and is part of the MTrail Running Series. The start and finish are in Wetlina, and the race follows a self-supported format, emphasizing its rugged character.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
description: The 60th Race Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event held in the port region of Gdańsk on September 5, 2026. The event brings together athletes of different ages and ability levels, offering race-walking competitions over 10 km (women and men, including the Open, U20 and U18 categories), as well as 5 km and 3 km races for younger participants and the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also features the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the “Walk with the Postman” Prologue and the Polish Post Office Defenders’ Run – Energa Cup. The organizer, LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, also promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by holding wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.

name: Chojnik Karkonoski Festiwal Biegowy
description: Chojnik Karkonoski Running Festival is a mountain running event held in Sobieszów, in the heart of the Karkonosze Mountains. The festival offers a range of distances, from a family-friendly educational run to a challenging 102 km ultramarathon with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. The routes follow scenic, rocky trails in Karkonosze National Park, offering unique views and challenges for runners of varying experience levels. The event brings people together and promotes running as a team sport, as well as nature education.

name: Olkuski Bieg Uliczny
description: The Olkusz Street Run VII Silver Ten is an annual running event organized by the Olkuszbiega Association, the Olkusz Municipal and Town Office, and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Olkusz. The 10 km main race consists of two 5 km loops, with chip timing and markers every kilometer. The route follows streets with asphalt and partial cobblestone surfaces; the start and finish are in the Market Square in Olkusz. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running as a form of recreation for all age groups.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: The Praski Half Marathon is an annual running event in Warsaw that attracts both recreational and experienced runners. The half-marathon course passes through the scenic and historic parts of Praga, offering participants unique views and atmosphere. The event takes place at night, adding a distinctive character and appeal. The organizers provide professional support, timekeeping, and race packages including an official T-shirt.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The 46th International Usedom Marathon is a unique running event that crosses two countries along Europe’s longest seaside promenade. The 42 km route connects Świnoujście in Poland with Wolgast in Germany, passing through historic seaside resorts and scenic woodland. Runners can enjoy varied surfaces, beautiful views of the Baltic Sea, and the unique atmosphere of Usedom Island.

name: I Mistrzostwa Śląska Osób z Niepełnosprawnościami
V Bieg Pamięci Ofiar Bombardowania Węzła Kolejowego
XIV Grand Prix Nordic Walking Nowa Wieś Lęborska
Felsburglauf
description: The Felsburglauf is a traditional running event held annually since 2013 on the last Sunday in August at the stadium below Felsburg in Felsberg. The event offers races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m and attracts runners of all ages from the region. Its family-friendly atmosphere and beautiful setting make it a popular event in the Schwalm-Eder district. As a licensed race in the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup, participants can also earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: Races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m
Start and finish at the stadium below historic Felsburg
Family-friendly atmosphere in beautiful surroundings
additional: The race is part of the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup. The youngest participants are often born in 2020 or later, and the oldest runner was born in 1937. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht 1863 Felsberg and partner TSV Jahn Gensungen. Distances: 400 m, 1 km, 5 km, 10 km; terrain: stadium and the area around Felsburg; registration not explicitly mentioned

name: Volkslauf in St.Vit Laufen und Gutes tun
location: St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The charity run “Laufen und Gutes tun” takes place on September 5, 2026, in St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The races follow flat loop courses through St. Vit, starting and finishing at the Küsterhaus. The event supports various social causes, including pediatric outpatient palliative care, the Malteser Herzenswunsch ambulance, DKMS, and families in need. Alongside the runs, the event features an inline skating race for the first time, as well as a charity tattoo campaign to encourage participants’ social commitment.
course_highlights: Flat loop courses through St. Vit
Start and finish at the Küsterhaus
9.1 km inline skating race (5 laps), helmets required
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the running shoe. Race bibs and materials can be collected on event day from 13:30 in the registration tent next to the Küsterhaus. Water is available along the course, with tea and fruit at the finish area. Changing facilities are available at the local youth center. Helmets are required for the inline skating race. A charity tattoo campaign and DKMS registration will be available on site. Participation through membership is possible; donations support children’s hospices, DKMS, and families in need. Races are offered over various distances, including a Bambini run and inline skating.

name: Werler Kurpark Crosslauf - Hindernislauf für Groß und Klein
location: Werl Kurpark, Werl, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Werler Kurpark Crosslauf is an obstacle race for all ages, held in the picturesque Kurpark in Werl. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, from short courses for children to a challenging 6.4 km course for endurance runners. New in 2026 is the relay cross, which encourages team spirit and fun. The varied course features numerous exciting obstacles that make the race a special experience.
course_highlights: A variety of obstacles, including Climb the Wall, Waterlagoon and Mountainclimber
Distances from 480 metres to 6.4 kilometres
New for 2026: Project S as an additional obstacle
additional: On-site late registration is available up to 60 minutes before the respective start (except for the relay). Race numbers use electronic timing via Racersult. An exclusive Kurparkcross shirt can be pre-ordered only until 30.06.2026. Spikes, barefoot running and costumes are not permitted for safety reasons. Accompaniment on the course is permitted only for the U6 Bambini race. Obstacles, courses for children and adults, family-friendly, team spirit, fun

name: Wildman Harz
description: WILDMAN Harz is a challenging trail-running event around the mountain town of Wildemann in the Harz Mountains. The course features tough climbs, technical downhills, spruce forests and alpine meadows, offering an authentic trail-running experience in the Upper Harz. With distances from 1.5 km to 55 km, there is a suitable challenge for every trail runner. The event also features a varied program, including a pasta party and a barbecue party, making the weekend a special experience.
course_highlights: Tough climbs and technical downhills
Spruce forests and alpine meadows
Singletrack trails over rugged terrain around Wildemann
additional: Late registration is possible online up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late-registration fee of EUR 10. Age limits are defined for each course. The program includes a pasta party on Friday and a barbecue party on Saturday. There are race categories, mandatory equipment and aid stations. Registration is through the partner myRacePartner.com. Courses have up to 2,100 metres of elevation gain. Aid stations, timing, environmental and fair-play rules, a program including pasta and barbecue parties, and registration are required.

name: Ederauenlauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.4 km
description: The Ederauenlauf in Bergheim is a popular running event offering a variety of distances suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels. The course runs through the picturesque Ederauen and provides ideal conditions on a measured course eligible for record lists. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, numerous volunteers, and great spirit. Alongside the sporting competition, the focus is also on sharing the experience and supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Measured course eligible for record lists through the Ederauen
Distances from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km)
Start and finish at the central sports complex of TV08 Bergheim
additional: The event offers various distances, from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km). The course is dry and sheltered from the wind, with ideal running weather. There is a family-friendly atmosphere with many volunteers and spectators. The event supports social projects such as the Marburg Children's Cancer Aid. The central sports complex of TV08 Bergheim serves as the start and finish venue. Courses are measured and well marked, including for Nordic walking; donations support children's cancer aid; event in September 2026.

name: Fehmarn Marathon
description: The Fehmarn Marathon takes place annually on the island of Fehmarn and offers runners a varied course through the eastern part of the island. The main races follow roads, dike paths and uneven dirt tracks, providing a diverse running experience. The event starts on 5 September 2026 at 9:30 a.m. at the sports field at Inselschule in Fehmarn. In addition to the marathon, there are other races with award ceremonies, and all participants receive an official marathon shirt. Timing is done with a foot chip attached to the running shoe, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Loops along roads, dike paths and uneven dirt tracks
Course through the eastern part of Fehmarn
Start and finish at the sports field at Inselschule
additional: Bib pickup is available the day before the event from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. and on the day of the event from 8:00 a.m. Award ceremonies take place at staggered times after the races. Timing is done with a foot chip, which must be returned after the race; a €15 fee applies if it is lost. The event ends at approximately 3:15 p.m. with the arrival of the bicycle escort marking the end of the course. Parking is recommended, with the start area within walking distance. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective race. Shirts tend to run small, so larger sizes are recommended. The event takes place in all weather conditions; online registration is available, including running shirts and various categories.

name: 4. Backyard Ultra Munich
description: The Munich Backyard Ultra is a unique running event in Oberschleißheim near Munich, where runners complete a 6.7 km lap every hour. The distinctive feature is that the same course is run each time, and only one person emerges as the winner in the end. The event thrives on a strong community, with runners, volunteers, and spectators supporting one another and creating a special atmosphere together. Safety, refreshments, and comfort are taken care of, allowing participants to focus fully on their running experience.

name: Intern. Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run, organized by TSV Poggenhagen von 1946 e.V., takes place on September 5, 2026. This is a traditional fun run, scored in accordance with the rules of the German Athletics Association (DLO) and recognized for all DLV fun run badges. Certificates are available for all placings and can be downloaded online, and awards are presented to the top three finishers in each category. A special prize is also awarded to the largest registered group. The terms of participation and liability limitations are prerequisites for taking part.

name: Volkslauf Eisbergen 2026
organizer: TuS Eisbergen TURN- UND SPIELVEREIN 1919 EISBERGEN e. V.
description: The Volkslauf Eisbergen is a long-standing running event in Porta Westfalica, offering various distances for children and adults. The course runs around the Eisbergen sports field and offers varied running options, with a 5.7 km Volkslauf and a 17.7 km long-distance race. Refreshments are also provided for participants, and the event is part of the Mühlenkreisserie. The course can also be viewed on Komoot, making it easy to prepare.

name: Volksbank Mitte Kurstadtlauf
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Kurstadtlauf in Heilbad Heiligenstadt is a long-running race taking place for the 27th time on September 5, 2026. The 19-kilometer course crosses the Dün and starts and finishes in the Vitalpark. A tree is planted for each participant to help reforest local woodlands, making the race especially eco-friendly. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere and invites runners of all abilities.

name: 55. Brockenlauf
description: The Brockenlauf is Germany’s oldest mountain race and has been held annually in Ilsenburg in the Harz Mountains since 1927. The main 26.2 km course climbs 890 meters to the Brocken, the highest mountain in northern Germany, and offers a challenging experience with changeable high-mountain weather at the summit. The route passes through picturesque natural scenery and historic places, with impressive views. In addition to the main race, there are other shorter courses that also offer an experience in nature. The event is open to all runners, regardless of club membership.

name: Brokser Volkslauf
description: The Brokser Volkslauf takes place on September 5, 2026, in Bruchhausen-Vilsen and offers running and walking events for all age groups. The event includes distances from 400 m to 20 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. Held in all weather, it offers participants a varied program featuring a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The races start at the school and sports center, and children’s and youth races are rewarded with medals.

name: Gremsdorfer Kerwalauf 2026
distance_verbose: 10 km, 8 km, 7.65 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.8 km, 1.9 km, 1 km
description: The Gremsdorf Kerwalauf is a traditional running event in Gremsdorf, offering various distances for all age groups. The event includes races for toddlers, children, youth, recreational runners and the main race, as well as walking competitions. The routes pass through the scenic surroundings of Gremsdorf and offer a varied experience for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The race takes place annually as part of the Kerwa festival and is a popular event for the whole family.

name: 46. Internationaler Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run invites running enthusiasts to Poggenhagen on September 5, 2026. The event offers 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon races, all starting together. The scenic course loops around Poggenhagen, passing the air base and continuing to the bathing island in Steinhude. Children can also take part in races over 450 and 850 meters. All races finish at the TSV Poggenhagen sports park.

name: SOKOLOVSKÁ 12/24 RUN
description: Sokolovská 12/24 RUN is an endurance running race lasting 6, 12 or 24 hours, open to individuals, pairs and teams of four. The race takes place on an easy, gently undulating loop around the Michal Natural Swimming Area in Sokolov. It starts on Saturday, 5 September 2026 at 11:15. Camping accommodation with full facilities is available. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners and offers various age and team categories, with exchanges permitted in the transition area by the refreshment stand.

name: Běh kolem Světa
description: Běh kolem Světa is a traditional running event held in Třeboň, following a route around the Svět pond. Since its launch in 2012, the race has gained a loyal following and offers an attractive 11.7 km course that follows the Svět Nature Trail. The event takes place every September and is popular for its natural scenery and varied terrain, including dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden footbridges, and sections of asphalt. The race is suitable for runners of all abilities, and entry can also be purchased as a Christmas voucher.

name: Mirovice - Běh do háje
location: Mirovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

name: Podhostýnská 10
location: Zámecký park, Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Czech Republic
description: Podhostýnská 10ka is a running race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem, offering 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races.
