The event takes place in the castle park and is part of the Běhy Zlín running series. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all ages who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize tradition and high-quality race organization.

name: Běh Plzeňské teplárenské kolem Boleveckých rybníků
description: The Plzeňská teplárenská Run around the Bolevec Ponds is a traditional running event organized by Pro Sport Activities, offering races for children and adults in the picturesque setting of the Bolevec Ponds in Plzeň. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including the youngest runners. Entry is free, and the first 300 people to register will receive a voucher for refreshments. In addition to the races, there is a program for children and an autograph session with athletes.

name: Birell Večerní Běh na 10 km Praha
description: The Birell Prague Evening 10 km Run is a traditional night race offering a unique atmosphere as Prague’s streets light up. The race starts at dusk, giving runners the chance to experience the city’s beauty in an unusual light. You can take part individually or as part of a team and enjoy the magical nighttime atmosphere beneath the stars. The race is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts thousands of runners every year.

name: adidas Běh pro ženy 5 km Praha
description: Come and run the adidas Women’s 5K in Prague, the largest race created specifically for women. The 5 km course is suitable even for runners with no prior training, with a 50-minute time limit. Enjoy the unique atmosphere and the support of thousands of women at an exclusive race with no men on the course. Sign up with your friends and share the joy of running and solidarity.

name: Barokomaraton
description: Barokomaraton is the 19th edition of a cross-country race held in the picturesque town of Plasy and the valley of the Střela River. The race is intended both for experienced runners and for those who run for pleasure and want to enjoy the beautiful autumn scenery. Runners can expect routes along forest and field paths, with regular refreshment stations. The organizers are also preparing a cultural program, entertainment for children, and refreshments, making Barokomaraton an enjoyable day of sport and relaxation for the whole family.

name: Strážný nahoru a dolů
description: Strážný Up and Down is part of the ISCAREX Cup, a traditional series of running races in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a challenging uphill and downhill run in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Dobrouč. The organizers provide a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for all participants. The event is suitable for experienced runners and recreational athletes who want to try running on hilly terrain.

name: Lupenická dvanáctka
description: The Lupenice Twelve is a traditional running race in Lupenice, held for the 33rd year. The race offers a 12 km course with 98 metres of elevation gain, running entirely on asphalt and clearly marked. The start is at the Lupenice sports complex, and the race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix. All participants run at their own risk, and those under 18 must provide parental consent.

name: Jenštejnská pětka
description: The Jenštejn Five is an annual 5 km running race held in the village of Jenštejn since 2014. In addition to the main race, other running categories are also held, making the event accessible to a wide range of runners. It is a traditional sporting gathering in the Central Bohemian Region and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in the picturesque setting of Jenštejn.

name: Zbraslavská Závist
description: Zbraslavská Závist is a trail uphill race that starts in Prague-Zbraslav near the former mini zoo and leads to the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist. The course is 3.5 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering a challenging and interesting running experience. The race is suitable for athletes ready for a fast start and a demanding climb. It is organised by KOPEC, z.s., under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation, and is part of Prague’s traditional running calendar.

name: Beh Novoveskou Hutou
location: Novoveská Huta, Spišská Nová Ves, Slovakia
organizer: Športový Klub ROHALS a Mesto Spišská Nová Ves

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: muži nad 60 a ženy nad 50 rokov - 3 €

price_tiers.distance: Dorast a beh pre zdravie 5 km

description: Sports Club Rohals warmly invites you to the 16th edition of the Run Through Novoveská Huta, taking place in Novoveská Huta. Adults can take on a new 12.2 km course to Vojtechova samota and back, the same for women and men. A 5 km course is also available for those who prefer a shorter distance. Children and young runners will compete on shorter courses through the streets of Huta, grouped by age category. After the race, participants can refuel with goulash; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest.
course_highlights: The new adult course goes to Vojtechova samota (Šadroň) and back
The adult course is 12.2 km and is the same for women and men
Short courses for children through the streets of Novoveská Huta, grouped by age category
additional: Registration for school-age participants is from 11:30 to 12:45, and for juniors and adults until 14:45. Participants may start in only one category. Goulash will be provided after the race; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest. Adult categories compete for points in the Spišská Nová Ves District Running League. 12.2 km and 5 km courses, categories for different age groups, registration on the day of the event, activities for children and adults.

name: Marathon Chopok
description: Marathon Chopok is a challenging mountain race in the stunning surroundings of the Low Tatras, testing your abilities across a variety of surfaces and terrain. The race takes place on September 5, 2026, starting at 7:00 a.m. from Srdiečko and finishing at Chopok, at an elevation of 2,004 m above sea level. There are two main routes: SkyMarathon Chopok, 43 km long with 2,600 m of elevation gain, and the shorter Sky Race Jasná Trail, 21 km long with 1,400 m of elevation gain. Relay teams can also take part in the longer race. The route runs along both the southern and northern sides of Chopok, including the main ridge, and offers beautiful views and varied terrain.

name: Kokava Trail
description: Kokava Trail is a certified trail race starting and finishing in Kokava nad Rimavicou, with routes through the Veporské vrchy and Stolické vrchy mountain ranges. There are two distances: the main course is 78 km with +3330 m of elevation gain and an 18-hour time limit; the shorter Pasiečky Trail is 23 km with +1200 m of elevation gain and a 7-hour time limit. The varied route consists of 45% meadow sections, 45% forest trails and 10% asphalt. It has no difficult technical sections, but includes several steeper descents and climbs. Runners can make use of six aid stations. Mandatory equipment includes a thermal blanket, headlamp, mobile phone with an active SIM card, GPS device, reflective vest and sufficient fluids. Winners in the Men, Women, Men 50+ and Women 50+ categories will receive medals and prizes during the awards ceremony at the cultural centre.

name: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series Round 3 is part of a series of running events held in Prešov throughout 2026. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, from beginners to professionals. The courses are designed to bring the community together, promote a healthy lifestyle, and make exercise enjoyable. The entry fee includes timing, a medal, refreshments, and an accompanying program. Children who are members of Prešov Running Team can run for free.

name: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom
location: Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Ul. Doliny
description: The 6-Hour Run Under Šariš Castle is an endurance running event held in Veľký Šariš, Prešov District. The race is open to individuals and relay teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The entry fee is the same for all runners, and the event offers the chance to test your endurance in a six-hour run in the beautiful surroundings below the castle. The organizers, Gejza Sabanoš and Ondrej Fedor, ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: Ozorovská dvanastka
location: Malé Ozorovce, Malé Ozorovce, Parkovisko pred KD
description: Ozorovská Twelve is a running race held in Malé Ozorovce, offering courses for both children and adults. The race is organized by OZ Zorovčan in cooperation with the municipality of Veľké Ozorovce. Participants can compete in the 6 km and 12 km races, with categories by age and gender. The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 10:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere near the cultural center.

name: Horský kros Gerlach
location: Gerlachov okr. Poprad, Gerlachov okr. Poprad, Gerlachov od pomníka ( Prezentácia: Obecný úrad Gerlachov )
description: Horský kros Gerlach is a traditional mountain uphill race that starts in the village of Gerlachov and runs through the Velická Valley to the Sliezsky dom mountain hotel. The course is 8,400 metres long with an elevation gain of 879 metres, and runners tackle a rocky trail and sections of asphalt road. The event is suited to runners who enjoy challenging mountain terrain and beautiful views of the High Tatras. The programme also includes children’s races, and runners can purchase an entry with original Horský kros Gerlach socks.

name: Beh za Tatry
location: Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, pod vyhliadkovou vežou Tatras Tower
organizer: Barbora a Slavomír Ogurčákovci v spolupráci s občianskym združením Žiť Tatry
description: Beh za Tatry is a running event held in the picturesque setting of Štrbské Pleso in the High Tatras, below the Tatras Tower observation tower. The races offer a start for children at 14:00 and for adults at 16:00, with the course running on natural surfaces along the lakeshore and cross-country ski trails. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing runners of various age groups to take part. The organizers are Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčák, in cooperation with the Žiť Tatry civic association, who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Veľatský lesný beh
description: The Veľaty Forest Run is a traditional running event organized by the civic association OZ Stopa in the village of Veľaty. The race takes place at the FK Veľaty sports field and offers courses of various lengths for men and women aged 15 and over, while children’s races are held directly on the football pitch. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, voluntary donations in place of an entry fee, and refreshments. Volunteers support runners throughout the day, and times are recorded by timekeepers, followed by the announcement of the winners and the presentation of prizes.

name: Telekom Night run
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km

name: Bėgam už Kalvariją miesto gatvėmis XII
14 Tyski Półmaraton
description: The 14th Tychy Half Marathon is a 21.0975 km race certified by the PZLA. It runs through the streets of Tychy and around Lake Paprocany. The start, finish, and race village are located at the Tychy Athletics Stadium. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the city’s sporting spirit, and offers numerous activities, including children’s races, massages, and sports demonstrations. The course was modified in 2022 to reduce the number of uphill sections, making it more participant-friendly. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Tychy and has been growing in popularity since 2012.

name: 26 Eco Półmaraton Wałbrzych
description: The 26th edition of the Toyota Eko Half Marathon Wałbrzych is one of the most important running events in the region and the country, attracting runners from all over Poland. Following last year’s organizational success and record attendance, the event once again confirms its strong position on Poland’s sporting map. Participants gave the half-marathon course very high ratings, and the unique atmosphere created by Wałbrzych’s supporters gives the event its unmistakable character. We warmly invite you to take part or cheer on the runners.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
location: Obliwice, Nowa Wieś Lęborska, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Join the 44th International Open Cross-Country Race for the Forest Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, taking place on September 6, 2026, in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two 3.2 km laps, with the start and finish in the same place. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for the whole family amid nature. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and an athlete, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the local community.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is Poland’s oldest continuously held 10-kilometre road race, taking place in Gdańsk. The race starts at the historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The course is certified and marked every kilometre, and the finish is at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, providing an extra attraction for participants. The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Defenders of the Coast in 1939.

name: Bieg KoBBiet
description: Bieg KoBBiet is an annual race held in Bielsko-Biała. In 2026, it will take place on September 6 at the Municipal Stadium. The event is dedicated to the memory of Ewa Szymanek-Płaska, head of the Education and Sports Department at Bielsko-Biała City Hall. This year’s race supports children on the autism spectrum. Registration opens on April 10, 2026, at 10:00. The race is held under the honorary patronage of Bielsko-Biała Mayor Jarosław Klimaszewski.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła is a 5 km race held in Bukownica, Mazowieckie. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness on an easy asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to their individual levels and offer support from experts. The event has a friendly, motivating atmosphere and is ideal for those who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running.

name: XVIII Bieg Koguta
description: The 18th Bieg Koguta is a 10 km race held in Oława on September 6, 2026. The event is organized by the Oławska Grupa Biegowa in cooperation with local institutions, and participants can expect professional timekeeping. The race office will be open both the day before the race and on race day, making it easier to collect race packs. The race is open and welcoming to runners of different ability levels.

name: Bieg na Rowerze - Rower na Biegu
VII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Zblewo
location: Twardy Dół, Zblewo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: X Bieg Neptuna
location: Trzebież, Police County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 16. Wardenburger Sommerlauf
description: The Wardenburg Summer Run is a long-standing race in Wardenburg that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 5 km to the 10-mile race; some start together and split at the Tillysee. The event focuses on fair, well-organized race management with chip timing and offers runners a varied route through the region. Children can take part in special untimed races, and Nordic walking is also on the program. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: The 10 km and 10-mile races start together and split at the Tillysee
Varied routes from 5 kilometers through the Wardenburg region
Timing with a chip integrated into the race bib
additional: No on-the-day entries are possible. Race bibs have an integrated chip; race bibs must be returned in the finish area. Running with dogs is not permitted. Baby joggers are allowed; participants with baby joggers should line up at the back. The Bambini run is without a race bib or timing. Toilets and changing rooms are available. Runners who exceed the 16:00 time limit will not be timed. Several distances; some races are not timed; participation is only permitted with a race bib; no on-the-day entries; organized via Laufmanager.

name: 31. Fulda-Marathon

price_tiers.distance: Halbmarathon (Einzel und Team), 5 km, 11 km, Mini-Marathon

description: The Fulda Marathon is a special running experience in the heart of Fulda, Hesse. The route passes the cathedral, runs through the Baroque Old Town and the Fulda floodplains, and finishes in the stadium. The event is organised by volunteers from Leichtathletik-Gemeinschaft Fulda e. V. and offers a well-planned course and professional organisation. In addition to the half marathon, there are other events, including 5 km and 11 km races and a mini marathon for different age groups.
course_highlights: The route passes the cathedral and runs through the Baroque Old Town
A run through the natural landscapes of the Fulda floodplains
Finish in Fulda’s city stadium
additional: Start times for the other races: 10 km at approx. 09:40, 5 km at approx. 10:00, mini marathon at 14:00 (primary school) and 15:00 (lower secondary school). The routes for all events are clearly mapped and can be downloaded. The event is organised by volunteers, with comprehensive support along the course, medical care and refreshments. Fulda Marathon T-shirts and a health check are available. Various events include the half marathon, 11 km, 5 km, team and mini marathon; registration opens on 01.02.2026; check the terms and conditions and cancellation fees; numerous refreshment and support points, an accompanying programme and medical care.

name: 8. Flensburg liebt dich Marathon
description: The Flensburg liebt dich Marathon offers a varied running experience, with routes through Flensburg’s modern and historic city centre, along the Sonwik Marina and by the harbour. The marathon consists of four laps of 10.55 km, with a maritime atmosphere, and finishes at Südermarkt. There is also a half marathon over two laps of the same course, as well as other races, including a marathon relay, 10 km and 5 km runs. The event sends a positive message about community and quality of life in the region and warmly welcomes runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Four laps of 10.55 km through the city centre, Sonwik Marina and harbour
Flat roads along the Förde with a maritime atmosphere
Finish at Südermarkt in Flensburg
additional: For registrations from 24.08.2026 onwards, race bibs will not be personalised, and medal engraving and shirts will not be offered. Race materials can be collected upon presentation of the digital registration confirmation or an identity document. Participation is limited to 1,000 runners for the marathon and 2,000 for the half marathon. The awards ceremony takes place at Flensburg Galerie. For safety reasons, participation with electronic audio devices, walking poles, jogging strollers, prams and animals is not permitted. Online registration only; race materials can be collected at Flensburg Galerie. Various race distances are available, including a marathon relay, children’s races and practice sessions.

name: DresdenHALF
location: Dresden city center, Dresden, Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Teilnahme am DresdenHALF KidsRUN kostet 10 Euro.

description: The DresdenHALF is an exciting half marathon that will pass through the heart of Dresden for the first time on September 6, 2026. The 21.1-kilometer course runs along the Elbe and past the city’s most beautiful landmarks, with each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s partner cities. The event offers runners a unique experience against a historic backdrop and with an international atmosphere. In addition to the half marathon, there are also other races for children and recreational runners, making the weekend a special running experience.
course_highlights: 21.1 km through the heart of Dresden, along the Elbe
Each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s 13 partner cities
Start at the World Trade Center Dresden, finish at the Saxon State Parliament
additional: The DresdenHALF starts at the World Trade Center Dresden and finishes at the Saxon State Parliament. The course is officially measured and eligible for record lists. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and the time limit is 3 hours. Race packets will be distributed on September 4 and 5, 2026, at the World Trade Center Dresden. Every participant receives exclusive arm warmers and a finisher’s medal. The EWG Dresden5K includes an exclusive bobble hat. It is possible to transfer a race entry for a fee. All KidsRUN participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate. The course is officially measured; participation is open to runners aged 16 and over; the time limit is 3 hours; merchandise and race-entry transfers are available; children’s races and events on the day before the race on September 5 are included.

name: Canyon Run Mühlheim
description: The Canyon Run in Mühlheim am Main is Hesse’s most beautiful forest run, taking runners through the Mühlheim quarries. It takes place on September 6, 2026. The event offers flat, officially measured courses, attractive prize money and prizes, and a unique atmosphere with live music in the finish area. Runners of all ages can choose from a range of distances, from the 400 m mini run to the half marathon, with excellent refreshments along the course. The race also supports social projects in the region, making the Canyon Run a special community experience.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured courses through the Mühlheim quarries and Mühlheim Forest
Half marathon with 80 metres of elevation gain, 10 km with 50 metres, and 5 km with 20 metres
Start and finish at the Dietesheim sports grounds, with live music and excellent refreshments
additional: Net timing by transponder, provided by RST Volkslauf GmbH. Prize money and prizes for the fastest runners. Team competitions for companies, clubs, and schools. Professional photos in the finish area. Charity run raising donations for local social organisations. Races for families, kids, and teams; refreshments, prize money, photos, and community activities included.

name: Kasseler Frauenlauf 2026
description: The Kassel Women’s Run is a charity run for women in Kassel-Wehlheiden, traditionally held on the first weekend in September at the Buchenau athletics track. The event focuses on exercise without performance pressure: there is no timing, no ranking and no pressure to set personal bests. Participants can run, jog, walk or stroll, with short children’s races as well as 5 km and 10 km run-walk routes on flat courses. The day supports women in need and fosters a relaxed community atmosphere, with a warm-up program, music, food, a raffle, childcare, applause and participant certificates.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km and 10 km routes
Children’s races of 400 m and 800 m
Finish at the Hessenkampfbahn on Auedamm
additional: There is no timing or ranking. Participants can run, jog, walk or stroll. The event offers a community atmosphere with a warm-up, music, food, a raffle, childcare and participant certificates. It takes place at the Buchenau athletics track in Kassel-Wehlheiden and emphasizes relaxed, inclusive participation for women and children of all ages.

name: Schapener Volkslauf
description: The Schapen Fun Run offers runners and walkers a choice of distances in a natural setting around the village of Schapen and the Riddagshausen ponds. The routes pass through idyllic woodland and pond areas, as well as historic places such as Schapen railway station. The 1.2 km route is especially family-friendly and is intended mainly for children and young people, accompanied by their families. The event features a group warm-up, childcare and massages in exchange for a donation, and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running.
course_highlights: The 10.5 km route loops around the Riddagshausen ponds and passes through Buchhorst
The 6.1 km route passes Schäfer’s Ruh and historic Schapen railway station
The 1.2 km route is for children and young people and can be completed once or twice
additional: Start times vary by distance, from 9:15 a.m. to 10:20 a.m. There is a group warm-up, childcare and massages in exchange for a donation. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 1921 Schapen e.V. The event takes place in September 2026 and includes various running and walking distances, as well as activities such as a warm-up, childcare and massages.

name: Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 6,00 € für Kinder & Jugendliche bis einschl. Jahrgang 2008

description: The Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg is a long-standing running event taking place on September 6, 2026, in Pinneberg. The event offers various distances for children, young people, and adults, including a 1 km fun run for kindergarten children, a 2.5 km beginners’ and team race, and 5 km and 10 km courses for older participants. The races follow green loop courses through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark, with the start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark. The event is family-friendly, and spectators can watch and cheer on the children throughout the fun run.
course_highlights: Green loop course through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark
Children’s fun run with 2 laps around Drosteipark
Start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark
additional: Race packs (bib numbers including transponders) will be distributed at the VfL-Sportzentrum Fahltskamp on 04.09.2026 from 09:00-19:00 and on 05.09.2026 from 09:00-16:00. Late entries are possible online until one hour before the start for an additional fee of €5.00. The team classification is based on 3 runners, whose individual times are added together; mixed teams are allowed. Online registration is available; bib number pickup is on September 4 and 5 at the VfL-Sportzentrum; late entries are subject to a fee; the start and finish area is at Drosteiwiese.

name: Geithainer Herbstlauf
description: The Geithain Autumn Run is a family-friendly autumn race held at the Geithain Stadium in Geithain, Germany. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a 300 m Bambini Run, a 2.5 km Chestnut Run for children, a 7 km Fun Run, a 7 km walking route, and a 17 km scenic run for older participants and walkers. The start and finish are at the stadium, and the courses are GPS-measured and approved by the German Athletics Association. In addition to the races, there is a children’s programme, a bouncy castle, certificates, medals and small prizes. Every fifth finisher in races of 7 km or longer is rewarded with a bottle of sparkling wine.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Geithain Stadium
GPS-measured courses ranging from 0.3 km to 17 km
Family-friendly programme with children’s races and walking routes
additional: Every fifth finisher in the 7 km races or longer receives a bottle of sparkling wine. The event is organised by Impact Geithain e. V., with support from FSV Alemannia Geithain e. V. The children’s programme and bouncy castle are part of the event. The event includes children’s races, childcare, certificates, finisher medals, small prizes for children and a special bonus: every fifth finisher in the longer races receives a bottle of sparkling wine.

name: 10. Parchener Fiener-Cross
description: The Parchen Fiener Cross is a long-standing cross-country race in the Jerichower Land district, held in northern Saxony-Anhalt as part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP running series. The event attracts numerous runners of all ages each year and offers additional competitions, including the Heidel Team Cup and a family classification. The race takes place at the Klapperhalle on Parkstraße in Parchen and is known for its varied cross-country course. The event promotes running in the region and brings together sporting competition and a sense of community.

name: 15. Brunsberglauf
location: Holm-Seppensen, Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 15th Brunsberglauf on September 6, 2026, in Buchholz/Holm-Seppensen offers runners a varied program, including main races over 11.7 km, a half marathon, and a 5 km family run. The courses pass through forests and blooming heathland, with highlights such as Höllenschlucht, Brunsberg, Mühlenteich, and Zwergentunnel. There are also four children’s races for different age groups. The whole family can enjoy an attractive program of activities in the finish area. The Brunsberglauf’s motto is “Running and doing good,” and it supports charitable organizations in the region.

name: 23. Schoninger Volkslauf
description: The Schoninger Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in the Solling, held annually by SC Schoningen 04. The event offers runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to run varied routes through the beautiful countryside around Schoningen. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and strong sense of community, promoting both sport and togetherness. Every year, numerous runners take part to compete and enjoy a great running event together.

name: 37. CURREX Alsterlauf
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf is a traditional road race in Hamburg, held on a flat, traffic-free loop around the Inner and Outer Alster lakes. The event offers a unique start and finish atmosphere in Hamburg city center and is one of Europe’s largest 10-kilometer road races. In addition to the main 10 km race, there are also 5 km events, a schoolchildren’s race, and the R5K Tour for young runners. The courses are officially measured and ideal for fast times.

name: 38. Volkslauf des TSV Breuna
description: The 38th Breuna Malsburg Run takes place on 6 September 2026 and is a long-established running event in the Breuna running and hiking park. The race offers an attractive course through the beautiful natural surroundings of Breuna and is open to runners of all ages. The event is organized by TSV Breuna e.V. and is part of the Nordhessencup. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.

name: 6. Tuchmacher Stadtlauf
description: The Tuchmacher City Run in Bramsche is a popular event with several race distances that attracts numerous participants each year. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and varied route through the city center. The 10 km main race is particularly popular with competitive athletes, while the schoolchildren’s race draws a large field and creates a lively atmosphere. The Bramscher Rumläufer organize the event with great dedication, supported by local schools and sponsors.

name: Breunaer Volkslauf mit 21,1km Malsburglauf
description: The 38th Breunaer Malsburglauf takes place on September 6, 2026, and is an established running event in Breuna. The race runs through the Breuna Running and Hiking Park and offers an attractive course for runners. The event is organized by TSV Breuna e.V. and is open to runners of different ages and ability levels. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.

name: Gölitztallauf
description: The Gölitztallauf is an annual race in Marktgölitz, celebrating its 44th edition on September 6, 2026. The event features four different race distances, including a 1 km children’s race. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and awards across various age groups. Award ceremonies take place soon after the races to keep participants’ wait times short.

name: R5K - 5K Alsterlauf Hamburg 2026
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf Hamburg is a traditional running event featuring officially measured, flat, paved courses along the Outer Alster and on Ballindamm. The event offers various distances, including 10 km, 5 km and children’s races, and is open to runners of different age groups. The races are traffic-free and safely supervised by police and race marshals. The Hamburg 10 km Road Championships are also held as part of the Alsterlauf.

name: Stadtallendorfer Stadtlauf
description: The Stadtallendorf City Run takes place as part of the Heimat- und Soldatenfest in Stadtallendorf and is organized by TSV Stadtallendorf in cooperation with the German Armed Forces. The course is a loop through Heinz-Lang-Park and the adjacent stadium. Races are offered for various ability levels, including a 5-kilometer fun run and a 10-kilometer main race. These are followed by races for young people and children. The event attracts numerous athletes and offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, festive atmosphere.

name: Staffellauf der MBB-SG Augsburg
description: The 41st Augsburg MBB SG Augsburg Relay Race takes place on September 6, 2026, in the Siebentischwald forest in Augsburg. The event features a relay marathon with three runners, each running one lap of 7,032.5 meters, as well as an individual half-marathon over 21.1 kilometers. The course is paved, flat, fast, and runs mostly through the forest, creating ideal conditions for runners of all ability levels. There is also a recreational run of about 7 kilometers, particularly suitable for beginners. The course is well marked and designed as an out-and-back route.

name: Dörverden läuft 2026
description: The run in Dörverden is a versatile running event suitable for all ages and ability levels. The measured courses range from 1.8 km for walking and running to the 10 km main race, which consists of two 5 km laps. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes community sport in the Lower Saxony region. Races start in staggered intervals from 10:00 a.m., so every participant can find a suitable event.

name: Fränkische Schweiz-Marathon
description: The Franconian Switzerland Marathon takes place on September 6, 2026, in the picturesque landscape of Franconian Switzerland. The course runs from Neideck to Walberla, passing idyllic villages, castles, and rock formations. The car-free federal highway provides ideal running conditions. Tens of thousands of spectators and a varied supporting program give the event a festival atmosphere. The anniversary edition warmly welcomes runners of all ability levels to take part.

name: Glomb City Marathon Bremerhaven
description: The GLOMB City Marathon Bremerhaven is an annual marathon in Bremerhaven, held since 2005. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon and a 10 km race. The course is a flat loop starting and finishing in front of the Bürgermeister-Smidt-Gedächtniskirche, and runs through the city center and Havenwelten. Runners enjoy an attractive route with many sights and a unique setting along the water and harbor facilities. The event is organized by the event agency Execute Sports Events, which ensures professional organization.

name: Vorkloster run (1. etapa)
description: Vorkloster Run is a stage race held in the picturesque foothills of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands, amid the medieval atmosphere of Porta Coeli Monastery. The race features three stages of varying distances and profiles, from a fast, flat stage to more challenging hilly sections. It is organized by the experienced DálRunDál team in cooperation with the Porta Coeli Monastery Brewery, which adds to the authentic experience. The routes are carefully marked and run mostly away from traffic, offering beautiful views of the surrounding countryside and historic landmarks.

name: Ostrava City Marathon
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Moravská Ostrava, Ostrava, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ceny absolutního pořadí (ženy i muži) 1. 5.000,- Kč 2. 3.000,- Kč 3. 2.000,- Kč 4. 1.000,- Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ceny absolutního pořadí (ženy i muži) 1. 4.000,- Kč 2. 3.000,- Kč 3. 2.000,- Kč 4. 1.000,- Kč

description: The Ostrava City Marathon is the oldest marathon in the Czech Republic, bringing a sporting atmosphere to the centre of Ostrava every year and connecting the world of running with the city’s industrial spirit. It offers a wide range of race categories, from children’s runs and relays to the classic marathon, and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The running festival is open to everyone who wants to experience its unique atmosphere and support the charitable MiniMarathon. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, allowing runners and spectators alike to enjoy the centre of Ostrava in motion.
course_highlights: The marathon course runs through Ostrava’s historic centre
Refreshments are available on the course approximately every 5 km and at the finish
Accompanying activities and an exercise programme with INDIVIDUAL FITNESS
additional: Online registration is open until 28.8.2026 at 23:59, after which it closes. On-site registration is available only on Saturday 5.9.2026, subject to capacity, except for the non-competitive MiniMarathon. Race numbers are personalised according to the registered race distance; electronic timekeeping is provided by non-returnable chips included with the race number. Refreshments, toilets, showers, changing rooms and baggage storage are available for participants. Start times: marathon and half marathon at 09:00, relay at 09:20, children’s races from 09:45. The accompanying programme includes an exercise programme with INDIVIDUAL FITNESS and a performance by Judo Club Baník Ostrava. The MiniMarathon is a charity run. According to the organiser, the event takes place in all weather and is wheelchair accessible.

name: Podčerchovský kros
description: The Podčerchovský Cross-Country Run is a challenging cross-country race held on Babí hora near Chodov. It follows forest paths with several tough climbs. The longest loop is 2.5 km and is also suitable for runners wearing spikes. The race is open to all age groups, with various distances ranging from children’s races to the men’s main event. Results are announced shortly after the race, and winners receive medals and prizes, with cash awards also offered in the main category.

name: Běh na Lahti
description: We invite you to the 47th edition of the traditional Běh na Lahti running race, taking place on September 6, 2026, in Děčín. The race offers two courses: the main course is nearly 10 km long with 230 meters of elevation gain, passing the Kvádrberk viewpoint and continuing above the village of Ludvíkovice; the shorter course is just under 5 km long with 130 meters of elevation gain. The route runs through the forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River, offering beautiful views and a challenging run. Check-in and registration take place at the start from 8:00 to 9:45. The race starts at 9:00.

name: Rychnov pomáhá během
description: Rychnov Helps Through Running is a charity race held in Rychnov nad Kněžnou, offering routes for children and adults in various age categories. The race takes place in early September and is known for its friendly atmosphere, accompanying program, and support for those in need. Every participant receives a race pack and a medal, while the best runners in each category win valuable prizes. The event also includes an autograph session and a fun quiz with prizes, contributing to a family-friendly atmosphere and community spirit.

name: Běh mezi mosty
description: The Run Between the Bridges is a charity sporting event organized by the Athelas Home Hospice and the Friends of the Stone Bridge in Písek Association. Reviving the tradition of the original race, it is for everyone who wants to support seriously ill patients and their families. Participants can run, walk, or make a symbolic contribution. The entry fee is a donation that helps provide care at home for those who can no longer run. The event takes place in Písek and offers a variety of routes, including children’s runs and family walks.

name: Jihlavský půlmaraton
location: Sportovně relaxační centrum Český mlýn, Jihlava, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 500 Kč na osobu při elektronickém přihlášení a bezhotovostní platbě.

description: The Jihlava Half Marathon is a traditional 21.0975 km race run over two laps in the Český mlýn Sports and Recreation Centre in Jihlava. The race is open to individuals, pairs and teams of four, and the course is officially measured and marked every kilometre. In addition to the main race, the programme includes children’s races, a family run and a 10 km race. The event features a wide range of activities for the whole family and supports Nikča, who is facing serious health problems.
course_highlights: Officially measured 21.0975 km course over two laps (10.54 km each)
Refreshment stations approximately every 3 km with water and isotonic drinks
Start and finish at the Český mlýn Sports and Recreation Centre in Jihlava
additional: The race bib includes a timing chip that does not need to be returned. Relay teams receive a chip at registration and return it after the race. Registration and race bib collection take place at Decathlon Jihlava on the Friday before the race and at the start venue on race day. Refreshments are available on the course, with more at the finish, along with accompanying activities including sports and entertainment for children. Parking is recommended at the free car parks at Kaufland, OBI, Albert Hypermarket and Vodní ráj. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the venue. The 2027 edition takes place on 5 September, with the start scheduled for 11:00. The programme also includes the Decathlon 10 km race and a family run. The event facilities are at the Český mlýn complex.

name: Horský čtvrtmaraton Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch
description: The Jablonné nad Orlicí–Suchý vrch Mountain Quarter Marathon is a mountain race taking place on 6 September 2026 in Jablonné nad Orlicí. The course climbs through mountain terrain to Suchý vrch and is part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running and the Krkonoše Cup in Hill Running. The race covers approximately 10 km with around 580 metres of elevation gain. The course challenges runners’ endurance and their ability to run on technical mountain terrain. Registration is available on site, and the race is intended for runners looking for a challenge in nature.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 9. kolo
description: The Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. The race is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans, who are divided into categories. Registration takes place on-site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the start at 10:00. The race is part of a series in which runners earn points toward the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Traveling Cup based on their performance and age.

name: Dukelský beh mieru
location: Svidník, Svidník, Štart: Dukliansky priesmyk, Cieľ: pešia zóna Svidník
description: The Dukla Run for Peace is one of the oldest and most significant running events in Slovakia, held every year on the first Sunday in September. The route runs from Dukla to the centre of Svidník and is 19 kilometres long, descending from 479 m above sea level at the start to 244 m above sea level at the finish. Runners follow a historic route associated with the Carpathian-Dukla Operation, commemorating the victims and the struggle for peace in 1944–1945. The event has a rich history and strong emotional significance, bringing together competitive runners and amateurs.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Srbsko
description: The Berounka Running Series in Srbsko is a community trail race run mostly along the Heart of the Bohemian Karst Nature Trail. The route starts at the railway station and passes over the Srbsko footbridge, by the Bubovice Waterfalls and through the Kačák Valley along the Berounka River to the finish. The race offers beautiful natural scenery, a friendly atmosphere, and on-site refreshments and storage for personal belongings. Each participant receives a race number, and the top three finishers in each category receive diplomas.

name: S kopečka do kopečka
description: The S kopečka do kopečka Run is a traditional endurance race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering runners the chance to test themselves on a challenging course in Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners series and is open to both recreational runners and competitive athletes. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for anyone looking to enjoy a run in beautiful surroundings and take on the challenge of hilly terrain.

name: Novostrašecký běh - Memoriál Vildy Šubrta
description: Novostrašecký běh – Vilda Šubrt Memorial is a traditional running race held in Nové Strašecí, featuring a 6 km course. The race takes place at the SK Nové Strašecí football stadium and in the surrounding area, on a mix of asphalt, field and forest paths. The main category is scheduled to start at 18:00. The race is suitable for the general public; adults pay an entry fee of 100 CZK, while children can take part for free. Online registration is available even on race day, making it easy to participate.

name: Geofyzikální běh
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Geophysical Run is a traditional running event organized by the Institute of Geophysics of the Czech Academy of Sciences. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4. The event has a long history dating back to 1985 and offers a sporting experience in nature with a scientific background. It is open to the general public and combines physical activity with the popularization of geophysics and the natural sciences.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 4 etapas
description: The Ukmergė Factory Cross-Country Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event featuring cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling, and rogaining competitions. The event encourages active leisure in nature and promotes sport among participants of all ages. The competitions take place in Ukmergė, and the main organizer is the public institution Sportas miške. Participants compete by age group and event type, with a mass start for all groups. The time limit for the competitions is 120 minutes, except for Mini Rogaining.

name: 7. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Run for Health is a charity series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that everyone can complete at their own pace. Proceeds from entry fees go to help those in need, giving the event purpose and added value. The start is traditionally at 17:45 at Lodičky, with registration beginning at 17:00. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.

name: Witzenmann Opavská míle
description: The Witzenmann Opava Mile is a prestigious one-mile (1609 m) running race that continues the tradition of the Stanislav Mikeska Memorial. The race is open to a wide range of participants, including professionals, amateurs, children, families, corporate and school teams, people with disabilities, and wheelchair users. It takes place in Opava and is supported by its presenting partner, Witzenmann Opava. The course record is held by Filip Sasínek, with a time of 3:55 minutes set in 2023. The race is held regularly and is one of the most significant running events in the Czech Republic.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Liberec
description: The Night Run for Světluška in Liberec is a charity running event held on September 10, 2026, at the Vesec sports complex. Participants can choose between a 3 km course (1 lap) and a 6 km course (2 laps), with the run starting at 8:00 p.m. The entry fee is 500 CZK, half of which supports the Světluška project and half of which goes toward direct assistance for people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program, including a concert, and race packs with a headlamp or sports headband for those who register early.

name: Běh Akátkami
description: Běh Akátkami is a regular running race in Brno-Židenice, with courses for men, women, and children. Men run 5.2 km (3 laps), women 3.6 km (2 laps), and children of any age have their own 1.6 km lap. The race takes place in the evening, with registration from 17:15 and the main race starting at 18:00. Refreshments and baggage storage are available after the finish. Participants compete at their own risk and can use public transport and parking nearby.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026
distance_verbose: 100 mil, 50 mil, Ultramaraton, Maraton, 24 km, Półmaraton, 10 km
description: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026 is a mountain trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Table Mountains, near Radków Reservoir. The courses pass through rocky mazes, technical trails, and beautiful rock formations such as Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały. The event attracts both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners, offering a range of distances and a unique atmosphere close to nature. Radków is an ideal place for a sporting adventure and a chance to recharge amid nature.

name: Ipsheimer Weinberglauf
location: Ipsheim, Neustadt an der Aisch-Bad Windsheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Ipsheim Vineyard Run is a traditional race held on the second Friday in September in the picturesque Ipsheim vineyards. It offers various events for schoolchildren and recreational runners, as well as the main race over a distance of approx. 5,800 m. The course is well marked and runs through the vineyards, offering a wonderful view of the Aisch Valley. After the race, participants can relax with refreshments and wine at the awards ceremony at the Weinberghaus. The race has become a sporting highlight, with almost 400 participants.
course_highlights: Race routes through the Ipsheim vineyards
Excellent views over the Aisch Valley in the finish area
Routes marked with colored arrows and distance markers
additional: Race number collection from 16:00 on race day in the start area below the Ipsheim vineyards. Race numbers must be worn on the front of the chest. All participants receive a high-quality technical T-shirt as a gift. Showers are available at the Ipsheim festival hall. Toilets are located in the start area and at the Weinberghaus. Free refreshments in the start area, during the main race, and at the finish. Clothing transport from the start to the finish for all races. Shuttle bus from the finish to the showers and the Weinberghaus, with shuttle service to the parking lot every half hour from 20:00. Parking at the start is available in a lit parking lot; parking in the vineyards is prohibited. Awards ceremony after the main race at the Weinberghaus, with wine and refreshments. Terrain in the vineyards, online registration, medals, T-shirts, refreshments, shuttle service, parking in Ipsheim

name: Emder Sparkassen Delftlauf
description: The Emder Sparkassen Delftlauf takes place on September 11, 2026, at Hafentor in Emden and is organised by Emder Laufgemeinschaft e.V. The event offers 6-kilometre and 10-kilometre runs, as well as 6-kilometre walking/Nordic walking. The course runs through the city of Emden and is conducted in accordance with the International Competition Rules. Timing is provided using a chip supplied by the organiser, and certificates are awarded to the three fastest women and men. The race is open to everyone, including unaffiliated participants.

name: Lauf der Bildung Aschersleben
description: The Lauf der Bildung in Aschersleben is a family-friendly city race on Friday evening, starting and finishing at Augustapromenade. The course passes through the historic city wall area and offers distances of 2.3 km, 4.6 km and 9.2 km for children, recreational runners and ambitious runners completing multiple laps. The event is part of the Solvay Cup and attracts both club runners and local families. The atmosphere is small and welcoming, and the event is well organised by the Kreisvolkshochschule Aschersleben.

name: Prajzské kilo
description: Prajzské kilo is an ultratrail race through the Hlučínsko region, recalling the historic borders and stories of a region divided in 1742. The race offers three distances—30, 50 and 100 km—with different time limits and elevation gains. You’ll run through a landscape of old roads, chapels and field tracks, bearing the traces of history and the identity of local residents. The race counts toward the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and also offers points for the UTMB Index and ITRA. Participants receive a unique medal and T-shirt, with refreshments along the course and at the finish. Childcare is available for the shorter distances.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines the excitement of sport with meaningful support for an important social cause: the mental health of children and young people. The event will take place across Poland on 12 September 2026, inviting participants to run together and take action for their communities. Every lap, kilometre and minute on the course matters, highlighting the spirit of community and support. This anniversary edition invites runners to take part and show their support.

name: Bieg 7 Dolin
description: Bieg 7 Dolin is a 100 km mountain ultramarathon held in the scenic Sądecki Beskids, starting and finishing in Piwniczna-Zdrój. The course follows challenging mountain trails with significant elevation gain, offering participants exceptional views and a chance to connect with nature. The race is part of the Running Festival, which combines sporting competition with promoting the region and an active lifestyle. The time limit for completing the course is 19 hours, and aid stations and drop bags are available along the route. It is a challenge for experienced mountain runners looking to take on demanding but beautiful terrain.

name: IX Bieg o Puchar Miasteczka Siewierz Jeziorna
5 Aktywna Piątka
description: The 5th edition of the “Aktywna Piątka” run will take place on September 12, 2026, in Frydek, in the Miedźna Municipality. This is a fast road race on a course exactly 5 km long, certified by the Polish Athletic Association, starting at 11:00. The event will also host the Silesian Voivodeship Championships in the 5 km, and the participant limit is 600. An accompanying Family Run for children and young people up to age 15 will be held over three distances.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing runners from different regions together. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability, and participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross. The races take place on forest and urban routes, creating a welcoming atmosphere of sporting competition and community. The Grand Prix is a long-standing tradition and passion that brings runners together year after year.

name: Bieg przez Most – Białołęcka Triada Biegowa
II Ćwiartka Drzymały
location: Miasteczko Krajeńskie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Leszczyński Festiwal Sportu – Półmaraton Leszczyński C&C Partners
Orawski Półmaraton Rysim Tropem
location: Lipnica Wielka, Nowy Targ County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIII Razem do Celu
location: Oleszka, Zdzieszowice Municipality, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Sieroszewice
location: Sieroszewice, Sieroszewice Municipality, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVIII Bieg Papieski
location: Służewo, Aleksandrów Kujawski County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Volvo Tierparklauf
description: The Volvo Tierparklauf takes place on September 12 and 13, 2026, at Tierpark Berlin. It is especially family-friendly and suitable for beginner runners. The route leads through the zoo, past various animals such as monkeys and flamingos, creating a unique atmosphere. Participants and accompanying persons receive free admission. The event is part of the popular Berlin läuft! series and is known for its animal-themed atmosphere and comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: Route through Tierpark Berlin with views of monkeys, flamingos and other animals
Free admission to Tierpark Berlin for participants and accompanying persons
Running festival for the whole family at the event venue
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the shoe. Participants receive a comprehensive starter pack, with refreshment stations, toilets, an online certificate and free admission to the zoo. Groups of 15 or more receive a 10% discount and can collect their race materials together. Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start. Optional extras such as event shirts, medal engraving and HD finish-line videos can be booked. Free admission, run through Tierpark Berlin, family-friendly, route past animals

name: Freiberger Herbstlauf
location: Platz der Einheit, Freiberg, Saxony, Germany
description: The Freiberg Autumn Run is a traditional race through Freiberg’s municipal forest, starting at Platz der Einheit on September 12, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. The varied program offers races for the whole family, including Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, several running distances from 2 km to the half marathon, as well as a corporate relay and the Einfach?Mensch!Lauf. The varied routes pass through the surrounding forests and include some climbs, making the race especially appealing.
course_highlights: Route through Freiberg’s municipal forest
Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports facility
Varied routes with some climbs
additional: Events for the whole family, including Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, a corporate relay and a unicycle race. Various distances from 400 m to the half marathon. Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports facility. Multiple events, including the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, children’s races, Nordic walking, a unicycle race and team competitions; the venue is the municipal forest and Platz der Einheit.

name: Lauf in den Herbst
description: The Putzbrunn Autumn Run is a DLV-approved public race organized by the sports club’s gymnastics department. It offers running opportunities for all age groups and ability levels, with distances from 1.5 km to 10.7 km. A special feature is the inclusive nature of the race, which welcomes people with different abilities. Alongside sporting competition, the event emphasizes community and the fun of running.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, and 10.7 km
Inclusive race with participants from Lebenshilfe and Frame Runner
Age-group rankings and team rankings
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 12:00 at the Putzbrunn triple gymnasium. Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective race. Certificates will be handed out on site and made available as PDFs the following day. Special prizes are awarded to the fastest runners and the oldest participants. Refreshments and changing facilities are available on site. Courses are available for different age groups; registration by email; no advance registration required.

name: Schwarzenbacher Ausdauertag 2026
location: Sportzentrum Turnerheim, Schwarzenbach an der Saale, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Schwarzenbach Endurance Day on September 12, 2026, offers a varied program of running and walking events for all age groups. From the Bambini Run and schoolchildren’s race to the Fun Run, 10 km race and half marathon, there is something for every ability level. The start and finish are at the Turnerheim Sports Center in Schwarzenbach an der Saale. Refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area provide water and bananas; at the finish, participants can enjoy a sports buffet with fruit, water and cake. Timing is done using a disposable chip in the race bib, except for the Fun Run and Bambini Run.
course_highlights: A variety of running and walking events for all age groups
Start and finish at the Turnerheim Sports Center
Refreshment stations with water and bananas along the course and in the finish area
additional: Online registration opens on June 1, 2026. Timing is done using a disposable chip in the race bib (except for the Fun Run and Bambini Run). A sports buffet with fruit, water and cake is available at the finish. Registration opens on June 1, 2026; on-site registration is also possible. The event takes place in the Upper Franconia region and offers a mix of running and walking courses as well as a family-friendly supporting program.

name: 10-Teiche-Marathon
description: The 10 Ponds Marathon in Hahnenklee is a scenic marathon held in September as part of the HarzerWanderWochen. The course takes runners through the Upper Harz, offering the chance to experience the region’s natural beauty and numerous ponds. The event is part of a ten-day hiking program featuring a variety of activities and live music. The marathon is a special challenge for runners who appreciate combining athletic achievement with enjoying nature.

name: 3. Wunstorfer Citylauf
description: The Wunstorf City Run is a running event in the city center of Wunstorf, organized by TuS Wunstorf. The race starts and finishes in front of the town church, which serves as the event hub. There are various distances, from a 400-meter Bambini run and several children’s and youth races to the 10-kilometer main race. The course is a 1,400-meter loop through the city center, run a different number of times or in a modified format depending on age group and distance. The City Run thus offers suitable races for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Fichtl-Fun-Run
description: The Fichtl-Fun-Run is an annual running event in Fichtenberg that is aimed particularly at children aged 6 to 11. Training for the run includes playful activities, running games, obstacle courses, and athletic exercises, held both outdoors and in the community hall. The event promotes community and enjoyment of sport in a family-friendly atmosphere. The run is organized by Sportkameradschaft Fichtenberg e.V., a long-established club with a wide range of sports.

name: Freisinger Volksfestlauf 2026
description: The Freising Volksfest Run 2026 is organized by LC Freising e.V. and takes place on September 12, 2026, in Freising. The exact route has not yet been finalized; it will either run through the town center or directly around the Volksfest grounds. The race is a popular event that combines tradition with a sporting challenge. Further information will be announced in due course.

name: KlosterLauf Wiedenbrück
description: The KlosterLauf in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a special running event taking place for the fourth time on September 12, 2026. The start and finish are at Wiedenbrück Monastery, and the races follow two scenic circuits through the city. The event is aimed both at ambitious runners and at everyone who enjoys the camaraderie and fun of running. Community and the joy of running are at the heart of this sporting highlight.

name: Neubrandenburger Staffelmarathon (LC/NLC)
description: The Neubrandenburg Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay event taking place on September 12, 2026, in Neubrandenburg. The event is hosted by SV Turbine Neubrandenburg e.V. and gives runners the opportunity to cover the marathon distance together as teams. The start is at 9:30 a.m., and the event runs until approximately 2:30 p.m. The club’s running group organizes the event and looks forward to welcoming many participants.

name: Rudelsburglauf
description: The Rudelsburglauf is a long-standing running event along the Rudelsburg near Bad Kösen, organized by LG Rudelsburg 1995 Bad Kösen e.V. The race takes place annually and gives runners of all ability levels the opportunity to experience the beautiful local region together. The event is a highlight in the club’s calendar and combines a sporting challenge with an experience of nature. Information about the race details and registration is published in good time before the event.

name: Run of Hope
description: The Run of Hope is an annual charity event in Kronach that brings together runners of all ages to fight cancer together. The event offers various distances, including Nordic walking and a fun run, and takes place on the LGS grounds in Kronach. Starting at 12:00, participants can enjoy a sporting yet supportive atmosphere made possible by generous sponsors and dedicated volunteers. The race combines athletic effort with social commitment and invites everyone to make a difference with every step.

name: Schledehausener Berglauf
description: The Schledehausener Berglauf is a 10-hour hill-running event in Schledehausen, part of Bissendorf, Germany. The race starts and finishes at the Schledehausen sports hall. The goal is to climb and descend a short hill as many times as possible, accumulating the most elevation gain within the time limit. The course is 700 metres long and has an elevation gain of 32 metres, with an average gradient of 10%. There are individual, relay and team categories. Omas on Tour organises the race as a charity event in support of HelpAge Deutschland e. V.

name: Spiegelsbergelauf
description: The Spiegelsbergelauf on September 12, 2026, in Halberstadt offers varied race distances for all ability levels. The 14 km course leads over the Gläserner Mönch and is a real challenge with its elevation gain and terrain. The 8 km loop around the Jagdschlösschen combines speed and nature, while the 4 km course through the Spiegelsberge is an inviting introduction to competitive running. The youngest participants can take part in a 400 m fun run. The event is organized by SwimBikeRun Halberstadt e.V. and takes place at the Sportanlage Friedensstadion.

name: SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL
description: The SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL is a welcoming trail race in the beautiful surroundings of Suhl, celebrating its anniversary edition on September 12, 2026. The route follows some winding paths away from the main artery of the Thuringian Forest, passing clear streams, dark valleys and glistening mountain ridges. The event offers an unforgettable experience in nature with spectacular views and is part of the SüHLER BÜCHSEN CUP. Finishers of the longer distances receive ITRA/UTMB® qualifying points.

name: ULTRAMARATHON DM im 100km-Straßenlauf
description: The 38th German 100 km Ultramarathon Championship takes place on September 12, 2026, at Wartenberg Stadium in Berlin-Wartenberg. This road race is a demanding long-distance event that requires endurance and mental strength. The event is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and offers an official championship atmosphere under the auspices of the German Athletics Association. Participants can look forward to professional organization and an athletic challenge.

name: Unstrutlauf
description: The Unstrut Run is a versatile running event in Dingelstädt, offering suitable distances for all ability levels, from 2 km to the half marathon (21.1 km). The varied routes follow the Unstrut and feature scenic highlights, paved cycle paths and short climbs. Drinks, fruit and bratwurst are provided. All proceeds are donated to charitable projects in the region, giving the event a special social character.

name: Niedermeiserer Dorflauf
description: The Niedermeiser Village Run is a running event organized by TSV 1864 Niedermeiser e.V. and takes place on September 12, 2026, in Liebenau/Niedermeiser. The races run around Bodenberg, with distances ranging from 400 meters to 18.5 kilometers. There are also walking and Nordic walking events over various distances. The start and finish are at the sports field in Niedermeiser, where race materials are also distributed. The event is approved by the Hessian Athletics Association and is held in accordance with the applicable regulations.

name: REHAmed Herkules-Berglauf
description: The REHAmed Herkules Mountain Run is a challenging mountain race through Wilhelmshöhe Mountain Park in Kassel, running almost entirely on paved natural trails. The course passes numerous landmarks, including Löwenburg and Steinhöfer Waterfall, and finishes at the Hercules Monument. The race is open to runners and walkers and offers both individual and three-person team relay categories, ideal for families, clubs and companies. Changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Reform School gym, and transport for clothing to the finish is arranged.

name: Okolo Kolovrat
description: The Run Around Kolovraty is a traditional race that takes you through the beautiful surroundings of Kolovraty, including the neighboring municipalities of Uhříněves and Lipany, as well as part of Říčany. It offers 11 km and 21 km routes, with the shorter distance also available as a two-person relay. The routes run mainly along tree-lined field, meadow, and forest paths, promising a wonderful running experience in nature. The race is suitable for all runners looking to improve their time or set a personal course record.

name: ČEZ RunTour Brno
description: ČEZ RunTour Brno is a family-friendly running event held near the Brno Reservoir, offering courses for all ages, from children to experienced runners. Choose from distances of 500 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21.1 km). The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, excellent facilities, and activities for the whole family. Every participant receives a race pack and contributes to charity. ČEZ RunTour is an ideal opportunity for recreational and elite runners alike to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of the Brno Reservoir.

name: Běh na Boží horu
description: The Run up Boží hora is a traditional race in Ivančice, challenging participants to climb 109 steps to Boží hora. Runners set off individually at one-minute intervals, ensuring a smooth race. The event is part of the wide range of activities organized by the Ivančice Leisure Centre, which has a long tradition and the support of the city. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a unique sporting experience in an attractive setting.

name: Běh Kovohutěmi
description: Běh Kovohutěmi is a traditional running race held in Lhota u Příbramě since 1967. The event features a 12 km main course as well as races for children and young people. It takes place at the TJ Kovohutě stadium and is popular with runners of all ages. Every year, it attracts many participants and is part of the Brdy Running Cup.

name: Strojařská desítka
location: Správa údržby silnic Zlínského kraje, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Strojařská desítka is a traditional road race in Zlín, now held for the 42nd year. The race offers 10 km and 5 km courses with 153 metres of elevation gain on a certified out-and-back route between Zlín’s Maják, the U Boudy crossroads, Salaš and back. The start is always at 10 a.m. by the headquarters of the Road Maintenance Administration on K Majáku Street. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all categories who want to compete in the beautiful surroundings of Zlín.

name: Běh přátelství Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Klenčí pod Čerchovem–Waldmünchen Friendship Run is part of the Běžec Chodska running series, which offers a diverse range of races in the Chodsko region. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem and attracts runners of all ages. The course is suitable for those who enjoy nature and trail running, while the race atmosphere encourages friendly gatherings among the running community. The Běžec Chodska series is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, ensuring an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Bezdězský půlmaraton
description: The Bezděz Half Marathon is a running race held in the picturesque Máchův kraj region around Bezděz Castle. It offers two routes of approximately 13.6 km and 21.2 km, with elevation gains of 200 to 300 metres, along forest roads, trails and short stretches of asphalt. The race is suitable for the general public and also includes children’s races. Refreshments, baggage storage, toilets, and an awards ceremony with a raffle are available at the venue. The field is limited to 500 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities.

name: 7 pohoří Krkonoše
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races offer technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. Whether you’re an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains will test your strength, willpower, and determination. Conquer all seven mountain ranges and become a trail-running legend.

name: Běh k Mohyle Hanče a Vrbaty
description: The Run to the Hanč and Vrbata Cairn is a traditional mountain race held in the Krkonoše Mountains. It starts at the White Bridge over the Elbe in Špindlerův Mlýn and finishes at the Hanč and Vrbata Cairn. The 9 km route, with 696 metres of elevation gain, runs mostly on asphalt and trails, offering beautiful views and unforgettable experiences. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners across different age categories. After the race, refreshments and a raffle are available, and public transport can be used to return from the finish.

name: ČEZ RunTour Ostrava
location: Dolní Vítkovice, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: Nočný beh mestom Lučenec
description: The Night Run Through Lučenec is a night race along the illuminated streets of Lučenec, covering a distance of 4.5 km. The event is open to the general public, including juniors and adults, with categories by age and gender. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad and takes place near the Synagogue, with electronic timing and chip technology. The start is scheduled for 19:30. Participants can expect a commemorative medal, a race number, refreshments, and an accompanying program.

name: Školáčik detský beh
description: Školáčik Children’s Run is a running event for children of various age groups, held in Lučenec near the synagogue. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad. The race is open to boys and girls aged 3 to 15 inclusive, including children with disabilities. The entry fee is symbolic and encourages children to take part in sports activities in the pleasant surroundings of the city.

name: Beh okolo Lysej
location: Lysá pod Makytou okr. Púchov, Lysá pod Makytou okr. Púchov, pri kultúrnom dome
description: Beh okolo Lysej is a traditional running race in the village of Lysá pod Makytou, offering various categories for children, juniors, women, and men by age. The race takes place by the cultural centre and is organised by Bežecký klub Lysá pod Makytou. The children’s start is at 11:00, categories E, women, and juniors start at 12:30, and men start at 13:00. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky
description: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky is a night trail race in the beautiful wine-growing region of Topoľčianky, taking place on 12 September 2026. Runners will enjoy routes passing by Topoľčianky Castle and Hrušov Castle, with forest paths and an atmosphere under the stars. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the international UTMB Index, adding to its prestige. There are two main distances to compete in—11 km and 22 km—and the course also features a Conti Speed Section, where a valuable prize is up for grabs.

name: Marina Liptov RUN
location: Bobrovník, okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Bobrovník, okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Marina Liptov
organizer: Olympijský klub Liptova a rezort Marina Liptov
description: Marina Liptov RUN is a sports and leisure event set in the beautiful surroundings of the Marina Liptov resort near Liptovská Mara. This unique run combines nature with quality services in harmony with the four elements—fire, water, earth, and air. Runners can enjoy a peaceful and inspiring setting with views of the surrounding countryside and the chance to relax at the resort after the race. Marina Liptov is an ideal destination for athletes and families looking for an outdoor experience.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 3. Jesenné kolo
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany
description: The Lemešany Running League – 3rd Autumn Round is a running competition held in the village of Lemešany, in the beautiful surroundings of the Garden of Movement. The race is open to all age groups and ability levels, offering a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to enjoy sports outdoors. It is organised by the Garden of Movement, which provides quality facilities for sport and recreation.

name: Beh pre Labky jesenný špeciál
location: Košice, Košice, Košice - časť Kavečany, chata Hrešná
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: The Run for Paws Autumn Special is a running event in Kavečany, Košice, near Hrešná Cottage, organised by the Union for Mutual Assistance of People and Dogs (UVP). The race is open to various categories, including women, men, children, and runners with dogs, including shelter dogs. The 5 km course offers a pleasant autumn atmosphere surrounded by nature. Registration is available online at a discounted price and on site for a higher fee. The event supports dog adoption and brings runners and animals together in a friendly setting.

name: Night run Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, R M s.r.o.
description: Night Run Michalovce is a night running race held at Námestie osloboditeľov in Michalovce. The race offers three distances: 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km, suitable for different age groups and performance levels. The adult race starts at 19:00, and the children’s races begin at 17:00. The organizers are Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, and R M s.r.o. The race is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the city at night.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two 5 km laps, for a total distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Center for Social Activity and aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local running community together. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting automotive events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants can take part in competitive racing, training sessions, and qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at automotive enthusiasts and also offers car rentals and one-on-one training with instructors. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of motorsport and improve your skills on a professional track.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
