description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are charity races organized in Środa Wielkopolska, supporting the work of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social cause, engaging the local community and the legal profession. It is an established tradition that promotes physical activity and solidarity.

name: XRUN - Vistula Trail
description: Vistula Trail is a mountain trail race held in Wisła, offering a variety of distances, from short routes for children to challenging mountain courses. Runners can enjoy scenic views of the Beskids, starting either in the center of Wisła or on the Czech side in Třinec. The routes pass notable landmarks such as Soszów Wielki, the Soszów Mountain Shelter, and Czantoria, combining an international adventure with the character of the Beskids. This event is for mountain-running enthusiasts who value variety and the beauty of the natural landscape.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km course runs along the city’s main thoroughfares, including the area around Jasna Góra, giving the race a distinctive prestige. The course is officially certified, attracting runners aiming for a fast pace and personal bests. It’s an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in a picturesque urban setting.

name: Bieg na Skałę
organizer: Centrum Kultury, Sportu i Rekreacji w Skale
description: Bieg na Skałę is a unique sporting event that combines physical activity with the natural beauty of Ojców National Park. The race route follows scenic paths and hills, offering participants varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky sections, and steep climbs. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to enjoy a sense of adventure and the fresh air. After the race, participants can look forward to commemorative medals, prizes, and a range of activities, including games for children. The event takes place in a friendly, sporty atmosphere.

name: Chyża 10
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and is part of the Nowy Tomyśl County Grand Prix series of running events. The race starts at 9:00, and the race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared course.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Północy XI Maraton Bieg Czterech Latarni
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: The Northern Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on September 13, 2026, on the Hel Peninsula, bringing together the Northern Marathon and Marathon Relays under one banner. The course passes through the scenic locations of Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, along Puck Bay, with sea views and four lighthouses that give the race its distinctive character. The event offers a range of distances for runners of all abilities, from the marathon and relays to the half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km, as well as a children’s race—the Little Lighthouse Keeper Run. It is not only a sporting event, but also a journey through the beautiful corners of the coast and an opportunity to connect with nature.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The 15th Damak Half Marathon in Tarczyn is a family celebration of running, guaranteeing a great atmosphere and unforgettable experiences. The half-marathon course winds through picturesque fields, forests, and apple orchards, giving the race a unique character. The event attracts runners of all ages and also offers races for children and youth. The organizers look after participants by providing attractive race packs and support from sponsors.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
description: The Radom Sobriety Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The races take place on the scenic trails of the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, giving participants the opportunity to compete in the marathon, half marathon and other accompanying races. The marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and sobriety, while also bringing together the local running community. This event has a well-established tradition and attracts both amateur and experienced runners.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów on the Run is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cycling Association, taking place on September 13, 2026, by the Żyrardów Reservoir. Participants can choose between two distances: 10 km and 5 km, both running around the reservoir in multiple laps and finishing on the reservoir grounds. The event promotes physical activity, community, and a friendly sporting atmosphere, while also helping promote the city of Żyrardów and the Mazovia region. The race is open to adults, and athletes using active wheelchairs may also take part in the 10 km race.

name: 32. Międzynarodowy Bieg Uliczny o Puchar Przewodniczącego Rady Miejskiej
Biegaj razem z nami
location: Zebrzydowice, Cieszyn County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: II Bieg Tropem Wilka
location: Korpele, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: III Palmirski Bieg Pamięci Janusza Kusocińskiego
XII Bieg Marchewkowy
location: Zielonki, Kraków County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVIII Bieg o Puchar Burmistrza Miasta i Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie
location: Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XX EKO Bieg po Dolinie Będkowskiej
Internationaler Altenaulauf
description: The International Altenau Run in Borchen is a traditional running event organised by SC Borchen 1926/32, Athletics Department. The race takes place annually and is part of the Hochstift Cup. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also demonstrates social commitment: coffee and cake are offered free of charge, and donations are collected for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels an attractive platform.
course_highlights: Part of the Hochstift Cup
A variety of distances for different age groups
Traditional race with a social commitment
additional: Coffee and cake are offered free of charge at the cake stall. Donations are collected for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V. Runners can register for distances online; the event also includes social activities such as coffee and cake and fundraising for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V.

name: 6. DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused extreme experience in the wooded Deister hills near Springe. The event offers running and walking routes of 10 km, 21.1 km (half marathon) and 42.2 km (marathon), with challenging climbs, including the Deisterhölle, with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with aid stations, places to sit and filled rolls for walkers. The event is all about consideration for others and enjoying nature, with awards for the fastest runners and a finisher’s gift as a souvenir.
course_highlights: Deisterhölle with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch
Marathon walk with an additional climb to Bielstein and the Deister ridge
Aid stations with places to sit and filled rolls
additional: Race bib collection from 7:15 a.m. at IGS Springe. Chip timing with a rental chip; return the chip to receive a wheat beer glass as a finisher’s gift. Showers and changing rooms in the IGS Springe sports hall. Parking at IGS, netto and BZE. Travel by S5 to Springe station, then a 10-minute walk to the Nord school centre. Awards ceremonies: 10 km and half marathon at 12:00, marathon at 14:30. Sew-on patches for walkers. Trail event with challenging terrain, refreshments at aid stations, and options for runners and walkers.

name: Braker hkk Lauf
description: The 19th Braker hkk Run takes place on September 13, 2026, in Brake (Unterweser). It is a short running race with distances of 850 meters and 10 kilometers. The race offers a pleasant opportunity to run in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. Please check the exact event details directly with the organizer.
course_highlights: Distances: 850 m and 10 km
Typical September weather with approx. 19°C and 45 mm of precipitation
Start location in Brake (Unterweser)
additional: The race offers two distances: 850 meters and 10 kilometers. September weather is typically mild and cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event usually takes place in pleasant temperatures of around 19°C. Participants should check the latest details with the organizer before registering.

name: Kiel Lauf
description: The Kiel.Lauf is a long-established running event in Kiel, with various competitions for all age groups. The main event is the half marathon, covering 21.1 kilometers through western Kiel and attracting both recreational runners and elite athletes. The 10.2-kilometer fun run is the event’s largest race by participation and offers a lap through Kiel city center with a great atmosphere. There are also shorter races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: The half marathon runs across western Kiel
The fun run goes through Kiel city center
A range of distances from approx. 0.7 km to 21.1 km
additional: The half marathon starts at 10:50 a.m. and the fun run at 09:45 a.m. Due to construction work, short-notice course changes may occur and will be announced in good time. The event is very popular, with more than 10,000 runners. There are various races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly. The event includes street closures and participant information, and offers technical running shirts for most categories.

name: Othaler Gutshof Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Othaler Gutshoflauf is a young but popular running event starting and finishing at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal. The event offers distances ranging from 0.5 km to the 21.1 km half marathon, which is known as the Intersport Liebig Half Marathon and passes through several villages. The race gives participants the chance to explore the eastern foothills of the Harz on varied routes. Around 350 runners take part each year, highlighting the event’s growing popularity.
course_highlights: Half marathon route through Sotterhausen, Holdenstedt, Klosterrode and Beyernaumburg
Start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal
Distances ranging from 0.5 km to 21.1 km
additional: Start times: 09:00 half marathon, 09:45 10 km run/walk, 10:00 5 km run/walk, 10:05 0.5 km run, 10:15 1 km run, 10:30 2 km children’s race. Routes for children, recreational runners and competitive runners; start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm in Othal; supported by sponsors such as Intersport Liebig and Autohaus Liebe.

name: Rathaus Center Dessauer CityRUN
description: The 26th Dessauer Rathaus-Center CityRUN is a long-standing race in downtown Dessau that has attracted runners from the region and beyond for many years. The route follows a circuit through the city’s central streets, with the start and finish on Zerbster Straße near the Rathaus-Center. The race offers a sporting challenge in an urban setting and is part of a varied sports programme organised by Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising major sporting events in the region for decades.
course_highlights: Circuit through downtown Dessau
Start and finish on Zerbster Straße at the Rathaus-Center
Route along Steinstraße, Askanische Straße and Kavalierstraße
additional: Volksbank children’s race for children up to 9 years old over 1,000 metres, free for all children and schoolchildren from Dessau. The organiser is Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising numerous major sporting events in the region for over 20 years. Various distances, including children’s races; company race; on-site registration available; finisher medals

name: Sindiso-Spendenlauf
location: Hof von Walter Jahn, Zeitlarn, Bavaria, Germany
price_range: 20 Euro für Laufshirt, Spenden ab 20 Euro für Teilnahme
description: The Sindiso Charity Run on 13 September 2026 in Zeitlarn is a community event combining running, celebration and fundraising. The event takes place at Walter Jahn’s farm and offers runs for all ages, along with a colourful festival featuring lots of attractions for children. Alongside the sporting experience, the event focuses on supporting the education project in Rabuor, Kenya. Food and drinks will be available, and there will be a range of entertainment, including a children’s train, face painting and vehicle displays.
course_highlights: 10 km run consisting of 2 laps of 5 km each
Attractions for children, including a children’s train and face painting
Vehicle displays by the Neutraubling Water Rescue Service, Laub Volunteer Fire Brigade and BRK Barbing/Neutraubling
additional: The Sindiso running shirt can be purchased for €20 on race day after ordering through the online registration. Runs are available for different age groups and disciplines, including a 400 m toddlers’ farm run, a 1.5 km children’s run, a 5 km run, a 10 km run and 5 km Nordic walking. The event kicks off with a big party from 11:00 a.m. and offers a wide range of food and a colourful programme of activities. 10 km run (2 x 5 km), family activities, children’s programme, vehicle display, donations to the education project in Kenya

name: Volksbank-Münster-Marathon
description: The Volksbank-Münster-Marathon is a major running event organized by runners for runners, largely by volunteers and with great dedication. With around 12,000 participants, more than 300 artists and bands, and over 100,000 spectators along the course, this autumn marathon offers a unique atmosphere. The course is almost entirely flat and runs through the running- and cycling-friendly city of Münster. A red carpet is rolled out in the finish area on Prinzipalmarkt, making the finish a special experience.
course_highlights: Almost entirely flat course
More than 300 artists and bands along the course
Finish on a red carpet at Prinzipalmarkt
additional: The marathon is part of a major event featuring several races, including the Atruvia Staffelmarathon, Wecker-28 (28 km), Stadtwerke-Kids Marathon, Westfalen AG Charity-Lauf (10 km), and H+B technics-Gesundheitslauf (6 km). There is a combined ranking with the Enschede Marathon. The marathon office is open on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 9:00 to 15:00. A marathon guide with general information and FAQs is available. The marathon attracts around 12,000 runners, offers qualification opportunities for other races, and is supported by numerous sponsors. There are also accompanying events such as talks and health seminars.

name: Waldlauf des TuS Calle-Wallen - Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup
description: The 46th TuS Calle-Wallen Forest Run is part of the Volksbank Sauerland Running Cup and takes place on September 13, 2026, in Meschede. The event offers 1 km and 10 km races and is open to runners of all age groups. The race runs through the wooded areas around Meschede and promises a varied course in a natural setting. September weather is typically mild and mostly cloudy, ideal for running events.
course_highlights: Run through the wooded areas around Meschede
1 km and 10 km distances
Natural setting and varied course
additional: Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with lows of about 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation; skies are mostly cloudy. The event takes place in Meschede, where typical weather is around 19 °C with cloudy skies. It is a great opportunity for the whole family to take part in a traditional race.

name: Wemdinger Stadtlauf
description: The Wemding City Run invites runners of all ages to explore Wemding’s historic old town and the scenic countryside on the edge of the Ries. A special highlight is the panoramic run to the Maria Brünnlein pilgrimage church, combining sporting challenges with impressive views. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and welcomes both experienced runners and beginners. Timing is handled electronically using transponders in the race bibs, and an awards ceremony takes place on the stage at the market square.
course_highlights: Run through Wemding’s historic old town
Panoramic run to the Maria Brünnlein pilgrimage church, with views across the Ries
Start and finish at the market square in the town centre
additional: Race-pack collection and late entries are available on the event day until 30 minutes before each start at the race office in the Geopark Information Centre at the market square. The children’s run has no timing or results list; all children’s and school races receive medals. Timing for the other races is handled using transponders in the race bibs. Parking is available at Johannisweiher, with access via Wolferstädter Straße. Various race distances, medals, non-cash prizes, group prizes, children’s and school races, group training before the event.

name: 17. Parklauf Tangerhütte
description: The 17th Park Run Tangerhütte takes place in the idyllic Tangerhütte City Park and is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP race series in the north of Saxony-Anhalt. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including 1.1 km for young runners, 2.9 km for youth, and 5.4 km and 10.3 km for adults. The routes pass around Spiegelsee and by sights such as the New Palace and the Mausoleum. In the finish area, SV Germania Tangerhütte provides refreshments for participants, including grilled food, drinks, fruit, coffee, and cake.

name: 21. swb-Marathon Bremen
description: The 21st swb-Marathon Bremen takes place on September 13, 2026, and offers runners a varied running experience through Bremen. The start and finish are on Bremen’s Market Square. The course passes well-known sights such as Werdersee, Weserwehr, Rhododendron-Park, the University, Bürgerpark, Überseestadt and Schlachte, and ends with a run through Weserstadion. In addition to the marathon, there is also an AOK Half Marathon, a HIRSCH 10 km race and an AOK children’s race. The event is aimed at beginners and experienced runners alike and promises an unforgettable day of sport, with a great atmosphere and support from spectators.

name: 43. Internationalen Airport Race
description: The 43rd International Airport Race in Hamburg takes place on September 13, 2026, and offers a varied running experience around Hamburg Airport. The 10-mile race traditionally starts at 11:00 a.m. at the LSV sports facility on Borsteler Chaussee. In addition to the main 10-mile race, there are also 5 km races and the Mini Airport Race. The unique airport setting provides ever-changing views and a special atmosphere.

name: DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused endurance event that combines running and walking in the outstanding natural surroundings of the forested Deister mountain range. The event offers 10 km, 21.1 km, and 42.2 km courses for runners and walkers. The challenging routes pass through the Deisterhölle, including a continuous 200-meter elevation gain, and offer a unique nature and mountain experience near Hanover. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with participants looking out for one another, and offers aid stations, finisher gifts, and an awards ceremony in addition to the sporting challenge.

name: Dübener Heidelauf
description: The Dübener Heide Run is a traditional forest race held at the scenic Obermühle in Bad Düben, a spa town in northern Saxony. The event is organized by SV Bad Düben and offers courses for children, teenagers, and adults. With distances ranging from 500 m to the half marathon (21.1 km), the race appeals to both young runners and experienced long-distance athletes. It is part of the regional athletics structure for northern Saxony and Leipzig and is known for its family-friendly, club-oriented character.

name: ebm-papst Marathon
description: The ebm-papst Marathon in Niedernhall is a long-standing running event taking place for the 29th time on September 12 and 13, 2026. The event offers various disciplines, including the marathon, half marathon, duo marathon, relay marathon, 10 km run, handbike and inline skating events, as well as children’s races and Nordic walking. The course winds through the region’s scenic landscape and offers a varied experience for runners of all ability levels. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied program of entertainment, childcare and a pasta party. Every finisher receives a medal and can download a free finish-line photo.

name: Eicklinger Volks- und Familielauf
description: The 1st Eicklingen Community and Family Run is aimed at active families who want to spend an enjoyable day running together. The focus is on fun and the joy of running, without the pressure of competition. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for all age groups and encourages people to get active together.

name: Garbenteicher Volkslauf
description: The Garbenteich Volkslauf, organized by Sportverein 1928 Garbenteich e.V., is a traditional race in Pohlheim, known as a good training run for the Frankfurt Marathon. The course has been optimized for safety, so it no longer crosses any federal highways or railway lines. There are seven refreshment stations offering water, cola and tea, and excellent refreshments await participants after the race. Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 08:00 or the day before at the Sport- und Kulturhalle Garbenteich.

name: Holzlandlauf
description: The Holzlandlauf is a traditional race in the Holzland region near Hermsdorf, held every year on the second Saturday in September. Starting in 2026, the race will be part of the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), giving the courses international recognition and making runners’ performances visible worldwide. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 11 km and a half marathon, through the beautiful natural landscape of the Holzland. The race welcomes both ambitious trail runners and recreational runners and offers a special atmosphere in the region.

name: Kristall Lauf Weißwasser
description: The Kristall-Lauf Weißwasser is a versatile popular race that welcomes runners and walkers of all ages. The course crosses mixed terrain, including asphalt, concrete, sand paths and forest trails with roots. The race is part of several regional competitions, including the Bezirksrangliste Dresden, the Sachsenenergie Läufer-Cup and the Niederlausitz-Cup. It also offers an official walking competition recognized by the German Athletics Association. A special feature is the traditional team race, which encourages community and team spirit.

name: Miltenberger Landkreis Lauftag
description: The Miltenberg District Running Day on September 13, 2026, offers a variety of races for different age and ability groups. The routes run through the Elsenfeld State Forest and along the former Spessart steam railway line, with scenic and mostly flat sections. All participants receive T-shirts, and the top runners are honored with prizes in kind. The event is ideal for runners looking for a well-organized race in a natural setting.

name: Run for life
description: Run for Life is a charity race established in 2001 in support of Münchner Aids-Hilfe e.V. The 26th edition of this DLV-approved public race will take place on September 13, 2026. The race starts at 2:00 p.m. on the forecourt of the Bavarian National Museum in Munich and follows a familiar route through the English Garden. The event is held under the patronage of Munich Mayor Dominik Krause and combines athletic commitment with social engagement.

name: runroll City
description: The runroll City event takes place on September 13, 2026, in Bielefeld and offers a fast-paced sporting experience on a flat 7.2-kilometer course through the heart of the city. The course is ideal for fast times and is suitable for both intensive running training and a fast race. Participants can enjoy moving through the urban landscape and become part of a dynamic event.

name: Volkslauf TSV Adendorf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1.2 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: Zeuthener Jedermannslauf
description: The Zeuthen Jedermannslauf is a popular community run held every September in Zeuthen. It offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from 400 m to 10 km. The event is family-friendly and promotes recreational sport in the region. The races start at Zeuthen S-Bahn station and follow a varied route along the forest promenade.

name: HochRhön-BergTrail
description: The HochRhön Mountain Trail is a challenging trail-running event in the picturesque uplands of the Hochrhön around Hilders. The event offers four trail distances from 7 km to 42 km, with varied routes through forests, along singletrack trails and forest roads, and across meadows. The races feature some steep climbs and wonderful views, particularly from Auerbergsee and Buchschirm. The event also supports a good cause, with part of the entry fees donated to the Malteser Children’s Hospice and Family Support Service in Fulda. The event is part of the regional Trailrunning Cup Rhön and also offers children’s races.

name: Okolo Muňáku
location: Munice u Hluboké nad Vltavou, Jihočeský
description: Okolo Muňáku is a family running race in Munice near Hluboká nad Vltavou, offering a relaxed atmosphere and a fast course around Munický Pond. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is open to all age groups, including children’s races. Each edition supports the charity Centrum Bazalka, which receives part of the entry fees. After the race, there is a varied program, including a raffle and prizes for the fastest runners.

name: Vrchlabský 1/2 Maraton
description: The Vrchlabí City Half Marathon is the inaugural edition of the half marathon, held in the heart of the Krkonoše Mountains at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí. During the race, participants can enjoy a sporting challenge on asphalt roads, field paths and forest trails, as well as a cultural programme and a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main half marathon, shorter 2 km and 9 km routes are available for children, juniors and families with children, taking them through the town and its side streets. The event brings together running, experiences and community, and is co-funded by the State Environmental Fund of the Czech Republic.

name: Forestova čtrnáctka
description: Forestova čtrnáctka is a 14 km running race around Záluží near Plzeň, featuring a mix of field, forest, and gravel roads with light trail terrain. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children and young people, who can enter for free. Runners can look forward to plenty of refreshments, a participant medal, and race photos. Registration opens at 9:00, and the start is scheduled by 9:45. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The organizer emphasizes participant safety and fitness to compete; runners take part at their own risk.

name: Králický Lískovec
description: Králický Lískovec is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Lískovec hill and its vicinity in Králíky, Pardubice Region. The race offers various distances, from short children’s categories to the 8 km main race, which is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The main race starts at 11:30, while the children’s categories start from 10:30. The race is suitable for the general public and prizes are awarded to winners in each category. Registration is available on-site on race day from 8:00 to 9:45.

name: Kokořínský kros
description: Kokořín Cross is a trail race held amid the picturesque scenery of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, not far from Prague. The race offers three main routes of 15 km, 10 km and 5 km, which pass through romantic ravines and by unique sandstone towers. The start and finish are located in the municipal spa complex in Mšeno, which provides facilities including refreshments and a children’s corner. The race is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offers a wide range of categories, with the option to change route distance even on race day.

name: Hostivařská 15°
description: Hostivařská 15 is a family-friendly trail race in the natural surroundings of Prague’s Hostivař district, offering more than just a test of performance. The race takes place around the reservoir, golf course and meanders of the Botič River, with mostly forest trails and very little asphalt. There is no timing equipment at the start; the winner is the runner who estimates their time most accurately. The atmosphere is outdoorsy and brewery-themed, and the event is suitable for all ages, including children.

name: 4Drun
description: 4Drun is a traditional running race organized by Sportovní klub DDsport, z.s., held in the picturesque surroundings of Dubany near Prostějov. The race offers a 10.2 km course through the area around Dubany, neighboring villages, and nearby cycle paths, combining asphalt and cross-country sections. The program also includes a 2 × 5 km relay, a 4 km family run, and children’s races, making the event suitable for all age groups. A varied program of accompanying activities is planned for race day, and every participant receives a commemorative medal.

name: Beh Ždaňou
location: Ždaňa, okr. Košice okolie, Ždaňa, okr. Košice okolie, Obecný úrad
description: Beh Ždaňou is a running event in the village of Ždaňa in the Košice-okolie District, offering courses for various age groups and ability levels. The races cover 2.5 km and 5 km, with categories divided by age and gender. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, adults, and seniors. The organizers welcome all runners who want to enjoy a sporting day in the pleasant surroundings of the village.

name: Beh okolo Spišského hradu
location: Spišské Podhradie, Spišské Podhradie, Pred MsÚ
description: The Run Around Spiš Castle is a traditional running race in Spišské Podhradie, featuring a mix of asphalt and compacted dirt roads with grassy sections. The course passes around the historic Spiš Castle and is suitable for various age groups, including children and adults. The event is organized by the Town of Spišské Podhradie, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. Registration is available online or on site, and residents of Spišské Podhradie can enter for free.

name: RUN & RAVE Palanga
description: RUN & RAVE Palanga is a new community initiative for people who love movement, music, and good energy. The event takes place in Palanga and includes mobility training, a 5 km social run with DJ music, an ice bath ritual, and coffee breaks. It’s a great opportunity to meet new people, make connections, and experience summer energy at a single morning event. Registration is required, and participants are invited to bring running shoes, swim shorts, and a towel.

name: Crow Mountain Survival
description: The Crow Mountain Survival obstacle race in Bremen is an exciting adventure returning for its ninth edition on September 6, 2026. Distances range from 1.2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, featuring challenging obstacles and spectacular water sections, including a swim across Lake Werdersee. The event offers challenges for beginners and experienced OCR veterans, as well as inclusive races for people with disabilities. The varied course runs through forests, meadows and over different terrain, testing endurance, strength and agility. Special untimed races for children and newcomers make it easier to get started.
course_highlights: Spectacular water crossing through Lake Werdersee
Varied course through forests, meadows and over different terrain
Challenging obstacles involving climbing, balancing, crawling and traversing
additional: Wave starts of 10 people every 60 seconds for the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km races; runners are assigned to waves based on their pace at registration; untimed youth and inclusive races; medals and certificates for all participants; start times vary by distance, e.g. the youth race at 09:30 and the introductory race at 12:00; children under 12 require prior approval to participate in certain distances. Distances range from 5 km to 15 km, with water sections, natural trails through forests and meadows, challenging obstacles, and inclusive youth, introductory and inclusive races.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - září
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a regular 8 km running race held in the pleasant surroundings of Plzeň. The race is for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking available for participants. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and is suitable for various age groups.

name: Malý Pieninský maratón – mem. Bohuša Ježíka
location: Červený Kláštor okr. Kežmarok, Červený Kláštor okr. Kežmarok, Kúpele Smerdžonka
organizer: Malý pieninský maratón – memoriál Bohuša Ježíka
description: The Malý Pieninský Marathon – Bohuš Ježík Memorial is a running event in Červený Kláštor, offering an 18 km course with 163 metres of elevation gain. The route runs through the Dunajec River Gorge, with half the surface paved and half forest trail. The start is scheduled for 10:00. The entry fee includes a medal, a gift, a race number, refreshments along the course and at the finish, lunch, and a raffle. In addition to the main race, a non-competitive 9+9 km relay is also available.

name: B2Run Berlin
description: The B2Run Berlin on September 16, 2026, is a corporate run with a course of around 5.7 km around Berlin’s Olympic Stadium. The race finishes with an emotional finish-line experience inside the historic Olympic Stadium and offers a unique team event for companies and individual participants from Berlin and the surrounding area. The focus is on team spirit, motivation, and fun rather than personal bests, making it ideal for beginners, walkers, and experienced runners. The event combines physical activity with workplace health promotion and a professional supporting program featuring an emcee and music.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (10) – zářijový
description: The 5 km and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running series in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava where personal bests are often set. The races are part of the 16th edition and are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to pros. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the chance to meet the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant, adding to the relaxed running atmosphere.

name: Podzimní běh okolo Europlantu
description: The Autumn Run around Europlant is a traditional running race held in Prague’s Horní Počernice district. The race is 7.5 km long and combines paved and off-road sections. It starts in the early evening, with slower runners setting off earlier. The event is open to all runners and is supported by Prague 20. After the race, participants are rewarded with potatoes provided by the sponsor, Europlant.

name: Běh proti násilí
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
organizer: Asociace pro práci s lidmi, kteří se dopouštějí násilí z.s.
description: Run Against Violence is a traditional charity run held in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6. It supports the Stop Violence program and clients taking part in long-term therapies focused on managing anger and aggression. The run brings together participants of all ages who want to show their support and offer hope to those trying to change their behavior. The 5 km course is suitable for anyone who wants to support a good cause while enjoying exercise in nature. The event is organized by Diakonie ČCE, a major provider of social services in the Czech Republic.

name: Maraton 3 Jezior / Three Lakes Marathon
description: The 3 Lakes Marathon is a mountain running festival held in the scenic Beskid Mały region, in the Soła River valley. The main distance is an ultramarathon of approximately 43 km with around 2,485 m of elevation gain, taking runners through the highest parts of the Beskid Mały Mountains, with beautiful views of three lakes and the surrounding mountains. The course combines challenging climbs and technical descents, giving participants the chance to discover both the region’s wild nature and its historic sites. The event takes place during the beautiful transition from summer to autumn, adding to the charm of the route and its surroundings.

name: 23 Przejście Dookoła Kotliny Jeleniogórs...
description: The Hike Around the Jelenia Góra Valley is one of Poland’s best-known long-distance hiking events, held since 2004. Participants cover a route of approximately 140 km around the Jelenia Góra Valley, crossing the Karkonosze, Rudawy Janowickie, Kaczawskie Mountains and Izera Mountains. The event commemorates GOPR rescuers. The entry fee includes race materials, a souvenir, a hot meal and a certificate. The challenging route has approximately 5,500 m of elevation gain, and participants have a 48-hour time limit to complete it.

name: 3 Backyard Ultra Zagłębie
description: Backyard Ultra Zagłębie is a unique ultramarathon run on a 6.706 km loop around Pogoria 3 Lake in Dąbrowa Górnicza. Runners start every hour, and the last person to finish each lap continues running until only one winner remains. The course combines varied surfaces—asphalt, dirt and forest paths, and a beach section—requiring both endurance and technical precision. The event is the final of the Polish Backyard Ultra League and attracts fans of extreme challenges from across Poland.

name: Ogólnopolskie Mistrzostwa Policji
location: Łazy, Zawiercie County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Stadtlauf Hanau - Stärke zeigen - gemeinsam gegen Gewalt an Frauen
description: The Hanau City Run takes place on September 18, 2026, under the motto “Show strength – Together against violence against women.” Around 3,500 people take part each year to make a stand against violence against women. The run combines sporting commitment with an important social cause and provides a platform for solidarity and awareness. The event is well organized, with bib pickup and the race office at Hanau City Hall.
course_highlights: Route through downtown Hanau
Start and finish at Hanau Market Square
A city run with an urban feel and good infrastructure
additional: The race office opens at 2 p.m. on race day at City Hall. Bib pickup is available from 2 p.m. Bag storage is available at City Hall from 3:30 p.m. Changing facilities are limited. There are no shower facilities. Paid parking is available in nearby parking garages. Mobile structures on Market Square are permitted only for the organizers. The run is an annual event that raises donations for women’s shelters. Registration opens in June 2026. More than 3,500 participants are expected.

name: SportScheck RUN Hannover
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The SportScheck Run Hannover is an evening night run that transforms Hanover’s city centre into a spectacular display of lights. Runners can choose between a 1 km children’s race and 5 km and 10 km courses, which pass through the illuminated city centre and landmarks such as Opernplatz, the Lower Saxony State Parliament, Kröpcke and the New Town Hall. The nighttime atmosphere makes the run a particularly memorable experience. The fastest runners can take part in a 10 km SpeedRUN, with a target time of under 50 minutes. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and also offers training plans to help them prepare.

name: ONW-Lauf Dannenberg 2025
description: The ONW Run 2026 is a major charity run supporting the Onkologisches Netzwerk Wendland. It takes place on September 18, 2026, in Dannenberg’s old town. There are three race distances—2.1 km, 4.2 km and 10.5 km—all starting at the market square. The event welcomes participants of all ages and supports a good cause while fostering a strong sense of community. The entry fee for schoolgirls is covered; adults pay 6 euros. Groups of four or more can compete in the team ranking and win trophies.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
17. PKO Bytomski Półmaraton
organizer: Klub MKS MOSM Bytom, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Bytomiu, Centrum Handlowe Plejada
description: The 17th PKO Bytom Half Marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and brings together the local community of Bytom and the surrounding area. The race takes place on a certified, paved 21.097 km course consisting of a single loop. The start and finish are located at G City Plejada Shopping Centre in Bytom. Participants can expect refreshment and hydration stations, as well as support from pacemakers. After the race, they can personalize their medal by having their finishing time engraved.

name: PKO Wieczorny Półmaraton Łódź
description: PKO Łódź Evening Half Marathon is a new, atmospheric running event held in the center of Łódź. The start and finish are located on the grounds of the revitalized EC1 power and heating plant, which is now a center for culture and science. The 21.097 km course passes through the city’s most recognizable places, combining its industrial history with modernity. This is a race where not only the result matters, but also the unique atmosphere and energy of the city.

name: 30 Międzynarodowy Bieg Uliczny Bieg Rekreacyjny 10 km
Gontyniec Celtic Trail
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the scenic Gontyniec massif. Runners cover as much distance as possible, with fully equipped aid stations after each loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, beautiful views of the Noteć Valley, and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It’s a special experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable memories.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie
description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race taking place on September 19, 2026, in Sopot. The start and finish are located in the parking lot by the Forest Opera, and the course runs through the scenic areas around the venue. The race is part of a series of four events held on different dates and at different locations in Sopot, offering participants a unique atmosphere and the chance to compete over a short distance. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and well-organized event.

name: XIV Jastrzębska Dziesiątka
description: The 14th “Jastrzębska Dziesiątka” Street Run is an annual road race held in Jastrzębie-Zdrój. Participants cover a distance of 10 km along the city’s central streets. The start and finish are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at 6 Jana Pawła II Avenue. The participant limit is 600, and the race is scheduled to start at 17:00 on September 19, 2026. The accompanying run takes place from 15:00 to 15:50 on the same day.

name: Rollercoaster 21 WMRA Mountain Running World Cup
Tam i z powrotem
location: Złoty Stok, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 44 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Łagiewniki, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Insellauf Rund um Amrum
location: Norddorf auf Amrum, Nordfriesland, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Insellauf Rund um Amrum is a popular fun run for everyone, held annually in late summer in Norddorf on the North Sea island of Amrum. The event offers a sporting challenge amid the unique natural surroundings of the Wadden Sea National Park, a World Heritage Site. Participants can enjoy the varied landscape of dunes, Kniepsand and sea views. The race is an appealing way for both locals and holidaymakers to combine physical activity with experiencing nature.
course_highlights: Run through the varied landscape of Kniepsand and dunes
Course in the Wadden Sea National Park, a World Heritage Site
Start and finish in Norddorf on Amrum
additional: The Insellauf takes place annually in late summer. The event is part of Amrum’s extensive sports programme. The venue is the AOK-Nordseeklinik, Strunwai 23, in Norddorf on Amrum. The event takes place in the Wadden Sea National Park area and emphasises experiencing nature and beach activities. Registration is possible on site or by email, with refreshments and support provided by local partners.

name: Röderhof-Benefiz-Lauf
description: The Röderhof Charity Run takes place on September 19, 2026, in Diekholzen and offers various running and walking distances for all age groups and ability levels. This traditional charity event focuses on the enjoyment of running and coming together to support a good cause. Distances range from 500 meters to 10 kilometers, including special wheelchair races. Start times are staggered to ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 500 m to 10 km
Inclusive wheelchair races and walking routes
A run through the scenic surroundings of Diekholzen
additional: Online registration closes on 15.09. at 21:00. Late entries are possible on the event day up to 1 hour before the start, subject to a €2 late-entry fee. Payment by direct debit is possible. The event includes several start times for different distances and categories, including special wheelchair races and walking routes. Various running events, wheelchair races, walking, and the option to donate via PayPal

name: BraunenBerg-Trail
description: The BraunenBerg-Lauf on September 19, 2026, in Aalen offers varied mountain-running courses for different age and ability groups. A particular highlight is the Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg-Trail, which starts underground at the Besucherbergwerk Tiefer Stollen visitor mine and covers 32 km of trail running with 1,100 metres of elevation gain. For beginners and recreational runners, the technically easy VR Bank-BraunenBerg-Lauf covers 14.6 km with 446 metres of elevation gain. Children’s and youth races round out the programme. Personalized race bibs, chip timing, refreshments and a baggage drop are available in the finish area.
course_highlights: Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg-Trail: 32 km of trail running with 1,100 metres of elevation gain; starts at the Besucherbergwerk Tiefer Stollen visitor mine
VR Bank-BraunenBerg-Lauf: technically easy 14.6 km mountain run with 446 metres of elevation gain
Children’s and youth races with personalized race bibs, timing and refreshments at the finish
additional: A special bus transports runners from Oberalfingen to the start at the Besucherbergwerk Tiefer Stollen, departing at 9:45 a.m. A baggage drop is available in the finish area in Oberalfingen. Personalized race bibs and chip timing are provided for all races. Medals for all finishers. Runners exceeding the time limits are disqualified (32 km: by 3:30 p.m.; the 14.6 km race also has a time limit). Awards ceremony at 3:30 p.m. in Oberalfingen. Multiple races are offered, including the trail race and children’s and youth races; registration includes starter packs with timing chips and medals.

name: Jan Schüpp Bürgerlauf Wittmund
distance_verbose: 12.5 km, 10 km, 10 km, 6.4 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2.7 km, 2 km

name: 32. Stadtparklauf
description: The Stadtparklauf Sondershausen is a traditional running event held annually in Sondershausen City Park. It offers various distances from 500 m to 10,000 m and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The route winds through the picturesque city park, offering a pleasant running atmosphere in a green setting. The event is organized by SV Glückauf Sondershausen e.V. and is very popular in the region.

name: 6. The Devil's Loop - Langenberg Backyard Ultramarathon
description: The Devil's Loop - Langenberg Backyard Ultramarathon is a challenging ultramarathon held in Enge-Sande, Schleswig-Holstein. The race is part of the Waterkant Cup and offers runners the opportunity to test their endurance on a demanding course. The organizer, Sportverein Enge-Sande von 1959 e.V., is a multi-faceted club offering a wide range of sporting activities. The event is aimed at ambitious runners looking for a special challenge.

name: Altstadt-Run 2026
description: The Altstadt-Run Treysa 2026 takes place on September 19 in Schwalmstadt and is part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup. The event offers runners an appealing opportunity to run through the historic old town of Treysa. Organized by ESV Jahn Treysa, the race is for all running enthusiasts looking for a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: BraunenBerg-Lauf
description: The BraunenBerg-Lauf on September 19, 2026, offers varied mountain-running courses on the Ostalb, appealing to both beginners and experienced runners. The event features several distances, including the technically straightforward 14.6 km VR Bank-BraunenBerg-Lauf with 446 meters of elevation gain and the challenging 32 km Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg-Trail with 1,100 meters of elevation gain, which starts underground at the Tiefen Stollen visitor mine. Children and teenagers have their own races, with personalized timing, refreshments, and medals. Runners can use a baggage drop in the finish area and enjoy a welcoming atmosphere on the Ostalb.

name: Duinger Berglauf
description: The Duinger Mountain Run takes place on September 19, 2026, in Duingen, Lower Saxony, and offers races for children and adults. The event starts and finishes at the OBS sports hall and includes short children’s races as well as more challenging 5 km and 10 km mountain runs with around 110 meters of elevation gain. Organized by Duinger Sport-Club e.V., the run has been an accessible local mountain-running event for 19 years. After the run, all participants receive free access to the indoor swimming pool and sauna, with changing rooms, showers, and refreshments available on site.

name: Edeka Ladage-Lauf Wennigsen
description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen offers a varied programme for all age groups, with distances ranging from about 600 m for kindergarten children to 10 km for adults. The races take place on a varied loop course on the grounds of Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School, running through residential areas and along field paths, with a special atmosphere at the start and finish. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also has a social focus, as proceeds from the main race are donated to the Bastlergemeinschaft der Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is a popular community run with a family-friendly atmosphere and a long tradition in the region.

name: Fichtelgebirgstrailrun
description: The Fichtelgebirgstrailrun is a challenging trail-running competition held on partially unpaved roads and trails in the natural surroundings of the Fichtelgebirge. It requires participants to have good fitness and coordination, as well as respect and a sense of personal responsibility toward themselves, fellow runners, and the environment. The course passes through the unique and sensitive natural landscape of the Fichtelgebirge, offering runners an immersive experience in nature. The event places great importance on safety, fairness, and environmental protection.

name: Freimarktslauf
description: The Freimarktslauf in Garrel is the region’s largest community race, offering a varied running experience for young and old, beginners and professionals on its flat loop courses. The event features distances ranging from a 400 m children’s race to the 10 km main races, which take place on a flat 2.5 km loop through Garrel. Alongside the sporting competition, community and fun take center stage, supported by RunClub Garrel, which specifically encourages beginners. More than 1,300 participants make the race a popular event filled with unforgettable moments.

name: Kapuziner-Kessellauf
description: The Kapuziner Kessellauf is a traditional race through the Kessel and the Kulmbach Forest, starting at the Weiher Sports Center. Since its revival in 2002, it has been a fixture on the Upper Franconian running calendar. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program featuring music, coffee and cake, a finish-line buffet, and a large raffle. The Bambini and schoolchildren’s races are especially family-friendly, with medals for all participants. The event also promotes community spirit through team rankings and awards for the teams with the most participants.

name: Klausdorfer Kranichlauf
description: The Klausdorf Crane Run invites runners of all ages to take part in various races through the beautiful surroundings of Klausdorf. Times are recorded using a chip issued with the race number. Every participant receives a certificate and a medal, and the top three finishers in each race are honored separately. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish, and changing rooms and restrooms are available at Vorpommernhus. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes.

name: Seelauf TSV-Obernzenn
description: The TSV Obernzenn Lake Run is a traditional running event featuring various distances for children, teenagers, and adults. The courses include a bambin run, school races, a middle distance, and a long distance of approx. 10.7 km. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with participant gifts and attractive prizes for the top runners. Registration is exclusively online via my.raceresult.com from 1 May 2026. Start times are staggered to ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: Wehringer Wertachlauf mit schwäbischen Meisterschaften
description: The Wehringen Wertach Run is a local running event in Wehringen, Germany, organized by Laufgemeinschaft Wehringen. The program includes a short 350-meter run and a 10 km run, classified as a short run. The course goes around the village of Wehringen and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. This edition also includes the Swabian Championships.

name: Wilstermarsch Lauf
description: The Wilstermarschlauf is a long-established running event in Wilster, taking place for the 34th time on September 19, 2026. The event offers various race distances for children and adults, including 400 m, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km, through the scenic Wilstermarsch. Alongside the sporting competition, a varied program featuring games, bouncy cushions, a DJ, a barbecue stand, and refreshments provides entertainment and a welcoming atmosphere for participants and spectators. The race is part of the Steinburg Cup and attracts several hundred runners each year, supported by numerous volunteers.

name: Wutzseelauf
description: The Wutzsee Run in Lindow (Mark) is a family-friendly fun run, taking place for the 21st time on September 19, 2026. The varied routes run around Lake Wutzsee through Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park and offer running opportunities for all age groups, from Bambinis to experienced runners. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere, professional chip timing and a varied program of activities. Participants can look forward to distances from 600 meters to 22 kilometers, including Nordic walking. Award ceremonies take place after the races, and every finisher receives a certificate to download or print on site.

name: Arberland Ultratrail
description: The ARBERLAND Ultra Trail on 19 September 2026 offers trail running in one of the most beautiful areas of the Bavarian Forest. The route leads through autumn forests ablaze with colourful leaves, over peaks with breathtaking panoramic views, and finishes at the Hohenzollern Ski Stadium at the Großer Arbersee. The event has established itself as a popular end-of-season race for the trail running community, thanks to its relaxed atmosphere, friendly volunteers and fantastic trails. The event is organised by the Woidläufer e. V. club, which can also provide information about the best trails in ARBERLAND.

name: Běh pro hospic Červený Kostelec
description: Run for Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, with courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children’s courses along a forest path, as well as 2, 5 and 10 km courses over rolling mixed terrain, mostly asphalt with some forest and field paths. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services provided by the Červený Kostelec Regional Charity. Participants can enjoy the pleasant countryside around the Kostelec ponds, with views of the surrounding mountains.

name: Zátopkova 10
description: Zátopkova 10 is a traditional running race held in Lomená Alej in Stará Boleslav. The course consists of two five-kilometre loops along forest trails. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup 2026 series and offers a 10 km main race, a two-runner relay, and children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres. The course is mostly flat, and the start is staggered, with an on-course refreshment station. Runners receive a race number with a timing chip, a commemorative medal, and additional services including refreshments and photos from the course.

name: Li.T.R. – Lipno.trail.run.
description: Li.t.r. is a weekend trail festival featuring a 108 km main race with over 2,000 metres of elevation gain around Lipno. The run offers a unique opportunity to discover the little-known Lipno region, its history and its stories during a demanding ultratrail. The race is open to both solo runners and teams, and is complemented by a programme of activities from Friday to Sunday. The atmosphere is friendly and community-focused; the event is organised by runners for runners, with respect for nature and local culture.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Mírové náměstí, Ústecký
description: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem 2026 is a traditional running race with a fast, flat course that follows the Elbe River and passes the local chemical plant. This half marathon is known as the “Ferrari among races” for its speed and the records that are often set. During the race, runners can enjoy beautiful views of the Bohemian Central Highlands and Střekov Castle. The festival offers various running events, including a half marathon, a half-marathon relay, a 10 km race, and family runs.

name: Mladé Běchovice
description: Mladé Běchovice is a traditional running race for children aged 1 to 18, held on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. The race offers courses of varying lengths, from 50 to 1,300 metres, to accommodate participants across a wide age range. Around 800 children take part each year, making it a significant sporting event for young runners. In 2026, the popular race will be held for the 61st time.

name: Běh Moravským krasem
description: Run through the Moravian Karst is part of the Blansko District Running League, which dates back to 1976. The race gives runners from the Blansko area and beyond the chance to test themselves in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Moravian Karst. It is suitable for the general public and forms part of a year-round competition that promotes running in the region. The organizers aim to provide quality services and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.

name: Litovelská nealkoholická čtrnáctka
description: Litovelská Non-Alcoholic Fourteener is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque town of Litovel in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of a running series and offers an opportunity for recreational and competitive runners alike. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public, and its name—which refers to the event’s non-alcoholic nature—also reflects its friendly atmosphere.

name: Podzimní běh Heřmanův Městec
description: The Autumn Run in Heřmanův Městec is a traditional running race held in a beautiful castle park. It offers two main distances, 5 km and 10 km (two laps), as well as children’s races in the start and finish area. The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league and attracts runners of all ages who enjoy the pleasant autumn atmosphere and excellent facilities.

name: Hořovický cvoček
description: Hořovický cvoček is a traditional running race held in Hořovice, offering a course approximately 12 km long. The route follows forest paths and paved roads, starting on Valdecká Street by the water tower and heading towards Hvozdec. The main race starts at 10:00 and is for adult runners, with no children’s categories. The entry fee is 150 CZK with pre-registration and 200 CZK on the day. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup and has a long history, with results and statistics available.

name: Kačina Run
description: Kačina Run is a running race held in the beautiful grounds of Kačina Castle and its expansive park. It is part of the BĚHEJ ZÁMKY STŘEDNÍ ČECHY series. The race offers courses for children of up to 800 metres and 5 km and 10 km courses for adults, running mostly on gravel and forest paths. The event is suitable for anyone who enjoys exercise and nature, and offers a friendly atmosphere with refreshments along the course and at the finish. The start and event facilities are located behind Kačina Castle, where registration and the awards ceremony also take place.

name: Leskros Mácháč
description: Leskros Mácháč is a new event this season, with beautiful routes ideal for running and canicross in the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, not far from Lake Máchovo. The routes follow soft sandy trails covered with pine needles, making for a pleasant running experience in a natural setting. The event offers a range of distances, from children’s races up to 21 km, including running, canicross, walking/running, and dog trekking categories. Race facilities include refreshment stations for people and dogs, massages, taping, and canine physiotherapy advice, helping all participants feel at ease.

name: Štramberský Jasoň
organizer: Spolek Bezva běh pro bezva lidi z. s.
description: Štramberk Jasoň is a traditional hiking march and running event taking place on September 19, 2026, in Frýdlant nad Ostravicí and the surrounding area. It offers 22 routes of varying lengths, from 6 km to 67 km, including both race and hiking options. Participants can choose routes passing through Lysá hora, the Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník and other scenic locations in the Moravian-Silesian Region. At the finish in Štramberk, all registered participants receive an original medal and can order a printed T-shirt. The event is suitable for a wide range of participants, including families with children, and also offers routes suitable for strollers and seniors.

name: Havlíčkova pětka
location: Havlíčkovo náměstí, Havlíčkův Brod, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Havlíčkova Pětka is a running race of approximately 5.2 km, running mainly along cycle paths and pavements beside the Sázava River in Havlíčkův Brod. It is suitable for those who do not have a relay team or find a half marathon too challenging. The race starts from Havlíčkovo Square, and part of the entry fee goes toward supporting sports equipment for young people. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny running cup and offers refreshments at both the start and finish.

name: Běh rodným krajem Emila Zátopka
description: The Run Through Emil Zátopek’s Native Region is a traditional race dedicated to the legacy of the famous Olympic athlete Emil Zátopek. It is held each year on the Saturday closest to his birthday, 19 September. The race starts in his hometown of Kopřivnice, by the statue of Emil Zátopek, and finishes at the Wallachian Open Air Museum in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm after a challenging 22.3 km course with a hilly profile. The race is open to participants aged 15 and over and also offers accompanying runs for children and the public. After the race, the winners are ceremonially presented with awards in the presence of distinguished guests.

name: Kocelovice-Hornosín-Kocelovice
description: The Kocelovice–Hornosín–Kocelovice cross-country run is a traditional sporting event organized by the municipality of Kocelovice in the South Bohemian Region. The run takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, and participants can expect a route from Kocelovice to Hornosín and back. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts and anyone looking for an active day out in scenic terrain popular with hikers and cyclists. The start and finish are by the former school building in Kocelovice, where the race is also organized. The event lasts approximately four hours.

name: Havlíčkobrodský půlmaraton
description: The Havlíčkův Brod Half Marathon is a traditional running event held in Havlíčkův Brod, celebrating its 14th edition in 2026. The main half-marathon course follows public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River, and passes through Havlíčkův Brod Square. The event also includes children’s races, relays, and the shorter Havlíčkova Pětka, making it accessible to the general public across a range of age groups and ability levels. The race offers quality facilities, refreshments on the course and after the race, professional timing, and a rich accompanying program.

name: Běh pro Hospic Anežky České
description: The Run for Anežka Česká Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, offering courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children’s courses along a forest path, as well as 2, 5 and 10 km courses over rolling mixed terrain, mostly on asphalt with some forest and field paths. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services. Race numbers are distributed from 8:15, and the main race winners are announced at 12:00.

name: Jilemnice - Žalý
description: Jilemnice–Žalý is a hill race with a total elevation gain of 569 metres, held in the picturesque surroundings of Jilemnice in the Liberec Region. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and features a challenging 9.5 km course. The start is in Jilemnice’s town square, and the race is suited to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain. It is organised by ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., which provides professional organisation and support for participants.

name: Soběchlebský Š-krpál
organizer: místní běžečtí nadšenci ve spolupráci s obcí Soběchleby a SDH Soběchleby
description: Soběchlebský Š-krpál is a traditional running race held in the area around the village of Soběchleby since 2017. The main course is approximately 11.7 km long, with 268 m of elevation gain, and runs 90% on unpaved farm and forest roads. Since 2024, the event has also included a 6 km fitness run, suitable for beginner runners and walkers. The start and finish are at the football pitch in Soběchleby, which has facilities including changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The accompanying programme includes children’s races for various age groups.

name: Černošický běh
description: The Černošice Run is a traditional race held in Černošice, offering routes for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The event takes place at the sports field at the end of Husova Street and includes short children’s races, a family relay, and longer routes for adult runners. Starts are staggered from 14:00 to 15:40, allowing participants of different age groups to take part comfortably. The event is suitable for families and runners looking for a sporting challenge in a pleasant town setting.

name: Big Bear's Ultra
description: Big Bear's Ultra is a challenging ultra-trail race around the city of Žilina, offering a unique running experience in nature with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape. The race takes place near the Považské Museum and Budatín Castle and features various distances that test runners’ endurance and determination. The course runs through hills and mountain areas with significant elevation gain, making the event a challenge for experienced runners. The organizers emphasize an eco-friendly approach and participant safety.

name: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: Half Marathon
description: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: The Half Marathon is a certified half marathon with World Athletics international status, held in Nitra’s historic centre at Svätopluk Square. The event brings together sport, community and charity, offering runners a unique experience in an Oktoberfest atmosphere. Alongside the half marathon, the festival also features relays, family and senior runs, charity runs and children’s races. The organisers emphasise a healthy lifestyle, inclusion and community cooperation in the region.

name: Kopaničiarska 10-tka
location: Myjava, Myjava, pred MsÚ v Myjave
organizer: TJ Spartak Myjava Atletický oddiel a mesto Myjava
description: Kopaničiarska 10-tka is a running race in Myjava offering a 10 km course for men and women, with shorter options for women and the Buď - fit category. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office in Myjava and is organized by TJ Spartak Myjava Athletics Club and the town of Myjava. The main race starts at 13:00, while primary school boys and girls start at 10:00. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages, including age-based categories and special categories for Buď fit and children.

name: Dobšinská desiatka
location: Dobšiná okr.Rožňava, Dobšiná okr.Rožňava, Dobšiná, Lanyiho Huta
description: Dobšinská desiatka is a traditional running race organized by the ŠK Dobšiná civic association. It takes place in the picturesque setting of Lányiho Huta in Dobšiná. The race features a varied course combining forest roads and asphalt, suitable for runners in different categories, including Nordic walking. The event also includes activities such as an autograph session with Slovak Olympians and family activities, creating a pleasant atmosphere for all participants.

name: Kapušianska 5-ka
description: Kapušianska 5-ka is a running race held in Kapušany Park in the village of Kapušany. The race is open to various age groups, including juniors, adults, and veterans. It is an enjoyable sporting event that promotes an active lifestyle and community sports. The event is organized by the municipality of Kapušany, which also provides support and contact information for participants.

name: Letné športové hry pracovníkov U.S.STEEL
location: Košice, Košice, vstupný areál USS Košice Šaca
description: The U. S. Steel Košice Summer Sports Games are a traditional event that has been held for 34 years, giving employees the opportunity to compete in a variety of sports. The games include athletics, badminton, bowling, tennis, football, table tennis, beach volleyball, cycling, chess and darts. The event is for U. S. Steel Košice employees and promotes sportsmanship and team spirit in the pleasant surroundings of the USS Košice Šaca complex. Golf tournaments and other sporting activities are also organized alongside the competitions.

name: Generali Trail Hubkovou
description: Generali Trail Hubkovou is a running race in Humenné organized by Bežecký klub Humenné with support from the city and local sponsors. The race takes place in the square by the Municipal Cultural Centre and offers categories for men, women, juniors, and children. The main race starts at 13:00, and the children’s categories begin at 11:00. Participants can choose from several entry packages, which include a medal, a promotional pack, a raffle, refreshments, and a technical T-shirt. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with refreshments along the course.

name: Lietuvos aklųjų ir silpnaregių lengvosios atletikos bėgimo plentu čempionatas
description: The Lithuanian Athletics Road Running Championship for the Blind and Visually Impaired is a specialized running event for blind and visually impaired athletes. The competition takes place in Zelvė, Elektrėnai Municipality, and is organized by the Lithuanian Blind Sports Federation (LASF). Since 1990, the federation has actively supported sports for blind and visually impaired people in Lithuania, aiming to provide equal opportunities to take part in various sporting competitions and events. The championship is an important tradition that promotes physical activity and a sense of community among athletes.

name: Bėgimas „Ateik ir įveik!", skirtas prof. K. Baršausko atminimui
description: The “Come and Conquer!” run is a traditional event organized by Kaunas University of Technology in memory of Prof. K. Baršauskas. It invites participants to test their strength on a variety of running and walking routes, including a new 5 km run with dogs. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively, promote a healthy lifestyle, and take part in a community sporting event. The competition takes place at the KTU Stadium and in Ąžuolynas, and participants receive commemorative medals and prizes by age group.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
location: Park Miejski w Mosinie, Mosina, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. It attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional support and a generous race pack.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechit Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at St. Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, following the route of Otto III’s historic journey. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timekeeping, and course safety. Participants receive a race package with a medal and a recovery meal.

name: 6 Półmaraton Aleją Dębów Czerwonych
organizer: Gmina Łęka Opatowska, Gmina Wieruszów, Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Turystyki w Wieruszowie, Spółdzielnia Socjalna Green Service
description: The 6th Red Oaks Avenue Half Marathon is a half-marathon race (21.097 km) taking place on September 20, 2026, in Wieruszów. The event is organized by the Łęka Opatowska Municipality, the Wieruszów Municipality, and the Municipal Sports and Tourism Centre in Wieruszów. The race is open and welcoming to runners, and the course runs along the scenic Red Oaks Avenue. The race office will be open on the day of the event from 08:00 to 11:30, and timing will be electronic. The event is supported by local partners and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and excellent race-day conditions.

name: 7 H2O Półmaraton
description: The 7 H2O Half Marathon is a 21.097 km race taking place on September 20, 2026, in Wrocław. The flat route is on asphalt with sections of compacted gravel and follows a single loop, starting and finishing at 3 Międzyrzecka Street. The event promotes running and physical activity among Wrocław residents, offering participants professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race has a 3-hour time limit and provides hydration points and a recovery meal after the finish.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The CZTERY PORY ROKU Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking event on the same route. The event is charitable in nature and is coordinated by the Active People Association “Biegnij Oławo” and the Oława Municipal Office. The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30, and the event is scheduled to start on December 20, 2026. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.

name: Festiwal Górski Maraton Trzech Jezior
description: The Three Lakes Mountain Marathon Festival is a unique running event in the scenic land of the Beskid lakes, featuring four distances: the 3.5 km Czupel Vertical with 600 m of elevation gain, a 43 km marathon, 21 km, and 17 km. The routes pass through the wild mountain terrain of the Little Beskids, offering participants beautiful views, varied terrain, and a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event brings the running community together and promotes an active lifestyle as well as the area’s tourist and cultural attractions. Races take place on September 18–20, 2026, and the main marathon is an ultramarathon with demanding climbs and technical descents.

name: II Bieg Farmera
description: The 2nd Farmer’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Police. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help participants prepare optimally for the race. This sporting event is aimed at runners who value good organization and opportunities for development.

name: Prószkowski Bieg Uliczny
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Prószkowie
description: The Piotr Blachucik Prószków Street Race is one of the region’s most atmospheric running events, taking place on September 20, 2026, in Prószków. The race offers a dynamic course and sporting excitement, while children’s races are also held before the main event to promote physical activity from an early age. It’s a day full of energy, smiles, and friendly competition, ideal both for runners aiming for a result and for anyone looking to spend time actively.

name: VII Bieg Pocztyliona
description: The 7th Pocztylion Run is a 10 km race taking place on September 20, 2026, in Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy sporting competition in a friendly atmosphere.

name: XV Półmaraton Augustowski
description: The 15th Augustów Half Marathon will take place on September 20, 2026, in Augustów, starting at 1:00 p.m. at the Municipal Amphitheatre. Participants will cover the half-marathon distance of 21.0975 km, running a course that is a competition equal to half the length of a marathon. The event is organized by the Augustów Swimming Association and is an important running event in the region.

name: 12 Bieg Ziemi Puckiej
location: Połczyno, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 4 Wilczy Pęd na Trójmorski Wierch
location: Jodłów, Międzylesie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg na Zamek po miecz Spycimira
XI Gminna Zadyszka
location: Kurnos Drugi, Bełchatów County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIX Mazowiecki Bieg Norwidowski
location: Dębinki, Gmina Zabrodzie, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Stadtlauf Erding 2026
description: The Erding City Run is a long-standing running event for runners of all ages. A range of distances is offered, including children’s races, a 5 km run and a 10 km run through the beautiful town of Erding.
