The event embraces inclusion and features special classifications, for example for children from St. Nikolaus School. It is organised by the Trisport Erding club and is a popular sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: Children’s races with age-appropriate distances of approximately 0.8 km to 2.5 km
Stadtwerke Run over 5 km and 10 km through Erding city centre
Inclusive classification for children from St. Nikolaus School
additional: The Erding City Run offers special children’s races with different distances for each age group. There is a separate 0.8 km classification for children from St. Nikolaus School. The event emphasises inclusion and is open to runners of all ages. Running routes, registration, results, photos, road closures

name: Aerzener twinfit-Volkslauf
price_range: € 5,– bis € 9,– je nach Lauf und Anmeldung

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km, 10 km und Walking € 8,– bis zum 19.09.2026

description: The Aerzener twinfit Volkslauf is a family-friendly running event offering various distances. It starts and finishes in Aerzen. Events include 5 km and 10 km fun runs, a 5 km company and team run, a 1.8 km schoolchildren’s run, and a free children’s run. The event takes place on September 20, 2026, and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments and an awards ceremony. The races are scored according to DLV rules, and participants can win prizes and enter a raffle.
course_highlights: Start and finish at twinfit, Königsförder Straße 19, 31855 Aerzen
5 km and 10 km fun runs, plus a 5 km company and team run
1.8 km schoolchildren’s run and free children’s run
additional: Late registration is available on September 20, 2026, from 9:00–9:45 a.m.; for the schoolchildren’s run, until 11:45 a.m. Changing facilities with showers are available at twinfit. The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 1:30 p.m., with certificates for places 1–3 and a raffle. Drinks are available along the course and snacks in the finish area. Parking is available at twinfit. Events for children and young people. Registration opens on August 1, 2026; late registration is available on the day of the event. Scoring according to DLV rules, prizes and certificates, company and team run, parking at the event venue.

name: Druffeler Volkslauf
description: The Druffeler Volkslauf takes place on 20 September 2026 in Rietberg-Druffel and offers timed races over 1 km and 10 km. The event supports a solidarity initiative in sport that promotes running and maintains a relief fund for the families of injured runners. laufen.de members can benefit from the “Book smart, pay less!” offer. The course is officially measured and suitable for record purposes.
course_highlights: Timed races over 1 km and 10 km
Start in Rietberg-Druffel
Typical September weather: around 19 °C, with mostly cloudy skies
additional: Registration supports a solidarity initiative in sport and a relief fund for injured runners. Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with a minimum of 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation; skies are usually cloudy. Discounted registration is available through laufen.de; the event supports charitable causes. Ask the organizer for details before registering.

name: Herbstlauf und 29. Wandertag Fleckenberg
location: Sportplatz auf der Latroper Straße, Fleckenberg, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 39th Autumn Run and Hiking Day in Fleckenberg takes place on September 20, 2026, at the sports field on Latroper Straße. The event is a scoring race in the Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup and features a scenic 15 km loop with varied terrain. The route follows forest paths, a paved climb, and some rocky sections, making well-cushioned running shoes ideal. Changing rooms and showers are available, as are food and drink sales. After the race, an awards ceremony will be held, with certificates and trophies.
course_highlights: 15 km loop starting at the sports field, elevation 360 m
Varied route with a paved climb, firm forest paths, and some rocky terrain
The return route follows the final kilometres of the Rothaarsteig Marathon
additional: Indoor changing rooms and showers are available. A wide selection of food and drinks will be on sale. The awards ceremony begins at approximately 12 noon, with awards for the children’s and youth races. Every participant receives a certificate; the fastest runner receives a trophy. Scoring race in the Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup; start and finish at the sports field on Latroper Straße; indoor changing rooms, showers, refreshments, and certificates for all finishers.

name: Möhnesee-Pokal-Lauf = Mehr als eine Herausforderung
description: The 38th Möhnesee-Pokal-Lauf, under the motto “More than a challenge,” takes place on September 20, 2026, in Möhnesee-Günne. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 30 km, and challenges participants with a demanding course. The race is known for its varied scenery and the special atmosphere at Möhnesee. Runners can look forward to a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km and 30 km race distances
Venue in Möhnesee-Günne, surrounded by scenic countryside
Typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies
additional: The race takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026. Average temperatures are around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night. Approximately 45 mm of precipitation is expected, with mostly cloudy skies. The race is held in September, with typical temperatures around 19 °C; checking with the organizer for further details before registering is recommended.

name: Kassel Marathon
description: The Kassel Marathon is the largest sporting event in North Hesse and takes place from September 18 to 20, 2026, at the Auestadion Kassel. The event offers a variety of races, including a marathon, half marathon, power walking, relay, corporate run, and children’s races. The marathon course has 200 meters of elevation gain and runs through the city of Kassel. Participants receive a finisher’s medal and a free finisher shirt. Runners are supported by medical care from the German Red Cross and a post-race massage service.

name: 12. PSD Bank Halbmarathon
description: The PSD Bank Half Marathon in Hamburg is a fast, flat running event that takes runners through the Wandsbek district and as far north as Berne subway station. The course then heads back via Rahlstedt and Tonndorf to the start and finish area on Wandsbeker Marktstraße. The race is known for its unique atmosphere, with support from spectators and live bands along the course, and takes place in late summer at dusk.

name: 14. Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra
description: The Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon held in Northeim. The course passes through varied terrain and offers a special challenge for experienced ultrarunners. The event has a long tradition, with numerous finishers and records that underscore the race’s high quality and athletic demands. Participants can download the course GPX track to prepare optimally.

name: 21. Fun-Run
description: The 21st Maisel’s FunRun takes place on 10 May 2026 in Bayreuth and is a fixture on the regional running calendar. The event attracts over 4,000 running enthusiasts every year, from beginners to ambitious athletes. Various race distances are offered for adults, including a half marathon, quarter marathon and 5 km run, as well as several children’s races with no entry fee. The finish line leads directly onto the Maisel’s Weissbierfest festival grounds, where runners can celebrate with live music and freshly tapped Maisel’s Weisse. The varied, mostly flat course passes some of Bayreuth’s most beautiful spots and creates a great race-day atmosphere.

name: 28. Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The 28th Hiddestorf Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. The event offers distances of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km, and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied program of activities that includes face painting for children. The event is open to all runners; club membership is not required.

name: 8. Altstadtlauf Salzwedel
description: The Altstadtlauf Salzwedel is part of the Elbe-Ohre-Cup and will take place for the eighth time in 2026. The course runs through the historic old town of Salzwedel on a 5 km loop. The longer distances, 10 km and half marathon, are run over multiple loops accordingly. The event is organized by Sportclub Demker ’95 e.V. and offers runners in northern Saxony-Anhalt an attractive racing opportunity.

name: Karlsfelder Seelauf
description: The Karlsfeld Lake Run is a long-standing running event held at Lake Karlsfeld. The race offers an attractive route in a natural setting and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht Karlsfeld and will take place for the 47th time in 2026. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Uentroper Geithelauf
description: The 24th Uentroper Geithelauf takes place on September 20, 2026, and takes runners through the green heart of Uentrop. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 46/68 Uentrop e.V. and offers a sporting community in a natural setting. The routes pass through fields and forest paths in the surrounding area and are suitable for various fitness levels. The event emphasizes fun, community, and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.

name: CANOSSA Benefiz Berglauf
description: The CANOSSA Charity Mountain Run® in Bad Harzburg is a challenging fundraising run through Harz National Park, taking place on September 20, 2026. Participants can complete the course by running, Nordic walking, or hiking; it ends at the CANOSSA Column on Burgberg. The run supports inclusive activities for children and young people in the Goslar district, combining a sporting challenge with social commitment. After the run, participants can look forward to a festive after-race event with music, refreshments, and an awards ceremony.

name: Citylauf Leer
description: The Citylauf Leer is a traditional running event taking place on September 20, 2026, in downtown Leer at Denkmalsplatz. The event offers races for various age groups and distances, including Bambino, Teeny, 5 km and 10 km races. The course follows closed circuit routes through the town center, with refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area. All participants receive a T-shirt (while supplies last), and attractive prizes and certificates are awarded to the top runners. The event includes individual and team competitions and takes place in all weather.

name: Fürst Carl Seenlandmarathon
description: The Fürst Carl Seenland Marathon takes place on September 19 and 20, 2026, in Pleinfeld on Lake Brombach. The event offers a range of distances, including a marathon, half marathon, relay, fun run, schoolchildren’s run and children’s run, on paved and partly asphalted paths. The marathon and half-marathon distances are officially certified by the DLV. The event welcomes runners of all ages and offers a varied program with accompanying events and refreshments.

name: Grebinlauf
description: The Grebinlauf takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, in Grebin and offers varied routes for runners, walkers, children, and relay teams. The event is known for its great atmosphere and a special finish at the Grebin sports field. One highlight is the turnaround point at Grebin Mill, which makes the course unique. Registration is via the Davengo platform.

name: Halbmarathon Altötting
description: The Altötting Half Marathon on 20 September 2026 is one of the fastest nature runs in the world and was awarded 5 stars by European Athletics. The course runs 80% on paved forest paths in the Altötting Forest and is flat, sheltered from the wind, and has little asphalt. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers a 6 km run and a fun run. Free childcare is available for children aged 5 and over, and numerous bands and music along the course create a lively atmosphere.

name: Heidelauf Halle am 20.09.2026
description: The 278th Heidelauf Halle takes place on September 20, 2026, in Halle (Saale) and is organized by SV Halle Triathlon. The event gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a traditional race. The course runs around Heidebad and offers varied surroundings. Registration is open until the day of the event.

name: Hörnle Berglauf Bad Kohlgrub
description: The Hörnle Berglauf in Bad Kohlgrub is a traditional mountain race held annually, taking runners up the local Hörnle mountain. The event features a challenging course with impressive views and a sporting test for mountain-running enthusiasts. The race takes place in September and attracts participants from both the region and beyond. The Bad Kohlgrub Ski Club organizes the event with great dedication and provides a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: IWB Laurentiuslauf x Landkreislauf
description: The IWB Laurentiuslauf x Landkreislauf takes place annually in Bobingen and is a traditional running event along unique trails and enchanting paths in the forests west of Augsburg. Alongside the sporting competition, the event focuses on supporting a vocational training project at Bobingen Middle School, giving participation a social purpose as well. The event also features a career-orientation rally that offers young people exciting insights into regional vocational training opportunities. The race is part of a vibrant community of dedicated sponsors and volunteers and is always held on the third Sunday in September.

name: Kemmerner Kuckuckslauf
description: The Kemmern Cuckoo Run is a traditional running event in the center of Kemmern, taking place for the 16th time on September 20, 2026. Various races are offered for all age groups, including Bambini, school and youth races, as well as a 4 km fun and corporate run and a 10 km main race. The event is known for fair sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere with plenty of spectators. Food and refreshments for runners are available at the SC Kemmern clubhouse.

name: km von Röthenbach
description: The 10 km von Röthenbach is an event approved by the German Athletics Association, taking place on September 20, 2026, in Röthenbach a.d.Pegnitz. The event offers various race distances for all age groups, including a fast, flat circuit on a course measured by the German Athletics Association. Timing is provided by a chip integrated into the race bib, and the event is family-friendly, with races for children and young people. Changing rooms, showers, and medical services are available on site, and the venue is easily accessible by public transport.

name: Lohelauf
description: The Lohelauf in Wentorf near Hamburg is a long-standing race, taking place for the 21st time in 2026. The event offers a range of distances for different age groups and ability levels, including runs from 1.5 km to 9 km and a 5 km walking route. The race takes place in the beautiful Wentorfer Lohe conservation area and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and team spirit. On race day, there is a tent village, with the start and finish at the dog meadow, where participants can collect their race numbers and enjoy the event.

name: Mommelsteinlauf
description: The Mommelsteinlauf in Floh-Seligenthal, OT Hohleborn, is a family-friendly running event organised by SV 1962 Hohleborn. From the Bambini run and youth and beginner courses to the challenging 32 km trail, every runner and Nordic walker can find a suitable route. The routes are marked, with refreshment stations on routes of 8 km and longer. The event offers timing using a bib-chip transponder and medical support. At the finish, participants can enjoy refreshments and a coffee-and-cake buffet.

name: Sonneberger Spielzeuglauf
description: The 6th Sonneberg Toy Run and 2nd Company Run will take place on September 20, 2026, in Sonneberg. The event offers several race distances, including the main race, beginner race, Nordic walking, schoolchildren’s race, and Bambini run. All races start at the same time and finish together. In addition to individual rankings, there is a special company ranking for the company with the most participants and the most creative company, as well as an award for the club with the most participants. The Nordic walking race is timed, but there is no awards ceremony. The event is family-friendly and organized by Leichtathletik Sonneberg e. V.

name: Sparkassen-Küstenmarathon 26
description: The Sparkassen Coastal Marathon in Otterndorf is a long-standing race on the North Sea coast, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers various distances, from a Bambini run for kindergarten children to the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km. The courses run through the historic old town, along the Elbe dike and by the water, guaranteeing a varied and scenic running experience. In addition to the marathon, there are also half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as relay and walking events. The event emphasizes community, endurance and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Weddelbrooker Dorflauf
description: The Weddelbrook Village Run is a traditional race through the village of Weddelbrook and the surrounding countryside. It offers various distances from 900 m to 10 km, so runners of all ages and ability levels can take part. The course passes through scenic areas, including a section around the lake, and has a family-friendly atmosphere with plenty of volunteers on site. The race is known for its good organization and offers the opportunity to compete with other runners or simply enjoy running.

name: Wilscher FUN-RUN
description: The Wilsche FunRun is a longstanding race that has been held annually at the Wilsche sports field in Gifhorn since 2005. It is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup and offers an appealing race over a 10 km distance. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and strong participation, and is an established part of the regional running scene. The race starts promptly at 10 a.m., and the event is supported by local organizations such as the fire brigades and the German Red Cross.

name: Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. It offers routes of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied supporting program that includes face painting for children. The event is particularly suitable for runners of all ages and places great emphasis on a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.

name: Trail Český ráj
description: Trail Český ráj is a popular trail half marathon that takes you through the heart of Český ráj, including the courtyard of Kost Castle, pine groves and sandstone cliffs. This race continues the popular ELEVEN PŮLMARATON ČESKÝ RÁJ, now in its eleventh edition, and offers what is probably the most beautiful trail half-marathon course in the Czech Republic. The start is by Komárov Pond, and the finish is a reward for every runner. The race also offers runners a wide range of services, including refreshments, changing rooms and medical assistance.

name: PoHodová devítka
description: PoHodová Devítka is a traditional running race in Velká Bíteš, held in September after the local festival. The main course is 9 km long and suitable for all runners, while children can compete on shorter courses. The race offers a friendly atmosphere and is open to the general public, with categories for children and youths. About one third of the route is on asphalt and two thirds on unpaved roads. The race takes place amid normal road traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.

name: Memoriál Matěje Mauera
description: The Matěj Mauer Memorial is a 9 km running race that runs mostly along forest trails, with one longer climb. The race takes place in the picturesque Capartice area near Plzeň and is part of the Běžec Chodska series. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves in a natural setting on a more challenging course. It is suitable for runners seeking a trail challenge and the atmosphere of a traditional race.

name: Bešeňovský charitatívny beh pre MAPENZI
organizer: Občianske združenie MAPENZI by Generation of love, Obec Bešeňov
description: The Bešeňov Charity Run for MAPENZI is a running event organized by the MAPENZI by Generation of Love civic association and the municipality of Bešeňov. The races take place at the football field in Bešeňov and include 10 km and 5 km categories, children’s races, and a recreational 2 km run. The children’s races start at 15:00 and the main race at 16:00. The event is charitable in nature and suitable for the general public, including people of various age groups.

name: Olšavský pohár – Memoriál Júliusa Kažimíra
location: Ruskov okr. Košice okolie, Ruskov okr. Košice okolie, pred Obecným úradom
organizer: Obec Ruskov and Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Ruskov
description: The Olšavský Cup – Július Kažimír Memorial is a running race held in the village of Ruskov in the Košice-okolie District. The race offers two main courses of 16.8 km and 9.7 km, with the start in front of the Municipal Office. Men, women, and children can compete in various age categories. The event is organized by the municipality of Ruskov and the Ruskov Volunteer Fire Brigade in cooperation with neighboring municipalities. The race is suitable for the general public, including seniors and children, who can enter for free.

name: 404. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Little Monaco Prize is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race has a long history and is part of the KRB Chrudim club’s running calendar. It offers a sporting atmosphere and an opportunity to test yourself on an interesting course in beautiful surroundings. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Zlín
description: The Night Run for Světluška in Zlín is a charity running event held on September 24, 2026, at náměstí Míru. The start is at 8:00 p.m., and participants can choose a route to suit them or walk it. Entry packages are available in two options—with a headlamp or a sports headband. Part of the entry fee goes toward helping people with severe visual impairments, underscoring the event’s charitable nature. There is also an accompanying program for all participants.

name: Běh okolo Campusu
organizer: Běžecký spolek z.s. a Sportuj s námi, z.s.
description: The Run Around Campus is a running race in Brno, held in the Bohunice district. The race features a 5.6 km loop, with men and women competing in a single category. The program also includes a children’s race for children of any age, with the loop length determined before the start. The event is friendly and open to all runners, offering a chance to discover interesting places in Brno.

name: Bėgimo varžybos Kauno rajono mero Valerijaus Makūno ir olimpiečio Kęstučio Orento taurei laimėti
Schülerlauf
description: The Rüppurr Schools’ Students’ Run is a long-standing annual running competition that brings together students from various schools in Karlsruhe. The event has separate categories for girls and boys, and all participants receive certificates and medals. Prizes are awarded for first, second and third place. Registration is through the schools, and late entries are possible on the day of the event. The run takes place around the TUS Rüppurr club grounds and encourages young athletes in the region.

name: Eleven Večerní běh
description: ELEVEN Evening Run is a 5 km night race held in the early evening at the VOLT brewery grounds in Jablonec nad Nisou. The route runs around three reservoirs and is suitable for men, women and young people aged 16 and over, as well as children up to 15 years old. The race offers a sporting atmosphere, chip timing and valuable gifts for the first participants to register. The start and finish are at the brewery grounds, where race numbers can also be collected.

name: Běh Březinou v Polné
description: The Březinou Run in Polná is a traditional running race organized by Běžecký tým Polná and Běžec Vysočiny z.s. and held at the football stadium in Polná. The race offers courses for different age categories, from the youngest children to veterans, with the main 9.5 km race following field and forest paths through the valley of the Šlapanka River. The race starts at 17:00, and participants can expect a pleasant atmosphere and commemorative prizes for the top finishers in each category. The race has a long tradition, with more than 39 editions since 1992.

name: Beh Tokajskými vinicami
location: Oddychové centrum, Čerhov, Trebišov District, Slovakia
description: The Run Through the Tokaj Vineyards is a traditional running race held in the village of Čerhov in the Trebišov District. The course winds through the picturesque Tokaj vineyards, offering beautiful natural scenery and a pleasant setting for runners of all ages. The event is suitable for both amateur and experienced runners who want to enjoy a day of sport outdoors and discover the unique Tokaj region. It is organized by the municipality of Čerhov, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Tokaj vineyards, with beautiful views
Natural surroundings with moderate elevation gain
A combination of paved and forest roads
additional: The event takes place at the Recreation Centre in Čerhov. A course map is available on the municipality’s website. No specific start times or wave assignments are provided. Registration information is available on a separate page. No entry fees or race categories are listed.

name: Greičio ratai 2026
description: Greičio ratai 2026 is a running competition taking place at Vilnius Vingis Park Stadium on September 25, 2026. The event includes 60 m races for children, 1,000 m races with special categories for people with disabilities using tricycles, and 5×1,000 m relay races for mixed, men’s, and women’s teams. The aim of the competition is to promote running as a healthy lifestyle, popularize athletics, and determine the strongest teams. Participants must follow the rules. The event is open to everyone, and registration is required in advance.

name: #BeActive bėgimas, skirtas Europos sporto savaitei
description: The European Week of Sport #BeActive event in Vilkaviškis is an important community tradition, inviting people of all ages and fitness levels to spend time actively. The program includes relay races, active games, football, wrestling and chess competitions, line dancing, exercise, Nordic walking and a group walk around the city. The evening program culminates in a group dance and an energetic “Dance party” to Zumba rhythms, bringing participants together and highlighting the importance of movement in the community.

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Poland
description: Nocna Piątka is a unique 5-kilometer race taking place on September 26, 2026, in Gdańsk, the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are located on the illuminated pitch of Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, where participants can expect a spectacular show featuring lasers, music, and lighting effects. The course winds through the city, with cheering points featuring music and fire shows creating a one-of-a-kind nighttime atmosphere. This new edition of the well-known half-marathon companion race has been moved to Saturday evening to offer runners and spectators a special experience.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Run Challenge is an annual running event held in Gliwice, combining sport, a friendly atmosphere and time in the city’s green spaces. The run is open to experienced runners and anyone looking to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The start traditionally takes place in the clearing behind the Piast Stadium, and the race office opens at 9:00, with the run starting at 10:00. Advance registration and an entry fee are required. It’s a great opportunity to end February actively and head into the upcoming spring season with renewed energy.

name: Kołobrzeska Odyseja
description: Kołobrzeska Odyseja ’26 is a series of three exceptional races held in Kołobrzeg, combining passion, strength, and a seaside atmosphere. The event offers races over 5 km, half-marathon, marathon, and 10 km distances. The courses are certified by the PZLA, and participants can look forward to generous race packs, a finisher zone with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It’s a great opportunity to feel the energy of the seaside and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.

name: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Koło Towarzystwa Przyjaciół Lasu "Dolina Małej Panwi"
description: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi – In Pursuit of the Beaver is a running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque surroundings of Zawadzkie. The event offers 5.3 km and 10.3 km routes through the Mała Panew Valley, giving participants the chance to connect with nature and enjoy an active break. It is organised by the Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Association and the “Dolina Małej Panwi” Circle of the Society of Friends of the Forest.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
XIII Bieg Branicki
description: The 13th Branice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on September 26, 2026, in Branice, Opole Voivodeship. Runners can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The organizers provide expert support and the option to manage race information through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: XXI Mikołowski Bieg Uliczny
description: The 21st Henryk Biskupiak Mikołów Street Race is the biggest sporting celebration in Mikołów and takes place annually. The street race attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting physical activity and the spirit of sporting competition. Participants can take on a route through the city streets, while the organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere full of sporting excitement. The event is an excellent opportunity to bring the local community together and promote a healthy lifestyle.

name: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków
description: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków is a cross-country race held in Reduta Park in Kraków, with 5 km and 10 km routes. The course runs mainly along paths and forest tracks, with one significant climb, combining sport with the opportunity to learn about the history of the Kraków Fortress. After the race, participants can explore historic fortifications and sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a guide, making the event a unique combination of physical activity and historical education. The organizers are members of the Adventure Association, who have been involved in organizing sporting and adventure events for years.
course_highlights: Cross-country course along paths and forest tracks
One substantial climb on the course
Visit to historic sites of the Kraków Fortress after the race
additional: After the race, participants and accompanying persons can visit historic sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a professional guide. The top finishers receive unique trophies made from 100-year-old bricks. The race routes are off-road and green, with history in the background. Guided visits to sites of the former Kraków Fortress are available after the race. Information about the distances, course, and location comes from previous editions; details of the edition on 25.09.2027 have not been confirmed.

name: VIII Bieg Szlakiem Kolejowym
location: Czerwona Woda, Gmina Węgliniec, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Schottener Stauseelauf
description: The Schotten Reservoir Run is organized by TGV Schotten, the largest sports club in the Vogelsberg region. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete on varied courses around the reservoir. The run is part of the club’s extensive sports program, which also includes numerous major running events. Participants and visitors are warmly welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Running routes around the Schotten Reservoir
Varied terrain in the Vogelsberg region
Organized by an experienced sports club with professional timing
additional: Registration, results and certificates are provided through the club’s own timing service, "TGV SportStar". TGV Schotten is a large sports club with more than 1,300 members and organizes other major events in running and other disciplines in addition to the Reservoir Run. The race is known for its fast, flat course and attracts runners from across the region. Registration is available on the official website, and the event is a popular opportunity for recreational and competitive runners to improve their personal bests.

name: Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte
description: The 19th Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte takes place on September 26, 2026, and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. The routes pass through the historic town center, along the Ems and through the surrounding countryside, vividly reflecting the motto “Town, Country and River.” In addition to the 10,000-meter main race, there are other events, including a 5,000-meter race, walking, children’s and Bambini races, and an untimed fun run. The event is suitable for competitive runners, recreational runners and families, and is organized by TV Friesen Telgte e.V.
course_highlights: 10,000-meter main race through the historic town center, the Ems floodplains and the countryside
5,000-meter race with a water station halfway along the course
Varied routes featuring asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €2 late-entry fee (for the Bambini race, charged once per family or group). Changing facilities are available at the old double gymnasium at the school center, close to the start and finish. Medals, trophies and certificates are awarded in various events and age groups. The course is varied, with asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails. Photos and video recordings will be taken and published. The start and finish are at the school center sports field; registration is online; changing facilities are at the Old Double Gymnasium; children’s races are not timed.

name: Herbstcross des SSV-MG-Ahlsdorf / 2. Peter Zinke Gedenklauf
MOUNTAINMAN Reit im Winkl
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: MOUNTAINMAN Reit im Winkl is a challenging trail-running event in the Chiemgau Alps, with five different distances ranging from 11 to 73 kilometers. The routes pass through impressive mountain scenery, with highlights including ski jumps, the idyllic Klausenbach Gorge, alpine pastures, and Dürrnbachhorn, with breathtaking views all the way to the Wilder Kaiser. The event welcomes trail runners from beginners to professionals, although the longer distances are suitable only for experienced runners. Special routes are available for hikers, and dogs are also welcome on the shorter routes. The event offers a friendly, family atmosphere, with an expo, Kids’ Trail, Community Trail, and a pasta party on the evening before the race.

name: Kreuzhorst Ultra
description: The Kreuzhorst Ultra (KRHU) is a family-friendly backyard ultra in Magdeburg-Kreuzhorst, taking place for the third time on September 26, 2026. The 6.7 km course starts again every full hour, and participants run as many laps as they can or wish to. The race is a private invitation-only event focused on community, passion, and the joy of running. The course runs mostly along forest and field paths with no significant climbs, and there are classifications for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km.

name: Bausch+Ströbel Stadtlauf Ilshofen
description: The Bausch+Ströbel Ilshofen City Run is a long-standing running event held annually in Ilshofen. It offers runners of various ages and ability levels the opportunity to compete on a varied route through the city. The course is well marked and passes through attractive parts of the city, making the race appealing to both participants and spectators. The city run is a popular event on the regional running calendar and is organized by TSV Ilshofen.

name: Bergzeitlauf Brockenheroes 2026
description: The BROCKENHEROES mountain time trial and mountain race is a challenging individual time trial in the Harz, taking place on September 26, 2026, in Schierke. Participants compete on a range of courses of up to 24 km and up to 900 meters of elevation gain, including road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing, and Nordic walking. The event offers a unique challenge against the clock, the mountain, and oneself, starting on Brockenstraße and finishing on the Brocken plateau. The atmosphere is defined by sporting ambition and the impressive natural scenery of the Harz.

name: Böckstiegellauf
description: The Böckstiegellauf is a scenic race through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills, running from Peter auf’m Berge in Bielefeld to the center of Werther. Distances include 18 km and 10 km, as well as a 2.5 km schoolchildren’s race. The course partly follows the Hermannslauf and passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum. The event is very well organized, with a shuttle bus from the finish to the start and an awards ceremony in the center of Werther.

name: Cloppenburger Citylauf
organizer: Stadt Cloppenburg, Lauftreff des SV Bethen
description: The Cloppenburg City Run is a popular running event held as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival, which takes place annually on the last weekend in September. The main race starts at the Red School on the market square and runs along Eschstraße to Rathausplatz. In addition to the main race, there is a relay competition in which teams of four each complete a course of approximately 1,000 metres four times. The event is organised by the running group of SV Bethen e. V. and overseen by the NLV district of Cloppenburg.

name: Crosslauf Winhöring
description: The cross-country race in Winhöring on September 26, 2026, offers a varied event for different age groups and performance levels. The event includes a 7.5 km main race and a 700 m children’s course. The route runs through the scenic surroundings of Winhöring and offers runners of all ages an athletic challenge.

name: Drei-Täler-Lauf
description: The 3-Täler-Lauf, organized by TV Mettingen 1930 e.V., takes place on September 26, 2026, and takes participants along varied routes through the three valleys of Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal in the Tecklenburger Land. The 14.1 km main race features challenging, hilly terrain and impressive views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg. There is also an 8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes alike. Children are warmly welcome to take part in an 800 m schoolchildren’s race and a 400 m Bambini run, where fun takes center stage. The event is family-friendly and offers timing with a disposable chip, as well as showers and changing rooms at Ludgeri-Schule.

name: Emmertinger Herbstfestlauf
description: The Emmerting Herbstfest Run takes place at the sports field in Emmerting and is part of the local autumn festival. The event is aimed at children, adults, club runners, recreational runners, and walkers. There are various distances, including Bambini runs, children’s races, 5- and 10-kilometer runs, and Nordic walking routes. Its family-friendly, festive atmosphere makes the run a popular meeting place for the local running community.

name: Herbstfestlauf
description: The 30th Niederstetten Autumn Festival Run takes place around the town hall in Niederstetten and offers varied routes for all age groups. The shorter races run through the town center, while the main race follows the scenic Vorbach Valley. Participants can look forward to beautiful views of the vineyards and Weikersheim Castle. A range of race categories, from the mini run to the relay, means there is something for everyone.

name: Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf
description: The Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf is a long-standing running event that has been held annually on the Pohl-Boskamp grounds since 2002. With distances of 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km, the race offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is especially family-friendly, with special Bambini runs for children and a varied program featuring games, a food mile and entertainment. It promotes a sense of community and the joy of being active, and welcomes individuals, school classes, teams and companies.

name: Hotfoot Run Warstein
description: The Hotfoot Run Warstein is a spectacular obstacle race on September 26, 2026, with distances ranging from 5 km (Family Edition) to 20 km, making it suitable for all fitness levels and age groups. The course crosses the Montgolfiade grounds and the ski slope, and passes through the quarry, with plenty of muddy obstacles, water slides, and foam. The event features an exciting start show and a unique atmosphere, and has promoted team spirit and fun since 2007. Whether you’re a fitness enthusiast, part of a fun-loving group, or with your family, everyone can enjoy an unforgettable adventure here in NRW.

name: Höhlerfestlauf
description: The 11th Höhlerfest Run on September 26, 2026, in Gera offers a varied running event with routes for all ages and ability levels. New this year is the 22 km cross-country run with obstacles and 420 m of elevation gain, which passes through the Stadtwald and Hofwiesenpark. In addition to classic distances from 0.8 km to 12 km, there are walking and handicap routes, as well as the popular parent-child run for preschoolers. The event stands out for its special atmosphere, with live music and a family-friendly feel, supported by the City of Gera.

name: König Ludwig Lauf - Sommeredition
description: The König Ludwig Lauf - Summer Edition is Bavaria’s most scenic panoramic run in the Ammergau Alps. The event offers varied courses from 6 km to 21 km through the picturesque landscape of the Ammergau Alps Nature Park. A free shuttle bus takes participants to the start in Ettal, and the event is ideal for trail and landscape running enthusiasts. Its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized arrangements make the run a special experience.

name: Oldersumer Appel-Loop
description: The Oldersum Appel-Loop is a popular race that passes through Oldersum’s picturesque parks, along the Rorichumer Tief canal, and through the “alte Seilerei” museum. The course finishes in the apple park, where the Oldersum Apple Market is also taking place and refreshments are available. In addition to the main 5 km and 10 km races, there is a 5 km walking route and 800 m children’s races for various age groups. The race is part of the Ostfriesische 7 running series and offers a lovely atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: R5K Berlin
description: The R5K Tour Final 2026 is a youth race held as part of the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON, where ambitious runners aged 12 to 22 can compare their 5 km times. The final in Berlin is part of a series of three races, with times added together to determine the overall winners in the U20 and U23 age groups. Alongside the sporting challenge, attractive prize money and training camp grants are available for the top participants. The event supports young athletes and offers a thrilling platform for emerging running talent.

name: Wald-und Hügellauf
description: The Forest and Hill Run in Groß-Umstadt is a long-standing race that starts and finishes at Ludwig-Wedel-Stadion on September 26, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: the classic 13.2 km course and the half marathon distance of 21.1 km. The race is part of the Langlauf Cup Jugenheim and is sanctioned by the DLV. The route runs through forests and hills, where runners can expect witches in the woods and the “Mountain of Truth.” Refreshments are available along the course, and after the race there is an awards ceremony, with showers and changing rooms on site.

name: Mělnický vinařský běh
description: The Mělník Wine Run is a traditional running race in Mělník, offering 10 km and 21 km courses. The race takes place on a single loop with beautiful views of the castle and vineyards, and the route passes historic and natural attractions in the surrounding area. After the finish, participants can enjoy a tasting of local wines, a commemorative glass, a free lunch, and a large prize draw. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own free races. The event is organized by the Run the World association, which promotes running as a friendly community activity.

name: Grymovská pětka
description: Grymov Five is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering athletes the chance to test their abilities in the pleasant surroundings of the town of Grymov. Liga stovkařů Olomouc is a club specializing in recreational and competitive running that organizes a number of endurance races in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of its running calendar and attracts runners of various ages and ability levels. The club also supports runners with training and race preparation, ensuring a high-quality sporting experience.

name: Běh Bohutínem
description: Běh Bohutínem is a traditional running race organized by SK Sporting Bohutín and held at the Litavan football pitch. The race offers an 8 km course for men and a 4 km course for women, with a surface combining asphalt and forest trails. The event also includes children’s races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The main race starts at 13:00, and the atmosphere is friendly and sporty.

name: Běh Zlínského kraje
description: The Zlín Region Run is part of the Zlín Region Day celebrations, taking place on 26 September 2026 in Zlín. The event offers not only a sporting experience in the form of a 6 km run, but also a cultural programme, regional cuisine and family activities. The run is open to the general public and is part of a fun-filled day featuring crafts and regional products. The event is organised by the Zlín Region, which supports sport and local traditions.

name: Běh Velké skály
description: Běh Velké skály is a traditional running race held in Děčín, offering 11 km and 6.5 km courses through forest and urban terrain. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including children, for whom special races are held. The race starts at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium, and its atmosphere is enhanced by the beautiful surrounding countryside and rock formations. The race is now in its 56th edition and is known for its exceptional atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Plzeňský kardioběh
description: The Plzeň Cardio Run is Plzeň’s largest cross-country race, with 5.8 km and 10 km courses. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and also serves as the Czech Republic Cross-Country Championship for healthcare professionals. It is organized by Pro Sport Activities, an agency with a long-standing tradition of organizing sporting events in Plzeň and the surrounding area. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a quality sporting experience in the natural surroundings of Plzeň-Roudná.

name: 7 pohoří Beskydy
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountain Ranges is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The Beskydy race takes place at the Horečky amphitheatre in Trojanovice and offers technical trails, epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. The routes follow forest roads and paths, with climbs up interesting hills and long descents. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can look forward to refreshments and professional facilities.

name: ŠumpeRUN
location: Historical Centre of Šumperk, Šumperk, Czech Republic
description: ŠumpeRUN is a popular city race through the historic center of Šumperk. The eighth edition offers races for the general public, including the main 10 km race, a 3.33 km race, three-person relay teams, and children’s races of various lengths. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit while celebrating the city’s cultural heritage. For 2026, a varied program of activities is planned, including group warm-ups and music along the course.

name: K3-run
description: K3 – the Krčmaň Run over Three Peaks is an 11.3 km race with approximately 350 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through beautiful countryside over three peaks, mainly on paved paths and partly on grass, with predominantly firm surfaces. This run offers athletes an enjoyable experience in nature and a challenge in the form of climbs and trail running.

name: Horský beh Pačanským chotárom
location: Pača, okr. Rožňava, Pača, okr. Rožňava, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Pačanský Chotár Mountain Run is a running event in the village of Pača, offering two main courses: a more challenging 13.5 km main race with 492 m of elevation gain and a shorter 6.3 km hobby run with 203 m of elevation gain. The routes combine paved and forest roads, with beautiful views and refreshment stations along the way. Runners start and finish in front of the cultural centre in Pača, and the organizers provide route navigation and marking. The event is suitable for both experienced and recreational runners and offers a sporting atmosphere with refreshments and a raffle.

name: Rybnícka 10-ka a 5-ka
location: Rybník, okr. Levice, Rybník, okr. Levice, futbalový štadión
organizer: Obec Rybník, ZŠ s MŠ Rybník
description: Rybník 10K and 5K is a running event held at the football stadium in the village of Rybník, Levice District. Races are held over two distances—5 km and 10 km—with various age categories for men and women. The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including secondary school students and seniors, who receive discounted entry fees. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and quality facilities for runners.

name: Behaj lesmi Devín
description: Behaj lesmi Devín is a unique trail race near Bratislava, offering a route with views of the confluence of the Danube and Morava rivers and Devínska Kobyla. The trails follow the historic Amber Road and pass through blooming wild garlic avenues, making the run an unforgettable experience. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is listed as a UTMB Index Race, providing an international points ranking. You can compete on the short 12 km route or the 22 km half marathon. Both routes feature a marked Conti Speed Section, with a valuable prize up for grabs.

name: S Ankou za život
description: The Run with Anka for Life is a charity event held in Košice near St. Elisabeth Cathedral. The entry fee is a voluntary contribution, and all proceeds from entry fees go to the Oáza - Hope for a New Life facility. The event is organized by the Anka Kolesárová Pastoral Centre in Vysoká nad Uhom. Runners can combine a sporting challenge with supporting a good cause.

name: Hutčanská 5 s vierou – beh srdcom i telom
description: The Run with Heart and Soul in Nižná Hutka is an annual running event offering a 5 km course for experienced runners and a fun 500 m route for the youngest participants. Alongside the sporting experience, the program includes a spiritual reflection, refreshments, a panel discussion, and music. The event creates a welcoming community atmosphere and encourages both competition and the joy of running.

name: XXVI Nidos pusės maratono bėgimas. Lietuvos pusės maratono bėgimo čempionatas.
description: The International Nida Half Marathon is a traditional annual event held in Nida, on the Curonian Spit. The event includes a half-marathon distance, the 5 km YIT Run, and shorter distances for children and young people. It is a great opportunity for both professional and recreational runners to enjoy running in a unique natural setting and take part in the Lithuanian Half Marathon Championships. The event encourages physical activity and promotes sport in Lithuania, while participants can look forward to professionally prepared courses and a friendly atmosphere.

name: VERTICAL VILNIUS 2026
organizer: TA Trail Akademija VŽ Vaidas Žlabys
description: Vertical Vilnius is Lithuania’s most vertical off-road running race, held in Vilnius. Participants tackle the slopes of Liepkalnis, and the race offers an opportunity to earn ITRA ranking points. An eco-friendly “Trash Vertical” challenge is also organized to encourage participants to care for the environment. Registration for the event is free, so everyone is invited to take part and test their strength on this unique course.

name: 26-as Tarptautinis Nidos Pusės Maratono Bėgimas
description: The 26th International Nida Half Marathon will take place on September 26, 2026, in Nida. The event offers several distances: a half marathon, a 5 km YIT run, a 2 km youth run, and short children’s runs (500 m and 210 m). The courses are certified according to World Athletics and AIMS requirements, and the starts take place at different locations in Nida. This traditional event encourages physical activity and promotes running and athletics in Lithuania.

name: Vertical Vilnius
description: Vertical Vilnius is Lithuania’s most vertical off-road running race, held on the slopes of Liepkalnis in Vilnius. Participants tackle steep mountain slopes, aiming to earn ITRA rating points and take part in the eco-friendly “Trash Vertical” challenge. The race promotes physical activity and environmental care, inviting runners to test their strength on a unique course.

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, featuring a 21.0975 km course. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is open to mass participation, with starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time, and participants can also enter 4-person relay teams. The organizers provide professional timekeeping, medical support, refreshments and water along the course. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and helps raise the profile of Gdańsk in Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km half-marathon course in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time
additional: The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The start is divided into time-based corrals according to declared finish time (red, blue, green and yellow). Relay teams start from the blue corral. The race package includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timekeeping, medical support, water at refreshment points, refreshments after the finish and a medal. The full race package is guaranteed for payments made by 30.08.2026. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer’s consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including a half marathon and 5 km race, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration takes place online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or by traditional bank transfer. Races for children and teenagers are also available.

name: 48. Maraton Warszawski
description: The 48th Warsaw Marathon is a special running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting thousands of runners. The course passes through the capital’s most beautiful and historic locations, offering unique views and an unforgettable atmosphere. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and T-shirt, while spectators can enjoy numerous attractions and cheering zones. It is a celebration of running that brings together sport, culture, and community.
course_highlights: Start beneath the Palace of Culture and Science in the centre of Warsaw
The course passes along Krakowskie Przedmieście and Nowy Świat, over Poniatowski Bridge with views of the Vistula, and by PGE Narodowy
Road closures ensure safe and comfortable running conditions
additional: The race number must be worn on the front of the clothing and must not be covered or altered. The start and finish are in the city centre, near metro stations. On race day, baggage storage, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event features numerous attractions and cheering zones, as well as a programme at the Marathon Fan Zone and EXPO Sport&Fitness. Participants can join the #BiegamDobrze charity programme with a free race number. Races include a 10 km event (Warszawska Dycha) and the Mini Marathon for children and young people, held during the same weekend. Registration is available through the official website, and the event also includes a half marathon and a 5 km race. The organisers provide attractions and support for participants.

name: 21. Kamień Extreme - Rybnik
description: The 21st Kamień Extreme is a challenging mountain run held in Rybnik, attracting fans of extreme running challenges. The race takes place on September 27, 2026, and offers professional timing using RFID technology. The event is organized by MOSiR Rybnik, providing participants with smooth organization and a sporting atmosphere. The race starts at 12:00, and registration closes on September 17, 2026, at 23:59.

name: 1 Półmaraton Ostrzeszowski
description: The 1st Ostrzeszów Half Marathon – Along the Crown of the Wielkopolska Hills 2026 is a unique half-marathon taking place in picturesque Ostrzeszów. The course leads over two hills and past two springs, offering participants one-of-a-kind views and terrain challenges. It’s a great opportunity to experience the natural beauty of Wielkopolska and enjoy a sporting adventure in a friendly atmosphere. We invite all runners to take on the challenge and join the event.
course_highlights: Course over two hills
Route passes two springs
Picturesque landscapes of Wielkopolska

name: 16 Bieg im. Pawła Lorensa
description: The 16th Paweł Lorens Memorial Run is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque setting of Lake Paprocany in Tychy. The race commemorates the achievements of outstanding runner Paweł Lorens, a multiple Polish Championship medalist and promoter of athletics in the region. The course is flat and fast, following compacted paths along the pedestrian promenade and a paved sidewalk. Free children’s races are also held on race day, with registration available on the day of the event.

name: Kresowe Trail #11
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate, non-commercial trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place mainly in the Podlasie region and surrounding areas, offering two distances: Szpurt (approx. 6–8 km) and Wertep (approx. 17–21 km). The events have a limited number of participants, helping ensure safety and respect for nature and local communities. They welcome both beginner and experienced runners and also include Nordic walking competitions. The 2026 season will conclude with the final race in Michałowo on September 27.

name: X Półmaraton Crossowy
description: The X TOYOTA Cross Half Marathon is a cross-country race held in Jelcz-Laskowice on September 27, 2026. The event is organized by KB Harcownik Jelcz-Laskowice, and the race office is open from 08:00 to 10:30 at the Nad Stawem center. Participants can compete in the 21.1 km and 10.5 km races, or take part in the 10.5 km Nordic Walking event. The event is supported by local institutions and partners, and timing is electronic, using modern equipment.

name: XXVIII Jesienne Biegi Małkińskie
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Małkini Górnej
description: The 28th Małkinia Autumn Runs is an annual running event held in Małkinia Górna, attracting runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The competition takes place on cross-country routes, offering participants the chance to compete amid beautiful autumn scenery. The event is part of the Cross-Country Running and Nordic Walking Grand Prix, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in the local community.

name: Festiwal Biegowy i Nordic Walking
location: Olszewo-Borki, Ostrołęka County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Nice To Fit You Warszawska Dycha
Nowotarski Półmaraton
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XII Zielona Wierzchosławicka Dycha
location: Wierzchosławice, Tarnów County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: 14. Bahrs-Kartoffellauf
description: The 14th Bahrs Potato Run 2026 in Jembke offers runners a varied program with three distances: the 10 km Bahrs Run, the 5 km Potato Run, and an 800 m children’s run. The event takes place on September 27, 2026, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, culinary delights, and a colorful program featuring performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders. Race bibs must be returned after the run, and there is no on-site registration. The event is part of the running cup and offers not only sporting challenges but also a chance to socialize over a generous cake buffet and savory dishes.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Komoot
5 km course on Komoot
800 m children’s run
additional: Start times: 10 km Bahrs Run at 10:30, 5 km Potato Run at 12:00, and 800 m children’s run at 13:15. No on-site registration; advance registration only. Race bibs must be returned after the run. Food and drink include potato soup, veggie bowls, potato pancakes with applesauce, burgers, bratwurst, shashlik, and rosemary potatoes. Performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders at approximately 11:45 and 13:00. Award ceremonies take place after the respective races. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, diverse running options for all age groups, and the opportunity to combine the run with a social gathering.

name: Asse-Volkslauf und Nordic Walking
description: The Asse Run and Nordic Walking event organised by TSV "Vater Jahn" Wittmar is held annually and will take place for the 34th time on 27 September 2026. The event is very popular, with record participation last year. It offers various running and walking routes in the beautiful surroundings of Wittmar and is open to athletes of all ages. Registration opens at the end of June. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run.
course_highlights: Route distances: 0.3 km and 10.6 km
Nordic walking included
Venue: Wittmar, Germany
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run. Registration opens at the end of June; detailed information is available in the official race announcement. The event includes running and Nordic walking events.

name: Schusterlauf
description: The Schusterlauf Preetz is a long-standing running event with various distances, taking place on September 27, 2026, in Preetz. The challenging 16 km course leads through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker, and requires good to very good fitness. Alongside the main race, there are shorter distances, including the Bambini Run for children and the Kirchsee and Wehrberg runs. The event is part of the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, where participants can earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: 16 km course through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker
Good, firm-footed trails in the Wehrberg and along the shores of Lake Kirchsee
Challenging course with a changeover point at Gut Wahlstorf
additional: Race number collection is available the day before the event (19:00–20:00) and on race day from 08:00 at the Alte Wilhelminenhalle, Schulstraße 2, 24211 Preetz. Participation in the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, including points scoring, is automatic. Race number changes are not possible. New service: Bags can be dropped off in a truck on the Marktplatz near the finish. GPX files for the 5 km and 16 km courses are available to download. Courses are available as GPX files; online registration; start and finish in Preetz; bag drop-off service and results downloads.

name: Bergkloster-Lauf
description: The Bergklosterlauf, organized by TuS Velmede-Bestwig in cooperation with Bergkloster Bestwig, takes place on September 27, 2026, in the Sauerland. The 6, 10 and 21-kilometer races pass idyllic streams, run along ridges with magnificent views and through smaller settlements before finishing at Bergkloster Bestwig. In addition to the races, there are children’s and youth races, plus a supporting program featuring live music, childcare, free massages and extensive catering. The event is also part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup organized by LAC Veltins Hochsauerland. The start and finish are easy to reach and offer ample parking, as well as affordable accommodation at Bergkloster.
course_highlights: Routes pass idyllic streams
Ridges with magnificent viewpoints
Finish at Bergkloster Bestwig
additional: Free massages are offered after the finish. Childcare is available for “running parents.” The start and finish are just 600 meters apart and are easy to reach by bus, train or car. There are 500 parking spaces nearby, including spaces for motorhomes. Affordable accommodation is available at Bergkloster. The 10-kilometer race is also open to walkers. The children’s and youth races start at 12:00. The 10-kilometer race and the children’s and youth races are scoring events for the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup. Routes of 6, 10 and 21 km; children’s and youth races; registration via Race Result; parking and accommodation at Bergkloster; route maps on Outdooractive

name: Internationaler Hochfelln-Berglauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Nenngeld 40.- € inklusive Nudelparty, Talfahrt mit der Hochfellnseilbahn, Parkplatz, Verpflegungsbuffet, Duschen, Gepäcktransport

description: The International Hochfelln Mountain Run is a traditional mountain race in Bergen, Germany, held annually. The course starts in the valley at the Hochfelln cable car station at an altitude of 600 metres and finishes at the summit of the Hochfelln at 1,671 metres. It is 7.8 km long, with 1,071 metres of elevation gain. The race is part of the Mountain Running Grand Prix and offers runners a challenging, scenic mountain-running experience. In addition to the race, the event includes a pasta party and a wide range of refreshments for participants.
course_highlights: 7.8 km course with 1,071 m of elevation gain
Start at the valley station of the Hochfelln cable car (600 m), finish at the Hochfelln summit (1,671 m)
Part of the Mountain Running Grand Prix, with challenging mountain terrain
additional: The €40 entry fee includes Saturday's pasta party, the downhill ride on the Hochfelln cable car, parking, a generous refreshment buffet, showers and luggage transport. Race bibs can be collected on the evening before the race and on race day. Welcome party with pasta dinner on Saturday evening. Mountain trail terrain, registration required, historic race with multiple editions.

name: Volkslauf durch das schöne Alstertal
description: The Volkslauf through the beautiful Alstertal takes place on 27 September 2026 in Hamburg and offers runners an appealing natural route along the hiking trails in the upper reaches of the Alster. The event includes various distances, from the half marathon to 10 km and 4 km, as well as fun runs for children. The route stands out for its natural setting in the heart of Hamburg, with a few small climbs and stairs. The event is part of the 27th Hamburg Laufcup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and medical care.

name: 52. BMW Berlin-Marathon
description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the largest and most prestigious marathon events in the world and is part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors. The course is known for its flat terrain and takes runners past Berlin’s most beautiful landmarks. In addition to the classic marathon, the event offers a 5-kilometer race, inline skating races, and various ways to take part through charity, tour operators, or running camps. The event is distinguished by its unique energy and international running community.

name: Northeimer Stadtlauf
description: The Northeim City Run is a long-standing running event held in the city of Northeim. The races start and finish at Münsterplatz, a central location in the city. The event is organized by Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V. and offers a sporting event for runners of all ages. It takes place on September 27, 2026, and includes various race routes through the city.

name: Aindlinger Kleeblattmarsch
description: The Aindling Cloverleaf March is a unique 24-hour march in which participants can cover up to 100 kilometers over four 25-kilometer loops. The route is not marked and there are no road closures, requiring considerable determination and a good sense of direction. The route passes through varied, hilly landscapes around Aindling, including woodland and open countryside as well as picturesque villages. The march supports social projects, combining athletic effort with a good cause.

name: Auricher Spendenlauf
description: The Aurich Charity Run is a charitable running event benefiting various organizations, including Leukin e.V. and the Sandhorst Volunteer Fire Department. The races take place around the Energy Experience Center in Aurich and offer competitions for all age groups, from a children’s race to main races over 5 and 10 kilometers. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of numerous volunteers and sponsors. Award ceremonies take place soon after the races, and certificates are available online.

name: Kienberglauf
description: The Kienberglauf is a traditional running event organized by SV 08 Oehrenstock e.V. and held annually on the last Sunday in September. The event offers various competitions for different age groups and ability levels, including Nordic walking, children’s races, and distances from 2 to 16 kilometers. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Oehrenstock near Ilmenau and is a highlight of club life. The fastest runners receive trophies, and all participants receive a certificate.

name: Kleeblattultra (100-Meilen-Lauf)
description: The Kleeblattultra is a challenging 100-mile ultramarathon in Schwarme, Lower Saxony, that passes through three districts. The event was conceived with the idea of establishing the first 100-mile race in northern Germany. Organized by TSV Schwarme and a dedicated four-person team, the race offers experienced ultrarunners a unique opportunity to take on a special challenge. The course consists of four cloverleaf loops of 25 miles each, run consecutively. The event places emphasis on professional organization, with timing, live tracking, and aid stations.

name: Marner Kohltagelauf
description: The Marner Cabbage Day Run is a long-standing race in Dithmarschen and an official part of the Dithmarschen Cup and the Dithmarscher Company Cup. The event offers a range of distances, from 400 metres for children to 10 kilometres for adults. The courses are traffic-free, clearly marked, and have markers at every kilometre. Refreshments are available along the course and at the finish, and timing is provided professionally using a chip attached to the race number. The event takes place in almost any weather and offers changing and shower facilities at the Marne swimming pool.

name: Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf
description: The 10th Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf is a traditional scenic race for running and Nordic walking enthusiasts, taking place on September 26 and 27, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of Möhrendorf. The route follows forest, meadow, and field paths, passing numerous carp ponds, and includes approximately 150 meters of elevation gain over 21.1 km. In addition to the half marathon, there are Nordic walking events and various youth and children’s races. The event offers a varied, nature-rich setting for participants of all ages.

name: Nordahl Grieg Gedenklauf
organizer: Förderverein der Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule mit gymnasialer Oberstufe Kleinmachnow
description: The Nordahl Grieg Memorial Run is a long-standing running competition in Kleinmachnow, taking place on September 27, 2026, at Maxim Gorki Comprehensive School. The event offers various competitions for Bambini, schoolchildren, young people, and adults on circuits around the school and Lake Kleinmachnow. All participants can enjoy drinks and refreshments in the finish area and receive medals after crossing the finish line. The event is organized by the Friends of Maxim Gorki Comprehensive School and is held under the patronage of the Norwegian Ambassador and the Mayor of Kleinmachnow.

name: Ruhstorfer Geländelauf
description: The Ruhstorf Cross-Country Run is an approximately 7.5-kilometer trail run around Ruhstorf an der Rott, taking in beautiful scenery and several climbs. The route is roughly half asphalt and half farm and meadow paths. Its attractive natural setting makes the run suitable for both ambitious runners and beginners. It takes place annually and is part of the 2024 Grenzland Running Cup. The event is organized by SVG Ruhstorf e.V. and offers a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

name: SPORT IN Reisberglauf
description: The 29th SPORT IN Reisberglauf takes place on September 27, 2026, in Lippertshofen. The race is recognized by the German Athletics Association (DLV), which means results can be officially included in athletics rankings. Two distances are offered: a short 400-meter run and a longer 13.8-kilometer run. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete in an official, recognized race.

name: Bleckeder Storchenlauf
description: The 1st Bleckede Stork Run takes place on September 27, 2026, and offers runners and walkers various race distances in the great outdoors around the sports field in Bleckede. The routes pass through wooded areas and open spaces with small to medium-sized hills, providing varied running conditions. Bib numbers and chips must be collected 30 minutes before the respective start. The event is organized by VfL Bleckede von 1862 e. V. and is open to participants of all ages, including a Bambini run for the youngest children.

name: City-Lauf Lübeck
description: The City Run Lübeck 2026 takes place on September 27 and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. Events include a bambinilauf, school races, unicycle races, a 5 km run and walking event, and the 10 km main race. The routes pass through Lübeck’s city center, with current construction work taken into account to ensure attractive and safe running routes. The City Run is open to everyone, including those who are not members of a club, and offers team rankings and a friendly atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.

name: Crosslauf Friedrichsruh mit Kreismeisterschaft
description: The Friedrichsruh Cross-Country Run with District Championships is a cross-country event in Geestland, Germany, held at the Sportzentrum Nordeschweg. The event is organized by TV Langen von 1908 e.V. and offers various distances, from 0.5 km for the youngest participants up to 25 km. In addition to the district championship races for children, young people, and adults, there are also open supporting races over distances from 2.5 km to 10 km. The event is characterized by a friendly club atmosphere and a focused local running event.

name: Crosslauf und Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder
description: The Cross-Country Run & Nordic Walking event in Birkenwerder takes place on Sunday, 27 September 2026, and is organised by SV Grün-Weiß Birkenwerder e.V. Several race distances are offered, ranging from 400 m to 8.6 km, as well as a Nordic walking competition, in which the use of poles is mandatory. The event is open to various age groups, from Bambini to seniors. All participants receive a printable certificate, and medals are awarded to places 1 to 3. Registration is online, with a limit of 500 entries; late registration is possible through the day of the event.

name: Einstein-Marathon
description: The Ulm Einstein Marathon is one of the largest running events in southern Germany and takes place on September 27, 2026. The event offers various disciplines, including the classic marathon, half marathon, relay races, and other running and walking formats. The course runs through the city of Ulm, starting at the exhibition grounds and finishing at Münsterplatz. More than 15,000 runners are expected for the 22nd edition, which will feature a varied program and a special Einstein collection.

name: Elmshorner Stadtlauf
description: The Elmshorn City Run is a traditional running event for the whole family in Elmshorn. The officially measured 5 km loop runs mainly along paved roads through the city centre. In addition to the main races over 5 and 10 kilometres, children’s races over 600 m and 1.5 km are also offered. The event is also the SHLV State Championships and offers a lively atmosphere with refreshments and a supporting programme at Rathausplatz.

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
description: Běchovice–Prague is a legendary 10 km road race with the longest unbroken tradition in Europe, now being held for the 130th time. The race is the official Czech Republic Road Running Championships and features a challenging 10,031-metre course that will test every runner. The exceptional atmosphere is complemented by modern facilities, including an accompanying programme and commemorative medals. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and also offers a relay race.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
description: Běh Metropole is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle and a sense of belonging among residents of their district. The race is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, as well as people with disabilities, who represent their district. Every start earns points in the competition to determine Prague’s most sporting district. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with original medals and gifts for participants.

name: Mariatálsky štvanec
description: Mariatálsky štvanec is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Little Carpathians, offering a range of events for recreational and competitive runners. The event takes place in the village of Marianka, with a family-friendly atmosphere, and culminates in a beautiful sunset. You can compete in the 6 km, 10 km, and 15 km categories, in three-person teams over 3×6 km, or in the children’s Beh Záhoráčik races. The start and finish are at the football pitch, and the race is governed by the rules of the Slovak Athletic Federation.
