name: MTBIKER Kylof Ľubietová
location: Ľubietová, okr. Banská Bystrica, Ľubietová, okr. Banská Bystrica, OÚ Ľubietová
description: MTHIKER Kylof Ľubietová is a running race that combines history, nature and a great atmosphere in the picturesque heart of Slovakia. There are three race distances: a 4.3 km hobby run for beginners and young runners aged 13 and over, a 10 km main race for competitive and recreational runners, and an 850 m children’s race for children aged 6 to 12. The course features climbs and beautiful views of the Low Tatras. Runners can compete for cash prizes and valuable awards. After the finish, participants can enjoy traditional granadír and an original medal that is part of the Marathon Tour.

name: Gréta Run
location: Liptovská .Sielnica okres L. Mikuláš, Liptovská .Sielnica okres L. Mikuláš, 8,7 km štart z Kvačianskej doliny (ústie) , 15 km štart z Koliby Gréta
description: Gréta Run is a traditional running race set in the scenic surroundings of Kvačianska Valley and Liptovská Sielnica, offering routes of various lengths for children and adults. The race follows the yellow hiking trail and the embankment, finishing at Koliba Gréta, where refreshments and a cultural programme await participants. The event also includes a rich programme of activities for families and children. The organizer, the Liptov Olympic Club, provides high-quality technical and medical services.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 5. kolo
description: Šamorín Running League 2026 – Round 5 is a running event organized by 3klub Šamorín in cooperation with the town of Šamorín. The races take place in the pleasant surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park in Šamorín and are open to various age groups, from preschool children to adults. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race begins at 10:30. The event offers participants the opportunity to take part in the league and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a community setting.

name: Svatováclavský běh Blažovicemi
organizer: Spolek přátel Svatováclavského běhu - sdružení Vévoda
description: The St. Wenceslas Run through Blažovice is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Blažovice in the South Moravian Region. It offers two main routes of 10 km and 5 km, running mostly along natural paths and forest trails. The event also includes community runs and children’s races ranging from 50 to 1,100 metres, making it appealing to a wide audience and families with children. It is organised by the Friends of the St. Wenceslas Run Association, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation.

name: Běh Neumannovou stezkou
description: The Neumann Trail Run is a traditional running race organized by the T. J. Sokol Unhošť running club in the picturesque, wooded surroundings of Unhošť. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in nature and is complemented by children’s races. Runners who register in advance receive a lower entry fee. The event has a long history and is held regularly in autumn.

name: MilešovKa(p)
description: MilešovKa(p) is a traditional 17.5 km running race from Teplice to Milešovka, with 846 m of elevation gain. The course follows asphalt roads, hiking trails, and dirt and forest paths, and is marked with the Czech Tourist Club’s red and blue trail markings. The race is open to the general public and offers awards for the top finishers in each category, hill climbers, and age-record holders. It is organized by SPONA Teplice, an association that supports amateur sport in the region. The results are announced alongside other running events in November.

name: Běh kolem Panské skály
description: The Run Around Panská skála is a popular trail race taking place on September 28, 2026, in Kamenický Šenov-Prácheň in the Liberec Region. The race offers 3 km and 6 km routes through hilly terrain around Panská skála and is part of the Českolipsko District Running League. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced racers, offering a unique experience of running in nature with beautiful views.

name: Kauno rajono bėgimas 2026
description: The Kaunas District Run 2026 is a traditional sporting event held at a distinctive location in Kaunas District—the square next to the Old Zapyškis Church of St. John the Baptist. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity, bringing together running enthusiasts of all ages and abilities. Participants can choose from several distances, while the organizers provide a safe, technically prepared course and a pleasant atmosphere for everyone.

name: ACE BATTLE RUN:  ACE BATTLE Mile indywidualni zawody rankingowe na dystan...
OTF presented by DYNAFIT
description: OTF presented by DYNAFIT is a trail running festival in Oberaudorf, Bavaria, taking place from October 1 to 4, 2026. It offers five distances from 12 km to 100 km, including the new OTF 100 XXL Ultra, with 104 km and 5,900 meters of elevation gain. The event is part of the ITRA National League and offers ITRA points for the various distances. Alongside the race, the after-party creates a lively atmosphere where runners and spectators can celebrate together.

name: Podzimní běh projektantů "Od hospody k hospodě"
description: The Designers’ Autumn Run “From Pub to Pub” is a traditional running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4-Krč. The race is popular with runners and has been held for many years, welcoming all running enthusiasts and nature lovers. Organizers Pepa Krejčí and Honza Vočko warmly invite you to take part in this popular race, which offers an enjoyable experience in nature. Registration is available on race day, approximately one hour before the start.

name: Baran Trail Race
description: Baran Trail Race is a recurring running event held in scenic Węgierska Górka. The event offers a range of distances from 10 km to 100 km, along challenging mountain routes with beautiful views and natural terrain. It attracts both amateurs and experienced runners, offering unique challenges and an exciting atmosphere. The organizers ensure the event runs professionally and participants stay safe.

name: Běh Karla Havlíčka Borovského
location: Park Budoucnost, Havlíčkův Brod, Czech Republic
description: The Karel Havlíček Borovský Run is a traditional circuit race in Havlíčkův Brod, offering distances for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The route runs through Budoucnost Park and passes notable landmarks, including the memorial to the victims of the world wars and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský. The race is suitable for all age groups and features a mix of paved and unpaved paths with gentle elevation changes. The start and finish are at the elementary school at V Sadech 560, where showers and toilets are also available.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Run Warsaw is one of Poland’s best-known running events, bringing thousands of participants together in the heart of the capital each year. The race takes place on the first Saturday of October and offers a 10-kilometer course passing through Warsaw’s most iconic landmarks. The FUNRUN format focuses on the joy of being active, without pressure or competition, encouraging participants to run, walk, or jog at their own pace. Along the route, participants are supported by music zones, cheering spectators, and motivating partner points, and every participant receives a commemorative Nike Dri-FIT T-shirt and a medal at the finish.

name: VIII Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazow...
description: The 8th Run Along the Green Trail of the Masovian Lowland is a 5 km race taking place on September 27, 2026, in Czerwonka Włościańska. The start and finish are located at the Primary School in Czerwonka. The event is organized by local sports clubs and institutions, and the course runs through the scenic terrain of the Masovian Lowland. The event is open to adults and young people over the age of 15 with the consent of a legal guardian.

name: XIII Podbieg na Makowicę
description: The 13th Podbieg na Makowicę is a 10 km mountain race taking place on October 3, 2026, in Rytro, Małopolska. The course has a challenging profile with uphill sections, making it an excellent challenge for runners who enjoy mountain routes. The organizers encourage runners to prepare using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running and supports runners in their preparations.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
Saerbecker Kirmeslauf
price_range: Bambinilauf € 1,00; Schülerläufe 1,2 km und 2 km € 3,00; 5 km Jedermannlauf € 8,00; 10 km Hauptlauf € 10,00
description: The Saerbeck Kirmes Run takes place on October 3, 2026, at Sparkassen Stadium Saerbeck. The course is entirely paved and flat, and runs along well-maintained secondary roads, allowing for fast times. The event offers races for various age groups, with transponder timing and results determined by finish order. Children receive medals, and awards are presented for the overall and age-group results. Participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Well-maintained, fully paved course
Flat secondary roads for fast times
Start and finish at Sparkassen Stadium Saerbeck
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the back of the race bib. Finish order determines the results. Online certificates are available to all participants. The course is monitored by volunteers, but traffic rules must still be observed. Every child receives a medal in the children's races. Liability for theft is excluded. Participants must confirm that they are in a healthy state of training. Online registration is available; late entries are accepted on the day of the event for a fee; the event is held under official supervision in accordance with DLV/IWR rules.

name: 16. Köhlbrandbrückenlauf
description: The Köhlbrand Bridge Run is Germany’s largest bridge run and crosses the landmark in Hamburg’s port. The event gives runners the unique opportunity to cross the impressive Köhlbrand Bridge and experience the port atmosphere up close. The run attracts numerous participants every year and is known for its distinctive course and great atmosphere along the route.

name: 26. Bismarck-Gedenklauf
description: The Bismarck Memorial Run is an annual road and forest race in Schönhausen (Elbe), Saxony-Anhalt, held on German Unity Day. Organized by SV Preussen 27 Schönhausen, it is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP and offers 6.5 km and 13 km distances, as well as shorter races for children and young people. The course starts at the club’s sports center and follows paved roads into the forest, past Kollerberg. The longer distance is run twice. The event honors Otto von Bismarck, Schönhausen’s most famous son, and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments at the sports center.

name: 28. Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The 28th Alfelder Leinetal Run takes place on Saturday, October 3, 2026, in Alfeld, Lower Saxony. Various distances are offered for adults, including 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, all finishing at the Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, signposted courses are ideal for maintaining a steady pace. There are also races for children and young people, making for a varied program.

name: 49. Warburger Oktoberwochen Volkslauf
description: The 49th Warburg Oktoberwochenlauf takes place on October 3, 2026, at the Diemelaue Sports Center in Warburg. The event offers a 5 km company competition and is also open to young people and students. Registration is by SEPA direct debit via RaceResult. Further details about the race regulations will be provided to participants later.

name: 10km Lauf Neuhütten
description: The Neuhütten 10 km run is a popular race starting and finishing at Burgfriedenhalle in Wüstenrot-Neuhütten. The course is a gently rolling but fast loop, suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers age-group rankings up to M/W 80 and a finisher’s medal for young participants. After the race, there is an awards ceremony with prizes and certificates. The race is also part of the Laufcup Schwäbisch Fränkischer Wald.

name: Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf takes place on Saturday, October 3, 2026, in Alfeld, Germany. Distances include 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, all finishing at Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, signposted courses are ideal for maintaining a steady pace. There are also races for children and young people, making for a varied program.

name: Burgentrail Unterfränkische Traillaufmeisterschaften
description: The Burgentrail in Ostheim is a challenging trail-running event that will host the Lower Franconian Trail Running Championships on October 3, 2026. The course follows varied forest and meadow trails, passing historic castle ruins such as Lichtenburg and Königsburg, and features technically demanding trails with roots and steep descents. The scenic surroundings, with views across the Grabfeld, make this a special experience for trail-running enthusiasts of all ability levels. SC Ostheim/Rhön warmly invites everyone who loves running to take part in this sporting highlight.

name: Crailsheimer Sparkassenlauf (4. Lauf des 4-Jahreszeiten Laufcup 2026)
description: The Crailsheimer Sparkassenlauf is a family-friendly sporting event taking place on October 3, 2026, in downtown Crailsheim. The event offers a variety of race distances for all age groups and fitness levels, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s and main races, as well as walking and relay races. The races follow varied loop courses through the heart of the city, with enthusiastic spectators and a lively atmosphere. Sustainability and community are central to the event, allowing participants to take part in a sporting event with a focus on environmental responsibility.

name: Cross der deutschen Einheit
description: The Cross der Deutschen Einheit in Weißensee is a traditional cross-country race organized by the sports club Blau-Weiß 1921 Weißensee e.V. This race is being held for the 35th time and offers various competitions for all age groups, including Bambini races, youth races, a 3.5 km race, a 10.5 km race, a half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking. The course runs around the Gondelteich, with varied sections including climbs and stairs, and offers a sporting challenge for runners of all ability levels. A jubilee relay race rounds off the program and requires no registration or entry fee.

name: Duvenstedter Dorflauf
description: The Duvenstedt Village Run is a traditional race around Alt Duvenstedt, held annually on German Unity Day. With several distances for children, teenagers, and adults, it offers a suitable challenge for all age groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, volunteer involvement, and wonderful village community. The course is clearly marked and offers varied running scenery in and around Alt Duvenstedt.

name: Herbstlauf TuS Ofen
location: Ofen, Bad Zwischenahn, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The TuS Ofen Autumn Run is a family-friendly race taking place for the 35th time on October 3, 2026. The event offers distances for all ages and ability levels, from 800 m for the youngest participants, a 3 km schoolchildren’s race, a 5 km walking and fun run, to the 10 km EDEKA-Böse Run for ambitious runners. The start and finish are at the TuS Ofen sports field. A large cake buffet in the sports hall will provide refreshments, and all participants will receive a gingerbread heart at the finish as a special gesture.

name: Krautsander Insellauf
description: The Krautsand Island Run is a long-standing running event on the Elbe island of Krautsand near Drochtersen. Organized by SV Dornbusch and TV Wischhafen, the race offers an attractive route in a natural setting. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and takes place annually on October 3. It is organized by the Kehdingen Athletics Association, which ensures everything runs smoothly.

name: Langeooger Sanddornlauf 2026
description: The Langeoog Sea Buckthorn Run takes place on October 3, 2026, on the island of Langeoog and offers races for various age groups. The main distances are 5 km and 10 km on paved paths and roads, ideal for island residents and visitors. There are also dedicated races for young participants: 400 m (Bambini) and 1,000 m (youth). The event marks the end of the island running series and is supported by the island school. The awards ceremony takes place in front of Haus der Insel, where runners gather after crossing the finish line.

name: Neudorfer Fichtelberglauf mit LM Berglauf
description: The Neudorf Fichtelberg Run is a challenging mountain race covering 9.4 kilometers with 550 meters of elevation gain. It has been held annually in Sehmatal in the Ore Mountains since 1987. Considered the toughest mountain race in Saxony, it attracts both professional and amateur runners. The race starts at the Neudorf Spinning Mill and finishes on the Fichtelberg summit plateau. The event includes an open state mountain running championship and offers a free shuttle service for the return journey.

name: Oberbayerische Straßenlaufmeisterschaften 10 km
description: The Schweiger Forest Run is a long-standing running event organized by LG Sempt in Anzing, held annually on October 3 since 1983. The 44th edition in 2026 offers fast courses and a family-friendly atmosphere in the heart of the Anzing Forest. The Upper Bavarian 10 km Road Running Championships are held as part of the Forest Run. The event is open to runners of all age groups and is known for its excellent organization and large running community.

name: Ochsenweiherlauf Emskirchen
description: The Ochsenweiherlauf in Emskirchen is a long-standing running event organized by TSV Emskirchen and held annually on October 3. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a youth/schoolchildren’s run, a fun run, walking, and the 10 km main race. The course follows paved forest paths around the Ochsenweiher and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. Refreshments are provided, and times can be used for the German Sports Badge.

name: Rodenbacher Lauftag
description: The Rodenbacher Running Day is a traditional run for peace and democracy in Europe, taking place for the seventh time on October 3, 2026. The event offers four competitions for the whole family on a flat, paved, high-speed course measured according to IAAF rules through the oxygen-rich Rodenbach Forest. A special highlight is the stadium finish at the end of the 5 km loop, offering an exciting experience for spectators and runners. The youngest participants can enjoy an appealing stadium cross-country race with obstacles, commentated by an experienced team of announcers. The run is ideal preparation for the autumn marathon and is distinguished by its family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization.

name: Stauch Cup
description: The Stauch Cup, also known as the Kupferzeller Kärwelauf, is a long-standing running event in Kupferzell. It offers a variety of distances for all age groups, including a toddlers’ race, children’s and youth races, a health run, Nordic walking, and a main race. The event takes place around the Carl-Julius-Weber-Halle, which also serves as the start and finish area and provides changing rooms and showers. The award ceremonies are held in the hall, where refreshments are available, creating a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Strausseelauf
description: The Straussee Run in Strausberg is a traditional annual running event. It gives runners of different ability levels the opportunity to compete and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Straussee. The event is organized by Kultur- und Sportclub Strausberg e.V. and takes place at Theodor Fontane Gymnasium in Strausberg. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.

name: Taubertal 100
description: The Taubertal 100 is a scenic ultramarathon with distances of 50 km, 70 km, 100 km, 2 x 100 km, and 100 miles. The point-to-point course runs from Rothenburg ob der Tauber to Bad Mergentheim, Tauberbischofsheim, or Gemünden and offers one of Germany’s most beautiful ultra-running routes. The race is IAU Bronze certified and officially measured, which also makes it eligible for world records. Alongside the sporting experience, there is a runner dinner and organized return transport. High-quality technical shirts, caps, and multifunctional neck gaiters are available as optional extras.

name: 4 Moore Ultratrail-Marathon
description: The 4 Moore Ultratrail Marathon is a non-commercial 53-kilometer ultratrail run through the countryside around Langenhagen. The route passes through a variety of moorland and heathland areas, including Kananoher Forst, Schwarzes Moor, Otternhagener Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Große Heide and Bissendorfer Moor. The course is unmarked and navigated by GPS; the final GPS track and a briefing are sent by email in advance. Three aid stations provide drinks and snacks. Participants must bring their own hydration containers and cups. Entry is limited to 50 runners, and the time limit is 9 hours.

name: PUMA Třeboňský půl/maraton 10 a 5 km
description: The Puma Třeboň Marathon, Half Marathon, 10 km and 5 km races run through the unique natural landscape of the Třeboňsko Protected Landscape Area. The courses are flat with minimal elevation gain, mostly following paved cycling paths and forest trails, allowing runners to achieve personal bests in beautiful, peaceful surroundings. The race starts in Třeboň’s Renaissance square and passes through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO listing. The ideal October date offers pleasant running weather and a motivating atmosphere, with professional pacers on the course.

name: Run Berounka Run
description: Run Berounka Run is a relay race for teams and individuals that follows the Berounka River from Újezd u Svatého Kříže to Prague-Radotín. The 130 km route is divided into 6 legs, with over 3,100 metres of elevation gain, mainly on forest and field roads. The race starts on 3 October 2026 from 5:00 a.m. in several waves; the Ultra category starts the evening of 2 October. The race is open to teams of 2 to 6 runners and individuals in the Ultra category. Winners are announced in several categories, and refreshments are provided at the finish.

name: 24DS (24 Dlouhé Stráně)
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: 24DS is a 24-hour endurance challenge in the unique setting of the Hrubý Jeseník mountains, running from Kouty nad Desnou to the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage hydroelectric power station. The race offers stunning views of the Jeseníky Mountains and combines day and night running with sunrise and sunset. The demanding route has 820 metres of elevation gain and is 90% trail, making it suitable for individuals and pairs. The Kouty nad Desnou resort offers comfortable facilities, including restaurants, accommodation and parking.

name: Běh kolem Hejtmanu
description: The Run Around Hejtman is a traditional sporting event held in Chlum u Třeboně in the Třeboň region on the second Saturday in October. The main event is a 10 km run with a time limit of 1 hour and 20 minutes, following local roads and fishpond dams through picturesque surroundings. The race is open to the public and takes place amid regular road traffic, with an emphasis on safety and compliance with the rules. Shorter races are organized for children and young people up to 15 years old, with on-site registration on race day. The organizer is TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně, z.s.

name: ČEZ RunTour Praha
location: Praha, Park Ladronka (u televizní věže), Praha
description: ČEZ RunTour Prague is a family-friendly running event offering distances of 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km for recreational runners and elite athletes, as well as children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ladronka Park and is part of a nationwide series held at eight unique locations. The organisers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, including an accompanying programme and a charitable element. Every participant receives a race pack and can support charity by taking part.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - říjen
location: Příluky, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 2 Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of fewer than two laps on a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant can look forward to a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish as a reward for their effort.

name: Běh na Čerťák
description: Běh na Čerťák is a traditional race organized by AK Běžci z Rýmařova, held at the Flemmich Garden complex in Rýmařov. The race offers courses for various age categories, from preschoolers to seniors, with the main route running along forest roads and over the summit of Kamenná hora. The start is at the SKI Flemmich Garden complex, and the course includes field roads, meadows, and forest trails with beautiful views. Refreshments and the results ceremony are provided after the race at the SKI complex. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region, and category winners receive prizes.

name: Benešovská osmička
description: Benešovská osmička is a traditional cross-country race in Benešov near Semily, held for more than half a century. The race offers courses for the whole family, from preschool children to veterans, with the main 8,000-metre race winding through the picturesque countryside around the village and along the slopes of Benešov Hill. The start and race facilities are at the sports complex in Horní Benešov. Prizes are provided for competitors, and light refreshments are available for all participants and spectators.

name: Běh města Příbrami
description: The Příbram City Run is a traditional running event held for the 32nd year in the picturesque setting of Nový rybník in Příbram. The event offers various categories, including the 10 km main race, relays, and children’s runs, welcoming a wide range of runners. It is suitable for families, students, and individuals looking to enjoy a sporting day in a friendly atmosphere. Start times and registration are tailored to each category to ensure everything runs smoothly and is well organized.

name: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run
location: Liberec, Náměstí Dr. E. Beneše před libereckou radnicí, Liberecký
description: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run is a race in nature that gives runners the chance to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy running along forest trails in the Jizera Mountains. It is the final race of the season and runs through the forest, around a reservoir, across a granite quarry, and back. Runners can choose between a shorter 12 km route and a longer 22 km route, allowing them to test their strength amid beautiful natural scenery.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - říjen
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open race for runners of all ages and abilities who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. The course follows Stromovka’s paved paths. Adults run two laps (3.2 km), while children aged 12 and under run one lap (1.6 km). After the race, everyone is rewarded with a warm cinnamon pancake. The race is part of the year-round Lívancový pohár, which encourages regular participation and reflection on performance.

name: SILESIA kros 1/2marathon ZRUŠENO
description: SILESIA Cross 1/2 Marathon is a traditional cross-country running race held in Opava-Kylešovice, with its event hub at the U Chovatelů grounds. The race offers 21 km and 13 km courses that pass through scenic locations including Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka and Opava. The course is challenging and partly uses roads open to traffic. Participants must follow fair-play rules and respect nature. Times are recorded electronically without chips, and the awards ceremony takes place at the finish venue. The 2026 race has been cancelled, but information about previous editions and courses is available.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
description: The Run Through the Chateau Park is a race set in the picturesque surroundings of Vlašim Chateau Park. The 8.4 km course combines off-road and paved sections, offering runners a varied experience. The race is organized by Atletika Vlašim, z.s., and is part of the official Czech Running calendar. The event is ideal for runners looking to enjoy a run in a beautiful park with a historic atmosphere.

name: Z(a)tracené vrchy
description: Z(a)tracené vrchy is an adrenaline-fueled team orienteering-and-beer race that combines running, walking, and crawling, held in the scenic terrain of Bordovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. Participants must complete the course carrying a 10-liter keg of beer on their backs, take part in mini-games at checkpoints, and drink the beer at the checkpoints. The race combines a physical challenge with teamwork and fun, and the course winds through rugged terrain with climbs and descents. The winning team receives a perpetual trophy and gift packages. The event is for adults over 18 and emphasizes participant safety and responsibility.

name: Běh Pístovickou riviérou
description: The Pístovice Riviera Run is a traditional cross-country race along forest paths above the Pístovice Riviera recreation area in Pístovice near Vyškov. The race is open to everyone who enjoys healthy exercise, from children to adults, and takes place in all weather. The course is uneven, with possible puddles and mud, and includes uphill and downhill running and walking. The organizers, Lyžařský klub Vyškov, warmly invite runners and spectators to take part and support sport in the region.

name: Cibulka - Košířský okruh
description: Cibulka - Košířský Circuit is a popular running race held in Prague’s Košíře district, featuring a course approximately 4.5 km long. The race is part of a series of local running events and is intended for recreational runners as well as those looking to improve their performance in a natural setting. The route follows forest roads and trails around the Cibulka lookout tower, providing a pleasant and varied environment for running. The event is suitable for all ages and running levels, with an emphasis on enjoying exercise outdoors.

name: Běh za bořetickým burčákem
description: The Run for Bořetice Burčák is a traditional sporting event held in the picturesque wine-growing village of Bořetice, in the heart of the Blue Mountains. The run gives participants the chance to experience the beautiful landscape of vineyards and wine cellars characteristic of this part of South Moravia. The event is organized by the Bořetice Municipal Cultural Commission, SDH Bořetice, and the Republic of Kraví hora, and is part of the village’s rich cultural calendar. The run is scheduled to start in the afternoon on October 3, 2026, at Sólo by the cultural center.

name: Jarabský polmaratón
location: Jarabá, Brezno District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia
description: The Jarabá Half Marathon is a unique mountain trail race in the Low Tatras, covering 22.1 km. It features a demanding course with climbs, descents, and technical terrain. The race is designed for trail-running and active-outdoor enthusiasts, who can enjoy beautiful views and the atmosphere of a running community ranging from professionals to recreational athletes. The event has been held since 2015 and embodies the spirit of a friendly running get-together: “Go as you can around Jarabá.” In 2025, it is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League, underscoring its quality and challenge.

name: U.S.Steel Family Run – Minimaratón
description: The U. S. Steel Family Run - Mini-Marathon is a running event in Košice and part of the traditional International Peace Marathon. Runners of all ages are welcome, with no age restrictions. The event follows the rules of World Athletics and the Slovak Athletic Federation, and the organizers ensure thorough preparation and organization. The start and finish are on Hlavná Street in Košice, making for an appealing city run.

name: Karpaty Run – Bratislava Trail Run
location: Malokarpatské Námestie 1, Bratislava - Lamač, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Karpaty Run - Bratislava Trail Run is the largest trail running festival in the Little Carpathians, offering routes of varying lengths and difficulty for runners and hikers. The race takes place in pleasant natural surroundings, with an emphasis on nature conservation and a healthy lifestyle. The routes run mainly along forest roads and trails, with minimal asphalt, and are suitable for intermediate to advanced runners. The organizer is the Hojta civic association, which promotes sport and ecological values.
course_highlights: The routes run 65% along forest roads and 33–35% on forest trails
Elevation gain ranges from 80 m to 876 m, depending on the race distance
Aid stations are available at several points along the course, depending on the race distance
additional: The start is 700 m from Malokarpatské Square in Lamač, with a transfer 20 minutes before the start. There is no time limit for most routes, except for the longest ones, which have limits of 5 or 7 hours. Aid stations are available along the course depending on the race distance. Refreshments can be purchased at Biely Kríž. The race takes place on 3 October 2026. Registration is available through the official website. Race categories include various age groups. Most distances have no time limit.

name: Bėgimas skirtas Sporto ir kūno kultūros dienai paminėti
Festiwal Biegowy JuraRun 2026
distance_verbose: 100 km, 50 mil, Maraton, Maraton, 23 km, Półmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km
description: The JuraRun Running Festival is a unique sporting event held in the heart of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland, combining a passion for running, competition, and the satisfaction of pushing your own limits. In 2026, the festival will feature as many as 9 different running events, with distances ranging from 5 km to over 100 km, as well as Nordic walking and a night run. The routes pass through picturesque landscapes, limestone rocks, forests, and Jurassic hills, offering both technical challenges and beautiful views. The festival is open to runners of all abilities and includes a varied program of accompanying events and attractive race packages.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Silesia Marathon 2026
description: Silesia Marathon is the largest running event in Silesia, and in 2026 it will take place as a three-day running festival. Participants can choose from a range of distances, including the marathon, half marathon, ultramarathon, and 10 km and 5 km races. The finish line is at the iconic Silesian Stadium, adding a unique touch to the event. It’s not just a competition, but also an unforgettable experience and a celebration of the running community.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The 25th Maciej Frankiewicz Poznań Marathon is the jubilee 25th edition of the classic 42.195 km distance, taking place on October 4, 2026, in Poznań. For a quarter of a century, the race has brought together thousands of runners and spectators, offering a new, attractive course that starts and finishes at the Poznań International Fairgrounds. The organizers provide professional medical support, timekeeping, and a generous race pack. It is a unique sporting celebration, backed by enthusiastic support from Poznań’s spectators and a rich tradition.

name: II Radomski Bieg Onkologiczny
description: The 2nd Radom Oncology Run is a running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The event aims to promote physical activity and support people affected by cancer. The run takes place in Radom and is part of the association’s calendar of running events, which engage the local community in a variety of sporting activities. Participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Olsztyn Półmaraton
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie
description: The Olsztyn Half Marathon is an annual 21.1 km race held around the picturesque Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn. The mixed-surface course includes asphalt, paving blocks, compacted gravel paths, and forest trails, making it an attractive and varied route for runners. The event also features 5 km races and races for children, creating a sporting atmosphere for the whole family. The organizers provide at least two refreshment stations along the route and professional race office service. It’s a great opportunity to combine sport with the beauty of nature and active recreation.

name: Wild Run
organizer: Fundacja Zoo Wrocław – DODO i Zoo Wrocław Sp. z o.o.
description: Wild Run is a charity race held in Wrocław, with a course running through Wrocław Zoo. The event aims to support the protection of endangered animal species living in Poland, and participants can also run virtually on any route. The main race consists of two laps of approximately 5 km each, and races for children and young people are also held. All participants receive commemorative medals, while the top finishers receive prizes from sponsors.

name: Botaniczna Piątka - edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczna Piątka, Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland

name: Bieg o Puchar Wójta Mikołajki Pomorskie
25. Benther-Berg-Lauf
location: VSV Benthe Sportplatz, Am Hammfeld, Ronnenberg-Benthe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Benther-Berg-Lauf takes place on 3 October 2026 in Ronnenberg-Benthe and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover. The event offers various race distances for all age groups, from Bambini and children's races to a half marathon over 21.8 km. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Benther Berg and offers an enjoyable running experience for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. Race numbers and transponders can be collected from 8:30 a.m. in the VSV Benthe gymnasium. Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start.
course_highlights: 21.8 km long-distance race (half marathon) through Benther Berg
A variety of distances, from the 550 m Bambini race to the 21.8 km long-distance race
Part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover
additional: Race numbers and transponders can be collected from 8:30 a.m. in the VSV Benthe gymnasium. Late entries are possible on the event day up to 45 minutes before the respective start, with an additional late-entry fee of €5 (€2 for the Bambini and children's races). Parking is available in a designated car park behind the sports facility; access on the event day is only possible as far as the cul-de-sac. Groups of 5 or more people can request a discount by email. Course map, online registration until 02.10.2026, parking behind the sports facility, participation in the Laufpass possible, various race distances, children's and Bambini races

name: 31. Geiseltalseelauf
description: The Geiseltalsee Run is a long-standing running event in Braunsbedra that welcomes runners of all ability levels. The route passes through the scenic surroundings of Lake Geiseltal and offers a sporting challenge across varied terrain. The event is very popular and attracts numerous participants every year. Alongside the competition, the sense of community is also a central part of the event.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Geiseltal
Varied terrain with scenic views
Half marathon with a course record set the previous year
additional: Late entries are possible on race day up to 1 hour before the start. The event also includes children’s and youth races as well as walking events. It takes place in Braunsbedra at Lake Geiseltal and is part of the Landescup. The exact start and finish locations can be found on the official website.

name: Buchdorfer Jedermannslauf
price_range: 8 Euro für Erwachsene, 4 Euro für Schüler/Jugendliche
description: The 33rd Buchdorfer Jedermannslauf takes place on October 3, 2026, and offers runners a challenging course through a romantic woodland area. There are two distances: 10 km for adults and 3.3 km for young runners. The event is ideal as a personal performance test and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. The entry fee is moderate, and there are nutritious prizes for the winners, as well as a special prize for the team with the most participants.
course_highlights: 10 km and 3.3 km courses on well-maintained forest roads
A challenging woodland section with a romantic atmosphere
Starting area in the nearby woodland next to the football pitch, in the direction of Daiting
additional: Registration is possible until approximately 25 minutes before the start at the Eisstockschützenheim next to the football pitch. Nordic walkers may use the course without registering, but will not be timed. Participation is at your own responsibility and risk. Courses of 10 km and 3.3 km; registration until approximately 25 minutes before the start; no club membership required; participation at your own responsibility.

name: Kranlauf
description: The Kranlauf Offenbach takes place every year on German Unity Day at the blue harbor crane, and all proceeds support Aidshilfe Offenbach. The event offers three timed race options suitable for both individual participants and groups. The route goes around the harbor and offers a unique atmosphere in Offenbach. Race bibs are equipped with a timing chip, and a €5 deposit is charged, which can be refunded or donated.
course_highlights: Run by the blue harbor crane in Offenbach
Distances: approx. 1.3 km, 2.6 km, and 5 miles
Timing chip in the race bib
additional: Race bibs with an integrated timing chip for the 5-mile race. A €5 deposit is charged for the bib; it can be returned or donated. Online registration is open until 30 minutes before each race start; on-site registration is also possible until 30 minutes before the start. Event runs from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. at Offenbach Harbor. Parking is available in the Hafenzentrum underground garage and near the Mainparkplatz. Travel by bicycle, on foot, or by public transport is recommended. Races over 1.3 km, 2.6 km, and approx. 8 km; online registration until 30 min. before the start; harbor festival with music and food and drink.

name: Labertal-Lauf
description: The Labertal Run is a traditional running event in Geiselhöring, taking place for the 16th time on 3 October 2026. The course is considered one of the most scenic in the region, away from town centres and busy roads, and runs partly along the Kleine Laber. The Labertal Run also hosts the Lower Bavarian Championships in the 10 km road race. The event attracts runners from the region and beyond and offers ideal conditions for fast times in autumn running weather.
course_highlights: Scenic course away from town centres
Runs directly alongside the Kleine Laber for part of the route
Hosts the Lower Bavarian Championships in the 10 km road race
additional: The race traditionally starts in the morning; most recently, the start was at 09:40. The well-established course offers ideal running conditions. The event is part of the Lower Bavarian Championships and attracts the region's top runners. Registration is possible until race day; club membership is not required. Flat courses for all ability levels.

name: Odenwälder Herbstlauf
description: The Odenwälder Autumn Run is a traditional running event taking place on 3 October 2026 in Mudau. The event offers five different routes through the beautiful Mudau Odenwald, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, Nordic walking and a Bambini run. The routes are mostly on paved, flat forest paths and asphalt, with no significant climbs, making them challenging as well as scenic. Prizes are offered for personal bests on the half-marathon and 10 km courses, and each registration supports a charitable cause. The start and finish areas are at the Odenwald Stadium in Mudau, where race-number collection and awards ceremonies also take place.
course_highlights: Routes through the Mudau Odenwald on asphalt and paved forest paths
Flat terrain with no significant climbs
Officially measured courses: half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km, 5 km, Nordic walking (10 km) and Bambini run (600 m)
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day from 7:30 a.m. at the Odenwald Stadium. Timing is gun time, using an integrated disposable transponder in the race number. There are up to 5 aid stations on the course with bananas, isotonic drinks and water. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the TSV clubhouse. Valuables can be stored securely there. Awards ceremonies will take place in the stadium as soon as possible after the races. Age-group rankings and team competitions are available for the 5 km and 10 km races. Late entries are possible on race day until 8:45 a.m., for a late-entry fee of 4 EUR, by email or in person. The run is known for its rolling courses and family-friendly atmosphere. There are also special competitions for children and young people.

name: Ortsstraßenlauf
description: The TV Marienhagen Ortsstraßenlauf has been held annually on German Unity Day since 1990 and is the club’s largest sporting event. The routes run along roads inside and outside the village, as well as paved forest and field paths. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Laufcup and offers categories for Bambini, schoolchildren, young people and seniors. The event is open to everyone; club membership is not required. Advance registration is no longer available—registration is only possible on site. Refreshments are provided during and after the event, and every participant receives a certificate.
course_highlights: Routes on roads and paved forest and field paths
10 km run and 7.5 km Nordic walking on out-and-back courses
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Laufcup
additional: Registration is only possible on site, no later than 45 minutes before the start. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Every participant receives a certificate. Children and young people may not enter more than one event. Refreshments are provided during and after the race at the village community centre by the sports field. The route passes through the village; advance registration is not available. Refreshments are available on site, and all participants receive certificates.

name: Treiser Volkslauf
description: The Treis Volkslauf will take place for the 34th time on October 3, 2026, in Staufenberg-Treis. The event welcomes runners, walkers, and hikers of all ability levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a large cake buffet and delicious pea soup. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a popular running series in Hesse and the surrounding area. Registration opens on August 1, 2026, via Race Result.
course_highlights: Part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a regional running series
A variety of routes for running, walking, and hiking
Large cake buffet and pea soup
additional: Registration for the Volkslauf opens on August 1, 2026, via Race Result. A large cake buffet and pea soup are available for participants. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup running series, which includes several events in the region. The club also offers regular running and walking meetups, as well as beginner courses. Running, walking, and hiking event; community activities; refreshments including a cake buffet and pea soup

name: Bismarckturmlauf
location: Neustadt an der Orla, Thuringia, Germany

name: Soester Stadtlauf
price_range: abhängig von der Distanz (Infos im Anmeldeportal)
description: Experience the traditional Soest City Run, a sporting highlight for young and old in the historic city centre of Soest. Whether you’re a recreational runner, a competitive athlete or running with your family, together you’ll make the day an unforgettable experience, with a unique atmosphere along the course. The event offers various race distances, an appealing supporting programme, and refreshments for all participants and guests.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the heart of the historic old town
Atmospheric run through Soest city centre
Commentary, music and refreshments along the course
additional: Race distances: children’s races 475m (start 12:00), school races 950m (born 2016–2018, start 12:45) and 1450m (born 2006–2015, start 14:15), main races 4km (start 15:00) and 10km (start 15:45). Parking available on the outskirts of town, with a shuttle service. Drinks and snack stands for participants and guests. An appealing family programme and on-site commentary. Various race distances, start and finish in the heart of the old town, refreshments, shuttle service, awards ceremony immediately after the races.

name: 14. Burgdorfer Spargel-Lauf
description: The Burgdorf Asparagus Run is an annual running event held as part of the Oktobermarkt town festival in Burgdorf. On 4 October 2026, the 14th edition of this popular event will take place, welcoming recreational runners of all ages. The courses run along the Aue and through the city centre, with the start and finish at the Aue Bridge, Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße. The event offers 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as Nordic walking and a children’s run.

name: 23. Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The 23rd Central German Marathon on October 4, 2026, offers a unique running experience through the Central German metropolitan region, starting in Leipzig and finishing in Halle (Saale). The route passes through two federal states and two cities. The marathon starts at the Sportforum in Leipzig and finishes in Halle, a cultural capital with a history spanning more than 1,200 years. Other events include the Händel Run Half Marathon, the half-marathon relay, the 10 km run, 10 km walking, the Salzwirker Run, and the AOK Fun Run. The event combines a sporting challenge with cultural highlights and green running paths in the city of Händel.

name: Bayerische Halbmarathon-Meisterschaften
description: The Bavarian Half Marathon Championships will take place on October 4, 2026, in Aschaffenburg on Westring, near the Linde MH Arena. The event is hosted by TV Haibach and is open to active athletes and Masters from Lower Franconia, the Bavarian Lower Main region, Northern Bavaria, and across Bavaria. The championship gives runners the opportunity to compete on an official half-marathon course and win the Bavarian championship titles. Online registration is open until September 22, 2026.

name: Boitzer Herbstlauf
description: The Boitzer Autumn Run is a local autumn race with walking in Walsrode, Lower Saxony, organized by the SV Kirchboitzen sports club. In 2026, the event will be held in person for the 19th time and is open to runners and walkers of all ages. Participants can get the key information directly from the organizing team on site. Further practical details are provided by SV Kirchboitzen.

name: Cottbuser Oktoberlauf
description: The Cottbus October Run is a traditional running event held at the Cottbus Sports Centre, in the athletics stadium and mainly in the forest on firm paths and cycle paths. The event offers various distances ranging from 400 metres to the half marathon (21.1 km), with routes that include both paved and unpaved paths. Children and young people can take part in special races with obstacles and varied course sections. Participants receive a commemorative medal and can access their certificates online. The event is part of the Sparkassen Running and Walking Cup and offers trophies and prizes to the top runners in various age groups.

name: Gaudilauf 14
organizer: Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Gaudilauf is a traditional race taking place on October 4, 2026, in Bad Liebenwerda. The route leads from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda and back to Munich, offering a scenic course along the Elster. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with the competitive aspect taking a back seat. Refreshments are provided every 5 kilometers, and a relaxed celebration with drinks and grilled food awaits participants at the finish. A bus transfer from the finish back to the start is available on request.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The Ovenhausen Autumn Run is a traditional race held annually on the first Sunday in October and organized by TuS Ovenhausen. The event offers various distances for different age and performance groups, including a challenging 20.8 km tour through forests and hills, as well as shorter races for young athletes. The course is varied, with sections on cycle paths, in the Grubestadion, and through the forest. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes, and usually takes place in pleasant autumn weather.

name: Kalbsvilla Run
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Kalbsvilla Run takes place in Ortenberg, Hesse, with the historic Kalbsvilla on Am Mühltor serving as the start and finish area. Various distances are offered, including a 5 km run, a 10 km run, a half marathon, and 5 km Nordic walking. There are also races for toddlers, children, and teenagers, making the event family-friendly. Timing is electronic via a Race Result transponder, and the event supports a good cause as a charity run.

name: OLFINCAR HRADECKÝ PŮL/MARATON
description: OLFINCAR Hradec Králové Half Marathon is the largest sporting event in Eastern Bohemia and has been held since 2013. The race offers certified courses, including a marathon, half marathon, relay, 10 km race, and children’s races. The course is one of the fastest in the Czech Republic and is considered one of the most scenic urban courses. In 2026, the event will also host the Czech Masters Half Marathon Championships and the Czech Championships for emergency and security services in the half marathon. The facilities at the new football arena in the city center provide runners with comfortable services.

name: Horský běh Alfrédka - Memoriál Miroslava Čermáka
description: The Alfrédka Mountain Run – Miroslav Čermák Memorial is a race run mainly along forest roads, covering 13.6 km with 430 m of elevation gain. It is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix and the Czech Mountain Running Cup. The challenging route through the beautiful countryside of the Moravian-Silesian Region is ideal for fans of mountain running and endurance events. The race takes place in Stará Ves near Rýmařov and is suitable for experienced runners looking for a trail challenge.

name: Běh okolo Panoramy
description: The Run Around Panorama is a traditional cross-country race through challenging mountain terrain around Jáchymov’s football stadium. The race is open to all age groups and is being held for the 33rd year. The event is organised by Tělovýchovná jednota Jáchymov and offers a sporting experience in the beautiful surroundings of the Ore Mountains.

name: Běh údolím Orlice
organizer: Tělovýchovná jednota Sokol Klášterec nad Orlicí
description: The Orlice Valley Run is a traditional cross-country race held in Klášterec nad Orlicí, offering routes through meadows and along local roads over hilly terrain. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. Winners receive medals, prizes and cash awards. The start and finish are at the football pitch by the school, and the main race begins in the morning.

name: Slatinský kros
description: Slatinský Cross-Country Run is a traditional cross-country running race held in Brno-Slatina, now in its 19th year. The race takes place in Terénky Park on Dědická Street and features a grassy course with rolling terrain, putting runners to the test in a pleasant natural setting. The event is held under the auspices of the Brno-Slatina Municipal District and is suitable for the general public. Participants can look forward to trophies, medals, and valuable prizes.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - říjen
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race focuses on the joy of running and competing primarily against yourself. It takes place in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc by the fountain, except for some June and August races, which are held by the river. The run is part of a cup competition, where results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.

name: Roštejnské stráně
description: Roštejnské stráně is a traditional cross-country race organized by Orel Telč and part of the Orel Running League. This 14th edition takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ranč u Lipek in Telč and offers various categories, including family relays and a fun run for beginners. The race is open to all age groups and emphasizes fair play and sportsmanship. Winners will receive medals, certificates, and prizes, with special awards also presented to the youngest and oldest runners.

name: Běh kolem Lužnice
description: The Run Around the Lužnice is a traditional running race organized by the Atletika Veselí athletics club in Veselí nad Lužnicí. The race offers runners of all ages a unique opportunity to enjoy the beautiful countryside and sporting atmosphere at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium. The club has a long-standing commitment to athletics and running races, with an emphasis on high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and children alike.

name: Huť - Bratříkov - Huť
location: Huť u Jablonce nad Nisou, Liberecký
description: Huť-Bratříkov-Huť is a traditional cross-country race held every year on the first Sunday in October in Huť near Jablonec nad Nisou. Established in 1972, the event offers a 10 km main race and shorter distances for different age groups. The route passes through scenic countryside, with a grassy sports field serving as the start and finish area. The race welcomes runners of all ages, from children to adults, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Medzinárodný maratón mieru
description: The International Peace Marathon in Košice is a traditional running festival taking place on 4 October 2026 on Hlavná Street. Organized by the Košice Marathon Club, it offers a marathon, a half marathon, and other events, with the start and finish located in the city center. The event is known for its long history and high-quality organization, including the Slovak Half Marathon Championships. Runners can expect professional timing and a rich program of accompanying events.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v polmaratóne mužov a žien - MMM 2026
Běžecká série Berounka – Tetín
description: The Berounka - Tetín Running Series is a community trail race held on October 5, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of Tetín. The route crosses hills and offers beautiful views of the Bohemian Karst and the surrounding countryside, including a climb to the Beroun lookout point. The race is part of a series of 12 runs that encourage runners of all levels to stay active outdoors in a friendly atmosphere, with support from local pubs. Refreshments, bag storage, and prizes for the top finishers in each category are available on site.

name: Mrdická mašina
description: Mrdická mašina is a fast 2.0 km run across the meadows of Mrdice in Heřmanův Městec. The race is part of the Heřmanův Městec Sports League, which includes ten athletics and cycling events around the Mrdice fortress site. The race is open to the general public and offers a fun sporting challenge for all runners. It is organized by the Běžecký klub Heřmanův Městec, which supports running and sporting activities in the region.

name: Warburger Stundenlauf 2026
description: The 34th Warburg Hour Run takes place on October 7, 2026, in Warburg. The competition is aimed at adults and offers both individual and team categories. The course is flat and the event lasts one hour. There are also competitions for children and young people; details can be found in the organizer’s official announcement.
course_highlights: Flat course
Duration: 1 hour
Individual and team categories available
additional: A competition for children and young people is also offered. The start and finish are at Hüffertsportplatz; exact location details require RUNME Premium. The event is part of the RUNME race calendar. Participants receive certificates and trophies; registration is online; the event takes place in October, weather permitting.

name: Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried
description: The Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried is a short autumn cross-country race held on the grounds of the Bergfried in Saalfeld, Germany. Distances range from 800 m to 4.8 km and are designed for fast off-road running rather than long road races. The race takes place outside the stadium and is classified as both a hill race and a cross-country race. The Saalfelder Leichtathletikverein has organized the event for many years, with separate races for children and adults and various age groups.

name: Herbstcross des Saalfelder LV
distance_verbose: 13.5 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 2 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: Roštejnskou oborou
description: Běh Roštejnskou oborou is a friendly race for the general public, held amid the picturesque forests near Růžená in the Vysočina Region. The course follows forest trails and is suitable for all ages from 4 years upwards, with distances ranging from 300 metres to 8,900 metres. The event is part of the Běžec Vysočiny cup and offers a unique experience of running in nature, with the chance to observe local wildlife. It is organized by TJ Růžená, z.s., and is ideal for families and sports enthusiasts looking to combine sport with nature.

name: Pražský Kelt
description: Pražský Kelt is a unique 100 km ultra trail in the heart of Prague, offering runners the chance to discover beautiful natural scenery and Celtic hillforts, with a total elevation gain of 2,500 metres. The route winds through Prague’s forested, hilly landscape and passes historic sites such as the Šance, Butovice, Závist and Vyšehrad hillforts, as well as others. It also offers stunning views of the city and the surrounding countryside. The race starts and finishes at the grounds of Kunratice Elementary School and is intended for runners looking to experience the atmosphere of an ultramarathon in an unconventional urban setting. The race is limited to 120 participants, creating an intimate and friendly atmosphere.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 5 etapas
description: The Ukmergė Factory Cross-Country Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event aimed at promoting running, cycling and orienteering in nature. The competitions take place in Ukmergė, with participants competing in cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling and rogaining events. The event encourages active leisure for people of all ages and fosters young people’s interest in sport. The races start at the stadium of Šilas Basic School, and the time limit is 120 minutes (except for Mini Rogaining).

name: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė
description: The Ukmergė Factory Cross-Country Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event featuring cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling, and rogaining competitions. The event takes place in Kopūstėliai Forest in Ukmergė and aims to encourage active recreation in nature and promote sport among participants of all ages. The start is shared by all groups and takes place in the evening; participants compete in age groups and event categories. The main organiser is VšĮ Sportas miške, and the event is supported by several Ukmergė companies.

name: II Korczyński Półmaraton Górski XI Korczyński Bieg i Nordic Walking "Do Prządek"
description: The 2nd Korczyna Mountain Half Marathon and 11th Korczyna “Do Prządek” Runs and Nordic Walking event takes place in the picturesque areas of Korczyna and Czarnorzeki. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, bringing together experienced runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The courses follow mountain trails, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and take on off-road challenges. Registration is online, and the organizers ensure a welcoming atmosphere and the safety of participants.

name: 30 Bieg Przełajowy o Nóż Komandosa
location: Stadion Miejski w Lublińcu, Lubliniec, Poland
description: The 30th Commando Knife Cross-Country Race is a prestigious running event held under the honorary patronage of the Polish Military Bishop, Dr. Wiesław Lechowicz. The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec and is intended for soldiers and uniformed services personnel, who compete in full field uniform. The event aims to determine the uniformed services cross-country champions, promote mass-participation running, and bring together uniformed services communities. The course runs along the street in front of the stadium, finishing on the stadium track. The women’s race starts at 12:00 and the men’s at 12:27.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, combining a passion for running with an active lifestyle. The event promotes health, community, and the joy of movement, welcoming runners of different ages and abilities. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of Mysłowice, creating a friendly atmosphere and a running community. Participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross events, and entry to the Grand Prix is free.

name: 2 Maraton od Źródeł do Ujścia Grabiszynki
Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet na cały cykl w jednym mieście (4 imprezy) można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Warsaw’s Młociński Park. The events combine recreation and sport, promoting physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in local and overall standings. Races take place during the season from October to April, with the main race starting at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through forests or urban parks
A race in the natural surroundings of Młociński Park in Warsaw
A series of four races per season in each location
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race numbers and chips are collected on race day. The entry fee on race day is 60 zł. A season pass also allows one free start in a city other than the participant’s main location, subject to prior notification by email. Participants must be at least 16 years old; younger participants (born in 2008–2010) may take part with parental consent. The race schedule is fixed and also includes CITY TRAIL Junior races for children. The Warsaw races for the 2026/2027 season are scheduled for October 10, November 21, January 16, and March 20; the start is at 11:00. The stated date of October 9, 2027, is not confirmed by the available season dates.

LIII Maraton Pieszy w Puszczy Kampinoskiej
VIII Półmaraton Lasy nad Utratą

XIV Cross Centaura

location: Zębowice, Opole County, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

XIV ultraMaraton Bieszczadzki
