name: Muswiesenlauf
description: The Muswiesenlauf is a traditional fun run in Hohenlohe, celebrating its 41st edition on October 10, 2026. It is the oldest fun run in the region and offers a range of distances for children, teenagers, and adults. The courses are officially measured and follow varied routes along paved agricultural roads and gravel forest paths. Every participant receives a certificate, and children also receive bumper-car tokens. The event takes place as part of the historic Muswiese festival, which has been held annually since 1434.
course_highlights: Officially measured distances of 500 m, 1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Varied routes featuring paved roads and gravel forest paths
Run held as part of the traditional Muswiesenfest in Hohenlohe
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the relevant start. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Forum multipurpose hall, 2 km away; basic changing facilities without showers are available at the start area. The awards ceremony takes place in the Muswiesenhalle at the festival grounds. Parking is available around the festival grounds and the start/finish area; heavy traffic may cause delays. Races over 500 m, 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m; online registration until one day before the race; late registration available on race day; race bibs distributed at Stadel Hofburk.

name: Wadersloher Volkslauf
description: The Wadersloh Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Wadersloh, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses are available and are eligible for rankings until 2029. There are also shorter races for children and walking routes. The event takes place at the Sportpark on Winkelstraße and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a start-number deposit and timekeeping.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured and eligible for rankings until 31.12.2029
600 m Bambini run and 1000 m schoolchildren’s race on the synthetic track at the Sportpark
7.5 km walking and Nordic walking route available
additional: A start-number deposit of 2.00 EUR is collected by SEPA direct debit when registering online and refunded in cash on the event day when the start number with chip is returned. The 5 km and 10 km races are officially measured and have DLV approval until 2029. Photos and videos are taken and published as part of the event. Measured courses, online registration, start numbers with chips, sponsors

name: Vorlauf zum Harz-Gebirgslauf
description: The Harz Mountain Run warm-up is a free test run held one week before the main race. It gives runners the opportunity to check their fitness and get to know the Harz Mountain Run courses. The event starts together at 9:30 a.m. in Himmelpforte, Wernigerode, and offers distances of 2 km, 5 km, 11 km, and 22 km. At the finish, participants are welcomed with tea and bread with lard. No registration is required, but the courses are not yet marked.

name: 25. Volkslauf um den Altwarmbüchener See
description: The Volkslauf around Lake Altwarmbüchen is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. The race gives runners the opportunity to discover the Hannover Region on foot and take part in a varied range of running events. Each participation earns a stamp in the running pass, which is available both digitally and in a traditional format. The event is aimed at recreational athletes and promotes active movement in the region.

name: Abt-Degen-Lauf
description: The Abt-Degen Run organized by TV 1884 Zeil is a traditional running event taking place for the 30th time on October 10, 2026. Various distances are offered, including an 11 km main race, 1,600 m and 800 m races for students, and a children’s race. The event provides a well-organized course, timing, race-number pickup, showers and changing rooms, refreshments, and an awards ceremony. The race welcomes runners of all ages and promotes a sense of sporting community in Zeil am Main.

name: Brakelsieker Volkslauf "Am Fuße des Mörths"
description: The Brakelsiek fun run “At the Foot of the Mörth” is a classic local running, walking, and Nordic walking event in Schieder-Schwalenberg, held on a Saturday afternoon in October. Various distances are offered for adults and young people, including 5 km, 9 km, and 15 km runs, as well as 5 km and 9 km walking and Nordic walking. The start and finish are at the Brakelsiek sports field, and the route runs around the village sports field, with a gently rolling rural profile at the foot of the Mörth. The event offers a lovely opportunity to enjoy the autumn landscape in a relaxed atmosphere.

name: Parforceheide Crosslauf
description: The Parforceheide Cross-Country Run has been organized by RSV Eintracht 1949 in Stahnsdorf since 2008, giving recreational runners in the region the opportunity to discover the varied landscape of the Parforceheide. The course starts at the sports ground on Heinrich-Zille-Straße and passes the Südwestfriedhof cemetery, continuing through woods and natural surroundings with small climbs, sandy sections, and stretches of asphalt and cobblestones. Races are offered over 1 km (Bambini), 3 km (schoolchildren), 5 km, and 10 km for young people and adults. After the run, the organizer provides food and refreshments, and football matches are often held at the sports ground, making for a lovely day of sport for participants and their companions.

name: Pegnitztallauf 2026
description: The Pegnitztallauf is an afternoon event in Vorra, Germany, featuring a flat, single-lap course with no repeated laps. Events include 5 km races for adults and youth, a 10 km race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking for adults. Children’s and youth races round out the program, making this a local, club-oriented running event. The finish is at the tennis facility in 91247 Vorra, and the start is at 3:00 p.m.

name: Ramsthaler Wein-Berg-Lauf
description: The Ramsthal Wine Mountain Run is a traditional running event held annually in Ramsthal. It offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to schoolchildren, teenagers, and adults. The routes pass through Ramsthal’s picturesque vineyards and offer varied scenery. In addition to the running events, there is also a walking route that lets participants enjoy the beautiful surroundings.

name: Solvay Lauf
description: The Solvay Run Bernburg is a 5 km race in Bernburg, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place on October 10, 2026. The race starts at Krumbholzallee 8 at 10:00 a.m. It is part of the Solvay Cup and combines cross-country and road running, so it is not an easy, flat city course. It is aimed primarily at local clubs and usually attracts 100 to 300 runners. The event offers professional timing, online results, certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop-off, and refreshments at the finish.

name: Volkslauf mit Walking um den AWB See
description: The 25th Volkslauf with Walking around AWB Lake is a local running and walking event in Altwarmbüchen, a district of Isernhagen. The event offers short, flat distances around Altwarmbüchener See, with one lap measuring approximately 3.66 km. There are various running and walking routes for adults, as well as races for children and young people, making it a community running experience for the whole region. The start and finish are at Seestraße 23, and the races take place in the afternoon.

name: Cena Metuje
organizer: Sportovní klub Nové Město nad Metují z.s.
description: Cena Metuje is a traditional 10 km road race held in Nové Město nad Metují as part of the PRIMÁTOR CUP running series. This 65th edition also offers races for young athletes in various age categories. The route follows an asphalt road through the Metuje River valley to Peklo and back, providing an enjoyable yet challenging running experience. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, parents, and grandparents, who can earn points in the series. Winners are awarded in both the children’s categories and the main race, with cash and non-cash prizes.

name: VOKOLO priglu
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
description: Vokolo priglu is a traditional running race around the Brno Reservoir, held on October 10, 2026. The race offers a unique sporting experience on a 14.1 km course, approximately one-third of a marathon. The course is gently undulating, mostly on asphalt with some rocky sections, and offers beautiful views of the Brno Sea, Veveří Castle, and autumn forests. The race is open to individuals, pairs in the steamboat relay, four-person teams, companies, and universities, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Běh Borským parkem
description: The Borský Park Run is a traditional autumn sporting event in Plzeň, with a history dating back to 1970. The race is open to everyone, from beginner recreational runners to experienced athletes of all ages. It offers the excitement of the starting line, the thrill of the race atmosphere, and the joy of crossing the finish line. The organizers provide a welcoming race environment and homemade refreshments for all participants.

name: Běhej lesy Lednice
description: Běhej lesy Lednice is part of a popular running series offering races in some of the Czech Republic’s most beautiful natural settings. The Lednice race takes place in the picturesque Lednice-Valtice Cultural Landscape, where runners pass through the château park, around ponds, and by iconic landmarks such as the Temple of the Three Graces and the Apollo Temple. The routes suit runners of different ability levels and include the shorter Nova 14 km and the longer ČSOB 21 km, both with an international UTMB Index. The event also features competitions on speed sections and an exciting finish straight, providing extra motivation for participants.

name: Hradčanské vlnky
description: Hradčanské Vlnky is a traditional cross-country trail race in Hradčany near Olomouc, offering three main distances: 5.6 km, 10.4 km, and a half marathon of 21.1 km. The race focuses on off-road running, mostly on forest and field paths, making for an attractive and challenging course. The event also includes children’s categories with various distances. Runners can enjoy refreshments, chip timing, and extensive facilities, including showers. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for a wide range of runners, from children to experienced trail runners.

name: Podzimní běh Olympu
location: Stromovka Park, Prague 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Autumn Run of Olymp is a traditional running race organized by the Olymp Prague Police Sports Club. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Stromovka Park in Prague 7. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and a sporting challenge in a pleasant urban park. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes team spirit and an active lifestyle. The organizers welcome all participants and provide support during registration and throughout the race.

name: Benešovský půlmaratón a desítka Pojizeřím
description: The Benešov Half Marathon and 10K through the Jizera Region is a traditional running race set in the picturesque village of Benešov u Semil in the Liberec Region. The race offers half-marathon and 10-kilometre routes through the beautiful countryside of the Jizera Region, with varied terrain. It is organised by TJ Benešov u Semil, which provides a friendly atmosphere and light refreshments for runners and their supporters. The race is suitable for runners of all levels and is part of the village’s sporting activities.

name: Běh Bukovem
description: Běh Bukovem is an annual running festival held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Bukov and Plískov as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The race takes place entirely on meadows, forest roads, and trails, offering runners an enjoyable experience in nature. The event is suitable for a wide range of age groups, from the youngest children to veterans. It is organized by the municipality of Plískov in cooperation with Farma Ekl and is known for its friendly atmosphere and tradition.

name: Kašavský kros
description: Kašava Cross-Country Run is a traditional trail race in the Kašava area, offering two main routes for runners aged 16 and over, as well as children’s races. The event takes place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, and is known for its established course with hills and a pleasant atmosphere. It is organized by the VALACHBAJK TEAM KAŠAVA association in cooperation with the local municipality and school. The children’s races take place after the main races and are divided into several age categories, with different course lengths.

name: MUTRAverz - Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run (2)
organizer: Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run, z. s.
description: MUTRAverz is an extreme ultra-trail race held in the Ore Mountains, specifically in Mikulov and its surrounding area. The race is designed for experienced runners seeking a challenging course in beautiful countryside along marked hiking trails. The organizers emphasize safety, fair play, and high-quality event support. The race is suitable for runners over 18 who are physically and mentally prepared for extreme conditions. We look forward to welcoming you to the next edition on October 10, 2026.

name: Rybský trhák
description: Rybí Challenge is a road race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice in cooperation with the Municipality of Rybí and TJ Sokol Rybí. The race is 7 km long with 135 metres of elevation gain and is open to various age categories for both men and women. The start is at the TJ Sokol Rybí football pitch, and runners can use the provided changing rooms and showers. Refreshments are available at the finish, along with prizes for the top runners in each category, including an award for the oldest participant and the best runner from the municipality of Rybí.

name: Běh pro Kleofáše
description: The Run for Kleofáš is a traditional charity run held in the spa park in Třeboň, supporting the local hospice. Participants can choose from several categories, from short children’s races to a 12-kilometre run around Svět Pond. Less experienced runners can enjoy a pleasant four-kilometre route, and there is also a relay for two or four runners. The event offers a varied programme of activities for children and is part of Hospice Week.

name: Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna
location: Městský úřad Špindlerův Mlýn, Špindlerův Mlýn, Czech Republic
description: The Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna is the traditional 34th edition of a mountain race held as part of the Czech Cup. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn and features a challenging 14 km course with 901 metres of elevation gain. It is ideal for mountain-running enthusiasts looking to test themselves in the beautiful mountain setting of the Krkonoše.

name: Červený okruh
description: The Červený okruh in Doksy is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, taking place on 10 October 2026. The race gives runners the chance to test themselves on an interesting course in the natural surroundings of Termit in Doksy. The event is part of a regional running race series and attracts both the general public and experienced athletes. The organizers provide a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities for all participants.

name: Bašťanská šestka
description: Bašťanská šestka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of the reservoir in Baška, Moravian-Silesian Region. The race is organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s., which has long been dedicated to athletics and supporting sporting activities in the region. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in beautiful natural surroundings. Both experienced runners and recreational athletes are welcome to register and take part.

name: Svatováclavský běh - Tyreto RUN
description: The St. Wenceslas Tyreto RUN 2026 is a charity running race held on October 10 in Děčín. The race offers courses for men, women, and children, including a family run, and supports people with multiple sclerosis through proceeds from entry fees. Participants can enjoy a sporting experience while supporting a good cause. The first ten people to register will receive a discount on Tyreto tire purchases.

name: Javornícka stovka
description: The Javornícka Stovka is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike held in the Javorníky Mountains. Runners cross challenging mountain terrain with several checkpoints and time limits. The event is intended for experienced runners seeking a challenge in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and registration are in Čadca, and the finish is in Lysá pod Makytou. The organizers emphasize safety, mandatory equipment, and medical assistance along the entire route.

name: GARMIN Beh Súľovskými skalami
organizer: SCK CYKLO TOUR Súľov - Hradná a MTBIKER community
description: The GARMIN Run Through the Súľov Rocks is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Súľov Rocks, offering three courses of varying lengths and difficulty. Runners pass through picturesque countryside with views of rock formations and ridge trails, and the courses include refreshment stations. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own categories and starts. It is organized by the Slovak Cycling Club CYKLO TOUR Súľov - Hradná, which provides thorough preparation and services for participants.

name: Spoznaj Trebišov behom – Night RUN
location: Námestie pod OD Billa, Trebišov, Slovakia

name: Grand Prix – Cabaj-Čápor
location: Cabaj-Čápor, Cabaj-Čápor, neďaleko penziónu Salaš Cabaj, Čáporský les
description: Grand Prix Cabaj-Čápor is a traditional cross-country race in beautiful natural surroundings, held in the village of Cabaj-Čápor, starting near Salaš Cabaj. Runners can choose from several distances, including 10 km, 3 km, and children’s races over 600 m and 1,000 m. The event is ideal for anyone who wants to enjoy the atmosphere of sport outdoors, whether for competition or simply for the joy of movement. Registration is open and participant numbers are limited, so it is best to sign up early.

name: Jesenný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce a Atletický klub Michalovce
description: The Autumn Run of Michalovce Residents is a traditional running race in Michalovce, offering an opportunity for competitors of different age categories. The race takes place at the grounds of 2nd Primary School at J. Švermu 6 and consists of a 400-metre children’s run and a 3-kilometre main race. The event is suitable for families and runners who want to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and take part in sporting activities in pleasant surroundings. The organizers provide refreshments and commemorative items for participants.

name: Beh Myšľou
location: Nižná Myšľa, Nižná Myšľa, Archeoskanzen Nižná Myšľa
description: The Beh Vyšnou Myšľou is a running event organized by the Running Club of the Municipality of Vyšná Myšľa and the Municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The races take place at the football pitch in the municipality of Vyšná Myšľa, in the Košice-okolie District. The children’s categories start at 14:00 and the adult categories at 16:00. Men and women can compete in various age categories, including a two-person relay over 2 × 3 km. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for running in the municipality.

name: Rozhanovská dvanástka
location: Rozhanovce, Košice-okolie District, Košice Region, Slovakia

name: Kaišiadorių maratonas 2026
description: Kaišiadorys Marathon 2026 is the first marathon to be organized in Kaišiadorys. It will take place on October 10, 2026, marking the beginning of a new tradition and bringing together runners from Lithuania and abroad. The marathon will be held in an active, sports-minded city known for its sporting events and active lifestyle. The event is organized by BK “Kaišiadorys bėga,” Kaišiadorys District Municipality, Kaišiadorys Education and Sports Center, and VšĮ “Maratomanija.”

name: Bėgimas Gintarinė jūrmylė
organizer: Klaipėdos miesto sporto bėgimo klubas “Gintarinė jūrmylė”
description: “Amber Sea Mile” is an international running race held in beautiful Smiltynė. The event offers a range of distances: 0.5 nautical miles for children, 1 nautical mile for anyone who wants to take part, 3 nautical miles for women, and 6 nautical miles for men and professionals. The start and finish are at the Sports and Wellness Base, and participants are treated to army-style porridge and tea. The race tradition commemorates the winners’ names on a memorial stone raised from the bottom of the lagoon.

name: Wzgórzowa Trzynastka
description: Wzgórzowa Trzynastka is a 13 km trail race held in the scenic area around Chrząszczyce. The course follows local roads and crosses a military training area between Chrząszczyce, Domecko, Opole-Winów and Górki. The event promotes a healthy, active lifestyle and running as a form of recreation. Alongside the individual race, it also features relay races, a uniformed services category and a family team orienteering challenge. The start and race office are in Chrząszczyce, and the participant limit is 300.

name: 12. PKO Cracovia Półmaraton Królewski
description: The Cracovia Royal Half Marathon is an international half marathon held in Kraków, a city with a thousand-year history and the former seat of Polish kings. The race attracts thousands of participants from around the world, combining a passion for sport with sightseeing at historic sites. The finish line at the impressive TAURON Arena Kraków delivers unforgettable excitement and cheers from spectators. The event is part of the Royal Running Triad and the Polish Half Marathon Crown, underscoring its prestige and standing among runners.

name: Dobromiejski Festiwal Biegów i Nordic Wa...
location: Swobodna, Gmina Dobre Miasto, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Piwna Mila
description: The Beer Mile is a unique race over a flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres and the highlight of the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start by drinking one beer, and beer refreshment stations are placed along the course approximately every 500 metres. This sporting celebration brings together runners, spectators and families, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a special finisher’s medal.

name: UltraKotlina
description: UltraKotlina is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Jelenia Góra Valley, covering the scenic ranges of the Rudawy Janowickie, Kaczawskie Mountains, Izera Mountains, and the Karkonosze. The event offers six distances from 15 km to 142 km, as well as a relay, with the finish in Szklarska Poręba. The routes are marked and follow well-known trails as well as quiet backroads, allowing both experienced ultrarunners and beginners to enjoy every kilometer. The event is also an opportunity to bring the running community together and promote the region.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
description: The Friendship Run is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque area around Skrzeszewo, giving participants the chance to spend time actively and discover the charms of Kashubia. The running series attracts runners of different ages and skill levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Wąsowo, Kuślin, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Październikowy
location: Łubianka, Toruń County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: The CITY TRAIL Grand Prix is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of city parks. In Poznań, the course loops around Lake Rusałka, starting on Św. Wawrzyńca Street and finishing at the city beach by the lake. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly check their results on the same course. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start on Św. Wawrzyńca Street, finish at the city beach
Suitable for beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course remains the same throughout the season, allowing runners to compare results across months and years. The series also includes children’s races. The official calendar lists the dates for the 2026/2027 season but does not confirm a race in Poznań on 10 October 2027.

name: Pielgrzymi Półmaraton o Memoriał Jana Pawła II
X Festiwal Biegów Rodzinnych Cała Oleśnica Biega
Büdelsdorfer Eiderlauf
description: The Büdelsdorf Eiderlauf is a traditional autumn race in Büdelsdorf, Schleswig-Holstein, organized by SG Athletico Büdelsdorf. It offers classic local road-race distances, including 5 km and 10 km, on flat, manageable courses that are ideal for recreational runners and beginners. The start and finish are often at Eiderstadion, giving the event a friendly, informal atmosphere. The race attracts children, young people, and local club runners, and is a fixture on the regional autumn running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat road-race distances
Start and finish at Eiderstadion
Family-friendly local club race
additional: The race takes place in typical October weather, with daytime temperatures around 14 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Distances range from 1.5 km to 11.1 km, including children's races. After a break during the COVID-19 pandemic, the format was adjusted to incorporate the start and finish in the stadium. Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, 5.8 km, 10.9 km, 11.1 km; flat courses; autumn event; start and finish in the stadium; open to all age groups

name: Berglauf
location: Geislingen an der Steige, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The mountain run organized by the Schneelaufverein Geislingen is a long-standing event held annually in Geislingen an der Steige. The route climbs uphill and offers runners a challenging course in a scenic setting. The event attracts both competitive and recreational runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere. Registration is handled through MY RACE RESULT, with the deadline falling shortly before the race.
course_highlights: Uphill route with a challenging elevation profile
Scenic surroundings in Geislingen an der Steige
Start and finish at the SVG ski hut, Dorfstr. 70
additional: Registration and results are handled through MY RACE RESULT. The registration deadline is 12:00 noon on the Saturday before the race. The start and finish are at the SVG ski hut in Geislingen an der Steige (Weiler o. H. district). The event takes place on October 11, 2026; route and elevation profiles are available; registration is through Race Result; the venue is SVG Dorfstr. 70, Geislingen an der Steige.

name: Citylauf Schwabach 2026
description: The RIBE Citylauf Schwabach on 11 October 2026 offers a varied running programme for all age groups and ability levels. Events include a half marathon, relay, main race, fun run, walking and children’s races. The races start and finish at Königsplatz in Schwabach, and participants can expect a well-organised event with a family-friendly atmosphere. The route leads through the city and offers a special running experience in Schwabach, the City of Gold Leaf.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course of approx. 21.1 km
Start and finish at Königsplatz next to the town hall
A variety of race distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Late entries are possible only on race weekend, subject to availability. Places are limited, and on-site late entries are not available for sold-out events. Participants in the main races must be at least 16 years old; the maximum time is 3 hours. Relay legs are approx. 7 km each. The start and finish are at Königsplatz next to the town hall and at Fürstenherberge, respectively. Registration is open until 4 October 2026. A variety of categories are available for different age groups and ability levels. Refreshments are provided at several points along the route.

name: Salzachbrückenlauf
description: The Salzach Bridge Run starts and finishes at Burghausen town square, below Burghausen Castle, the longest castle complex in the world. The route follows the Salzach, which forms the border between Germany and Austria, and includes several border crossings. Various distances are offered, including a 505-metre parent-child run, a 3.2 km fun run, a 5.5 km walk and the 8.8 km main race. More than 1,000 participants take part each year, from children and recreational runners to club runners and fast athletes. The run is a charity event organised by nine volunteers, with proceeds supporting local people in need.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Burghausen town square below the castle
The route crosses the Salzach and the German-Austrian border
The 8.8 km route includes four border crossings and sections on gravel paths by the bathing lake
additional: The run takes place annually under the patronage of Bürgerinsel Burghausen. The 8.8 km route includes a second lap and passes a bathing lake and a rowing lake. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Multiple distances, including a 505 m route; charity event; scenic surroundings around Burghausen; open to children, recreational runners and competitive runners.

name: Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof-Lauf 2026
location: Schloss Erbhof, Kirchwiehe, Thedinghausen, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof Run takes place on October 11, 2026, in Kirchwiehe, directly opposite Schloss Erbhof in Thedinghausen, Lower Saxony. Organized by TSV Thedinghausen, the road race has welcomed children, young people, active adults, and masters since 2016. Distances offered are 10 km, 5 km, and an 800 m children’s run, which takes place in the tree park near the start and finish. The course is a measured, flat 5 km loop that is also suitable for Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Measured, flat 5 km loop
The 10 km course completes the loop twice
800 m children’s run in the tree park directly by Schloss Erbhof
additional: The 5 km course is also suitable for Nordic walking. October weather is typically 14 °C, with lows around 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The children’s run, “Löwenlauf,” is designed specifically for the youngest participants and takes place near the start and finish area. Start and finish in Kirchwiehe opposite Schloss Erbhof; children’s run in the tree park; October weather with temperatures around 14°C low and 6°C high, 40 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy.

description: The Stadtwerke Lübeck Marathon on 18 October 2026 offers runners a varied choice of distances in the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck. In addition to the classic marathon, the event includes a duo marathon, half marathon, relay and other shorter races suitable for all ages and ability levels. The course runs through the picturesque city and offers a sporting challenge with regional championship scoring. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and emphasizes community and a passion for sport.
course_highlights: Marathon with Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring
Duo marathon relay point in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea
Course through the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck
additional: Free medal engraving is available for registrations by 31.01.2026, with name, distance and finish time. A preferred race number can be selected free of charge during the early registration phases, subject to availability. Relay event with 10 x 4.2 km. Handbike half marathon on the same course as the runners’ half marathon. Duo marathon relay point in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea. On-course refreshments include honey gels; Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring. Registration by 30.09.2026. Various race number and medal options.

name: Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K
description: The Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K is Berlin’s fastest 10-km race, starting in front of Charlottenburg Palace. The course runs through Berlin Zoo and offers a unique running experience in the capital. In addition to the classic 10-kilometer course, there is also a 2 x 5 km relay and a 4.2 km short course from the zoo to Charlottenburg Palace. The event is suitable for all abilities and age groups and offers a large running festival for the whole family.

name: 19. Burger-Rolandlauf
description: The Burger Rolandlauf is a traditional race that normally takes place in Burg and is jointly organized by Rolandgymnasium Burg and LG Ihleläufer Burg. The course runs through the town along the Ihle, through the forest and past the Bismarckturm, finishing in the school courtyard. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program with music, activities for children and refreshments. The 2026 event in Burg was cancelled due to a lack of permits; instead, a replacement event will take place in Tangerhütte City Park.

name: Frühstückslauf
description: The breakfast run in Wernigerode is a group run without timekeeping, leading from the market square up to Wernigerode Castle. The route is about 3 kilometers long, with an elevation gain of 100 meters. The run takes place as a group and is free of charge. A light snack is served afterward, making it a sociable event.

name: H/21 Halbmarathon
description: The H/21 Hannover Half Marathon is a new running event on the national events calendar, combining urban flair, modern beats and green sections of the course. The start and finish are in the heart of Hannover, and the route passes notable hotspots throughout the state capital. The event takes place in autumn and offers a special running experience in a vibrant urban setting. Join the prologue as Hannover begins a new chapter in running history.

name: München Marathon
description: The Munich Marathon offers a varied running experience in the Bavarian capital, with the marathon, half marathon, 10 km run, and marathon relay. The marathon course passes through Olympiapark, Leopoldstraße, the English Garden, and Munich city center, and finishes in Olympiapark. The half-marathon course starts in the English Garden and also finishes in Olympiapark. The marathon relay lets teams cover the 42.195 km together, with handovers at designated kilometer markers. Due to renovation work, the finish is at Hans-Jochen-Vogel-Platz next to the Olympiahalle.

name: Bad Hersfelder Lollslauf
description: The Bad Hersfeld Lollslauf is a traditional running event held annually in Bad Hersfeld, attracting runners of all ages and ability levels. With distances ranging from the Bambini Run to the 10 km individual race, the Lollslauf offers a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. Alongside competition, the event also emphasizes community and the joy of running. It is a regular fixture on the running calendar and draws participants from across Germany.

name: Klosterlauf Aurachtal
description: The Klosterlauf Aurachtal is a running event starting and finishing near Münchaurach Abbey Church. All routes are marked with kilometer signs and run mainly on paved and gravel paths. Various events are offered, including a 10 km main race, a fun run, youth races, Nordic walking, and children’s and Bambini races. The event is open to all healthy people who are sufficiently trained; club membership is not required.

name: Porta Volkslauf
organizer: SC Nammen / SC Porta Westfalica Nammen e.V.
description: The Porta Fun Run 2026 is a long-standing running event in Porta Westfalica and has been a fixture on the regional running calendar for more than three decades. The event attracts runners of all ages, from competitive athletes to those running for enjoyment. The route follows roads and field paths around the Nammen sports ground and through the Nammer Unterholz nature reserve, offering varied, flat sections with magnificent panoramic views of the Porta. The run is part of the Mühlenkreisserie and takes place at the local sports facility in Nammen. The warm atmosphere and sense of community make the day a special experience.

name: Sebastian Fredrich Gedenklauf (LM/LC/NLC)
description: The Sebastian Fredrich Memorial Run is a long-standing running event in Lubmin, organized by the triathlon and running group of HSG Uni Greifswald. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere, supported by many volunteers. The route passes through scenic sections and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of an active running and triathlon community in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania.

name: Storkower See Lauf
description: The Storkower See Run is a long-standing running event organized by Triathlonverein Fürstenwalde 1990 e.V. and approved by the Brandenburg Athletics Association. On October 11, 2026, runners of various age groups and ability levels can take part on courses of different lengths around Lake Storkow. The event offers a fair competitive atmosphere and is open to running enthusiasts of all ages. Online registration opens in January 2026, and participants are listed in an official start list.

name: Wendlandmarathon
description: The Wendlandmarathon Kolborn is a traditional road race in Lüchow, Lower Saxony, held since 1993. The event offers a wide range of distances, from the marathon and half marathon to short children’s races, appealing to both long-distance runners and families. The course is measured to AIMS/IAAF standards and has kilometre markers and aid stations. Practical facilities for participants include parking, showers, changing rooms and certificates, as well as finisher medals for children.

name: Borský kros
description: Borský kros is a traditional running race organized by Borský klub lyžařů Machov in the picturesque Doleček cross-country skiing area in the Hradec Králové Region. The course offers a range of difficulty levels, from gentle, gradual climbs suitable for families with children to challenging, rugged and steep profiles for experienced runners. The race is part of the club’s varied sporting activities and takes place in beautiful natural surroundings with excellent facilities. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and a high-quality sporting experience for all participants.

name: Podzimní přespolní běh - Memoriál Jiřího Bláhy
description: The Autumn Cross-Country Run – Jiří Bláha Memorial is a traditional race held since 1986; this year marks its 39th edition. The race takes place at the swimming pool complex in Nové Město na Moravě, where registration opens at 8:30. The longest course is approximately 6 km for men; women run 2 km, and youth courses range from 300 m to 1,500 m. The race is run on grass, so spikes are recommended. Category starts are staggered so everyone can make it to Sunday lunch, and the results are announced shortly after the last men’s category finishes.

name: Lesní běh Říčany XCR
description: Lesní běh Říčany XCR is a popular forest race held in Říčany, offering courses for all age groups, from children to veterans. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region and includes courses of various lengths, including 11 km and 5.7 km for adults, with challenging forest trails and steep climbs. The event is intended not only for sports enthusiasts but also for families with children, who can enjoy shorter routes tailored to the participants’ ages. The organizer, Bežecký klub Říčany, invites everyone to spend time actively in nature and take part in this traditional event.

name: Běh na Strandu
description: Běh na Strandu is a distinctive uphill running race held on Stránská skála in Brno-Slatina. Competitors start individually at one-minute intervals, allowing them to focus on the 450-meter course with 47 meters of elevation gain. The course follows a rocky and grassy path, and the race is divided into several age categories, from younger pupils to veterans. After finishing, runners must return their race bibs, and the results are announced after the last competitor finishes. Registration takes place on race day from 9:00 to 10:00, and the start is at 10:01.

name: Hrabenovský kros
description: Hrabenov Cross is a 7.47 km forest cross-country race with 200 metres of elevation gain, held in the picturesque surroundings of Hrabenov near Šumperk. The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which offers challenging cross-country courses in the Šumperk area. It is suitable for runners seeking a challenge on natural terrain with significant elevation gain. The route runs through the forest and offers beautiful natural scenery and technically interesting terrain.

name: Slavkovský lesík
description: The Slavkovský lesík Cross-Country Run is a traditional race organized by TJ Opava, held in the picturesque woodland near Slavkov u Opavy. The race gives runners the chance to enjoy running in nature on varied terrain in a relaxed sporting atmosphere. The start and registration take place by the TJ Sokol Slavkov football field, with the race traditionally starting at 10 a.m. The organizers invite all runners to take part and promise an enjoyable sporting experience.

name: Rozběháme (i) Klenčí
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Rozběháme Klenčí is a traditional running race set in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem in the Plzeň Region. The race offers runners of all ages and abilities a chance to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the region’s beautiful nature. Results and rankings are carefully tracked, and the race is part of the wider Běžec Chodska series. The organizers welcome all runners and provide quality event support.

name: Z Dobřichovic na Šraňk
location: Dobřichovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: From Dobřichovice to Šraňk is a 3.7 km uphill race with 280 meters of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series. This race offers a challenging course with a significant climb, ideal for lovers of mountain running and outdoor challenges. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Dobřichovice and is suitable for runners who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. Come and enjoy the atmosphere of the race and push your limits at this traditional event.

name: Beh za zdravie – Kuchajda
description: Run for Health – Kuchajda is a charity running event taking place on October 11, 2026, at Kuchajda in Bratislava. The event combines sport with support for health and the community, aiming to help disadvantaged people and organizations through physical activity. Participants can run, jog at an easy pace, or walk, while enjoying a great atmosphere filled with inspiring stories and solidarity. Run for Health is open to all ages and fitness levels and supports charity projects with a real impact.

name: Beh ulicami Krompách
location: Krompachy okr. Spišská Nová Ves, Krompachy okr. Spišská Nová Ves, pred budovou mestského úradu
organizer: Mesto Krompachy, Komisia kultúry a športu pri MsZ v Krompachoch
description: The Run Through the Streets of Krompachy is a traditional race in the town of Krompachy, offering categories for children, adolescents, juniors, men and women in various age groups. The race takes place in front of the town hall and is organized by the City of Krompachy and the Culture and Sports Commission of the Krompachy Municipal Council. The start is split, with children’s categories and adolescents starting at 9:30 and adults at 11:00. The entry fee is a symbolic €5, except for schoolchildren, adolescents and runners over 60. The race is suitable for the general public and supports sporting life in the region.

name: Beh do vrchu Banské – Mlačky
location: Kultúrny dom, Banské, Vranov nad Topľou District, Slovakia

name: Beh okolo Sidorova
location: Hotel Áčko, Hrabovská cesta 34, Ružomberok, Slovakia

name: Běh na Kraví horu
description: The Run up Kraví hora is a public hill-running race with a mass start, held in the picturesque surroundings of Kraví hora in Teplice nad Metují. The race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and challenges athletes with a demanding climb and beautiful views. It has a long tradition and is popular with runners looking to test themselves on mountainous terrain. The organizer, Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, ensures high-quality organization and a pleasant race atmosphere.

name: Zátopkova pětka
description: Zátopkova pětka is a traditional running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club in Kopřivnice. The race takes place on the cinder track at Emil Zátopek Stadium and is part of the Lašská Running League. It is open to the general public and offers runners the chance to race on a quality athletics track in a pleasant sporting atmosphere. The race has a long tradition and is popular with runners of all ages.

name: Prešovská hodinovka na tartane
location: Prešov, Prešov, atletický štadión Prešovskej univerzity
organizer: BK ZasRun, Olympijský klub Prešov, AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita
description: The Prešov Tartan Hour is a running race held at the Prešov University athletics stadium in Prešov. The competition is open to various age categories of men and women and offers a unique opportunity to test your endurance and speed on a tartan track. It is organized by BK ZasRun Šarišské Bohdanovce, Olympijský klub Prešov, and AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita. The race is ideal for runners who want to experience a high-quality athletics atmosphere and compete in the pleasant surroundings of a university stadium.

name: Běh Heulosem - memoriál Jiřího Šmrhy
description: The Heulos Run – Jiří Šmrha Memorial is a traditional running race held in Heulos Forest Park in Jihlava. The race offers various categories and distances for men, women, veterans, juniors, youth and children, with colour-coded circuits along the forest park’s paths and trails. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1977 and is part of the Běžci Vysočiny series. The race starts in the afternoon at the Na Stoupách athletics stadium, and its routes are suitable for a wide range of runners, from the youngest participants to veterans.

name: Gladiator Race Praha
description: Gladiator Race Prague is a demanding obstacle course race set in Čihadla Nature Park on the outskirts of Prague. The race combines relatively flat running sections with water, mud and challenging obstacles, including a net over a water sluice. This ninth edition brings a unique atmosphere, new challenges and the camaraderie that participants have come to love. Various race categories are available for adults, children and dogs, making the event appealing to a wide range of participants.

name: Stovka Považím - Považie ultra trail
description: Stovka Považím is a challenging long-distance hike and ultra trail in the beautiful Považie region, intended for experienced ultrarunners and hikers. Each year, it offers an original and extremely demanding course, with Route A forming part of the Czech-Slovak Ultra Trail Cup and the first stage of the Extreme Ultra Trail Combination. The event takes place in Trenčín and the surrounding area, with several routes and luggage transport provided between the start and finish. Participants can sleep in the gym at Predmier Elementary School, adding to the comfort of the competitors.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail is a trail running series held on the hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km and 11 km, providing a range of challenges for trail runners. The race showcases the beauty of the Kashubian landscape and regional attractions, and participants can look forward to excellent aid stations along the route. The event is supported by the #AktywnaWieś program and organized by the Pomerania Sports Association.

name: Dębowiec Nocna Pętla
description: Dębowiec Night Loop is a mountain race on the slopes of Dębowiec in Bielsko-Biała. It follows an 8-kilometre route along forest trails from Dębowiec to the Wapienica Valley and back. Runners must tackle a steep climb beneath the Dębowiec chairlift, and a bonfire and meal await them at the finish. The race is a unique opportunity to spend an October evening actively. Participants receive a race pack and medals, with prizes for the top finishers and oldest runners. A Nordic walking event covering approximately 4 km takes place alongside the race, also finishing at the Dębowiec 520 mountain hostel.

name: IV Wilczy Półmaraton
description: The 4th Wilczy Half Marathon is a unique trail race held in the picturesque, wild forests of the Rybnik Forest District, in the “Głębokie Doły” nature reserve. The approximately 22 km half-marathon route follows unique forest trails, giving runners a chance to connect with nature and encounter rare plant species. It is the only half marathon of its kind in Silesia, promising plenty of adrenaline and satisfaction for cross-country enthusiasts. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the course is full of fun, muddy pitfalls. Join us in Wilcza for an unforgettable sporting experience!

name: Rajd Waligóry
description: Rajd Waligóry is an orienteering rally held in the scenic Wiśnicz Foothills near Bochnia. Participants compete by finding checkpoints using a map and compass, combining adventure, exercise, and outdoor fun. The courses vary in length and difficulty, catering to both families and more experienced competitors. The event has a recreational and sporting character and promotes an active lifestyle as well as discovering the local nature and history.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
X Bieg o Puchar Rektora ANS w Nowym Targu
XI Półmaraton Piastowski
location: Wilkszyn, Miękinia, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 35 Orla Pięść
location: Świeszyno, Koszalin County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: III Festiwal Biegowy w Nadleśnictwie Kli...
location: Sowno, Goleniów County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Falke-Rothaarsteigmarathon
location: Schmallenberger Sauerland, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 23rd FALKE Rothaarsteig Marathon takes place on 17 October 2026 in the Schmallenberger Sauerland. The event offers marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking and a 12.5 km AOK run. The course passes through the scenic Rothaar Mountains and is recognised by the DLV as an officially authorised popular race. More than 1,000 runners take part each year, enjoying the varied trails and forest scenery.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the Rothaar Mountains
DLV-recognised, officially authorised popular race
A range of events: marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking and 12.5 km AOK run
additional: Registration opens on 01.05.2026. Late registration is available until half an hour before the start of the respective event. Start times are staggered: marathon at 11:00, half-marathon at 12:00, walking and Nordic walking at 12:15, and the AOK run at 11:45. The event venue is Latroper-Str. 57392 Fleckenberg in the Schmallenberger Sauerland. Registration opens on 01.05.2026; no dog runs. A detailed course description is available, along with start times and organisational information on the website.

name: TeutoMarsch
location: Grundschule Hohne, Lengerich-Hohne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Teutomarsch is a unique hiking and running experience through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area. Organized by Turnverein Hohne von 1911 e.V. in Lengerich, the Teutomarsch offers two routes designed to delight participants. The event is very popular, and starting places fill up quickly. The exact route is still being finalized, but promises to be a fantastic and unique course. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and dogs are allowed on a leash.
course_highlights: A unique route through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area
Two different routes for a special experience
A nature experience in the Lengerich-Hohne region
additional: Registration for the 2026 Teutomarsch sold out within 30 minutes, with 500 starting places. There is a waiting list. Participants consent to being photographed and filmed and to the publication of the resulting images and footage. Entry fees are non-refundable. Minimum age: 16. Dogs are allowed on a leash. The organizer accepts no liability for personal injury, property damage, or loss or theft. Trail running, no timekeeping, refreshment stations along the route, start and finish at Grundschule Hohne, participant limit: 500.

name: Altmühltrail
description: The Altmühltrail 2026 takes place on October 17 in Dollnstein in the Altmühltal Nature Park, offering a unique trail-running experience that combines sport, nature, and culinary delights. The route leads over challenging trails, past impressive rock formations, through dense forests, and along scenic ridges. In addition to the sporting challenge, tasting stations featuring regional specialties make for a special experience. The children’s race, with its trail obstacle course, also gives young runners the chance to gain their first experience.

name: Panoramalauf Niedenstein
description: The 24th Niedenstein Panoramic Run takes place on October 17, 2026, in Niedenstein. The event is organized by SG 1898 Chattengau e.V. and Lauftreff Niedenstein. The run offers an attractive course around the Hessenturm Stadium and the clubhouse, set amid the beautiful landscape of the region. Participants can look forward to a well-organized running event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup.

name: Prignitzer Moormeile
description: The Prignitzer Moormeile in Bad Wilsnack is a traditional race taking place for the 26th time on October 17, 2026. The event offers various distances from 1 km to 12.4 km, running through the Wilsnack forests, the Kurpark, and around the Karthanehalle. The races are suitable for children, young people, and adults, and are part of the Prignitz Cup and the Brandenburg Cup. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, good on-course refreshments, and professional timing.

name: Steigerwald - Fackellauf 2026
description: The Steigerwald Torchlight Run is being organized for the 39th time by the athletics department of TSV Burghaslach and traditionally takes place on the third Saturday in October. The event gives runners of all ability levels the opportunity to run together through the beautiful Steigerwald countryside. It is a fixture in the regional sporting calendar and promotes community and enjoyment of running.

name: Vellberger Volkslauf
description: The Vellberg Volkslauf is a local running event in Vellberg, Baden-Württemberg, organized by TSV Vellberg e.V. It is part of the Stadtwerke Läuft bei dir series, which also includes races in Michelfeld, Gaildorf and Bibersfeld. The event offers a classic 10 km race and a 400 m race for different age groups. Registration is online only; late registration is available up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Timing is provided by Speed Timing, and certificates can be printed on site.

name: Berchtesgaden
description: Berchtesgaden lies in southern Bavaria and offers an impressive alpine landscape of high peaks, romantic lakes, and Germany’s only Alpine National Park. The region is ideal for hikers and mountaineers, who can experience nature up close on a variety of circular trails and tours. The historic center of Berchtesgaden combines culture and history with a modern shopping experience in an Alpine setting. A special destination is the Kehlsteinhaus, with its breathtaking panorama at an altitude of 1,834 meters.

name: XTERRA O-SEE Ultra Trail
description: The XTERRA O-SEE Ultra Trail on October 17, 2026, in Kurort Oybin, Germany, is part of the XTERRA Trail Run World Series and serves as the European Championship. The event offers various distances from 0.5 km to 100 km, taking runners through the varied and challenging landscape around Oybin. Runners experience a combination of nature, trail running, and sporting challenges in a picturesque setting. In addition to the races, there is an extensive program of events, including a pasta party, awards ceremony, and Canicross the following day.

name: Ndb. und KR Passau Cross-Laufmeisterschaft im Rahmen des 5. intern. DJK Crosslauf in Passau
ČEZ RunTour Pardubice
location: Velké pardubické závodiště, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: ČEZ RunTour Pardubice is a family-friendly running event offering seven different races for all ages and ability levels. With distances ranging from 500 metres for the youngest runners to a half marathon, everyone can find their own challenge. The race takes place at the Velká pardubická racecourse and, alongside the sporting experience, offers a varied programme for the whole family. Participants receive a race pack and contribute to charity. The atmosphere is friendly and welcoming to both recreational and elite runners.
course_highlights: Distances include 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, plus children’s races of 500 and 1,000 m
Start and finish at the Velká pardubická racecourse, with its unique atmosphere
Refreshment stations along the course; at least two on the half-marathon route
additional: The race offers a special emergency medical service phone line during the event. Every runner receives a gymsack with gifts from partners. Children receive a Lidl race pack, and there is a supervised kids’ corner. Pacers are on the course to help runners achieve their target times. Refreshments are available at the finish for children’s races, with refreshment stations on the longer routes. The event includes multiple distances, participant medals, refreshment stations, changing rooms, showers, medical support and post-race photography.

name: Půlmaraton Český les
description: The Český les Half Marathon is a traditional trail run held amid the picturesque scenery of the Český les in the village of Nemanice. The race offers two routes: 21 km with 520 m of elevation gain and 7 km with 80 m of elevation gain. Both lead through beautiful countryside, and a GPX route is available to download. On the longer course, overall winners and age-group winners are announced, while the shorter course awards the three fastest men and women. The start and finish are both in Nemanice, with parking available near the start.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (11) – říjnový
description: The 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running race in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The race is part of the 16th edition of the running league, where runners can compare themselves with others and with their previous performances. The course is certified, and the 10 km distance offers the opportunity to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, runners can enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments and an awards ceremony for the top finishers.

name: NN NIGHT RUN České Budějovice
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: NN NIGHT RUN České Budějovice is one of the largest running events in České Budějovice, held at Přemysla Otakara II Square. This night run offers the atmosphere of the city illuminated by headlamps and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. More than 2,000 runners take part each year, from beginners to experienced competitors. The program also includes children’s races and charity runs alongside the main 10 km race.

name: Ultramaraton Zapomenuté hory
location: Tábor v Račím údolí - Uhelná 126 - býv. okres Jeseník, Olomoucký
description: The Forgotten Mountains Ultramarathon is an autumn trail race that takes you along superb mountain trails to the most remote parts of the Rychleby Mountains. The routes pass through deep valleys, remote ridges and beautiful viewpoints, including the highest peak of the neighboring Góry Bialskie in Poland. The race offers three route options of varying lengths and difficulty, suitable for experienced runners seeking wild nature and unforgettable experiences. The event also includes an evening program of talks and entertainment. We look forward to welcoming everyone who wants to discover these forgotten mountains as few have before.

name: Běh kolem Ameriky
description: The Run Around Amerika is the third-oldest running race in the Czech Republic and the country’s oldest cross-country race. It has been held since 1925 in Amerika Forest Park in Písek. This traditional forest run gives competitors the chance to test themselves over various distances, with the main race covering 10,400 metres. The race has a rich history and is known for its atmosphere and cooperation with partner cities abroad. Every year, it attracts a wide range of runners, from sprinters to endurance athletes, and is an important sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Amerika Forest Park
Main course covering 10,400 metres
Historic race with a tradition dating back to 1925
additional: The race has 25 competition categories and is internationally recognised thanks to cooperation with partner cities in England and Germany. The start is located by the Interhotel Amerika. Only two editions have not been held in its history: in 1942 and 2020. The 101st edition of the race and the 2nd edition of the Jaroslav Putschögl Memorial are scheduled to take place in 2027.

name: Běh podél Halštrova

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 250 Kč při přihlášení v den závodu

description: The Run Along the Halštrov is a traditional autumn race that follows the beautiful landscape of the Halštrov Nature Park from Háj Hill to the mineral springs in Doubrava. The race is open to adults and children, who run a shorter course. Participants can enjoy a mix of paved and forest roads, with the finish at the mineral water spring, where transport back to Aš and refreshments are provided. The number of participants is limited to 200, so early registration is recommended. The event is organized by the Jasan Aš Ski Club with the support of the town of Aš and local forests.
course_highlights: The route runs through Halštrov Nature Park from Háj Hill to the mineral springs in Doubrava
Adults run approximately 9.7 km; children run 4 km
The course follows both paved roads and forest trails
additional: The adult race starts at approximately 11:00 at the source of the Halštrov, and the children’s race starts at 10:45 in Dolní Paseky. The finish is at the mineral water spring in Doubrava, from where transport back to Aš is provided. Refreshments are available at the finish. The number of participants is limited to 200. Registration is available by email until 20:00 on 15 October or in person on the day until 9:30. For the 2026 edition, capacity was limited to 200 runners; transport was provided from the registration venue to the start and from the finish back to Aš. Available sources confirm the 2026 edition, but not the date 16 October 2027.

name: Od radnice k radnici
organizer: Okresní sdružení České unie sportu Náchod

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: elektronicky přihlášení závodníci s připsanou platbou startovného do úterý dne 13. 10. 2026 do 24 hod.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: elektronicky přihlášení závodníci od středy 14.10.2026 od 00.00 hod. do pátku 16.10.2026 do 10.00 hod. a v pátek 16.10.2026 od 13 – 18 hod. v hale SK Náchod v hotovosti

description: The Run from Town Hall to Town Hall is part of the PRIMÁTOR CUP running series in the Náchod region. The race is open to all age groups, including children, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. The route runs from the square in Hronov along the main road and through the town streets to the town hall in Náchod, making for an interesting urban run with views of the surrounding landscape. The race is suitable for runners of all levels and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Start on the square in Hronov and finish on the square in Náchod
The route follows the main road, crosses a railway bridge and continues through town streets
An urban run combining asphalt and local roads
additional: Registration is online at sportchallenge.cz from 1. 9. 2026 to 17. 10. 2026 at 8:00. Registration is also possible on site on race day for a higher entry fee. Race bibs can be collected at the SK Náchod (Rubena) hall on Friday 16.10. from 13:00 to 18:00 and on Saturday 17.10. from 7:45 to 9:45. Children can earn points by taking part in all races in the series and receive a reward. Competitors participate at their own expense or at the expense of the sending organization. Information on courses and prices is available for the 2026 edition; details for the 2027 edition have not yet been provided. The youngest children may run with a companion.

name: Malá křivoklátská
description: Malá Křivoklátská is a traditional forest race with a long history dating back to 1973. It takes place in the picturesque valley of the Rakovnický Stream, below Křivoklát Castle. The main race is 6,000 metres long and consists of two laps on forest and asphalt paths, with gentle elevation changes and beautiful views of the castle. Race facilities and the youth course are at the Kolečko sports ground, which provides ideal conditions for competitors of all ages. The youth course is flat and 600 metres long, with race distance adjusted to the runners’ age. The event is organised by Sokol Křivoklát, a club with a rich sporting tradition and a base in the municipality of Křivoklát.
course_highlights: Forest course with an ascent towards the walls of Křivoklát Castle
Two laps of 3,000 metres each in the main race
Flat 600-metre youth course at the Kolečko sports ground
additional: Race facilities and the start/finish are at the Kolečko sports ground. The main race starts en masse, and the course crosses footbridges and a ford over the Rakovnický Stream. The youth course is a 600 m loop, run for 1–3 laps depending on age. The course combines forest paths, asphalt and a cycling path with fine gravel. The race has a long tradition and a stable course dating back to 1975. The 54th edition takes place in 2026; information about the date and prices for the 2027 edition has not been confirmed in available sources.

name: Běh okolo Lemberka
location: Kaplička u Markvartického rybníka, Jablonné v Podještědí, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní klub ZŠ Jablonné v Podještědí
description: Běh okolo Lemberka is a traditional autumn running race held by the chapel near Markvartický Pond, on the green hiking trail between Jablonné v Podještědí and Lvová. The race offers various distances, from children’s categories to adult races, including relays. The start is on Saturday morning, and the race is part of the Českolipská District Running League. Participants have access to limited changing facilities, and the top three in each category receive a certificate and a prize.
course_highlights: The routes follow the green hiking trail between Jablonné v Podještědí and Lvová
Various distances, from 50 m for the youngest runners to 10,000 m for adults and veterans
The race is part of the Českolipská District Running League – For the Českolipský deník Cup
additional: Registration opens at 8:30 a.m. at the start and finish area. Limited men’s and women’s changing facilities are available in a tent near the start. Veteran categories are offered only for the 10,000 m race. The top three in each category receive a certificate and a prize. The race is part of the Českolipská District Running League – For the Českolipský deník Cup. Children’s and youth races are also included. According to available information, the 2026 edition takes place on 17 October; the date of the 2027 edition has not been confirmed.

name: Malá Kunratická
location: Kunratický mlýn, Kunratice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Malá Kunratická is a traditional cross-country race organized by Atletický veteránský klub ČR 1982 with the support of the Prague 11 municipal district. The race takes place in Kunratice near Kunratický mlýn and features a moderately challenging 3,250-metre course. It starts from the same location as Velká Kunratická, but the course is completely different. The event is suitable for runners looking for an interesting off-road race in the pleasant surroundings of Prague 11. Registration takes place at the gazebo near the start from 9:30.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging cross-country terrain
Course length: 3,250 metres
Starts at the same location as Velká Kunratická, but follows a different course
additional: Runner registration takes place at the gazebo near the start from 9:30. The race is supported by the Prague 11 municipal district and organized by Atletický veteránský klub ČR 1982. The start and finish are at Kunratický mlýn, Prague 4, Kunratice. In a schedule published previously, registration began at 9:30, veterans over 40 started at 10:30, and men aged up to 39 together with women started at 11:00. Times and other details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Heimstaden Havířovská desítka
location: Havířov city centre, Havířov, Czech Republic
description: Heimstaden Havířovská desítka is a traditional running race in the center of Havířov that combines athletic achievement with support for athletes with disabilities. The race offers different distances for individuals, families, and corporate teams, including the main 10 km race, a 5 km run, a 4×2.5 km relay, and a 500-meter family run for children. Every year, runners of all abilities come together to share the joy of movement and support a good cause. Race packets include chip timing, refreshments, and participant medals.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race over two laps through the center of Havířov
4×2.5 km relay race, with corporate teams welcome
500 m family run for children under 15
additional: Registration is available until 11:00 on race day for the main race and relay, and until 10:00 for the 5 km run. Chip timing, refreshments on the course and after the race, and the option to order a running T-shirt for 350 Kč. The race supports a good cause: 100 Kč from each entry fee goes to Handicap Sport Club Moravia. The relay is open to everyone over 18, or younger participants with written consent from a legal guardian; teams may be mixed, regardless of gender. According to information for the 2026 edition, the race packet included chip timing, refreshments, and a finisher’s medal. Part of the entry fees paid by runners who are permanent residents of Havířov supports the boccia players of HSC Moravia. Price information applies to the 2026 edition, not the 2027 race.

name: Krumlovský běh
location: Orlovna, Rakšice, Moravský Krumlov, Czech Republic
organizer: AC Moravský Krumlov a Orel Jednota Rakšice
description: The Krumlov Run is a road race held at the Orlovna grounds in Rakšice, Moravský Krumlov. It offers a 10.9 km course for men and a 4.5 km course for women, on asphalt and surrounding paths. The event is listed among runs for health, hobby runs, and children’s races, making it suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages. It is organized by AC Moravský Krumlov, led by Mgr. Zuzana Marková. Registration is available on a separate page, and the race is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s services for runners.
course_highlights: Courses run on asphalt and surrounding paths
Course distances: 10.9 km (men) and 4.5 km (women)
The event includes a hobby run and children’s races
additional: The race is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletics Federation. It is organized by AC Moravský Krumlov; the contact person is Mgr. Zuzana Marková. The event is open to the general public, including hobby runners and children. The program also includes children’s races, a hobby run, and a run for health. The information provided concerns the 2026 edition; details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Podvihorlatský kros
location: Poruba pod Vihorlatom, Poruba pod Vihorlatom, futbalové ihrisko (amfiteáter)
description: The Podvihorlatský Cross is a running event held at the football field (amphitheatre) in Poruba pod Vihorlatom. The races include starts for children’s categories and the main category. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads, with 30% asphalt surface. The event is organised by Mgr. Ján Podstavský with the support of the Municipality of Poruba pod Vihorlatom. It is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025 and offers categories for various age groups and Nordic walking.

name: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica
location: Oščadnica, Oščadnica, Račatak na Námestí M. Bernáta pri fontáne
distance_verbose: Maratón, Maratón, Maratón, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km
organizer: Obec Oščadnica, Klub turistov Oščadnica, extremmaraton.sk
description: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica is a mountain marathon through the picturesque Kysuce countryside, mainly along mountain ridges with beautiful views of Veľká Rača. The 42-kilometre course, with nearly 1,700 metres of elevation gain, will test your endurance, strength and love of the mountains. This is not a race but a recreational running experience that celebrates the joy of movement, friendship and determination. The organisers provide full services, including refreshments, a T-shirt and a post-run get-together.

name: Rozhanovská dvanástka
organizer: Obec Rozhanovce, Občianske združenie KŠK Rozhanovce
description: Rozhanovská dvanástka is a running race held at the amphitheatre grounds in Rozhanovce. It offers two main categories—a short 6 km course and a long 12 km course—open to both men and women. The race is organized by the Municipality of Rozhanovce and the KŠK Rozhanovce civic association, and is suitable for runners of various levels. The race is scheduled for 17 October 2026, with the children’s races starting at 10:45 and the main courses at 11:00.

name: Šurianska desiatka
description: Šurianska desiatka is a running event held in the town of Šurany, with the start and finish in front of the Municipal Office. The course runs along the town’s streets and through part of Nitriansky Hrádok on asphalt roads. The event is open to the general public, including pupils, juniors, recreational runners, and Nordic Walking participants. It is organized by Gymnázium Bernolákova 37, Šurany, and the number of participants is limited in categories A to J. Refreshments and drinks are provided for competitors. Winners receive diplomas, prizes, and cash rewards.

name: Memoriál Ondreja Holca v cezpoľnom behu Poniky

name: Vajnorský minimaratón
location: Park pod lipami, Vajnory, Bratislava, Slovakia

name: Psotkov memorial
description: The Psotkov Memorial is a traditional mountain running race in the heart of the High Tatras, held near Štrbské Pleso. Runners can choose between two challenging courses: BASIC, 25.3 km long with 1,540 m of elevation gain, and EXTREME, 37.9 km long with 2,490 m of elevation gain. The route passes through picturesque mountain scenery, including a climb below the summit of Kriváň, a descent to Tri studničky, a stretch past Jamské pleso and through the Furkotská Valley, and a finish at Chata pod Soliskom. The race is part of the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia and offers a unique experience of running in challenging mountain terrain.

name: Tajovský beh
location: Tajov, Okres Banská Bystrica, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia

location: Muráň, Revúca District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia

location: Gajary, Malacky District, Bratislava Region, Slovakia

location: Soblahov, Trenčín District, Trenčín Region, Slovakia
