name: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas
description: The Backyard Ultra World Championship is a unique off-road running event in which runners must complete a 6.7 km loop every hour until only one runner remains standing. The race takes place on hilly, off-road courses that demand endurance and determination. It challenges both physical and mental endurance, and there is always only one winner. Trailo Kalvė organizes the event with special attention to course quality and participant experience, inviting runners to test themselves and push beyond their limits.

name: XII Pagarbos/Paramos bėgimas „IN MEMORIAM“, skirtas šiais metais mirusiems kariams atminti
organizer: Lietuvos didžiosios kunigaikštienės Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų organizacija
description: The “In Memoriam” Run of Respect and Support in Vilnius is a prominent event held to honor Lithuanian Armed Forces personnel who died this year and support their families. The event takes place in Vingis Park and includes non-competitive 1 km and 4 km distances, as well as an open 10 km Lithuanian Armed Forces Running Championship. The run began as a heartfelt initiative to remember a young officer and has become an important annual civic and patriotic tradition. It is organized by the LDK Birutė Association of Women in Officers’ Families together with the Ministry of National Defence and the Lithuanian Armed Forces.

name: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė
description: The Graužikai–Kelmė Run is a traditional race in Kelmė District held in memory of Vaidotas Rimkus. The event takes place in October and aims to promote running and athletics in Lithuania, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and increase physical activity among local residents. It attracts runners of all ages, who can choose from several distances, including the 8 km main race. Participants are awarded cups, medals, and commemorative prizes.

name: 52.Maraton Dębno 2026
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dębnie
description: The 52nd Dębno Marathon is the oldest and one of the fastest marathons in Poland, taking place on October 18, 2026. The 42.195 km course, certified by the Polish Athletic Association (PZLA), runs through the streets of Dębno and the surrounding area, making it ideal for personal bests. The event has a rich tradition dating back to 1966 and attracts both amateur and professional runners from Poland and abroad. Participants can expect professional organization, numerous refreshment stations, and enthusiastic support from spectators. The marathon is also an opportunity for the running community to come together and a celebration of sport for the whole family.

name: 12. PKO Półmaraton Gliwicki
description: The Gliwice Half Marathon is a running event held since 2014, and over 12 years it has become an important fixture on Poland’s running calendar. The race follows a course that starts and finishes at the PreZero Arena sports and entertainment hall in Gliwice. Participants can expect professional organization, a time limit for completing the course, and support from volunteers and city services. In 2026, the race comes to an end, and the city of Gliwice takes over its organization, continuing the event’s tradition.

name: Wartko!... bez Gaszowice
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Gaszowicach
description: WARTKO!... Bez Gaszowice is an annual 10 km road race organized by the Culture and Recreation Centre in Gaszowice. The event attracts people who enjoy an active lifestyle and promotes sport in the local community. The race takes place in the scenic area around Gaszowice, offering participants the chance to compete and have fun together. The event is open and welcoming to runners of all ability levels.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (10)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach
description: The 14th Panewniki Wild Boar Run is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewniki Forests in Katowice. The race takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times, with a time limit of 3 hours. The event promotes an active lifestyle and educates participants about appropriate conduct in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
description: The 17th Puck Land Half Marathon is a well-known running event in Pomerania, returning in 2026 in a new edition under the STONE TRI & RUN banner. The event takes place on a refreshed course in an autumn setting, making it an ideal way to wrap up the running season. It features a half marathon, a 5 km race, and a 5 km Nordic walking event, all with individual starts. It’s a great opportunity to enjoy the beautiful Kashubian countryside and experience the sporting atmosphere of the Puck Running Triad.

name: 40. Bieg Barbórkowy o Lampkę Górniczą – Sztafeta Międzyzakładowa
XII Otwarty Bieg Uliczny i Marsz Nordic Walking
Laubacher Ramsberglauf
price_range: bis 20. September vergünstigtes Startgeld, danach zzgl. Nachmeldegebühr
description: The Laubach Ramsberg Run is a traditional running event that starts and finishes in the picturesque castle park in Laubach. The event offers various distances for different age and ability groups, including a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run, and races for schoolchildren and Bambini. The races feature a varied course through the beautiful countryside around Laubach. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere, with refreshments, changing facilities, and an awards ceremony right in the castle park.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Laubach Castle Park
A varied course through the countryside around Laubach
Refreshments and changing facilities at the Sports and Cultural Hall
additional: Registration is via RACERESULT, with a reduced entry fee available until 20 September; a late registration fee applies thereafter. Changing and shower facilities are available at the Sports and Cultural Hall. The awards ceremony takes place right in the castle park. Distances: 10 km main race, 5 km fun run, children’s races over 1500 m and 300 m; registration via Raceresult; start and finish in the castle park; refreshments, changing and shower facilities on site; October weather: approx. 14°C, cloudy

name: Offenbacher Mainuferlauf
description: The Offenbach Main Riverside Run is an open running event held annually along the Main River in Offenbach. Races are offered over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 2 km schoolchildren’s run. The course follows the Main and offers an attractive riverside setting. In 2025, short-notice course changes were made due to construction work. The event is open to all runners; club membership is not required. It has a family-friendly atmosphere and a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: Run along the Main with attractive riverside scenery
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon
Separate 2 km schoolchildren’s run
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Mathildenschule Offenbach, Arthur-Zitscher-Str. Parking is recommended at the Innenstadt car park on Berliner Straße (about 750 m away; fee of approximately €1 per hour). Due to construction work, Mainstraße is closed, resulting in short-notice course changes. This year’s course is not eligible for record purposes because official measurement was not possible. The half-marathon starts about 350 m from the previous start location. The 5 km and 10 km races start by the Main at the finish arch. The 2 km schoolchildren’s run starts by the Main as usual. Event photos are provided by Team Ingo Kutsche. Course changes due to construction work; course not eligible for record purposes; registration opens on 1.8.2025; weather-dependent conditions; various race distances

name: Salacher Löwenlauf
description: The Salacher Löwenlauf is a running and Nordic walking event in Salach, Germany, taking place on October 18, 2026. The courses cover 500 metres for children, 2 kilometres for teenagers, 6 kilometres for fitness runners and Nordic walkers, and 10 kilometres for experienced runners. The course is undulating but well suited to beginners, and all races finish on Baumgartenstraße near the Stauferlandhalle. The event is organised by TSG Salach, which also highlights the connection to the Stauferland region in the Nordic walking race.
course_highlights: Undulating course profile, not a flat sprint
Finish on Baumgartenstraße near the Stauferlandhalle
A range of distances for children, teenagers and adults
additional: Start times are planned around midday. There are dedicated races for children (500 m Bambini Löwenlauf) and teenagers (2 km Jugend-Löwenlauf). The event also includes a 6 km Nordic walking race. October weather is typically around 14 °C, with occasional rain and mostly cloudy skies. The event includes Nordic walking and is open to all age groups. It is recommended that participants check the details with the organiser before registering.

name: Traditioneller Sparkassen-Herbstwaldlauf
location: Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum, Beckum, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Traditional Sparkasse Autumn Forest Run in Beckum is a popular running event taking place on October 18, 2026, at the Harberstadion Neubeckum Sports Center. The event offers various races for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a schoolchildren’s run, a 5 km everyone’s race, 5 km walking, and the 10 km main race. Participants receive medals, certificates, and trophies, making the run a motivating experience for recreational and competitive runners. Late registration is possible until approximately 30 minutes before the start, offering flexibility for last-minute entrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Harberstadion Neubeckum Sports Center
Races for all age groups, from Bambini to the main race
Trophies for the fastest runners and certificates for all participants
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event until approximately 30 minutes before the start, for an additional fee of €2. All participants in the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races receive medals; certificates are awarded for the 5 km everyone’s race and 5 km walking, and trophies for the three fastest runners in the 10 km main race, as well as certificates for all participants. Forest running event; registration and results on the website.

name: Weißenhorner Altstadtlauf
description: The Weißenhorn Old Town Run is a traditional race held every year in October in the historic old town of Weißenhorn. The event is organized by TSV Weißenhorn and gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in a friendly, sporting atmosphere. The race is known for its varied course through the picturesque old town and is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. Enjoyment of running and community are at the heart of the event.
course_highlights: Course through the historic old town of Weißenhorn
Varied terrain with views of the town
Traditional event in October
additional: The race is organized by TSV Weißenhorn, which also offers other athletics training groups and events. The athletics department meets regularly for training, and the Old Town Run is an annual highlight in October. The event takes place at the TSV hall and in the old town. It is held every year, with various races for all age groups. Registration is usually through Race Result, and the results are publicly available. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and support from the local community.

name: Oldenburg Marathon
price_range: 35 Euro für Sportshirt (genaue Startgebühr nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon on October 25, 2026, offers runners a varied programme featuring a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, 10 km city run, 5 km run and children’s mile run. The course goes through Oldenburg and Wardenburg and is known for its good refreshments and friendly atmosphere. The event welcomes runners of all abilities and also offers a public race series with additional competitions during the year. Participants receive high-quality long-sleeved shirts, and extensive services are available on site.
course_highlights: Refreshment stations every 5 km on courses of 10 km or longer, with water, sports drinks and fruit
Showers in the sports hall at Graf Anton Günther School, approximately 300 m from the start/finish area
Changing facilities and baggage drop-off on Level 1 of the Schlosshöfe car park
additional: Race packs will be handed out on October 11 from 11 a.m. at the Schlosshöfe. On race day, collection opens at 7 a.m. for marathon runners and at 8 a.m. for everyone else. Group registration is available. After the race, extensive refreshments will be provided, including drinks, fruit, coffee, tea, pastries and non-alcoholic wheat beer. Physiotherapy students will offer free massages. Portable toilets and changing facilities are available. Multiple race distances, start in Wardenburg, road closures in the city centre, finisher medals, online registration available

name: 20. Müggelsee-Halbmarathon
description: The Müggelsee Half Marathon is a scenic race in southeast Berlin that runs entirely around the Großer Müggelsee. The event offers three distances: a half marathon, 10 kilometers, and 5 kilometers, each laid out as either an out-and-back route or a loop. The course passes through the historic Spreetunnel and offers idyllic views of Berlin’s largest lake and the surrounding Müggelberge. The race is suitable for all runners, whether they are aiming for personal bests or simply want to enjoy the community and nature. The start and finish are at Müggelseeperle, and the race takes place on October 18, 2026.

name: Almetal-Marathon
description: The Almetal Marathon 2026 takes place on October 18 and offers runners a scenic route from Büren-Ringelstein to Ahorn-Sportpark in Paderborn. Alongside the classic marathon distance, there are two half-marathon options and a relay race covering four stages. The event is shaped by the volunteer commitment of numerous sports clubs and offers a family-friendly atmosphere and an impressive experience of nature in the Alme Valley.

name: Döbraberg Dr. Heinz Laubmann Gedächtnis Lauf
description: The Döbraberg Dr. Heinz Laubmann Memorial Run is a traditional group run that starts in Hof and takes participants along the Webersteig to the Döbraberg, the highest point in the Frankenwald. The event takes place in October and offers distances of 8.5 km, 14.5 km and 23 km, as well as 8.5 km walking and Nordic walking routes. The shorter adult runs are untimed, with the focus on reaching the summit together. The route is hilly and challenging, with a structured format in which pacemakers set the pace and overtaking is not permitted. The run was established in 1968 in honour of Dr. Heinz Laubmann, founder of the IfL clubs.

name: Kauferinger Stauseelauf
description: The Kaufering Reservoir Run is a running event in Kaufering offering several distances, including a half marathon and shorter routes of 0.4 km, 0.8 km and 8.2 km. The event attracts runners from the region and features a varied course around the reservoir. The atmosphere is family-friendly, making it suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website, highlighting the race’s tradition and popularity.

name: Spannrit Volks- und Straßenlauf TSG Kleinostheim
description: The Spannrit Volks- und Straßenlauf TSG Kleinostheim is a local road-running event in Kleinostheim, Germany, held at the Maingauhalle on Ludwigstraße. The event is organized by TSG Kleinostheim and offers children’s and youth races as well as 5 km and 10 km races for adults. The adult course is flat and follows an out-and-back route, with all races finishing at the Maingauhalle. The event is being held for the 15th time and is listed in the German athletics calendar, underscoring its significance in organized club running.

name: Kros Českým rájem
description: Kros Českým rájem is a trail race in a picturesque, little-known corner of Český ráj, featuring a varied and undulating course that winds among sandstone rocks, forest paths, and white-sand trails. The race is 100% trail and is suitable for nature lovers and technical runners. The start and finish are in the village of Skokovy, which is less than an hour from Prague. Race day also includes children’s races and an accompanying programme, including a children’s area.

name: Podzimní Kiosk
description: Podzimní Kiosk is a cross-country race held in Tyršovy sady in Šternberk, featuring a 7 km course for men and a 3.5 km course for women. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners and gives runners the chance to test themselves in pleasant autumn surroundings. The course runs over mixed terrain, making for an engaging and dynamic race for all participants.

name: Běh Zlínem "Přes valašské kotáry"
description: The “Across the Wallachian Hills” race in Zlín is a traditional running event that gives runners the chance to experience the beauty of the Wallachian countryside and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The race starts at the Mládeže Stadium, and the route takes runners through picturesque hills and natural scenery. The organizers emphasize quality organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín series, which includes various running events in the region.

name: PREFA Brněnská 25
organizer: BehejBrno.com, MARATON BRNO z.s., Aleš Čtvrtníček
description: PREFA Brněnská 25 is a traditional road race held in Brno and the surrounding area, running continuously since 1967. It offers several distances—25 km, 16 km, 8 km, and relays—and is open to a wide range of participants, from competitive runners to beginners. The race takes place at the Olympia Park complex near the rope course in Modřice and is part of the Czech Running Club. The first category starts at 11:00, making it convenient for families and recreational runners to take part.

name: Horokros
description: Horokros is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which offers a challenging cross-country race in the picturesque Jeseníky Mountains near Šumperk. The race is intended for runners looking for a trail challenge with varied terrain and natural obstacles. The course is known for its difficulty and beautiful views, attracting both experienced competitors and mountain-running enthusiasts. The Chlapácký běh series rewards regular participants who complete at least six races in a season. Come enjoy the sporting atmosphere and push your limits in the unique setting of the Jeseníky Mountains.

name: Běh na Žaltman
description: The Běh na Žaltman is an open hill race with a mass start, part of the Krakonoš Czech Hill Running Cup and the East Bohemia Grand Prix series. The race takes place in Malé Svatoňovice in the Hradec Králové Region and offers a sporting challenge amid beautiful natural surroundings. The route follows demanding terrain with significant elevation gain, attracting runners of all abilities. The event is a traditional part of the running season and welcomes athletes and fans of hill running alike.

name: Běh okolo Rané
description: The Run Around Raná is a race held in the surroundings of Raná near Louny in the Ústí nad Labem Region. It offers an 8.5 km course for men and a 4.25 km course for women. The race is part of the Louny Running Cup and gives runners the opportunity to enjoy running in natural surroundings with picturesque views. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners looking for a quality race with a regional tradition.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 10. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular running competition over a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km), with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. The race takes place at Kuchajda in Bratislava and is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. The start is traditionally at 10:00, and the event also includes children’s races of approximately 200 meters. The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is part of a series of races held throughout the year, offering runners of various age groups and ability levels an opportunity to compete.

name: Challenge Airport Run
location: Prešov, Prešov, vojenská letecká základna v Prešove
organizer: Prešov Running, v spolupráci s Vojenskou leteckou základňou v Prešove
description: Challenge Airport Run is a unique running experience at the Military Air Base in Prešov, combining sport with the atmosphere of military training. Runners can choose between a 5 km and a 10 km course, with each participant carrying a symbolic weighted backpack, highlighting courage and endurance. The event offers an unforgettable atmosphere among helicopters and military equipment, which is rarely accessible to the public. In addition to the athletic challenge, it is also a tribute to discipline and strength, with a rich accompanying programme and original race packs.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 6. kolo
organizer: 3klub Šamorín o.z. v spolupráci s mestom Šamorín
description: The Šamorín Running League is a traditional running competition organized by 3klub Šamorín, held in the pleasant surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park in Šamorín. The league offers several rounds with different distances, suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts. Participants can expect high-quality organization and a pleasant atmosphere in and around the amphitheater. The league is part of the region’s active sporting life and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: Slaňaki CUP – Beh do vrchu Dubník
location: Zámutov okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Zámutov okr. Vranov nad Topľou, pred Obecným úradom
organizer: Klub otužilcov Vranovské Vydry, Obecný úrad Zámutov, Penzión Kondor Zámutov
description: Slaňaki CUP - Dubník Uphill Race is a traditional uphill race held in Zámutov, Vranov nad Topľou District. The course is 11.2 km long with 600 metres of elevation gain, and the finish is at Slovakia’s highest structure, the Dubník transmitter, at an altitude of 318 metres. The race is part of the Slovak Uphill Running Cup and is open to a broad range of male and female runners of various ages. It is organized by the Vranovské Vydry Winter Swimming Club, Zámutov Municipal Office, and Penzión Kondor Zámutov. The race challenges runners to test their endurance and strength on demanding mountain terrain.

name: Žipovská desiatka
location: Hlavná ulica, Nižný Žipov, Trebišov District, Slovakia

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 8. kolo
location: Námestie T. G. Masaryka, Trenčianske Teplice, Slovakia

name: Botanic Five Kaunas
location: Botanical Garden of Vytautas Magnus University, Kaunas, Lithuania

name: Klánovický 1/2maraton
description: The Klánovice Half Marathon is a trail half marathon through the beautiful surroundings of Klánovice Forest in Prague. The race offers a certified 21.0975 km course along forest paths, a nature trail, and tracks with minimal asphalt and no significant climbs. The event also includes 10 km races, a relay, and children’s races, all with convenient facilities and refreshments along the course. It is ideal for nature lovers and trail runners who want to discover the forest’s beautiful spots and enjoy a friendly atmosphere with an accompanying program.

name: Dvojmíľový beh 30. ročník, Memoriál Gabriela Zelenaya 5. ročník - preteky mládeže
Loučení s oválem
description: Farewell to the Track is a traditional race organized by the Slezan Frýdek-Místek Sports Club. It has been held annually since 2000 as the final track race of the season. Originally intended only for young athletes, it added adult categories in 2014, with distances of 1500 m for men and 800 m for women. After a break from 2017 to 2019, the race returned in 2020 with 800 m events for young athletes and 3000 m for adults. The race takes place at Na Příkopě 1159 in Frýdek-Místek and is a popular event among the region’s athletics community.

name: Beh k srdcu SNP
location: Atletický štadión pri Strednej odbornej škole polytechnickej, Ul. Čs. armády 24, Martin, Slovakia

name: Medziklubové preteky Jesenný kros ŠK Juventa Žilina
Mizuno Neon Run Olomouc
description: Mizuno Neon Run in Olomouc is a nighttime running event full of color, lights, and fun. It’s not a race, but an experience for all participants. This neon run offers a wild and crazy glowing experience that celebrates the joy of movement and having fun together. Get ready to shine and enjoy an unforgettable atmosphere at the Výstaviště Flora grounds in Olomouc.

name: Łemkowyna Trail
location: Krynica-Zdrój, Powiat nowotarski, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, 100 km, Ultramaraton, 50 km, Maraton, 28 km, 10 km
description: Łemkowyna Trail is a mountain race along a route marked by the Main Beskid Trail in the Low Beskids. The event takes place around Krynica-Zdrój and Komańcza, offering a range of distances from 10 km to a 150 km ultramarathon. The course features substantial elevation gain and challenging natural terrain, making it a test for trail-running and mountain-adventure enthusiasts. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from across Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: Route marked by the Main Beskid Trail
Significant elevation changes of up to +5,860 m and -5,970 m on the longest distance
A range of distances from 10 km to 150 km, with time limits
additional: Participants can switch between courses until October 1, 2026. Participant limits for individual distances range from 300 to 550. Starts are scheduled across October 17 and 18, 2026, with different start times for each distance. Each distance has a time limit. The event takes place on natural mountain trails with substantial elevation changes. Courses include elevation gains of up to 740 m for the 30 km and 150 km ultramarathon distances, with time limits of up to 35 hours. Registration is available online, with options for entry-fee refunds and transfer of race packages.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet na cały cykl w jednym mieście (4 imprezy)

description: The CITY TRAIL Grand Prix with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Wrocław’s Osobowicki Forest. The event is recreational and sporting in nature, promoting physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in local and overall rankings. The main race starts at 11:00. The event is open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part under parental supervision.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through the urban forest of Osobowicki Forest in Wrocław
A cross-country race in natural surroundings, through woodland and parkland
A series of four races per season in each location
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race bibs and timing chips are collected on race day. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. A pass for the entire series allows participants to take part in four races in a given city. Pass holders can also take part in one race in another city free of charge, after notifying the organizers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, and the event ends at around 12:15. It is not possible to drive directly to the start and race office; parking is available along Osobowicka Street. The series also includes children’s races.

name: XXIII Bieg śladami ks. Józefa Londzina
Nordwalder Laufspektakel
description: The Nordwalde Running Spectacle is a popular running event with various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as children’s races. It takes place annually in Nordwalde and attracts numerous runners looking forward to a sporting challenge. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good organisation. It offers suitable running options for competitive runners, families and children alike.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon
Children’s races over 1 km and 2 km
Participant and course records for the 5 km and half marathon
additional: The event takes place annually and offers children’s races alongside the main distances. It combines a sporting challenge with a family-friendly atmosphere. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. The event takes place in Nordwalde, with more than 800 participants at the last edition, including record-breaking times and food and drink.

name: Sparkassen Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd
location: Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd, Schwäbisch Gmünd, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd is a traditional ultramarathon that has been held annually since 1991 during golden October. The 50-kilometer course with 1,100 meters of elevation gain crosses the Three Imperial Mountains—Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen—through breathtaking scenery. In addition to the main race, other events include the Alb Ultra at approx. 60 km, the 37 km Alb-Trail, a 25 km race, a 10 km run and walk, and a children’s race. The event offers a sporting spectacle for the whole family and a varied program including a talk, briefing and pasta party.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,100 meters of elevation gain across the Three Imperial Mountains: Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen
Breathtaking natural scenery and landscapes
A range of distances, from the children’s race to the 60 km Alb Ultra
additional: Start for all races (except the Alb-Trail) is on Schwerzerallee, level with the Großsporthalle. Event center at the Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd. Electronic timing using a transponder in the race number (no ChampionChip). A medal is included for races over 25 km; medals for other races can be ordered online for €5. Return transport by local and special buses is available to participants with a race number. Friday evening program includes a talk, briefing and pasta party (€7 contribution toward the meal). Loop course across the Imperial Mountains, aid stations, relay and team competitions, award ceremonies, race number with RFID transponder

name: Burgkirchner Raiffeisen-Crosslauf
location: Freizeitzentrum Halsbachgraben, Burgkirchen an der Alz, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Burgkirchner Raiffeisen Cross-Country Run is a hilly cross-country race in Burgkirchen an der Alz, Bavaria. The start and finish are at the Halsbachgraben Leisure Centre. The event is part of the Raiffeisen Cross-Country Series and offers various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including short courses from 0.65 km to 1.3 km and longer races of 4.5 km and 6.6 km. The course is challenging and hilly rather than flat, making even the short distances strenuous. Separate races for children and teenagers, as well as a special 6.6 km race for men, round out the programme.
course_highlights: Hilly cross-country course, not a flat road
Start and finish at the Halsbachgraben Leisure Centre
Various distances for children, teenagers and adults
additional: Results, photos and further details are available at laufpix.de. Official information is also linked via crosslauf-is.de. Typical October weather: around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Multiple course distances, separate categories for children and teenagers, not a flat road race, and a sporting challenge due to the hilly terrain

name: Gelenauer Erzgebirgscross
description: The Gelenau Erzgebirge Cross is a long-standing running event in the Erzgebirge, organised by LV 90 Erzgebirge. The competition takes place in Gelenau and gives runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on a challenging course. The event is known for its scenic and varied cross-country course through the Erzgebirge. It is open to children, young people, adults and masters, and is a regular fixture in the regional athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Scenic cross-country course in the Erzgebirge
A range of courses for children, young people, adults and masters
Organised by the experienced LV 90 Erzgebirge
additional: The registration deadline is 2 November 2025. Entries should be sent to Sophia Teicher, Kemtauer Straße 27, 09423 Gelenau/Erzgebirge. The contact email is given as meldung "ät" lv90.de. The event includes various categories and age groups, with possible official results for rankings. October weather is typically cool, with temperatures around 14°C; rain is possible.

name: Lusatian Race Walking
price_range: 20-40 EUR pro Veranstaltung, kostenlos für Kinder unter 15 Jahren, zusätzlich 10 EUR bei Anmeldung vor Ort

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: U18 und U20 – 20 EUR pro Veranstaltung

description: The Lusatian Race Walking is an internationally recognized race walking meeting taking place on 24 October 2026 at Weinauparkstadion in Zittau. The competitions cover various distances from 1 km to the marathon, held on an officially measured and certified 1-km loop on flat asphalt. The event is part of the World Race Walking Tour at Silver level and offers both elite and public races for various age groups. The organizers emphasize professional timekeeping, medical care and compliance with international competition rules.
course_highlights: Flat 1 km asphalt loop in Weinaupark, Zittau
Officially measured and certified course
Penalty Zone used for longer distances (5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon)
additional: Children up to age 15 can take part for free. Late entries are possible until 21 October 2026 for an additional fee of 20 EUR. Accreditation and race-number collection take place on 23 October from 16:00 to 18:00 and on 24 October from 8:00 onwards in the start and finish area. The marathon time limit is 4:45 hours. Doping controls are conducted in accordance with World Athletics and WADA. The race takes place on a flat asphalt course in Weinaupark in Zittau, with various categories for youth, adults and masters. Judging seminars are also held, and international competition rules are applied.

name: Alb Marathon
description: The Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd is a traditional ultramarathon that has taken place every year since 1991 during golden October. The route covers 50 kilometres with 1,100 metres of elevation gain over the Three Imperial Mountains of Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen, through breathtaking scenery. Alongside the classic marathon, other races include the Alb-Trail (37 km), the Alb-Ultra (approx. 60 km), as well as shorter distances and relay races suitable for runners of all ability levels. The event offers a sporting spectacle for the whole family, with a varied programme including a talk, briefing and pasta party on the evening before the race.
course_highlights: 50 km route with 1,100 metres of elevation gain over the Three Imperial Mountains of Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen
Breathtaking natural scenery and landscapes on the Swabian Jura
A variety of races, from the Bambini run to the 60 km Alb-Ultra
additional: All races start on Schwerzerallee, level with the Großsporthalle. Race headquarters are at the Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd. Electronic timing uses a transponder in the race bib (no Champion Chip). A medal is included for races over 25 km; a medal for other races can be ordered online for €5. Return transport by regular and special buses is available for participants with a race bib. The programme on Friday evening includes a talk, briefing and pasta party (€7 contribution toward costs). Several race distances are offered, including the 50 km Ultra, 37 km Trail, 25 km, 10 km and relay; the event includes a trail briefing, pasta party and family-friendly activities.

name: B.U.T.XxX - BURGBERNHEIM ULTRA TRAIL
description: The B.U.T.XxX - Burgbernheim Ultra Trail is a challenging ultratrail race in the picturesque landscape of Burgbernheim, Bavaria. The event gives runners the opportunity to experience nature and a varied course with demanding climbs. The race is a challenge for experienced trail runners and fosters a sense of community among participants. The event is organized by TSV Burgbernheim and takes place annually.

name: Lauf der Crossserie des BLV-Kreises Ansbach
Tálínská desítka
location: Náves před obecním úřadem, Tálín, Czech Republic
organizer: Obec Tálín a Progres TT Tálín
description: Tálínská desítka is a traditional running race held in the village of Tálín, bringing together athletes of all ages in the village’s picturesque setting. The race is part of the village’s sports calendar and supports community life and sporting activities for local residents and visitors. The event is organized in cooperation with local sports clubs, including Triatlon Team Tálín, and offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. The start and finish are on the village square in front of the municipal office, creating a friendly atmosphere and making the race easily accessible to participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the village square in front of the municipal office in Tálín
Picturesque village setting suitable for running
Event suitable for all age groups, including people with physical disabilities
additional: The race is part of Tálín’s sporting events, which support community life and are open to the general public, including children, seniors, and people with physical disabilities. It is organized by local sports clubs Triatlon Team Tálín and Galaxy Cyklošvec Písek. The village also has the V OBRAZE mobile app for following current information. The date October 23, 2027, has not been confirmed by available sources; sources refer to the 2026 edition.

name: Třebíčský maraton
description: The Třebíč Marathon invites you to run through the picturesque streets of Třebíč’s historic centre, where you can admire the atmosphere of its UNESCO landmarks, including the iconic Basilica of St. Procopius. In addition to the marathon, you can choose the half-marathon or the shorter 10K, both of which also pass through the city’s historic and natural beauty. Refreshment stations await you along the course and at the finish, followed by a relaxing AfterRun party—the perfect way to round off a day of sport. Families can also enjoy children’s races right in the city centre, with an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: Picturesque streets in Třebíč’s historic centre
The atmosphere of UNESCO landmarks, including the Basilica of St. Procopius
Refreshment stations along the course and a welcoming atmosphere
additional: The registration fee must be paid within 14 days of registration; otherwise, the registration will be cancelled. After completing online registration, you can also register on site, but the number of race packs is limited. An AfterRun party will round off the day after the race. Children’s races take place right in the city centre, with a lively atmosphere. The event offers a marathon, half-marathon, 10K race and children’s races. Prices published for the 2026 edition may not apply to 2027.

name: Slapy Trail Maniacs
description: Slapy Trail Maniacs is a marked trail race around the Slapy Reservoir, offering three challenging routes of 61 km, 47 km, and 33 km. The main course, with 2,300 metres of elevation gain, follows roads, paths, stream crossings, rocky outcrops, and steep drops, making for a varied and technically interesting run. There are two course premiums—a climbing premium and a speed premium—and the race is also suitable for earning ITRA points. Medals, diplomas, prizes in kind, and prize money are prepared for the top runners. The organizer is Š&P Outdoor z.s., which provides high-quality organization and support for runners.
course_highlights: 61 km main course with 2,300 m of elevation gain
Routes follow roads, paths, stream crossings, rocky outcrops, and steep drops
Climbing and speed premiums on the course
additional: Participants who complete the 61 km or 47 km routes can earn ITRA points. Medals, diplomas, prizes in kind, and prize money await the fastest runners. The organizer is Š&P Outdoor z.s.; the contact person is Ondřej Kutiš. The marked race features technically challenging terrain around the Slapy Reservoir. Race facilities are listed at Hořovická chata in Borotice. Information about the routes and prices comes from a previous edition and may not apply to the 2027 edition.

name: Olomoucký kros
location: Přírodní koupaliště Poděbrady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Olomouc Cross is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the natural surroundings of the Poděbrady swimming pool in Olomouc. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region and gives athletes the opportunity to test their fitness and performance in a beautiful natural setting. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners who want to test themselves in a cross-country race.
course_highlights: Run in the natural surroundings of the Poděbrady swimming pool
Part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Cross-country race with natural obstacles
additional: Available information about previous editions relates to races for children and young people; the program for the 2027 edition has not been confirmed.

name: Skalička run
location: Obecní hřiště, Skalička, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Skalička Run is the fifth edition of a successful off-road running event, held mainly in the valley of the Lubě stream in the South Moravian Region. The race offers three distances—22 km, 13 km and 7 km—on cross-country and trail terrain. It starts at the municipal sports ground in Skalička and is suitable for nature-running enthusiasts seeking different levels of difficulty. The event is organized by DálRunDál z.s., led by Pavel Matoušek.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly through the valley of the Lubě stream
Cross-country and trail terrain
Distances of 22 km, 13 km and 7 km
additional: The race is organized by DálRunDál z.s.; the contact person is Pavel Matoušek. The start is at the municipal sports ground in Skalička. Race type: cross-country/trail. The first category starts at 11:15. The first category start time is listed as 11:15; the start location is the municipal sports ground.

name: Leskros Hradečák
location: Kemp Stříbrný rybník, Malšova Lhota, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Hradečák is part of Leskros, the largest Czech running and canicross series, offering an authentic trail-running experience. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Stříbrný rybník campsite in Malšova Lhota near Hradec Králové, and includes various running and canicross categories as well as the unique Leskrosí jednadváca race. Individuals and whole families can take part, with children’s races and a charity walk also on offer. The series emphasizes fairness, transparency, and support for nonprofit organizations through entry fees and donations.
course_highlights: Authentic trail running in interesting locations across the Czech Republic
Canicross on the main route, approximately 4 km, with OPEN and ELITE categories
The unique Leskrosí jednadváca: 19–22 km along an unmarked route through beautiful places in the surrounding area
additional: The race offers running, canicross, and Leskrosí jednadváca categories. The Rozběháček children’s running program is free. A 4 km charity walk is also part of the event. Results for individual races and the whole series are announced. Registration and entries are managed through the Rozběháme Česko app. The organizer is the nonprofit organization Rozběháme Česko z.ú., which supports charitable projects. For the 2026 edition, the first category was scheduled to start at 8:00; this time may not apply to the 2027 edition.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí
location: Prokopské údolí, Praha 5, Prague, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: děti 6-11 let: 100 Kč pro přihlášené a zaplacené předem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: děti 0-5 let: 60 Kč pro přihlášené a zaplacené předem

description: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí is a traditional autumn running race set in the beautiful natural surroundings of Prague’s Prokopské and Dalejské valleys. It offers two main courses, approximately 8.7 and 14.3 km long, on paved and unpaved paths, meadows and trails, with limited traffic on the asphalt roads. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants and has a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments and children’s races. The field is limited to 500 runners, helping ensure a comfortable event. The organizers emphasize clear course markings and runner safety.
course_highlights: Courses run through the beautiful, rugged landscape of Prokopské and Dalejské valleys
Two courses of approximately 8.7 km and 14.3 km, with every kilometre marked
Courses combine paved and unpaved paths, meadows, trails and asphalt roads with limited traffic
additional: Race-day check-in and registration take place from 9:00 to 10:45. The children’s races start from 10:00; the main races start at 10:45 (8 km) and 11:00 (14 km). The field is limited to 500 runners. On-site registration is available for an additional fee of 600 Kč if capacity has not been reached. There is one refreshment station on the course. The timing chip is attached to the race bib and does not need to be returned after finishing. Trail shoes with a more aggressive tread are recommended. The venue has toilets, baggage storage, changing tents, a results ceremony and a raffle. Course, price and start-time details are from the 2026 edition; information for the 2027 edition has not been confirmed in available sources.

name: Běhej Valachy
location: Hotel Galik, Velké Karlovice, Czech Republic
description: Běhej Valachy is a trail-running race across the rugged hills of the picturesque Velké Karlovice valley. The course follows the Hanzlůvka valley and passes the Za Miloňovou bell tower before climbing to the ridge of the Vsetín Beskids, below Vysoká and up to Člověčí. From there, it descends along a steep ridge with beautiful views of the Beskids and Javorníky. The race offers unique views, challenging climbs, and a memorable experience of movement and nature. It also includes children’s races for various age groups and a family race.
course_highlights: The course follows the Hanzlůvka valley and passes the Za Miloňovou bell tower on its way to the ridge of the Vsetín Beskids.
Beautiful views of the Beskids and Javorníky from a steep ridge.
A challenging climb past the U Křenků cottage and a mountain sprint at an elevation of 938 m above sea level.
additional: There are mass starts for adults running 12.5 km and 6.5 km, as well as a 3.2 km family race. Children’s races are divided into age categories from 4 to 15 years. The start area opens at 11:45; check-in and registration for children take place from 8:00 to 9:15, and adult check-in runs from 9:30 to 11:30. The finish straight is attractive and offers plenty of room for a final sprint. The organizer reserves the right to change the schedule on race day. According to information available for the 2026 edition, the races on offer are 12.5 km, 6.5 km, and a 3.2 km family run, alongside the children’s races. Facilities include registration, a changing room, showers, and refreshments; prices for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava
location: Městský stadion Ostrava-Vítkovice, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon Ostrava is a prestigious running event offering a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, and mixed team race on a fast, certified course in Ostrava-Vítkovice. The event takes place at the Ostrava-Vítkovice City Stadium, with both the start and finish on the stadium track. Runners can follow in the footsteps of the legendary Emil Zátopek and experience the atmosphere of a professionally organized race with an accompanying program and high-quality event organization. The race package includes an original technical shirt, a medal, and refreshments during and after the race. The event is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes.
course_highlights: Fast, certified course in Ostrava-Vítkovice
Start and finish on the track at the City Stadium
8 aid stations on the marathon course offering water, fruit, and energy supplements
additional: The race bib with timing chip must be worn on the chest for accurate timekeeping. After the start, marathon runners complete one lap of the stadium track before heading out onto the course. Lead and follow vehicles and cyclists accompany the front and back of the field. Changing rooms, toilets, and baggage storage are available at the stadium. Parking is available for a fee at Ostravar Arena or, in limited numbers, free of charge on nearby streets. After the race, a generous selection of refreshments, an expo, and free physiotherapy are available. The 2026 edition, originally scheduled for 24 October 2026, was moved to 2027 because of road reconstruction in Ostrava and the surrounding area. The date 23 October 2027 has not been confirmed on the official website.

name: Moravská Sázava
location: Horský Resort Buková Hora, Červená Voda, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné ULTRA 50 je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné DVOJIC je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč / člen dvojice

description: Moravská Sázava Ultra 50 is a 50 km ultrarunning race that follows the valleys of the Moravská Sázava River from Zábřeh to the summit of Buková hora. The course offers a varied mix of forest roads, natural trails and paved sections, with a total elevation gain of 1,369 metres. The race is suitable for experienced ultrarunners as well as runners looking for a new challenge, and finishes at the summit of Buková hora, from where participants can comfortably ride the cable car down. After the race, camping is available in the finish area, with showers and breakfast on Sunday morning.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,369 m of elevation gain
A mix of forest roads, natural trails and paved sections
Finish at the summit of Buková hora, with the option to ride down by cable car
additional: Participants receive an ID wristband, race bib and GPS tracker. Aid stations along the course provide water, sports drinks, Coca-Cola and fruit. After the race, camping is available at the finish, with access to showers. The finish area is at the cable car’s upper station, and participants can comfortably ride down by cable car. Results are timed electronically and manually. GPS trackers are mandatory and are used to track participants online. The race is included in the UTMB Index 50K and ITRA 50K - 2. The race base is at Horský Resort Buková Hora.

name: Běh kolem Asuánu
location: Jižní konec retenční nádrže Asuán, Jinonice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Asuán is a traditional cross-country race held on the dam of the Asuán retention reservoir in Prague’s Jinonice district. It offers courses of various lengths for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, on gently undulating natural terrain, finishing on a paved straight. The race can only be reached on foot from several nearby bus stops and is organized by Atletika Stodůlky z.s. The entry fee is voluntary, making the event accessible to runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Gently undulating course on natural terrain
Paved finishing straight
Start and race office on the dam of the Asuán retention reservoir, accessible on foot
additional: Race categories are divided by age, with course distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest runners to 3600 m for men. The start and race office are located at the southern end of the Asuán retention reservoir. Access is on foot only from the Ovčí hájek and Galerie Butovice bus stops and the Volcano complex. Information about the 2027 edition was not confirmed in the available sources.

name: Běh do vrchu na Pastýřskou stěnu
location: Pastýřská stěna, Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic

name: Beh hrebeňom Čergova
description: The Run along the Čergov Ridge is the longest mountain race in the Čergov Mountains, intended for nature-running enthusiasts and trained runners. The course starts in the village of Kamenica and passes over the range’s highest peaks, including Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá and Sedlo Besná. It is 32 km long, with 1,413 metres of elevation gain. Runners can enjoy stunning panoramic views and challenging terrain on hiking trails. The race takes place on 24 October 2026, starting at 9:00 at Farma Kamenica and finishing at Sedlo Besná, near Hotel Šport Lysá.
course_highlights: 32 km mountain race with 1,413 m of elevation gain
Crosses the highest peaks of the Čergov Mountains: Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá and Sedlo Besná
The route follows hiking trails marked blue and green
additional: A large bus will be provided for all participants, taking them in the morning from the village of Drienica to Kamenica (departing at 7:15 from the car park by Hotel JAVORNÁ). The organisers will also transport participants’ personal belongings from the start to the finish. Race-day registration is open from 7:00 to 8:30 at Farma Kamenica. The awards ceremony and lunch will be held at Hotel Šport Lysá. The race takes place on 24 October 2026 and is open to men and women in various age categories, offering the chance to take part in a mountain trail race amid the beautiful scenery of the Čergov Mountains.

name: Rajecká 12-minútovka
location: Ihrisko pri ZŠ na Lipovej ulici, Rajec, Slovakia
distance_verbose: 13.7 km, 10 km, 8.3 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 1 km
description: The Rajecká 12-Minute Run is a dynamic running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held on the sports field by the primary school on Lipová Street in Rajec. This short, intense run is ideal for runners of all levels who want to test their speed and endurance within a limited time. The event is part of the region’s running tradition and offers a pleasant atmosphere with support from the local community. The organizers ensure the course is well prepared and provide a welcoming environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Run on the sports field by the primary school on Lipová Street in Rajec
Intense 12-minute time limit
Pleasant atmosphere with support from the local community
additional: Registration is online, with the option to pay later for an additional fee. The event is suitable for all age groups and running levels. Refreshments are provided after the run, and results are announced at the venue. The race takes place on the sports field by the primary school on Lipová Street in Rajec, offering a chance to improve personal records in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Beh vinicami Bojničiek a Hlohovca
location: Cultural center near the church, Bojničky, Trnava District, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 15 € pre prihlásených on line do 23.10.2024 aj so zaplatením štartovného

description: The Run Through the Vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec is a running event organized by the Bojničky Athletics Club and the municipality of Bojničky. The race takes place at the cultural center by the church in Bojničky and offers categories for men, women, and Nordic walking on a 6 km course. Registration fees can be paid online or on-site, with a discount for students. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of various age groups.
course_highlights: The course runs through the vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec
Categories for men, women, and Nordic walking
Start at the cultural center by the church in Bojničky
additional: Categories: Men (M, M 40, M 50, M 60), Women (Ž, Ž 40, Ž 50), Nordic walking for men and women on the 6 km course. The registration fee can be paid online or on-site on race day. The event also includes Nordic walking; registration is available online, and the venue is the cultural center by the church in Bojničky.

name: Ružínska desiatka
price_range: 15,-€ online, 20,-€ na mieste; detské preteky 5,-€ online, 7,-€ na mieste
description: Ružínska Desiatka is a running race organized by Športový klub Jaklovce in cooperation with the municipality of Jaklovce, held by the Ružín Reservoir. The course is mostly asphalt with a small proportion of gravel, making for a fast and enjoyable run. Men and women compete in various age categories over 10 km and 5 km, and children’s races are also held. The main categories start at 11:00, and the children’s categories begin at 10:00. The race is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all levels.
course_highlights: 90% asphalt, 10% gravel (macadam)
The route runs around the Ružín Reservoir in Jaklovce
Categories for men, women, and children across various age groups
additional: The children’s categories start at 10:00, and the main categories at 11:00. Categories include various age groups for men and women, as well as overall rankings and special awards for the oldest, youngest, and best runners from Jaklovce. The course is mostly asphalt with a small proportion of gravel. The event includes 5 km and 10 km categories, children’s races, a raffle, and an inflatable bouncy castle.

name: Sporto šventė Juodšilių ruduo
location: Juodšilių, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The “Juodšilių ruduo” sports festival is a Vilnius District sporting event taking place on October 24, 2026, in Juodšiliai. The event encourages community members to take part in sports, promotes athletics and running, and advocates a healthy lifestyle. Anyone may participate, with distances of 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km. Participants register and collect their bibs at the event venue from 10:00 to 11:30. Participation is voluntary, and runners are responsible for their own health.
course_highlights: The course is in the territory of Juodšiliai Eldership, Vilnius District
Events: 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km cross-country runs
Walking animals and using personal support during the event are prohibited
additional: Bib collection and registration take place from 10:00 to 11:30. Participants must present an identity document to collect their bib. Participants may not transfer their bib to another person, use personal support, walk animals on the course, or leave the course without a judge’s permission. Protests must be submitted in writing within 30 minutes after the end of the event, with a fee of 30 EUR. The fee for changing an event is 6 EUR; changing to a longer event requires payment of the difference. Running events: 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km; registration from 10:00 to 11:30; participant awards and commemorative medals; participant restrictions and rules.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: PKO Sopot Half Marathon is an annual running event held in the seaside city of Sopot, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half marathon course runs through the city’s picturesque streets, offering exceptional views and the atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city. The finish line is at ERGO Arena, adding a distinctive character and sporting spirit to the event. It is also an opportunity for families to celebrate sport together, with numerous accompanying races for different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: A seaside course through the streets of Sopot
Finish line at ERGO Arena—a unique place to cross the finish
The atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city, attracting runners and spectators
additional: The event also includes accompanying races such as the Half Marathon Relay, the 5 km Run, and races for children and juniors. The race pack includes a medal and other merchandise. The finish at ERGO Arena provides a unique atmosphere and comfort for participants. The organizer also offers the “Run, Be Ready” training plan for those preparing for the race.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja jesienna 2026
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema is a unique night road race in Koszalin, offering three distances: 7 km, a half marathon, and a marathon. The course runs through the city streets, with the start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium. The race has official PZLA certification, ensuring accurate course measurement and the possibility of setting records. The event has a one-of-a-kind atmosphere, with a laser start at 2:00 a.m. highlighting its unique nocturnal character. Participants can expect excellent organization, attractive prizes, and keepsakes.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course, confirming accurate measurement
A loop of approximately 7 km, completed multiple times depending on the distance
Start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium in Koszalin
additional: The race starts at 2:00 a.m. with a laser start. The race office for children and young people is located at the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall. The course runs through the streets of Koszalin, with views of exhibits at the aviation museum. After each distance, children receive gifts and prizes directly at the stadium. The course is undulating, and runners can rest at the stadium, which the loop passes through.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale running event held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The marathon course runs through wooded and rural areas, offering runners peace and contact with nature, with a distinctive point on the loop at Napoleon’s Stone. The race has a friendly, informal character, without competitive pressure or crowds, creating a welcoming atmosphere for logging miles together. The organizers, including local runner Arek Tołłoczko, take care of course markings and participants’ comfort. In 2024, a series of four marathons on this course is planned, taking place at different times of the year.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km course through forests and picturesque fields
A loop featuring the distinctive Napoleon’s Stone as a landmark
Every kilometre marked, with the start/finish on Polna Street
additional: A 7 km running route laid out and marked by the Harcownik Running Club from Jelcz-Laskowice; convenient parking; no crowds and a relaxed atmosphere without competitive pressure; a planned series of four marathons in 2024, taking place in winter, spring, summer and autumn. Sources describe a 42.195 km marathon course; there is no confirmed information about the entry fee or registration for the 2027 edition.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
description: The Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Dolnej Doliny Wisły is an annual running event held in Tczew County. The event features two races: a PZLA-certified marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.097 km. The routes pass through the scenic Vistula Valley, over a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces, with traffic restricted during the race. The start and finish are located in Tczew, and the event attracts runners from various regions, offering professional organization and clearly marked routes.
course_highlights: A PZLA-certified 42.195 km marathon through Tczew and nearby towns
A 21.097 km half marathon on an asphalt-and-gravel route
The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals; traffic is restricted during the race
additional: The participant limit is 400 paid entrants. The marathon starts at 09:00 at the School Complex of Construction and Clothing in Tczew; the half marathon starts at 11:00 at the Primary School in Małe Walichnowy. The start line closes 15 minutes after the start. The marathon course is PZLA-certified; the half marathon course is not. The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals.

name: XLIV Perła Paprocan
description: Perła Paprocan is a marathon held around Lake Paprocany in Tychy on a 7 km loop. Participants can choose any distance by running multiples of the loop, up to a full marathon. The event is recreational and intended for training, with no need to declare a distance in advance. Every participant receives a commemorative medal at the finish. The organizers emphasize that the atmosphere and sense of community among runners matter more than competition. Tychy is the only city in Poland where a marathon is held twice a year, and Perła Paprocan is one of those editions.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop around Lake Paprocany
Paved sections (over 50%), along with compacted paths and forest trails
A station with drinks, fruit, and sweets after each loop
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the Irysy restaurant by Lake Paprocany in Tychy (ul. Parkowa 17) on October 23, 2026, from 14:00 to 17:00; October 24, 2026, from 10:00 to 15:00; and on race day from 8:00 to 9:30. A third party may collect a race number with written authorization. Participants under 18 must have consent from a parent or guardian. Valuables can be left in the storage area, marked with the race number.

Glauchauer Herbstlauf
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinschaft Glauchau e.V. und Kreissportbund Zwickau
description: The Glauchau Autumn Run is a long-standing running event in Glauchau, held annually in autumn since 1986. The event offers courses for runners of all ages and ability levels, including a half marathon, 10 km, 3.2 km and 1.1 km races, as well as walking and Nordic walking. The routes pass through the scenic surrounding area on asphalt and paved paths, including sections alongside the reservoir and the castle pond. The event is a sporting highlight for the region and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running to experience autumn actively.
course_highlights: 21.1 km flat scenic run with 75% asphalt and 25% paved paths
10 km course with 25% asphalt and 75% paved paths around the reservoir and castle pond
3.2 km and 1.1 km loops around the grounds of the Sachsenlandhalle Glauchau
additional: Half-marathon time limit: 2:45 h. Intermediate checkpoint at km 14.3 (reservoir pavilion) must be passed by 12:00; otherwise, disqualification with a shortened course to the finish. Race number includes a baggage tag and a raffle ticket. Recommended parking: Kaufland, Grenayer Straße. Late registration/changes possible on 24.10.2026 from 13:00 to 14:30, with a late registration fee of 5 euros. Registration opens on 01.08.2026. Race numbers include chips; age-group rankings, team and special rankings. No refunds. Limits apply to the company and family runs and Special Olympics. Participation includes shipping of the entry fee.

name: Olympiaberg-Cross München mit Deutschem Cross Cup
organizer: Förderverein Leichtathletik & Events München e. V.
price_range: Männer/Frauen 18 Euro, Jugend 8 Euro, Kinder 8 Euro, Barfußlauf 8 Euro
description: The Olympiaberg Cross Munich is a challenging cross-country race in Munich’s historic Olympic Park, taking place on October 25, 2026. The course follows a loop of approximately 1,100 metres, with several notable climbs and obstacles such as straw-bale sections. The race is part of the German Cross Cup and offers age-group and team classifications. Elite runners can win cash prizes, and all participants receive a certificate through an online service.
course_highlights: Approximately 1,100-metre loop with several marked uphill sections
Four numbered straw-bale sections as technical obstacles
Start and finish in the central area of Olympiaberg in Munich’s Olympic Park
additional: Online registration is possible until 60 minutes before the respective start. DLV start authorisation requires the DLV start-pass number and DLV regional association to be provided. All participants can use an online service to print their certificates. Separate age-group and team classifications are available (U12 to U18). Barefoot runners receive a special gift. The course features climbs and obstacles (straw bales) and is a challenging, hilly route. Online registration. Start and finish in Munich’s Olympic Park.

name: Volkswaldlauf des MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt
description: The MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt Volkswaldlauf takes place on 25 October 2026 in Winsen-Borstel. The event offers distances ranging from short children’s races to a challenging 20.3 km course, making it ideal for families as well as runners looking for a longer distance. The start and finish are at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground on Heidlandsweg, which serves as the central meeting point. The race is part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup and promises a varied route through natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.5 km to 20.3 km
Start and finish at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground
Event as part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup
additional: The event is aimed at families and runners of all ages. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The Am Habichtshorst sports ground is the central meeting point for runners. Distances: 0.5 km to 20.3 km, including children’s races; central meeting point at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground; October weather: approx. 14°C, 6°C low, 40mm of precipitation, cloudy

name: Mönchsdegginger Lauf zum Plossen - 1. Lauf Jedermannlaufserie
35. Ricklinger Volkslauf / Ricklinger Volkslauf
location: Meisenwinkel 9, Hannover-Ricklingen, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Ricklingen Volkslauf is a local race day in Hannover-Ricklingen, organized by TuS Ricklingen. It offers flat races for adults over approximately 5.5 to 5.7 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking over the same distance. The main race is the 10 km Lothar-Mayer-Lauf. There is also a 400 m Bambini race for the youngest participants and a 1 km students’ race, allowing families and club runners to take part together, with participants grouped by age category.
course_highlights: Flat courses in Hannover-Ricklingen
Races for adults and children, plus walking and Nordic walking
Finish at Meisenwinkel 9 in Hannover-Ricklingen
additional: Running and walking events are grouped by distance and age category. There is a 400 m Bambini race and a 1 km students’ race. All races finish at the same location. The event takes place in Hannover-Ricklingen, with the start and finish at Meisenwinkel 9. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a range of events, including walking and children’s races.

name: 44. Zerbster Rolandlauf
description: The 44th Zerbst Roland Run is a traditional fun run in Zerbst, Saxony-Anhalt, starting and finishing at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium. The event takes place on a Sunday in October and is organized by the athletics department of TSV Rot-Weiß Zerbst. Various distances are offered for all age groups, from short children’s races to 10 kilometers for adults. The course is a flat 5-kilometer loop on paved and mixed surfaces that also passes through the stadium. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop on paved and mixed surfaces
Course passes through the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Separate categories for children, teenagers, adults, and seniors. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category. Typical October weather: around 14 °C, mostly cloudy, with about 40 mm of precipitation. The race also supports Anhalt Hospice Zerbst and is organized as a community fun run with medals and certificates.

name: Gütersloher DJK Halbmarathon
description: The Gütersloh DJK Half Marathon is an established running event in Gütersloh, taking place on 25 October 2026. The event offers a half marathon as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The courses are officially measured by the DLV and are therefore eligible for rankings. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with awards for the fastest runners in various age categories and overall standings.
course_highlights: DLV-measured half-marathon course to IAAF/AIMS standards
5 km and 10 km road races as additional events
Awards for places 1–6 in the overall standings
additional: Certificates can be downloaded from the timekeeper’s website, www.timeteam-jung.de. Awards ceremonies will take place in the tent as soon as possible after the races. Parking is available at Hauptschule Nord, Ahornallee. DJK Gütersloh accepts no liability for accidents, theft or other damage. Measurement to DLV/IAAF/AIMS standards, online registration, parking at Hauptschule Nord, disclaimer of liability, certificates via www.timeteam-jung.de
