description: The FSV Run takes place on October 25, 2026, in the Brucker Lache in Erlangen and offers races for all age groups, from Bambinis to adults. The course is a relatively flat 5 km loop, which runners complete twice for the 10 km race. Alongside the sporting experience, social engagement is also a focus: €2 per participant is donated to the Förderverein Erlanger Tafel. Children can enjoy medals and face painting, and free fruit, tea and non-alcoholic wheat beer are available in the finish area. The event also prioritizes environmental protection, for example by allowing participants to label and store their own bottles.
course_highlights: Relatively flat 5 km loop in the Brucker Lache
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
Course suitable for runners and Nordic walkers
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 1 hour before the starts, for a €2 late-registration fee. The Bambini and schoolchildren’s races are free. There is face painting, medals for children, changing facilities at the primary school, and free refreshments in the finish area, including fruit, tea and non-alcoholic wheat beer. The event supports the Förderverein Erlanger Tafel with donations per participant. Races over 0.4 km, 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km, plus relay races; registration online and on the day of the event; eco-friendly travel by bicycle or bus; children’s activities and refreshments on site; donations to the Erlanger Tafel

name: Lauf um den Eisbrunn - 1. Lauf der Jedermannserie
location: Sportgelände des SV Mauren, Harburg, Donau-Ries, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Lauf um den Eisbrunn kicks off the LG Donau-Ries everyone’s running series in late autumn. The road race takes place in Harburg, with the start and finish at the SV Mauren sports grounds. Events include a main race of approximately 10 km, a 3 km short race, and a 7 km walking route. The event welcomes all running enthusiasts, from children to club runners, and offers a friendly atmosphere for individual entrants and series runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the SV Mauren sports grounds in Harburg
Main race of approx. 10 km, plus a 3 km short race and a 7 km walking route
Local late-autumn road race with typical October weather around 14 °C
additional: Race numbers with transponders are distributed on site before the start. The main race starts in the morning, followed by the shorter events. The series concludes with a final in Nördlingen on the third Sunday of Advent. A local race for all age groups, including children, teenagers, adults, and walkers. The series finale in Nördlingen offers community runners a good opportunity to prepare for winter.

name: Porzellinerlauf
location: Sportplatz Am Dohlenstein, Kahla, Thüringen, Germany
description: The Porzellinerlauf Kahla is a traditional autumn road race starting and finishing at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground in Kahla, Thuringia. The 13 km race is the main event, alongside shorter children’s and youth races, making the day appealing to both families and regular runners. Organised by SV 1910 Kahla e.V. since 1971, the race combines a sporting challenge with the local porcelain tradition. Regional timekeepers oversee the course, which receives particularly positive feedback for its route.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground
13 km main race, with shorter children’s and youth races
Route through Kahla with a connection to its porcelain tradition
additional: The field is modest, with around 101 to 300 runners and more than one hundred finishers in recent editions. Typical November weather in Kahla is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. Timing is provided by regional timekeepers. The race has been established since 1971 and regularly attracts between 101 and 300 participants. The course is known for its good condition and attractive surroundings. The event also includes refreshments, showers and an awards ceremony.

name: VR Bank Westküsten Herbstlauf Schafstedt
description: The VR Bank Westküsten Autumn Run Schafstedt is an autumn running event in Schafstedt, Schleswig-Holstein, taking place for the 38th time in 2026. Distances include 3 km, 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 5 km walking route. The event welcomes adults and younger participants and fosters a family-friendly atmosphere with children’s and youth races. The routes pass through the autumn landscape in the fresh air and offer an alternative to city runs.
course_highlights: The 3 km route is flat
The 5 km run and 5 km walk include some hills
All races finish at the same finish line
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Typical October weather in Schafstedt is around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event also includes walking options and is aimed at families and young people. October weather is generally mild, with temperatures around 6–14 °C, creating ideal conditions for an autumn run.

name: Thüngersheimer Bocksbeutellauf 2026
description: The Thüngersheim Bocksbeutel Run is a traditional race held annually in Thüngersheim. The event offers runners of all ages a friendly, welcoming atmosphere, with a generous runners’ buffet, a large cake and coffee bar, and a medal and bottle of wine for every finisher. Children receive a small gift. The race is a celebration of the local running community, combining sporting ambition with a sociable gathering.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque wine region around Thüngersheim
Generous runners’ buffet and large cake and coffee bar
A bottle of wine for every finisher, or a gift for children
additional: Every finisher receives a medal and a bottle of wine; children receive a small gift. A generous runners’ buffet and a large cake and coffee bar are available. Registration is open until 14.09.2026 to benefit from lower fees. Distances: 600 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km; date: 25 October 2026; local race, family- and club-friendly

name: Freisinger Strassenlauf pwd. by Munich Airport
Běh metropole MČ Praha 6
location: Park Ladronka, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh metropole is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and residents’ sense of belonging to their district. The race in Prague 6 takes place in Ladronka Park and offers a chance to test your strength in a friendly atmosphere. Each participant represents their district and contributes to the competition to find Prague’s most athletic district. Original medals are prepared for runners as keepsakes from each edition.
course_highlights: Race in Ladronka Park in Prague 6
A series of races held across Prague’s districts
Promoting a healthy lifestyle and community spirit
additional: Each participant represents the district where they have permanent residence and contributes to the districts’ scores. Special medals are prepared for each category as unique keepsakes from the race. The official website lists a previous edition in Ladronka Park; the date 24 October 2027 is not confirmed by the available sources.

name: Račiansky kros – jeseň
location: Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros – autumn is a traditional running race held in Bratislava, in the Knižková dolina area of Bratislava-Rača. The race gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the autumn atmosphere in the pleasant surroundings of the amphitheatre and nearby area. The organisers, OZ PERUN, ensure thorough preparation and refreshments for participants. The event is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages.
course_highlights: Race in the natural surroundings of Knižková dolina
Start and finish at the Bratislava-Rača amphitheatre
Autumn atmosphere and quality refreshments
additional: The registration form and consent of the data subject are available on the website. The organiser is OZ PERUN. IBAN for payments: SK09 8330 0000 0025 0082 7935. The course is 80% forest paths and 20% asphalt. The races are open to men, women and children. Registration is available online and on-site, with a limited number of starting places. The event also includes children’s races and post-race refreshments.

name: T1 Ring kros
location: Areál T1 ring, Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
description: T1 Ring Cross is a running race held at the T1 Ring venue in Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou District. The race offers two main courses: 9 km with approximately 210 metres of elevation gain and a 4 km course. There is also a non-competitive Nordic Walking event. Men and women can compete in various age categories, and children have a separate start. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025. The main race starts at 13:00 and the children’s race at 11:00.
course_highlights: 9 km course with approximately 210 metres of elevation gain
4 km hobby course and non-competitive Nordic Walking event
Race at the T1 Ring venue in Vechec
additional: Children start at 11:00. Men’s and women’s categories are divided by age. Part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025. The race takes place at the T1 Ring venue, with registration available online and on site. Entry fees range from €8 to €20. Race starts are at 11:00 and 13:00.

name: Košickopolianska desiatka
description: The Košickopolianska Ten is a running event organized by the municipality of Košická Polianka and held in front of the cultural center in Košická Polianka. The main race starts at 1:00 p.m., while the children’s categories begin at 11:00 a.m. The race is divided into several age categories for men, women, and children, welcoming runners of all ages. The organizers welcome everyone who wants to enjoy a day of sport in the pleasant surroundings of the municipality.
course_highlights: Start and finish in front of the cultural center in Košická Polianka
Several age categories for men, women, and children
The pleasant surroundings of the municipality of Košická Polianka
additional: The children’s races start at 11:00 a.m. Categories are divided by age, from age 0 through seniors. The event is organized by the municipality of Košická Polianka; contact phone numbers and email addresses are available for those seeking information. The race is part of a series of editions and offers the opportunity to take part in a 10 km race, with various categories for all age groups, including children’s races.

name: Atenčan
location: Kozárovce Reservoir, Kozárovce, Levice District, Slovakia

Kojša RUN – lesný beh „Bežkovanie bez lyží“
location: Areál bežeckého lyžovania LK Metropol, Kojšovská hoľa, Slovakia

name: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“
description: The “Around Lithuania” Run is a traditional running event held in Rumšiškės, on the grounds of the Lithuanian Open-Air Museum. The event offers a range of distances, from a 300 m children’s race to the 21.098 km half marathon, which is the main event and counts toward the Lithuanian Running Cup standings. Participants start according to age-group handicap rules, and the event program includes registration, starts for different distances, and awards. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and compete with running enthusiasts from all over Lithuania.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 300 m children’s race to a 21.098 km half marathon
Starts follow age-group handicap rules
Location: Lithuanian Open-Air Museum in Rumšiškės
additional: Event program: 09:00 registration and race number distribution, 10:45 competition opening, starts for different distances from 11:00 to 13:00, awards from 14:00. The main distance is 21.098 km, consisting of 4 laps. The age-group handicap system allows less competitive participants to start earlier. The event takes place in Rumšiškės, with online registration available. The program includes starts, awards, and special groups.

name: Smaltovaný bažant
description: The Enamelled Pheasant is the final race in the Ruler of Mrdice series, held in the picturesque pheasantry in Heřmanův Městec. This traditional 1,500-metre race offers an opportunity to test your strength in a friendly atmosphere. The Heřmanův Městec Running Club organizes a range of sporting activities and group training sessions throughout the year, complementing the racing season. The Enamelled Pheasant is an ideal event for runners who want to end the season with joy and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A 1,500-metre race in the pheasantry
Part of the Ruler of Mrdice series
A traditional race in Heřmanův Městec
additional: The race is part of the Ruler of Mrdice series, which includes classic races as well as open, timed group training sessions. The running club holds regular group runs every Tuesday in a friendly atmosphere. A course map and results from previous editions are available. The race is the final round of the Mrdice League. In 2026, the first category was scheduled to start at 18:00; the 2027 race date had not been confirmed in the available materials.

name: Podzimní půlmaraton VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Cycling path near Kempinku, Braník, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The VAŠÍ LIGY Autumn Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1 km road race held in Prague 4-Braník on the cycle path by Kempink. The route follows a beautiful, flat and fast path along the Vltava from Braník to Vrané and back, often enabling runners to achieve personal bests. The race offers a relaxed running atmosphere and is suitable for anyone looking to experience a high-quality half marathon in pleasant surroundings. The first category starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A beautiful route along the Vltava on a cycle path
A flat and fast course
Route from Braník to Vrané and back
additional: The race takes place on a flat cycle path that is suitable for fast times and personal bests. It is organized by VAŠE LIGA; Petra Lundák can be contacted. A relaxed atmosphere is guaranteed.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nepomuk
location: Sokolovna Nepomuk, Nepomuk, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nepomuk is a fun run with no racing, held on October 28. Routes are available for adults and children and run mainly along paved paths and roads through the town of Nepomuk. The event base is at the local Sokol grounds, where participants can collect their race pack and receive a beautiful medal shaped like the Republic after finishing. Sports activities are set up for children, and refreshments are available at the finish. Parking is available on nearby streets and in the gym’s parking lot.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along paved paths and roads through the town of Nepomuk
The route passes St. John of Nepomuk Church and crosses the Mihovka stream
The finish is at the Sokol gym, with a slight uphill section
additional: No finishing times are recorded, and no results list with rankings is produced. The race pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Sports activities for children are available at the event grounds. There is a place to leave belongings and refreshments. Parking is available on nearby streets and in the gym’s parking lot.

name: Provodovský běh
location: Provodov, Zlín District, Zlín Region, Czech Republic

description: The Provodov Run is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Provodov near Zlín. It offers three distances of 5, 11 and 21 kilometres, running mainly along field and forest paths. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in shorter age-based races free of charge. It is organised by UnArt Provodov, p.s., and takes place regardless of the weather, with an emphasis on safety and fair play. The start and registration are at Areál mládí and the FC Rak Provodov football pitch.
course_highlights: Trail race mainly along field and forest paths
Three distances: 5 km, 11 km and 21 km, with varying levels of difficulty
Free children’s races, with distances from 30 to 750 metres depending on age
additional: Race registration opens at 9:00 at Areál mládí. The race number must be clearly displayed on the chest. First aid is provided by members of the Czech Red Cross (ČČK). The race takes place regardless of the weather; only extreme conditions may cause it to be postponed or cancelled. The organiser reserves the right to change the programme and rules without prior notice.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Březník
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Březník is a fun run with no competition, held on October 28. The routes follow the Oslava and Chvojnice valleys, mostly on asphalt and forest paths with gentle descents and climbs. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children, so early online registration is required. Everyone can look forward to a beautiful republic-shaped medal at the finish and a race pack with gifts. The run takes place on the boundary of the Divoká Oslava National Nature Reserve, in a private area with open restrooms.
course_highlights: The route follows the Oslava and Chvojnice valleys on asphalt and forest paths
A challenging route with rugged terrain and a steep descent on the 6.2 km course
A run on the boundary of the Divoká Oslava National Nature Reserve
additional: No finish times are recorded, and no results list with rankings is produced. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children. The race pack contains a race number and gifts. A republic-shaped medal is awarded at the finish. Open restrooms are available. The route includes asphalt and unpaved forest paths, including a challenging section with a steep descent on the 6.2 km course.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Děčín
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Děčín is a traditional race held on 28 October to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The main race route is 5 km long and winds through the picturesque town, past the castle gardens and Mariánská louka, across the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and along the flat Elbe embankment, finishing by crossing Tyršův Bridge back to Smetanovo nábřeží. Children can choose between two distances: 5 km for older children and 1 km for the youngest, both following a similar route to the adults’ race. The event offers professional timing, a race pack, and a medal shaped like the country for all participants.
course_highlights: 5 km loop through the castle gardens and Mariánská louka
Cross the new bridge with views of the Elbe
Flat stretch along the Elbe embankment and crossing Tyršův Bridge
additional: The race is professionally timed. Every participant receives a medal shaped like the country at the finish. The race pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Online registration closed on 25 October.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Dolní Újezd
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Dolní Újezd is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race offers a main 8.9 km route through the countryside, with moderate elevation changes and a combination of asphalt and hard-packed farm roads. Children can choose flat 1.4 km routes based on their age categories. All participants receive a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Facilities with refreshments, changing rooms, and parking are available for runners’ comfort.
course_highlights: Main race route: 8.9 km with 112 m of elevation gain
A combination of asphalt and hard-packed farm roads
Children’s 1.4 km routes on a flat asphalt road
additional: Start and finish by the Sokol Hall in Dolní Újezd. Facilities include changing rooms, refreshments, and parking. Registered participants receive a race pack and medal. No timing system is used, but results and a winners’ ceremony are provided. On-site registration beyond the race capacity does not guarantee a medal or race pack.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Kutná Hora
location: Oleška, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, organized on October 28 by the Czech Sokol Association. In Kutná Hora, the run will take place for the first time, offering a sporting atmosphere and a chance to meet people with a connection to Sokol. The main race route is just under six kilometers long, with the start and finish at the Sokol gym, which provides facilities including changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments. The event is suitable for families and individuals, with an emphasis on safety and professional organization.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Sokol gym, with full facilities
Main race of just under 6 km in the beautiful surroundings of Kutná Hora
Children’s courses are safely routed within the grounds, with no need to cross roads
additional: The race capacity is set at approximately 155 runners to ensure quality organization and timekeeping. A team of volunteers is ready to help with course navigation and event organization. Facilities at the Sokol gym include changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments. The children’s courses are safely routed within the grounds so children do not have to cross roads.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Louňovice pod Blaníkem
location: Louňovice pod Blaníkem, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Louňovice pod Blaníkem is a traditional race held in honour of the founding of Czechoslovakia and takes place on 28 October. The 5.6 km main race starts from the square and passes through the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník, including its highest point, where the Chapel of St Mary Magdalene stands. The route combines paved sections with field and forest trails. At the finish, participants receive a beautiful medal shaped like the republic, and main-race entrants can enter a raffle. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series and is timed professionally.
course_highlights: The route passes through the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník
Run past the Chapel of St Mary Magdalene at the highest point of Malý Blaník
A mix of paved roads, field paths and forest trails
additional: The start and finish are on the square in Louňovice pod Blaníkem, in front of the chateau. A raffle for main-race entrants is held after the winners’ awards ceremony. Every participant receives a medal shaped like the republic at the finish. All races are timed professionally. The main race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Lužice
location: Lužice, Hodonín District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Lužice is a traditional race celebrating the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 27 October 2027. Runners follow paved paths and roads through a beautiful new park created after a tornado, past orchards and vineyards. Shorter routes for children are set up in the Sokol Hall grounds, which also provide changing rooms, showers and refreshments. At the finish, everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the country and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: The route passes through a new park created after a tornado
The route goes past orchards and vineyards around Strání
Paved paths and roads in Lužice
additional: The race is held without chip timing, but finish times are recorded and winners are announced. Changing rooms, toilets, showers and refreshments are available in the Sokol Hall grounds. Sports equipment and games are provided for children. Parking is available by the Sokol Hall and the Sports Hall.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Mníšek pod Brdy
location: Státní zámek Mníšek pod Brdy, Mníšek pod Brdy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Mníšek pod Brdy is a traditional race held in honor of the founding of Czechoslovakia. It takes place on October 28. The race starts by the state chateau and runs through the picturesque surroundings, including Sokol Hall on Vrška, ponds, and the U Káji Maříka Inn. There are various race distances for adults and children, with predominantly asphalt surfaces and easy courses. At the finish, all participants receive a beautiful medal in the shape of the republic, and a race pack with a race number and gifts is provided. The start area has tents for registration and changing, toilets, refreshments, and benches.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the state chateau in Mníšek pod Brdy
The route passes Sokol Hall on Vrška and ponds
The course is asphalt; children's loops are on a grassy area
additional: The event is held in RACE format without timing, but finish times are recorded and winners are announced. Parking, a bag drop, and a rest area are available at the start.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nový Bydžov
location: Nový Bydžov, Hradec Králové District, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nový Bydžov is a traditional race held on October 28 in honour of the founding of Czechoslovakia. The event offers routes for adults and children. The main adult race is 4.8 km long and runs partly through the town and partly along dirt roads, crossing two bridges over the Cidlina River. Shorter children’s races take place on the athletics track at the Sportring complex. At the finish, all participants receive a commemorative medal in the shape of the republic and a goody bag. The race takes place in live traffic, with organisers and volunteers stationed at intersections, and is suitable for runners of all categories.
course_highlights: 4.8 km route with 30% asphalt and 70% dirt roads
Cross the Cidlina River via two different bridges
The most challenging section is the uphill climb in the village of Humburky
additional: The race takes place in live traffic, with organisers at intersections and volunteers along the route. The lead runner is guided by a cyclist. Children’s races take place on the athletics track; times are not recorded, and placings are indicative. A goody bag and medal are included in the race. In bad weather, goody bags are handed out in the lobby of the Sokol hall; otherwise, distribution takes place outdoors by the clay court.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Uherský Brod
location: Uherský Brod, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Uherský Brod is a traditional race held in honor of the founding of Czechoslovakia, taking place on October 28. The race offers several routes for different age groups, including 5 km and 8 km races for adults and shorter races for children. The routes pass through the town center, residential neighborhoods, around a pond, and past allotment gardens. Timekeeping is professionally managed, and the fastest runners receive awards. Every participant receives a race pack and an original medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Participants under 18 may register only with the consent of a legal guardian. Registration is also available on site.
course_highlights: The 5 km route passes through the town center, residential neighborhoods, and around a pond
The 8 km route continues further into the countryside, passing a spring and an observatory
The start and finish are at the Sokol stadium, with professional timekeeping
additional: Race times are recorded by professional timekeepers. At the race facilities, every participant can collect a race pack containing a race number and gifts. A beautiful medal shaped like the republic awaits everyone at the finish. Participants under 18 may register only with the consent of a legal guardian. Registration is also available on site.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28 by the Czech Sokol Association. It draws inspiration from the historic 1919 relay race, “Rozestavný běh,” and has become a modern tradition that grows every year, connecting dozens of locations in Czechia and abroad. The race offers runners of all ages, including children, an opportunity to celebrate the founding of the republic through movement. The routes vary and often pass through both urban and natural areas, allowing participants to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of each location.
course_highlights: The route in Děčín passes through the castle gardens, Mariánská louka, the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and the flat Elbe riverbank
Children’s races have shorter routes, some of which follow the same route as the adult race
The routes are mostly flat, with varied sections and iconic landmarks in each city
additional: Registration is available online only and is valid once the entry fee has been paid. Children aged 15 to 18 may take part only in the main race. A race T-shirt can be purchased during registration and must be ordered by October 15. On-site registration is available only while capacity remains and does not include a race pack or a medal for late entrants. Races are divided into the BĚH, ZÁVOD, and VELKÝ ZÁVOD levels, each with different rules. In Děčín, times are recorded using professional timing, and participants receive a republic-shaped medal at the finish.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Milovice
location: Milovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Milovice is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28. The race offers an easy 5.8 km trail suitable for beginner and experienced runners, with a partly paved and road surface. Children can enjoy simple oval courses around Haken Stadium, with distances varying by age. At the finish, all participants receive a beautiful medal shaped like the republic and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: An easy 5.8 km trail with a partly paved and road surface
Children’s courses around Haken Stadium with an oval gravel surface
A course suitable for beginner and experienced runners; trail shoes are recommended
additional: The race pack includes a custom-designed bag featuring #SBR graphics, Halls Ice Team & Cola (adults only), and an original medal at the finish. On-site registration takes place at Haken Stadium, which also has changing facilities and restrooms. Parking is available near the stadium. For refreshments, you can visit the RKDM restaurant and Clock Cafe next to the stadium.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Písek
location: Palackého sady, Písek, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Písek is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 28 October. The race offers several routes for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults, and is part of the broader tradition of runs organised by the Czech Sokol Community. The route passes through the picturesque Palacký Gardens, across the Stone Bridge and along the river, with professional timing and awards for the fastest runners. Every participant receives a race pack and an original republic-shaped medal at the finish.
course_highlights: Start in Palacký Gardens by the music pavilion
Across the Stone Bridge and along the Otava River
The route crosses the footbridge to the right bank and returns to the Ševčík Pavilion
additional: The race pack includes a custom-designed bag featuring SBR graphics, a medal at the finish, and the option to order an official Alpine Pro T-shirt for an additional fee. The main race is limited to 180 runners. Registration and race-pack collection close at 11:45 for the children's routes and at 13:30 for the main race. Square, where participants can expect professional timekeeping, a race pack and a beautiful republic-shaped medal at the finish. Music, sports demonstrations and refreshments for runners and spectators add to the atmosphere. The route is flat, wide enough and safe, with no parked cars, making for a comfortable run through the historic centre of Prostějov.

A flat, sufficiently wide course with no parked cars

description: The DRESDEN-MARATHON has been held regularly in late October since 1999. It offers a flat, fast course through the Saxon state capital, passing its famous sights. The route goes through the historic Old Town, including Brühl’s Terrace, the Semper Opera House and other Baroque buildings, as well as the lively Neustadt district. More than 300 musicians and numerous bands create a special atmosphere along the course. The second half of the marathon runs through the Blasewitz district, with views of the palaces on the Loschwitz Elbe slope and the villas along Goetheallee, before returning to the Old Town along the Elbe.

Atmosphere created by more than 300 musicians and bands along the course

Alongside sporting ambition, the focus is on having fun amid the Franconian Forest’s romantically rugged natural scenery. The overall male and female winners of the main race receive prize money, and the club with the most participants receives a financial award.

In addition to individual rankings, there are group and team rankings, making the race particularly appealing to teams. The organizing team places great importance on professional delivery and continually improving the event.

The race takes place away from city streets in the Rantzauer Forst area and also offers walking and hiking events. With a modest field of usually 101 to 300 runners, the event has more of a club-run feel than that of a major race.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal Rantzauer Forst, away from city streets
5 km, 10 km and cross-country options
Modest field with a club-run atmosphere
additional: Results are published via race result; public start lists, photos, reports and historical rankings are available. In addition to the races, there are walking and hiking events, including a 5 km walk. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with rainy days. The event takes place in typical November weather, around 7°C and with rainy conditions. It is open to runners and walkers of all ages, with a modest participant count of between 101 and 300.

name: Neustädter Sparkassen Nachtlauf
location: Neustadt an der Aisch, Neustadt an der Aisch, Bavaria, Germany
organizer: Turn- und Sportverein 1861/08 Neustadt an der Aisch e.V.
description: The Sparkassen Night Run in Neustadt an der Aisch is a popular running event with several competitions, including a children’s run, fun run, Nordic walking and the main race. The event takes place in the town centre, with the start and finish at the town hall on the market square. It offers an attractive course that has been adapted to participants’ needs. Race numbers are available at the town hall, and showers and changing rooms are available at the TSV sports ground. The award ceremonies take place in the evening in front of the Sparkasse or at the town hall. Every participant receives a small thank-you bag at the finish.
course_highlights: The course runs through the town centre, with adjustments to avoid narrow sections
Start and finish at the town hall on the market square
Showers and changing rooms available at the TSV sports ground
additional: Late entries are accepted at the town hall until 30 minutes before the respective start, for a late-entry fee of 2€. Race-number distribution starts at 15:45 at the town hall. Jackets may be left at the town hall or in the Stadtwerke tent during the race, at the owner's own risk. For safety reasons, children start in staggered groups: boys 3 minutes before girls. Main-race prize money: 1st place 150€, 2nd place 100€, 3rd place 75€. Course changes are possible. Children’s-run course length: 1.7 km; main race: 4 laps; fun run: 2 laps. The event takes place in the town of Neustadt an der Aisch, with the start and finish near the Neustadthalle and at the town hall on the market square.

name: Tiergarten-Cross
description: The Tiergarten Cross in Schleswig is a local cross-country race taking place on November 1, 2026. The event offers two main distances, 4.4 km and 8.8 km, which start one after the other so the fields are separate. The course is undulating and demands constant changes of pace, making the race varied. In addition to the main races, there are also children’s and youth races, making the event family-friendly and diverse.
course_highlights: Finishes in Tiergarten Schleswig, the most distinctive point on the course
Undulating course with constant small changes of pace
Separate start times for the 4.4 km and 8.8 km distances
additional: The event also includes children’s and youth races. Typical November weather in Schleswig is cool, with daytime highs of around 7 °C, and rainy on most days. The event takes place in Tiergarten Schleswig, is weather-dependent (November is usually rainy), and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various race categories.

name: Winterlaufserie 2026/2027, 1. Wertungslauf
description: The Winter Run Series in Hamm is a long-standing winter road-running series, now taking place for the 51st time. The first scoring race covers a distance of 15 km on roads outside the stadium. The event attracts many club runners from Westphalia and beyond, including teams from Dortmund, Münster and Bielefeld. The race offers a challenging course in the cool November weather and is a popular start to the winter season for runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: 15 km road race outside the stadium
A field with a strong club-running presence from Westphalia and the surrounding area
Typically cool and rainy November weather
additional: The starting location is Ahnatal. The average November temperature is around 7°C, with frequent rain (approximately 45 mm of precipitation). The event is part of the Winter Run Series, which may take place in typical weather of around 7°C with rain. It is the series’ first scoring race and appeals to runners from various regions.

name: Motolské jamky
location: Golfový areál Golf Club Praha, Motol, Praha, Czech Republic
price_range: 600 Kč (10 km), 500 Kč (5 km), 100 Kč (dětský závod)
description: Trail Running Cup – Run Across Motol Pits is a running race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Golf Club Praha golf course in Motol. The race gives runners the chance to enjoy challenging trail terrain in Prague 5, with beautiful views and a natural atmosphere. The event is part of the Trail Running Cup series and is suitable for everyone who loves running in nature. The race traditionally starts at 9:00.
course_highlights: Trail run at the Golf Club Praha grounds in Motol
Natural, varied terrain with views
Location in Prague 5 with good accessibility
additional: Registration, race details and results are available at the external link https://tech.orgsu.org/Site/SG/3. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series, which features other races throughout the year. The trail courses include the golf course; registration closes 30 minutes before the start, and parking is available directly at the venue.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - listopad
description: The Olomouc 2 Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and competing primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age-grading coefficient and runners collecting points throughout the year. On-site registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and the race starts in the morning. The race is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has supported the running community for more than 35 years.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
Suitable for all ages and running abilities
Picturesque setting by the park fountain
additional: On-site registration is from 9:30 to 10:00. The start is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. The race is part of a year-long cup competition, with points calculated using an age-grading coefficient. It is part of the Olomouc 2-mile race series, takes place on a paved course, registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and it is suitable for all age groups and running abilities.

description: The HRUŠTICE Road Race – Zdeněk Drobník Memorial is a traditional race with a history dating back to 1974. Since 2024, it has been run on a new 10 km course through the Jizera Valley. This popular autumn event attracts runners from across the surrounding area each year and offers beautiful views and an atmosphere shaped by local history and traditions. The start and race facilities are in Turnov, with chip timing and professional organization. After the race, prizes are raffled, traditionally including regional semi-precious stones.
course_highlights: New 10 km course through the Jizera Valley
Beautiful views from the plateau above Turnov
Traditional prizes featuring regional semi-precious stones
additional: All categories start together. Registration and race-number pickup take place from 08:30 to 10:00. On-site registration is available until 10:00 for a higher entry fee. After the race, race numbers are entered into a prize draw. Race facilities are located in the AC Turnov athletics clubroom at Ludvík Daněk Stadium. The race is part of a long-running series and offers various age categories. Registration and results are managed by STOPNI TO s.r.o. The race takes place on a road course and is open to runners of all levels.

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful natural surroundings along the Berounka, motivating runners of all levels to exercise regularly. The race in Beroun, held on November 2, 2026, is a night stage through the Křivoklát forests, with views of the surrounding area and a final descent from the Děd lookout tower to the finish. The route is well marked and offers beautiful natural scenery, refreshments, and baggage storage. The series is suitable for experienced runners as well as beginners who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Night stage requiring a headlamp
The route runs through the Křivoklát forests, with views by the walnut-tree avenue
A challenging climb to the Děd lookout tower, followed by a descent back to the finish with views of Beroun
additional: Every participant receives a race number. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. Bringing a headlamp for the night run is recommended. The top three finishers in each category receive diplomas. Night stage, trail run, marked routes, views of the surrounding area, on-site registration, start no later than 17:45, refreshments and baggage storage, winners’ awards by category, headlamp required.

description: Gorlicki Mountain Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque Low Beskids, near Radocyna and Wysowa-Zdrój. The race offers three distances: 8.2 km, 24.4 km, and a Vertical race to Magura Małastowska. The courses feature significant elevation gain and beautiful views, and the participant limit is strictly controlled, ensuring an intimate atmosphere. The organizers provide professional race services, awards ceremonies, and cash prizes. Taking part is an excellent opportunity to test your strength on mountain terrain.
course_highlights: 24.4 km course with 610 m of elevation gain
8.2 km course with 160 m of elevation gain
2.3 km Vertical race with 340 m of elevation gain to Magura Małastowska
additional: Participant limits: 24 km — 250 people, 8 km — 150 people, Vertical — 150 people. The start and finish for the 8 km and 24 km races are at the State Forests Centre in Radocyna; the Vertical race starts at Magura Ski Park / Małastów. Time limits: 5 hours for 24 km, 1 hour for the Vertical. Entry fee refunds are available until 31.10.2027. Race bibs must be visible on the front of shirts or shorts.

name: 20 Gminne Biegi z okazji Święta Niepodległości
Heiner-Mayr-Staffelberglauf
description: The Heiner Mayr Staffelberg Relay is a challenging mountain relay taking place on November 7, 2026, in Bad Staffelstein. Organized by TSV 1860 Staffelstein e.V. with support from Sparkasse Coburg-Lichtenfels, the route covers 3,960 meters and 260 meters of elevation gain, from the start on Hirtengasse-Horsdorfer Straße up to the Staffelberg plateau at the Adelgundis Chapel. Runners can expect a challenging race with impressive views across the Franconian countryside. The race pays tribute to decades of dedication to running in the region.
course_highlights: 3,960-meter course with 260 meters of elevation gain
Start on Hirtengasse-Horsdorfer Straße in Bad Staffelstein
Finish on the Staffelberg plateau at the Adelgundis Chapel, with panoramic views
additional: Mountain relay, starts at 2 p.m., finish on the Staffelberg plateau, registration until November 6, 2026, open to all age groups

name: Internationaler Fackellauf
description: The 45th International Torch Run in Rodenbach takes place on November 7, 2026, and offers a challenging 7 km course for adults. The course is a hilly loop with a total of 92 metres of ascent and descent, appealing to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers alike. In addition to the main event, there are also races for children and young people; details can be found in the organizer’s official race announcement. The start is at 18:00, and all events share the same finish.
course_highlights: 7 km hilly loop
92 metres of ascent and descent
Very challenging, hilly course
additional: Races for children and young people are offered; see the organizer’s official race announcement for details. All events share the same finish location. The exact finish location display requires RUNME Premium. The event takes place on November 7, 2026, starting at 18:00, with accommodation options near the start and finish area. The event is part of the Red Cross’s international humanitarian commitment, conveying a message of hope and peace.

name: Limes- Winterlaufserie - 1. Lauf über 10 km
description: The Limes Winter Running Series is a three-part winter running series in Pohlheim. The first race, a 10 km run, forms the basis for the overall standings. The series attracts runners from the region, particularly from the Lahn-Dill district, and has a long tradition, with its 49th edition taking place in 2026. The race offers a great opportunity to compete with other runners during the colder months and kick off the winter running series.
course_highlights: 10 km run through Pohlheim, Watzenborn-Steinberg
Part of a three-race winter running series
Popular race with regional participation, particularly from the Lahn-Dill district
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, usually rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Please check the details with the organizer before registering. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge in a wintry atmosphere. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and also provides results and participant lists.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim
description: The Rodgau Winter Running Series is a traditional running event that has been held in Rodgau since 1980, attracting recreational runners as well as top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series features four race dates, each with 5 km and 10 km routes through the Jügesheim Forest, described as fast and flat. The event takes place at the Maingau-Energie Stadium in Rodgau Jügesheim and offers team rankings for men’s, women’s and mixed teams. The organization receives high praise, and there is a COVID-safe outdoor changing area. Timing is handled with a bib chip.
course_highlights: A flat, fast route through the Jügesheim Forest
Event held at the Maingau-Energie Stadium in Rodgau Jügesheim
Team rankings for men’s, women’s and mixed teams
additional: Start times: 5 km at 14:00, 10 km at 15:00. Chip timing using a bib chip (gun-time recording). The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. Club members receive a 50% discount on the entry fee when registering by email. Payment is in cash on site. There is a COVID-safe outdoor changing area (covered). The route is very popular for personal bests. The event takes place on four Saturdays: 1.11.2025, 6.12.2025, 3.1.2026, 7.2.2026. The series comprises several races, with chip timing and refreshments at the stadium. Teams of three are possible. The event is also geared toward winter training, with training plans provided.

name: 14. Sollingquerung
description: The Solling Crossing is a unique run from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen, taking place on November 7, 2026. The course is run exclusively by GPS, as it is not marked, making the event particularly challenging and exciting. The field is limited to 100 participants, creating a friendly atmosphere. The start is at 9:00 a.m., after runners are taken by bus from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen at 7:45 a.m. A tip for runners: anyone who completes the marathon distance at the Solling Run on June 6, 2026, is guaranteed a starting place in the Solling Crossing.
course_highlights: Course from Bad Karlshafen to Dassel
No course markings; GPS navigation only
Aid stations along the course
additional: Start at 9:00 a.m. after the 7:45 a.m. bus ride from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen. Field limited to 100 participants. No course markings; GPS navigation only. Tip: A starting place is guaranteed to participants in the Solling Run marathon on June 6, 2026. The course is unmarked, GPS navigation is required, November weather may bring rain and temperatures of around 2–7°C, no on-site entries are possible, and the event sells out quickly.

name: 6. Weserbergland Backyard Ultra
description: The Weserbergland Backyard Ultra Run is a unique ultrarunning event in Höxter, North Rhine-Westphalia, held every year in November. Participants run a lap of about 6.7 kilometers every hour until only one runner remains. The race stands out for its distinctive challenge and the camaraderie among runners. The event is known for its demanding course and the impressive performances of participants, who often run for many hours and cover many kilometers.
course_highlights: A course of approximately 6.7 km per lap
A loop course with challenging climbs on the Heiligenberg
A run through varied terrain in the Weserbergland
additional: The race traditionally starts at 10 a.m. Registration usually fills up quickly, and the field often reaches capacity early. There is currently no waiting list. The event is organized by TuS Lütmarsen e. V. Participant numbers are limited to ensure the quality and safety of the event. It is one of Germany's last major Backyard events of the year, with typical November weather and long nights. Registration opens on 1 May 2026.

name: Heseper Martinslauf
description: The Hesepe Martinslauf is a popular athletics competition in Groß-Hesepe, held annually in November. Organized by SV Groß Hesepe, it offers various categories for children, young people, adults and masters. The event includes races of approximately 8,870 m and 3,000 m, as well as competitions for children and young people, offering both an athletic challenge and a community experience. After the race, participants can look forward to a sociable atmosphere with refreshments and special activities.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in the natural surroundings of Groß-Hesepe
Routes of approximately 8,870 m and 3,000 m
A variety of categories for all age groups
additional: The event takes place in November, with registration by email and various competition classes for children, young people, adults and masters. After the race, there is often a sociable gathering with refreshments.

name: Pokallauf
description: The “Rund um Marienberg” Cup Race is a traditional running event held in the Marienberg region. Competitions are held in classic and freestyle technique, with distances of 5 km and 10 km, each run on a 2.5 km loop. The event offers runners of various age groups and ability levels a sporting challenge in a scenic setting. Due to the current snow conditions, technical and course adjustments may affect how the competition is run.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances on a 2.5 km loop
Classic technique for U6–U9; freestyle technique from U10
New 10 km distance from H21
additional: The event is organized by ATSV Gebirge/Gelobtland e.V. The event announcement will not be updated. Competition technique depends on age group: U6–U9 use classic technique with a mass start; U10 and older use freestyle technique with a mass start. Depending on snow conditions, the route may vary, with adjustments to technique and distance. It is a popular event for runners seeking nature and a challenge.

name: SCC Cross Country
description: The SCC Cross Country is a forest race in Berlin at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage in Westend. Two clearly defined cross-country routes are offered: 4 km for U16 through adults and 9 km for U18 through adults; both races start in the morning. The event is deliberately straightforward and is aimed at club runners, young athletes and adults who want to run short off-road loops, setting it apart from the city’s major road races. The course follows paved and unpaved forest paths, where rhythm, sure footing and a fast finish matter more than scenic views. Awards go to the top three in each age and gender category, and there is a prize for the fastest final lap for men and women.
course_highlights: Forest race on paved and unpaved forest paths
Two routes: 4 km for U16 through adults, 9 km for U18 through adults
Focus on rhythm, sure footing and a fast finish
additional: Entry is free for SCC members. Late registration is available shortly before the start for an additional fee. An archive of results is available to document the race. The event takes place at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage on Harbigstraße in Westend, Berlin-Charlottenburg. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with rainy days. Forest race on paved and unpaved forest paths, entry fee for non-members, late registration for an additional fee, November weather around 7 °C, rainy.

name: Schkölener Stadtparklauf
description: The Schkölen Stadtparklauf is a long-standing running event in Schkölen, Thuringia, taking place on November 7, 2026. Organized by TSV 1885 Schkölen and SSV Friedrich-Schiller-Gymnasium Eisenberg, the event offers various distances for children, teenagers, and young adults. The routes run through the town park and include short and long loops, combined according to age group. The event emphasizes clear age-group divisions and is aimed particularly at young runners.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.6 km to 5 km, tailored to age groups
Loops through the town park, combining short and long loops
Age groups determined by calendar year for fair competitions
additional: Age groups are determined by calendar year; for example, a 6-year-old runner in 2025 belongs to age group 6. Participants are asked to enter the correct age group when registering late. Various running distances, age-group divisions, registration with the correct age, looped running on the sports field

name: Sparkassen-LüneCross
description: The Sparkassen-LüneCross is an exciting and challenging cross-country running event set amid nature and the city of Lüneburg. The varied course follows sandy, root-covered trails, meadows, forest paths and gravel tracks, testing endurance, strength and running technique. Main races are offered over 4 km and 8 km, along with shorter distances for children and young people and 8 km relay races. Alongside the sporting challenge, the focus is on the enjoyment of running and community, with a school competition and a convivial awards ceremony afterwards.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with sandy, root-covered trails
Routes through meadows, forest paths and gravel tracks
8 km relay races can be run by teams of 3 to 6 runners
additional: There is a school competition with prizes for schools with the highest participation rate. Food and refreshments are available, followed by an awards ceremony and a convivial get-together. Relay teams of 3 to 6 runners can be formed from family, colleagues, teammates or friends. The route passes through natural surroundings, including forest paths, meadows, sand and gravel. Registration is required; family and group participation is possible.

The event has three distances: 2.5 km, 10 km, and 300 m for children, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy running surrounded by the community.
course_highlights: Course in Jonava
Distances: 2.5 km, 10 km, and 300 m for children
Suitable for participants of all ages
additional: The event date is November 7, 2026, and it is a popular annual running event in Jonava.

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Winter Running Series 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series connected with the traditional Rund um Wellen event. It is organized by the local running club, which also runs the historic Wellen Marathon, one of the oldest marathons in Germany. The event offers a welcoming, family atmosphere, various distance options, and strong local support from volunteers, sponsors, and the local fire brigade. The organizers aim to preserve the event’s well-established challenge and familiar character.
course_highlights: Part of the long-standing Rund um Wellen event, with four distances
Rural, family-friendly atmosphere, organized by a local club
Strong local support from volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather: average 7 °C (minimum 2 °C) with frequent rain (45 mm of precipitation). Start location: Beverstedt-Wellen. Terrain: mixed. Registration: not specified. Further notes: Part of the Rund um Wellen event, with local support and volunteers involved.

name: Bibersfelder Herbstlauf
description: The Bibersfeld Autumn Run is part of the "Stadtwerke - Läuft bei dir" running series and offers suitable routes for runners of all ages. The event features varied courses, with the classic 10-kilometer run at its heart. Participants can look forward to a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere, and both individual runners and teams are welcome. All finishers receive certificates and gifts, while younger runners also receive medals. Registration is online only, and late registration is possible up to 45 minutes before the start.
course_highlights: Classic 10-kilometer run
Family-friendly event with routes for all ages
Part of the regional "Stadtwerke - Läuft bei dir" running series
additional: Late registration is possible up to 45 minutes before the start. Certificates are provided digitally and can be printed at the venue or conveniently at home. The Cup Quartet awards ceremony takes place after the fourth race in Bibersfeld, from approximately 14:00. Various running and walking distances, online-only registration, certificates can be printed at the venue or at home, including a 10-kilometer run and a half marathon.

name: Hohen Neuendorfer Herbstlauf
description: The Hohen Neuendorf Autumn Run is a traditional running event that has been held in Hohen Neuendorf since 1900 and is considered the birthplace of cross-country running in Germany. The run attracts numerous participants from the region and beyond each year and offers distances for all age groups, from a children’s run to longer distances. The event brings generations together and is supported by many volunteers and local partners. It traditionally takes place in November and is a fixture on the regional sporting calendar.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country run with a history dating back to 1900
Participants spanning generations, from age 3 to over 90
Support from local clubs and reservists along the course
additional: The run includes various distances, including a 400-metre children’s run and a 5.5 km course. The event is supported by many volunteers, including the Roter Adler Reservists from Lehnitz. The Autumn Run is one of the largest running events in the Oberhavel district and attracts participants from various regions. It takes place at the Rudolf Harbig sports ground and is weather-dependent. Registration is via MyRacepartner. The event is known for its historical significance in cross-country running in Germany and promotes a sense of community through sport.

name: Lop dwasch dörn Wildenloh
location: Wildenloh bei Oldenburg, Landkreis Oldenburg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: Lop dwasch dörn Wildenloh is a traditional cross-country run held in early November on the beautiful fitness trail in Wildenloh, west of Oldenburg. The name means “Run across Wildenloh” and reflects the event’s rustic character: it takes place in the forest, without showers. The event is organised by the sports club Team Laufrausch e.V., which creates a friendly, nature-oriented running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on the local fitness trail in Wildenloh
Rustic forest course without showers
Traditional event with regional character
additional: The run takes place on a rustic forest course without showers. Several distances are offered (short course: 1600m, middle course: 3200m), and results from previous years are available. The event is organised by the sports club Team Laufrausch e.V. The run is held annually in November. There are no showers on site, results are published, and categories include children and adults.

name: Obersulmer Volkslauf
description: The Obersulm Fun Run takes place on November 8, 2026, around Lake Breitenau and offers runners of all ages an appealing running experience. The event includes various distances, such as the 10 km main race, the 5 km fun run, and walking and Nordic walking routes. The course is scenically attractive, with moderate elevation changes, and is accompanied by enthusiastic spectators. Its friendly atmosphere and professional organization make the fun run a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Breitenau
5 km course with a starting elevation of 227 m and an elevation of 233 m
Attractive course with gravel and crushed-stone surfaces
additional: Professional timing using a transponder in the race bib. Bib must be worn on the front. Medals for Bambinis and schoolchildren at the finish. description: What sets the Nieuchwytni Run apart from other events is its regionally unique “moving finish line” format. Participants do not run toward a designated point; instead, they try to stay ahead of the pursuit team for as long as possible. The runners will start at 10:00, and exactly 15 minutes later the “finish line” will set off along the course—a cyclist and a car equipped with professional timing equipment. The moment these vehicles overtake a runner marks the end of their race, and their result is recorded. The pursuit team will gradually increase its speed, from an initial 15 km/h to 35 km/h in the final stage of the race.

name: II Bieg Transgranicznej Przyjaźni
description:
A 5-kilometre main race, a Nordic walking event over the same distance, and shorter races for children in the Young Athlete Zone. The event opens the Polish-Czech Grand Prix series, which concludes a month later in Ludgeřovice.

Course: moderately easy, with a new route this year

We have changed the route compared with the first edition. Four kilometres now run along Teligi and Czarnieckiego streets—on asphalt, with plenty of space and no tight turns. It’s a stretch where you can keep a steady pace from start to finish.

Only the final kilometre goes through post-mining areas. The surface gets uneven, but it’s just five minutes of running—and also the most interesting part of the course. You run through a part of Silesia that is coming back to life.

The total elevation gain is 18 metres, spread across the whole distance. There are no climbs that disrupt your rhythm. It’s a good course for your first-ever five kilometres, and a fair one for anyone looking to test their time—as long as you save some strength for the finish.
additional:
The event is part of the “Pink October” campaign and promotes breast cancer prevention. It is organised by the “Srebrne Nici” Association, with the Czech club BK Ludgeřovice as its partner.

name: XXV Bieg Sobiborski "Ocalić od zapomnienia - uczyć dla przyszłości"
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Włodawie
description: The start is at 12:00 by the Sobibór Museum and Memorial to the Victims, on county road No. 1727L along the Żłobek–Sobibór–Wołczyny section. After approximately 300 m, runners cross the tracks of railway line No. 81 Chełm–Włodawa and run to provincial road 816. They then follow provincial road 816 towards Włodawa. After approximately 8.5 km, runners cross the tracks of railway line No. 81 Chełm–Włodawa again and run through the village of Orchówek to Włodawa, continuing along Okunińska Street, Rynek Street and J. Piłsudski Avenue, with the finish at 4 Szkolna Street.
additional:
“There are places in our country marked especially by the blood of thousands of victims murdered in the cruellest way and in the name of the most despicable of ideologies—the ideology of hatred. One such place is Sobibór, where, in just over a dozen months (1942–1943), the Nazis managed to murder approximately a quarter of a million people, especially people of Jewish nationality.”

The race is an unusual history lesson for society. It contributes to achieving sporting goals and also helps instil in the younger generation a remembrance of the tragic history of the extermination camp in Sobibór.

name: 50. Hermann-Löns-Park-Lauf
location: Hermann-Löns-Park, Hannover-Wülferode, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Hermann-Löns-Park Run in Hannover-Kirchrode is a traditional road and fun run held annually in early November. The event offers various distances from 400 m to 10 km, officially measured and approved by the German Athletics Association. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, volunteer support, and professional timekeeping. Runners can enjoy a raffle and refreshments in the finish area, making it a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses in accordance with German Athletics Association standards
Run through Hermann-Löns-Park in Hannover-Kirchrode
Various distances from 400 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible on site on Saturday from 14:00 to 16:00 and on Sunday from 9:00 until 45 minutes before the start. Race numbers can be collected on both days. Electronic timekeeping is used, with results recorded via race number. Spikes are not allowed and may lead to disqualification. The event takes place in all weather conditions. A €2 deposit for the race number is payable at registration. Courses from 1.5 km to 10 km, marathon relay, registration and results online

name: Braunschweiger Speed5
description: Braunschweiger Speed5 is the fastest fun run in the city of Braunschweig, organised by Polizeisportverein Braunschweig and Braunschweiger Laufclub. The running event on November 8, 2026, offers exciting races for recreational and competitive runners of all ages, including an 800 m children’s race, a 1-mile schoolchildren’s race and a measured 5 km race. The event features professional chip timing, a clear cutoff time for the fast 5 km race, and a friendly atmosphere with refreshments at the finish and music. Awards ceremonies recognise the top female and male runners in various age groups and main races.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course with a 22-minute cutoff in the fast race
800 m children’s race and 1-mile schoolchildren’s race
Professional chip timing and awards for top finishers
additional: Race bib collection starts at 09:15 on the grounds of Polizeisportverein. Refreshments are available for runners at the finish, with musical entertainment by DJ Carlito. Paramedics will be on site for safety. A pacemaker will be available in the slower 5 km race to help runners achieve times under 20 minutes. Certificates can be accessed online or on site after the race. Course: measured 5 km, children’s and schoolchildren’s races. Registration via RaceResults. Parking is available along Georg-Westermann-Allee and Ebertallee. The event takes place in Prinzenpark.

name: Lauf am Lech - 2. Lauf der Jedermannserie
description: The Lauf am Lech is the second race in the Jedermann series by LG Donau-Ries, an autumn running series in the Donau-Ries region of Bavaria. The race takes place at Georg-Weber-Stadion in Rain and offers 3 km and 10 km courses. The series caters to both recreational and experienced runners and moves from town to town, with each race held at a different venue. Race numbers are equipped with transponders and must be collected at least 20 minutes before the start. Online pre-registration is recommended to avoid waiting on race day.
course_highlights: Start at Georg-Weber-Stadion in Rain
3 km and 10 km course distances
Part of a multi-race series through different towns in Donau-Ries
additional: Race numbers with transponders; collection at least 20 minutes before the start; online pre-registration recommended to avoid queues on race day. Participants can pre-register online; the series visits several towns in the region; November weather is usually rainy.

name: Lauf Rund um den Höglwörther See
description: The Run Around Höglwörther See is a traditional race in Teisendorf, featuring a scenic route around Lake Höglwörth. The event offers several distances, including a 13 km race, a 4.2 km charity run, and Bambini and kids’ races. The atmosphere is shaped by a strong sense of community, live music, and excellent refreshments at the finish. The event also supports regional fundraising projects and fosters team spirit through team rankings.
course_highlights: 13 km route around Lake Höglwörther See through picturesque scenery
4.2 km charity run on a loop around the outskirts of Teisendorf
Bambini and kids’ races on child-friendly routes in the town centre
additional: Race-number collection from 08:30 in the Teisendorf sports hall, near the start and finish. Timing is done using a disposable transponder attached to the race number. There is a refreshment station along the route and a free refreshment stand at the finish with tea, coffee, water, fruit, and cake. Live music along the route and a DJ/announcer at the finish. Team ranking for clubs and companies, with special prizes and a brewery tour for the winning team. Late entries are possible on race day until 11:00 (for an additional fee). Terrain/charity run/community event, distances of 4.2 km and 13 km, start at the Teisendorf sports hall

name: Mausebergecrosslauf
description: The Mauseberge Cross-Country Run is an autumn cross-country race held in the Mauseberge Forest near Husum in northern Germany. The course follows natural forest trails over uneven terrain, with mud and several climbs. The event is organized by the athletics department of Husumer Sportverein and is a long-standing fixture on the regional race calendar.
course_highlights: Natural forest trails in the Mauseberge Forest
Uneven, muddy terrain
Several climbs
additional: The start is in Husum, and the venue can be reached by car. Typical November weather averages 7 °C (minimum 2 °C), with frequent rain (about 45 mm of precipitation). The race takes place in November in typical autumn weather, with temperatures around 2–7 °C and rain. Registration with the organizer is recommended. Places are available for various distances, including 1 km, 3.35 km, 5 km, 6.67 km, and 8.33 km.

name: Quickborn Run über 5 km und 10 km
description: The Quickborn Run is organized by TuS Holstein Quickborn and will be held for the 47th time in 2026. There are two race distances, 5 km and 10 km, starting in Quickborn on November 8. Childcare is available for families with young children, allowing parents to take part as well. The event offers changing facilities, free parking and a free timing chip on loan. The races are open to young people aged 12 and 14 and up, respectively, and follow the rules of the German Athletics Regulations.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km race routes
Start and finish at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Gymnasium in Quickborn
Free timing chip on loan
additional: Start times: 10:00 a.m. for the 5 km race, 11:00 a.m. for the 10 km race. Race pack collection from 8:00 to 10:30 a.m. at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Gymnasium. Changing facilities in the sports hall. Free parking at the sports hall and in the AKN station parking garage. Participation from age 12 for the 5 km and age 14 for the 10 km. Registration opens on 1.7.2026 via the Race Result portal. Late registration is possible on the day of the event, but participant numbers are limited, particularly for the 5 km race. Distances: 5 km and 10 km; minimum ages: 12 for the 5 km and 14 for the 10 km; limited places; parking at the sports hall and AKN station parking garage.

name: Wernigeröder Armeleuteberglauf
description: The Wernigeröder Armeleuteberglauf is a challenging trail race in November that starts and finishes at Haus Blume in Wernigerode. The route takes runners to the Kaiserturm and offers a varied challenge, with narrow forest paths, muddy sections and steep climbs. In addition to the main races over 5.4 km and 10 km, there are also children’s races over 1 km and 2.1 km. The event is organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V. Wernigerode and, with around 160 participants, is a popular local tradition that also includes a pasta party on the evening before the race.
course_highlights: Trail race on narrow forest paths
Steep climbs to the Kaiserturm
Muddy and fast downhill sections
additional: The event has four distances: 1 km and 2.1 km for children, and 5.4 km and 10 km for the main races, which start together later in the morning. A pasta party on the evening before the race is a small local tradition. Trail character with challenging climbs; registration by email; pasta party on Saturday evening at Waldgasthaus Armeleuteberg.

name: 2. Paradieslauf Weimar West
description:
We invite you to the west of Weimar!

A fast, scenic course and a wonderful sense of community await you!

All proceeds go to a good cause!

Bambini races
Children’s races
Beginner’s race (3.5 km)
Relay race (3 x 3.5 km)
Main race (10 km)
