name: Stadtparkstaffelmarathon
description:
All information about the 2024 Stadtpark Relay Marathon organized by the marathon department of FC St. Pauli von 1910 e.V.

Date: Sunday, 04 October 2026, 10:00 a.m. (finish cutoff: 3:00 p.m.)

Start / finish: “Jahnkampfbahn” (stadium), Stadtpark, Linnering 3, 22299 Hamburg

Course and format: Relay race, 5 participants per team—women’s, men’s, mixed (at least 2 women). Each team member runs two laps of 4.2 km each on paths in the western part of Stadtpark (around the planetarium). Course marshals will be present. A detailed course map can be viewed at the end of the page.

Registration: by email to staffelmarathon@marathon.fcstpauli.com

Registration deadline: 20.09.2026

Required information: First and last names of all relay team members, the relay team’s name, and whether the team is a women’s, men’s, or mixed team.

name: Běh na Dobrošov
location: Náchod-Běloves, Náchod, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Dobrošov is a public uphill race with a mass start, held in Náchod-Běloves in the Hradec Králové Region. The race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and gives athletes the chance to test themselves on a challenging uphill course. It is organized by the Redpoint Teplice nad Metují club and is popular with runners who enjoy challenges in a natural setting. Runners of all ages and ability levels traditionally take part.
course_highlights: Uphill race with a mass start
Challenging course through the natural surroundings of Náchod-Běloves
Part of the Běžecké vršky series
additional: This is a public mountain race with various categories, including historical information about the race and related events.

name: Běh Labským údolím
location: Dolní Žleb, Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: LABÁCI (Děčínský horolezecký oddíl a Klub orientačního běhu Děčín)
description: The Run through the Elbe Valley is a traditional autumn running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Žleb, near Děčín. The race offers routes of various lengths, running mainly along forest roads and trails over varied terrain. It is organised by the Labáci group, which continues the long-standing tradition of local organisers. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including veterans and youth.
course_highlights: 16 km main course and 8 km shorter course over varied terrain
Mostly forest roads and trails
Picturesque autumn setting in the Elbe Valley
additional: Race-day check-in takes place from 10:45 at the “U Kosti” pub in Dolní Žleb. Travelling to the race by train is recommended. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup. Registration will open during spring 2026. Registration runs until 30 October 2025; the start is scheduled for 1 November at 12:00, with check-in until 10:45. Train transport from Děčín is available.

name: TRAIL LÁZNĚ VELICHOVKY
location: Lázně Velichovky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Lázně Velichovky is the third edition of an autumn trail race in the historic spa town of Velichovky. It offers varied and beautiful running terrain, with the start and finish on the spa colonnade, where covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant are available. The race is complemented by spa amenities, including a café, and offers original medals, gifts and a race pack. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for all lovers of trail running and spa surroundings.
course_highlights: The most colourful autumn running terrain
Start and finish on the spa colonnade
Covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant
additional: The race includes an original medal, race pack, electronic timing chip, refreshments during the race and at the finish, changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, medical services and an accompanying programme. Gladiator Race clothing is also available for purchase, and parking is available near the event centre. Online registration via reg-sportvisio.cz, medals, chip timing, course photos, certificates, refreshments and spa services.

name: Jizerun
location: stadion Čelákovice, Čelákovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: přátelé a sportovní nadšenci z Hitgymu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: RUN AND FUN - pouze do 31. 8. 2026 nebo do vyprodání kapacity.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: NO FUN, JUST RUN - pouze do 24. 10. 2026 nebo do vyprodání kapacity.

description: Jizerun is a relay race connecting Prague and the Jizera Mountains. Teams of 4–5 runners cover a total of 164 km along cycle paths and Jizera Mountain trails in a single day. The race offers a unique team experience, with a choice of two entry packages featuring different benefits such as a sports T-shirt, headband, evening buffet and finisher medals. The event is open to men’s, women’s, mixed and corporate relay teams and is supported by general partner Metrostav a.s.
course_highlights: 164 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains
A combination of cycle paths and Jizera Mountain trails
Relays for teams of 4–5, with each runner completing at least 3 legs
additional: Entry packages are for teams of 5. The RUN&FUN package includes T-shirts, headbands, a buffet dinner, finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking and a finisher party with live music. The NO FUN, JUST RUN package includes finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking and a finisher party. Facilities and services include mobile toilets, showers at the finish, medical services, an announcer and full event support. When registering, the captain’s details must be provided; team members and T-shirt sizes can be added later. Each team member must run at least 3 legs, and only one car per team is allowed. The race supports a fundraiser for hospice and hospice care in the Czech Republic. Registration opens in April 2026.

name: Běh kolem Práchně
description: Běh kolem Práchně is a traditional running race in Horažďovice, offering a 9.5 km course. Since 2024, the updated route has followed the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit. The start and finish are located in front of Envicentrum PROUD, which provides runners with facilities including changing rooms, toilets and refreshments. The results are announced at approximately 12:00 after the race. The event is organized by DDM Horažďovice and KČT Horažďovice, who ensure a pleasant atmosphere and a smooth event.
course_highlights: The 9.5 km course follows the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit
Start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD, with full facilities
A mixed-type race in the picturesque surroundings of Horažďovice
additional: The results are announced at approximately 12:00 at Envicentrum PROUD, where refreshments, changing rooms and toilets are available. The course follows the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit, with the start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD and refreshments and facilities available after the race.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - listopad
description: The 2 Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is welcomed at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their effort.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit, just under two laps long (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children up to 12 years old (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in both adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start include by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). Races take place on the first Saturday of every month, start at 9:00, and registration is from 8:15 to 8:55; you can arrive by bike, on foot, by car, or by trolleybus. The course is a precisely measured asphalt circuit; the main course is 3.2 km long and the children's course is 800 m long.

name: Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka - Běžecký festival Otrokovice 2026
description: The Otrokovice Running Festival is a traditional sporting event offering a wide range of races, including a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, decamarathon and youth races. The MUDr. Josef Podmolík Memorial is the flagship half-marathon race, held in the beautiful surroundings of Otrokovice. Runners can enjoy a well-maintained course with electronic timing and the atmosphere of a running festival with a varied program for all age groups. Race check-in and the awards ceremony take place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and marathon courses in Otrokovice with chip timing
A 4.2195 km decamarathon loop
Youth races over various distances from 200 m to 1,700 m
additional: Race check-in takes place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall. Runners must collect their race number and chip for electronic timing. Winners are presented with their awards after each race in turn, and winners are required to attend the ceremony. Registration is by email. The event includes various age groups and races on city streets and at the sports hall.

name: Svatojánská 20
location: TJ Lokomotiva Beroun, Beroun, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Svatojánská 20 is a traditional running race held in Beroun, offering two main routes of 11 and 18 kilometres. The start and finish are at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium. The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and the Loděnice Stream, with turnarounds at the settlement of V Kozle (11 km) and in Svatý Jan pod Skálou (18 km). The race is open to a wide range of age groups and offers refreshments at the finish, as well as cash and non-cash prizes for the top runners.
course_highlights: The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and the Loděnice Stream
The 11 km route turns around at the settlement of V Kozle; the 18 km route turns around in Svatý Jan pod Skálou
The start and finish are at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium
additional: On-site check-in and registration on race day from 11:00 to 12:40. Runners who register in advance and pay by 5 November will receive a race number bearing their name. Finish-line refreshments include tea and biscuits. The race takes place in open traffic; participants must obey traffic regulations and take part at their own risk. Parking is available around the stadium; nearby car parks are recommended because of the blue parking zones. Online and on-site registration are available. Medals and certificates are awarded, and cash prizes are paid.

name: Kovářská pětka
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Kovárna VIVA a spolkem Běhy Zlín
description: Kovářská pětka is a traditional 5-kilometre city road race held in the Baťa complex in Zlín. The race is open to both adults and children and is organised by Kovárna VIVA in cooperation with the Běhy Zlín association. The event offers a high-quality sporting experience in the centre of the regional capital, with international participation. It attracts a wide running community every year and is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organised proceedings.
course_highlights: The course runs through the former Baťa complex in Zlín
A 5-kilometre road race in an urban setting
The race is suitable for adults and children
additional: The race is part of a year-round competition for runners from the Zlín region. The organisers provide online results and event photos. Children’s categories are also included. The event provides professional timing and support for the regional running community. It is part of a series of races in Zlín, offers various age categories and is suitable for the general public.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - listopad
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race is suitable for slow and fast runners, experienced runners and beginners who want to improve their personal best, train, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park setting. After the finish, everyone receives a warm cinnamon pancake. Times are recorded for every participant and results are published online; they count toward the year-round Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs along Stromovka’s paved paths
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful setting of Královská obora–Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (beneath the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Arriving by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings (unattended), along with a mobile valuables storage service. Toilet cabins are available on site. Start at 9:07; registration from 8:15 to 8:45; online registration available. The race takes place in Královská obora–Stromovka Park. Parking is by the bridge to Císařský Island; changing facilities and toilets are available.

name: Labský půlmaraton
location: Lysá nad Labem, Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: The Labský Half Marathon is a running race held in Lysá nad Labem, offering two courses of approximately 12.5 km and 21.3 km. The routes pass through the flat Polabí forest, on a mix of paved and unpaved roads, trails, and short sections of asphalt or concrete. The start and finish are at the racecourse, where refreshments, baggage storage, and other facilities are available. The race is suitable for the general public and is limited to 700 participants. The program also includes children’s races with distances varying by age.
course_highlights: The courses are flat and run through the beautiful Polabí forest
Start after approximately 1 km on the racecourse
Refreshment stations at km 8 and 17 on the 21 km course, and one station at km 8 on the 12 km course
additional: The race is limited to 700 participants. Baggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments, and a raffle are available for runners. Parking in the venue costs 50 CZK per car. Children’s races range from 200 to 1,000 metres depending on age. The route is marked with ribbons, signs, and flour arrows, and each kilometre is marked approximately. The race includes children’s races, registration is available online, and the route may be modified due to reconstruction work in the area.

name: Závod dvojic
description: Hostivařské dvojice is a relay running race for pairs, offering a unique team-running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Hostivař. The race is for pairs who want to enjoy a sporting challenge as well as the friendly atmosphere. The route passes through scenic terrain and is suitable for runners of all levels. Come for a run and enjoy a great sporting event in a welcoming community.
course_highlights: Relay race in pairs
Scenic surroundings of Hostivař
Friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, in Kladno. It is a team relay event, and registration is available online.

name: Hornická desítka
location: Národní dům, Frýdek-Místek, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hornická desítka is a traditional running race held in Frýdek-Místek. It has been held since 1980, with interruptions, and the tradition was revived in 1996. The event offers various running disciplines, including youth races, a Run for Health and the main 10 km race. It celebrates exercise and sporting spirit, attracting hundreds to thousands of participants of all ages. It is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere. The race starts at the National House in Frýdek-Místek and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: The course runs in the Frýdek-Místek area; the event dates back to 1980
A main 10 km race, accompanied by youth races and a Run for Health
Start and finish at the National House in Frýdek-Místek
additional: The event includes a non-competitive parents-and-children run, youth races, a Run for Health and the main 10 km race. It is known for its excellent organization and relaxed atmosphere. The organizer is Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s. The race takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at the National House in Frýdek-Místek. The event involves road closures and traffic measures.

name: Malá Pardubická cross country
location: Labe and vicinity, near TJ Dynamo canoe club, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Malá Pardubická - cross country is a traditional cross-country race organized by the AC Pardubice athletics club. The race takes place near the Elbe River and close to the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoe club. The organizers warmly invite all runners and running fans to this popular event, which offers a sporting experience in a natural setting. The race regulations and further information are available on the club’s website.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on natural terrain near the Elbe River
Start and finish close to the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoe club
A traditional running event organized by AC Pardubice
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, is open to the general public, including children and young people, and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Žandovská desítka
description: Žandovská desítka is a traditional 10-kilometer race held in Žandov in the Liberec Region. The event is part of the Českolipsko District Running League and welcomes runners of all ages. The course runs on both roads and trails, offering varied surroundings for competitors. The race is popular with the regional running community and provides an opportunity to challenge yourself and meet fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The course runs on both roads and trails
Part of the regional Českolipsko running league
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race takes place in November 2026. Registration and further details are not specified. The event is part of a broader series of regional races.

name: Dobřichovický běh
location: Škvárový stadion TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Run is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers runners a course approximately 6 km long. The race starts at the cinder track at TJ Sokol Dobřichovice and follows farm roads, providing pleasant running terrain. The event is suitable for both adults and children, who have their own races. The main race starts at 13:00 and is organized by ASK Dipoli.
course_highlights: Course approximately 6 km long
Starts at the cinder track at TJ Sokol Dobřichovice
The course follows farm roads
additional: Start location: TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Pražská 375. The course was measured by GPS at 5.72 km, though the race information lists it as 6 km. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup, which also includes children's races. The course combines a cinder track and farm roads. The course includes a cinder track and farm roads; online registration is available; races are suitable for all age groups.

name: Velká kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Velká kunratická is one of the oldest running races in the Czech lands. It is held every year on the second Sunday in November in Kunratice Forest in Prague. The race has been run continuously since 1934 and is known for its challenging course and changeable weather, which contribute to its unique atmosphere. A wide range of runners take part, from young children to veterans, competing on six courses ranging from 370 to 3,100 metres. The event is organised by the Spartak Praha 4 athletics club.
course_highlights: Challenging courses through Kunratice Forest
Six courses ranging from 370 m to 3,100 m
Wave starts in pairs, with a 10-second interval
additional: All categories start in pairs at 10-second intervals. Official BUSHMAN-brand T-shirts are available exclusively during registration. Ordered T-shirts can be collected at the tent on the dam. The total number of participants is limited to 3,600, with a limit of 2,700 runners on the route over Hrádek. Registration changes can be made by email until 14 October 2026; after that, they can only be made at check-in. The race takes place in November, with the number of participants limited to 3,400. Online registration opens on 5 October 2026, and on-site registration is available. There are various age and performance categories.

name: Jizerun

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Jizerun is a relay running race from Prague to the Jizera Mountains, following the Jizera River. Teams of 4–5 runners cover a total of 165 km along cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains in a single day. The race offers a unique sporting experience and the chance to work as a team in men’s, women’s, mixed, and corporate categories. The route is divided into several stages of varying difficulty, allowing each runner to choose a suitable segment.
course_highlights: A 165 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains along cycle paths and trails
A relay race for teams of 4–5 in several categories
Stages with difficulty ratings from 1 to 8 on a 10-point scale, across varied terrain
additional: The entry fee includes timing, GPX tracking and the JIZERUN app, portable toilets, finish-area facilities including showers, a speaker and sound system, medical services throughout the race, gifts from partners, photos and video, and full event staffing and all relevant permits. The route is divided into 14 stages of varying lengths and difficulty; for example, the Bradlec–Klášter stage is 14.7 km and rated 7/10. The 2026 edition is sold out; the organizer mentions a waiting list. Teams consist of four or five runners.

description: The Run Against Addiction is a running race in Homolka Forest Park in Plzeň, with courses for different age groups, from children to adults. The route follows paved paths and includes both flat children’s courses and the varied terrain of the 6 km main race. There is also a relay race for teams of three, with each runner completing one lap. The event is suitable for runners of all abilities who want to support the fight against addiction and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in nature.
course_highlights: The route follows paved paths in Homolka Forest Park
The 6 km main race features varied terrain and three laps
The children’s courses are flat and adapted to different age groups
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 9:00 to 10:30. Children’s races begin at 10:00, with staggered starts by age group. The men’s and women’s main races and the relay start at 11:30. The relay has three runners, each completing one lap of approximately 2,000 m. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 12:15. A recommended route is available on Garmin Connect as a single lap, which will be run three times during the race. The organizer lists children’s races and a 6 km race; Kudy z nudy also lists a 3 × 2 km relay for 2026. The race regulations available on the organizer’s website are for the 2024 and 2025 editions, so prices from those editions have not been assigned to the 2026 race.

description: Krumlovská 11 is a St. Martin’s charity run held on 8 November 2026 at Hornobránský Pond in Český Krumlov. It offers a main run of approximately 11 km for runners aged 15 and over, a family run for children aged 2 to 15, and relay races. The route passes through beautiful countryside via Křížová hora and Přídolí. The event supports the Personal Assistance social service, which helps children with disabilities and seniors in the region. There is also a varied program of accompanying activities and running T-shirts available to purchase.
course_highlights: Main route: approx. 11 km via Křížová hora and Přídolí
Family run: 1–2 km depending on age category
Relay race: 2 × 5.5 km, with the baton exchange at Hornobránský Pond
additional: The main run and relay races start at 12:11; the family run begins from 10:01, with staggered start times for the different categories. The main run has a capacity of 200 runners, and the family run a capacity of 200 children. Race packs with bib numbers can be collected at the venue from 8:45 to 11:30. Running T-shirts and St. Martin’s goose are available to purchase for an additional fee. Relays may be women’s, men’s, mixed or corporate. The event is a charity event, with proceeds supporting the Personal Assistance social service in Český Krumlov. The start and finish are at Hornobránský Pond; the main run starts from 12:11. Online registration is open until 30 October 2026 and is mandatory. The race has a capacity of 200 participants.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - září
location: Madal Bal, Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and follows an accurately measured asphalt loop. Every participant can enjoy the run, and a warm cinnamon pancake awaits at the finish line. The race takes place regularly on the first Saturday of every month, with timed results and prizes for the top finishers in the men’s, women’s, and children’s categories.
course_highlights: An accurately measured asphalt loop of just under two laps (3.2 km)
The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to 12 years old. Every runner is timed, and the top three in each category receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The start is at 9:00. The top three in the women’s, men’s, and children’s categories receive small prizes.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - září
location: Bruselská brána, Královská obora Stromovka, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Prague is an open race for the public, held in the beautiful surroundings of Královská obora – Stromovka park. The course follows the park’s paved paths. Adults run two laps (2 miles, 3.2 km), while children up to 12 years old run one lap (1 mile + 70 m). The race is part of the year-round Lívancový pohár, which recognizes performances adjusted using an age coefficient. Register on site at the Bruselská Gate or online in advance for faster check-in. The race usually starts at 9:07 on the first Saturday of each month.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths in Stromovka park
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1 mile + 70 m)
Beautiful surroundings in Královská obora – Stromovka, with almost no rain
additional: On-site registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is also available for faster check-in. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings (unattended), along with a mobile valuables storage service and portable toilets. Arriving by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský ostrov on Za elektrárnou street. The race takes place on the first Saturday of each month. On-site registration is from 8:15 to 8:45, and the first start is at 9:07; you can also register online. Adults run two laps and children run one.

Every child participant will receive a reward. The children’s races have a capacity of 40.

name: BĚHÁMOS - rodinné běžecké závody
description:
🏃‍♀️🏃 BĚHÁMOS – family running races by Holasice Primary and Nursery School
On Sunday, October 4, from 10:00, we’ll get Holasice moving!
Register HERE:
https://forms.gle/duaUcTh2u7ZRpg1v8
BĚHÁMOS is a family running event that brings together what matters to us: children, adults, school, exercise and Holasice. And since we’re a school, our most famous teacher, Jan Amos Komenský, has to be part of it too. That’s where BĚH + ÁMOS = BĚHÁMOS comes from.
We don’t just want to organize a race to see who gets the best times. We want to create a day when children, parents, grandparents, friends and neighbors can all meet in one place. In short, a sports gathering with a family atmosphere.
📅 SUNDAY, 4 OCTOBER 2026
📍 Na Cihelně sports ground, Holasice
https://mapy.com/s/locojejatu
⏱️ Races start from 10:00
📝 Race check-in: 9:00–9:30
🏅 CATEGORIES
AMOS’S LITTLE SPROUTS
born 2021–2023 | 200 m
AMOS’S LITTLE RUNNERS
born 2019–2020 | 250 m
AMOS’S SPEEDSTERS
born 2017–2018 | 500 m
AMOS’S AGILE RUNNERS
born 2015–2016 | 750 m
AMOS’S QUICKSTEPS
born 2013–2014 | 1,400 m
AMOS’S DASHERS
born 2011–2012 | 1,400 m
BĚHÁMOS RUNNERS
born 1592–2010 | 3,200 m
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 AMOS’S FAMILY RELAY
4 × 250 m | 2 adults + 2 children under 14.9 years old
To finish, we’ll join forces in Amos’s family relay. And “family” doesn’t mean you have to show a birth certificate when you register. 😊
Each four-person team simply consists of two adults and two children. Parents can run with their children, a mom with an uncle, two dads, two moms, or even two families who are friends. You don’t have to be related—the important thing is to put together a team of 2 + 2 and BĚHÁMOS!
📝 REGISTRATION
Runners can register online until 2 October here: https://forms.gle/duaUcTh2u7ZRpg1v8
or on race day at the venue (cash only).
Race check-in will take place on race day from 9:00 to 9:30.
👧 Children – FREE
👨 Adults – 100 Kč
🏆 WHAT’S IN STORE?
Medals and prizes will be provided for runners. Refreshments, facilities and portable toilets will also be available.
Above all, though, we want to enjoy a pleasant morning of sport where the most important thing isn’t who finishes first, but that we BĚHÁMOS together.
⚠️ PARTICIPATION AND RESPONSIBILITY
Each runner takes part in the race voluntarily and at their own responsibility and risk. By registering, they confirm that they are medically fit to complete the chosen course. The legal guardian is responsible for the health and safety of any underage runner.
Runners must follow the organizers’ instructions and behave in a way that does not endanger themselves or other participants.
🏫 ORGANIZERS
Holasice Primary School and the Municipality of Holasice
📧 Contact: behamos@seznam.cz
So, who’s going to BĚHÁMOS with us? 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️

location: Loděnice SK Zlíchov, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Dívčí Hrady Maiden’s Pie Run is a traditional running race organized by SK Zlíchov Praha, held on the first Saturday in November. The race has a friendly atmosphere and a limited number of participants, making for a relaxed, sunny event. Everyone who takes part is a winner, as every runner gets a pie. The event is suitable for all age groups, with veterans making up the largest category. The race starts at 9 a.m. at the SK Zlíchov boathouse in Prague.
course_highlights: A traditional November run with a friendly atmosphere
A limited number of participants for a relaxed event
The Veterans category has the most participants
additional: The event is limited to 40 runners. Traditionally, there is a pie for every participant after the race. In 2025, the event was affected by a change of date, but next year’s edition returns to its usual date on the first Saturday in November. The organizer lists the start time as 9:00. In the 2025 edition, registration took place from 9:00 at the SK Zlíchov boathouse; the race started at 10:30. The schedule and fee for 2026 may differ.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske
description: The Strážske Liberation Run is a traditional race held to mark the anniversary of the city’s liberation. This sporting celebration attracts runners of different age groups, including youth and adults, who compete over various distances. The event is organized by the City of Strážske in cooperation with the MBO Strážske running club and is known for its long history and strong community spirit. Runners can enjoy the city’s atmosphere while testing their abilities in a friendly yet competitive environment.
course_highlights: Several categories, including youth and adults
Start in front of the Strážske Municipal Office building
A traditional race with a long history and community support
additional: The event has a long-standing tradition, and in 2026 it will be held for the 49th time. Runners are divided into several age groups, including preschoolers, schoolchildren, and adults. After the race, the fastest runners in each category receive awards, and a raffle with valuable prizes is held. The course runs through the city of Strážske, with the finish in front of the Municipal Office building.

description: On the evening of August 21, the Jonava Sports Center invited running enthusiasts to the fourth stage of the Jonava Running Cup. This time, participants took on a scenic 7 km course in the village of Panoteriai. This August was a special one for the village, marking the 115th anniversary of Panoteriai School and the 30th anniversary of the consecration of the Church of the Discovery of the Holy Cross. Although heavy rain accompanied the runners, it did not dampen the festive atmosphere—the awards ceremony was held inside the Panoteriai church.

Participants can choose from a range of distances: 42 km, 21 km 98 m, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, and a 200 m children’s race.

description: The “Come and Conquer” run is an unforgettable event full of challenges and surprises. The most enduring runners are invited to set off on an adventure through the hills and valleys of Ąžuolynas Park! From a true test of endurance to active entertainment, there’s something for everyone among the different race distances and obstacle courses—whether you’re a thrill-seeker or an enthusiast of active recreation. This year, the run attracted a record number of participants and was held at the KTU Student Campus and in Ąžuolynas Park.

description: The renewed and unique representative Šiauliai Run 2024 will take place on September 22 at 12:00. THE BIG START. The run will follow the city’s central streets, passing places significant to Šiauliai’s history. It is for people of all ages, from recreational runners to professionals. The program includes a 700 m children’s run, a 1236 m run commemorating the date of the Battle of the Sun, and 5 km and 10 km runs.

name: Gintarinė jūrmylė
description: “Gintarinė jūrmylė 2025” will take place in beautiful Smiltynė, with the start and finish at the Sports and Wellness Base. Entry is free for participants under 20 and LLAF members if they register by 11 p.m. on October 8. Registration on October 9 until 3 p.m. costs 5 euros. The race covers 3 nautical miles (5.55 km – one lap) for women and junior girls, and 6 nautical miles (11.11 km – two laps) for men and junior boys.

name: Vilnius 700 Ultra
description: The “Vilnius 700 Ultra” run will take place in Vingis Park on October 12, 2024. The event’s partners are the Amatininkų klubas “Dvaro meistrai.” Race bibs will be issued on race day from 8:00. All distances will start at 9:00, and the time limit for the 70 km and 70 km relay races is 8 hours. The winners and prizewinners will be awarded at 17:00.

distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratonas, 30 km, Pusmaratonas, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: Trail Kursiu Nerija (#TKN) is an unforgettable running adventure with incredible views and plenty of sand! This race takes place on the Curonian Spit and offers a range of distances—from 1 km to 104 km—so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.

name: Graužikai - Kelmė Race
description: The “Graužikai–Kelmė” V. Rimkus Memorial Run took place on October 28, 2023, in Kelmė, marking the 50th anniversary of this traditional event. This year, more than 200 runners from across Lithuania and guests from Ukraine took part. Vitalij Kuznetsov was the fastest in the 8 km race. The fastest woman was Aurika Balsytė, who is from Kelmė District. There was also a 1.8 km race, in which Lukas Mikavičius performed best, and a 200 m race for young children.

name: Pagarbos bėgimas IN MEMORIAM
location: Vingio parko estrada, M. K. Čiurlionio gatvė, Vilnius
description: On October 19 at 10:00, the 10th annual “In Memoriam” tribute and charity run will take place in Vingis Park, Vilnius, honoring those who sacrificed their lives for our freedom. The event brings together a community committed to remembering and commemorating these heroes. Participants in the 10 km race will compete for awards in the Open Lithuanian Armed Forces Championship. There will also be non-competitive 1 km and 4 km options to run, walk or roll; no winners or prize-winners will be selected.

name: Krosas Juodšilių ruduo
description: On October 25, 2025, the “Sporto renginiai” association and the Juodšiliai Eldership of Vilnius District Municipality are organizing the “Juodšilių ruduo” sports festival. The race course includes the forest trail on Mokyklos St. and the forest trails on Šilo St. One lap is 4.5 km long. Race bibs will be handed out and new participants can register from 10:00 to 11:30. Races start at 12:00 with the 600 m run, followed at 12:15 by the 4.5 km, 9 km and 18 km distances.

name: Panevėžio maratonas
description: The Panevėžys Marathon 2024 will take place in Panevėžys, Lithuania, and registration will open on September 13, 2024. Anyone who has registered and had a health check may participate. Participants can choose from various distances: a 400 m walk, 2.8 km, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon, with different age requirements.

name: PINK RUN su Antėja
description: PINK RUN with Antėja is an annual pink ribbon charity run dedicated to the fight against breast cancer and the prevention of this disease. Join our event in the heart of Kaunas—Laisvės Avenue—and run for the women you love. Support the fight against breast cancer by taking part in runs of various distances for both professionals and amateurs. Pink Run with Antėja is more than a run; it is a message that we love them.
